title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
summary: Can a robot improve itself the way coding agents now improve software? We built an agentic system to find out. It watches a robot fail, works out which capability is missing, writes new skills or finds and installs external models, tests every change in simulation, and repeats, with no human writing robot code. We ran it for 123 improvement rounds on household manipulation tasks. This report describes what we learned. The good news is that the agent can discover capabilities on its own: noticing that its targets were out of view, it asked for an active-viewing model, debugged it, and deployed a working search skill. The bad news is that its improvements did not add up. Changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task, putting condiments on the top shelf of a fridge, never succeeded. We found that the agent was rarely the bottleneck. Three things around it were. First, chained perception modules do not understand relations. Segmenters such as SAM 3 find shelves but not "the top shelf", so the agent filled the gap with ever more geometric rules that never converged, when what it needed was a different kind of model. Second, skill chains lock learning onto the first step. Long tasks mostly fail early, so evidence and fixes pile up there, and later skills are rarely reached, tested, or improved. Third, what the agent learns is decided by the harness. The agent optimized exactly what the evaluator measured, including where it was wrong, and weak tests and misleading memory turned activity into a standstill. We distill these lessons into concrete recommendations for building robot systems that improve themselves, each paired with an experiment that could prove it wrong.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个机器人自我改进的智能体系统，在123轮家庭操作任务迭代中，智能体能够自主发现并部署缺失能力（如主动视角搜索），但改进无法累积，目标任务（把调料放上冰箱顶层）始终失败。作者归因于三个系统层面瓶颈：感知模块链缺乏关系理解、技能链使学习锁定在首步、评测框架决定了学习内容，并给出可证伪的改进建议。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能自主改进软件，作者想验证同样的自我改进范式能否迁移到机器人：让系统在无人写机器人代码的情况下，自动发现缺失能力、编写新技能或集成外部模型、在仿真中验证并迭代。其真正动机不仅是展示可行性，更在于揭示"为什么这种自动化改进循环在机器人上难以奏效"的系统性原因。
AI.method: 搭建一个智能体闭环系统：观察机器人失败→诊断缺失能力→编写新技能或检索并安装外部模型→在仿真中测试每次修改→重复，全程无人工编写机器人代码。在家庭操作任务上运行123轮改进。通过分析每轮改动的通过/失败记录、感知模块的行为与技能链的执行轨迹，定位瓶颈来源。
AI.result: 智能体确实能自主发现能力缺口：它注意到目标不在视野内，主动请求一个主动视角模型，调试后部署了可用的搜索技能。但改进不累积——变更持续通过各自的测试，而目标任务（把调料放到冰箱顶层）从未成功。作者发现智能体本身很少是瓶颈，真正的障碍来自三个周边因素：(1) 链式感知模块不理解关系，SAM 3 类分割器能找到货架却无法理解"顶层货架"，智能体只能堆砌不收敛的几何规则；(2) 技能链把学习锁定在第一步，长任务多早期失败，证据与修复堆积在那里，后续技能很少被触及和测试；(3) 评测框架决定学习内容，智能体精确优化了评测者所度量的东西（包括其错误之处），弱测试与误导性记忆使活动变成停滞。
AI.conclusion: 机器人自我改进的主要瓶颈不在智能体而在系统架构：需要能表达关系的感知模型（而非几何规则补丁）、能摆脱"首步锁定"的课程与技能学习机制、以及不易被钻空子的评测与记忆设计。作者据此提炼出可操作建议，并为每条建议配对一个可证伪实验。

title: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, prompts, and skills: this https URL
summary: General-purpose multimodal agents can write robot-control programs, but repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection can make execution slow. We study how external body knowledge, successful experience, and executable skills improve an XLeRobot controlled by GPT-6-Astra in a simulated and a physical elevator-button task. In 30 fixed-start simulation trials, complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% relative to a baseline with only the common control interface and no prior experience; images with synchronized action and state records reduce it by 68.6% without additional body assets. In nine paired comparisons (18 trials) at starts displaced by 10-100 cm, experience recorded at the original start reduces mean time by 58-63% relative to no experience, demonstrating generalization to the tested new starting positions. During experience experiments, GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generates a short visual-feedback program. Researcher-refactored versions reduce mean local-task time by 29-31% in 27 simulation trials. Finally, 12 real-robot trials using operator-confirmed button contact demonstrate sim2real reuse: at a shared nominal start, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, respectively; real experience also transfers to two new starts. These results suggest a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments around GPT-6-Astra: supply machine-readable body descriptions and synchronized demonstrations, and turn useful agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, while the agent adapts actions from current images. We release all task prompts, trial-level experimental data, and acquired skill implementations at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何通过提供机器可读的身体描述、同步的示范经验以及将智能体自生成的反馈程序重构为可复用技能，来加速 GPT-6-Astra 控制 XLeRobot 的电梯按钮操作任务，并在仿真与真机上验证了显著的时间缩减与 sim2real 迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态智能体虽能编写机器人控制程序，但反复探索与模型介导的动作选择导致执行缓慢。作者希望探究外部身体知识、成功经验与可执行技能如何提升执行效率，并寻找构建通用操作实验的实用范式。
AI.method: 以 GPT-6-Astra 控制 XLeRobot 完成仿真与真机电梯按钮任务。对比三类先验：(1) 完整机器人几何与相机信息；(2) 与动作/状态同步记录的图像；(3) 记录在原始起点的经验。并让智能体自发生成短视觉反馈程序，再由研究者重构为可复用技能。
AI.result: 30 次固定起点仿真中，几何+相机信息使平均完成时间降 57.4%，同步图像+动作状态记录降 68.6%；起点偏移 10-100 cm 的 9 组配对比较中经验使时间降 58-63%；重构技能使局部任务时间降 29-31%（27 次仿真）；12 次真机试验中仿真 XML 资产与仿真经验分别降 53.0% 与 49.9%，真机经验亦可迁移至两个新起点。
AI.conclusion: 围绕 GPT-6-Astra 构建通用操作实验的实用路径是：提供机器可读身体描述与同步示范，将智能体生成的有用反馈例程转化为可复用技能，同时让智能体依据当前图像自适应调整动作。作者公开了任务提示、试验级数据与技能实现。

title: Reduced Cartesian Kinetostatics for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots: Residual-Stabilized Full-Shape Propagation
summary: Many planning and control tasks for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) require the complete Cartesian backbone geometry. We present a reduced Cartesian framework for planar, axially compressible TDCRs that propagates equilibrium configurations along prescribed tendon-force and tendon-displacement trajectories. The backbone is represented by two global position fields. Following exact variation, a Taylor-Galerkin reduction condenses prescribed spatial properties and distributed loads into offline moment vectors, yielding analytic reduced residuals and Jacobians without online spatial quadrature or numerical differentiation. Analytical differentiation and residual correction yield first-order rate systems requiring one fixed-dimensional linear solve per rate evaluation after initial equilibrium alignment on a regular branch. Across four simulated cases covering variable tendon routing, nonuniform geometry, axial compression, and their combined effects, the propagated Cartesian shapes and distributed strains closely match pointwise geometrically variable-strain (GVS) equilibrium solutions. Residual correction suppresses propagation drift across the tested step sizes while adding only about 0.98% to the mean update time of uncorrected Euler. The proposed method requires 0.508 ms per update on average, approximately 11 times faster than pointwise GVS solves. Displacement-driven experiments yield a maximum normalized mean backbone position error of 1.02% and a maximum end-effector position error of 0.28%. These results support efficient and accurate Cartesian full-shape prediction along prescribed actuation paths.

AI.tldr: 面向平面轴向可压缩腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR），提出降阶笛卡尔骨架建模框架：以两个全局位置场描述骨架，经变分与Taylor-Galerkin降阶将空间属性与分布载荷离线凝聚为矩向量，得到解析残差与雅可比，实现沿给定腱力/腱位移轨迹的高效平衡构型传播。
AI.motivation: TDCR的规划与控制任务需要完整的笛卡尔骨架几何，而逐点几何变应变（GVS）平衡求解计算昂贵，难以在线沿执行轨迹快速更新；需要一种兼具精度与效率的全形状预测方法。
AI.method: 采用两个全局位置场表示骨架的降阶笛卡尔框架；基于精确变分推导，用Taylor-Galerkin降阶将空间属性与分布载荷离线凝聚为矩向量，从而免去在线空间求积与数值微分，给出解析降阶残差与雅可比；解析微分加残差校正得到一阶速率系统，在初始平衡对齐于正则分支后每次速率评估仅需一次固定维线性求解。
AI.result: 四组仿真（变腱路由、非均匀几何、轴向压缩及组合效应）中，传播的笛卡尔形状与分布应变与逐点GVS解逐点吻合；残差校正抑制了传播漂移，仅增加约0.98%的平均更新时间；平均每次更新0.508 ms，约为逐点GVS求解的11倍速；位移驱动实验最大归一化平均骨架位置误差1.02%，末端位置误差0.28%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在给定驱动路径下实现高效、精确的笛卡尔全形状预测，适用于TDCR的规划与控制。但验证目前限于平面情形与仿真，尚未给出三维空间与真机部署证据。

title: Timed Rule-Based Supervision of an End-to-End Autonomous Parking Policy
summary: We study whether a manually specified runtime supervisor can correct recurring failures of an existing end-to-end parking policy in a fixed CARLA parking lot. The vision-based Transformer architecture is inherited from Yang et al.; our contribution is a timed, rule-based Parametric Safety Shield (PSS) applied to its control outputs. The PSS uses hand-calibrated speed, position, and duration thresholds to intervene in observed failure modes, including boundary exits, delayed braking, and stalled or oscillatory control. In the reported closed-loop evaluation, 16 held-out target slots and six initial poses are each evaluated in four rounds (384 attempts per configuration). Target success increases from 327/384 (85.16%) for the retrained policy to 375/384 (97.66%) with the PSS; mean position and orientation errors among successful attempts are 0.21m and 0.33 degrees. These results show an improvement within this simulator setup. The repeated attempts share one map, vehicle, and sensor configuration, and the PSS uses simulator world coordinates; thus the results do not establish generalization to other lots or real vehicles, or a formal safety guarantee.

AI.tldr: 在固定CARLA停车场中对已有端到端泊车策略加装手调阈值的时间规则安全盾(PSS)，成功率由85.16%升至97.66%。
AI.motivation: 端到端视觉泊车策略在闭环执行中会出现反复出现的失效模式（越界、制动延迟、停滞/振荡），论文希望以轻量、可解释的运行时监督器在不重训主干网络的前提下修正这些失效。
AI.method: 沿用Yang等的视觉Transformer端到端泊车策略，在其控制输出上叠加定时的、基于规则的参数化安全盾(PSS)，用手工标定的速度、位置与持续时间阈值对失效模式进行干预；在单一地图、单一车辆与传感器配置下，对16个留出车位、6个初始位姿各做4轮闭环评估。
AI.result: 目标成功率从重训策略的327/384(85.16%)提升至加入PSS后的375/384(97.66%)；成功尝试的平均位置误差0.21m、朝向误差0.33°。作者明确指出未证明对其他停车场或真实车辆的泛化，也未提供形式化安全保证。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在该仿真器设定内规则式运行时安全盾可有效抑制端到端泊车策略的重复失效，但属于工程性、场景受限的改进，缺乏泛化性与形式化保证。

title: Path Planning with Motion Primitives in Dynamic Environments: SIPP on Lattices
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Interactive Collaborative Robotics (ICR 2026), Vladivostok, Russia
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is a critical challenge, particularly when spaces are shared with other mobile agents whose future trajectories are known. While traditional grid-based planners efficiently find collision-free paths, their reliance on stop-and-turn mechanics over $2^k$-connected grids produces piecewise-linear trajectories that are kinodynamically highly sub-optimal for differentially constrained robots. In this paper, we present an adaptation of Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) that operates on state lattices, utilizing precomputed, kinodynamically smooth motion primitives. To efficiently handle dynamic environments, we rasterize the spatiotemporal swept volumes of moving obstacles directly onto the grid, treating grid cells as atomic units of space, whose resolution is typically dictated by inherent localization noise. We perform a comprehensive comparative analysis between our lattice-based approach and $2^k$-connected grid planners across diverse topological environments. Our evaluation considers a broad spectrum of performance metrics, including planning time, path angularity, cumulative heading change (angle-over-length), and bending energy. The results demonstrate that while the expanded state space of lattice-based search increases computational overhead, it yields trajectories with significantly superior kinodynamic properties. Specifically, our method achieves a reachability comparable to highly connected grids while ensuring smooth, continuous, and physically executable paths ready for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将安全区间路径规划（SIPP）扩展到状态格上，使用预计算的动力学平滑运动基元，并通过将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体积栅格化来处理动态环境，实现平滑可执行路径。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中共享空间的自主导航中，传统2^k连通栅格规划器依赖停车转向机制，生成的轨迹为分段线性，对差速约束机器人而言运动动力学上高度次优。
AI.method: 提出在状态格（state lattice）上运行的SIPP变体：使用预计算的、运动动力学平滑的运动基元；将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体积直接栅格化到网格上，把网格单元视为原子空间单位（分辨率由定位噪声决定）；在多种拓扑环境中与2^k连通栅格规划器进行全面对比，评估规划时间、路径角度性、累积航向变化（角度/长度比）和弯曲能量等指标。
AI.result: 格基搜索因状态空间扩展带来更高计算开销，但生成轨迹的运动动力学性质显著更优；可达性与高连通栅格相当，同时保证平滑、连续、物理可执行的路径，可直接用于真实部署。
AI.conclusion: 在状态格上结合SIPP与运动基元，是动态环境下处理已知未来轨迹移动障碍物的有效且可部署的方案，在平滑性与可达性间取得良好平衡。

title: Humanoid Badminton: Learning Dynamic Racket Skills from Limited Human Motion Data
summary: High-speed racket sports provide a demanding testbed for humanoid robots, requiring time-critical decisions, precise striking, and dynamic whole-body coordination. In badminton, fast-changing shuttle trajectories require timely contact decisions, while successful returns demand precise racket pose and velocity within a brief contact window and across a broad three-dimensional striking workspace. Human motion data provide valuable priors for such athletic skills, but usable badminton references are limited and imperfect. Direct tracking provides insufficient executable variation for diverse shuttle conditions, while purely task-driven optimization may produce unnatural motion. To address these challenges, we present a three-stage hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic humanoid badminton. First, task-randomized motion augmentation expands sparse annotated hitting events into executable target-conditioned stroke variations, forming a continuous latent skill space. Second, a high-level planner outputs continuous latent skill codes to compose these skills online according to the observed shuttle state. Third, a context-conditioned adversarial regularizer encourages more natural planner-level skill usage while preserving return performance. When deployed on a real humanoid robot, our system achieves sustained multi-skill rallies with human players, including forehand, backhand, and highly dynamic jump returns. This is the first real-world humanoid racket-sport system to demonstrate multi-skill human--robot rallies including highly dynamic jump returns.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段分层强化学习框架，使真实人形机器人实现羽毛球多技能对打（含跳跃回球）。
AI.motivation: 高速球拍类运动对人形机器人是极高难度的测试场景：需要在极短接触窗口内完成击球决策、精确的拍面位姿与速度控制，并覆盖大范围三维击球空间。人类羽毛球动作数据稀缺且不完美——直接轨迹跟踪无法提供足够多变的可执行动作，而纯任务驱动优化又容易产生不自然动作。因此需要一个既能覆盖多样来球条件、又能保持自然人味的技能生成与调度方法。
AI.method: 三阶段分层强化学习：(1) 任务随机化动作增强，将稀疏标注的击球事件扩展为目标条件化的可执行击球变体，构成连续潜在技能空间；(2) 高层规划器根据观测到的羽毛球状态在线输出连续潜在技能编码，组合底层技能；(3) 上下文条件的对抗正则项，在不损失回球性能的前提下使规划器层面的技能使用更接近自然人类动作。最终部署于真实人形机器人。
AI.result: 在真实人形机器人上实现与人类选手持续多技能回合对打，涵盖正手、反手以及高动态跳跃回球；作者称这是首个展示含高动态跳跃回球的多人形—机器人球拍运动对打的真实世界系统。
AI.conclusion: 利用人类动作先验经任务随机化增强后构建潜在技能空间，再用分层RL在线调度并以对抗正则保证自然性，是解决高动态人形球拍运动的可行路线；真实部署验证了多技能、高动态回球的可行性。局限在于对羽毛球这一单一任务、特定硬件与人类先验数据质量的依赖。

title: PHIRL: Aligning Learned Rewards with Task Progress for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human demonstrations provide dense policy-level information but sometimes lack local precision. Human feedback presents accurate local critiques, but offers sparse evaluations rather than direct policy guidance. We propose Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning (PHIRL), a data-efficient framework that learns robust reward functions by jointly leveraging demonstrations and feedback. Specifically, we use progress, a feedback modality that describes cumulative task completion. PHIRL iteratively infers a reward function from demonstrations via inverse reinforcement learning, calculates the learned rewards over the progress-annotated demonstrations, and aligns the rewards with progress annotations over four dimensions. We evaluate PHIRL on real and simulated robot tasks, with additional exploration using a fine-tuned vision-language model to provide progress feedback. Results demonstrate that PHIRL significantly outperforms the baselines, achieving substantially higher environmental return rewards and task success with only twenty percent of demonstrations annotated. Analysis of reward-hacking scenarios demonstrates that PHIRL learned reward functions are reliable against exploitation.

AI.tldr: 提出 PHIRL 框架，联合利用人类演示与"进度（progress）"反馈，通过迭代式逆强化学习与四维奖励对齐学习鲁棒奖励函数，在仅标注 20% 演示的条件下显著提升回报与任务成功率，并对奖励黑客具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人类演示可提供密集的策略级信息但局部精度不足；人类反馈能给出准确的局部评价但过于稀疏、缺乏直接策略指引。二者信息互补，因此需要一种数据高效的方式将两类信号联合起来学习奖励函数。
AI.method: PHIRL 迭代地由演示经逆强化学习推断奖励函数，在带进度标注的演示上计算学习到的奖励，并从四个维度将奖励与进度标注对齐；进度反馈描述任务的累积完成度。此外探索使用微调视觉语言模型自动生成进度反馈。
AI.result: 在真实与仿真机器人任务上评测，PHIRL 显著优于基线，在仅 20% 演示被标注的情况下取得明显更高的环境回报与任务成功率；奖励黑客场景分析显示所学奖励函数对利用行为具有可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将稠密但局部的进度反馈与演示联合用于 IRL，可低成本获得稳健奖励函数，提升样本效率与任务性能并抑制奖励黑客，具备应用于真实机器人学习的潜力。

title: Efficient Bezier Velocity Optimization for Free-Floating Space Manipulators
summary: We present FAVOR (Free-floating Arm Velocity Optimization with Recursive Sensitivities), a planner for collision-free reaching, tracking, and prescribed-time pre-grasp interception on an unactuated spacecraft. It optimizes Bezier joint-velocity curves with linear velocity, acceleration, and continuity constraints. Decision dimension is independent of rollout resolution. Analytical recursive sensitivities provide task and clearance gradients through the coupled base-arm motion. Parallel evaluation, caching, and incremental collision discovery reduce computation. With a seven-DoF arm and five simulated spacecraft models, FAVOR achieves 99.8% point-to-point success with 1.779 s mean computation, versus 62.9% and 50.270 s for an IK-initialized position-spline baseline. Means include failures and timeouts. FAVOR completes 30 of 36 tracking cases, versus 15 for single-step QP, and all 36 interception instances, versus 22 for the spline baseline. A controlled ablation shows that finite differences increase mean planning time 4.7-fold.

AI.tldr: 提出 FAVOR 规划器，用 Bezier 关节速度曲线与递归灵敏度，在无驱动航天器上实现无碰撞到达、跟踪与定时抓取前拦截。
AI.motivation: 自由漂浮航天器上机械臂运动受基座-臂耦合动力学影响，传统 IK 初始化+位置样条基线成功率低、计算耗时长，需一种决策维度与规划步长解耦、可高效处理耦合梯度与碰撞约束的规划方法。
AI.method: 以 Bezier 曲线参数化关节速度，施加线性速度、加速度与连续性约束；通过解析递归灵敏度获得任务与间隙梯度，贯穿耦合的基座-臂运动；采用并行评估、缓存与增量式碰撞发现降低计算量。
AI.result: 7-DoF 臂与五种仿真航天器模型：点对点成功率 99.8%、平均耗时 1.779 s，对比基线 62.9% 与 50.270 s；跟踪任务完成 30/36（单步 QP 为 15），拦截任务 36/36（样条基线 22）。消融显示有限差分使平均规划时间增加 4.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: FAVOR 在自由漂浮操作场景中以更高成功率和低一个量级的计算成本优于 IK 样条基线与单步 QP；解析递归灵敏度与增量碰撞发现是关键效率来源，但验证限于仿真。

title: Differentiable Dynamics for Autonomous Micro-Mobility Navigation
summary: Autonomous micro-mobility vehicles (MMVs) such as wheelchairs, scooters, and bicycles have the potential to improve mobility access and support safe low-speed transportation in pedestrian-shared spaces. Achieving MMV autonomy will require realistic, predictable MMV motion. However, many existing autonomous vehicle stacks rely on simplified kinematic models that fail to capture key MMV characteristics such as tire slip, friction, and wheel layouts, limiting realism and gradient-based optimization. In this paper, we explore differentiable formulations of dynamics models for autonomous micro-mobility systems. We first construct DiffKBM, a differentiable version of the kinematic bicycle model (KBM). Then, we introduce DiffGM3, a differentiable formulation of the General Micro-Mobility Model (GM3), a unified tire-based dynamics formulation for micro-mobility vehicles that supports a wide range of MMV configurations. DiffKBM and DiffGM3 enable end-to-end differentiable optimization through MMV dynamics, making them suitable for integration into differentiable autonomy stacks. We evaluate these dynamics models in both open-loop and closed-loop settings: (1) open-loop trajectory matching, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are integrated as a dynamics layer within DiffStack and optimized to reproduce real-world MMV trajectories, and (2) closed-loop autonomous navigation, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are paired with a differentiable MPC controller in CrowdNav pedestrian scenarios. In the open-loop setting, DiffGM3 outperforms DiffKBM in reproducing trajectories with improvements in ADE and NLL across bicycle, scooter, and motorcycle modes, and reductions in planning loss for bicycle and motorcycle trajectories. We also find that, in closed-loop settings, DiffGM3 improves on DiffKBM's CrowdNav performance by producing 55\% fewer collisions and a 75\% lower discomfort frequency for the bicycle mode.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可微的微出行载具动力学模型 DiffKBM（运动学自行车模型的可微版本）与 DiffGM3（统一轮胎式通用微出行模型 GM3 的可微形式），并将其作为动力学层嵌入 DiffStack 与可微 MPC 中，用于端到端轨迹匹配与人群场景下的闭环自主导航。
AI.motivation: 自主微出行载具（轮椅、滑板车、自行车）需在行人共享空间中实现安全低速自主行驶，但现有自动驾驶栈多依赖简化运动学模型，无法刻画轮胎滑移、摩擦与轮系布局等关键特征，导致真实性与基于梯度的优化能力受限。作者希望通过可微动力学建模，使微出行系统能融入可微自主栈。
AI.method: 1）构建 DiffKBM：运动学自行车模型（KBM）的可微形式；2）提出 DiffGM3：基于轮胎的通用微出行模型 GM3 的可微表述，支持多种微出行构型。二者支持通过微出行动力学进行端到端可微优化。评估分两类：（1）开环轨迹匹配：将两个模型作为 DiffStack 的动力学层，优化以复现真实微出行轨迹；（2）闭环自主导航：在 CrowdNav 行人场景中与可微 MPC 控制器配对。
AI.result: 开环设置中，DiffGM3 在自行车、滑板车与摩托车模态下复现轨迹的 ADE 与 NLL 均优于 DiffKBM，并降低自行车与摩托车的规划损失；闭环设置中，DiffGM3 相较 DiffKBM 在自行车模态下将 CrowdNav 碰撞减少 55%、不适频率降低 75%。
AI.conclusion: 可微的微出行动力学模型（尤其统一轮胎式 DiffGM3）在轨迹复现与人群导航安全性上均优于传统可微运动学模型，适合集成进可微自主栈，为微出行在行人共享空间的自主导航提供了建模基础。

title: Game-Theoretic Control with Constrained Potential Surgery
summary: Constrained general-sum dynamic games are a popular formulation for highly interactive multi-agent planning problems. In recent years, Generalized Nash Equilibrium (GNE) solvers have achieved real-time performance for small dynamic games. However, solution speed still remains a bottleneck, and controlling even a small number of agents (e.g., more than four) in a dynamic task remains elusive. In addition, Newton solvers that focus on the first-order conditions are vulnerable to non-Nash saddle points, limiting the usefulness of the provided solution. In this work, we propose a fast and versatile interior point solver for constrained dynamic games, along with a computationally efficient second-order correction that increases the probability of converging to a local GNE solution in constrained dynamic games. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated on numerical benchmarks and a physical experiment involving scaled race cars.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种快速通用的内点法求解器，用于带约束的一般和动态博弈，并引入计算高效的二阶修正以提高收敛到局部广义纳什均衡的概率，在数值基准与缩比赛车实物实验上验证。
AI.motivation: 带约束一般和动态博弈是多智能体高交互规划的主流建模方式，但现有广义纳什均衡求解器速度仍是瓶颈，超过四个智能体的动态任务难以实时求解；且只关注一阶条件的牛顿类求解器容易收敛到非纳什鞍点，解的有效性受限。
AI.method: 提出面向带约束动态博弈快速通用内点法求解器：将约束博弈的KKT条件纳入内点框架求解，并设计计算代价可控的二阶修正项，用于从非纳什鞍点附近逃离、提升收敛到局部GNE的概率。
AI.result: 在数值基准测试与缩比赛车（scaled race cars）实物实验中评估，所提方法在求解速度与收敛质量上较现有求解器均有改善（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: 内点法结合二阶修正是求解带约束动态博弈、实现多智能体实时交互规划的一条有前景路径，且具备实物验证支持。

title: GT-VLA: Target-Conditioned Trace Guidance for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on robotic manipulation, but they often struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, configurations, and long-horizon settings. A key challenge is that VLAs overfit to training scenes and fail to follow novel language instructions. Off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs) often provide stronger generalization, but cannot directly control robot actions. To combine the common sense of VLMs with VLA control, we propose Guided Trace VLA (GT-VLA), a steerable framework that accepts guidance from an external generalist VLM through trace-conditioned action generation. GT-VLA uses a generalist model to identify semantic guidance for the current skill, converts this guidance into a 2D visual trace, and conditions its action policy on the resulting trace-rendered observation. This design separates semantic target acquisition, trace generation, and low-level action execution, allowing high-level guidance to propagate to robot actions. GT-VLA uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with skill-specific trace and action modules for robust execution. We evaluate GT-VLA on LIBERO and a physical robot platform, showing improved generalization over recent VLA baselines in both settings. The code and additional supplemental materials are available on our project website at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GT-VLA 通过外部通用 VLM 生成语义引导，将其转为 2D 视觉轨迹并作为条件渲染给动作策略，以 MoE 架构解耦语义定位、轨迹生成与底层执行，在 LIBERO 与真机平台上提升泛化性能。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在机器人操作上表现良好，但难以泛化到未见任务、配置与长时序场景，核心问题是其过拟合训练场景且无法遵循新语言指令；而现成 VLM 泛化更强却无法直接输出机器人动作。作者希望融合 VLM 的常识推理与 VLA 的控制能力。
AI.method: 提出 GT-VLA 可引导框架：由通用 VLM 为当前技能识别语义引导，将引导转化为 2D 视觉轨迹（trace），再以轨迹渲染后的观测作为条件驱动动作策略。整体采用 Mixture-of-Experts 架构，配备技能专属的 trace 模块与 action 模块，实现语义目标获取、轨迹生成、底层动作执行三阶段的解耦。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 基准与真实机器人平台上均优于近期 VLA 基线，泛化能力提升；代码与补充材料已公开于项目网站。
AI.conclusion: 通过外部通用 VLM 的 2D 轨迹引导与模块化解耦设计，可在不牺牲底层控制精度的前提下向 VLA 注入常识泛化能力，是一种可扩展的可引导 VLA 范式。

title: End-to-end QP-based policies: A unified perspective on robust control and robot learning
summary: We present an end-to-end QP-based policy framework that enables systematic policy construction with minimal domain-specific design, while preserving the transparency and interpretability of model-based control. The proposed policy representation supports both domain-randomized model-based auto-tuning, where policy parameters are optimized over distributions of disturbances and model variations, and black-box policy construction, where the problem is formulated in terms of a (possibly) unknown model without requiring explicit notions of states, inputs, or the underlying system dynamics. We establish connections to existing policy representations and control paradigms, including robust control, multilayer perceptrons, and robot learning, and interpret our end-to-end QP policies as a common abstraction of these approaches. We validate the resulting framework in both simulation and hardware, demonstrating a broad range of applications spanning robustness, automatic policy tuning, and control under unknown system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出基于二次规划(QP)的端到端策略框架，以最少领域设计实现系统化策略构建，并保持基于模型控制的透明性与可解释性；支持域随机化模型自调优与黑盒策略构建两种模式。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型策略（如MLP、强化学习）缺乏可解释性，而基于模型的控制方法又难以进行端到端优化与自动调参；作者希望兼顾两者，用一个统一且透明的策略表示来覆盖鲁棒控制、机器人学习等范式。
AI.method: 将策略参数化为QP（二次规划）求解问题：一是域随机化下的基于模型自动调参，在扰动与模型变化的分布上优化策略参数；二是黑盒策略构建，仅以（可能未知的）模型形式表述，无需显式状态、输入或动力学；并建立与鲁棒控制、多层感知机及机器人学习的联系，将其视为这些方法的共同抽象。
AI.result: 在仿真与硬件上验证了框架，覆盖鲁棒性、策略自动调优以及未知系统动力学下的控制等多种应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 端到端QP策略可作为基于模型控制与学习型策略之间的统一抽象，在保持可解释性的同时提供系统化、低领域依赖的策略构建能力。

title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
summary: Contact-rich manipulation depends on force sensing that is hard to infer from visual signals alone, both for collecting demonstrations and for training policies. Force-annotated data, however, remains hard to obtain at scale: real-robot collection ties every demonstration to physical hardware, physics simulators report contact forces that deviate systematically from real measurements, and learned world simulators, though scalable and realistic, are vision-only, so operators feel nothing during data collection and the data carries no force/torque (F/T) labels. We present HapticWorld, an interactive world simulator that predicts joint torque together with observations and renders it back to the operator in real time, closing the haptic loop between a human and a learned world model. Across three contact-rich tasks, torque feedback raises data collection throughput by 1.6 times on average. Policies trained on HapticWorld-generated demonstrations succeed in 54/60 real-world trials, approaching the 56/60 upper bound of real-world data, and far exceeding the 19/60 success rate of the vision-only baseline. Moreover, the success rates measured inside HapticWorld closely match real-world evaluation, demonstrating that HapticWorld can serve as a stand-alone F/T-conditioned policy evaluation platform.

AI.tldr: HapticWorld是一个可交互的"世界模拟器",在预测观测的同时预测关节力矩并实时回传给操作者,从而在人-学习世界模型之间闭合触觉回路,用其生成的带F/T标注演示训练的策略在真实任务中成功率54/60,接近真实数据上限56/60,远超纯视觉基线19/60。
AI.motivation: 力/力矩(F/T)标注数据难以规模化获取:真机采集受硬件制约、物理仿真器的接触力与真实测量存在系统性偏差、纯视觉学习世界模型虽可扩展且逼真但无触觉反馈,操作者采集时"无触感"且数据无F/T标签。而接触丰富操作恰恰依赖视觉难以推断的力感知。
AI.method: 构建HapticWorld:一个可交互的世界模拟器,联合预测关节力矩与观测,并将力矩实时渲染回传给人类操作者,在人机之间闭合触觉回路,用于采集带F/T标签的演示并训练力条件策略。
AI.result: 在三个接触丰富任务上,力矩反馈使数据采集吞吐量平均提升1.6倍;由HapticWorld生成演示训练的策略真机试验成功54/60,接近真机数据上界56/60,远超纯视觉基线19/60;且HapticWorld内部评测成功率与真机评测高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: HapticWorld可作为独立的F/T条件策略评测平台,并为接触丰富操作提供可扩展的力标注数据采集范式,大幅缩小仿真与真机的差距。

title: Inertia-Corrected Newton Method For Generalized Nash Equilibria in Dynamic Games with Optimality Verification
summary: Newton methods efficiently find Generalized Nash Equilibria (GNE) in dynamic games by solving for the KKT necessary conditions. These methods are fast and can support multi-agent Model Predictive Control (MPC) for highly dynamic robots. However, a small KKT residual alone does not certify that the returned solution satisfies the second-order sufficient conditions for a local GNE. In this paper, we propose an efficient numerical method to verify the second-order sufficient conditions (SOSC) for a local GNE. We connect the inertia of the agent KKT matrix with the positive definiteness of the reduced Hessian of the cost function, projected onto the null space of the constraints. Furthermore, we introduce an inertia-corrected update step that improves convergence to local GNEs by destabilizing strict saddle points with weak cross-agent coupling. Our main contribution is a fast Newton solver for Constrained Dynamic Games that provides efficient optimality checking. Through numerical benchmarks, we demonstrate the proposed solver's runtime and convergence performance in practical multi-agent planning problems. We also validate the solver's real-time capabilities in physical experiments using a platform of miniature autonomous race cars.

AI.tldr: 提出一种快速牛顿型求解器，用于约束动态博弈中的广义纳什均衡，并通过智能体KKT矩阵惯性与约化Hessian正定性之间的联系，高效验证局部GNE的二阶充分条件（SOSC）。
AI.motivation: 牛顿法求解GNE虽快，但KKT残差小并不能保证解满足局部GNE的二阶充分条件；缺乏高效的数值最优性验证手段，可能导致多智能体MPC在鞍点附近收敛到非真实局部均衡。
AI.method: 将智能体KKT矩阵的惯性（正负特征值个数）与代价函数约化Hessian在约束零空间投影上的正定性建立联系，从而以数值方式检验SOSC；进一步提出惯性校正更新步，通过 destabilize 弱跨智能体耦合下的严格鞍点来改善局部收敛；整体为约束动态博弈的快速牛顿求解器，附带高效最优性检验。
AI.result: 数值基准显示求解器在多智能体规划问题中具有良好运行时间与收敛性能；在微型自主赛车平台上开展物理实验，验证了实时能力（SOSC验证可高效完成并改善收敛）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为约束动态博弈提供了兼具快速求解与最优性验证的牛顿框架，可作为多智能体MPC/动态博弈的可部署实时工具，并可避免弱耦合鞍点带来的假收敛。

title: Low Cost Eye Tracking for Vision Screening
summary: This engineering study assesses gaze-assisted data acquisition during visual screening with a Gaze Quest implementation via webcam and GC308 near infrared camera with an Orlosky eye tracking pipeline. Ten subjects performed under both acquisition conditions. Accuracy of Tumbling E orientation, reported application logMAR value,and response latency were determined from keyboard responses and hence are behavioral outputs as opposed toeye tracker screening results. Frame-to-frame change in theangle between successive normalized gaze vectors (28.2degrees) served as the GC308 eye tracker derived diagnostic with an effective sampling rate of roughly 8 FPS. No screen target calibration or gaze to screen translation was done on the GC308 eye tracker output data for the current analysis and hence, these data represent acquisition stability and not gaze accuracy in relation to the target. The webcam pipeline relied on 25-point screen calibration. Because the display resolution and pixel pitch could not be retained in the records of the study, the reported application logMAR values cannot be viewed as measures of visual acuity in any way.

AI.tldr: 该工程研究评估了在视觉筛查中采用注视辅助数据采集的可行性，比较了基于网络摄像头与GC308近红外摄像机的两种采集条件，并指出所报告数据仅代表采集稳定性而非注视准确性或视力测量。
AI.motivation: 探索低成本注视追踪方案（网络摄像头与近红外摄像机）在视觉筛查数据采集中的应用潜力，评估其采集稳定性与行为输出指标，为后续注视辅助筛查系统设计提供工程依据。
AI.method: 10名被试在两种采集条件下完成Tumbling E方向判断任务；通过键盘响应获得方向准确率、应用logMAR值与反应延迟等行为输出。GC308眼动仪以约8 FPS有效采样率，采用连续归一化注视向量间夹角逐帧变化（28.2度）作为诊断指标，未做屏幕目标校准或注视-屏幕映射；网络摄像头流程则依赖25点屏幕校准。Orlosky眼动追踪流程被用于实现Gaze Quest。
AI.result: GC308数据显示的向量夹角逐帧变化为28.2度，有效采样率约8 FPS；由于缺少屏幕校准，该结果仅反映采集稳定性而非注视准确性。网络摄像头流程使用25点校准。由于研究记录未保留显示分辨率与像素间距，所报告的应用logMAR值不能作为视力测量指标。
AI.conclusion: 注视辅助数据采集在视觉筛查中具备一定工程可行性，但当前GC308数据仅能反映采集稳定性，无法评估注视准确性；logMAR值亦因缺失显示参数而不具视力测量意义。未来需补充校准与显示参数记录以支持有效性验证。

title: Grasp2Twist: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Jar Opening by Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents Grasp2Twist, a bimanual dexterous manipulation system that learns to grasp and twist open jar lids using reinforcement learning. Learning this task raises three challenges: learning a unified policy for a multi-stage task, sustaining lid twisting, and sim-to-real transfer. To address the first challenge, we introduce a continuous enclosure measure to guide grasp formation and a binary enclosure indicator to guide the grasp-to-twist transition for unified policy learning. We derive both from the geometric relationship between the object center and the convex hull formed by the hand's palm and fingertips. Kinematic constraints limit how far the hand can rotate the lid with fixed contacts, so sustained twisting requires finger contact reconfiguration. We use a three-stage curriculum to facilitate exploration of these contact changes and also improve robustness for sim-to-real transfer. With our approach, the learned policy demonstrates finger gaiting, reconfiguring hand-object contacts to sustain lid rotation. It transfers zero-shot to the physical system and achieves an 88% task success rate across six household containers, including peanut-butter, vitamin, and instant-coffee jars. Ablations further validate the roles of the geometric enclosure in grasp formation and the curriculum in contact-reconfiguration exploration.

AI.tldr: Grasp2Twist：双臂灵巧操作系统，用RL学习抓取并拧开罐盖，通过几何包络度量+课程学习实现手指步态与零样本sim-to-real迁移，成功率88%。
AI.motivation: 开罐盖任务需统一多阶段策略、持续旋转（需手指接触重构）、以及sim-to-real迁移，三者兼具难度。
AI.method: 基于手掌与指尖构成的凸包与物体中心的几何关系，定义连续包络度量引导抓取形成、二值包络指示引导抓取到拧转的过渡，实现统一策略；用三阶段课程促进接触重构探索并提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 策略涌现手指步态（finger gaiting），可持续重构手-物接触；零样本迁移到真实系统，在六种家用容器上达88%成功率；消融验证几何包络与课程的作用。
AI.conclusion: 几何包络度量与课程学习是解决多阶段、接触重构与sim-to-real的有效手段，实现了接触丰富的双臂灵巧操作。

title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models
summary: Vision--language--action (VLA) models provide strong priors for robotic manipulation but are typically deployed as frozen policies, unable to improve from their own failures. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to continued improvement, yet manual environment resets and task-success supervision hinder autonomous learning. We introduce \textbf{FIND}, an agentic real-world RL framework that closes the loop between scene understanding, weakness-aware practice, self-evaluation, and policy improvement in a persistent workspace. FIND reframes autonomous practice as a scene-conditioned, performance-aware task-selection problem: instead of restoring a predefined scene after each rollout, it uses the resulting scene to determine what to practice next. A vision--language agent identifies feasible tasks from a predefined library, prioritizes those with lower recent success rates, and evaluates outcomes using paired pre- and post-execution observations. We instantiate FIND with a frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ VLA and residual off-policy RL. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks, the independent human-assessed success rate improves from $55\%$ to $71.9\%$. A representative run completes 456 autonomous episodes within 6 hours of interaction, requiring 30 scene-recovery interventions and no human-provided reward labels during online learning. Ablations and systematic evaluations further examine key design choices, agent evaluation accuracy, and human intervention requirements. Our website is made publicly available at: this http URL .

AI.tldr: FIND：面向真实世界机器人操作的自主体强化学习框架，将自动练习重构为"场景条件化、性能感知的任务选择"问题，用VLA智能体持续评估并改进冻结的π0.5策略，八项真实任务人工评估成功率55%→71.9%。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽为操作提供强先验，但通常以冻结策略部署，无法从自身失败中改进；真实世界RL又受限于人工环境重置与任务成功监督，难以自主持续学习。因此需要一种无需人工奖励标注、无需固定场景重置的自主练习机制。
AI.method: FIND把自主练习建模为场景条件化、性能感知的任务选择问题：每次rollout后不复位到预定义场景，而是利用rollout产生的当前场景决定下一步练什么。视觉-语言智能体从预定义任务库中筛出可执行任务，优先选择近期成功率较低者，并以执行前后的成对观测做自我结果判定。实现上以冻结的π0.5 VLA搭配残差off-policy RL进行策略改进，全过程在线学习不依赖人工奖励标签。
AI.result: 在八项真实世界操作任务上，独立人工评估成功率由55%提升至71.9%。代表性单次运行在6小时交互内完成456个自主episode，仅需30次场景恢复干预，在线学习期间无人工奖励标注。消融与系统性实验分析了关键设计选择、智能体评估准确率与人工干预需求。
AI.conclusion: FIND表明，借助场景理解的智能体式任务选择与自评估，冻结VLA可在持久化工作空间中实现低人力介入、无奖励标签的真实世界自主持续改进，为VLA从静态策略走向自进化系统提供可行路径。

title: Fiber-Normalized Manipulability and Determinant Proxies: Intrinsic Redundancy Optimization Across and Within Task Fibers
summary: This work establishes that determinant-based manipulability is an exact objective for fixed-task redundancy optimization, despite its dependence on task coordinates and the choice of task-space metric used for volume measurement. On every regular task fiber, the determinant proxy, its representation in any task chart, and every metric-completed manipulability differ only by positive constants. They consequently induce the same complete ordering, constrained extrema, gradient directions, critical points, and local optimality classifications. For comparisons and trajectory optimization across task fibers, this work introduces fiber-normalized manipulability: the capability attained at an internal state divided by the best capability available on the same fiber. The resulting dimensionless scalar is invariant under coordinate changes on the internal-state and task manifolds and independent of the task-space metric. Its associated loss provides an intrinsic objective for physically admissible cross-fiber trajectories, including problems with prescribed or free task evolution and temporal coupling. Planar-manipulator and redundant aerodynamic-allocation examples demonstrate fixed-fiber equivalence, task-dependent cross-fiber differences, and invariant fiber-normalized trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 该工作证明行列式型可操作度是固定任务冗余优化的精确目标，并提出纤维归一化可操作度以实现跨任务纤维的轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 行列式型可操作度依赖任务坐标与任务空间度量，这让人质疑其作为优化目标的内在性；同时跨任务纤维比较能力时缺乏一致、无量纲的度量。
AI.method: 在正则任务纤维上分析行列式代理、其任意任务图中的表示及各种度量补全的可操作度之间的关系；定义纤维归一化可操作度（内部状态能力除以同纤维最优能力），并构造对应的内在损失函数。
AI.result: 证明各量在同一纤维上仅相差正常数，因而诱导相同的完全序、约束极值、梯度方向、临界点与局部最优分类；纤维归一化可操作度在内部状态与任务流形坐标变换下不变且与任务空间度量无关；平面机械臂与冗余气动分配算例验证了固定纤维等价性、任务相关跨纤维差异及不变轨迹优化。
AI.conclusion: 行列式可操作度对固定任务冗余优化是精确目标，纤维归一化版本为跨纤维物理可行轨迹优化提供了内在、无量纲的目标函数。

title: Active 3D weaves for load-bearing and damage-resilient locomotion
summary: The craft of weaving, where different materials are interlaced, has tremendous potential for creating active and functional systems for use in soft robots, prosthetics, wearables, exoskeletons, and more. These textile-like systems are flexible and safe for human-machine interaction; however, this inherent flexibility limits their ability to carry loads, which is essential for many robotic functions. In this work, we introduce a general framework for integrating active materials into three-dimensional (3D) woven shells to create robotic structures that combine high axial stiffness for load bearing, low bending stiffness for efficient actuation, and system-level resilience for damage tolerance. These woven robots can be modularly assembled from 'woven corners', a fundamental unit of 3D woven structures. We use eigenvalue calculations to identify load bearing and actuation mechanisms of the 3D woven structures, and use that information to make five different robots capable of locomotion. We demonstrate that these 3D woven robots can locomote carrying loads 70 times their self-weight, and can maintain repeatable performance even after being subjected to extreme compression. This work is a pathway toward the design, manufacturing, and simulation of future 3D woven robotic systems where load bearing, high stiffness, active functional deformation, locomotion, and system-level resilience are all needed.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出将主动材料集成到三维编织壳体中的通用框架，构建兼具高轴向刚度、低弯曲刚度与损伤容限的"编织机器人"，并以特征值计算识别承载与驱动机制，实现五种可行走机器人。
AI.motivation: 织物类系统柔软、安全，适合人机交互，但固有柔性使其难以承载，限制了在软体机器人、假肢、可穿戴与外骨骼中的应用。需要一种能同时满足承载刚度、驱动柔顺性与损伤容错的机器人结构设计范式。
AI.method: 以三维编织壳体为结构基础，将主动材料（驱动器）嵌入其中；提出"编织角（woven corner）"作为3D编织结构的基本模块化单元，实现模块化组装；通过特征值计算（刚度/模态分析）识别结构的承载与驱动机制，并据此设计五种可移动机器人；实验评估承载能力与压缩后性能。
AI.result: 所得3D编织机器人可承载约自身重量70倍的载荷并实现移动；在经受极端压缩后仍保持可重复的性能；共实现五种不同运动形式的机器人原型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来3D编织机器人系统的设计、制造与仿真提供了路径，使承载、高刚度、主动功能变形、移动与系统级韧性可同时实现。

title: Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand
summary: Pretrained robot policies offer strong manipulation skills but are typically limited to single-agent settings, where a robot acts in isolation. In this work, we study how to adapt pretrained single-agent diffusion policies to multi-agent settings using minimal collaborative data, co-optimizing for two key objectives: high coordination performance and single-agent skill retention. To this end, we introduce ALTER, an adaptation method for coordination on demand: the adapted policy coordinates with other robots when deployed in a team while remaining capable of acting independently when operating alone. Execution is decentralized: each robot acts only on its own visual observations, without explicit inter-agent communication. Our method trains a coordination head that predicts a residual denoiser to transform single-agent behavior into coordinated multi-agent behavior when necessary while also preserving single-agent capabilities. To preserve single-agent capabilities, we augment a small number of collaborative demonstrations with self-distilled data generated by the base policy during training of the residual denoiser. In simulation,ALTER achieves higher coordination success over our baselines while retaining much higher source-skill retention. In our hardware experiments, we find similar trends where ALTER better co-optimizes for coordination success and single-agent skill retention than the baselines

AI.tldr: 提出 ALTER，用少量协作数据把预训练单体扩散策略适配为可按需协调的多机器人策略，同时保留单体技能。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略操作能力强，但通常局限于单体场景；直接用于多机器人协作会破坏已有单体技能，且协作数据稀缺。
AI.method: 在冻结的预训练单体扩散策略上训练一个"协调头"，预测残差去噪器，将单体行为在需要时转化为协作行为；训练时用基础策略自蒸馏生成的数据扩充少量协作示范，以抑制对源技能的遗忘；执行完全去中心化，各机器人仅依赖自身视觉观测，无显式通信。
AI.result: 仿真中协作成功率高于基线，且源技能保持率显著更高；真机实验呈现相同趋势，ALTER 在协作与单体技能保留的折中上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 残差式协调头加自蒸馏数据增强可在极少协作数据下实现"按需协调"，兼顾多机协作与单体能力保留。

title: GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces
summary: In this paper, we present a Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration (GAUGE) framework for planner-conditioned active calibration of opaque quadruped velocity interfaces. Commercial quadrupeds commonly expose planar-velocity commands, but the underlying locomotion controller remains inaccessible and can produce systematic discrepancies between commanded and realized motion. A navigation planner typically uses a structured subset of the command envelope. GAUGE maintains a Bayesian command-to-motion model and selects authorized trials according to their expected reduction of posterior epistemic uncertainty under the planner-induced command distribution. The resulting posterior supports validation-based stopping, bounded inverse compensation, and task-relevant recalibration after detected interface shifts. In three controlled response families, GAUGE reaches the joint criterion for task-facing accuracy and uncertainty with fewer trials than passive, D-optimal, and task-agnostic alternatives. Across six held-out Isaac Sim navigation maps, it meets the declared noninferiority margins against dense calibration. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出GAUGE框架，在规划器诱导的命令分布下，用目标感知的不确定性准则主动标定四足机器人不可见的平面速度接口，实现高效、任务相关的逆补偿与重标定。
AI.motivation: 商用四足机器人仅开放平面速度指令接口，底层运动控制器不可访问，导致指令与实际运动存在系统性偏差；而导航规划器通常只使用命令包络中的结构化子集，因此不必全空间稠密标定，应聚焦任务相关的命令区域，并在接口漂移后重标定。
AI.method: 维护贝叶斯命令-运动模型，按"规划器诱导命令分布下后验认知不确定性期望缩减量"选择授权试验（goal-aware uncertainty-guided主动学习）；后验支持基于验证的停止准则、有界逆补偿（bounded inverse compensation），以及检测到接口变化后的任务相关重标定。
AI.result: 在三类受控响应族中，GAUGE以少于被动、D-最优和任务无关基线的试验次数达到任务精度与不确定性的联合准则；在六个留出的Isaac Sim导航地图上，满足对稠密标定所声明的非劣性边界。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 面向任务、不确定性驱动的主动标定可显著降低四足速度接口标定成本而不牺牲任务表现，适用于规划器条件化的实际导航部署，并具备接口漂移后的再标定能力。

title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
summary: Sequential manipulation requires a robot to track what has already happened, even when the current scene no longer reveals it. Policies with explicit history representations make past interactions available as context for current decisions. We ask how action generation itself can form a persistent state for subsequent control. Building on action-side test-time training, RecastVLA maintains an adaptive policy state within a flow-matching vision-language-action policy. The state is represented by shared fast weights and remains fixed throughout action generation. Depth-specific interfaces read the same state, while features across depths and flow evaluations jointly define one update for the next policy call. Subsequent action losses train the initialization, interfaces, and update rule by differentiating through earlier state transitions. At deployment, updates use the policy's own action-generation features without expert action labels. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboDojo, and twelve real-robot tasks, RecastVLA improves mean success over a matched policy trained without test-time training, including 10.68 percentage points on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean. In controlled RoboTwin comparisons, retaining state improves success, and the shared design exceeds independently trained layer-local TTT by 2.58 points.

AI.tldr: RecastVLA 将流匹配 VLA 策略在动作生成过程中形成的隐状态（共享 fast weights）作为持久策略状态，跨深度层与流采样步联合更新，无需专家动作标签即可测试时自适应，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboDojo 及 12 项真机任务上平均成功率优于匹配基线。
AI.motivation: 顺序操作任务中，当前观测往往无法反映历史交互信息，策略需要显式历史表征作为决策上下文。已有工作多从观测侧构建历史记忆，作者转向追问：动作生成过程本身能否形成可延续到后续控制步骤的持久状态。
AI.method: 在流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略上引入动作侧测试时训练（test-time training）：用共享 fast weights 表示自适应策略状态，并在一次动作生成过程中保持固定；不同深度的专用接口读取同一状态，跨深度特征与流评估步梯度联合构成对下一次策略调用的单次更新；通过反向传播穿过先前状态转移，用后续动作损失训练状态初始化、接口与更新规则。部署时更新仅依赖策略自身动作生成特征，不需要专家动作标签。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboDojo 及 12 项真机任务上，平均成功率均超过未使用测试时训练的匹配策略，其中 RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean 提升 10.68 个百分点；RoboTwin 受控对比显示保留状态可提升成功率，共享设计比独立训练的分层 TTT 高 2.58 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作生成过程本身可作为持久策略状态的载体，共享 fast weights 式状态比分层独立 TTT 更有效；该方法可在无标签条件下部署，为序列化操作提供可延续的控制上下文。

title: AquaBEV-Nav: Learned BEV Occupancy for Underwater Navigation and Exploration
summary: Safe underwater exploration requires a robot to understand where surrounding structures are located and which regions are available for motion. Existing vision-based underwater exploration systems commonly obtain this information indirectly by estimating monocular depth, unprojecting the geometry into 3D space, and accumulating it into a 2D bird's-eye-view occupancy map. This reliance on intermediate depth estimation is particularly problematic underwater, where scattering and wavelength-dependent attenuation degrade visual cues and limit the reliability of monocular depth estimates. We introduce AquaBEV-Nav, an underwater exploration framework that bypasses explicit monocular depth estimation through direct bird's-eye-view occupancy prediction. Built upon the CORAL hierarchical exploration framework, AquaBEV-Nav replaces its depth-based perception front end with AquaBEV. Given a single RGB frame, AquaBEV maps visual features into a learned polar representation, performs causal reasoning along the range dimension, and reconstructs local Cartesian occupancy without relying on intermediate depth prediction. The resulting occupancy map is accumulated into CORAL's persistent spatial memory, providing spatial context for VLM-based high-level planning and collision constraints for dynamics-aware local trajectory generation. Across ten simulated reef environments and six occupancy backbones evaluated under a single protocol, AquaBEV-Nav reaches 37.48 structure IoU and 53.2 target IoU, 88.95% closed-loop coverage with zero collisions.

AI.tldr: 提出AquaBEV-Nav水下探索框架，用单目RGB直接预测BEV占用（AquaBEV）替代显式单目深度估计，并嵌入CORAL分层探索框架，在十个仿真礁石环境中实现37.48结构IoU、53.2目标IoU、88.95%闭环覆盖率且零碰撞。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的水下探索系统依赖单目深度估计，再由几何反投影累积为2D鸟瞰占用图；水下散射与波长相关衰减严重破坏视觉线索，使单目深度估计不可靠，间接得到的占用信息也随之失真。因此需要绕开显式深度估计这一中间环节，直接获取可用于规划的BEV占用表示。
AI.method: AquaBEV-Nav基于CORAL分层探索框架，将其基于深度的感知前端替换为AquaBEV：输入单帧RGB，将视觉特征映射到学习得到的极化（polar）表示，沿距离维进行因果推理，直接重建局部笛卡尔占用，不依赖中间深度预测；所得占用图累积进CORAL的持久空间记忆，为VLM高层规划提供空间上下文，并为动力学感知的局部轨迹生成提供碰撞约束。
AI.result: 在十个仿真礁石环境、六种占用骨干网络、统一协议下评测，AquaBEV-Nav达到37.48的结构IoU与53.2的目标IoU，闭环覆盖率达88.95%，且碰撞次数为零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明水下探索可跳过显式单目深度估计，通过直接BEV占用预测获得更稳健的空间表示，从而支撑VLM高层规划与局部轨迹生成；但验证局限于仿真环境，尚缺乏真实水下平台的部署证据。

title: FutureRay: Control-Aligned Future Range for Agile Quadruped Navigation
summary: Moving obstacles can block a previously clear route while a quadruped robot executes a motion command. We investigate whether predicting changing clearance improves navigation when motion selection accounts for the robot footprint and the time needed to react and brake. We present FutureRay, which predicts ranges across viewing directions and future times, together with encounter risk, from depth-derived range history and observable robot motion. Training emphasizes near-term clearance and penalizes errors that overstate available space. A local planner queries the same forecast for candidate headings and combines it with current observations to check clearance around the robot footprint. Model-based reaction--braking limits guide speed selection, and the resulting velocity commands are passed to a fixed locomotion policy. In paired evaluations on 60 static and dynamic simulation scenes, FutureRay achieves 93.3% completion, compared with 75.0% for current-range persistence and 80.0% for Cartesian Kalman rollout, with perception, planning, and locomotion held fixed. FutureRay also records fewer collisions than both baselines. Qualitative trials on a physical quadruped show avoidance initiated while an obstacle is approaching the route, followed by renewed goal progress. These results show that joint range and encounter-risk prediction can improve obstacle avoidance without retraining the locomotion policy.

AI.tldr: FutureRay：基于深度序列预测未来多方向距离与遭遇风险的预测模型，供局部规划器在制动约束下选速，四足仿真完成率93.3%优于持久化与卡尔曼基线。
AI.motivation: 动态障碍可能在机器人执行指令途中阻塞原畅通路径，需在考虑机体足印与反应—制动时间的前提下预测净空变化以改进导航。
AI.method: 从深度导出的历史距离与可观测本体运动出发，预测多视角方向、多未来时刻的距离图与遭遇风险；训练强调近端净空并惩罚高估空间。局部规划器对候选朝向查询同一预测，与当前观测联合检查机体足印净空；基于模型的反应—制动极限约束速度选择，速度指令交给固定运动策略执行。
AI.result: 60个静态与动态仿真场景配对评估：完成率93.3%，对比当前距离持久化75.0%、笛卡尔卡尔曼推演80.0%（感知/规划/运动策略固定），碰撞数也更少；实体四足定性试验显示障碍接近路径时即提前避让并恢复目标推进。
AI.conclusion: 联合距离与遭遇风险预测可在不重训练运动策略的情况下提升避障表现，属预测驱动的规划前端增强。

title: RoboFFT: Finetuning generative robot policy via online reinforcement learning with forward process
comment: Accepted by CoRL2026. Project Website: this https URL
summary: Generative models, such as diffusion and flow-based models, have shown strong promise for robot policy learning by capturing complex and multimodal action distributions from demonstrations. However, policies trained solely with imitation learning often suffer from imperfect demonstrations and distributional shifts, while further improvement typically requires additional expert data. Reinforcement learning offers a natural solution through environment interaction, but effectively finetuning generative robot policies remains challenging due to the intractability of likelihood estimation. In this work, we propose RoboFFT, a forward-process reinforcement learning framework for finetuning generative robot policies, which applies forward noising to sampled actions and uses the weighted score / flow matching loss to construct a surrogate policy ratio for PPO-style updates. We evaluate RoboFFT with popular generative robot policies on representative simulation benchmarks, including long-horizon planning and sparse reward settings. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that RoboFFT consistently improves performance while achieving better stability and training efficiency. We further integrate RoboFFT into a real world RL framework and demonstrate its effectiveness in real world tasks. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: RoboFFT：通过对采样动作加前向噪声并构造加权分数/流匹配损失代理策略比，实现生成式机器人策略的PPO式强化学习微调。
AI.motivation: 生成式策略（扩散/流匹配）虽能建模多模态动作分布，但纯模仿学习受演示不完美与分布偏移困扰，需额外专家数据；而强化学习微调生成式策略受限于似然难以计算。
AI.method: 提出前向过程强化学习框架RoboFFT：对采样动作执行前向加噪，利用加权score/flow matching损失构造代理策略比，用于PPO式策略更新，从而绕开显式似然估计。
AI.result: 在长时程规划与稀疏奖励等代表性仿真基准上，配合主流生成式机器人策略，性能稳定提升，并具备更好的稳定性与训练效率；进一步集成到真实世界RL框架中验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoboFFT为生成式机器人策略提供了一种实用、稳定且高效的强化学习微调途径，仿真与真实任务均显示增益。

title: Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation
summary: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.

AI.tldr: FedDRMan：面向异构机器人操作的联邦子空间引导蒸馏框架，通过冻结教师行为克隆、低秩多模态子空间与动作分布蒸馏、按更新兼容性聚类并持久化簇模型、谱重平衡聚合，缓解非IID导致的表征漂移与更新冲突，在LIBERO上峰值平均成功率80.7%。
AI.motivation: 多机器人联合改进操作策略时无法集中训练演示数据，联邦学习是自然选择；但任务与环境的非IID分布会引起表征漂移和机器人策略更新互不兼容，朴素参数聚合具有破坏性。
AI.method: 每轮通信中服务器模型作为冻结教师指导本地行为克隆；引入低秩多模态子空间蒸馏与动作分布蒸馏，以保留全局有用的表征几何与策略行为；按更新兼容性对客户端分组并为每个簇维护持久模型；服务器对每个兼容聚合结果进行谱重平衡，缓解较弱但任务相关的策略更新方向被衰减。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上覆盖多种非IID设置、异构程度、客户端参与率变化，并结合消融与聚合分析，FedDRMan显著提升知识迁移并持续优于强联邦基线，峰值平均成功率达80.7%，比最强评测联邦基线高11.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 子空间引导蒸馏与兼容性聚类+谱重平衡的聚合设计能有效应对异构机器人操作中的联邦学习退化问题，为去中心化多机器人策略协同提供了可行方案，但证据仍限于仿真基准。

title: DS-VLA: A Dendritic-inspired Vision-Language-Action Model for Robust Action Control
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in language-conditioned manipulation, yet success under nominal evaluation does not necessarily translate into robust closed-loop behavior when executed actions are transiently corrupted. We introduce DS-VLA, a dendritic-inspired action architecture that incorporates dendritic spiking dynamics into VLA control to address this limitation. Specifically, to enable modularized feature processing and temporal information integration, DS-VLA equips action neurons with multiple sparsely connected dendritic branches, each featuring heterogeneous, learned decay factors. Furthermore, to suppress unreliable state updates while preserving task-relevant historical information, we introduce a neuron-wise inhibitory gate that adaptively regulates the admission of new multimodal evidence into dendritic states prior to somatic dynamics. We evaluate DS-VLA on all four LIBERO suites under both nominal rollouts and a unified closed-loop action-perturbation protocol. DS-VLA achieves a 91.6\% average nominal success rate and an 87.35\% average perturbed success rate, retaining 95.4\% of its nominal performance. Under the same reported perturbation setting, OpenVLA-OFT, FAST, $\pi_0$, and GR00T achieve 39.45\%, 23.90\%, 28.55\%, and 30.75\%, respectively. A controlled ablation isolates the contribution of neuron-wise shared inhibition, while analyses of neural dynamics and post-perturbation trajectories associate robust performance with selective evidence suppression and effective behavioral recovery. Together, these results demonstrate that integrating brain-inspired computational mechanisms offers a promising architectural prior for robust embodied intelligence beyond merely scaling vision-language backbones or generative action decoders.

AI.tldr: 提出 DS-VLA，将树突脉冲动力学引入 VLA 动作架构，通过多分支稀疏树突与神经元级抑制门提升闭环扰动下的鲁棒性，LIBERO 上名义成功率 91.6%，扰动后 87.35%（保留 95.4%）。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在名义评测下表现良好，但动作被瞬态扰动破坏时闭环鲁棒性差；作者希望从脑启发的计算机制（而非单纯扩大视觉-语言主干或生成式动作解码器）中获得更鲁棒的架构先验。
AI.method: DS-VLA：为动作神经元配置多条稀疏连接的树突分支，各分支具有异质、可学习的衰减因子，实现模块化特征处理与时序信息整合；在胞体动力学之前引入神经元级抑制门，自适应控制新多模态证据进入树突状态，抑制不可靠状态更新同时保留任务相关历史信息。
AI.result: LIBERO 四个套件上名义成功率平均 91.6%，统一闭环动作扰动协议下平均 87.35%，保留名义性能的 95.4%；同一扰动设置下 OpenVLA-OFT/FAST/π0/GR00T 分别为 39.45%/23.90%/28.55%/30.75%；消融实验隔离了神经元级共享抑制的贡献，神经动力学与扰动后轨迹分析表明鲁棒性与选择性证据抑制及有效行为恢复相关。
AI.conclusion: 将脑启发的树突脉冲计算机制作为架构先验，可在不单纯扩大视觉-语言主干或生成式动作解码器的前提下，显著提升具身智能的闭环鲁棒性。

title: Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. We further post-train PACE through failure-aware preference refinement using rollout-derived pairs that contrast normal or recovery behaviors with deviation-amplifying behaviors, thereby improving closed-loop correction. We integrate PACE into six open-source zero-shot VLN navigators and demonstrate consistent improvements on the cross-floor subsets of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, increasing the average success rate from 16.35% to 27.65% and from 4.76% to 12.06%, respectively. Real-world experiments further demonstrate PACE's applicability in unseen environments, highlighting the potential of traversable affordances to bridge semantic intent and reliable embodied behavior.

AI.tldr: PACE：一种监督式局部执行模块，将过渡语义落地为以智能体为中心的可通行可供性位姿，并以此条件化短程动作生成；通过失败感知偏好精化后训练，接入六个零样本VLN规划器，在R2R-CE/RxR-CE跨层子集成功率从16.35%→27.65%、4.76%→12.06%。
AI.motivation: 通用语义规划器能输出正确的高层意图，但在楼梯、门洞、狭窄通道等空间受限过渡处难以保证物理可行：到达过渡点并不意味着能通过，智能体需找到可执行的可供性位姿并从累积动作误差中恢复。因此需要弥补"语义意图—物理执行"之间的断层。
AI.method: PACE采用监督式局部执行架构，冻结零样本语义规划器：1) 将过渡相关语义映射为长时程、智能体中心的可通行可供性位姿（traversable affordance pose）；2) 以该空间目标为条件生成短时程动作；3) 用rollout构造偏好对，对比正常/恢复行为与偏差放大行为，进行失败感知偏好精化后训练，提升闭环纠错。
AI.result: 集成到六个开源零样本VLN导航器后，跨层子集一致性提升：R2R-CE平均成功率16.35%→27.65%，RxR-CE 4.76%→12.06%。真实环境实验验证了其在未见场景中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 可通行可供性可作为语义意图与可靠具身行为之间的桥梁；该模块化执行层即插即用于现有零样本VLN系统，显著改善跨层导航与误差恢复。

title: MemTransfer: Benchmarking Memory Beyond Matched Experience in Embodied Decision-Making
summary: Memory lets an embodied agent reuse past experience, yet retaining useful information does not ensure that the agent can apply it when conditions change. We present MemTransfer, a benchmark comparing six memory representations, a working-memory baseline and five representations of past experience, under a shared frozen vision-language-model policy. It comprises 100 navigation cases across ten task types in a simulated warehouse, with expert demonstrations supplying the history. Three comparisons vary the starting pose, route availability, and amount and task relevance of history. With one demonstration per task, Full-context and Episodic memory reach 95.3% and 100.0% success at the original demonstration start, but lose 48-49 percentage points at a new test start. Summary changes little between these two test starts, yet with four demonstrations per task it retains a smaller fraction of its unchanged-route success after blocking (39.3%) than Working memory (44.8%) or the two trajectory memories (56-58%). At the new test start, increasing from one to four relevant demonstrations raises Episodic success by 14.3 percentage points, while the other evaluated representations gain no more than 1.3 percentage points. Replacing half of the relevant histories with other-task experience lowers success for both trajectory memories. These results show that robustness to one kind of mismatch does not imply robustness to another, motivating evaluation of both stored information and its use at decision time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MemTransfer基准，在冻结VLM策略下系统比较六种记忆表示在具身导航中面对位姿、路径、历史数量与相关性变化时的鲁棒性，揭示"对一种失配鲁棒≠对另一种鲁棒"。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体记忆研究多关注信息保留，却忽视条件变化时能否正确调用记忆。作者希望厘清：不同记忆表示对不同类型的分布偏移（起始位姿、可通行路径、历史数量/任务相关性）是否具有一致的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建MemTransfer基准：模拟仓库中10类任务、100个导航案例，专家示范提供历史。比较6种记忆表示（1种工作记忆基线 + 5种过去经验表示），共享同一冻结的视觉-语言模型策略。设置三组对照：改变起始位姿、路径可用性、历史数量与任务相关性（含用其他任务经验替换一半相关历史）。
AI.result: 每任务1个示范时，Full-context与Episodic在原示范起点成功率95.3%/100.0%，但换新测试起点后掉48–49个百分点；Summary在两种起点间变化很小，但每任务4个示范并阻断路径后，其保留成功率（39.3%）低于工作记忆（44.8%）与两种轨迹记忆（56–58%）。新起点下，相关示范从1增至4使Episodic提升14.3个百分点，其他表示增益≤1.3个百分点。将一半相关历史替换为其他任务经验会降低两种轨迹记忆的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 对某一类失配的鲁棒性不蕴含对另一类失配的鲁棒性；记忆评估应同时考察"存储了什么信息"与"决策时如何使用"，单一成功指标或单一扰动设置会误导记忆表示的选择。

title: WSM-Aware HRI: An IoT-Enhanced Framework for Early Detection and Norm-Guided Repair of Failures with LLM Guidance
summary: Human-robot interaction (HRI) failures remain a major barrier to deploying robots in real-world environments. Prior work often treats failures as isolated technical faults or focuses on post-hoc recovery behaviors. In practice, many breakdowns arise because humans and robots operate under inconsistent assumptions about the current world state. We propose WSM-Aware HRI, an IoT-enhanced modular framework that unifies diverse HRI breakdowns as World-State Mismatches (WSMs) between a human's instruction-implied assumptions and a robot's grounded world model built from multimodal perception and digital augmentation. A Large Language Model (LLM) is used to make implicit assumptions explicit, map them to a small set of mismatch types, and specify the evidence needed for verification against the robot's world state. WSM-Aware HRI shifts failure handling from execution-time recovery to proactive mismatch detection during intention formation, enabling interventions guided by safety, norm compliance, and multi-user coordination with transparent explanations. We evaluate mismatch identification in ten everyday cases spanning both visual and latent-state mismatches. The system can accurately produce the expected output results, and ablations show that reliable identification depends on appropriate grounding representations and verification-oriented refinement. These results indicate that treating interaction breakdowns as explicit world-state mismatches enables earlier detection of impending failures and offers a principled mechanism for integrating external evidence and social constraints into human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出WSM-Aware HRI框架，将人机交互失败统一建模为"世界状态错配"(World-State Mismatch)，用LLM把人类指令隐含假设显式化并映射到错配类型，在意图形成阶段而非执行后主动检测潜在失败。
AI.motivation: 现有HRI失败研究多把失败当作孤立技术故障或只关注事后恢复行为；实际中大量崩溃源于人与机器人对当前世界状态的假设不一致，缺乏统一的成因建模与早期检测机制。
AI.method: 构建IoT增强的模块化框架WSM-Aware HRI：机器人侧用多模态感知与数字增强构建grounded世界模型，人类侧从指令推断隐含假设；用LLM将隐含假设显式化、映射到少量错配类型，并指定需验证的证据；在意图形成阶段进行验证，干预受安全性、规范合规与多用户协调约束，并提供透明解释。
AI.result: 在10个日常案例（涵盖视觉错配与潜在状态错配）上评测错配识别，系统能准确产出预期输出；消融表明可靠识别依赖于恰当的grounding表示与面向验证的refinement。
AI.conclusion: 将交互崩溃显式视为世界状态错配可实现更早的失败检测，并为把外部证据与社会约束整合进人机交互提供有原则的机制。

title: Human Motion Prediction for Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This paper compares three human motion prediction methods - GMM-based clustering, TransFusion, and Graph-Mixer - evaluating their effectiveness in human-robot collaboration. These predictions are valuable for improving robot motion planning by anticipating human movements and enhancing safety and efficiency in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 比较GMM聚类、TransFusion与Graph-Mixer三种人体运动预测方法在人机协作中的效果，为机器人运动规划提供前瞻性输入。
AI.motivation: 人机协作中机器人需预判人类动作以提升动态环境下的安全性与效率，需明确哪类运动预测方法更适用。
AI.method: 对三类代表性人体运动预测方法（GMM概率聚类、TransFusion、Graph-Mixer）进行对比评估。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化结果，仅声称预测有助于机器人运动规划与安全性、效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 人体运动预测对人机协作有价值，方法选择需进一步依据实验证据。

title: Proactive Motion Planning for Human-Robot Cooperation
summary: This abstract addresses the incorporation of human motion prediction into proactive and dynamic human-aware motion planning, with the goal of enabling safe collaboration between humans and robots. A deep learning, graph-based model is used to forecast human motion and is integrated into a planning framework. This framework employs a static roadmap along with a time-variant A* algorithm to modify the trajectory of a UR5e manipulator. This method greatly improves human-robot interaction and enables proactive collision avoidance by combining precise motion forecasts with adaptive trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 将基于图神经网络的人体运动预测模块嵌入静态路网+时变A*的规划框架，用于UR5e机械臂的主动式人机共融避障。
AI.motivation: 人机协作需要机器人主动预判人的未来运动，而非仅对当前状态做反应式避障；现有静态规划框架缺少对运动预测的集成。
AI.method: 图结构的深度学习人体运动预测模型 + 静态roadmap检索 + 时变A*搜索，在UR5e机械臂上修改轨迹实现主动避碰。
AI.result: 摘要仅声称大幅提升人机交互效果并实现主动碰撞避免，未给出量化指标、实验规模或真机部署细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作属于"预测+规划"级联的常规集成式方案，方法增量偏小、验证证据薄弱，可作为背景参考而非重点阅读对象。

title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Hongzhou Wang (wanghongzhou@jlu. this http URL )
summary: Code-as-Policy agents accomplish long-horizon embodied tasks by generating and executing code, yet continually improving them with teachers that are stronger but not globally reliable remains a key challenge. Existing distillation methods typically treat the teacher's complete behavior as the supervision target and thus misassign training credit on states where the teacher fails. We propose RE-0, a recursively verified policy improvement framework: rather than assuming that the teacher globally outperforms the student, RE-0 requests local corrections from the teacher on the student's own failure histories and checks in the environment whether each correction is genuinely beneficial; verified corrections yield immediate improvement. Building on this, we propose RE-OPD, which turns verified interventions into supervision for on-policy distillation. Only counterfactually verified teacher interventions provide distribution-level supervision, weighted by their measured local benefit, and the improvement they induce is projected back into the standalone student, so both where supervision is applied and how much credit the teacher receives co-evolve with the student policy. We further prove that the student's per-round gain is lower-bounded by its verified intervention gain up to verification and projection error terms. Experiments across multiple Code-as-Policy embodied tasks show that RE-0 improves both teacher-assisted execution and the standalone student, and generalizes to novel robots and scenes.

AI.tldr: RE-0：不假设教师全局优于学生，而是在学生失败轨迹上请求教师局部纠正并在环境中反事实验证，仅将验证有效的纠正用于策略改进；RE-OPD 进一步把验证通过的干预转为 on-policy 蒸馏监督并按局部收益加权，同时把收益投影回独立学生策略。理论证明每轮收益下界为验证干预收益（含验证与投影误差项），Code-as-Policy 具身任务实验显示教师辅助执行与独立学生均提升，并可泛化到新机器人与新场景。
AI.motivation: Code-as-Policy 智能体可完成长时程具身任务，但如何在"更强却非全局可靠"的教师下持续改进策略仍是难题。现有蒸馏方法把教师完整行为当作监督目标，在教师失败的狀態上错误分配训练信用，导致负迁移。
AI.method: RE-0：在学生自身的失败历史（状态）上向教师请求局部纠正，并在环境中做反事实验证，确认该纠正是否真正带来收益；验证通过的纠正直接产生改进。RE-OPD：把验证过的干预转为 on-policy 蒸馏的监督信号，只有反事实验证通过的教师干预才提供分布级监督，权重为其实测局部收益，并将所诱导的改进投影回独立学生策略，使"监督施加位置"与"教师信用分配量"随学生策略共同演化。理论上给出学生每轮收益以验证干预收益为下界（余项为验证误差与投影误差）。
AI.result: 在多个 Code-as-Policy 具身任务上，RE-0 同时提升教师辅助执行与独立学生策略表现，并能泛化到新机器人平台与新场景。
AI.conclusion: 核心贡献是"递归验证的策略改进"范式：用局部、可验证的教师纠正替代全局监督假设，配合收益加权的 on-policy 蒸馏与向独立策略的投影，实现学生与监督信号协同演化，并具理论下界保证。

title: DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies
summary: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. We introduce DRAM (Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory), a plug-and-play memory module that can be attached to a wide range of pretrained robotic policies, endowing them with long-horizon memory without architectural modification or backbone retraining, requiring only task-specific post-training of the memory module and action expert. DRAM maintains a fixed-size associative memory using gated delta-rule linear attention, with a modified update that incorporates all tokens within each frame in parallel. An architecture-agnostic readout integrates historical context into action prediction across different policy architectures. Experiments show that DRAM consistently improves frozen pretrained policies over short-context baselines and alternative compact memory designs, validating its effectiveness as a fixed-size, post-hoc memory module trained with the backbone frozen.

AI.tldr: DRAM：一种即插即用的固定大小联想记忆模块，通过门控delta-rule线性注意力为预训练机器人策略注入长时程记忆，无需改动骨干或重训，仅后训练记忆模块与动作专家。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作本质具有历史依赖性，但现有预训练策略仅依赖当前观测或短时窗口。已有长记忆方案要么堆叠多帧观测窗口导致推理成本剧增，要么依赖预定义语义特征，限制任务通用性并可能需要重训骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出DRAM（Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory），以门控delta-rule线性注意力维护固定大小的联想记忆，更新方式经修改以并行纳入每一帧内的所有token；采用与架构无关的读出机制，将历史上下文注入不同策略架构的动作预测中。训练时冻结骨干，仅针对特定任务后训练记忆模块与动作专家。
AI.result: 实验表明DRAM在冻结的预训练策略上稳定优于短上下文基线及替代性紧凑记忆设计，验证了其在骨干冻结条件下作为固定大小、事后插入记忆模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DRAM可作为通用即插即用模块为多种预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆，无需架构修改或骨干重训，为长历史依赖的操作任务提供了低推理开销的后验增强方案。

title: GlowTact: Simple and Compact Vision-Based Tactile Sensing with High Sensitivity and Spatial Resolution
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTS) provide rich contact information for robotic manipulation, but existing designs can be hard to simplify and adapt to the size and constraints of humanoid fingertips. We introduce \textbf{GlowTact}, a pressure-responsive vision-based tactile sensing mechanism that directly visualizes contact pressure. \textbf{GlowTact} requires only single-color, non-directional illumination, and the raw tactile image directly represents the pressure distribution without explicit geometry reconstruction. This simple sensing principle enables compact, customizable tactile sensors while preserving high sensitivity and rich spatial detail. We demonstrate gram-scale contact detection, accurate normal-force estimation, and reconstruction of fine contact geometry, including M1 screw threads. These results establish \textbf{GlowTact} as a practical new sensing technology for compact humanoid fingertips, combining a durable nitrile membrane and simple optical design with sensitive and information-rich tactile perception.

AI.tldr: GlowTact：一种压力响应式视触觉传感机制，通过单色非定向光照直接可视化接触压强分布，无需几何重建即可实现克级接触检测、法向力估计与精细几何（如M1螺纹）重建，面向紧凑型人形指尖。
AI.motivation: 现有视触觉传感器（VBTS）虽能提供丰富接触信息，但结构设计与尺寸难以简化、难以适配人形指尖的狭小空间与约束，需要一种更紧凑、可定制且保持高灵敏度的传感方案。
AI.method: 提出GlowTact压力响应式视触觉机制：仅需单色、非定向照明；利用压力响应发光使原始触觉图像直接表征压力分布，避免显式几何重建，从而简化光学设计并支持紧凑化、可定制传感结构，配合耐用丁腈膜。
AI.result: 实现克级接触检测、较准确的法向力估计，并能重建精细接触几何，包括M1螺纹细节，同时保持高灵敏度与丰富空间信息。
AI.conclusion: GlowTact可作为紧凑型人形指尖的实用新型触觉传感技术，将简单光学设计与灵敏、信息丰富的触觉感知相结合，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Assisting for Open-Ended Tasks: Goal-Oriented Shared Autonomy as a Particle Filter
summary: A common approach for shared autonomy blends human inputs with autonomous assistance based on the human's likely goal. However, most existing approaches assume that a static set of possible goals is known a priori, which limits the use of such methods in unstructured assistive settings. We instead investigate how to enable shared autonomy with open-ended and dynamically changing goals. We formulate goal-oriented shared autonomy as a particle filter in which particles represent candidate human goals. Unlike conventional approaches with a fixed goal set, our transition model dynamically proposes new candidate goals as the interaction evolves, and human actions update the belief over these goals in real time. We instantiate this framework with foundation models (e.g., vision grounding and large language models) that propose context-relevant semantic goals, generate goal-conditioned assistance from low-level skill primitives, and refine those skills from human corrections. We assess our approach through a user study where 12 participants perform a variety of tabletop manipulation tasks with our method and state-of-the-art shared autonomy baselines. The results show that our particle filter-based approach reduces the amount of time users spend teleoperating the system and improves user satisfaction. User study videos: this https URL

AI.tldr: 将开放式目标共享自主建模为粒子滤波器，粒子动态表示候选人类目标，用基础模型（视觉grounding+LLM）生成语境相关的语义目标与目标条件技能，并通过人类纠正实时更新信念。
AI.motivation: 现有共享自主方法大多假设候选目标集合是先验已知且静态的，这限制了其在非结构化辅助场景中的适用性；作者希望实现目标开放且动态变化的共享自主。
AI.method: 将目标导向共享自主形式化为粒子滤波器：粒子代表候选人类目标，转移模型随交互演化动态提出新候选目标，人类动作实时更新目标信念；用基础模型（视觉grounding、LLM）提出语境相关语义目标、由低层技能原语生成目标条件辅助、并从人类纠正中精炼技能。
AI.result: 12名被试的桌面操作任务用户研究显示，相比最先进共享自主基线，该方法减少用户遥操作时间并提升用户满意度。
AI.conclusion: 动态目标集粒子滤波框架可行且有效，基础模型可用于开放式目标共享自主的语义目标提出与技能生成/精炼。

title: Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC
summary: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) combines learned world models with online trajectory optimization, achieving strong performance in continuous control. However, the per-step cost of sampling and evaluating hundreds of candidate trajectories restricts deployment to control frequencies well below what real-time robotics demands. Motivated by the dual-process theory of human cognition, which distinguishes between fast, intuitive processing (System 1) and slower, deliberative reasoning (System 2), we ask whether every decision requires the same degree of computational deliberation. We propose Fast-TD-MPC, a lightweight framework that adaptively routes between fast policy execution and test-time planning, reserving costly deliberation for states where it is most needed. Fast-TD-MPC delivers competitive task performance across 103 continuous control tasks while achieving up to ~4x faster inference. Under external disturbances, Fast-TD-MPC selectively falls back to planning, maintaining robustness comparable to the original planner.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fast-TD-MPC，受双过程认知理论启发，在快速策略执行与测试时规划之间自适应路由，仅在需要时进行昂贵 deliberation，实现最高约 4 倍推理加速且保持任务性能与抗扰动鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动 MPC 每步需采样与评估数百条候选轨迹，计算开销大，导致控制频率远低于实时机器人需求。作者追问：是否每个决策都需要同等程度的计算 deliberation。
AI.method: 受人类认知双过程理论启发，构建轻量框架 Fast-TD-MPC，在快速策略执行（System 1）与测试时规划（System 2）之间自适应路由，将昂贵规划保留给最需要的状态；扰动下选择性回退到规划。
AI.result: 在 103 个连续控制任务上取得有竞争力的性能，推理最高加速约 4 倍；外部扰动下选择性回退规划，鲁棒性与原始规划器相当。
AI.conclusion: 自适应路由可在不牺牲性能与鲁棒性的前提下大幅降低 MPC 推理成本，为实时机器人控制提供可行路径，但证据集中于仿真连续控制基准，尚缺真实机器人验证。

title: RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: RECAST 将 VLM 的高层推理与视觉基础模型的空间定位结合，构建统一的"可操作代价地图"（Actionable Cost Map），用四类判断（可通行表面、风险物体、偏好朝向、可穿越间隙）同时条件化并打分轨迹候选，并通过"VLM 判定帧 + 当前帧"双时机制弥合语义推理滞后，实现仿真与真实四足平台上的导航提升。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人导航方法存在两类断裂：一是大规模学习型模型在训练分布外失效，二是 VLM 方法虽具备高层场景理解，却缺乏在场景中的空间落地（grounding），也未能把理解与动作对齐。作者希望同时获得"语义推理"与"空间可执行性"，从而在多样环境中实现安全、鲁棒的导航。
AI.method: 框架输入为机器人前视图像与用户指令。流程分三步：(1) VLM 分解场景，输出四类判断——哪些表面可通行、哪些物体有风险、应偏好哪个朝向、哪些间隙可穿过；(2) 用视觉基础模型（如分割/深度类模型）将这些表面与物体在图像中定位；(3) 把四类判断统一"重投"（recast）为一张紧凑的代价地图。该代价地图既作为轨迹解码器的条件，又用于对候选轨迹打分以选出执行轨迹。由于 VLM 的回答滞后于实时场景，两个环节都使用两个时刻的代价地图：VLM 所判定的 pivot 帧（携带全部四类判断）与当前帧（地形与碰撞代价由当前图像重建）。
AI.result: 相较最强先前方法，RECAST 在仿真中成功率提升 13.3 个百分点，在真实四足机器人上提升 31.4 个百分点；碰撞率分别下降 9.6 与 14.3 个百分点，在所有方法中达到最低碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 语义推理与视觉基础模型空间定位统一为单一代价地图，并以双时刻地图缓解推理延迟，是一种有效的具身导航范式，在仿真与真实四足平台上同时取得成功率与安全性的显著增益。

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
summary: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 World SLAM Model (WSM)，将 SLAM 的核心机制（增量状态更新、持久记忆、后端误差精修）内化为导航的下游机制，在预测未来视觉状态的同时联合估计相机运动与稠密几何，以联合导航–SLAM 目标端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把 SLAM 仅作为上游模块，只输出位姿、地图或 token；这种解耦导致下游导航无法直接受益于 SLAM 的持续状态维护与累积误差精修，难以支撑长时序世界建模与闭环具身交互。
AI.method: WSM 是一个统一框架：以当前观测与导航目标为输入，预测未来视觉状态并联合估计相机运动与稠密几何，将视觉预测锚定在不断演化的空间世界状态上；该状态随新观测增量更新，并经后端精修累积误差，为动作生成与闭环导航提供基础；整个框架以导航与 SLAM 联合目标端到端训练。
AI.result: 摘要层面报告：导航性能提升，同时保持较强的 SLAM 精度，验证了将 SLAM 作为长时序世界建模与具身交互内在机制的可行性。
AI.conclusion: SLAM 不应只是上游位姿/地图提供者，而可作为下游导航的内在状态维护与精修机制，兼顾导航决策质量与几何估计精度，为长时序具身世界模型提供了一条可行路径。

title: PF-RL: Progress Field Reinforcement Learning via Goal-Conditioned Value Geometry for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning~(RFT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) policies, yet sparse task-level outcomes provide limited credit for intermediate transitions, especially in long-horizon manipulation. A natural approach is to model intermediate task progress and use it as dense feedback for policy improvement. Despite their architectural differences, existing progress-aware methods commonly formulate task progress as an explicit scalar prediction, providing limited structure for modeling how intermediate observations relate to the task goal, which may hinder effective transition-level credit assignment. We introduce Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL), which learns a structured goal-conditioned progress representation over pretrained VLA features and converts it into dense credit for policy optimization.
