A lightweight shared Progress Field head maps current and goal representations into a compact progress space, where geometric distance induces goal-conditioned value, while complementary temporal and goal-structure objectives shape the learned geometry. Transition-level value changes naturally yield dense progress advantages, enabling fine-grained credit assignment for both offline policy improvement and online reinforcement fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that PF-RL consistently improves policy performance over strong supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement fine-tuning, and progress-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: PF-RL 将任务进度建模为目标条件下的结构化进度场，用几何距离诱导密集信用，用于 VLA 策略的离线改进与在线强化微调。
AI.motivation: 现有进度感知方法把任务进度表示为显式标量预测，缺乏刻画中间观测与目标关系的结构，难以在长时序操作中实现转移级别的信用分配。
AI.method: 在预训练 VLA 特征上学习目标条件下的结构化进度表示：轻量共享 Progress Field 头将当前与目标表示映射到紧致进度空间，用几何距离诱导目标条件价值，并用时间与目标结构辅助目标塑造几何；转移级价值变化生成密集进度优势，支持离线策略改进与在线强化微调。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 及真实双臂操作任务上，PF-RL 一致优于强监督微调、强化微调与进度感知基线。
AI.conclusion: 将进度从标量回归升级为目标条件进度场，可提供更有效的转移级密集信用，提升 VLA 长时序操作策略性能。

title: SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies demonstrate promising generalization across diverse short-horizon tasks. However, they remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, partly because the large-scale training data is biased toward single-stage manipulation tasks that are cheaper to demonstrate. A single weak atomic skill can cause failures across multiple multi-stage tasks. To address such failures, existing methods often require experts to identify the bottleneck and provide additional demonstrations, making the improvement costly and potentially impractical after deployment. To this end, we present a Self-Evolving Embodied System (SEES) that learns from failures and improves the VLA policy without additional expert demonstrations. SEES decomposes long-horizon tasks into atomic tasks and routes them to corresponding family policies. Each family consists of related atomic skills that share one VLA adapter. During execution, the system automatically monitors atomic-task outcomes to identify the most frequently failing atomic skills as the current bottlenecks. To overcome these bottlenecks, SEES constructs tailored RL tasks in simulation by restoring previously encountered states and generating task-specific success criteria with an LLM. Online RL updates the shared family adapters to promote positive transfer among related atomic skills and cumulative improvement across evolution rounds. Extensive experiments show that SEES can be integrated with different VLA backbones to progressively improve their long-horizon performance. We also observe continued improvement on unseen tasks, providing evidence of transfer beyond the evolution settings.

AI.tldr: 提出SEES自演化具身系统，将长程任务分解为原子任务并路由到共享VLA适配器的技能族，通过自动监测失败瓶颈、用LLM在仿真中构造针对性RL任务并在线更新适配器，在无额外专家示教下持续提升VLA长程性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在长程多阶段任务上不可靠，根源是大规模训练数据偏向单阶段操作任务，单个弱原子技能会拖垮整条任务链；而现有改进方法依赖专家定位瓶颈并提供新示教，成本高且部署后难以实施。
AI.method: SEES把长程任务分解为原子任务并路由到对应技能族策略，每个技能族共享一个VLA适配器；执行时自动监测原子任务结果，统计出失败最频繁的原子技能作为当前瓶颈；在仿真中恢复曾遇到的状态并用LLM生成任务专属成功判据构建RL任务，通过在线RL更新共享族适配器，促进相关原子技能间的正向迁移与跨轮次累积改进。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SEES可即插式集成到不同VLA主干上，逐步提升其长程任务表现；在未见过任务上仍观察到持续改进，说明存在超出演化设定本身的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 以"失败驱动+自动瓶颈定位+仿真RL自演化"替代人工示教闭环，是实现VLA长程能力持续自提升的可行路径，且具备跨任务迁移潜力。

title: MORPH: Self-Organising Multi-Robot Task Allocation via Neuroplasticity-Inspired Adaptive Topology
comment: Full version of the paper published in The 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS), this http URL implementation and experiment scripts are available at this https URL
summary: Multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) in dynamic environments faces a fundamental tension: effective coordination requires learned structure, but that structure must adapt when conditions change. Existing methods resolve this by assuming prior task knowledge, a utility function, a cost matrix, or a trained policy making them brittle when deployed without such knowledge or when task distributions shift. We present MORPH(Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy), a training-free MRTA framework where global allocation quality emerges from 4 local plasticity rules (synaptic, homeostatic, structural, and metaplasticity) applied to a directed pairwise preference matrix updated from runtime co-occurrence and task-completion feedback. MORPH requires no task model, no bid computation, and no offline training; response decisions use learned AGV-to-Picker preferences rather than a fixed proximity rule. Within the Gerkey-Mataric MRTA taxonomy, MORPH is the first method in the single-task, single-robot, instantaneous-assignment class to learn directed pairwise allocation preferences online. Evaluated on the TA-RWARE warehouse benchmark (8-24 agents, 4 maps, 800 steps per episode, 5 seeds), MORPH achieves 110% of all-to-all throughput at N=24 while using only 21% of possible coordination links as an efficiency advantage that grows monotonically with fleet size. Under spatial task distribution shift, MORPH degrades 3x less than proximity-based methods while its learned preferences remain uncorrelated with Manhattan distance. Systematic ablation confirms all four plasticity rules contribute measurably. Two allocation properties emerge without programming: cross-type preference dominance and progressive preference sparsification, mirroring the developmental refinement of biological neural circuits. Learned preferences are driven by task co-occurrence history, not spatial proximity.

AI.tldr: MORPH：一种免训练的多机器人任务分配框架，用4条局部可塑性规则在线学习有向成对偏好矩阵，在TA-RWARE基准上以21%链路达110%吞吐，空间分布漂移下退化仅为近邻法1/3。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下的MRTA存在根本张力：有效协调需要学到的结构，但条件变化时结构必须自适应。现有方法依赖先验任务知识、效用函数、代价矩阵或已训练策略，缺失这些知识或任务分布漂移时表现脆弱。
AI.method: MORPH为免训练框架，不建任务模型、不算标价、不做离线训练。对有向成对偏好矩阵施加突触、稳态、结构、元可塑性四条局部规则，由运行时共现与任务完成反馈更新；响应决策用学到的AGV-to-Picker偏好而非固定近邻规则。属于Gerkey-Mataric分类中单任务-单机器人-瞬时分配类。
AI.result: TA-RWARE基准（8-24智能体、4地图、每回合800步、5随机种子）：N=24时达全对全吞吐的110%，仅用21%可能协调链路，效率优势随规模单调增长。空间任务分布漂移下退化比近邻法小3倍，学到的偏好与曼哈顿距离不相关。消融证实四条规则均有可测贡献，并自发生成跨类型偏好主导与偏好渐进稀疏化两种分配特性。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、免任务模型的局部可塑性规则可自组织出高质量全局分配，且偏好由任务共现历史而非空间邻近驱动，为动态MRTA提供了不依赖先验知识的自适应替代方案。

title: An Empirical Study on What Matters for Viewpoint-Generalizable Policies in Visual Imitation Learning
summary: Visual imitation learning is a promising approach to training robot manipulation policies capable of completing a wide variety of tasks. However, policies today remain brittle to viewpoint perturbations, making deployment in diverse environments a challenge. We present a controlled empirical study of which design choices allow visuomotor policies to generalize across viewpoints. We find that viewpoint generalization improves when dense visual tokens are retained and the action head participates in geometric reasoning. On a suite of simulated tasks that span a wide range of camera poses, we show that these design choices yield a policy that remains performant across viewpoints. As a practical consequence, a policy trained with these design choices also transfers zero-shot from simulation to the real world under random camera configurations.

AI.tldr: 通过受控实证研究，发现保留密集视觉 token 并让动作头参与几何推理可显著提升视觉运动策略的视角泛化能力，实现仿真到真机的零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉模仿学习策略对视角扰动脆弱，难以在多样视角环境下部署，因此需要明确哪些设计选择能提升跨视角泛化。
AI.method: 在覆盖广泛相机位姿的仿真任务套件上进行受控实证研究，系统对比不同视觉表征（是否保留密集视觉 token）与动作头是否参与几何推理这两项设计选择的影响。
AI.result: 保留密集视觉 token 且动作头参与几何推理时，策略在跨视角任务上保持稳定性能；在随机相机配置下，该策略还能从仿真零样本迁移到真实世界。
AI.conclusion: 密集视觉 token 与动作头几何推理是提升视觉运动策略视角泛化的关键设计，且具仿真到真机部署的实际价值。

title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Alignment with Pressure for Precise Suction Manipulation
summary: Stacking and palletising demand precise placement: error left in one layer is inherited by the next, and a flat pad offers no feature to funnel a wrong pose into the right one. Top-down suction suits such dense arrangements, and suction has already been brought into vision-language-action (VLA) policies. What that work does not report, however, is a policy conditioned on a measured vacuum signal, or one that uses it to abandon an action already under way. Vision does not settle the question here, because at the moment it matters the cup and the face it holds occlude each other. We present CLAP, which makes the attachment state observable through a pressure module tapped into the vacuum line. The decoded reading replaces the suction command in the policy's proprioception, is fused with the visual features, and terminates the open-loop execution window so that the policy re-infers from a fresh observation. For data, we record goal-state disassembly on the physical robot and reverse the joint-state sequence offline, without a simulation replay. Targeted phase demonstrations, 8.3% of the training frames, cover the suction transitions and the configurations an interrupted grasp leaves behind. On a real Unitree Z1, one multi-task checkpoint reaches 96.67% average success in both colour settings, 16.67 and 10.00 points above the strongest baseline, its monochromatic four-block successes averaging 15.92 mm of error. Four ablation settings fall 5.00 to 13.33 points short. We will release code and trained weights.

AI.tldr: CLAP 将真空压力信号引入 VLA 策略：用压力模块解码吸附件状态、替换本体感知中的吸盘指令并与视觉特征融合，同时用实测读数提前终止开环执行窗口触发重新推理；通过物理机器人目标态拆解+离线反转关节序列生成数据，在 Unitree Z1 上多任务单检查点达 96.67% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 码垛与堆叠对放置精度要求极高：下层误差会被上层继承，平坦吸盘面没有可自纠正的几何特征把错误位姿"导向"正确位姿。下压式吸盘适合密集排布，且吸盘已被引入 VLA 策略，但既有工作未报告以实测真空信号为条件、更未用该信号中止进行中的动作。视觉在此无法裁决，因为关键时刻杯体与其所持面互相遮挡。
AI.method: 硬件上在真空管路中接入压力模块，使吸附接触状态可观测；解码读数替换策略本体感知中的吸盘命令，与视觉特征融合，并用于终止开环执行窗口，使策略基于新观测重新推理。数据采集为物理机器人上的目标态拆解，离线反转关节状态序列，不做仿真回放。针对吸盘状态转换与被中断抓取遗留构型做定向阶段演示，仅占训练帧 8.3%。
AI.result: 在真实 Unitree Z1 上，单个多任务检查点在两种颜色设置下均达 96.67% 平均成功率，分别高出最强基线 16.67 与 10.00 个百分点；单色四块任务平均误差 15.92 mm。四个消融设置分别低 5.00 至 13.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实测真空压力可作为可观测的接触状态信号，替代吸盘命令参与本体感知并与视觉融合，并作为事件触发机制关闭开环执行、驱动闭环重推理，从而在真实机器人码垛/堆叠中获得稳健的高成功率；代码与训练权重将开源。

title: Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on task intention without reconstructing pixels. This prediction and action decoding shape the representation jointly, while the policy retains access to current-frame spatial detail for execution. Representation analyses show that the learned features better separate task-driven change from perturbations and provide complementary information for control. Compact prediction targets reduce training tokens per sample, enabling a 2B-parameter model trained in 9.67 hours on 8$\times$ RTX 5090 GPUs and 6$\times$ faster than Fast-WAM on matched A100 GPUs. Copper-Policy outperforms every compared method without embodied pretraining on RoboTwin and several embodied-pretrained VLAs on LIBERO-Plus (80.85%). On three challenging real-robot tasks, it performs comparably to $\pi_{0.5}$ and attains a higher average score. Together, these results show that Copper-Policy combines strong control performance with efficient training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Copper-Policy，通过与策略联合学习紧凑的 world representation（而非预定义目标空间），仅做时序联合嵌入预测而不重建像素，在 RoboTwin、LIBERO-Plus 与真机任务上取得领先或可比性能，并大幅降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 通过建模未来场景演化获得行为先验，但在像素或潜空间中预测细粒度未来代价高昂；而已有证据表明即使不做测试时生成，协同训练的收益依然存在，因此需要回答"WAM 到底必须学到什么才能提升控制"这一问题。
AI.method: Copper-Policy 让 world representation 与策略联合学习：通过时序联合嵌入预测，在以任务意图为条件下预测未来观测的嵌入，而不重建像素；该预测与动作解码共同塑造表征，同时策略保留当前帧的空间细节用于执行。紧凑的预测目标减少了每样本训练 token 数。
AI.result: 表征分析显示所学特征能更好地区分任务驱动变化与扰动，并为控制提供互补信息。2B 参数模型在 8×RTX 5090 上 9.67 小时完成训练，在匹配 A100 上比 Fast-WAM 快 6 倍。无具身预训练即在 RoboTwin 上超越所有对比方法，在 LIBERO-Plus 上超过若干具身预训练 VLA（80.85%）；在三个高难度真机任务上与 π0.5 相当且平均分更高。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的联合嵌入式 world 预测足以支撑强控制性能，Copper-Policy 在保持领先控制表现的同时实现高效训练，说明 WAM 的增益未必依赖高成本像素级生成。

title: CollisionGAT: Controller-Agnostic One-Step Collision Screening for Multi-Agent Motion
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, 2 algorithms. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)
summary: Before a team of robots moves, each proposed step must be checked for collisions with other robots and with obstacles. We present CollisionGAT, a graph-attention network that reads the current and proposed states of moving agents together with locally relevant stationary obstacles and returns one collision-risk score per moving agent. Any controller can use these scores to accept, repair, replan, or postpone a proposed step. We mount CollisionGAT on a continuous path-following controller and on GATeD, an obstacle-blind D* Lite planner that uses typed vetoes to update its planning graphs. Exact geometric checks supply the training labels and independently audit every executed step.

AI.tldr: 提出CollisionGAT——一个图注意力网络，输入移动agent当前与提议状态及局部相关静态障碍，为每个agent输出碰撞风险分数，可支持接受/修复/重规划/推迟决策，并挂载到连续路径跟踪控制器与障碍盲的D* Lite规划器GATeD（使用类型化否决更新规划图），几何精确检查提供训练标签并独立审计每一步。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同移动前必须逐步做碰撞检查。传统几何碰撞检测在连续、多体、动态场景中计算昂贵且易与规划/控制耦合；作者希望用学习型风险评分替代/增强逐步几何检查，使任意控制器都能用统一的风险分数来做出接受、修复、重规划或推迟的决策。
AI.method: CollisionGAT：图注意力网络，节点为移动agent，输入为当前与提议状态以及局部相关的静态障碍，输出每个移动agent的碰撞风险分数。两个集成方式：(1) 挂载在连续路径跟踪控制器上；(2) 挂载在GATeD——一个"障碍盲"的D* Lite规划器上，用类型化否决（typed vetoes）更新规划图。训练标签来自精确几何检查，且每个执行步都由几何检查独立审计。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；报道的结构性结果是网络可为每个agent输出碰撞风险分数，可被控制器用于接受/修复/重规划/推迟提议步，并与连续路径跟踪控制器及GATeD规划器成功集成，全程由精确几何检查提供标签与审计。
AI.conclusion: CollisionGAT把学习型碰撞风险评分作为通用接口，解耦了规划/控制与碰撞检查；与GATeD结合可让原本障碍盲的规划器获得碰撞感知能力。摘要缺乏实机或仿真实验数据、成功率与对比基线，实际性能与泛化性需正文验证。

title: Towards Kinematic Actionable Infeasibility Detection in Motion Planning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Motion planning in robotics requires not only computing collision-free paths but also certifying infeasibility when no such path exists. Complete methods are limited to low-dimensional spaces, while sampling-based planners scale efficiently but cannot provide finite-time infeasibility certificates, leaving this problem largely unresolved in high-dimensional spaces. In this letter, we present a geometry-driven framework for certifying infeasibility through an explicit resolution-dependent analysis of configuration space topology. Leveraging signed distance field representations, the proposed method traces separating manifolds induced by obstacle boundaries directly in configuration space, enabling both detection of infeasibility and identification of the specific geometric cause. To address computational challenges, we develop a parallel frontier-expansion algorithm that exploits GPU acceleration for efficient simplicial reconstruction in high-dimensional spaces. We validate the approach on 4-DOF and 5-DOF robot scenarios, certifying infeasibility within seconds for 4-DOF cases and under four minutes for 5-DOF cases. We further discuss avenues for improving scalability to higher-dimensional spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出几何驱动的运动规划不可行性认证框架，利用SDF在构型空间中追踪障碍边界诱导的分离流形，结合GPU并行前沿扩展实现高维简单复形重构，在4-DOF/5-DOF场景秒级至四分钟内完成认证。
AI.motivation: 运动规划中证明"无解"与找到可行路径同等重要，但完备方法局限于低维空间，采样规划器虽可扩展却无法提供有限时间内的不可行性证书，高维空间的不可行性认证问题长期未解。
AI.method: 基于符号距离场（SDF）表示，对构型空间拓扑进行分辨率相关的显式分析，直接在构型空间中追踪由障碍边界诱导的分离流形；提出并行前沿扩展算法，利用GPU加速高维空间中的简单复形重建。
AI.result: 在4-DOF与5-DOF机器人场景中验证，4-DOF可在数秒内完成不可行性认证，5-DOF在四分钟内完成，并讨论了向更高维扩展的途径。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次在较高维空间中实现了可给出几何成因的有限时间不可行性证书，为高维运动规划的完备性认证提供了新思路，但可扩展性仍受维度限制。

title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
summary: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations. To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出SonoGraph-WM，一个动作与目标条件化的解剖世界模型，用场景图表征解剖结构并联合预测未来场景图与探头位姿，配合滚动时域规划器实现预测性超声探头导航，由CT标签图自动生成训练数据。
AI.motivation: 超声采集高度依赖操作者的解剖理解与探头运动预判能力，而现有机器人超声导航方法在选择动作时并未显式预测解剖结构将如何随探头移动而变化，因此缺乏前瞻性规划能力。
AI.method: 以场景图表示可见解剖结构、几何与空间关系，避免合成超声图像；用统一Transformer在给定场景图与位姿历史下联合预测未来场景图与位姿；采用滚动时域规划器递归想象候选轨迹，选择到达目标图的最短预测路径并执行短时片段后重规划；利用CT标签图沿表面约束的探头轨迹生成对齐的场景图–位姿训练数据，降低对人工标注超声序列的依赖。
AI.result: 在四个留出CT病例上，20步预测的空间关系F1保持93%以上；基于标注场景图的闭环导航在胆囊和胰腺上成功率分别为77.50%和75.00%；在机器人–体模实验中，使用标签图推导的场景图，规划器在73.7%的试验中到达目标视图。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持CT监督的解剖世界建模用于探头规划，并表明频繁的观测更新对可靠导航至关重要。

title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FINE 框架从已有 VLN 示范轨迹的未来观测中挖掘隐式监督，通过显式地标 token 与隐式未来 token 两项辅助任务增强导航策略，在示范数据受限时显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: VLN 策略适配新环境代价高昂，每条新路线与指令都需具身示范；而观测-到-动作的标准训练仅利用了轨迹中很小一部分信息，尤其是未来观测所蕴含的指令相关地标的外观与三维布局信息被浪费。
AI.method: FINE 为 VLN 主干引入两类互补辅助表征：(1) 显式地标 token，按指令指定的地标顺序，在语义 2D patch 特征空间与视角相关的 3D 几何特征空间中预测未来地标区域；(2) 隐式未来 token，借助视频世界模型生成同场景反事实未来，学习区分真实到达的地标状态与合理但错误的反事实状态。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上，全量训练数据下使 InternVLA-N1 成功率分别提升 2.6 与 4.5 个百分点；在 70% 示范预算下成功率提升 6.8 个百分点，约恢复因减少示范而损失性能的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 从既有示范的未来观测中提取辅助监督是提升 VLN 数据效率的有效途径，且数据越稀缺收益越明显，具备实际部署价值。

title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
summary: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.

AI.tldr: RoboFoundry 提出"自演化系统即策略"的具身智能体框架，将上下文系统与分层技能系统作为统一策略，通过执行经验转化为经验证的持久系统更新，实现跨本体迁移与在线演化。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体方法多单独优化记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口等组件，未将支撑系统整体视为统一策略；同时仅有交互并不会带来自我改进，除非执行经验被转化为持久且验证过的系统变更。
AI.method: 将智能体支撑系统形式化为 Self-Evolving System-as-Policy：诊断决策与记忆管理的能力缺口，把执行轨迹转化为经验证的任务特定系统更新，并将重复出现的改进提升为通用系统能力。演化在两个互补面进行——管理活跃内部上下文与持久文件系统记忆的上下文系统，以及组织原子技能、可复用组合与失败条件恢复的分层技能系统；共享语义接口将本体无关决策与本体相关执行解耦，使演化能力可跨异构机器人迁移。
AI.result: 在 EmbodiedBench 上达 SOTA，GPT-5.5 提升 27.8%，Qwen3.7-Plus 达到 70.3% 接近 GPT-5.5 的 72.7%；长时程记忆在 RoboMemArena 上至少领先基线 39.0%（含外部大模型辅助方法）；LIBERO-PRO 上各扰动类型超 Cap-Agent0 达 243.8%–679.7%；真实世界部署验证了跨机器人与任务的零样本迁移与在线演化。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体支撑系统作为可自我演化的统一策略，是把交互经验沉淀为持久能力的有效路径，并在仿真基准与真实部署中展现出实现全自主具身智能体的潜力。

title: Communication-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Decentralized Multi-Human Multi-Robot Task Allocation
summary: Multi-human multi-robot (MH-MR) teams combine robotic autonomy with human expertise, but effective task allocation requires coordinating scarce, dynamically available human support with distributed robot execution. Limited robot-robot and human-robot communication further complicates this coupling by delaying information exchange and supervisory intervention. We introduce CommHG, a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized MH-MR task allocation. CommHG represents coupled human-robot-task interactions through local graphs conditioned on information availability and age. Learned communication actions enable robots to decide when and which operator to query, and when to share information with peers. Allocation and communication are jointly optimized through cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, allowing the team to acquire useful information while managing limited communication and supervisory resources. We also introduce a benchmark integrating heterogeneous humans and robots, dynamic tasks and operational states, and constrained robot-robot and bidirectional human-robot links. Experiments across heterogeneous teams with up to 16 robots, 6 humans, and 112 tasks show that CommHG improves timely weighted mission completion as coordination scale increases, outperforming the strongest baseline in the Large scenario.

AI.tldr: CommHG：面向去中心化多人类-多机器人任务分配的通信感知异构图学习框架，联合优化分配与通信决策，并配套异构团队基准。
AI.motivation: MH-MR 团队需协调稀缺且动态可用的人力监督与分布式机器人执行；受限的通信与信息时效（age of information）导致信息交换与干预延迟，任务分配与通信耦合难以处理。
AI.method: 以条件于信息可用性与信息年龄的局部图表示人-机器人-任务耦合交互；学习通信动作决定何时查询哪名操作员、何时与同伴共享信息；用协作式多智能体强化学习联合优化分配与通信，去中心化执行。
AI.result: 构建含异构人类与机器人、动态任务与运行状态、受限机间链路与双向人机链路的基准；在最多16机器人、6人类、112任务场景中，随协调规模增大，及时加权任务完成率提升，在 Large 场景超过最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通信感知的异构图表示与联合学习可有效缓解通信受限下的人机协同瓶颈，具备向大规模去中心化异构团队扩展的潜力。

title: Learning Geometry-Aware Virtual Fixtures From Sparse Demonstrations
summary: In many teleoperation applications, collecting a large number of demonstrations as required for traditional probabilistic learning from demonstration (LfD) approaches may not be feasible. To still give operators the ability to intuitively create trajectories as Virtual Fixtures (VFs), we propose to leverage a motion prior in the learning process. Particularly, by using Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT), users are able to define guiding trajectories from the demonstration of just a few via points. To account for orientation guidance, we further reformulate classical LQT on Riemannian manifolds, introducing an additional geometric prior. Through a probabilistic interpretation of the LQT solution, we derive a covariance estimate at each trajectory point which we use to modulate the stiffness of the resulting fixture, resulting in strong guidance around the via points and softer guidance when far away. The covariance information is also used to define a validity region of the fixture, allowing the operator to leave its influence area and conduct unmodeled tasks. We evaluate the proposed Riemannian LQT formulation in a set of toy examples and the full framework on a cutting task requiring high precision in a minimally invasive surgery setting on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK).

AI.tldr: 提出基于黎曼流形上LQT的运动先验虚拟夹具框架，仅需少量via point即可生成含刚度和有效区调制的高精度引导轨迹，并在dVRK切割任务验证。
AI.motivation: 传统概率式LfD需大量演示，遥操作中难以采集；同时缺乏朝向引导与可变刚度/退出区域机制，难以支撑高精度任务。
AI.method: 以Linear Quadratic Tracking作为运动先验，将经典LQT重formulate到黎曼流形以引入几何先验处理朝向；对LQT解做概率解释得到每点协方差，用于调制夹具刚度（via point附近强、远处弱）并定义有效区域。
AI.result: 在一组toy examples上评估黎曼LQT表述，并在da Vinci Research Kit上以需要高精度的微创手术切割任务验证完整框架。
AI.conclusion: 少量via point即可获得直观可用的VFs，且刚度与有效区随协方差自适应，兼顾引导强度与操作者自主性，具备手术遥操作实用性。

title: PalmLeaf-VQA: A Multi-Script Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Historical Palm-Leaf Manuscript Understanding Across Diverse Regions
summary: Historical manuscripts remain largely absent from modern vision-language benchmarks, leaving open how well multimodal large language models (MLLMs) handle culturally diverse, degraded, and non-Latin document images. We introduce \textbf{PalmLeaf-VQA}, a multi-script visual question answering benchmark for historical palm-leaf manuscript understanding across South and Southeast Asian traditions. PalmLeaf-VQA contains \textbf{923 curated manuscript images} and \textbf{7,384 question--answer pairs} from eight collection groups: Balinese, Grantha, Jathakam, Kambaramayanam, Kannada, Khmer, Sundanese, and Tamil. Unlike recognition-oriented resources, the benchmark targets manuscript-aware visual reasoning over preservation-relevant cues, including physical condition, line structure, material and coating, binding holes, margins, symbols, drawings, and localized visual artifacts. We evaluate recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under open-answer and constrained-answer prompting and provide fine-grained analysis across collections, question categories, and task types. The strongest evaluated model reaches only \textbf{58.00\% exact-match accuracy} on the held-out test split, revealing substantial limitations in current MLLMs for rare-script, degraded-layout, and preservation-oriented document understanding. PalmLeaf-VQA provides a standardized benchmark for advancing culturally grounded and layout-aware multimodal document analysis.

AI.tldr: 介绍 PalmLeaf-VQA，一个面向南亚/东南亚历史贝叶经手稿的多文字视觉问答基准，含 923 张图像与 7,384 个问答对，最强 MLLM 仅达 58% 精确匹配。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言基准几乎不覆盖历史手稿，MLLM 对文化多样、退化、非拉丁文字文档图像的理解能力尚不明确，缺乏标准化评测资源。
AI.method: 构建 PalmLeaf-VQA 基准，涵盖八类收藏（Balinese、Grantha、Jathakam、Kambaramayanam、Kannada、Khmer、Sundanese、Tamil），聚焦保存相关视觉线索（物理状态、行结构、材质与涂层、装订孔、页边、符号、绘图、局部伪影）；在开放答案与受限答案两种提示设置下评测近期闭源与开源 MLLM，并按收藏、问题类别、任务类型做细粒度分析。
AI.result: 最强模型在留出测试集上仅获 58.00% 精确匹配准确率，揭示当前 MLLM 在稀有文字、退化版式与保存导向文档理解上的显著局限。
AI.conclusion: PalmLeaf-VQA 为文化根基化、版式感知的多模态文档分析提供标准化基准，凸显历史手稿理解仍是开放难题。

title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
comment: 32 pages (10-page main text plus appendices), 4 figures, 25 tables. Under review. Code, checkpoints, and demo video: this https URL
summary: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.

AI.tldr: TriDrive：联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求的自动化条件转移模型，在AIDE、BATON数据集取得SOTA，并蒸馏后于comma four车载平台实时运行（5 Hz、177 ms p95）。
AI.motivation: 以往工作孤立地建模舱内驾驶员行为或交通条件下的驾驶员运动，缺少对驾驶员-车辆-道路三者联合演化与实时车载评估的统一建模，因此需要联合建模框架。
AI.method: 模模态专用编码器：驾驶员的锚定运动学表征、因果CAN总线动力学、冻结的V-JEPA 2道路隐变量（含结构化道路裕度）；通过有向残差连接让驾驶员与道路上下文修正车辆预测，形成以自动化等级为条件的转移模型；并对道路编码器蒸馏以适配车载实时推理。
AI.result: AIDE基准全量SOTA（All-MPJPE 48.05 vs 71.47）；BATON 197.2小时数据上，有向连接与道路裕度使转向起始PR-AUC提升0.084、TTC下降提升0.286；comma four + 外置8 GB GPU上轻量预警探针5 Hz更新、p95延迟177 ms，AUROC 0.725 vs openpilot基线0.563；14名驾驶员实车配对研究评价预警更合适（+1.79）更及时（+2.67）。
AI.conclusion: 统一的驾驶员-车辆-道路联合预测在精度与实时性上均可落地，且人类驾驶员主观评价优于现有DMS，具备车载安全预警应用潜力。

title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出CAPEX框架，用多模态基础模型自身作为自主演示者，依据历史执行经验自适应调整基础模型的观察/推理/重规划频率，从而低成本、可扩展地采集机器人操作演示数据。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习高度依赖人类遥操作演示，但采集过程不直观、难以规模化且本质异步。虽然通用多模态基础模型能生成零样本操作轨迹，但在物理执行中反复调用它们缓慢且昂贵，限制了其作为可扩展数据生成器的能力。因此需要一种方法在保持成功轨迹优势的同时降低调用成本。
AI.method: CAPEX是一种经验条件化的演示采集框架：利用先前尝试的执行经验来适应性地决定基础模型何时观察、推理和重规划的频率（经验条件化调用策略）。在RoboCasa任务以及物理Franka和双臂YAM机械臂平台上评测，度量任务成功率、模型调用次数、token用量、采集时间与成本。并训练Diffusion Policy与ACT，在人类遥操作演示与基础模型生成演示的匹配集合上对比，评估自主采集数据的下游学习价值。
AI.result: CAPEX将成功演示数量提升4.3倍，同时将每个成功演示的成本降低80%。用CAPEX生成数据训练的策略性能接近匹配的人类演示训练策略；随着训练时间延长，从零训练策略的这一差距基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明基础模型可以作为可扩展、可复用的机器人经验来源，经验条件化调用能在不牺牲数据质量的前提下显著降低采集成本，为机器人数据采集提供新范式。

title: Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) is vulnerable to covariate shift during closed-loop execution, where small prediction or execution errors can drive the robot toward states poorly covered by the demonstration data. We focus on action-sequence planning, where a policy predicts a finite-horizon sequence of actions as a reference trajectory for robot execution. Existing approaches to covariate shift often rely on collecting additional corrective demonstrations, requiring further environment interaction and access to an expert or reference policy. We propose Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision (PARS), a simple training approach for improving recovery using only existing demonstrations. PARS perturbs the robot's proprioceptive state and anchors only the later portion of the predicted trajectory to the original demonstration, leaving the earlier portion free to generate corrective motion and recover toward the demonstrated behavior within the planning horizon. Unlike conventional input-noise augmentation, which preserves the original supervision target over the entire prediction horizon, PARS explicitly provides trajectory-level supervision for recovery from perturbed states. PARS requires neither additional environment interaction nor expert queries and can be instantiated across different action-sequence policy classes with only minor modifications to their BC objectives. Experiments on 51 RLBench manipulation tasks with flow-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based policies demonstrate that PARS improves robustness to covariate shift during closed-loop execution.

AI.tldr: PARS：仅用已有示范，通过对本体状态施加扰动并只锚定预测轨迹后段，为动作序列策略提供轨迹级恢复监督，提升闭环执行对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 动作序列规划的模仿学习在闭环执行中易受协变量偏移影响，微小误差会把机器人推向示范数据未覆盖的状态；现有方法多依赖额外采集纠错示范，需要环境交互和专家/参考策略，成本高。
AI.method: 提出 Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision（PARS）：训练时扰动机器人本体感知状态，但只把预测动作序列的靠后部分锚定到原始示范，前段不施加监督，使其自由生成纠错动作并在规划时域内回到示范行为。与传统输入噪声增强（保留整条监督目标）不同，PARS 提供轨迹级恢复监督；无需额外交互或专家查询，可对 flow-based、transformer-based、diffusion-based 等策略的 BC 目标做小幅修改即可实例化。
AI.result: 在 RLBench 的 51 个操作任务上，对基于 flow、transformer 和 diffusion 的动作序列策略进行实验，PARS 提升了闭环执行中对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PARS 是一种简洁、无需额外数据或专家的训练增强方法，通过轨迹级恢复监督缓解动作序列 BC 的协变量偏移问题，并可跨策略类别通用。局限在于验证仅在仿真基准（RLBench）上进行，缺少真实机器人实验与更细粒度的恢复行为分析。

title: SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control
summary: Cable-suspended hoisting is widely used to move heavy or bulky payloads that cannot be handled conveniently by rigid pick-and-place systems, for example in crane-assisted construction. Robotic hoisting using flexible cables is challenging because payload motion is underactuated, external disturbances vary, and delayed or lost visual observations can make the perceived payload state stale at control execution. These effects are particularly critical during precise insertion of a suspended payload's sockets onto rebar pins, which is a very common task in construction environments. We present SwingRL, a residual reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that combines an age-aware world model, a classical anti-swing prior, and a recurrent residual policy to address two coupled problems: stale feedback and uncertain dynamics. The world model propagates the newest received payload observation to the current control step using the executed commands, providing a time-aligned state estimate under delayed and lossy sensing. The prior supplies nominal tracking and swing damping. The residual policy learns bounded corrections to the prior rather than the complete control law, compensating for system-parameter variation, external disturbances, and remaining state-estimation errors. We evaluate SwingRL against classical and learning-based baselines across a cumulative difficulty ladder covering system-parameter variation, wind disturbance, degraded sensing, and strong gusts. Under the most difficult setting, SwingRL achieves 69.5% strict and 77.3% broad success, exceeding all baselines by at least 60 percentage points, respectively. World-model ablations support the role of time-aligned state estimation in maintaining insertion success as observation loss increases. Finally, without real-robot fine-tuning, SwingRL achieves 90% success on the physical rig.

AI.tldr: SwingRL: 面向缆索吊装插入任务的残差强化学习框架，融合"年龄感知"世界模型、经典抗摆先验与循环残差策略，解决延迟/丢包感知下的状态陈旧与动力学不确定问题，仿真与真机均显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 缆索吊装因柔性索具导致负载欠驱动，且外部扰动多变、视觉观测存在延迟与丢失，控制执行时感知到的负载状态可能已过时，这在"将悬挂负载套筒精确套入钢筋销"这一常见施工任务中尤为致命。已有工作难以同时处理反馈陈旧与动力学不确定性两个耦合问题。
AI.method: 提出 SwingRL 残差 RL 框架，包含三部分：(1) age-aware 世界模型，利用已执行控制指令将最新收到的负载观测前推到当前控制步，在延迟与丢包感知下给出时间对齐的状态估计；(2) 经典抗摆先验，提供名义跟踪与摆动阻尼；(3) 循环残差策略，学习对先验的有界修正而非完整控制律，以补偿系统参数变化、外部扰动与残余状态估计误差。
AI.result: 在涵盖系统参数变化、风扰、感知退化与强阵风的递进难度阶梯上，与经典及学习型基线对比；最难设定下达成 69.5% 严格成功率与 77.3% 宽松成功率，分别领先所有基线至少 60 个百分点。世界模型消融验证了时间对齐状态估计在观测丢失加剧时维持插入成功率的作用。未做真机微调即在实际装置上达到 90% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将经典控制先验与残差 RL 及时间对齐世界模型结合，可有效应对欠驱动柔性吊装中的陈旧反馈与不确定动力学；方法从仿真到真机具备零微调迁移能力，适合施工场景的高精度吊装插入。

title: REALM: A Coarse-to-Fine Generative Framework for Embodied Reactive Listening
summary: Generating responsive listener facial motion is an important task for embodied conversational AI. Two modeling challenges are central: accounting for the timing of speaker cues while maintaining continuity with the listener's ongoing motion, and capturing locally variable facial events alongside the overall motion trajectory. Listener responses may follow preceding cues with a temporal lag, while brief expressions and blinks introduce variation that is difficult to predict deterministically. These challenges motivate a framework that combines history-aware temporal alignment with stochastic expression refinement. We propose REALM (Reactive Embodied Audio-driven Listening Model), a coarse-to-fine framework for audio-driven reactive listening. A Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion module combines listener motion history with speaker audio through a delay-centered attention prior and adaptive gating. A coarse decoder predicts a base motion trajectory, which is augmented by audio-conditioned stochastic residuals in the expression subspace while retaining the coarse pose parameters. Evaluations on ViCo and L2L show improvements over the evaluated baselines across multiple motion-quality metrics. Additional analyses examine delay sensitivity, gate behavior, and blink dynamics. Finally, deployment on an Ameca humanoid robot and a perceptual user study demonstrate the applicability of the generated behavior to physical embodiment. Code: this https URL Demo: this https URL

AI.tldr: REALM：音频驱动的听者反应性面部动作生成框架，用延迟为中心的注意力先验与门控融合历史动作，再以表达子空间随机残差做粗到细细化，在ViCo/L2L上提升运动质量指标，并部署于Ameca人形机器人。
AI.motivation: 具身对话AI中听者面部反应生成存在两个建模难点：(1) 需兼顾说话人线索的时间延迟与听者自身动作的连续性；(2) 局部可变事件（短暂表情、眨眼）与整体运动轨迹需同时刻画，且这些事件难以确定性预测。故需要历史感知的时间对齐与随机表达细化的统一框架。
AI.method: REALM 采用粗到细框架：Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion 模块通过以延迟为中心的注意力先验和自适应门控，将听者动作历史与说话人音频融合；粗解码器预测基础运动轨迹；随后在表达子空间中用音频条件随机残差进行增强，同时保留粗姿态参数。
AI.result: 在 ViCo 与 L2L 数据集上，多项运动质量指标优于所评估的基线；额外分析考察了延迟敏感性、门控行为与眨眼动态；并在 Ameca 人形机器人上部署，感知用户研究验证了生成行为在物理具身上的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明历史感知的时间对齐结合随机表达细化可有效生成反应性听者面部动作，且可迁移至实体机器人平台，为具身对话AI的听者行为建模提供了可行路径。

title: Humanoids for Robot-Assisted Surgery: Bimanual Base Placement and Tool-Mount Optimization via Capability Maps
summary: Rapid advances in humanoid robotics have motivated growing interest in the application of humanoids for healthcare and clinical tasks. However, it remains unclear how close contemporary humanoids are to meeting the kinematic demands of robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery. In this work, we address the question of optimal robot positioning through a quantitative analysis of workspace and robot setup configurations. We present a capability-map-based robot setup framework that optimizes humanoid base placement and tool mounting orientation to maximize bimanual humanoid reachability while accounting for tool-tip kinematics and remote-center-of-motion (RCM) constraints. We evaluate three humanoid platforms spanning different body dimensions and kinematic redundancy on workspace reachability for three representative general surgery procedures: cholecystectomy, inguinal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. The proposed joint optimization of base placement and tool mounting consistently outperforms base-only optimization and heuristic baselines. For cholecystectomy and inguinal hernia repair, which are characterized by relatively small and minimally overlapping workspaces, humanoid reachability approached 90%. For the larger, overlapping multi-port arm workspace of sleeve gastrectomy, humanoids yield substantially lower coverage. These results quantify the near-term promise of humanoids for selected laparoscopic procedures and clarify key limitations that must be addressed for broader deployment.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出基于"能力图"（capability-map）的机器人配置优化框架，联合优化人形机器人基座位置与器械安装朝向，在满足工具尖端运动学与远程运动中心（RCM）约束下最大化双臂可达性，并在三种人形平台上评估三种腹腔镜手术的可达覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人用于医疗与临床任务的兴趣日增，但当代人形机器人能否满足机器人辅助腹腔镜手术的运动学需求尚不清楚，尤其缺少关于最优机器人定位的量化分析。
AI.method: 构建基于能力图（capability map）的机器人配置框架，将基座放置与器械安装朝向做联合优化，以最大化双臂可达性，同时考虑工具尖端运动学与RCM约束；在三种不同体型与运动冗余度的人形平台上，针对胆囊切除、腹股沟疝修补、袖状胃切除三类手术进行工作空间可达性评估，并与仅优化基座及启发式基线对比。
AI.result: 联合优化一致优于仅基座优化与启发式基线；对小且重叠少的工作空间（胆囊切除、腹股沟疝修补），人形可达率接近90%；对更大且多孔臂工作空间重叠的袖状胃切除，覆盖率显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了人形机器人在部分腹腔镜手术中的近期可行性，同时明确了更广泛部署前必须解决的关键局限（如大范围、多臂重叠工作空间的可达性不足）。

title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
summary: Little is known about how to manually design agents capable of dexterous manipulation. Some design principles have been inferred from close examination of how animals manipulate objects, but these structures and behaviors have so far resisted biomimicry and may not be optimal for artificial machines. Here we evolve freeform robots to pick up, hold, rotate, and use diverse objects. Unlike other approaches to optimizing robot hands, we do not presuppose the presence, articulation, or geometry of any part of the body. Although familiar prehensile forms such as tails, beaks, paws and claws may emerge spontaneously under certain conditions--and while such conditions could be of interest to evolutionary biologists--de novo manipulator design can also reveal whole new solutions, overlooked or unknown structures which may be better suited for the task at hand. We use contrastive learning to create a highly searchable genetic embedding of design space, an autoregressive developmental model to decode designs, evolutionary strategies to find good designs, and reinforcement learning to train each evolved design. Winning designs were automatically converted into a manufacturable blueprint, printed, assembled and tested in the real world in a zero-shot manner. The results represent the state-of-the-art in evolutionary robotics in terms of performance, diversity and complexity.

AI.tldr: 该工作用对比学习构建可搜索的设计嵌入、自回归发育模型解码形态、进化策略搜索构型，并用强化学习训练每个演化出的自由形态机器人，实现抓取、握持、旋转与使用多种物体的灵巧操作，获胜设计被自动转为可制造蓝图并零样本实机验证。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作代理的人工设计缺乏系统原则；从动物借用的结构与行为难以被仿生复制，且未必对人工机器最优。作者希望在不预设任何身体部件存在性、关节或几何的前提下，自动搜索出全新解决方案。
AI.method: 四段式流水线：(1) 对比学习构建高度可搜索的设计空间遗传嵌入；(2) 自回归发育模型将嵌入解码为机器人形态；(3) 进化策略在设计空间搜索优良设计；(4) 强化学习为每个演化设计训练控制策略。设计空间为自由形态(freeform)，不预设部件、关节数与几何。
AI.result: 演化出的自由形态机器人可完成拾取、握持、旋转和使用多种物体的任务；自发涌现出尾、喙、爪、掌等熟悉的抓握形态，也发现此前被忽视或未知的新结构。获胜设计被自动转换为可制造蓝图，打印、装配后在真实世界中以零样本方式测试成功。作者称其在性能、多样性与复杂度上代表进化机器人学的当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 无预设形态的协同演化（形态+控制）可自动产出可制造、可实机部署的灵巧操作器，揭示新设计可能性，并将进化机器人从仿真推向零样本真实世界验证。

title: VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning
summary: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.

AI.tldr: VPTwin 提出 Real-Sim-Real 视频预测框架：VLM 从真实演示重建数字孪生，Isaac Sim 在随机物理参数下做多轨迹前向动力学推演作为上下文参考，融合仿真物理合理性与真实视频中的未建模接触，并构建预测-规划闭环验证 VLM 动作，显著降低长时程视频预测的物理幻觉并提升操作规划性能。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的动作条件视频预测在长时程 rollout 中误差累积、产生物理不合理幻觉，严重削弱下游动作规划可靠性，需要引入物理先验约束。
AI.method: Real-Sim-Real 框架：VLM 依据真实演示构建可执行数字孪生；针对未观测物理属性估计的病态性，Isaac Sim 在随机化物理配置与候选动作下生成多个前向动力学 rollout；以这些 rollout 作为 in-context 参考，调和仿真动力学（物理合理性）与真实视频（未建模接触交互）；建立预测-规划闭环，用 VPTwin 视觉校验 VLM 提议动作。
AI.result: 在操作任务上显著减少视频预测中的物理幻觉，并明显提升操作规划性能。
AI.conclusion: 将实时同步的仿真孪生作为真实世界预测的锚点，可有效结合仿真物理约束与真实域细节，形成可闭环验证的预测-规划一体化方案。

title: Multi-Modal Non-Prehensile Estimation of Physical Parameters via Press-and-Pull Tipping
summary: Recovering physical properties of unknown objects through non-prehensile interaction is challenging because no single manipulation primitive reveals all relevant parameters. Planar pushing couples mass and friction, while conventional tipping cannot recover friction and may fail entirely when low-friction or curved-base objects slide or rotate instead of tipping. We introduce a multi-modal estimation framework that combines a sliding interaction with a press-and-pull tipping primitive to recover object mass, center of mass height, and surface friction. The press-and-pull interaction increases the object-table sliding threshold and stabilizes the pivot, enabling controlled tipping without any prior geometric object model. Wrist force/torque sensing, RGB-D perception, and robot proprioception are fused to estimate the physical parameters from the two complementary interaction modes. Experiments on an ABB IRB120 across four objects with varied geometry, mass, center of mass, and friction achieve low relative error, while successfully operating on curved-base objects that fail under conventional forward tipping. The results demonstrate that complementary non-prehensile interactions can recover a compact set of physical parameters without grasping, a prior object model, or learned interaction dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态非抓取交互框架，结合滑动与按压-拉动翻转，估计物体质量、质心高度与摩擦，无需几何模型且适用于曲面底物体。
AI.motivation: 单一非抓取操作原语无法揭示全部物理参数：平面推动使质量与摩擦耦合，传统翻转无法恢复摩擦，且对低摩擦或曲面底物体会滑移或旋转导致失败。
AI.method: 融合滑动交互与"按压-拉动"翻转原语的多模态估计框架；按压-拉动提高滑动阈值并稳定支点，实现无先验几何模型的受控翻转；融合腕部力/力矩传感、RGB-D感知与机器人本体状态，从两种互补交互模式中估计参数。
AI.result: 在ABB IRB120上对四个几何、质量、质心与摩擦各异的物体实验，相对误差低，并成功处理传统前向翻转失败的曲面底物体。
AI.conclusion: 互补的非抓取交互可在无抓取、无先验物体模型、无学习交互动力学的情况下恢复一组紧凑的物理参数。

title: Beyond State-as-Action: Exploiting Command-State Discrepancy for Robot Imitation Learning
summary: Constructing action targets from measured robot motion is an established approach in imitation learning. Under interaction constraints, however, command-state discrepancy may reflect control demands that motion alone does not capture. We investigate when this information matters and how to exploit it. Across three real-robot tasks, task and phase analyses reveal larger supervision gaps under constrained interaction, while selective command retention provides evidence of locally useful command information. Building on these findings, we propose Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW), which accounts for robot response times and combines subsequent progress, persistent unmet demand, and demand changes into continuous weights for command supervision. The method requires no task-phase annotations or changes to policy architecture or inference. CSDW improves over uniform command supervision on constrained tasks, while methods perform similarly in the less constrained task.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究交互约束下机器人命令-状态差异（command-state discrepancy）的监督价值，提出CSDW加权方法，将响应时间、后续进展、持续未满足需求及需求变化整合为连续监督权重。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习通常从实测机器人运动构造动作目标，但在受交互约束的任务中，命令与状态之间的差异可能反映运动本身无法捕捉的控制需求。作者希望探究这种信息何时重要以及如何加以利用。
AI.method: 先通过三个真实机器人任务的任务与阶段分析，考察受约束交互下监督信号缺口，并用选择性保留命令验证其局部有用性；在此基础上提出Command-State Discrepancy Weighting（CSDW），考虑机器人响应时间，将后续进展、持续未满足需求与需求变化组合成连续的命令监督权重。方法无需任务阶段标注，也不改变策略架构或推理。
AI.result: 在受约束任务上，CSDW优于均匀命令监督；在约束较弱的任务上，两者表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 命令-状态差异在受约束交互场景中包含有价值的监督信息，CSDW可作为一种轻量、易集成的加权监督策略提升模仿学习效果。

title: TimelyDAgger: Timing-Aware Expert Querying for VLA Policy Improvement
summary: DAgger improves robot policies by aggregating expert supervision from states visited during policy execution. Robot-gated DAgger automates expert queries, allowing the robot to decide when to request expert takeover. While existing gates emphasize detecting the need for assistance, takeover timing also shapes the content of these demonstrations and their value for policy learning. We propose TimelyDAgger, combining Bridge-PCA monitoring of internal vision-language-action (VLA) features with Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation based on expert behavior to improve takeover timing. We introduce an evaluation framework linking failure detection, takeover timing, and policy improvement, including Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR) for assessing supervision quality without retraining. Experiments show that takeover timing affects policy learning, with TimelyDAgger achieving competitive failure detection and higher post-training success in most evaluated settings under matched expert-action budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 TimelyDAgger，通过监测 VLA 内部视觉-语言-动作特征的 Bridge-PCA 与基于专家行为的反馈引导阈值自适应来改进机器人门控 DAgger 的接管时机，并引入 TASR 等评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人门控 DAgger 主要关注"是否需要帮助"的检测，而忽略了接管时机本身如何影响专家示范内容与策略学习价值。
AI.method: 将 Bridge-PCA 监测 VLA 内部特征用于失败/需求检测，并结合基于专家行为的 Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation 动态调整接管阈值，实现更及时的专家接管；同时构建连接失败检测、接管时机与策略改进的评估框架及 Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR)。
AI.result: 实验表明接管时机确实影响策略学习效果；在匹配的专家动作预算下，TimelyDAgger 在多数评测设置中实现有竞争力的失败检测与更高的训练后成功率。
AI.conclusion: 接管时机是机器人门控 DAgger 中被低估的关键设计变量，通过内部分布监控与自适应阈值可有效提升示范质量与策略改进。

title: Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"行为学行为基质（ethological behavioral substrate）"这一概念视角，主张将动物持续展现的行为协调能力（而非孤立技能集合）作为机器人学习的研究目标，并提出以机器人动物伴侣作为研究长期人机交互与持续适应的实验场景。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人学习虽在能力上不断进步，但相对忽视了动物持续展现的基础能力：在物理、环境与社会需求变化时保持"在场"、响应性与行为连贯性。作者认为这种持续协调能力在竞争性需求下被低估，是当前具身智能研究的重要空白。
AI.method: 属于立场/展望型（perspective）论文，未提出具体算法或系统。方法为概念性论证：1）引入"行为学行为基质"作为分析透镜；2）将动物行为从"孤立技能集合"重新定义为"竞争需求下的持续协调问题"；3）论证机器人动物伴侣作为研究长期交互、社会行为、记忆与持续学习的研究场景。
AI.result: 无实验、数据集或量化结果。产出为概念框架与研究方向倡议，主张持续行为胜任力可与具身智能体高层能力互补。
AI.conclusion: 持续的行为胜任力（situatedness、响应性、行为连贯性）应成为机器人学习的独立研究目标；机器人动物伴侣是研究长时程交互与持续适应的合适平台。

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
comment: 48 pages, including appendices. Project page: this https URL
summary: World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation. To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution. DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 将动态操作建模为反事实规划，解耦"生成计划的上下文"与"执行时物理状态"，无需动态数据训练即可实时操作运动目标。
AI.motivation: 基于静态示教训练的 World-Action 模型（WAM）在操作运动目标时会失败，作者将其归因于 target-response collapse：随执行推进，策略愈发偏向已学习的自身行为延续，对目标移动的响应性下降。目标是弥合"模型已学到什么"与"当前上下文可生成什么"之间的差距。
AI.method: DPP 框架：先利用 WAM 的预测展开估计交互预期发生的时机，结合观测到的目标运动预测未来交互位置；再构造反事实观测——把预测的目标位置放入熟悉的机器人上下文中，使模型调用已有操作技能，而非在不熟悉的机器人-目标构型下生成恢复行为；最后在执行阶段将该计划与机器人真实状态连接。无需额外动态数据训练。
AI.result: 可在单张消费级 GPU 上实时执行动态操作；仿真与真机实验在多种目标运动下取得一致提升，仿真性能超过所有评测基线，包括额外用动态数据训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实规划解耦上下文与物理状态，是提升 WAM 动态操作能力的一种免训练、可实时部署的有效途径，并指出了 target-response collapse 这一失效模式。

title: Multi-Terrain Mastery: A Comprehensive Controller for Bipedal Locomotion
summary: Advancing bipedal robots to navigate diverse terrains remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional locomotion controllers excel on specific surfaces but struggle across varied environments, limiting their practical applications. Given the unpredictable nature of real-world environments, a single controller capable of handling multiple terrains is ideal, eliminating the need for multiple specialized controllers. We propose a multi-terrain controller to enhance the versatility and robustness of bipedal locomotion. Building on previous work with a stance ankle motor for stability on inclined and rough surfaces, this paper extends capabilities to steep wet uneven grassy slopes, and compliant terrains such as sand, gravel, rocks, and constrained terrains like staircases. To address the unique demands of these terrains, we introduce a new impact map that is essential for maintaining performance and robustness against unseen terrains. We also discuss in detail the control structure for real-time deployment on the robot. We validate our controller on the 20 degree-of-freedom Cassie bipedal robot.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多地形双足行走单一控制器，引入新的碰撞/冲击映射（impact map）以提升对湿滑陡坡、沙砾岩石及楼梯等未见地形的鲁棒性，并在20自由度Cassie双足机器人上完成实机验证。
AI.motivation: 传统双足行走控制器通常只针对特定地面调优，跨地形泛化差，实际应用受限；而真实环境地形不可预测，用单一控制器覆盖多地形比维护多个专用控制器更理想。作者此前工作已验证站立踝电机对斜坡与崎岖地面的稳定性，本文希望将能力扩展到更极端与柔顺地形。
AI.method: 在已有站立踝电机控制框架上扩展为多地形控制器；核心创新是引入新的impact map（冲击映射）来刻画足-地接触冲击动力学，以维持性能与对未知地形的鲁棒性；论文还详细讨论了在机器人上实时部署的控制结构。控制器在20自由度Cassie双足机器人上验证。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标，仅声明在20自由度Cassie双足机器人上完成验证，控制器可应对陡峭湿滑不平的草坡、沙地、砾石、岩石等柔顺地形以及楼梯等受限地形，并保持对未见地形的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 单一多地形控制器可替代多个专用控制器，提升双足行走的通用性与鲁棒性；impact map的引入与实时部署控制结构是应对多样与未知地形的关键。本文属于具体方法与实机验证结合的工作，但对标定数据、成功率与失败模式披露不足。

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

AI.tldr: DeltaWAM 提出以"变化"为中心的世界-动作模型：用单个 delta token 编码相邻 DINO 特征图之间的变化，逐帧自回归预测未来变化，再由 flow-matching 动作专家结合空间锚点生成动作块，在 LIBERO 上达 92.8% 成功率，单块推理 142.1 ms、峰值显存 3.86 GB。
AI.motivation: 像素空间世界-动作模型需反复重建整个未来场景，计算开销大且存在严重时空冗余；物理操作中相邻帧的视觉上下文高度共享，策略真正需要预判的是帧间变化。
AI.method: 以紧凑 delta token 作为未来预测单元，每个 token 为编码相邻稠密 DINO 特征图差异的单向量；基于大规模视频预训练的隐空间世界模型 DeltaWorld 自回归预测每帧 delta token；flow-matching 动作专家以预测的转移与作为空间锚点的当前 DINO 特征为条件生成动作块。训练 256 GPU 小时（2×H100），0.725B 参数。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 92.8%；在 LIBERO-Pro 的程序性扰动下具备稳健泛化；推理每动作块 142.1 ms，峰值显存 3.86 GB。
AI.conclusion: 以帧间变化替代整帧重建的 delta token 范式，可显著降低世界-动作模型的计算与时空冗余，同时保持高成功率与泛化能力，为高效视觉前瞻策略提供新思路。

title: Temporal-Attention Head Specialization During Video Diffusion Training
summary: Video diffusion transformers depend on temporal attention to coordinate information across frames, yet nearly everything known about this mechanism comes from analyzing trained models, so when and where temporal-attention structure forms during training remains poorly characterized. Population averages can also hide it, since a few specializing heads and a diffusing majority cancel in the mean. We therefore conduct a checkpoint-resolved census of every temporal-attention head across nine Open-Sora STDiT training runs spanning three model scales (306M to 1.03B parameters), scoring each head with an entropy-normalized measure of cross-frame attention concentration (CFAC) under a preregistered change-point and effect-size selection rule. The census reveals the sparse picture that averages obscure. Aggregate CFAC is flat or decreasing in every run, while a small minority of heads, roughly 4--13% in full-grid runs, develops pronounced concentration. Across seeds, the reproducible signal is positional but block-level. Selected heads repeatedly arise in the first temporal block, whereas individual head coordinates do not reproduce once block membership is accounted for. Among the analyzed 760M selected heads, attention maps converge to a small repertoire of local frame-routing motifs, self-frame diagonals and adjacent-frame bands, even when the responsible coordinates differ across runs. Correlation and ablation analyses do not establish a causal link to generated video quality, and we bound our claims accordingly. Beyond this STDiT family, the study contributes a transferable methodology. Checkpoint-resolved, per-head analysis under fixed selection rules can expose sparse temporal organization in other factorized video diffusion transformers and, with adapted routing metrics, in joint spatio-temporal architectures.

AI.tldr: 对9次Open-Sora STDiT训练（306M–1.03B）进行checkpoint级、逐注意力头普查，用熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度（CFAC）度量并结合预注册变点/效应量准则，发现时序注意力结构稀疏：总体均值平坦或下降，仅4–13%的头出现集中，且可复现信号在块层面（首个时序块）而非具体头坐标；但未建立与生成视频质量的因果关系。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer依赖时序注意力跨帧协调信息，但现有认知几乎都来自对已训练模型的分析，训练过程中时序注意力结构何时、何处形成缺乏刻画；且总体平均会掩盖结构——少数特化头被大量弥散头在均值中抵消。因此需要checkpoint分辨、逐头的普查来揭示稀疏时序组织。
AI.method: 在9个Open-Sora STDiT训练run（3个模型规模，306M–1.03B参数）上做checkpoint级普查，对每个时序注意力头计算熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度（CFAC），采用预注册的变点检测与效应量筛选规则；跨种子分析可复现性（位置层面vs.头坐标层面），并聚类选中头的注意力图为帧路由motif；辅以相关性与消融分析检验与视频质量的关系。
AI.result: 聚合CFAC在所有run中平坦或下降，而少数头（全网格run中约4–13%）出现显著集中；跨种子可复现信号是位置性但属块级别——选中头反复出现在第一个时序块，一旦考虑块归属，单个头坐标不可复现。在760M选中头中，注意力图收敛到少量局部帧路由motif（自帧对角线、相邻帧带），即使跨run负责坐标不同。相关与消融分析未能确立与生成视频质量的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了STDiT中稀疏、块级别的时序注意力组织及其形成过程，并明确限定了因果性主张。更广泛的贡献是方法学：checkpoint分辨、逐头分析配固定选择规则，可迁移到其他因子化视频扩散Transformer，配合适配的路由度量亦可扩展到联合时空架构。作者将其定位为"可迁移方法论"而非性能提升。

title: One Evaluation, Any Operating Point: Hypernetwork-Amortized MeanFlow for 3D MRI Reconstruction
summary: Generative priors reconstruct accelerated 3D MRI well but pay heavily at deployment: tens of network evaluations per volume, and protocol-specific hyperparameter tuning. A third hidden cost is the scanner's fixed sampling pattern. We treat the whole operating point as an input. A 3D MeanFlow patch network (a one-step flow model) is fine-tuned end-to-end through a warm-started, five-iteration differentiable conjugate-gradient projection. A small hypernetwork maps the operating point (data-consistency weight, acceleration, and the Cartesian sampling pattern itself) to the network's per-channel modulation. Three findings follow. (i) Learning the acquisition is worth more than any other operating point: on clinical knee data, the learned mask gains up to +2.34 dB over the protocol's variable-density mask. This gain requires the solver: with a feed-forward reconstructor the same learned mask hurts at 4x (-1.7 dB), but with the data-consistency projection it adds +4.6 dB. (ii) One evaluation is highly effective: it beats a 20-step patch-diffusion prior by up to +3.1 dB on brain and +2.9 dB on knee. Three to five evaluations extend the front to +6 dB while using a quarter of the prior's network calls. (iii) Fully sampled targets are optional: trained self-supervised on a split of acquired samples, the reconstructor matches its supervised twin at 4x on real data. Finally, we report what failed and why: subject-adaptive acquisition from measured energy, combining self-supervision with learned acquisition, and amortising the data-consistency weight.

AI.tldr: 该工作将加速3D MRI重建的整个运行点（数据一致性权重、加速倍数与笛卡尔采样掩膜）作为输入，用超网络映射到3D MeanFlow一步流模型的逐通道调制，并通过热启动的5次可微共轭梯度投影端到端微调；核心结论是"学习采样掩膜"收益最大（膝关节+2.34 dB），单次网络评估即可超越20步扩散先验（脑+3.1 dB），且用采集样本的自监督训练可媲美有监督版本。
AI.motivation: 生成式先验虽能高质量重建加速3D MRI，但部署代价高：每个体数据需数十次网络评估、需按协议调超参，此外扫描仪的固定采样模式这一隐性成本通常被忽略。作者希望把运行点（含采样模式）本身当作可学习输入，在降低推理开销的同时提升重建质量。
AI.method: 采用3D MeanFlow patch网络（一步流模型）作为重建先验；通过热启动、仅5次迭代的可微共轭梯度数据一致性投影进行端到端微调；一个小型超网络将运行点（数据一致性权重、加速倍数、笛卡尔采样掩膜本身）映射为网络的逐通道调制参数，从而让采样模式与求解器联合优化。另测试了仅用采集样本子集的自监督训练。
AI.result: (i) 学习采集模式优于其他运行点：临床膝关节数据上，学习掩膜比协议的变密度掩膜最多提升+2.34 dB；该增益依赖求解器——前馈重建器下同一掩膜在4×反而降低1.7 dB，而加入数据一致性投影后提升+4.6 dB。(ii) 单次评估已很高效：比20步patch扩散先验在脑上高+3.1 dB、膝上高+2.9 dB；3-5次评估可将前沿扩展到+6 dB，同时仅用该先验网络调用量的四分之一。(iii) 全采样目标非必需：在采集样本的一个划分上自监督训练，4×真实数据上可匹配其有监督对照。此外报告了失败案例：基于测量能量的受试者自适应采集、自监督与学习采集结合、以及数据一致性权重的摊销。
AI.conclusion: 将"运行点"整体（尤其是采样掩膜）纳入可微端到端优化，配合一步流先验与少量共轭梯度投影，可同时显著降低推理开销并提升加速3D MRI重建质量；自监督可替代全采样标签。但受试者自适应采集、自监督+学习采集的组合以及权重摊销均未成功。

title: Enhancing Foundation Models for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification via Targeted Oversampling
summary: Remote-sensing foundation models offer strong representations for SAR imagery, but their behavior under severe long-tail class imbalance is still not well characterized. We benchmark DOFA and SAR-JEPA on the imbalanced OpenSARShip dataset and compare them with ImageNet-pretrained baselines under a fixed, training-efficient protocol that keeps the backbone frozen. To mitigate imbalance without fine-tuning, we apply four oversampling methods in embedding space exclusively to minority classes and train a lightweight classifier head on the augmented embeddings. Across both foundation models, oversampling improves Macro-F1 and test accuracy relative to their respective baselines, with the largest Macro-F1 gains observed for DOFA using ADASYN (34.39 to 38.56) and for SAR-JEPA using SVM-SMOTE (25.89 to 32.30). We also report class-wise behavior, showing that aggregate improvements can coexist with persistent failures on specific rare classes. Code for embedding extraction and reproducible multi-seed evaluation is provided to support rapid experimentation on free-tier hardware.

AI.tldr: 该文在类长尾失衡的OpenSARShip数据集上基准测试DOFA与SAR-JEPA两个遥感基础模型，冻结骨干网络、在嵌入空间用四种过采样方法仅对少数类增强，再训练轻量分类头，验证了无需微调即可改善Macro-F1与精度，但稀有类仍存在持续失效。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型（DOFA、SAR-JEPA）虽能提供强SAR表征，但在严重长尾类不平衡下的行为尚未被充分刻画；同时微调骨干代价高，需要一种训练高效、在免费算力上可复现的失衡缓解方案。
AI.method: 在类失衡的OpenSARShip数据集上基准测试DOFA与SAR-JEPA，并与ImageNet预训练基线对比；采用固定协议冻结骨干网络，仅在嵌入空间对少数类施加ADASYN、SVM-SMOTE等四种过采样，随后训练轻量分类头；提供嵌入提取与多种子可复现评测代码。
AI.result: 两种基础模型上过采样均相对各自基线提升Macro-F1与测试精度；DOFA配合ADASYN提升最大（34.39→38.56），SAR-JEPA配合SVM-SMOTE提升至32.30（25.89→32.30）。逐类分析显示总体提升与特定稀有类的持续失败并存。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间过采样是冻结主干条件下缓解长尾失衡的轻量有效手段，但聚合指标提升掩盖了稀有类失效问题，后续需关注类间均衡与稀有类鲁棒性。

title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Unknown-Class Detection in Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Ship classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is a critical computer vision task, yet the robustness of models under deployment shifts remains unclear. While models are often trained on one dataset and deployed on another, we lack a comprehensive understanding of their cross-dataset generalization. To address this, we evaluate six pretrained models on two SAR ship datasets in three settings: in-domain classification, cross-dataset transfer, and unknown-class detection. For unknown detection, we hold out all classes one at a time. In-domain, SARDet100K gives the best balanced accuracy on both datasets (73.4\% on FUSARShip and 53.2\% on OpenSARShip). In cross-dataset transfer, we observe strong failures: some models show moderate accuracy but near-chance balanced accuracy (for example, 64.5\% accuracy but 33.3\% balanced accuracy for OpenSARShip to FUSARShip). In unknown detection, performance depends on the held-out class and dataset, while MC-dropout variance is often close to random. These findings show that cross-dataset generalization in SAR remains limited and that task-specific uncertainty scores are often more informative than MC-dropout variance for held-out-class detection, although their relative ranking depends on the dataset and held-out class.

AI.tldr: 该文在两个SAR舰船数据集上评估六个预训练模型的域内分类、跨数据集迁移与未知类检测表现，发现跨域泛化严重失败，任务特定的不确定性分数常优于MC-dropout方差。
AI.motivation: 模型常在一个数据集上训练却部署到另一个数据集，SAR舰船分类的跨数据集泛化与部署漂移下的鲁棒性缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 在FUSARShip与OpenSARShip两个SAR舰船数据集上评估六个预训练模型，设置三种场景：域内分类、跨数据集迁移、未知类检测（逐类留出），并对比MC-dropout方差与任务特定不确定性分数。
AI.result: 域内SARDet100K均衡准确率最高（FUSARShip 73.4%、OpenSARShip 53.2%）；跨域迁移出现强失败（如OpenSARShip→FUSARShip准确率64.5%但均衡准确率仅33.3%）；未知检测性能依赖留出类与数据集，MC-dropout方差常接近随机。
AI.conclusion: SAR跨数据集泛化仍然有限，留出类检测中任务特定不确定性分数常比MC-dropout方差信息量更大，但相对排序依赖数据集与留出类。

title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
summary: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.

AI.tldr: ForensicZoom：面向人脸伪造检测的工业级 MLLM 框架，通过法证感知视觉表征 + NEED_ZOOM 自适应放大可疑区域 + 奖励塑形 + 归因优化，在大规模身份验证数据上达到 0.1% FPR 下 >97% TPR。
AI.motivation: 在线身份验证中漏检破坏安全、误报干扰正常用户，需兼顾可靠性与可解释性。专用取证检测器性能强但可解释性差；MLLM 语义理解与推理可解释性强，但伪造检测能力明显偏弱。作者认为关键瓶颈在于视觉证据获取方式：标准分辨率难以表征细微取证伪影，而一律高分辨率处理又计算低效。
AI.method: 为通用 MLLM 注入法证感知视觉表征并对齐语言模型与这些特征；核心机制 NEED_ZOOM 让模型在初始证据不足时自主请求对可疑区域放大查看，将固定单次分类转为自适应多轮取证推理；通过奖励塑形学习缩放行为，在检测精度与不必要的视觉检查之间权衡，把额外算力集中在困难样本上；最后以归因优化阶段提升自然语言取证报告质量并保持检测性能。
AI.result: 在大规模工业身份验证数据上，0.1% FPR 条件下 TPR 超过 97%，显著优于专用检测器与现有 MLLM 方法，同时输出可操作的取证归因。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自适应视觉检查（按需放大 + 多轮推理）是通向准确、可解释、可扩展的 MLLM 人脸伪造检测的有效路径。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CARPM-FIQA，通过在整个训练轨迹上累积类内紧凑度与类间分离度之比（relative point margin），解决 FR 集成式人脸图像质量评估（FIQA）因特征空间漂移导致的单轮质量估计不稳定问题，并在 8 个基准上验证其排名与判别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有与 FR 集成的 FIQA 方法存在时间不稳定性：训练过程中特征空间不断演变，单轮质量估计随之波动，形成"移动靶"，削弱了质量预测的可靠性。作者希望在不放弃 FR 集成性能优势的前提下，为训练目标提供稳定化机制。
AI.method: 提出 CARPM-FIQA：累积相对点边际（relative point margin，即类内紧凑度与类间分离度之比）在该训练轨迹上的测量值，用跨轮累积平均替代单轮估计。理论分析给出方差降低、MSE 改善、排序稳定性提升及随训练收敛的保证。在带质量组标签的 SynFIQA 数据集上做控制实验与消融，并在 8 个基准、4 个 FR 模型、2 个 FMR 阈值下与 12 种 FIQA 方法对比。
AI.result: 在 SynFIQA 上，累积平均取得更优判别能力，不同训练配置的消融均显示一致性提升。在 17 种对比方法中，CARPM-FIQA(L) 与 CARPM-FIQA(S) 按跨 FR 模型及基准归一化后的 pAUC-EDC/AUC-EDC 平均分别排名第 4 与第 6，每个 FR 模型的归一化均值均与最优方法相差仅几个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 累积平均为 FR 集成式 FIQA 的训练不稳定性提供了有理论依据的解法，同时保留 FR 集成带来的性能收益；更广泛地说明时间聚合策略可稳定那些因特征表示演变而目标值天然波动的深度学习训练目标。

title: Language-Augmented Video Action Anticipation: Design Fundamentals, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Review article. Supplementary material, machine-readable data, and public artifacts are available at this https URL
summary: Action anticipation predicts future human actions from partial video under incomplete context and temporal uncertainty. Recent systems introduce large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), or language-derived semantics at different stages, but reported gains are difficult to interpret when task formulation, visual pretraining, supervision, decoder design, and evaluation code change simultaneously. The central contribution of this review is an evidence-aware design map that crosses task regime with the point at which language-derived information intervenes. We characterise task regimes along six axes. These axes organise the literature into five broad task families: single-action, sequence, object-interaction, cross-view, and planning-oriented settings. C1-C3 locate interventions in context construction, goal/intention modelling, and future decoding, while C4 is treated as an adjacent, emerging grounding/executability extension. Unlike a generic processing pipeline, the map links each intervention to an appropriate counterfactual, failure diagnosis, and permissible evidence claim. Supporting contributions include a protocol-level audit of Ego4D-LTA and EPIC-KITCHENS-100, a multidimensional evidence profile, and the Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP). The unresolved EK-100 record is treated as a reporting-comparability case study and is not used as a leaderboard. Evidence for LLM benefits, goal ambiguity, and horizon effects is therefore formulated as testable hypotheses requiring matched validation, not as causal conclusions. The accompanying package contains the coded evidence, source locators, protocol metadata, and versioned catalogue used in the review.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于动作预期（action anticipation）的综述，核心贡献是一个"证据感知设计地图"，将任务设定（单动作、序列、物体交互、跨视角、规划导向）与语言派生信息介入点（C1上下文构建、C2目标/意图建模、C3未来解码，C4落地/可执行性延伸）交叉组织文献，并为每种介入方式匹配反事实、失效诊断与可允许的证据主张。
AI.motivation: 近期系统在动作预期中引入LLM、VLM或语言派生语义，但任务定义、视觉预训练、监督方式、解码器设计与评测代码同时变化，导致报告的性能增益难以解释，缺乏可比的因果归因依据。
AI.method: 不做新模型，而是构建综述性分析框架：沿六个维度刻画任务设定，归为五类任务家族；用C1–C3（上下文构建、目标/意图建模、未来解码）加C4（grounding/可执行性延伸）定位语言介入点；配套Ego4D-LTA与EPIC-KITCHENS-100的协议级审计、多维证据画像，以及Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol（BCAP）用于骨干网络受控的对比与消融。
AI.result: 给出编码化证据、来源定位、协议元数据与版本化目录；把EK-100中未解决的记录作为报告可比性案例研究而非排行榜；将LLM收益、目标歧义与预测时域效应表述为需匹配验证的可检验假设，而非因果结论。
AI.conclusion: 语言信息对动作预期的增益目前证据不足以支撑因果性结论，需在统一协议与匹配消融下重新验证；该设计地图为后续研究提供了介入点—反事实—失效诊断—证据强度的一体化设计规范。

title: Query-aligned video frame selection for long video understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process multimodal inputs by converting text, images, and videos into token sequences that are subsequently processed by a backbone language model. While MLLMs have achieved excellent performance in understanding the content of individual images, video understanding remains significantly more difficult because videos contain large number of video frames. MLLMs typically process only a subset of these frames, usually ranging from 8 to 64. MLLMs usually sample frames uniformly, regardless of their relevance to the question being answered. To address this limitation, several training-free, model-agnostic methods for selecting question-relevant frames have recently been proposed. In this work, we introduce a frame-selection method designed specifically for multiple-choice questions. We extend the query text by appending semantic cues derived from the answer choices and employ a direct query-frame alignment scoring mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to directly utilize answer choices as inference-time cues for selecting frames relevant to answering a question. The method first constructs a compact candidate pool by subsampling video frames at a fixed rate. The frames are then scored according to their maximum cosine similarity across all question-answer pairs to identify the most relevant frames for a given query. This approach preserves a fixed token budget while improving the relevance of the visual evidence provided to the downstream MLLM. We evaluate the effectiveness of our frame-selection method on the MLVU, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench benchmarks using three MLLMs: LLaVA-Mini, Qwen2-VL, and LLaVA-Video. Experimental results demonstrate that answer-aware frame selection generally outperforms uniform sampling and existing training-free frame-selection methods under the same frame budget.

AI.tldr: 首个将多选题选项文本作为推理时线索的无训练帧选择方法，通过问答对与帧的最大余弦相似度打分，在固定帧预算下提升视频问答中视觉证据的相关性。
AI.motivation: MLLM处理视频时受token预算限制，通常只均匀采样8–64帧，忽略帧与问题的相关性；已有无训练帧选择方法未利用多选题的选项信息。
AI.method: 先按固定速率下采样构造紧凑候选帧池；将选项语义线索拼接到查询文本上，以查询-帧直接对齐打分（跨所有问答对的最大余弦相似度）选出最相关帧，保持固定token预算。
AI.result: 在MLVU、Video-MME、LongVideoBench上，用LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL、LLaVA-Video三种MLLM评测，相同帧预算下答案感知帧选择普遍优于均匀采样及现有无训练帧选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 答案选项可有效充当推理时线索，提高下游MLLM所获视觉证据的相关性；该方法模型无关、无需训练，在多基准多模型上具一致性收益。
