title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
summary: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明在无标签去噪任务中，基于配对噪声观测训练的单步回归器即可达到MMSE去噪器效果，而多步流式迭代反而会偏离最优解，且训练越好退化越严重。
AI.motivation: 当前迭代式与生成式去噪器被广泛使用，默认"多步精修优于单次回归"。作者质疑这一假设在无标签去噪（label-free denoising）场景下是否成立，并探究流式机制与配对训练之间的关系。
AI.method: 在Noise2Noise设定下训练无条件rectified flow（使用同一信号的两个噪声观测对）；理论上分析其最小化器的一步读出等价于MMSE去噪器；在可解的高斯模型中精确刻画多步Euler积分的偏离；同时在CTDenoiser低剂量CT基准上跨五种架构、对比监督/相似度/盲点/逐图方法进行实验。
AI.result: 一步flow读出与直接回归器一致，而多步Euler积分逐渐降低保真度，且训练质量越高退化越明显；关键要素是去相关配对而非flow机制，一步配对回归器取得最佳无标签结果（+1.99 dB）。无标签方法中仅相关噪声感知的Noise2Sim优于噪声基线，Noise2Void因CT噪声违反像素独立假设而持平或变差；监督去噪器PSNR增益约4 dB，但通道化Hotelling观察者显示低对比度病灶可检测性下降。
AI.conclusion: 多步生成式迭代在无标签去噪中并无优势，甚至有害；核心在于噪声配对而非迭代机制。PSNR/SSIM等指标会掩盖临床相关的可检测性退化，提示评估指标需改进。

title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
summary: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.

AI.tldr: 首个在 DVS-PedX 行人过街基准上使用无监督脉冲神经网络特征学习的方法，用WTA-STDP字典+线性读出达到90.3%准确率、0.936 AUROC，接近有监督水平。
AI.motivation: 当前SNN过街检测依赖监督反向传播，需要昂贵的帧级标注；作者希望验证特征学习阶段完全无标签时的性能代价。
AI.method: 单层脉冲神经元用winner-take-all STDP从无标注事件帧patch学习滤波器字典；帧由与滤波器的余弦相似度加空间池化编码，仅用线性分类器读出（唯一监督成分）。
AI.result: 24,454帧测试集上90.3%准确率、AUROC 0.936（有监督端到端为92.0%/0.943）；恶劣天气AUROC 0.913。结果对可塑性规则不敏感，但对读出协议高度敏感：经典neuron-assignment读出仅0.70 AUROC；转换真实数据部分经读出重拟合从0.53提升到0.67。
AI.conclusion: 去除特征学习中的标签在本基准上精度代价很小；无监督脉冲网络报告的弱点可能源于读出协议而非学习规则。

title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, accepted at The 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026)
summary: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Specs-on-Faces数据集上对比ResNet-50、VGG-16和FaceNet三种预训练骨干网络在相同实验协议下的部分人脸识别（PFR）迁移学习表现，其中FaceNet微调配置PFN取得97.4%准确率，为该数据集最高。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中的人脸常因配饰、前景物体或画面边缘遮挡而不完整，导致识别精度大幅下降，因此鲁棒的部分人脸识别（PFR）仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 在Specs-on-Faces数据集上，对ResNet-50、VGG-16、FaceNet三种预训练卷积骨干进行迁移学习微调；统一采用160x160输入、冻结骨干+可训练分类头、固定epoch预算、相同的预处理/划分/优化协议，不做逐骨干超参搜索。
AI.result: FaceNet配置（PFN）显著优于其他两者，112个身份类上测试准确率97.4%，宏平均精确率87.04%、召回率84.61%、F1 84.17%，为该数据集上报告的最高准确率和召回率。
AI.conclusion: 在统一协议下，FaceNet作为骨干在部分人脸识别任务上优于ResNet-50与VGG-16，PFN可作为SoF数据集上的强基线。

title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
summary: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.

AI.tldr: 评估通用多模态大模型（Gemini）在七种禽类艾美耳球虫显微图像物种级诊断中的能力，发现其独立诊断可靠性不足。
AI.motivation: 球虫病对家禽养殖业造成重大经济损失，有效防控依赖准确的物种级诊断，而该任务专业性强、人工镜检成本高，因此作者希望检验通用多模态大模型能否在无领域微调的前提下承担此类诊断工作。
AI.method: 在4,225张覆盖七种禽类艾美耳球虫的显微图像上评测Google Gemini，设置两种提示条件（无候选标签、给定预定义类别列表），并额外测试其病理报告生成能力；同时考察BiomedParse的寄生虫分割性能。
AI.result: 无候选标签时输出宽泛且分类学上不一致；有候选标签时总体准确率仅14.9%，存在明显偏向（E. tenella达74%），对E. acervulina、E. mitis和E. praecox完全无法正确分类；生成的治疗报告语言连贯但未经核实，分割结果仅部分有效。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大模型尚不足以独立完成艾美耳球虫诊断，需依赖领域专用微调与专家验证，不能作为可靠的独立诊断工具。

title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
summary: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using this http URL , Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.

AI.tldr: 微调预训练 TrOCR 模型识别手写天城文字符，CER 3.95%、字符级准确率 96.05%，并部署为低延迟 Web 服务。
AI.motivation: 天城文（Devanagari）字符书写复杂，手写字符准确识别困难；作者希望用预训练 Transformer OCR 模型替代此前基于 CNN 的方案以提升识别精度。
AI.method: 输入图像统一为 RGB，分批 tokenize 并接入 Hugging Face Dataset；在约 5000 张字符图像上按 8:1:1 划分训练/验证/测试，微调 microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten；训练中采用混合精度、梯度检查点与早停；随后用 Golang + FastAPI 将模型部署为可扩展 Web 应用。
AI.result: 字符错误率 CER 3.95%，字符级准确率 96.05%，优于以往 CNN 模型；Web 服务单请求延迟低于 5 秒。
AI.conclusion: 验证了 TrOCR 用于构建可扩展手写天城文字符识别系统的可行性，并为后续基于 Transformer 的天城文识别研究奠定基础。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了 ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19 及自研 CNN 在 NIH 疟疾血涂片数据集上的诊断性能，并以 GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME 提供可解释性。
AI.motivation: 显微镜诊断疟疾依赖专家与专用设备，成本高且劳动密集，需要自动化、轻量且准确的检测手段以降低死亡率。
AI.method: 在 NIH 疟疾血涂片数据集上训练并对比四种现有 CNN 与一个自研模型；评估准确率、AUC、模型体积与推理时延，并对自研模型做剪枝；用 GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME 做 XAI 可视化。
AI.result: MobileNetV2 达 96.35% 准确率，模型体积最小（8.49 MB）、推理最快（1.35 ms）；自研模型达 97.67% 准确率、AUC 0.9756，但推理最慢（13.17 ms）；剪枝后自研模型精度与推理速度略有改善；更大骨干带来更大体积但精度提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 轻量网络在疟疾血涂片二分类中实现精度与效率的良好折中，剪枝与 XAI 可进一步提升实用性，但属医学影像领域应用，未提供通用方法层面的新洞见。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 该工作构建了一个基于微调视觉语言模型的XAI界面，面向工业制造中非专家（如蓝领工人）的目标检测，生成直观、情境化的解释，在清晰度、指令遵循、图像接地性与情境感知上优于GPT-4o-mini。
AI.motivation: 制造业产线中AI用于质检，但现有XAI方法面向技术专家，非专家难以理解，难以建立信任与落地集成。
AI.method: 先对现有视觉语言模型做基准测试，发现即用模型解释不清晰、缺乏情境相关性；随后微调一个视觉语言模型并集成到交互界面中，输出面向非专家的情境化解释。
AI.result: 在自研与公开机器人数据集上，相较GPT-4o-mini，在解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像接地性和情境感知方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 提升了AI解释的可访问性与可用性，使解释更直观并可应用于制造领域；本质是人机交互/XAI系统工作，未涉及机器人策略学习或物理智能方法。

title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at this https URL }

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"架构感知"的系统性评估协议，在780张乳腺超声图像上比较9种XAI技术（4类DL模型：超深、轻量、Transformer、混合）的解释质量，发现解释质量主要由模型架构与XAI方法的交互决定，无单一技术可通用。
AI.motivation: 医学影像DL诊断系统需要可解释性（XAI）保证透明度，但针对乳腺癌识别任务，XAI技术的选择多凭经验（ad hoc），缺乏跨不同DL架构的系统性评估，因此需要建立结构化的评估协议与选型指导。
AI.method: 提出架构感知的系统评估协议，选取9种主流XAI技术，覆盖4类DL架构（very deep、lightweight、transformer-based、hybrid）。在含780张图像的乳腺超声数据集上，采用临床对齐的空间指标（Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage）量化解释区域与专家标注病灶区域的一致性。代码已开源。
AI.result: 解释质量主要受"模型架构×XAI方法"交互影响，而非某单一技术普遍最优。混合架构生成的解释空间连贯性更好；轻量级与Transformer模型在不同方法间波动更大。没有一种技术能在所有架构与评估指标上泛化。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性同时取决于模型设计与解释策略，应联合选择DL模型与XAI技术，而非独立看待。该工作提供了结构化评估协议与乳腺癌诊断中XAI选型的实用指南，有助于构建更透明的临床决策支持系统。

title: TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出对称双臂专家(DAE)架构,共享VLM主干加解耦的双臂专属专家塔,通过两阶段双臂意图路由(语言指令/视觉语义)与轻量任务进度预测模块,缓解双臂交叉干扰并支持协同调度。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏显式机制解耦双臂状态与意图,导致交叉臂干扰,降低任务执行成功率;同时多机器人协作需要任务进度同步。
AI.method: 在共享VLM主干上构建对称双臂专家架构,每个臂拥有解耦的专家塔;采用两阶段双臂意图路由:第一阶段依据显式语言指令选专家,第二阶段依据隐式视觉语义路由;并引入轻量任务进度预测模块,用cross-attention融合pre-chunk时序特征与本体感觉及视觉观测的语义表示,逐帧估计任务完成进度。
AI.result: 实验验证了双臂意图路由的有效性与交叉臂干扰的解耦效果,并给出单臂到双臂(及反向)技能泛化、跨臂运动域技能迁移的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式双臂专家与意图路由可提升双臂VLA执行可靠性,任务进度预测支持协同调度;技能泛化与跨臂迁移现象为后续研究提供线索。

title: Learning with Object-centric Representations of Tactile Interactive Perception for Robot Manipulation
summary: Implicit object properties that are difficult to directly infer from vision, such as material, container contents, or softness, can be revealed through tactile sensing and exploratory interactions. However, because tactile signals are transient and sparse, extracting informative tactile events and effectively incorporating them into robotic manipulation remains a challenge. In this work, we present an object-centric context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations through tactile exploration. A token learner autonomously selects representative tactile segments from long-horizon exploration, while contrastive alignment with descriptive text embeddings enables a latent space that captures multiple physical object properties. These learned representations are then used as semantic context to guide object-centric manipulation policies and adapt strategies based on object properties. Experiments show that the learned representations achieve 93% and 84% property estimation accuracy on seen and unseen objects. Evaluated on three tasks involving visually ambiguous objects, i.e. multi-object rearrangement, pouring, and box opening, the proposed framework improves both target selection and property-dependent manipulation adaptation, raising task success, aggregated over all evaluation trials, from 41% to 92% on seen objects and from 19% to 67% on unseen objects over baseline policies without object-context conditioning. Videos and additional results are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出以物体为中心的上下文感知操作框架：通过触觉探索学习任务无关物体表征，token learner 从长程探索中选取代表性触觉片段，并与描述性文本嵌入做对比对齐，形成捕捉多种物理属性的隐空间；该表征作为语义上下文引导操作策略。在已见/未见物体上属性估计准确率 93%/84%，三个视觉歧义任务上成功率由 41%→92%（已见）与 19%→67%（未见）。
AI.motivation: 视觉难以直接推断材料、容器内容物、软硬度等隐式物体属性，需借助触觉与探索性交互；但触觉信号瞬态且稀疏，如何提取有信息的触觉事件并有效注入机器人操作仍是难题。
AI.method: 以物体为中心的上下文感知操作框架：(1) token learner 自主从长程触觉探索中筛选代表性触觉片段；(2) 与描述性文本嵌入做对比对齐，学得含多种物理属性的隐空间，且任务无关；(3) 将学得表征作为语义上下文条件输入以物体为中心的操作策略，实现依赖属性的策略自适应。
AI.result: 属性估计准确率：已见物体 93%，未见物体 84%。在三个涉及视觉歧义物体的任务（多物体重排、倾倒、开箱）上，相较无物体上下文条件的基线策略，聚合全部评测试验的任务成功率由 41% 提升至 92%（已见物体），由 19% 提升至 67%（未见物体）。
AI.conclusion: 触觉驱动的任务无关物体表征可有效充当语义上下文，同时提升目标选择与依赖属性的操作自适应能力，在已见与未见物体上均带来显著成功率增益。

title: SurgFlow: 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow for Surgical Robot Manipulation
summary: Paired video-action demonstrations enable autonomous surgical behavior, but such data is scarce: robots perform roughly 1% of surgeries, while video-only data is abundant. Learning 3D object flow offers an embodiment-agnostic way to utilize video data, but flow alone specifies how an object should move, not where and when the tool should engage it, a distinction that is critical in surgery. We introduce SurgFlow, a framework that learns 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow from stereo surgical video without action labels. For each object point, it predicts a future 3D trajectory and contact scores. We extract targets via 3D tracking and tool-object proximity, train a flow matching generator to predict them, and use predicted contact to trigger grasp and release while optimizing end effector motion from flow. On the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), SurgFlow succeeds in 37 of 39 stage evaluations across tissue retraction, bimanual reveal, needle pickup, and handover, outperforming baselines trained on equal data with or without action labels. Zero-shot transfer to a humanoid-based laparoscopic robot achieves 85% and 70% average success under similar and novel camera viewpoints, respectively.

AI.tldr: SurgFlow 无需动作标签,从立体手术视频中学习 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow(逐点未来 3D 轨迹 + 接触分数),通过 3D 跟踪与器械-物体邻近度提取监督目标,用 flow matching 生成器预测,并以接触信号触发抓取/释放、以流场优化末端执行器运动;在 dVRK 上 39 项阶段评估成功 37 项,零样本迁移至人形腹腔镜机器人达 85%/70%。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人示范数据稀缺(机器人仅完成约 1% 手术),而纯视频数据丰富。学习 3D 物体流是一种与具身无关的视频利用方式,但流只规定物体应如何运动,不指明器械应在何处、何时接触物体,而这一区分在手术中至关重要。因此需要在无动作标签条件下,从立体手术视频中同时学到"运动"与"接触时机"。
AI.method: 提出 SurgFlow:对每个物体点预测未来 3D 轨迹与接触分数,构成 Object-Centric Contact Flow。监督目标由 3D 跟踪和器械-物体邻近度自动提取,无需动作标签;用 flow matching 生成器预测这些目标;预测的接触分数触发抓取与释放,流场用于优化末端执行器运动。在 dVRK 上跨组织牵拉、双手显露、持针、器械交接四类任务评测,并零样本迁移到人形腹腔镜机器人。
AI.result: dVRK 上 39 项阶段评估成功 37 项;在同等数据量下优于有/无动作标签的基线。零样本迁移到人形腹腔镜机器人在相似视角下平均成功率 85%,新视角下 70%。
AI.conclusion: 接触感知的 3D 物体流可作为具身无关的中间表征,从未标注立体视频中学习接触时机与运动目标,实现跨平台手术操作技能迁移,减少对配对动作示范数据的依赖。

title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate. We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActionGround，一个无需训练、包裹冻结 VLA 策略的神经符号运行时层，通过阶段感知有限状态机与惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日项修正动作，开销<1ms，在 LIBERO-Spatial 上提升成功率最多 6%、稳定性 19.3%、轨迹效率 15%。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接将视觉观测与语言指令映射为动作，未显式建模操作任务的阶段结构（接近、抓取、搬运、放置）以及执行所遵循的刚体动力学，导致策略缺乏物理一致性与阶段约束，稳定性与轨迹效率受限。作者希望在不动模型权重、不重训练的前提下为冻结 VLA 注入这两类先验。
AI.method: ActionGround 为训练-free 的神经符号运行时层，包裹冻结 VLA（无微调、无权访问权重）。两个并行模块：(1) 符号化阶段感知有限状态机，判定当前操作阶段并施加阶段专属规则修正；(2) 始终开启的惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日项，将机器人运动方程注入每步控制，其动力学残差仅作为一致性诊断记录而非门控条件。固定超参跨任务与主干网络通用，每控制步开销<1ms。
AI.result: 在 7-DoF Franka Panda 的十个 LIBERO-Spatial 抓放任务上，跨 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA、Generalist-VLA 四个主干评测：成功率最高 +6 个百分点，稳定性最高 +19.3 个百分点，轨迹效率最高 +15%。独立 Robosuite 噪声扫描中，注入动作噪声下轨迹抖动鲁棒性提升约 10 倍。与真实 Agilex Piper 试验配对的同种子 Robosuite 仿真中，基线成功率由 35% 升至 95%。实机实验仅为定性部署演示，逐次成功率留待未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入任务阶段结构与刚体动力学先验，可作为即插即用、低开销的运行时层无训练地增强多种冻结 VLA 策略，且泛化到跨主干与跨任务。局限：仅限刚性物体抓放操作，实机缺乏定量每回合成功率证据。价值主要体现为真实/仿真一致性的稳定性与鲁棒性提升，而非新的表征或生成能力。

title: PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory
summary: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.

AI.tldr: PORTER 将 3D 场景图的持久化与常驻解耦：边缘端只保留轻量锚点，重型物体载荷在边缘与云端之间迁移，并用"不可替代支撑擦除"(ISE) 度量卸载带来的需求覆盖损失，从而构建预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.motivation: 任务驱动的即时 3DSG 方法只构建任务相关表示，但稀疏的按任务工作集无法限定机器人全生命周期的机载内存占用：任务切换后旧载荷可能对当前任务无关却在未来有用，全保留导致内存增长，全丢弃又造成重复构建开销。
AI.method: 提出 PORTER，将持久性与常驻性解耦，用轻量锚点常驻边缘、重型对象载荷在边缘-云之间迁移；指出仅凭相关性不足以决定常驻，需将任务分解为功能需求，并定义 ISE 度量卸载造成的需求覆盖损失（对可替代支撑打折、对剩余覆盖薄弱的需求加重惩罚）；按"最小边际 ISE/字节"反复卸载，构造预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.result: 在 JITOMA-Bench 上对四种 3DSG 构建器评估；在渐进压缩下，当载荷字节被卸载达 91% 时，汇总相对 mR@3 仍保持 100%。
AI.conclusion: 以需求覆盖损失（而非单纯相关性）驱动边缘-云载荷调度，可在保持任务检索性能的同时大幅压缩机载内存占用，为长期运行的机器人 3DSG 提供可扩展的内存管理方案。

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出 Q-WAM，面向世界动作模型（WAM）的 4-bit 权重-激活后训练量化方法，通过动作可观测性格拉姆矩阵（AOG）与动作子空间保护（ASP）保持动作生成精度，在仿真和真机上显著优于 SVDQuant 并接近 16-bit 模型。
AI.motivation: WAM 通过迭代扩散联合生成视频与机器人动作，在操作任务上表现强，但计算与显存开销极大，部署困难。现有 PTQ 方法（平滑、旋转等）无法维持动作生成精度，因此需要针对"动作保真度"的专用量化方案。
AI.method: 1）提出 Action Observability Gramian（AOG），度量某层输入通道加权组合上的舍入误差经过全部去噪步骤后对最终动作的改变量；2）提出 Action-Subspace Protection（ASP），将少数最动作敏感通道组合保留在 16-bit 低秩分支，其余权重与激活量化为 4-bit，且均以稠密矩阵乘法实现以便 GPU 高效执行；3）按各专家（expert）逐层聚合 AOG 得到的动作质量，识别对生成动作贡献最大的专家，仅对这些专家施加 ASP 以最小化开销。
AI.result: 在三个 WAM 上评测（仿真+真机）：RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 89.6–93.0%，距 16-bit 模型仅差 1.1 个百分点，量化块显存降低 3.1–3.4×；较最强基线 SVDQuant 高 2.5–8.7 个百分点。在 Unitree G1 人形与双臂 UR3 真机上，成功率较 SVDQuant 提升 12.8–17.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 针对动作生成敏感度的量化设计（AOG 驱动的 ASP 与专家选择）可在 4-bit 下基本保持 WAM 的动作生成精度，并实现显著显存与算力节省，具备真机部署可行性。

title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.

AI.tldr: AquaWAM: 首个面向水下具身智能体的世界动作模型，建模动作条件与被动物理动力学（推进器死区、惯性滑行、环境流），用紧凑导航状态替代高维视觉预测，在 USIM 基准 20 项任务上成功率达 72.6%，并在 Jetson AGX Orin 上决策速度比 U0 快 2.7 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）主要预测动作条件下的视觉观测，未显式建模水下机器人特有的被动动力学（惯性、浮力、水阻、持续漂移）。这些被动效应在动作结束后仍持续作用于载具，导致预测与决策失准。因此需要一个能同时建模主动控制与被动物理动力学的专用 WAM。
AI.method: AquaWAM 不预测未来图像，而是对紧凑导航状态建模，显式建模推进器死区、超出指令时长的惯性滑行与环境流等被动动力学。感知输入以 DVL、IMU、压力传感器、关节编码器为主，相机仅提供理解目标与目标位姿的语义信息。通过建模低维导航状态而非高维视觉观测，显著降低模型规模与计算开销。
AI.result: 在 USIM 基准的 20 项水下任务中达到 72.6% 任务成功率，优于现有方法；在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上动作决策速度比 U0 快 2.7 倍。部分机载传感器缺失时仍有效：无 DVL 速度测量时成功率 61.6%，而 U0 仅 39.4%。
AI.conclusion: 专用化的世界动作模型设计（状态空间建模 + 被动动力学显式建模）在水下具身场景中兼顾了性能、实时性与传感器鲁棒性，为水下/复杂动力学环境下的具身决策提供了可行范式。

title: CompliantWBC: Whole-Body Compliance for Heavy Humanoids via Force Latent Estimation and Residual Impedance Targets
summary: Whole-body compliant control is essential for deploying heavy humanoids under high payload in human-centric environments. Most prior force-aware learning-based pipelines focus on end-effector resistance, per-link upper-body springs, or end-effector stiffness modulation, leaving arbitrary-site perturbations on heavy platforms with lower-body engagement largely unaddressed. We close this gap with CompliantWBC comprising: (1) A base policy trained with RL to maximize compliance-fidelity reward, guided by a multi-site whole-body impedance reference controller, extending classical Cartesian impedance to any controlled link; (2) A bounded residual policy that edits the per-link impedance equilibrium over a frozen base, correcting the coarse but structured wrench estimate supplied by a force encoder co-trained behind a gradient barrier; (3) A Phong-weighted force-origin sampler with an axis-decoupled pelvis anchor induces lower-body-inclusive compliance curriculum training via two interpretable parameters. We evaluate CompliantWBC in simulation against both compliant and stiff baselines, achieving best compliant fidelity of 2.58cm deviation from analytical solutions, and demonstrate it on a real heavy humanoid across static/dynamic force reaction, board wiping, squat under payload, and cooperative payload transport. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: CompliantWBC：面向重型人形机器人全身柔顺控制的分层强化学习框架，实现任意部位外力扰动下的高保真柔顺响应。
AI.motivation: 重型人形机器人在有人环境中承受大负载时，需要全身柔顺控制。已有基于力感知的学习方法多局限于末端抗扰、上半身各连杆弹簧或末端刚度调节，未解决重型平台在任意部位受扰且需下肢参与的问题。作者旨在填补这一空白，实现可作用于任意受控连杆、并调动下肢的全身阻抗式柔顺。
AI.method: 提出 CompliantWBC 三层结构：(1) 基础策略用强化学习训练，以柔顺保真度奖励为目标，由多部位全身阻抗参考控制器（将经典笛卡尔阻抗推广到任意受控连杆）引导；(2) 有界残差策略在冻结的基础策略上修正各连杆阻抗平衡点，用于纠正由力编码器提供的粗但结构化的力螺旋估计，力编码器通过梯度屏障协同训练；(3) Phong 加权力作用点采样器配合轴解耦的骨盆锚点，用两个可解释参数实现含下肢的柔顺课程训练。
AI.result: 仿真中与柔顺和刚性基线对比，取得最佳柔顺保真度，与解析解的偏差为 2.58 cm；在真实重型人形机器人上演示了静态/动态力反应、擦白板、负重深蹲及协作负载运输等任务。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将全身阻抗式柔顺控制扩展到任意受控连杆并引入下肢参与，结合多部位阻抗参考与残差修正提升了柔顺保真度，并在真实重型人形平台上验证了多种力交互任务的可行性。

title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is this https URL .

AI.tldr: SocialHumanoid：面向人形机器人社交互动的单步共语全身动作生成系统，结合情感条件与历史窗口衔接，在线转为机器人参考并由全身控制器执行；同时发布 4 小时 AffectMoCap 情感动作数据集。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人被期望成为具身社交智能体，需要与语音同步、富有情感表现力且能实时执行的身体行为。现有共语动作生成方法主要面向数字人，缺少对情感控制与低延迟连续生成在物理本体上的联合支持。
AI.method: 提出 SocialHumanoid：给定回复语音与指定情感条件，单次前向即生成整段全身动作窗口，并通过运动历史条件连接连续窗口（one-step 生成）；生成的人体动作在线转换为与本体兼容的机器人参考，由全身控制器跟踪执行。为提供情感身体表达的显式监督，构建 AffectMoCap 数据集（4 小时，两名专业演员，含同步语音、身体动作、细粒度手部动作与情感标注）。
AI.result: 在 BEAT2 上取得所比较方法中最佳 FGD，语音—动作同步性具竞争力，相同协议下推理速度约为 GestureLSM 的 6 倍；感知评测显示使用 AffectMoCap 训练可提升从生成身体动作中识别情感的准确度；真机实验验证了连续的情感条件行为与稳定长时程执行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将情感可控、低延迟共语动作生成与真实人形本体执行打通，配套情感动作数据集，为人形机器人社交具身表达提供了可行方案。

title: Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking
summary: Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.

AI.tldr: 提出HumanoidCSL-20K数据集与基准，含20,648条中文手语句级序列，每条提供源视频、修复人手运动、直接机器人参考、几何修复机器人参考四个对齐版本，实现跨表示来源可追溯的分阶段评估。
AI.motivation: 手语数据采集成本高、遥操作难以规模化，因此希望复用大规模视频语料。但将视频导出的人体运动转化为人形机器人轨迹时，拟合、人体运动修复、重定向、机器人几何修复与控制等环节的误差在最终轨迹上难以解耦，缺少可归因的中间表示与评估协议。
AI.method: 构建四版本对齐数据集（源视频、局部观测支持的人体运动修复结果、直接重定向机器人参考、整机几何修复后的机器人参考），并保留跨表示来源追踪。设计成对评估，分别度量人体运动连续性与内容保持、机器人参考可行性、物理执行效果；提出手语专用运动学参考协议，对全规划运动上的手型、位置、掌心朝向与双手关系打分。
AI.result: 全语料实验显示，经修复后手臂/手部异常步态减少，双手间与手-躯干穿透下降；控制实验将参考可学习性与课程学习效应分离，分项得分定位出残余执行误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将手语视频到人形机器人的全链路拆解为可追溯、可分别度量的阶段，为手语机器人重定向提供了诊断型基准与评估协议；但偏数据集/基准性质，未给出端到端可部署的机器人系统与实机验证。

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出递归式治理手册蒸馏（Recursive Harness Distillation），将强智能体的干预经验蒸馏为可复用的"playbook"，并通过轻智能体的执行反馈递归精炼，在不更新模型参数的前提下提升VLA策略的真实操作成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型具备广泛操作能力，但在需要故障诊断与行为调整的执行场景中表现不佳。强智能体虽能通过交互发现有效干预手段，但其经验难以被复用与迁移到新任务实例。
AI.method: 强智能体将自身交互经验蒸馏为轻智能体可用的playbook；随后利用轻智能体执行反馈递归精炼该playbook。playbook作为可复用干预知识，在推理时注入而不更新任何模型参数，实现跨智能体的经验共享。
AI.result: 真实世界操作成功率从37.3%提升至64.0%；SimplerEnv Bridge上轻智能体+playbook达66.7%，GR00T-only基线为41.7%，并超过无playbook的强智能体；同一playbook也使强智能体达到79.2%。
AI.conclusion: 干预经验可被积累、经执行反馈精炼、并跨智能体复用于提升操作性能，验证了机器人领域中harness distillation的可行性。

title: Large Language Models for Model-Based Robot Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can contribute useful engineering knowledge to robot design, but directly generated designs may rely on implicit assumptions and provide no guarantees of feasibility or optimality. These assumptions are critical because different reasonable modeling choices can materially change which designs are predicted to be feasible or optimal. We therefore present a framework that uses LLMs to construct explicit engineering models containing physical relationships, compatibility constraints, and objectives, allowing these modeling choices to be inspected and revised before formal optimization. The model can then be updated with additional engineering, manufacturer, or system-specific information before formal multi-objective optimization provides feasibility and Pareto-optimality guarantees with respect to the finalized model and specified design space. We evaluate the framework on quadcopter and line-following robot component-selection problems. Across 30 direct LLM design trials, none could be verified as feasible under the corresponding finalized model. Comparisons with an independently developed expert model and successive stages of model refinement further showed that changes in modeling assumptions substantially altered the predicted feasible and Pareto-optimal design sets. Together, these results show that using LLMs to construct explicit engineering models makes the underlying design choices available for inspection and revision before those assumptions determine the optimized designs. Explicit modeling therefore provides an interface for combining LLM-generated engineering knowledge, system-specific information, and formal design optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出用LLM构建显式工程模型（物理关系、兼容性约束、目标函数），使建模假设可被检视与修正，再进行多目标优化以获得可行性与Pareto最优性保证。
AI.motivation: 直接让LLM生成机器人设计依赖隐式假设，无法保证可行性与最优性；不同建模选择会显著改变被判定为可行或最优的设计集合，因此需要在形式化优化之前将假设显式化并可被检视、修正。
AI.method: 框架分阶段：先用LLM构造含物理关系、兼容性约束与目标的显式工程模型；允许注入额外的工程、制造商或系统特定信息并对模型进行迭代修订；随后在最终确定的模型与指定设计空间上执行形式化多目标优化，给出可行性与Pareto最优性保证。
AI.result: 在四旋翼与循线机器人部件选择问题上评估。30次直接LLM设计试验中，无一个能在对应最终模型下被验证为可行。与独立开发的专家模型及模型逐步精炼各阶段的对比显示，建模假设的变化会实质性改变预测的可行设计与Pareto最优设计集合。
AI.conclusion: 用LLM构建显式工程模型，可在假设决定优化设计之前使设计选择可被检视与修订，从而为融合LLM工程知识、系统特定信息与形式化设计优化提供接口。

title: VIDEAS: Distilling Explicit Action Semantics from Demonstration Videos for World Models via Prior-Guided Simulation
summary: World models learn internal representations of environment dynamics to predict future states, enabling agents to optimize action plans without physical interactions. However, developing world models that genuinely internalize underlying causal physical laws to explicitly reason about action preconditions and subsequent state transitions remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose VIDEAS, a data distillation framework that transforms continuous physical dynamics from operational videos into explicit action semantics for foundation models. Specifically, it deconstructs visual demonstrations into discrete action trajectories and utilizes advanced vision-language models (VLMs) to extract structured knowledge encapsulating action preconditions and effects. To ensure physical consistency, we introduce a prior-guided trajectory simulation mechanism grounded within a text-based environment to rigorously validate the extracted knowledge. Notably, we incorporate negative trajectories to enrich knowledge completeness and enhance data diversity to mitigate cognitive bias. Furthermore, we present VIDEAS-WM, an 8B/9B-parameter suite of language-based world models trained on 34K high-quality samples derived from AgiBot-World dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDEAS-WM establishes state-of-the-art performance in high-level embodied action semantic reasoning, exhibiting profound physical understanding and robust generalization across unseen scenarios.

AI.tldr: VIDEAS 框架将操作视频中的连续物理动态蒸馏为显式动作语义（前置条件与效果），并用文本环境中的先验引导轨迹仿真进行物理一致性校验；据此训练的 8B/9B 语言世界模型 VIDEAS-WM（34K 样本，AgiBot-World）在高层具身动作语义推理上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能预测未来状态以支持无物理交互的动作规划，但难以真正内化底层因果物理规律，无法显式推理动作前置条件与后续状态转移。作者希望从大规模操作视频中提取显式、可验证的动作语义知识，以提升基础模型的物理理解与泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 将视觉演示解构为离散动作轨迹；2) 用先进 VLM 抽取结构化知识，包含动作前置条件与效果；3) 引入先验引导的轨迹仿真机制，在文本环境中严格校验所抽知识的物理一致性；4) 加入负轨迹以提升知识完整性与数据多样性、缓解认知偏差；5) 基于 AgiBot-World 数据集构建 34K 高质量样本，训练 VIDEAS-WM（8B/9B 参数语言世界模型套件）。
AI.result: 在高层具身动作语义推理任务上取得 SOTA，展现出深入的物理理解，并在未见场景中具有稳健的泛化能力；34K 蒸馏样本被验证为高质量且物理一致。
AI.conclusion: 数据蒸馏 + VLM 语义抽取 + 仿真校验，是把视频物理动态转成显式动作语义、并训练语言世界模型的一条可行路径；负轨迹与文本环境校验是关键设计，使模型具备可迁移的物理推理能力。

title: AMBIT: Anticipatory Multimodal Body Recruitment for Bimanual Tracking on a Humanoid
summary: A humanoid with 5-DoF arms cannot track generic bimanual end-effector trajectories with its arms alone; pelvis and waist motion must be recruited, but which motion, and when, is not uniquely determined. On a Unitree R1 in fixed double support, the set of dynamically valid recruitment strategies (pelvis pose and waist trajectories) for a task is a diverse continuous manifold, and a deterministic regressor trained on it mode-averages into strategies valid only 35% of the time, against 52% for a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and 82% for the best of 16 CVAE samples. We introduce AMBIT: the CVAE proposes strategies from a preview of the commanded trajectory, a non-learned selector filters, ranks and verifies them, and a receding-horizon loop commits to one with hysteresis. The committed strategy is the reference of the same whole-body differential-IK QP a reactive tracker runs, which keeps authority over residual error. On 160 held-out episodes that admit a valid strategy, in full MuJoCo dynamics under a torque controller, AMBIT reaches 85% success at a 3 cm/15 deg tolerance against 74% for the tracker (disjoint confidence intervals) and recruits the body before the arms saturate in 48% of episodes against 35%. Because diversity is preserved, constraints unknown at training time are enforced by selection alone: under five zero-shot shifts AMBIT beats the warm-started tracker on every shift and matches a test-time re-optimisation baseline 17x more expensive. On a Unitree G1, with hyperparameters unchanged, the protocol reproduces the structure of the valid set and widens the gap over the tracker to 0.85 against 0.53. Five selected strategies execute on the externally supported physical R1, distinct in pelvis excursion and tracking the planned end-effector motion to a median of 11 mm by encoder forward kinematics, which establishes kinematic realisability, not balance.

AI.tldr: AMBIT 用 CVAE 提出全身招募策略、非学习选择器筛选排序验证、滚动时域带滞回地提交一条策略作为全身差分 IK QP 的参考，在 MuJoCo 中 85% 成功率超越反应式跟踪器 74%，并零样本支持约束迁移。
AI.motivation: 5-DoF 双臂人形无法仅靠手臂跟踪通用双臂末端轨迹，必须调用骨盆与腰部运动，但"动哪个、何时动"存在多解；有效招募策略构成连续多样流形，确定性回归器会模式平均化（仅 35% 有效），需要保留多样性以应对训练时未知约束。
AI.method: AMBIT：CVAE 从指令轨迹预览中生成候选全身策略；非学习选择器对候选过滤、排序与验证；滚动时域循环配合滞回提交单一策略；该策略作为反应式跟踪器所用同一全身差分 IK QP 的参考，跟踪器保留残差误差控制权。
AI.result: 160 个留出回合、完整 MuJoCo 动力学与力矩控制器下，AMBIT 在 3 cm/15° 容差下成功率 85% vs 跟踪器 74%（置信区间不相交），48% vs 35% 的回合在手臂饱和前调动身体；五种零样本约束偏移下全面胜出，并匹敌 17 倍昂贵的测试时重优化基线；Unitree G1 上超参不变，差距扩大到 0.85 vs 0.53；物理 R1 上 5 条选中策略可执行，末端跟踪中位误差 11 mm（仅验证运动学可实现性，非平衡）。
AI.conclusion: 保留多解多样性并以选择（而非重训练）方式施加约束，是人形全身双臂跟踪中有效且可迁移的策略；方法在仿真与物理平台上均表现出对反应式跟踪器的显著提升。

title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Mobile Web and Intelligent Information Systems (MobiWIS 2026)
summary: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).

AI.tldr: 在Silverline厨房电器工厂部署AI辅助协作质检工位，双协作机器人（UR 10e视觉缺陷检测 + Comau Racer-5功能测试）通过ROS 2 Humble协同，多模态数据本地记录并实时可视化，产出真实产线节拍与工效学指标。
AI.motivation: 人工目视质检是装配线长期瓶颈，长班次下操作员疲劳导致缺陷检出率下降，因此需要AI辅助的协作机器人质检工位。
AI.method: UR 10e协作机器人搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流水线，Comau Racer-5执行功能测试；ROS 2 Humble + Ubuntu 22.04 LTS服务器协调；Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学、SPS电气安全测量多模态数据本地记录并在Grafana实时可视化；以四级人机交互（HRI）框架组织系统集成。
AI.result: 单件质检时间82 s降至61 s（约25%）；终检资源效率0.75升至0.88；操作员目视检验时间减少82%；NASA-TLX心理负荷显著下降（p = 0.005）。同时报告近距安全、眩光/反射下AI鲁棒性、双机器人ROS 2命名空间冲突、OS与依赖问题及工程解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该AI辅助协作质检单元在真实工厂完成部署验证，显著改善节拍与工效学指标，并沉淀了多机器人集成与人机交互的工程经验。

title: A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization
summary: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于机器人关节集成的盘式磁致伸缩扭矩传感器，轴向高度约1 cm，采用四磁强计架构抑制交叉力干扰，配合定制磁屏蔽，实现50 Nm满量程下1.34 %FS精度。
AI.motivation: 机器人精细控制与交互需要直接扭矩感知，而基于电机电流的扭矩估计精度不足；同时现有扭矩传感器体积大、难以集成到关节中，且易受寄生交叉力与外磁场干扰。
AI.method: 设计盘状磁致伸缩扭矩传感器：在窄磁化区域上通过四磁强计架构测量应力调制磁场并抑制交叉力影响；采用定制磁屏蔽增强灵敏度并抑制外部杂散磁场（降低约7倍）；涵盖机械设计、磁化工艺与实验标定验证。
AI.result: 紧凑轴向封装约1 cm；磁屏蔽使外部杂散磁场衰减约7倍并提升扭矩灵敏度；相对50 Nm满量程的测量精度为1.34 %FS；给出机械设计、磁化流程与实验验证细节。
AI.conclusion: 该盘式磁致伸缩扭矩传感器具备紧凑、抗干扰、精度可接受的特点，展示了在机器人关节直接扭矩感知中的应用潜力，后续可推进关节集成与实际部署验证。

title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
summary: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.

AI.tldr: 提出DnD攻击：将水印图像分解为语义灰度载体与残差分支，通过抑制残差分支实现与具体水印方法无关的“表示层”水印去除。
AI.motivation: 现有不可见图像水印评估仅覆盖压缩、缩放、模糊、颜色变化等良性后处理，忽视了“学习型去除器”这一威胁：该去除器在保持语义内容的同时丢弃携带载荷的残余证据。作者主张水印鲁棒性评估应从传统图像编辑转向表示层面的学习型去除。
AI.method: DnD将水印图像解耦为语义灰度载体与辅助残差分支，随后压制残差分支以削弱水印证据，从而把水印去除形式化为表示路由问题，且与水印方法无关。训练时引入潜在频谱扰动与低强度扩散暴露，使“丢弃”操作在自适应重建下保持稳定。实验覆盖七个代表性水印族，并配合操作扫描与消融。
AI.result: 在七个水印族上，单一共享操作设置即可取得有竞争力的去除效果与高视觉保真度。操作扫描与消融区分了可用攻击与损伤图像的设置：更强噪声或扩散可通过破坏图像抬高去除分数，而实用区间来自丢弃残差潜在表示本身。
AI.conclusion: 水印鲁棒性评估不应只针对常规图像编辑，而应纳入表示层面的学习型去除威胁；DnD给出了方法无关、可泛化的评估范式。

title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
summary: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 RemTraceNet，用于"水印去除攻击痕迹"的少样本取证检测，融合残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar 统计与块 DCT 证据，在 23 种去除流程与 10 种水印配置下实现 82.75%–88.17% 的 TPR@1%FPR。
AI.motivation: 现有水印攻击研究只关注水印抑制效果与感知质量，忽略了"去除过程是否可被取证检测"这一独立目标；验证失败时，去除痕迹本身可提供溯源与所有权证据，而现有方法普遍不评估取证隐蔽性。
AI.method: 研究"水印攻击专用"少样本取证：对每个已知流程训练专家模型，区分其输出与配对的干净/未攻击水印对照；设计 Attack-vs-Clean 与 Attack-vs-Watermarked 两类评测以避免"水印存在性"捷径；分别使用图像对齐对照（事后方案）与提示匹配对照（生成器集成方案）。RemTraceNet 在原生分辨率下融合受限残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar 统计与块 DCT 证据。
AI.result: 覆盖 23 种去除流程、10 种水印配置，原生 256×256 与 512×512 输入；每流程 100 张攻击训练图，三种子宏平均 TPR@1%FPR 为 82.75%–88.17%；相同标签与协议下超过重训的 SRNet、ZhuNet、SiaStegNet 基线 10.80–15.68 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 擦除水印与擦除"去除痕迹"是两个不同难题；在有限监督下，去除痕迹仍可被学习检测，取证隐蔽性应作为独立评价维度。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的轻量稀疏高斯过程校正模块，插入 VideoChat2 的投影层与语言模型之间，用少量样本修正低光视频的中间表示以提升动作描述质量。
AI.motivation: 真实低光条件下视频内容退化，导致 VLM 难以准确描述人类动作；而微调底层大模型成本高、样本需求大，因此需要一种无需微调、低开销的表示级纠错方案。
AI.method: 不微调 VLM，在投影层与 LLM 之间插入稀疏高斯过程误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与验证过的目标表示之间的残差，并用新提出的不确定性感知系数自适应缩放后加回原表示；同时设计分块组合核提升残差估计精度。仅用 ARID 数据集 44 个样本训练，推理开销小，框架设计上可迁移到其他兼容 VLM。
AI.result: 通过定量残差预测与生成描述文本的定性分析评估校正效果（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
AI.conclusion: 表示层纠错是提升低光视频理解的低成本可行路径，少量样本即可训练；方法不依赖特定 VLM，具备架构可迁移性，代码已公开。

title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 提出轻量模块化 Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，利用 ViT 中间层全部 patch token 对齐 EEG/MEG 脑信号，在 THINGS-EEG2 与 THINGS-MEG 上取得 SOTA 解码精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 M/EEG 视觉解码普遍将脑信号对齐到预训练视觉编码器的单一全局嵌入（CLS），丢失了中间层 patch 表示中更细粒度的视觉信息，能否借此提升表示学习尚不明确。
AI.method: RPA 为轻量、模块化适配器，对齐 ViT 中间层的全部 patch token；通过消融分析比较 pooling/masking/CLS token 的作用；用六项定量特征分析（高低层语义与颜色、纹理等低层视觉特征）验证对齐所依赖的信息；并测试替代脑编码器（含 EEG 基础模型）与可插拔替代模块（卷积、attention、ConvNeXt）。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG2 上被试内 Top-1 95.4%、跨被试 35.5%；THINGS-MEG 上分别为 65.2% 与 6.7%，两数据集均达 SOTA。消融显示池化或掩码 patch token 会降低表示质量，完整 patch token 集合对 EEG 对齐更重要，CLS token 独有信息很少。
AI.conclusion: 确立了利用视觉编码器隐空间进行脑–图像对齐的设计原则，方法可跨脑编码器与适配器结构迁移，为非侵入式 BCI 与脑–图像对齐开辟新方向。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: this https URL
summary: Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint? We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work. Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 本文针对压缩域视频描述（compressed-domain video captioning）方法 CoCap，通过受控替换实验回答一个窄问题：CLIP I-frame 编码器与浅层 BERT 解码器谁是精度瓶颈。作者将 CLIP 替换为 SigLIP2、将 BERT 解码器替换为 GPT-2，在相同数据、采样预算与优化计划下对比三种配置，并额外报告推理延迟。
AI.motivation: CoCap 以 I-frame、运动矢量、残差直接在压缩域上工作，牺牲少量精度换取大幅推理加速，但其 CLIP 编码器与浅层 BERT 解码器均已显著落后于更新替代方案。作者希望明确：CoCap 的精度有多少受限于这两个组件，且二者中哪个构成约束瓶颈。
AI.method: 用 SigLIP2 替换 CLIP I-frame 编码器，用 GPT-2 替换 BERT 风格多模态解码器，在完全相同的训练数据（VATEX 的 4,999 片段子集）、采样预算和优化计划下评估三种配置：原始组合、仅替换编码器、两者同时替换。所有比较均基于作者自己复现的 CoCap 而非原文报告数值，并报告每种配置的推理延迟。
AI.result: 复现结果与原文接近：CIDEr 54.9 vs 52.7、METEOR 23.4 vs 23.2 略高，BLEU-4 29.7 vs 31.4、ROUGE-L 48.9 vs 49.4 略低，差异归因于评测子集。两种替换方向相反：仅 SigLIP2 提升所有指标（CIDEr +4.5），而在此基础上叠加 GPT-2 会侵蚀该增益，因为预训练解码器在 4,999 片段上两个 epoch 内即过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 编码器是更紧的约束，解码器替换反而带来负收益；由于速度是压缩域描述的核心动机，任何以延迟为代价换取的精度增益都应被如实报告。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 提出混合残差注意力网络（HRAN）结合新型自适应动量优化器（IAMO），对蚕图像六分类（健康/患病）达98.67%准确率。
AI.motivation: 蚕桑养殖中疾病早期检测依赖人工，效率低且主观；需要自动化图像分类方法在早期识别患病个体，减少经济损失。
AI.method: HRAN：残差块做深层特征提取，融合空间与通道注意力聚焦病灶特征；数据经归一化、缩放、去噪预处理及增强；提出IAMO优化器提升收敛速度与训练效率。
AI.result: 在蚕图像六分类任务上准确率达98.67%，空间+通道注意力与IAMO结合显著提升对类间细微差异的辨识能力。
AI.conclusion: HRAN可用于蚕桑疾病早期检测，未来将提升多环境下的可扩展性与效率。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出通道局部对比（CLC），在YOLO26分割原型头上加一个由64个零初始化有界门控的固定局部高通残差，在四个乳腺超声数据集上一致提升组宏Dice（+1.12~3.11个百分点），仅增加64参数和0.0049 GFLOPs，T4 FP16前向仅增0.0966 ms。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割需要准确边界，同时评测必须防止患者或重复图像跨越数据划分；现有分割原型头对局部边界对比度利用不足，且划分协议常被忽视。
AI.method: 将YOLO26分割原型头做紧凑改进：新增固定局部高通残差（Channel Local Contrast），由64个零初始化、有界通道门控调制，故初始等价于基线。在四个数据集上做五折配对比较，并采用患者级/重复组分组的划分：BUS-BRA用患者不相交外层测试+独立内层验证，BUS-UCLM与BrEaST用患者分组验证，BUSI因无患者标识用重复图像组件分组。
AI.result: 组宏Dice分别提升1.68、3.11、1.12、2.45个百分点（BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST）；仅BUS-BRA的配对95%置信区间不含零。额外开销为64参数、0.0049 GFLOPs；640像素、单T4、batch=1、FP16 TensorRT图时间2.1478 ms（CLC）对2.0512 ms（基线），不含前后处理，前向开销0.0966 ms。
AI.conclusion: CLC以极小参数与算力代价在四个数据集上一致提升分割精度，但增益显著性与泛化仍有限（四组中仅一组置信区间排除零），属低开销的即插即用式改进。

title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
summary: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model. This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain. On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.

AI.tldr: 提出 MDL-SG 三阶段分词器训练流程（发现/复制/效用），用显著性增益+超几何复制检验+MDL 准则自动决定合并次数，在 WikiText-103 上无需预设词表大小即自动停止，并在同算力 TinyGPT 上取得更低 BPC。
AI.motivation: 传统 BPE 需外部指定合并次数或目标词表大小，且仅按频率选择合并对；SG-BPE 虽用统计显著性替代频率，但仍未解决"何时停止合并"以及"合并是否真正有利于语言模型"的问题。
AI.method: 三阶段分离流程：在发现集上按 Significance-Gain 排序候选对；在独立复制集上用单侧精确超几何检验并配合逐迭代 Benjamini-Hochberg 多重检验校正；再在效用集上用最小描述长度（MDL）准则评估，当无复制通过的候选带来正留出 MDL 增益时自动停止合并。
AI.result: WikiText-103 上，120K/250K/500K 字符训练样本分别自动停在 209/433/847 次合并；500K 字符时得到 1,017 词表的存储词表。算力匹配 TinyGPT（2,024,448 参数、每语言模型 500 次优化器更新）下验证/测试 BPC 为 3.2612/3.2436，优于 SG-BPE 的 3.2894 与频率 BPE 的 3.3493（测试 BPC）；但频率 BPE 原始压缩率更强。
AI.conclusion: 以压缩为导向的合并选择与语言模型效用并不一致；MDL 校准的显著性增益可在不预设词表规模的前提下自动确定合并次数并提升下游 BPC。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出受控评测框架，用语义保持变换解耦分辨率退化与任务难度，并给出AUSC与PVS两项指标，在5个模型族、5个基准上归纳出高分辨率下VLM的三类失效模式。
AI.motivation: VLM在高分辨率输入下表现不佳，且现有工作多为零散改进，缺少对"为什么在高分辨率失效"的系统性理解。作者希望把分辨率导致的性能下降从任务难度中分离出来，从而可量化、可归因地诊断失效机理。
AI.method: 构建受控评测框架：通过语义保持变换（semantics-preserving transformations）构造仅改变分辨率/纵横比/分块方式而语义不变的样本，实现分辨率因素与任务难度的解耦。提出两项指标——AUSC（缩放曲线下面积，衡量与基线精度无关的缩放鲁棒性）与PVS（预测方差分数，衡量分辨率引起的预测不稳定性）；在5个模型族、5个基准上做系统实验并做架构族间的退化模式对比。
AI.result: 识别出三类主要失效模式：(1) 视觉token上限导致下采样带来的信息丢失；(2) 非标准纵横比下patch边界移动与位置编码脆弱造成的tokenization伪影；(3) token数增加带来的注意力稀释。即便SOTA模型在高分辨率下也出现性能下降，且退化模式按架构族呈现系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率失败具有可分解、可量化的机理，而非单纯的难度问题；据此给出面向架构设计与数据增强的可行建议，以缓解上述局限。

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
summary: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 跨数据集水稻叶病分类的系统性基准：强度增强有效，AdaBN 有害，归因分析（Grad-CAM）在实用样本量下无法诊断域偏移。
AI.motivation: 农业CV模型在一处图像集上训练、部署到另一图像集时性能显著下降，跨数据集迁移失败机制缺乏系统诊断与可复现基线。
AI.method: 三个孟加拉水稻叶病数据集（5,419张图、6个迁移对、3种CNN骨干、3个随机种子）基准；对比强增强、分割去除非叶片内容、DINOv2 自监督ViT线性探针、自适应批归一化（AdaBN）；并用Grad-CAM在12个样本上做归因判别；结果冻结并公开含SHA-256校验。
AI.result: 强增强平均提升跨域 macro-F1 +0.070（Wilcoxon p<0.001，18对中15对为正）；分割去背景方向性正向 +0.066（p=0.062，n=36）；DINOv2 线性探针同样出现跨域崩塌，排除架构归纳偏置；AdaBN 一致损害迁移，损害幅度与源-目标标签先验差异及模型深度相关（Spearman rho=0.621，p=0.009）；Grad-CAM 无法区分正确/错误跨域预测（p=0.462）。
AI.conclusion: 采集条件偏移是跨域失败主因；增强是有效适应策略，AdaBN 无效；常规归因代理不足以诊断域偏移，需更大样本。为农业CV跨域泛化提供严格经验基线。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 用选择性推断为病理 MIL 的高注意力实例做统计显著性检验，控制 Type-I 错误并提升统计功效。
AI.motivation: 基于注意力的多示例学习（MIL）被广泛用于全切片病理图像（WSI）的弱监督分析，高注意力实例常被当作可视化解释中具有诊断价值的区域。然而，注意力分数本身无法判断被选中的高注意力实例是否显著偏离正常实例，导致解释的可靠性不足。
AI.method: 将高注意力实例的评估形式化为统计假设检验问题，判断被选中的高注意力实例是否显著偏离基于特征相似度挑选的代表性正常参考实例。由于目标实例与参考实例均经由数据依赖的选择过程得到，标准假设检验失效，因此引入选择性推断（selective inference, SI）框架，显式建模注意力驱动的实例选择与自适应参考选择所诱发的选择事件，从而在给定这些事件的条件下计算有效的选择性 p 值。
AI.result: 在合成数据与 MNIST 类数据上实现了 Type-I 错误率控制，并在病理 WSI 上展示了实用可行性，统计功效高于传统的过度条件化（over-conditioning）方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为注意力型 MIL 的可视化解释提供了具有统计有效性保障的检验工具；其实验局限于合成数据、MNIST 与病理切片，未涉及机器人、具身智能或真实世界物理场景验证。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇关于"视频理解智能体"的综述，提出智能体循环形式化框架，并以"挑战—设计"分类学梳理上下文瓶颈、证据稀疏、时序因果与多模态歧义四类问题对应的层次化证据记忆、主动证据获取、状态与过程跟踪、角色专化协同等设计，并总结状态空间、学习范式、监督信号与评测协议及开放方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型处理模态与长时序上下文的能力增强，固定式视频-语言推理已不足，需要能主动决定"看什么、留什么、验证什么、如何行动"的智能体系统，但该方向缺乏统一的问题形式化与设计分类。
AI.method: 综述性方法：形式化视频理解智能体的 agent loop（自适应状态构建 + 动作选择）；构建"挑战→设计"分类学，将上下文瓶颈、证据稀疏、时序因果、多模态歧义映射到层次化证据记忆、主动证据获取、状态与过程跟踪、角色专化协同；并梳理状态空间范式、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评测协议。
AI.result: 给出统一的形式化框架与问题-设计映射表，系统整理了状态空间与学习/监督范式、现有基准和评测协议，并指出面向智能体原生的时序建模与视频原生智能体等开放方向。
AI.conclusion: 视频理解正从固定推理转向自适应智能体范式；未来需在时序状态建模与视频原生智能体架构上进一步突破。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions.
