However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 提出物理感知音视频描述统一框架：数据构建管线+OmniFysics-Agent+PPM，构建Daily-Physics 50K与OmniPhysCap基准，训练OmniFysics-Captioner，匹配Gemini 3.1 Pro并在多个视频描述基准取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 构建具身/物理智能全模态模型需要捕捉接触、支撑、形变、状态转换等细粒度物理证据的监督信号。现有全模态描述模型只建模通用视听语义，忽略瞬时或空间局部的物理证据。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建管线识别物理丰富片段，用OmniFysics-Agent协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具，采集时空对齐、可追溯的跨模态证据；2) 其中PPM在约2M图像级样本上微调，专门提取物体交互与状态变化线索；3) 构建Daily-Physics 50K数据集与evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC)基准；4) 基于该数据训练OmniFysics-Captioner。
AI.result: Captioner在音视频描述上匹配Gemini 3.1 Pro，在多个视频描述基准取得SOTA，显著优于其他开源模型；消融显示PPM证据提升物理覆盖率，产生更细粒度、更可靠的跨模态描述。
AI.conclusion: 证据驱动的物理感知数据构建与训练可有效提升全模态描述对物理证据的还原能力，为物理智能模型提供细粒度监督。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fysiverse-3D-SimReady 框架，从单张 RGB 图像（含实例与地面提示）重建仿真就绪的多物体场景，通过可微渲染精修相机空间位姿并修正支撑与接触关系，再接入智能体仿真流程执行目标条件物理推演。
AI.motivation: 现有单图 3D 生成方法主要产出视觉上合理的单体资产，而非可供仿真的场景状态；独立生成的网格在共享空间中易出现与输入相机不对齐、违反重力、穿模、物理仿真不稳定等问题，难以支撑感知—推理—行动闭环。
AI.method: 将生成物体网格放入统一的重力对齐场景，利用可微渲染精修相机空间位姿，并在场景层面修正支撑与接触约束以保证物理执行稳定；随后由智能体仿真工作流把场景特定任务目标转化为可执行的物理 rollout，并从原始相机视角渲染。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有单图重建与场景生成基线，该方法在输入视角对齐、接触合理性和物理稳定性上均更优，并可由单张图像驱动目标条件的物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将单图 3D 生成从"视觉合理资产"推进到"仿真就绪场景状态"，为图像驱动的物理仿真与智能体交互提供了可行路径。

title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at this https URL
summary: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PanOVOcc：免训练的全景开放词汇语义占据建图框架，统一全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期体素记忆，并建立Pan-Replica与Pan-Holo360D两个基准，IoU/mIoU大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 基于透视的语义占据建图空间覆盖有限，现有全景方法多仅从单次观测预测局部体素，缺乏长期、全局、可语言查询的语义占据地图，且该设定缺少系统评测基准。
AI.method: PanOVOcc为免训练在线框架，将全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期空间体素记忆统一起来，从全景RGB-D序列中持续融合几何与语义证据，构建全局、可语言查询的语义占据地图。
AI.result: 相较各指标最强基线，Pan-Replica上占据IoU与语义mIoU绝对提升+20.03与+7.06；Pan-Holo360D上分别提升+43.26与+20.16。
AI.conclusion: 全景序列驱动的持久开放词汇语义占据建图具备显著优势，配合所建立的两个合成与真实场景基准，为该方向提供统一评测平台。

title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
comment: Code and data will be released publicly at this https URL
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PanoFuse：为VLA策略引入全景感知分支，通过解耦语义-几何路由(DSGR)将全景基础模型的语义与几何表征分别注入下游状态与动作表征，并构建含全景RGB的真实机器人操作数据集，在7个评测设置中平均成功率52.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略多依赖有限视场的透视相机，缺少全局场景上下文，在视觉遮挡、干扰物和未见环境下操作不可靠。作者希望用全景(全向)感知为局部操作观测提供全局补充，同时避免异质特征直接混合带来的语义干扰。
AI.method: 提出PanoFuse全景增强VLA框架：(1)专用全景分支，利用预训练全景基础模型从全向观测中提取互补的语义与几何表征；(2)解耦语义-几何路由(DSGR)，将语义与几何作为两条独立上下文流，通过结构化分块注意力(block-wise attention)选择性路由到下游状态与动作表征；(3)搭建同步数据采集管线，构建含全景RGB、腕部视图、语言指令、机器人状态与动作的真实操作数据集。
AI.result: 在7个评测设置中平均成功率达52.9%，优于所评测基线，并在新物体、未见背景和干扰物丰富场景下取得一致增益。代码与数据将公开。
AI.conclusion: 以全景全局感知补充局部操作观测、并以解耦路由方式融合异构表征，是提升VLA在遮挡、干扰与分布外场景下鲁棒性的可行路径；配套的真实机器人数据集为该方向提供数据支撑。

title: Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion
summary: Current grasp diffusion models provide rich priors for generation, yet their object-centric approach can violate the kinematic and collision constraints imposed by the embodiment and the environment. Existing embodiment-aware methods primarily perform local corrections around generated grasps through gradient guidance or optimization, making it difficult to recover from fundamentally infeasible modes. We present Steer2Grasp, a training-free, embodiment-agnostic framework for inference-time grasp steering that adapts a frozen Cartesian grasp diffusion model using deployment-specific rewards. Through Feynman-Kac (FK) inspired particle reweighting and resampling, the method reallocates population mass from infeasible to high-reward grasp modes, enabling population-level mode transitions without modifying the pretrained diffusion model or requiring differentiable constraints. The framework enables a unified treatment for single and dual arm grasping through reachability and collision aware rewards, followed by gradient free gripper level local refinement. Across diverse objects, robot embodiments, and constrained environments, our method substantially improves feasible grasp generation while maintaining proximity to the underlying grasp prior.

AI.tldr: Steer2Grasp：一种免训练、与具身无关的推理时抓取引导框架，通过Feynman-Kac粒子重加权与重采样，将冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型的采样质量从不可行模式迁移到高奖励可行模式。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取扩散模型以物体为中心，忽略机械臂与环境带来的运动学与碰撞约束；已有的具身感知方法仅在生成抓取附近做局部梯度修正或优化，无法从本质上不可行的模式中恢复。
AI.method: 无需训练、与具身无关的推理时引导框架。基于Feynman-Kac的粒子重加权与重采样，在不修改预训练扩散模型、不需可微约束的前提下实现群体级模式转移；用可达性与碰撞感知的奖励统一处理单臂与双臂抓取，再做无梯度的夹爪级局部精修。
AI.result: 在多样物体、机器人具身与受限环境下，显著提升可行抓取生成率，同时保持与底层抓取先验的接近性。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时粒子重采样实现群体级模式迁移，为具身感知抓取生成提供了免训练、免可微约束、可跨具身复用的通用范式。

title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging because differences in hand morphology and contact dynamics often cause retargeted motions to fail at producing the intended object behavior. We present \textbf{FoLD}, a framework for learning dexterous manipulation of articulated objects through explicit force guidance. FoLD compute compensatory force fields from human demonstrations together with the robot's current interaction state, yielding a force prior that promotes the demonstrated object motion. This force prior informs a residual policy that adapts retargeted hand motions to the contact requirements of the task. We evaluate FoLD on a public benchmark for articulated object manipulation, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across tasks and embodiments. We further validate FoLD on real dexterous robot platforms, demonstrating successful transfer of human manipulation skills to robot execution. Here is the link of our project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: FoLD：从人类演示计算补偿力场生成力先验，引导残差策略适配重定向手部运动，实现铰接物体的灵巧操作迁移。
AI.motivation: 人手与机器人手在形态和接触动力学上存在差异，直接重定向（retargeting）的运动轨迹往往无法产生演示中期望的物体行为，导致人类演示向灵巧机器人的迁移失败。
AI.method: 将人类演示与机器人当前交互状态结合，显式计算补偿力场（compensatory force field），形成促进演示物体运动的力先验；该先验作为条件输入，指导一个残差策略在重定向手部运动基础上进行接触层面的适配调整。
AI.result: 在公开的铰接物体操作基准上跨任务、跨本体（embodiment）一致优于现有最强基线；并在真实灵巧机器人平台上验证，成功将人类操作技能迁移到机器人执行。
AI.conclusion: 显式力引导可有效弥合人手—机器手差异，为接触丰富的人到机器人操作技能迁移提供可行框架。

title: SLIP-VLA: Single-Step Latent Imagination for Policy Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Project page and demonstration videos: this https URL
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are increasingly effective for robotic manipulation, yet most predict actions directly from current observations without explicitly modeling future scene evolution. Recent methods introduce future prediction to improve action generation, but dense future modeling often requires expensive iterative denoising, while one-step alternatives can underperform their multi-step counterparts. To reconcile efficient future modeling with strong action performance, we present SLIP-VLA, a policy learning framework that equips VLA models with a Single-Step Latent Imagination for future-aware action prediction. SLIP-VLA obtains temporally dense future latent representations with a single denoising update, and we improve the perceptual sufficiency of these representations by aligning intermediate latents with future geometric and semantic features. We further improve their control sufficiency through action-conditioned latent world modeling and inverse dynamics modeling, explicitly coupling latent transitions with robot actions. SLIP-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, while its single-step latent imagination takes only 12 ms.

AI.tldr: SLIP-VLA：用单步 latent imagination 为 VLA 提供未来感知动作预测，在仿真与真实操作任务达 SOTA，单步想象仅 12 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 多直接从当前观测预测动作，缺少对未来场景演化的显式建模；引入未来预测的方法中，稠密未来建模依赖昂贵的迭代去噪，而单步替代方案性能常劣于多步版本。因此需要同时兼顾高效未来建模与强动作性能。
AI.method: 提出 SLIP-VLA 策略学习框架：通过单次去噪更新获得时间上稠密的未来潜在表示（Single-Step Latent Imagination）；用未来几何与语义特征对齐中间 latent 以提升感知充分性；并通过动作条件 latent world modeling 与逆动力学建模，将 latent 转移与机器人动作显式耦合，以提升控制充分性。
AI.result: 在多个仿真基准与真实世界操作任务上取得 SOTA 性能；单步 latent imagination 推理耗时仅 12 ms。
AI.conclusion: 显式但轻量的未来 latent 建模可在不牺牲效率的前提下显著增强 VLA 的动作生成能力，为未来感知的机器人策略学习提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning
summary: Joint-embedding world models enable visual planning by learning action-conditioned dynamics in latent space. Yet they are commonly trained for one-step prediction on encoded states, while planning recursively applies the learned transition to its own predictions. One-step accuracy therefore does not capture how prediction errors propagate under recursive rollout. We decompose multi-step rollout error into the errors introduced at individual steps and their propagation through subsequent transitions. We show that state-affine dynamics are precisely the differentiable transitions with state-independent Jacobians, eliminating the nonlinear propagation residual and making the error propagation operators depend only on the action sequence. Guided by this result, we introduce SALT (State-Affine Latent Transition), an action-conditioned state-affine dynamics model in which the action modulates both the state transformation and the additive update. We train SALT through recursive multi-step rollout supervision, feeding each predicted latent state back into the transition so that training matches how the model is used during planning. Across four visual planning environments, SALT exhibits $1.48$--$2.19\times$ higher one-step prediction error than the matched LeWM baseline, yet improves closed-loop success in every environment by $10.0$ percentage points on average. On OGBench-Cube, the fraction of episodes that fail with a sharp rise in model-predicted cost after execution decreases from $23.3%$ to $2.0%$.

AI.tldr: SALT 提出状态仿射潜在转移动力学模型，通过递归多步 rollout 监督训练，虽单步误差更高但闭环规划成功率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入世界模型通常在隐空间做单步预测训练，但规划时是递归地把转移模型作用到自身预测上，导致单步精度无法反映误差在递归 rollout 中的传播特性，训练目标与使用方式不匹配。
AI.method: 将多步 rollout 误差分解为各步引入的误差及其在后续转移中的传播；证明状态仿射动力学正是雅可比与状态无关的可微转移，可消除非线性传播残差，使误差传播算子仅依赖动作序列。据此提出 SALT：动作同时调制状态变换与加性更新，并以递归多步 rollout 监督训练，将预测隐状态反馈回转移模型。
AI.result: 在四个视觉规划环境中，SALT 单步预测误差比匹配的 LeWM 基线高 1.48–2.19 倍，但闭环成功率平均提升 10.0 个百分点；OGBench-Cube 上执行后模型预测代价急剧上升而失败的回合比例由 23.3% 降至 2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 单步预测精度并非递归规划的最优指标，刻意选择状态仿射结构并采用递归多步监督可带来更稳定的误差传播与更高的闭环规划成功率。

title: InfraVLA: Extending Vision-Language-Action Navigation with Infrastructure Cameras
summary: Many indoor environments in which robots operate, such as warehouses, offices, and hospitals, already have cameras installed. They observe parts of the building that the robot cannot see from where it stands, yet navigation policies, including recent vision-language-action (VLA) models, do not use them. We propose InfraVLA, an end-to-end method that adapts a pretrained navigation VLA to such static infrastructure views: a closed-circuit television (CCTV) encoder turns each external view into tokens of the input sequence. Because the views matter only at rare decision points, fine-tuning alone did not make the policy use them in our experiments; we therefore train in two stages, on demonstrations with upsampled counterfactual data and then on recovery data. We evaluate on two simulated warehouse tasks, finding an object named in the instruction and rerouting around blocked aisles, where the deciding information is often visible only to the infrastructure cameras. Tested in distribution, InfraVLA reached a success rate of 100% on both, against 34.0% and 73.6% for a baseline without CCTV input. On out-of-distribution test sets it reached 88.2% and 88.9%. On a real quadruped fine-tuned with under 10 minutes of demonstrations, the policy reached 83.3% against 29.2% for the on-board-only baseline.

AI.tldr: InfraVLA 将预训练导航 VLA 与静态基础设施摄像头（CCTV）视图适配，通过两阶段微调（反事实上采样 + 恢复数据）使策略在关键决策点利用外部视角，在两个仓库仿真任务与真实四足上取得大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 室内机器人环境（仓库、办公室、医院）已普遍安装摄像头，能观测机器人本体视野外区域，但导航策略（含近期 VLA 模型）未加利用。作者希望把这类静态基础设施视角接入端到端导航 VLA，以解决指令目标与通道阻塞等仅外部视角可见的决策信息问题。
AI.method: InfraVLA：在预训练导航 VLA 上增加 CCTV 编码器，将每个外部视图转为输入序列 token。由于视图仅在稀疏决策点起作用，单纯微调无法让策略使用它们，故采用两阶段训练：先在反事实上采样（counterfactual upsampled）的示范数据上训练，再在恢复（recovery）数据上训练。
AI.result: 两个仿真仓库任务（按指令找物体、绕行被阻塞通道）：分布内成功率 100% 与 100%，无 CCTV 基线为 34.0% 与 73.6%；分布外测试集为 88.2% 与 88.9%。真实四足仅用不到 10 分钟示范微调，成功率 83.3%，仅本体感知基线为 29.2%。
AI.conclusion: 外部静态摄像头视图可作为有效且低成本的导航观测扩展，使端到端 VLA 在关键决策点获得本体不可见信息；两阶段训练（反事实数据 + 恢复数据）是让策略真正使用稀疏有用视图的关键。真实四足结果初步验证了可迁移性。

title: Demonstration-Free Success-Probability Reward Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
comment: Under review. Project webpage: this https URL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables generalist robot policies to improve through trial-and-error interaction, yet its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by sparse task rewards. Existing general-purpose reward models typically alleviate this issue by learning task progress from expert demonstrations, but introduce a distribution mismatch with the mixed-quality rollouts encountered during policy optimization, making their estimates unreliable on suboptimal and failed behaviors from which the policy must learn. In this work, we introduce a demonstration-free reward learning paradigm where dense reward feedback can be learned directly from sparse task outcomes and policy experience. We theoretically show that terminal task outcomes implicitly define dense success-probability feedback at intermediate timesteps, which can be recursively learned through bootstrapping. Based on this insight, we introduce eVTA$_0$, which learns success probabilities from mixed-quality policy rollouts through temporal-difference-style bootstrapping, without expert demonstrations or intermediate annotations. We further introduce RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER), a closed-loop framework that adapts eVTA$_0$ using newly collected rollouts as the policy evolves. Experiments show that eVTA$_0$ provides more informative rewards than state-of-the-art reward models and achieves the best average policy performance across all LIBERO task suites under the same RL training budget, improving success rates by 5.4%-13.8% over the initial policy. In real-world manipulation, RLER further improves overall success rates by 20%-26%, with 35%-36% gains under out-of-distribution conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of demonstration-free reward learning and adapting rewards as the policy evolves. Project webpage: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出无专家演示的奖励学习范式：利用稀疏任务结果与策略经验递归估计中间时刻成功概率（eVTA₀），并配合闭环RLER随策略演化自适应奖励，在LIBERO与真实机器人操作上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: RL提升通用机器人策略受限于稀疏奖励；现有通用奖励模型依赖专家演示学习任务进度，但训练分布与实际优化中混合质量（次优/失败）rollout存在分布错配，导致估计不可靠。作者希望无需演示、无需中间标注即可获得稠密奖励信号。
AI.method: 理论证明终端任务结果隐式定义了中间时间步的稠密成功概率反馈，可通过自举递归学习。据此提出eVTA₀，用时序差分式自举从混合质量策略rollout中学习成功概率，无需专家演示或中间标注；进一步提出RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER)，用策略演化过程中新采集的rollout闭环自适应更新eVTA₀。
AI.result: eVTA₀提供的奖励比SOTA奖励模型更具信息量；相同RL训练预算下在全部LIBERO任务套件取得最佳平均策略性能，成功率较初始策略提升5.4%–13.8%。真实世界操作中RLER将整体成功率提升20%–26%，分布外条件下提升35%–36%。
AI.conclusion: 无演示奖励学习与随策略演化自适应奖励均有效，为通用机器人策略的在线改进提供了不依赖专家数据的稠密奖励方案。

title: Observability-Informed Optimal Sensor Placement for Soft Robots
comment: Published in IEEE Robosoft 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
summary: This paper presents the application and experimental evaluation of a systematic method for optimal sensor placement in soft robots. Existing methods either lack generalizability across different soft robot morphologies or do not account for system dynamics. The applied method uses convex optimization to find the optimal sensor configuration that maximizes an observability Gramian-based metric. The framework is experimentally evaluated using position and strain measurements on a soft continuum arm. Kalman filter state estimates using optimal sensor placements yield lower reconstruction error than a baseline across all sinusoidal input trials, with improvements on the order of millimeters. This case study shows that linear control theory tools can guide optimal sensor placement in soft robots, suggesting an interpretable approach to sensor placement that may extend to other morphologies.

AI.tldr: 将凸优化与可观测性Gramian指标用于软体机器人最优传感器布置，并在软体连续臂上以位置和应变测量做实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有软体机器人传感器布置方法要么缺乏跨形态泛化能力，要么未考虑系统动力学，因此需要一种兼具通用性与动力学感知的最优布置方法。
AI.method: 采用凸优化搜索使基于可观测性Gramian的指标最大化的传感器配置；在软体连续臂上采集位置与应变测量，用卡尔曼滤波进行状态估计并对比基线布置。
AI.result: 在所有正弦输入试验中，最优传感器布置下的卡尔曼滤波状态估计重建误差均低于基线，提升幅度在毫米量级。
AI.conclusion: 线性控制理论工具可指导软体机器人的传感器布置，该可解释方法有望推广到其他形态的软体机器人。

title: MomWorld: Momentum-Aware Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-horizon planning enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate scene evolution and potential risks, supporting safe and stable decisions in complex interactions. However, existing methods struggle to propagate motion trends from observed history into the future. Long rollouts based on a single latent state may further attenuate useful dynamics, retain stale motion patterns, and disrupt reliable near-term plans. We introduce MomWorld, a momentum-aware latent world model for long-horizon planning. MomWorld extracts scene motion trends from historical-to-current observations and propagates latent momentum into future horizons, jointly predicting future configuration and momentum states. A learnable momentum persistence mechanism preserves stable trends, scene-conditioned momentum updates adapt future dynamics, and a scene-adaptive reset gate suppresses stale momentum under abrupt changes. We further propose MoFlow, a momentum-conditioned flow-matching module that refines a base trajectory to align with the predicted future scene evolution in only a few integration steps, with a horizon-aware residual fusion that preserves near-term planning stability while permitting stronger long-range corrections. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM, nuScenes and Bench2Drive demonstrate that MomWorld improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 12.2% relative to MomAD over a 6-second planning horizon.

AI.tldr: MomWorld：动量感知的潜在世界模型用于自动驾驶长时域规划，通过传播潜在动量并结合动量条件流匹配（MoFlow）精化轨迹，6秒规划时域上碰撞率较MomAD降低12.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有长时域规划方法难以将观测历史中的运动趋势传播到未来；基于单一潜在状态的长回滚会衰减有用动力学、保留过时运动模式并破坏可靠的近期规划。
AI.method: MomWorld从历史到当前观测中提取场景运动趋势，将潜在动量传播至未来时域，联合预测未来构型与动量状态；包含可学习动量持续性机制、场景条件动量更新和场景自适应重置门。并提出MoFlow——动量条件流匹配模块，以少量积分步将基础轨迹精化至与预测场景演化对齐，并使用时域感知残差融合保持近期稳定性、允许更强远程修正。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM、nuScenes和Bench2Drive上实验表明，MomWorld提升了长时域规划一致性，在6秒规划时域上相较MomAD平均碰撞率降低12.2%。
AI.conclusion: 动量感知的潜在世界模型加动量条件流匹配轨迹精化，可有效缓解长时域规划中的动力学衰减与过时模式问题，为自动驾驶复杂交互下的安全稳定决策提供可行方案。

title: AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple predictive visual modeling with action generation, typically relying on iterative denoising with a fixed denoising steps. However, manipulation tasks contain actions chunks with varying sensitivity to generation errors: critical actions require precision, while less sensitive actions allow faster generation with fewer denoising steps. Here we introduce AnyStep World Action Model, a general framework for tunable-budget prediction and scene-dependent computation allocation. Our budget-aligned teacher-trajectory distillation trains interval-conditioned flow maps using explicit frozen-teacher transitions and shared low-rank adapters, supporting action generation from one-step prediction to multi-step refinement. Building on this capability, a lightweight risk-benefit scheduler predicts teacher-curvature-based difficulty and budget-specific student-teacher fidelity from a single one-step preview, selecting the smallest budget predicted to satisfy risk-adaptive fidelity requirements. We evaluate our framework on three widely used WAMs Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA using RoboTwin 2.0. Our method reduces average denoising steps by 60.2%, 49.8%, and 85.28%, respectively, while maintaining baseline task success rates. In particular, our AnyStep training substantially improves model performance under a one-step denoising budget, increasing task success rates by 7.07%, 12.08%, and 8.94% on Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA, respectively. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks further validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnyStep World Action Model（WAM）框架，通过预算对齐的教师轨迹蒸馏与共享低秩适配器实现从单步到多步的区间条件化流图生成，并用轻量风险-收益调度器自适应分配去噪预算，在三个WAM基线和六个真实机器人任务上大幅减少去噪步数并保持/提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 world-action model 依赖固定去噪步数的迭代生成，而动作块对生成误差的敏感度不均：关键动作需高精度，冗余动作可少步快速生成，固定步数导致计算浪费或精度不足。
AI.method: 1) 预算对齐的教师轨迹蒸馏：利用冻结教师模型的显式转移与共享低秩适配器，训练区间条件化 flow map，支持一步预测到多步精炼；2) 轻量风险-收益调度器：从单步预览中预测基于教师曲率的难度与各预算下的学生-教师保真度，选择满足风险自适应保真要求的最小预算。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上于 Motus、FastWAM、LingBotVA 三个基线上平均去噪步数分别减少 60.2%、49.8%、85.28%，同时保持基线成功率；单步去噪预算下成功率分别提升 7.07%、12.08%、8.94%；六个真实机器人操作任务进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 可调预算的 world-action model 训练与推理调度能显著降低推理成本、增强极端少步性能，且具备真实机器人任务有效性，具有较强实用与部署价值。

title: Principal Steering Subspaces for Online Adaptation of Frozen Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative robot policies provide expressive behavior priors, but updating a large diffusion or flow-matching model through online interaction is costly. Latent-space reinforcement learning avoids updating the pretrained generator by controlling its initial sampling noise, yet high-dimensional noise can have strongly anisotropic effects on decoded actions. We introduce Principal Steering Subspaces (PSS), a forward-query interface that constructs a fixed low-dimensional control basis from finite-difference decoder responses. Soft Actor-Critic controls the leading response directions, while the orthogonal complement is independently resampled from the Gaussian prior at each query. On three RoboMimic tasks with diffusion and flow-matching policies, response spectra reveal substantial concentration. Across five matched task-generator pairs, the training curves indicate that PSS generally converges faster and exhibits more stable late-training behavior than full-latent control, while achieving stronger final performance overall. Controlled Diffusion-Square ablations further show that leading-response directions outperform random and least-responsive subspaces of equal dimension. We further integrate PSS with a frozen, closed-source 3B-parameter vision-language-action (VLA) policy in a humanoid learning system with synchronous transition collection, reset-time optimization, and latency-aware asynchronous deployment. In an exploratory screwdriver-placement evaluation, success is observed in 2/10 trials for the frozen VLA policy and 6/10 after SAC+PSS adaptation. These results support decoder-response geometry as a practical basis for online adaptation of frozen generative robot policies.

AI.tldr: PSS 提出一种前向查询接口，从解码器有限差分响应中构造固定低维控制基，SAC 仅控制主响应方向、正交补从高斯先验重采样，实现冻结生成式机器人策略的在线自适应。
AI.motivation: 大规模扩散/流匹配机器人策略提供强行为先验，但在线交互更新代价高；潜空间 RL 虽避免更新生成器，却在控制高维初始噪声时面临解码动作响应的强各向异性问题。
AI.method: 对冻结解码器做有限差分探测响应谱，选取响应最强的方向构成固定低维控制子空间，用 Soft Actor-Critic 学习其系数，正交补每步从高斯先验独立重采样；并与冻结的 3B VLA 策略集成到人形学习系统，含同步转移采集、复位时优化与延迟感知异步部署。
AI.result: 3 个 RoboMimic 任务、扩散与流匹配策略上响应谱高度集中；5 组匹配任务-生成器对中 PSS 收敛更快、后期更稳定且最终性能更强；Diffusion-Square 消融显示主响应方向优于等维随机与最弱响应子空间；冻结 VLA 下螺丝刀放置成功率为 2/10，SAC+PSS 后提升至 6/10。
AI.conclusion: 解码器响应几何可作为冻结生成式机器人策略在线自适应的实用控制基，为免微调的大规模策略适配提供可行路径。

title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 28 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Project website: this https URL
summary: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.

AI.tldr: 提出 CodeActionBench：25 项操作的 Code-as-Policy 基准，无微调/示教/特权状态，统一机器人 API 下评估通用多模态模型的视觉推理到操作代码的转化，9 种配置共 675 次尝试成功率为 2.7%–73.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM/多模态模型能否把视觉理解与推理直接转化为可执行的机器人操作代码尚不清楚；已有基准多依赖任务专用微调、示教、特权场景状态或专用抓取/感知模块，难以公平比较模型自身的"代码即策略"能力，因此需要一个受控、无特权的测试平台。
AI.method: 构建 CodeActionBench：25 个操作任务，采用 agentic Code-as-Policy 范式。不提供任务微调、示教、外部专用感知/抓取模块与特权状态；共享机器人 API 仅提供 RGB 观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈与受限运动。固定任务实例、资源预算与隐藏的物理结果验证器，实现跨模型与 harness 配置的可控对比；共 9 种配置、675 次尝试。
AI.result: 成功率为 2.7%–73.3%；最强配置 GPT-6 Astra + Codex CLI 在三次尝试内至少成功解决 25 个任务中的 22 个。轨迹分析表明主要失败模式为空间对齐、物体保持与完成度判断，甚至出现动作已成功完成但任务仍判失败的案例。
AI.conclusion: CodeActionBench 为衡量通用模型将自身能力转化为操作行为提供了受控测试平台，并揭示了典型失败场景，说明该能力虽已有进展但仍存在显著提升空间。

title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
summary: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $\pi_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 将世界-动作模型(WAM)生成的视觉预测视为目标条件下的视觉提案，用冻结的动作条件世界模型构建一致性反馈，并以Flow Policy Optimization优化WAM动作头，在4个真实UR5任务上把平均成功率从43.4%提升到75.1%。
AI.motivation: WAM能联合预测未来视觉观测与动作，但视觉预测与生成动作所隐含的后果之间存在不一致：模型常先给出视觉上合理的完成画面，却生成无法可靠实现该画面的动作。因此需要利用这种跨模型预测差异作为反馈来改进动作策略，同时避免在线机器人交互与专门奖励模型训练。
AI.method: 把WAM的视觉预测当作目标条件视觉提案而非可执行计划；用一个冻结的动作条件世界模型预测动作条件下的后果；基于两份未来预测之间的一致性以及与终端目标的对齐程度构造反馈；再用Flow Policy Optimization（FPO）仅优化WAM的动作头。
AI.result: 在4个真实世界UR5操作任务上，平均成功率由43.4%提升至75.1%，对比π0.5的61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型预测差异可作为无需在线交互、无需任务奖励模型的有效反馈信号，用于改进机器人策略；在评测的操作任务中验证了其有效性。

title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
summary: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

AI.tldr: DeltaSeek 提出面向动态建筑环境的主动感知框架，形式化"具身可容许观测集"，并用 Husky A300+UR5e 在 IFC 基准上对比底盘相机与腕部相机的可观测性与采集代价。
AI.motivation: 建筑环境持续演变带来大幅几何变化，使静态建图与配准性能下降，因此需要主动感知：机器人需主动选择传感配置以解析环境当前状态。论文定位为该系统的前置问题——机器人具身形态如何限制其可获得的观测。
AI.method: 形式化具身的"可容许观测集"（permissible observation set）；在 IFC 导出的基准场景下，使用 Husky A300 底盘搭载 UR5e 机械臂，比较底盘安装与腕部安装两种 RGB-D 配置；以几何可见性对观测打分，以可行驶距离衡量代价；在含 8 处受控变化、4 种可观测性条件的房间级场景中，对 240 个可容许基座位姿与 5 种臂姿做穷举评估。
AI.result: 8 处变化中有 2 处不存在任何底盘视角可观测，而腕部相机两者均可解；对两者均可观测的变化，底盘相机中位行驶距离 6.0 m，底盘安装相机为 15.2 m（原文 6.0 ~m 为腕部、15.2 ~m 为底盘）。结果将"感知局限"与"采集代价"区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"观测是否不可能"与"是否只是需要更多移动"区分开，为具身约束下的主动感知提供形式化与实证基础，属于面向演化建筑环境中主动感知的初步框架。

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: Robot-GST 构建基于 3DGS 与 SAM3D 的 Gaussian-SAM 真实到仿真环境，结合时空推理与最终状态估计，在真实执行前对候选动作序列进行仿真评估与筛选，提升长程操作部署可靠性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型驱动的操作策略缺乏显式的任务结果预测与动作可行性评估机制，长程任务中误差逐步累积导致真实部署可靠性不足。
AI.method: 1) 用 RGB-D 观测经 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 重建高保真机器人环境，形成 Gaussian-SAM 真实到仿真平台；2) 融合视觉观测与语言指令，用大视觉语言模型进行时空推理与长程任务规划；3) 引入几何采样驱动的 Gaussian-aware 最终状态估计与基于状态的轨迹规划；4) 执行前在 Gaussian-SAM 环境中仿真候选动作序列，过滤不可行行为。
AI.result: 在刚性、软体与可变形物体任务（方块放置、玩具装箱、鸭子重排）上验证，几何感知时空推理与状态感知执行提升了跨物体类别的操作可靠性；作者主张几何重建+高质量渲染与仿真为操作行为评估提供可扩展途径。
AI.conclusion: 将几何感知重建与高质量渲染仿真结合，可实现"先仿真评估后执行"的操作范式，为真实世界操作部署的可靠性评估提供可扩展方案；当前以自建任务集验证，尚缺量化指标、基线对比与公开代码细节。

title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Glove-based motion capture is emerging as a scalable approach to collecting dexterous-hand demonstration data. However, due to the kinematic gap between the human and robot hand, the recorded human motions cannot be executed directly on the robot, especially for contact-rich tool-use tasks involving in-hand reorientation. Prior work bridges this gap in simulation through reinforcement learning (RL) or trajectory optimization, but the human contact pattern is hard to preserve under such formulations, often producing unnatural manipulation and unstable functional grasps. These methods also train a separate policy or solve a separate optimization for each reference trajectory, which is inefficient. To solve these problems, we propose DexTaG, a tactile-guided RL framework for dexterous manipulation. During training, tactile signals captured by the glove guide policy search toward the measured human contact pattern, reducing reliance on precise reference geometry for contact supervision. To improve efficiency, we train a single generalizable retargeter jointly on all training trajectories of the same object. The retargeter is further distilled into a tactile-free student controller conditioned on the target object trajectory for real-world deployment. On marker-pen and hammer manipulation tasks, DexTaG learns natural, contact-rich behaviors that baselines with distance-based contact heuristics fail to learn, generalizes to held-out trajectories of the same object and task, and outperforms single-trajectory baselines on OakInk2.

AI.tldr: DexTaG：用触觉信号引导强化学习，将手套采集的人类手部示教重定向到机器人手，训练单一可泛化重定向器并蒸馏为无触觉学生控制器，实现接触丰富工具使用任务。
AI.motivation: 手套式动作捕捉可规模化采集灵巧手示教数据，但人手与机器人手存在运动学差异，录得的人手动作无法直接迁移到机器人，尤其在手内旋转等接触丰富任务中。已有工作用RL或轨迹优化在仿真中弥合差异，但难以保留人类接触模式，易产生不自然操作与不稳定的功能抓取；且每条参考轨迹需单独训练策略或求解优化，效率低。
AI.method: 提出 DexTaG 触觉引导的强化学习框架：训练时用手套采集的触觉信号引导策略搜索，逼近实测人类接触模式，从而降低对精确参考几何的依赖；同一物体的所有训练轨迹联合训练一个通用重定向器以提升效率；再将该重定向器蒸馏为以目标物体轨迹为条件的无触觉学生控制器，用于真机部署。
AI.result: 在马克笔与锤子操作任务上，DexTaG 学到自然、接触丰富的行为，而基于距离接触启发式的基线无法学到；对同一物体与任务的留出轨迹具有泛化性；在 OakInk2 上优于单轨迹基线。
AI.conclusion: 触觉信号可作为接触模式的监督替代精确几何参考，联合且可泛化的重定向器加蒸馏学生策略为手套示教到机器人手的迁移提供了高效、可部署的实用路径。

title: LatentReRig: An SDF-Based VAE with Dual Decoders for Latent-Space Deformation Conditioning
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, extracted from final dissertation
summary: Transferring deformation between characters with different geometry and topology is challenging because conventional rigs encode behaviour through character-specific structures and correspondences. We present LatentReRig, an experimental framework that investigates whether pose-associated changes can instead be represented as reusable directions in a learned geometric latent space. An SDF-based variational autoencoder is coupled with two decoders: one reconstructs the implicit field, while the other predicts target vertex positions from source geometry and latent deformation conditioning. The source geometry may be neutral or already deformed. Experiments on a controlled humanoid dataset show that several poses induce coherent latent directions across identities, particularly for broad articulated motions. These signals can guide deformation of unseen characters, but explicit predictions remain less accurate for localized changes and corrective contributions. Diagnostic comparisons with repeated SDF sampling show that inter-identity distances exceed same-geometry resampling variability on average, while pose signals exhibit different margins above this baseline. The results support the presence of reusable pose-related structure and identify stable local conditioning and accurate mesh decoding as complementary requirements for improving transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentReRig 框架，探索是否可将姿态相关的形变表示为几何隐空间中的可复用方向，以实现跨身份角色的形变迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统绑定（rig）通过角色专属的结构与对应关系编码行为，导致几何与拓扑不同的角色之间形变迁移困难。作者试图验证姿态相关变化能否脱离角色专属结构、以隐空间方向的形式复用。
AI.method: 基于 SDF 的变分自编码器搭配两个解码器：一个重建隐式场，另一个从源几何与隐形变条件预测目标顶点位置；源几何可为中性或已形变状态。在受控人形数据集上进行实验，并与重复 SDF 采样构建的基线做诊断性对比。
AI.result: 多种姿态在不同身份间诱导出连贯的隐方向，尤其对大幅关节运动有效，可引导未见角色的形变；但局部变化与修正项上的显式预测精度较低。跨身份距离平均超过同几何重采样波动，姿态信号相对该基线的余量各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存在可复用的姿态相关结构，并指出稳定局部条件化与精确网格解码是提升迁移效果的两项互补需求。

title: Where Does the Watermark Hide? Push-Pull Disentanglement for Invisible Watermark Removal
summary: Fixed image distortions do not cover an attacker that learns from paired clean and watermarked images. We study this paired-training threat with single-image inference: deployment uses neither the clean reference nor the watermark key, payload, or decoder. An encoder maps each image to a structural latent $g$ and an auxiliary residual latent $u$. Push supervision reconstructs the watermarked image from $D(g_w,u_w)$. Pull supervision trains the zero-auxiliary output $D(A_g(g_w;k),0)$ toward the paired clean image. At $k=1.10,u=0$, the four-method sweep gives an average BER of $0.3958$, PSNR of $31.07$ dB, and SSIM of $0.9554$. Restoring $u$ from $0$ to $0.15$ moves average BER from $0.3893$ to $0.3357$, while PSNR falls from $30.99$ to $28.23$ dB. The intervention supports decoder dependence on the auxiliary input in the evaluated setting. The accompanying theory is a conditional, post-hoc account of this behavior rather than an experimentally verified information-relocation result.

AI.tldr: 研究配对训练威胁下的单图水印提取/去除：编码器将图像映射为结构隐变量g与辅助残差隐变量u，用push/pull监督训练；在k=1.10,u=0时四方法平均BER为0.3958、PSNR 31.07dB、SSIM 0.9554，u从0增至0.15使BER由0.3893降至0.3357而PSNR由30.99降至28.23dB。
AI.motivation: 固定图像失真（fixed image distortions）类水印方法无法防御能从成对"干净-带水印"图像中学习的攻击者。作者希望刻画这种"配对训练威胁"，且要求部署阶段具备单图推理能力：不依赖干净参考、水印密钥、载荷或解码器，从而更贴近真实攻击场景。
AI.method: 提出隐空间解耦的编解码框架：编码器把每张图像映射为结构隐变量g与辅助残差隐变量u；push监督由D(g_w,u_w)重建带水印图像，pull监督则令零辅助输出D(A_g(g_w;k),0)靠近配对的干净图像。在k=1.10、u=0条件下进行四方法扫描，并额外将u由0逐步恢复到0.15，观察BER与PSNR的变化以检验解码器对辅助输入的依赖。
AI.result: k=1.10、u=0时四方法平均BER 0.3958、PSNR 31.07 dB、SSIM 0.9554；将u由0恢复至0.15后，平均BER从0.3893降至0.3357，同时PSNR由30.99降至28.23 dB。该干预结果支持在所评估设置中解码器确实依赖辅助输入。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了配对训练威胁下单图推理水印攻击的行为刻画，但随附理论只是对该现象的"条件性、事后"解释，而非经实验验证的信息迁移结论；BER仍偏高，说明该攻击在该设置下尚未形成实用、稳定的水印移除能力。

title: Frequency-Domain AI-Generated Image Detection: Exploring Decoder and Channel Attention for Feature Refinement
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Optics, Machine Learning and Emerging Technology (OMLET)
summary: With the rapid progress of AI, the number of AI-generated images has increased significantly in recent years. However, the increasing variety of image generation models makes detection more difficult. In this work, we use Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) representation with EfficientNet-B0 for AI-generated image detection. EfficientNet-B0 provides a lightweight architecture that can be useful for resource-limited applications. Most frequency-domain detectors use a standard encoder to extract features from the FFT spectrum and directly pass them to a classifier. We explored a different approach by investigating ECA, U-Net, and Attention U-Net as alternatives to this direct encoder-to-classifier approach. ECA applies channel attention, while U-Net and Attention U-Net use decoder-based architectures to recover and refine spatial information in the extracted frequency features. We used a balanced subset of the MS COCOAI dataset that includes AI-generated images from five different models. Three runs were carried out for each experiment, and the average values were recorded. Experimental results indicate that EfficientNet-B0 obtained an accuracy of 84.64%, which is 4.50 percentage points higher than the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper. EfficientNet-B0 with U-Net provided a small improvement, achieving an accuracy of 84.85%, while ECA did not increase the overall performance. EfficientNet-B0 with Attention U-Net achieved the best overall performance, with an accuracy of 85.51% and an ROC-AUC of 92.99%. This represents an improvement of 0.87 percentage points in accuracy compared to the EfficientNet-B0 baseline and 5.37 percentage points over the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper.

AI.tldr: 该论文将FFT频谱表示与轻量级EfficientNet-B0结合用于AI生成图像检测，并探索用ECA、U-Net、Attention U-Net替代"编码器直接接分类器"的范式，在MS COCOAI平衡子集上取得85.51%准确率与92.99% ROC-AUC。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像数量激增，且生成模型种类日益多样，使检测难度上升；同时多数频域检测器仅用标准编码器提取FFT特征后直接送入分类器，未充分利用频域中的空间结构信息，且缺少面向资源受限场景的轻量方案。
AI.method: 以FFT频谱作为输入表示，主干采用轻量级EfficientNet-B0；对比三种替代"编码器—分类器直连"的结构：ECA（通道注意力）、U-Net与Attention U-Net（基于解码器结构恢复并细化频域特征中的空间信息）。数据采用MS COCOAI数据集的均衡子集，涵盖5种生成模型；每个实验重复3次取平均值。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B0基线准确率84.64%，比数据集论文报告的ResNet-50基线高4.50个百分点；加U-Net小幅提升至84.85%；加ECA无整体提升；Attention U-Net最优，准确率85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%，较EfficientNet-B0基线提升0.87个百分点，较ResNet-50基线提升5.37个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在频域AI生成图像检测中，轻量级EfficientNet-B0即可显著优于ResNet-50基线，而解码器式结构（尤其Attention U-Net）能进一步细化频域特征带来增益，通道注意力ECA则无明显作用；该方法适合资源受限应用。

title: SWT: Self-Supervised Video Object Segmentation via Sliding, Wavelet and Transportation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) aims to accurately segment target objects from consecutive video frames and track the changes of the objects in each frame of the video. Conventional VOS methods typically demand substantial quantities of pixel-level labeled video sequences for fully supervised learning, which limits the performance of the model in sparse video scenes, while existing VOS methods have limited adaptability to global changes in objects. Based on this observation, in this paper, we propose self-supervised VOS with Sliding window, Wavelet transform and optimal Transport (SWT), a self-supervised VOS framework entirely trained on static dataset using contrastive learning. Firstly, a rolling sample buffer reuses overlapping groups of independently sampled images across successive updates. Secondly, to address the long-distance modeling difficulty caused by simple convolutional structures, we introduce wavelet transform to expand the receptive field of convolutional kernels, thus improving the model's representational capability. Finally, we incorporate optimal transport to assist the model in finding the globally optimal match between the target across two frames, improving the model's ability to handle nonrigid deformations of objects. SWT only requires training on the COCO dataset once and achieves excellent results on five VOS datasets as well as an additional body part propagation dataset. The code will be released soon at [ this https URL ]( this https URL ).

AI.tldr: 提出自监督视频目标分割框架SWT，结合滑动窗口采样缓冲、小波变换扩大感受野与最优传输全局匹配，仅在COCO静态图像上训练一次即在5个VOS数据集及一个身体部位传播数据集上取得优异结果。
AI.motivation: 现有VOS方法依赖大量像素级标注的视频序列进行全监督学习，在稀疏视频场景中性能受限；同时已有方法对目标的全局形变适应能力不足。因此希望仅用静态图像、以自监督对比学习方式完成VOS训练，并提升长距离建模与非刚性形变匹配能力。
AI.method: 自监督VOS框架SWT，完全基于静态数据集、以对比学习训练。三点设计：（1）滚动采样缓冲（rolling sample buffer），在连续更新中复用独立采样图像的重叠分组；（2）引入小波变换扩展卷积核感受野，缓解简单卷积结构的长距离建模困难，增强表征能力；（3）引入最优传输，帮助模型在两帧之间寻找目标的全局最优匹配，提升对非刚性形变的处理能力。
AI.result: 仅在COCO数据集上训练一次，即在五个VOS数据集以及一个额外的身体部位传播（body part propagation）数据集上取得优异结果；代码承诺开源。
AI.conclusion: 以静态图像自监督对比学习替代视频全监督，配合滑动窗口采样、小波变换与最优传输，可有效提升VOS的长距离建模与全局形变适应能力，并具备跨数据集泛化性。

title: High-Capacity Robust Medical Image Exfiltration via Neural Network Weight Replacement
summary: Collaborative medical AI platforms allow researchers to train models on sensitive imaging data while restricting data export. However, trained models can serve as covert carriers of patient information: medical images may be encoded within model parameters and reconstructed outside the secure environment. Existing defenses rely on lightweight sanitization (e.g., fine-tuning, pruning, quantization) and limited statistical auditing, creating a realistic insider exfiltration risk. We introduce a high-capacity neural steganography attack that encodes medical images as continuous latent representations embedded into model initialization. A StyleGAN2-based adversarial autoencoder learns compact latent codes regularized to match standard weight initialization statistics, keeping embedded parameters statistically consistent with clean models. Noise injection during training improves robustness to export-time mitigation. The carrier model remains functional on its intended task and hidden images can be reconstructed directly from its weights after export. This continuous encoding enables robust and scalable exfiltration, allowing up to 99 brain MRI volumes to be embedded within a 30MB model, and remains recoverable under mitigations that disrupt prior bit-level schemes. While reconstructions are approximate rather than pixel-exact, embedded content remains anatomically recognizable and recoverable at scale, exposing a privacy risk distinct from prior bit-level approaches. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, BraTS, and LiTS demonstrate effectiveness across modalities, tasks, and architectures, highlighting the need for structural defenses beyond parameter-level sanitization. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出一种高容量神经隐写攻击：用StyleGAN2对抗自编码器将医学图像编码为连续隐变量并嵌入模型初始化权重，使载体模型保持任务性能，导出后可从权重中重建医学图像，单模型可嵌入约99个脑MRI体积，且能抵抗微调、剪枝、量化等防护。
AI.motivation: 协作式医学AI平台限制数据导出，但训练好的模型参数本身可充当患者信息的隐蔽载体。现有防护依赖轻量级净化（微调、剪枝、量化）与有限统计审计，存在现实的内部人员数据外泄风险，因此需要研究更高容量的隐写攻击以暴露该漏洞。
AI.method: 将医学图像编码为连续隐表示，嵌入模型初始化参数。使用StyleGAN2-based对抗自编码器学习紧凑隐码，并通过正则化使嵌入参数与标准权重初始化统计分布一致；训练时注入噪声以提升对导出后净化处理的鲁棒性。载体模型仍能完成原有任务，隐藏图像在模型导出后可直接从权重重构。
AI.result: 在30MB模型中最多可嵌入99个脑MRI体积；在MIMIC-CXR、BraTS、LiTS上跨模态、任务与架构均有效；重构虽为近似而非像素级精确，但解剖结构可辨识且可规模化恢复；对会破坏此前比特级方案的净化手段仍具可恢复性。
AI.conclusion: 该连续编码方案实现了鲁棒且可扩展的模型权重隐写外泄，暴露了区别于比特级方法的隐私风险，说明仅靠参数级净化不足，需要结构性防御。

title: GERIS: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Filtering Instance-Dependent Label Noise in License Plate Data Augmentation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. To appear in AUT Journal of Mathematics and Computing (AUT J Math Comput)
summary: In this paper, we propose GERIS, a game-theoretic framework for instance selection in the data augmentation phase of license plate recognition systems. During augmentation, synthetic license plate images are generated and transformed using stochastic noise to simulate real-world conditions. However, certain noise configurations lead to highly distorted, unreadable images that degrade model performance by introducing instance-dependent label noise. GERIS formulates a non-cooperative game in which each noise vector competes for inclusion in the training set based on its similarity to labeled data and its contribution to model reliability. By identifying and pruning low-quality instances, GERIS improves the overall quality of the augmented dataset. Unlike traditional black-box learning methods, GERIS offers a transparent, theoretically grounded mechanism for data filtering. Experimental results demonstrate that GERIS outperforms existing instance selection methods in terms of classification accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: GERIS：将数据增强中的实例选择建模为非合作博弈，每个噪声向量以与标注数据的相似性和对模型可靠性的贡献竞争进入训练集，从而剪除低质合成车牌图像，提升数据集质量与识别精度。
AI.motivation: 车牌识别系统在增强阶段用随机噪声模拟真实条件，但部分噪声配置产生高度畸变、不可读的图像，导致实例相关的标签噪声，反而损害模型性能。传统黑盒学习方法缺乏透明、可解释的数据过滤机制。
AI.method: 提出 GERIS 博弈论框架：在非合作博弈中，每个噪声向量作为参与者，依据其与标注数据的相似度及对模型可靠性的贡献竞争被纳入训练集；通过求解博弈识别并剪除低质量实例，实现可解释、有理论支撑的数据筛选，替代传统黑盒过滤。
AI.result: 实验表明 GERIS 在分类准确率与鲁棒性上均优于现有实例选择方法。
AI.conclusion: GERIS 为数据增强阶段的实例选择提供了一种透明、理论可解释的博弈论机制，能有效抑制实例相关标签噪声、提升增强数据集质量，但其验证局限于车牌识别这一特定领域。

title: When Retrieval Hurts: Measuring and Explaining Retrieval-Induced Hallucination in Chest X-ray Report Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is an attractive way to improve chest X-ray reporting, because reports from similar prior studies supply clinical context a general vision-language model lacks. We show the same mechanism is a reliable source of clinical error. Over 100 MIMIC-CXR studies with a frozen LLaVA-1.5 generator and BioMedCLIP retrieval, CheXbert clinical F1 doubles under relevant retrieval (0.201 to 0.402) and collapses to 0.043 under clinically mismatched retrieval, a fifth of the image-only score; the retrieval-induced hallucination rate, counting only unsupported findings traceable to retrieved evidence, rises from 0.00 to 0.76 and 0.98. To show this is not an artefact of evidence-set coverage, we introduce a coincidental-overlap control that scores image-only generations against evidence they never saw, placing the chance base rate at 0.18, four to five times below the observed rates. The generator does not merely acquire findings, it transcribes text: 95% of reports produced under relevant retrieval contain an eight-word span occurring verbatim in the retrieved evidence but absent from the reference, against 0% without retrieval. We then explain the mechanism: a normal chest X-ray retrieves at least one abnormal precedent in 24 of 28 cases, because medical image-embedding similarity is dominated by anatomy and acquisition rather than by the presence of disease. This has a direct design consequence. Retrieval similarity does not predict harm (RIH rates 0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84 across similarity quartiles), so relevance gates conditioned on embedding similarity cannot work; gating on predicted pathology agreement removes 61% of unsupported evidence at no cost to useful coverage. We argue that retrieval-augmented clinical systems must be evaluated under retrieval failure, not only under retrieval success.

AI.tldr: 在MIMIC-CXR上揭示RAG会引入可溯源的检索诱导幻觉（RIH 0.00→0.76/0.98），并证明基于嵌入相似度的相关性门控无效，应改用预测病理一致性门控。
AI.motivation: 检索增强被视为改善胸片报告生成的有效手段，因其能提供通用视觉语言模型缺乏的临床上下文。但作者希望检验同一机制是否也会成为临床错误的可靠来源，并探究其失效机理与设计后果。
AI.method: 固定LLaVA-1.5生成器与BioMedCLIP检索，在100+例MIMIC-CXR上对比相关检索、临床错配检索与无检索设置；定义"检索诱导幻觉率"（RIH，仅计可溯源至检索证据的无依据发现）；引入巧合重叠对照（coincidental-overlap control）以图像生成结果对未见证据打分，估计随机基线；统计逐字复制跨度（8词片段）；用嵌入相似度四分位与预测病理一致性分别做门控消融。
AI.result: CheXbert临床F1在相关检索下翻倍（0.201→0.402），错配检索下崩塌至0.043（仅图像得分的1/5）；RIH由0.00升至0.76和0.98，而巧合重叠随机基线仅0.18。相关检索下95%报告含检索证据中出现但参考报告中不存在的8词逐字跨度（无检索为0%）。28例正常胸片中24例至少检索到1例异常先例，说明嵌入相似度由解剖与采集主导而非疾病。相似度四分位间RIH为0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84，无预测力；按预测病理一致性门控可剔除61%无支持证据且不损失有效覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 检索相似度不能预测危害，基于嵌入相似度的相关性门控不可行；检索增强临床系统必须在检索失败（而非仅成功）条件下接受评估，并采用病理一致性等语义门控。

title: Measuring the evolution of camera distance across a century of film
summary: The rise of computer vision and artificial intelligence has made possible new forms of large-scale computational measurement. We apply these techniques to a deep collection of 5,205 digitized films viewed in theaters between 1922-2025 (covering popular, prestigious, and independent movies) to trace the development of one of the most fundamental ways through which film communicates: by manipulating the space between the camera and its subject. This work finds abrupt changes with the rise of new technologies in sound and television, and allows us to shed an empirical light on gender disparity (women, despite having substantially less screentime than men, are disproportionately the subject of closer shots), and illustrate how animated films both inherit and break free from the norms of live-action filmmaking.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用计算机视觉方法分析5,205部1922-2025年的电影，量化研究"摄影机与主体之间距离"（镜头景别）的百年演变，揭示声音与电视技术引发的突变、性别差异以及动画与实拍电影的规范差异。
AI.motivation: 电影通过操纵摄影机与拍摄主体之间的空间来传达信息，这是最基础的视觉语言手段之一，但缺乏大规模、跨时代的定量实证研究。作者希望借助计算视觉与AI技术，对这一长期被视为定性/人文学科的问题提供经验性证据。
AI.method: 构建包含1922-2025年间在影院上映的5,205部数字化电影（涵盖大众、获奖与独立影片）的数据集；采用计算机视觉技术（如人脸/人体检测、景别估计等）自动测量镜头景别，进而进行跨年代的纵向统计分析、性别差异分析与动画vs实拍对比。
AI.result: 发现景别随声音技术与电视兴起出现突变；揭示性别差异——女性尽管总银幕时间明显少于男性，却不成比例地更多成为近景/特写镜头的主体；并刻画了动画电影如何既继承又突破实拍电影的拍摄规范。
AI.conclusion: 大规模计算测量可将传统上属于电影研究/人文学科的问题转化为可验证的实证问题，为电影视觉语言的演变、性别表征和技术冲击提供量化洞见。

title: LukeNet: A lightweight CNN integrated with an XAI model for Smart acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection and management
summary: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级CNN架构LukeNet，集成可解释AI，用于IoMT边缘设备上的急性淋巴细胞白血病(ALL)检测与分类，在3个数据集上实现99%准确率并优于6种SOTA CNN及集成模型。
AI.motivation: ALL需早期准确检测以支持及时治疗，但现有CNN检测系统多为理论研究，计算需求高，难以部署在计算、内存、延迟受限的IoMT边缘设备上，因此需要兼顾精度与效率的轻量级模型。
AI.method: 提出LukeNet轻量级CNN，采用depthwise separable卷积平衡模型深度与计算效率，缓解深层梯度消失问题，增强全局与局部特征提取；集成可解释AI(XAI)方法高亮显微图像中的相关区域；在3个ALL数据集上以五折交叉验证训练，并与6种SOTA CNN(DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16)、迁移学习模型及2个集成模型对比。
AI.result: 模型准确率99%，未见测试集准确率99%，优于所列6种SOTA CNN、迁移学习模型和2个集成模型；XAI方法可突出医学图像中的关键区域。
AI.conclusion: LukeNet为IoMT环境下ALL检测提供了一种兼顾精度与计算效率的轻量级可解释方案，但其为医学影像领域CV工作，缺乏物理AI/机器人等核心方向的方法洞见。

title: Seeing the Heat: Synthesizing High-Resolution Wood Thermal Responses from Optical Imagery
summary: The thermal behavior of wood is a critical factor in advanced material assembly. However, pixel-level thermal analysis remains fundamentally constrained by the low resolution and noise inherent to infrared thermography. To address this, we introduce an end-to-end computational framework that synthesizes high-resolution thermal responses directly from wood RGB images. We first establish a core physical linkage: because spatial color variation in natural wood is driven by cellular anatomy, optical intensity serves as a reliable geometric proxy for the localized solid volume fraction. By leveraging this theoretical insight, we develop an automated finite-element-method data engine that maps pixel-level optical intensity to a 3D thermodynamic voxel grid, generating high-fidelity synthetic thermal responses. We find that 1) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is uniform or linear, wood RGB images and their corresponding thermal responses exhibit extreme morphological similarities, and the lateral thermal diffusion acts as a low-pass filter that smooths out high-frequency details; 2) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is random, such morphological similarities are destroyed, and wood's 3D structure dominantly governs its thermal response. We further utilize these synthetic thermal responses to supervise a neural surrogate model built upon the DINOv3 foundation model. Our results demonstrate that the neural surrogate model successfully internalizes the governing thermodynamic laws, thereby bypassing computationally expensive simulations and enabling high-resolution thermal inference. This methodology effectively bridges the semantic and thermodynamic domains, unlocking systematic, pixel-level analysis of fine-grained wood thermal responses. Project: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该工作提出端到端计算框架，利用木材RGB图像中的光学强度作为局部固体体积分数的几何代理，通过自动有限元数据引擎合成高分辨率热响应，并以此监督基于DINOv3的神经代理模型，实现像素级热推断。
AI.motivation: 红外热成像存在分辨率低、噪声大的固有限制，难以进行像素级热分析；木材热行为对先进材料组装至关重要，因此需要一种从可见光图像直接推断高分辨率热响应的方法。
AI.method: 1) 建立物理关联：木材空间颜色变化由细胞解剖结构驱动，光学强度可作局部固体体积分数的几何代理；2) 构建自动化有限元数据引擎，将像素级光学强度映射为3D热力学体素网格，生成高保真合成热响应；3) 以合成热响应监督基于DINOv3基础模型的神经代理模型。
AI.result: 发现两类规律：当厚度方向热导率均匀或线性时，木材RGB图像与热响应呈现极高形态相似性，横向热扩散表现为低通滤波、平滑高频细节；当厚度方向热导率随机时，该形态相似性被破坏，3D结构主导热响应。神经代理模型成功内化热力学定律，绕过昂贵仿真实现高分辨率热推断。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在语义域与热力学域之间架起桥梁，实现木材细粒度热响应的系统化像素级分析，为从RGB图像推断物理热响应提供了可行范式。

title: Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation
comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

AI.tldr: 提出面向CCTA冠状动脉分割的表面度量与可微表面损失，通过二分匹配与血管半径容差解耦假阳（伪分支）与假阴（漏分支），揭示Dice训练模型的漏检多于虚构的不对称性，并在nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三个骨干与Image-CAS、ASOCA两个基准上微调，显著提升表面F1且Dice相当。
AI.motivation: 冠脉为细长管状结构，体积重叠指标Dice对远端分支缺失不敏感：多数体素属于少数粗近端段，漏掉远端分支对Dice几乎无影响，却严重破坏临床所需的连通性。Dice还是对称指标，无法区分伪分支（假阳）与漏分支（假阴）。因此需要从体积度量转向表面度量与优化。
AI.method: 1) 表面度量：将预测与参考表面点做二分图匹配，在局部化、依赖血管半径的容差下匹配，输出precision/recall/F1，并把假阳与假阴解耦。2) 基于该度量设计可微表面损失，同时抑制虚假体量并回收缺失结构。3) 在三个骨干（nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU）上，于Image-CAS与ASOCA两个公开基准上用等epoch对照进行微调验证。
AI.result: 强Dice基线在表面层面漏掉的血管表面远多于其虚构的表面，此不对称性被高Dice掩盖；与等epoch对照相比，所提表面损失在Dice相当的情况下显著提升表面F1，主要收益来自恢复漏检的远端血管。
AI.conclusion: 对于细管状血管解剖，应度量并优化血管表面而非其重叠体积；解耦假阳/假阴的表面指标能暴露Dice掩盖的结构性缺陷，可微表面损失可作为即插即用的微调目标提升连通性。

title: PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
summary: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms. The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出 PEEL-DDPM：在冻结的测量条件 DDPM 反演轨迹上，用最终图像证据网络只学习可辨识的 Student-t 坐标，并以扫描噪声与采样器重复实现的嵌套蒙特卡洛估计噪声方差，从而消解 NIG 回归的不辨识性，实现可辨识、可物理解释的预测不确定性分解。
AI.motivation: NIG 回归相对于其边际 Student-t 似然不可辨识：四个参数仅有三个组合被确定，剩余一个自由度无法由似然本身约束。现有证据学习方法通常通过交叉损失权重或启发式正则来填补该自由度，缺少物理含义明确的辨识手段。本文希望借助成像物理中已知的噪声生成机制来提供该缺失约束。
AI.method: 两阶段顺序训练、无跨损失权重系数。第一阶段以 epsilon-MSE 训练测量条件 DDPM 后冻结；其完整反向轨迹给出重建，重建与已知训练对象的残差送入最终图像证据网络。该网络仅拟合可辨识的 Student-t 坐标；通过重复的扫描仪噪声实现与重复扩散轨迹做嵌套蒙特卡洛，估计最终图像 aleatoric 方差并分解为扫描仪诱导与采样器诱导两部分，用该实测方差补足 NIG 的剩余自由度，并将预测不确定性拆为测量、扩散、认知三项。
AI.result: 在 8 个留出对象上的可行性研究中，名义 50%/80%/90%/95% 中心区间的经验覆盖率分别为 49.3%/80.3%/90.1%/95.6%；平均平方残差为平均预测方差的 0.967 倍；单图像 aleatoric 头对独立嵌套参考的合并 Spearman 相关为 0.785。在五个剂量水平上，扫描仪诱导方差对剂量的 log-log 斜率为 -1.15，而采样器诱导方差近乎剂量无关，斜率为 -0.01。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 PEEL-DDPM 是扩散式图像重建中实现可辨识且具物理可解释性不确定性量化的可行路径：校准良好、方差标度贴近经验残差、两类噪声源在剂量行为上呈现符合物理预期的分离，且无需交叉损失加权。

title: VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models
summary: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"诊断驱动"的后训练方法：用教师VLM对学生VLM进行压力测试，挖掘人类先验之外的失效模式（如doom loop、对抗安全），转化为定向监督与偏好对齐，并结合两种视觉token策略，产出两个准确率-效率变体（NanoFull、FlashFull），在约0.5B参数规模下兼顾精度、时延与行为可靠性。
AI.motivation: 亚十亿参数VLM已可部署在端侧，但小体积并不等于可用：手机上首token延迟可超2分钟。端侧可用性取决于三轴——准确率、效率、行为可靠性，而标准基准缺少第三轴（回答过短无法暴露doom loop，提示过温和无法探测对抗安全）。
AI.method: 诊断驱动的后训练配方：教师VLM对学生的失败进行压力测试，发现超出人类先验的失效模式，并将其转化为针对性监督与偏好对齐（以失败驱动优化补充通用数据缩放）；另配两种视觉token策略，得到准确率优先与效率优先两个变体。
AI.result: NanoFull在17个基准上归一化平均62.3，为公开约0.5B模型中最高，同架构同token预算下较基座+7.4，doom-loop率不高于最强基线；FlashFull保持61.4，同时将Pixel 9上的warm time-to-first-token从138s降至6.1s（23×）。
AI.conclusion: 三轴联合优化可将紧凑VLM推向实用的端侧部署。

title: The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

AI.tldr: GazeEarth：无需训练的多模态大模型超高清遥感理解框架，用问题引导选择证据单元，再以拓扑保持的注视式（foveated）全场景重采样在固定像素预算内放大重点区域并压缩边缘，仅需≤2次MLLM调用，在3个UHR遥感基准、4个冻结骨干上平均提升4.6–9.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: MLLM在有限视觉输入预算下解读超高分辨率遥感影像时，需在局部细节与场景上下文之间权衡。现有基于选择的方法（token剪枝/pat密筛选、反复裁剪检查）都不直接在全场景连续视图中重分配像素：前者只保留被选中的token或patch，后者把裁剪区域从周边上下文中剥离后重新编码。先导实验发现冻结MLLM已能提出有用的问题引导空间请求，但基于裁剪的检查并不能稳定提升回答质量。
AI.method: 将UHR理解建模为"固定像素预算如何分配"，提出GazeEarth免训练框架：1）MLLM从索引化的概览图中选出证据单元（evidence cells）；2）用确定性的拓扑保持形变（warp）把原图重采样到固定尺寸画布，放大证据单元及其共享邻域、压缩外围；3）同一冻结模型在此聚焦视图上作答。全程最多2次MLLM调用，无需外部选择器，也无迭代搜索。
AI.result: 在三个UHR遥感基准与四个冻结骨干上，GazeEarth相较直接回答平均准确率提升4.6–9.4个百分点，相较概览式回答提升3.4–4.3个百分点，并优于任务训练型方法。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLM可自主引导在UHR图像中"看向哪里"，而其从选定证据中能推断出什么，取决于证据以何种方式呈现——即像素预算的空间重分配方式比单纯的区域选择更关键。

title: Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions. Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here. One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115]. Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining. We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.

AI.tldr: 该文对AI生成图像检测的堆叠集成进行控制实验审视：融合仅在目标域重拟合时才有效；单语料评估不足；弃权机制（缺失数据）处理不当导致全NaN输入给出P(AI)=0.9985；语料A存在类条件JPEG偏差，限制所有域内结论，并公开代码与修正。
AI.motivation: 作者先前部署了由三个开源检测器（五个分数）加梯度提升元学习器构成的堆叠集成用于AI生成图像检测，并在论文中得出了若干结论。本文的动机是先补做本应首先完成的三类对照实验，以检验并纠正自身先前的结论，避免因评估设置缺陷（跨域拟合、单语料评测、缺失值处理不当）而产生错误主张。
AI.method: 构建普通堆叠集成：三个开源检测器输出五个分数，由梯度提升元学习器融合，将检测器失效视为缺失数据。设置三类对照：(1) 跨域拟合的已发布元学习器 vs 域内重拟合的stacker，并与最佳单检测器及事后校准器比较（McNemar检验、Delta-AUC自助置信区间）；(2) 多语料评估（含80张截图，报告AUC区间与集成-最佳成员差值区间）；(3) 弃权与缺失值诊断，包括全NaN输入的评分行为、AIDE检查点共享预处理路径导致的共同失效，以及要求两个不同架构的quorum规则。另检查语料A的类条件JPEG头部偏差。
AI.result: 跨域已发布元学习器在2000张StyleGAN人脸上不优于最佳单成员（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961，McNemar p=1.000）；域内重拟合的stacker优于该成员加事后校准器（Delta-AUC=+0.0025，[+0.0014,+0.0038]，p=3.4e-4）。早期草稿关于校准后单检测器胜出的结论系跨regime比较，已被修正。80张截图上各模型AUC区间均含0.5，集成与最佳成员降幅之差为[-0.185,+0.115]。五个检测器中四个静默、幸存者报"real"时，系统输出P(AI)=0.9985，因未含缺失训练的learner对全NaN输入评分为0.9995。三个AIDE检查点因共享同一预处理路径而同时失效，采用需两种不同架构的quorum规则可在不重训的情况下避免两类失败。语料A存在类条件JPEG偏差，仅凭头部即可区分类别。
AI.conclusion: 融合的价值取决于在目标域重拟合；单一语料不足以支撑评估结论；弃权是真实且相关的，缺失值处理不当会引发严重虚高评分，需通过架构多样性quorum缓解；数据集的类条件压缩偏差限制了域内数字的可推广性。作者发布代码、评测harness、哈希标识产物及全部修正，呼吁对集成检测结果做更严格的控制与纠错。

title: Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video
summary: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视DAiSEE课堂视频情感识别中的类别不平衡问题，指出其本质是"维度特异"现象（原始不平衡比最高约79:1），提出自适应混合标签策略AHLS：对不平衡可控的维度用四级分类、对严重长尾维度用二分类，并引入null-class占位机制将最大有效逆频权重比压到≤8.5×；在轻量FERShuffleNetV2+LTCN（0.39M参数）上取得四维平均Macro-F1 47.70%，优于11种对比方法。
AI.motivation: DAiSEE是学生情感状态识别的准基准数据集，其类别不平衡长期被当作单一的整体问题处理。作者认为这种认识不足：不平衡不仅是"量级"问题，其"结构"在不同情感维度上各不相同，因此统一的重加权、focal loss或统一二值化会以维度相关的方式失效。此外，还需探究分类策略与骨干规模化哪个对少数类识别影响更大，以及基准本身是否存在标注密度瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy（AHLS）：按维度自适应选择标签粒度——失衡可控维度保留四级分类，严重长尾维度降为二分类；配套null-class占位机制以压缩多任务联合优化的有效逆频权重比（从~79×降至≤8.5×）。模型侧采用轻量FEShuffleNetV2+LTCN（0.39M参数、0.07 GFLOPs），并与5个SOTA深度模型（最大167倍参数量）和5个传统机器学习基线共11种方法对比；另做跨模型行为分析与标注密度分析。
AI.result: 在DAiSEE四维情感上取得最高的平均Macro-F1 47.70%，优于全部11种对比方法（含5个更大规模SOTA深度模型与5个传统ML基线），而模型仅0.39M参数。跨模型行为分析表明：在此设定下，分类策略对少数类状态识别的影响可能强于单纯扩大骨干网络。同时给出DAiSEE在少数类情感状态上存在标注密度不足的证据。
AI.conclusion: 类别不平衡在DAiSEE上是维度特异现象，统一算法处理会以维度相关方式失效；维度自适应的混合标签策略加null-class机制能在极小模型上超过更大骨干，提示分类策略的价值可能高于盲目扩大模型。基准的标注密度限制提示：基准设计对后续进展的约束可能与算法改进同等重要。整体属于情感计算/教育场景视频分析的工作，与具身智能、3D重建、VLA等方向仅弱相关。

title: Residual Learning-Based Control of Vehicle Platoons with $\ell_2$ Stability Guarantees via Recurrent Equilibrium Networks
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: This paper proposes a residual learning-based control framework for heterogeneous vehicle platoons subject to parametric uncertainty and external disturbances. A nominal controller designed via Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs), along with disturbance-observer compensation, is enhanced by a Recurrent Equilibrium Network (REN) trained offline using stored trajectories and nominal-model prediction errors. The REN is constrained to satisfy a prescribed $\ell_2$-gain bound, enabling sufficient small-gain conditions for local closed-loop stability and disturbance string stability. Experiments demonstrate reduced spacing and velocity errors relative to the nominal controller.

AI.tldr: 面向参数不确定与外部扰动的异构车队，提出"LMI标称控制器+扰动观测器补偿+REN残差学习"的控制框架；REN离线训练并受约束满足给定ℓ₂增益界，从而给出局部闭环稳定性与扰动弦稳定性的小增益充分条件，实验显示间距与速度误差降低。
AI.motivation: 异构车队存在参数不确定性和外部扰动，纯模型控制器（LMI设计）难以在建模误差与扰动下保持精确的间距/速度跟踪及车队弦稳定性；同时学习型控制器往往缺乏稳定性保证。因此需要一种既能利用数据提升性能、又能提供可证明稳定性/弦稳定性边界的方法。
AI.method: 1) 用LMI设计标称控制器，并加入扰动观测器补偿；2) 采集轨迹与标称模型预测误差，离线训练循环均衡网络（REN）作为残差控制器；3) 对REN施加预设ℓ₂增益约束，结合小增益定理推导局部闭环稳定性与扰动弦稳定性的充分条件。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比纯标称控制器，所提残差学习框架降低了车队间距误差与速度误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习型残差（REN）与模型控制器结合，并利用ℓ₂增益约束将学习模块纳入小增益分析，可在不确定与扰动条件下同时获得性能提升与稳定性/弦稳定性保证，为安全学习控制提供了一种可行范式。

title: ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics
comment: 32 pages, 14 figures, Project page: this https URL
summary: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions.
