More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出ArticulateArena，一种表示不变的关节铰接距离度量，通过比较单自由度关节诱导的运动而非其参数编码来评估铰接预测，并证明其为度量，同时发布19,977个物体的ArticulateArena-20K数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有铰接物体重建评估协议将关节类型、轴方向、原点、运动限制分开打分，但这些参数共同描述同一物理运动，且同一运动可有多种等价参数编码，导致"最大错误却得分最高"以及误差在预测准确处病态或未定义，缺乏表示不变的铰接度量。
AI.method: 用单自由度关节诱导的运动而非编码参数进行比较；以李代数端点twist的无序对表示每个关节，构造商距离并证明其为度量；统一固定、旋转、棱柱、螺旋关节，通过紧化将连续关节纳入同一评分；按质量分布加权后读数以米为单位的RMS运动；用运动感知树编辑距离将该度量提升到完整运动学树，在固定内积下对重标记保持度量性质。
AI.result: 证明所得商距离为度量，且树编辑距离在树重标记意义下仍为度量；发布含19,977个已验证运动学铰接物体的ArticulateArena-20K，并在新度量下重新评估已发表的重建方法。
AI.conclusion: ArticulateArena为铰接评估提供表示不变、可解释且理论上良定义的度量，统一多种关节类型，并将结构与关节误差换算到同一运动单位，配合新数据集推动铰接物体重建评测标准化。

title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
summary: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $\delta < 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的几何深度估计方法，利用两帧单目图像与相机位姿，通过极线迁移合成虚拟双目对，在无人机与室内场景中优于 ZoeDepth、Depth Anything V2 等学习基准。
AI.motivation: 学习式深度估计在分布内精度高，但对新视角与新高度泛化差；直接双视图三角化在几何退化场景下有效深度比例低。
AI.method: 基于相机运动合成可自由选择基线的虚拟双目像对，将时间对应转化为立体三角化问题，从而缓解直接两视图三角化的几何退化；仅需两幅单目图像与相机位姿估计，无需训练。
AI.result: 在户外无人机飞行（最远约 90 m）与室内 OptiTrack 环境以 LiDAR 为真值验证：室内 AbsRel 0.092、δ<1.25 为 0.940，与直接三角化（AbsRel 0.073）相当，但在更多困难场景中保持有效深度；显著优于 ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）与 Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570）。
AI.conclusion: 免训练几何方法在跨域深度估计上具备强泛化性，可作为学习式深度模型在新视角/新高度下的可靠替代或补充。

title: ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models
summary: Jointly generating future video and actions has become a standard recipe for world-action models, and the strongest systems denoise the two streams on separate schedules: actions are decoded in few steps so control stays fast, while the video stream runs longer to keep the predicted future sharp. The design is deliberate, but it leaves the two streams on different clocks, and an action can become executable while the future that should justify it is still largely unresolved. We formalize this as a two-clock view of asynchronous inference and introduce the commitment-evidence gap, a quantity read directly from a model's own sampling schedule rather than measured by search. The gap is predictive: as it widens, candidate utility becomes harder to identify and extra candidate sampling buys less, while advancing the world stream buys more, and the two cross. Spending more world computation is therefore not simply better. The useful interval is closed at both ends, and both ends can be read off the schedule before any rollout. ReSync places the computation inside it: hold the action state, advance only the world within the supported window, then resume native denoising. No parameters change and no candidates are compared. On a frozen paired RoboCasa panel this improves success by 4.48 points, while an equal-compute control that waits without advancing the world does not move, and the same rule transfers to a second benchmark and a second backbone without retuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文从"双时钟"视角刻画世界-动作模型（world-action model）中动作流与视频流异步去噪所导致的"承诺-证据差"（commitment-evidence gap），指出该差距可由采样调度直接读出并能预测候选采样与推进世界流的收益交叉点，进而提出 ReSync：在支持窗口内冻结动作状态、仅推进世界流后再恢复原生去噪，无需改参数或候选比较。冻结的 RoboCasa 配对测试上成功率提升 4.48 点，等算力对照无效，且跨基准与跨骨干零调参迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前最强世界-动作模型普遍采用动作与视频分调度去噪：动作少步快速解码以保证控制实时性，视频流长步去噪以保证未来预测清晰。这种刻意设计导致两流处于不同"时钟"，动作可能已可执行而其应依据的未来尚未解析完成。作者希望在不增加候选采样、不改动模型参数的前提下，回答"额外的世界计算是否总是有益"这一问题，并给出可在 rollout 前预判的判据。
AI.method: 1) 形式化异步推理的"双时钟"视角；2) 定义 commitment-evidence gap：直接从模型自身采样调度读数，而非依赖搜索测量；3) 实验验证该差距的预测性：差距变大时候选效用更难识别、额外候选采样收益递减，而推进世界流收益增大，两者存在交叉；4) 提出 ReSync：在世界流受支持的窗口内保持（hold）动作状态不变，仅推进世界流，随后恢复原生去噪，不引入新参数、不做候选比较；5) 设计等算力对照（只等待、不推进世界流）。
AI.result: 在冻结的配对 RoboCasa 评测面板上成功率提升 4.48 个百分点；等算力但仅等待而不推进世界流的对照组无提升；同一规则无需重调参即可迁移到第二个基准与第二个骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 额外的世界计算并非单调有益，"有用区间"两端封闭，且两端均可由采样调度在 rollout 前读出；ReSync 通过把计算精确放置在该区间内，以零参数改动、零候选比较的方式稳定获得收益，并具备跨基准、跨骨干的可迁移性。

title: Integrity Detection and Characterization of Malicious Injections in RAVEN II
summary: The increasing adoption of robotic systems in surgery, together with the expanding range of procedures they can support and the growing level of autonomy they provide, has substantially increased the complexity of surgical robots. As these systems integrate more sensors, controllers, communication interfaces, and model-driven control components, their attack surface continues to expand. A compromise of the integrity of a surgical robot can therefore cause unintended robot behavior and potentially threaten patient safety. In this paper, we characterize the detection boundary of malicious injections on RAVEN II using a public dataset that pairs the platform's telemetry with external high-resolution encoder ground truth. We identify three injection points spanning the command and observation paths and evaluate three injection patterns with increasing temporal dispersion. To capture different detection behaviors, we perform detection at two timescales: the window scale and the session scale. Rather than reporting detection rates at an arbitrarily chosen threshold, we quantify, for each injection point and injection pattern, the smallest end-effector deviation that can be resolved while maintaining an alarm rate acceptable for surgical operation. Our results show that detectability is strongly influenced by how the injected deviation is distributed over time. An abrupt step can be detected at deviations well below the 1 mm clinical tolerance, whereas the same overall deviation spread across a window or a session can remain hidden from single-window statistics. The open source code can be found at this http URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文基于RAVEN II手术机器人公开数据集（遥测数据配对高分辨率编码器真值），刻画恶意注入的可检测边界：在指令与观测路径上设置三个注入点、三种时间弥散度递增的注入模式，并在窗口尺度与会话尺度两个时间尺度上进行检测，量化各条件下在可接受报警率内能分辨的最小末端偏差。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人集成更多传感器、控制器、通信接口与模型驱动控制组件，攻击面持续扩大；完整性问题可导致非预期机器人行为并威胁患者安全，因此需要明确恶意注入究竟在何种偏差量级、何种时间分布下可被检出。
AI.method: 利用RAVEN II公开数据集（平台遥测与外部高分辨率编码器真值配对）；选取跨指令路径与观测路径的三类注入点，构造三种时间弥散度递增的注入模式；分别在窗口尺度与会话尺度执行异常检测；不采用任意阈值下的检测率，而是逐（注入点×注入模式）求解在满足手术可接受报警率前提下的最小可分辨末端执行器偏差。
AI.result: 可检测性强烈依赖注入偏差在时间上的分布方式：突变的阶跃式注入可在远低于1 mm临床容差的偏差量级被检出；而同样总量的偏差若分散在一个窗口或整个会话内，则可能逃逸单窗口统计的检测。开源代码已随文提供。
AI.conclusion: 手术机器人恶意注入的检测能力由偏差的时间弥散方式决定，单窗口统计对分散式小偏差存在盲区；评价应报告"可分辨的最小偏差"而非任意阈值下的检测率，这为手术机器人安全监控的检测器设计与评估提供了更具临床意义的准则。

title: FINGR: Learning Dexterous Hand Control for Real-World Rubik's Cube Solving
summary: Manipulating a Rubik's Cube with a single dexterous hand is a challenging test of sustained, contact-rich control: the hand must execute successive layer turns while keeping the cube secure. Each turn requires some fingers to support the cube while others push a moving layer, release contact, and reset for the next move. To learn this coordination, we introduce FINGR (Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations), a policy that combines finger-relative geometry with future interaction prediction. A shared point encoder expresses the cube relative to each fingertip and aggregates its points without depending on cubie indexing. Learned future tokens share the observation encoder and receive supervision for contact-force changes, layer-turn progress, and finger joint displacement at multiple time scales. The resulting representation conditions a flow policy that directly generates finger actions. On a real dexterous hand, our policy achieves 99.0% success over 300 turn attempts, compared with 79.7% for the base flow policy. Integrated with grasping and table-assisted regrasping, the policy solves all ten scrambled $2\times2\times2$ cubes in a mean complete-system time of approximately 137 seconds. The project website is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: FINGR 结合指尖相对几何点云编码与多时间尺度未来交互预测监督，以流策略直接生成灵巧手动作，实现单手持魔方连续层旋转，真机 300 次尝试成功率 99.0%，并集成抓取与桌面辅助重抓完成全部 10 个打乱二阶魔方。
AI.motivation: 单手持魔方是持续、富接触控制的难题：需要部分手指支撑魔方、其他手指推动转动层，随后脱离接触并复位。核心难点在于手指间的角色分工与接触状态随时间切换的协调，以及不依赖固定 cubie 索引的几何泛化表征。
AI.method: 提出 FINGR（Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations）。共享点云编码器以指尖为参考系表达魔方点云并聚合，避免依赖魔方块编号；学习的 future tokens 与观测编码器共享参数，并在多个时间尺度上接受接触力变化、转层进度与手指关节位移的监督；该表征条件化一个 flow policy，直接输出手指动作。系统层面配以抓取与桌面辅助重抓模块。
AI.result: 真机灵巧手 300 次转层尝试成功率 99.0%，基线 flow policy 为 79.7%；集成抓取与桌面辅助重抓后，全部 10 个打乱 2×2×2 魔方均被解出，完整系统平均耗时约 137 秒。
AI.conclusion: 面向富接触灵巧操作，指尖相对几何表征与多尺度未来交互预测监督能显著提升连续接触切换的鲁棒性与长程任务成功率，并在完整真机系统中验证了可行性。

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: Simify：免训练、测试时通过大规模并行物理仿真做显式空间推理，单张RGB-D重建仿真就绪资产，用进化搜索优化物体布局，真机完成物体重排。
AI.motivation: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，支撑多物体交互的长时程任务；现有基础模型在空间推理上仍是隐式、弱几何约束的，难以可靠迁移到真实操作。
AI.method: 无需训练：由单张RGB-D图像，借助3D生成模型与VLM重建仿真就绪资产；给定奖励函数定义的任务（如搭最高塔），在仿真中并行启动数千条rollout，用进化搜索优化物体摆放，数秒内收敛。
AI.result: 在真实机器人硬件上做定量实验，端到端完成此前未见物体的复杂物体重排任务；性能优于空间推理基础模型类先前工作，并表明完整且准确的几何对sim-to-real成功至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 以测试时大规模并行仿真替代训练，可有效提升机器人空间推理与物体重排能力；几何重建的完整性/精度是sim-to-real的关键瓶颈。

title: TacGooseBumps (TacGB): Retrofitting Normal-Only Tactile Sensors with Shear Encoding for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Wenjie Li and Binyu Yang contributed equally
summary: Contact-rich policies often fail because distinct physical states look alike yet require different actions. Cameras may not reveal whether a connector is aligned or fully seated, while many normal-only tactile sensors can miss the tangential interactions perpendicular to the grasping direction that distinguish these states. We ask whether a learning policy needs calibrated shear measurements, or only a repeatable observation that separates shear-dependent contact states. We introduce TacGooseBumps (TacGB), a passive domed film that mechanically encodes tangential loading as pattern changes in an existing sensor's pressure map. Tangential loading tilts each dome and redistributes pressure across its footprint; an end-to-end policy consumes the resulting maps without added electronics, force reconstruction, or taxel-level dome alignment. Across four imitation-learning tasks and two data-collection pipelines, TacGB improves goal attainment, efficiency, and contact quality: insertion success increases by up to 36 percentage points, and successful insertions are completed faster, while fragile-object placement becomes gentler and drawing becomes more continuous and straight. Signal, stage-wise, failure-mode, and trajectory analyses link these gains to contact regimes in which task-relevant tangential interactions are poorly resolved by vision and normal pressure alone. Together, these results show that shear need not be measured metrically to benefit robot learning; it can instead be mechanically encoded without changing the underlying tactile sensor or the policy's pressure-map input format.

AI.tldr: 提出 TacGooseBumps (TacGB)：一种被动穹顶薄膜，将切向载荷机械编码为现有触觉压力图上的图案变化，无需额外电子元件或力重建，端到端策略直接消费压力图，在四个模仿学习任务上显著提升插入成功率、效率与接触质量。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的策略常因物理状态外观相似但所需动作不同而失败：相机难以分辨连接器是否对齐或完全就位，而仅提供法向信号的常规触觉传感器又难以捕捉与抓取方向垂直的切向交互。作者追问：学习策略究竟需要标定的剪切测量，还是只需一种可重复、能区分剪切相关接触状态的观测？
AI.method: 设计被动穹顶薄膜 TacGB，切向载荷使每个穹顶倾斜并在其足印内重新分布压力，从而把切向加载机械地编码进既有传感器的压力图。端到端策略直接消费这些压力图，无需增加电子器件、无需力重建、也无需做出力元级（taxel-level）的穹顶对齐。
AI.result: 在四个模仿学习任务、两条数据采集流水线上验证：插入成功率最多提升 36 个百分点，成功插入耗时更短；易碎物体放置更轻柔，绘画更连续、更笔直。信号、分阶段、失效模式与轨迹分析表明，增益来自视觉与法向压力难以分辨任务相关切向交互的接触区间。
AI.conclusion: 剪切信号无需被度量式测量即可使机器人学习受益；它可以通过机械方式编码，而不改变底层触觉传感器或策略的压力图输入格式。

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
comment: IEEE RA-Letters 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.

AI.tldr: ZeroBot 提出一种 real2sim 框架，仅用单视角物体图像与目标位姿，借助 image-to-3D 生成模型构建物体网格，在仿真中进行大规模并行强化学习，从而在无人类演示、无策略预训练、无已知物体模型条件下数分钟内学会操作技能，真实任务平均成功率 87%，平均训练时间 119 秒。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作学习通常依赖人类演示、策略预训练或已知物体 CAD 模型，成本高且难以扩展到新物体。作者希望在"零演示、零预训练、零物体模型"的苛刻条件下，利用 image-to-3D 生成能力快速实现真实世界操作任务学习，以验证 image-to-3D 模型在 real2sim 框架中的价值。
AI.method: 输入为物体的单视角图像与目标位姿；用 image-to-3D 生成模型重建完整物体网格；将网格导入仿真器进行大规模并行强化学习；并设计一种利用生成几何与学习到的价值函数来采样"机器人-物体接触"状态的动作空间，以加速训练。
AI.result: 在抓取、推动、铰接物体交互与多阶段操作等真实任务上取得 87% 成功率，平均训练时间仅 119 秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将 image-to-3D 模型纳入 real2sim 框架，可实现快速、自主的机器人学习，为无需演示与预训练的操作技能获取提供了可行路径。

title: Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, video: this https URL
summary: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.

AI.tldr: 提出在冻结的可微专家策略上反传动作一致性损失的视觉状态估计器训练方法，结合直接状态监督与调度目标，实现免重训专家的sim-to-real操作策略迁移，Panda真机达76%成功率。
AI.motivation: 教师-学生蒸馏需学生同时推断任务相关状态并重新学习专家已掌握的动作映射，效率低；而仅学习感知接口、最小化状态估计误差，并不等价于最小化下游控制误差，二者间存在目标错配。
AI.method: 保留基于状态的专家策略，仅训练视觉状态估计器：损失由直接状态监督项与经冻结且可微专家回传的动作一致性损失组成，并采用调度策略——先建立物理意义良好的状态估计，再逐步加大影响专家动作的误差权重。
AI.result: 在五个目标条件操作任务上，保留专家的方案稳定优于同来源示范语料的像素到动作直接模仿；并在真实Panda机器人上完成sim-to-real迁移，未重训底层专家即取得76%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将感知学习与下游控制误差对齐、复用而非重学专家动作映射，是提升接触丰富操作任务sim-to-real迁移效率与成功率的有效途径。

title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文将动作回归与流匹配统一在同一目标下，推导出分位数目标，设计 Quantile Head 单次前向预测中位数及正间隔构成有序边际动作分位数，支持多种采样策略并联合监督训练默认中位数策略，在 LIBERO 系列与两个真机任务上取得最高平均成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型的常见动作头存在明显局限：点回归只给出动作分布的点估计，标准流匹配采样器需要昂贵的迭代采样。作者希望在同一框架下兼顾表达能力与推理效率。
AI.method: 将回归与流匹配统一为共享目标并扩展导出分位数目标；据此设计 Quantile Head，一次前向预测中位数与正间隔以形成有序边际动作分位数，支持免重训的多采样策略，并以联合监督训练默认中位数策略；对联合监督进行局部分析，说明在校准邻近分位数、固定间隔、匹配修正速度下直接中位数更新方差低于仅中位数监督。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 及两个真机任务上，联合监督的中位数策略平均成功率高于对比方法，并在匹配的 LIBERO 基线中取得最短平均单回合时间。
AI.conclusion: 分位数化的动作头可在一次前向中给出分布性动作表示，避免迭代采样并保留多策略采样灵活性，联合监督有助于提升成功率与推理效率。

title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，用 SIGReg 正则化的可学习投影器压缩 patch embedding（规划 patch 减少16×、维度减少4×），在保持规划性能的同时实现约100×推理加速，用于端到端自动驾驶的世界模型零样本目标条件规划。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶需要能理解物理世界并进行推理、规划的安全世界模型。作者指出：现有动作条件 JEPA 世界模型（LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）在 E2EAD 场景下存在两难——要么规划精度可用但计算代价高，要么计算高效但不足以支撑规划。为把世界模型质量与策略学习解耦，需要一种兼顾精度与效率的 JEPA 世界模型。
AI.method: 1）系统评估现有动作条件 JEPA 世界模型，采用目标条件零样本规划设定：以真实未来观测作为目标，不训练任何驾驶策略，从而隔离世界模型质量与策略学习。2）提出 AD-E2E-JEPA：在投影后的 patch embedding 上施加 SIGReg 正则化的可学习投影器，将规划 patch 数量压缩 16×、embedding 维度压缩 4×。3）通过世界模型 rollout 在候选轨迹词表（256/8,192 条）上做目标条件规划，评估位移误差；并在 NAVSIMv2 上评测 EPDMS（含/不含乘法安全指标）。4）验证自监督预训练投影器对下游模仿学习的影响。
AI.result: 推理速度提升约 100×，8 帧 rollout 在 256 条候选轨迹上仅需 0.8 秒。不训练任何驾驶策略时，世界模型在 256/8,192 条候选轨迹词表下分别以 4.0/2.8 米平均位移到达平均距离 20 米的目标。NAVSIMv2 上，含乘法安全指标达 67.3/72.9 EPDMS，不含时达 84.1/86.5 EPDMS†。自监督预训练投影器将下游模仿学习从 80.2 提升至 85.4 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量可学习投影器 + SIGReg 正则化，可在几乎不损失规划能力的前提下大幅压缩 JEPA 世界模型的规划成本，缓解精度—效率权衡；零样本目标条件规划结果与下游模仿学习增益表明该世界模型具有实用价值，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Retrieval Relevance: Scene-Grounded Risk Entailment for Vision-Language Driving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives vision--language driving systems access to external safety knowledge, yet a retrieved risk rule may be relevant without applying to the current scene. A vision--language model (VLM) receiving such knowledge must ground objects, bind entities across time, and verify relations before deciding how to act, leaving the support for risk conclusions implicit. We address this relevance--applicability gap with a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph (DRKG) and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) reasoning stage before VLM decision-making. Structured perception instantiates scene facts, from which SWRL rules derive events and directed risk relations when their antecedents are jointly satisfied. Recognized events, bound risk relations, and semantic descriptions of activated rules form compact evidence that conditions the VLM and diffusion planner. In matched comparisons on nuReasoning, our method improved the nuReasoning planning score (NPS) by 1.30 points and the non-at-fault collision score (NC) by 2.76 points over the relevance retrieval-based baseline. These gains indicate that scene-applicable risk evidence improves safety-weighted planning relative to semantically retrieved risk knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出用驾驶风险知识图谱(DRKG)与SWRL规则推理作为VLM决策前的证据生成阶段,把检索到的风险知识转化为场景适用的事件与有向风险关系显式证据,在nuReasoning上提升NPS 1.30、NC 2.76。
AI.motivation: RAG为视觉-语言驾驶系统引入外部安全知识时存在"相关性-适用性"缺口:检索到的风险规则可能语义相关但并不适用于当前场景,而VLM需自行完成物体接地、跨时序实体绑定与关系核验,导致风险结论的支持过程隐式且不可靠。
AI.method: 构建驾驶风险知识图谱(DRKG),由结构化感知实例化场景事实;在其上用SWRL规则在前件联合满足时推导事件与有向风险关系;将识别出的事件、已绑定的风险关系及被激活规则的语义描述组成紧凑证据,用于条件化VLM与扩散规划器,形成检索-推理-决策流水线。
AI.result: 在nuReasoning的配对对比中,相较基于相关性检索的基线,NPS提升1.30分,非过失碰撞分数(NC)提升2.76分。
AI.conclusion: 显式的场景适用性推理可提供可验证的风险证据,相较仅按语义相关性检索风险知识,能更好支撑安全加权规划;知识图谱+规则推理与VLM决策互补。

title: Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知的稀疏路径记忆，将已执行的去程轨迹记录为有序几何锚点，并通过结构化提示、动作级仲裁与终端验证进行反向查询，以支持往返视觉语言导航（VLN）中的返程任务。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN通常被建模为单向任务，但真实部署的机器人到达目标后往往需要原路返回。作者诊断往返VLN中的三类失败：方向可观测性、偏差恢复与终止稳定性，指出长时程导航中返程能力被评估体系忽视。
AI.method: 构建连续往返VLN任务与50个反向配对回合；提出可靠性感知稀疏路径记忆，将去程轨迹存储为有序几何锚点，返程时经结构化提示反向查询，配合动作级仲裁与终端验证机制；在NaVILA与仿真Unitree Go2上在线评估，并加入精确路径信息作为上界对照。
AI.result: 语言-only返程在22.0%回合成功，在线系统达55.1%；提供精确路径信息后同一接口达86.0%。剩余在线差距主要来自几何证据不可靠而无法授权干预，说明返程受信息质量、行为一致性与在线可靠性三重限制。
AI.conclusion: 往返VLN的有效返程需要准确信息与基于该信息的一致动作两者兼备；信息质量、行为一致性与在线可靠性是长时程导航的独立瓶颈，为可靠性感知导航系统设计提供了诊断框架。

title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.

AI.tldr: RAVEL 提出一种异步推理框架，通过"滚动缓冲"复用部分去噪动作、并将 VLM 编码与动作生成解耦，同时引入轻量快速观测通路（FOP），显著降低流式 VLA 的推理延迟，并在仿真与真实操作任务中保持原有任务能力。
AI.motivation: 流式（flow-based）VLA 模型在通用机器人操作上表现优异，但其依赖计算量大的 VLM 编码与多步迭代式动作去噪，造成严重推理延迟瓶颈；在动态环境中机器人难以快速响应，因此需要针对 VLM 主干与动作专家两处计算瓶颈做加速。
AI.method: RAVEL 异步推理框架含两点核心设计：(1) 滚动缓冲（rolling buffer）将部分去噪的未来动作向前传递，使近期动作只需单步去噪即可执行，降低多步去噪延迟；(2) 将 VLM 编码与滚动动作生成解耦，动作专家持续使用最新的 VLM 上下文运行而无需阻塞等待，同时以轻量 Fast Observation Pathway（FOP）将当前观测直接条件化到动作专家。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务中，RAVEL 在保持底层 VLA 任务能力的同时，稳定实现显著更低的响应延迟，支持高频、响应式的闭环控制。
AI.conclusion: 异步化与滚动缓冲是缓解流式 VLA 延迟瓶颈的有效途径，可在不牺牲操作性能的前提下实现低延迟高频闭环控制。

title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: FailPatch：冻结VLA策略，在动作隐空间注入Null门控残差专家库，以Preserve–Redirect–Trust目标在失败状态重定向表征，仅0.52%可训练参数。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通常用成功示范微调，只提供直接动作监督，但几乎覆盖不到易失败状态；部署失败虽能暴露这些状态，却缺少可用于常规监督学习的纠正动作。
AI.method: 将动作监督与执行可靠性监督解耦：成功示范约束"应如何动作"，部署轨迹指示"何时行为不可靠"。观察到动作隐表征在可靠状态与失败关联状态间线性可分且直接条件化动作生成。据此在冻结VLA的动作隐空间引入Null-gated Residual Expert Bank（零门控残差专家库），并用统一的Preserve–Redirect–Trust目标：在可靠状态保留原策略、在失败关联状态选择残差专家、在受限干预下把表征从失败区域重定向到成功关联区域。
AI.result: 仅0.52%可训练参数下，在4个长时序RoboTwin任务上干净评测成功率提升11.0个百分点，干净到随机泛化提升9.5个百分点；三项真实世界任务相对基线提升16.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 利用部署失败信号在隐空间做有界残差修补，是一种参数高效、无需失败纠正动作标注的VLA可靠性提升路径。

title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile this http URL , robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该工作构建同步采集图像、触觉信号与手部运动的触觉动捕系统及UVTA数据集（5个接触密集任务，每任务1000次人手演示+150次机器人演示），并提出统一视觉-触觉-动作模型，将人手与机器人映射到对齐的触觉/动作表示空间并联合预测未来动作与触觉轨迹，实现人手触觉数据监督下的接触感知表征学习。真机5任务平均成功率70%，远超最强视觉-触觉基线29%与结构消融42%，且性能随人手演示数量持续提升未见饱和。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作依赖触觉反馈，但机器人触觉演示难以规模化：灵巧手遥操作给操作者的触觉反馈有限。相比之下，人类演示是更易扩展的多样触觉交互来源。作者基于一个简单前提——手可以不同，但交互底层物理不变——试图利用人类触觉数据改进灵巧操作策略。
AI.method: 1) 搭建触觉动捕系统，同步记录图像、触觉信号与手部运动；2) 构建UVTA数据集，涵盖5个接触密集任务，含1000次人手演示（多样交互模式）与每任务150次机器人演示；3) 提出Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model，将人手与机器人两种本体映射到对齐的触觉与动作表征，并联合预测未来动作与触觉轨迹；该联合目标使人手演示可监督接触感知表征学习，部署时仅执行机器人动作。
AI.result: 真机评测5个任务平均成功率70%，优于最强视觉-触觉基线（29%）与结构消融（42%）；性能随人手演示增加持续提升，在每任务1000次演示时仍未饱和，验证了可扩展人类触觉数据对灵巧操作的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 人类触觉演示是可扩展的数据来源，通过将不同本体对齐到共享的触觉-动作表征并联合预测未来动作与触觉轨迹，可有效把人类交互的底层物理迁移到机器人控制，显著提升接触密集灵巧操作性能且具备良好扩展性。

title: EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出 EgoTSR 框架，通过双向监督数据与 CoT-to-Tag 课程训练 VLM 判断第一人称任务进度（哪个状态更接近目标），并揭示输入顺序偏置。长时域准确率 92.4%，前-反向差距 0.1 点，非单调轨迹提升 11.8 点。
AI.motivation: VLM 在静态视觉理解上进步迅速，但在判断以自我为中心（egocentric）任务进展时不可靠：模型常依赖时间戳或呈现顺序等时序捷径，而非任务相关物体配置与空间关系。在操作任务中，重试、纠正动作与暂时性倒退使进度本质上非单调，因此目标条件的状态比较必须被显式建模。
AI.method: 三部分组成：(1) SpatialLogic-Bench，对每个物理状态对在原始与顺序交换两种呈现下、短/长时域设置中评估，诊断模型是依据任务状态证据还是时序捷径；(2) 数据构造流水线，将成功且近似单调的操作与第一人称轨迹转成双向监督，LongTag 保留中间子任务结构以支持长时域比较，failure-aware 数据覆盖回退与恢复；(3) 渐进式 CoT-to-Tag 课程，先监督任务相关状态变化的证据化解读，再通过可扩展的仅标签训练巩固比较规则。
AI.result: 代表性 VLM 表现出显著输入顺序偏置。EgoTSR 达到 92.4% 长时域准确率，前-反向差距仅 0.1 点；failure-aware 监督使非单调轨迹准确率提升 11.8 点、Recovery Accuracy 提升 11.2 点，同时保持广泛的视觉与空间能力。
AI.conclusion: 将目标条件状态比较确立为第一人称时空推理的显式形式化，用于任务进度理解，并说明诊断-数据-课程一体化设计的有效性。方法偏重 VLM 推理与评测，尚未在真实机器人上闭环验证。

title: Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出免标定流程，用 Universal Photometric Stereo 网络从视触觉图像直接估计接触面法向，在三种不同光学系统的传感器上验证，达到与标定基线相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 传统视触觉传感器要获得高精度接触面法向与深度，需用已知几何探针物理按压弹性体并做图像-真值映射标定；该方法难以跨传感器泛化，且标定流程随传感器形状与光学系统复杂度上升。作者希望用通用（标定无关）的光度立体方法消除这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 将接触面法向估计建模为光度立体问题，采用 Universal Photometric Stereo 神经网络，模型仅在合成数据上训练，无需针对具体传感器标定；在三种不同光学系统的传感器（含 dome 形 Digit 360）上做真实实验评估：金属球受控实验对比标定基线，含自然纹理物体测试高频细节恢复能力。
AI.result: 金属球受控实验中通用方法与标定法相当，平均角误差 6.56°；自然纹理物体上恢复高频表面细节，整体平均角误差 10.66°；在 dome 形 Digit 360 上相对标定基线角误差 10.18°，表明在充分照明条件下可用纯合成数据训练的模型估计真实触觉法向。
AI.conclusion: 通用光度立体网络为不同视触觉传感器设计提供统一的接触表面表示，免去逐传感器标定，为跨传感器的可迁移触觉感知奠定基础；局限在于依赖充足照明设置，且精度仍略低于标定基线。

title: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding
comment: 23 pages. Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
summary: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $\pi_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $\pi_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对icosphere transformer在相机旋转下精度骤降的问题，提出无参数的规范等变相对位置编码GE-RPE（在C_n子群上做Reynolds平均），并结合教师token置换π_R形成EquiSSL框架，显著提升全景分割鲁棒性与低标签微调性能。
AI.motivation: 全景360°场景理解依赖icosphere transformer，但当前最优球面模型在相机旋转90°时丢失过半分割精度；受控消融表明其相对位置偏置中的"规范依赖"（gauge dependence）是主要原因，即模型对gauge旋转不具等变性。
AI.method: 提出GE-RPE：对偏置在规范旋转有限循环子群C_n⊂SO(2)上做无参数Reynolds平均，得到C_n不变且O(n^-2)逼近连续SO(2)平均的编码；将其插入SphereUFormer骨干（零新增参数，前向延迟仅增1.5-4.4%）。进一步引入教师token置换π_R对齐SSL视图与旋转后学生帧，构成EquiSSL = GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT+MAE。
AI.result: 匹配三随机种子下GE-RPE模型精度下降仅1.3%；同压力协议下已发布SphereUFormer检查点下降53%。EquiSSL将下降收紧至0.8%，达68.30% val mIoU；1%标签微调在N=373测试集提升+2.39 mIoU（N=40验证集+4.10）。该修复可迁移至单目深度与零样本Structured3D分割。
AI.conclusion: GE-RPE从理论上可证C_n不变并逼近连续SO(2)平均，使模型成为可用的360°视觉计算基元，适用于全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移；代码已开源。

title: 3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting
summary: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? We introduce 3DGS-SC, a controlled static screen-content dataset and benchmark for examining this mismatch. Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. Complementing prior text-aware 3DGS research, 3DGS-SC targets controlled monitor interfaces and exact annotations; scene-wise robustness and acquisition effects remain open validation questions.

AI.tldr: 提出 3DGS-SC：一个受控的静态屏幕内容数据集与基准，用于检验 3DGS 重建中"图像保真度"与"屏幕文字可读性"之间的错配，并将评测拆分为全图保真、屏幕区域保真、OCR 可读性与边缘保持四类协议。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 评测普遍以 PSNR/SSIM 等整体保真度指标作为方法选择依据，但高保真是否意味着屏幕内容（文本、UI）可读尚不明确；作者希望通过受控数据集的屏幕区域与 OCR 指标，验证仅凭保真度做方法选择是否存在系统性失效。
AI.method: 构建受控静态屏幕内容数据集：10 个程序化生成的场景，提供固定多视角划分、精确相机参数、屏幕掩码、文本框与转录文本；评测协议将全图保真度、屏幕区域保真度、OCR 可读性和边缘保持显式分离，并在五种方法上给出对比结果。
AI.result: 在五方法对比中，LightGaussian 的屏幕 PSNR 仅高出 Mip-Splatting 0.08 dB，但 OCR 准确率落后 12.7 个百分点；在全部十组方法配对中，屏幕 PSNR 排序与 OCR 排序有 7 组不一致，说明保真度指标无法可靠预测文字可读性。
AI.conclusion: 高图像保真度并不蕴含屏幕内容可读性，仅依赖保真度的评测会导致方法选择失误；该数据集与协议是对已有文本感知 3DGS 研究的补充，作者也指出逐场景鲁棒性与采集效应仍有待验证。

title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
summary: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出HGPTrans，一种层次化图池化+Transolver注意力的网络，直接从车身表面网格预测气动阻力系数，在DrivAerNet/DrivAerNet++上误差最低，推理约0.293s/车，较CFD加速数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 车辆早期造型迭代需评估大量候选几何，CFD单次计算耗时数小时至数天，难以支撑大规模设计探索，需要快速准确的C_D预测代理模型。
AI.method: HGPTrans由三部分组成：(1)图同构卷积编码局部几何特征；(2)物理感知切片注意力以线性复杂度捕获远距离全局交互；(3)信息冗余感知的层次池化，逐步剔除冗余节点并保留有信息量的几何结构。
AI.result: 在DrivAerNet与DrivAerNet++上取得比基线更低的MAE与MSE；迁移到含轿车与SUV的真实车辆数据集，相对L1误差分别为1.56%与2.12%，每车推理约0.293s，较重高保真CFD加速数个数量级，预测值与CFD参考仅差几个百分点；消融实验验证各组件贡献及深度、池化比例的影响。
AI.conclusion: HGPTrans可作为高精度、高效率的车身气动阻力代理模型，支持大规模几何设计探索与跨车型迁移。

title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
summary: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出方向性多尺度覆盖（directional multiscale coverage）表示，用于图像-文本配对真实性检测，在9维尺度描述子的轻量分类器上取得优于MCOT的F1与平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 上下文图像滥用（图像被配上误导性声明）的检测中，现有配对检测器将图像与文本压缩为全局兼容性分数，或使用高度灵活交互模块，容易掩盖决定性的局部不匹配信号。
AI.method: 构造三种空间尺度上的双向局部图像-声明亲和度摘要：每个尺度每方向用均值、下四分位数和两个阈值支持率表示，方向均值之差构成9维尺度描述子，拼接三层尺度得到紧凑局部表示，供轻量全局-局部分类器使用。
AI.result: 在Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上，采用防泄漏的三折三随机种子评估，UNMATCH取得69.82 Macro-F1与71.05平衡准确率，分别比MCOT适配高出2.60和2.16个点；匹配-重分配干预实验显示打破原配对会降低覆盖度并提高差异度与假配对概率。
AI.conclusion: 方向性多尺度覆盖可作为紧凑、可解释的局部一致性表示，提升图像-声明配对真实性判别的效果。

title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
summary: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

AI.tldr: 提出 PSP-DiT，将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量与图像潜变量联合去噪，显著提升组合式文生图的计数、属性绑定与角色敏感关系能力。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间顺序与角色敏感关系的组合式提示上表现不佳。已有方法多将结构信息作为外部控制信号或事后解析，未将其纳入生成过程的潜空间建模。
AI.method: PSP-DiT 采用扩散 Transformer 架构，通过耦合的 transformer 流联合去噪图像潜变量与全景场景程序潜变量；引入全景 grounding 与循环一致性目标，将物体实例、属性、关系和计数与生成图像中的视觉支撑区域绑定。推理与训练设置与 flat-text 基线保持一致。
AI.result: 在 GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score 与 DetailMaster 上均优于强基线 flat-text 模型，计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系与长结构化提示上增益最大；图像质量保持不降，推理开销增加有限，且对不完美场景程序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将场景程序作为潜变量参与联合去噪，是提升组合式可控生成的有效范式，兼顾质量与鲁棒性，为结构感知生成提供新思路。

title: SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows
summary: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文发现3D CT报告生成器中，隐藏状态已包含生成报告所遗漏的异常信息（macro AUROC从隐藏态的0.848降至报告的0.739），据此提出基于对比解码的SelfCue方法，通过促进隐藏态已支持的证据、抑制不支持的证据来提升报告质量，并进一步蒸馏为学生模型SelfCue-KD。
AI.motivation: 现有3D CT报告生成研究多聚焦于更复杂的架构与更大规模训练数据，但作者观察到生成器在隐藏状态层面其实已编码了报告所遗漏的异常信息，信息损失主要发生在"隐藏态→token"的浮出（surfacing）过程中，因此问题关键不在模型容量而在解码阶段的信息利用。
AI.method: 作者首先量化隐藏态与生成报告之间的"隐藏-报告浮出差距"（18种CT-RATE异常上macro AUROC由0.848降至0.739）。基于此提出SelfCue：一种对比解码方法，利用隐藏状态作为自监督信号，促进其已支持的证据并抑制其不支持的内容，从而缩小该差距。进一步通过知识蒸馏将该行为内化到权重中，得到SelfCue-KD，推理时无需额外开销，可直接替换现有基线管线。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE数据集上，SelfCue将临床效力F1提升至0.481，LLM评判的GREEN分数提升至0.510（基线macro AUROC报告层面为0.739）。SelfCue-KD学生模型保留了大部分增益，推理无需额外组件，可即插即用于已有基线服务管线。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 报告生成的瓶颈更多在于隐藏态信息向文本token的有效浮出，而非模型容量或数据规模；通过对比解码放大隐藏态已有证据、蒸馏内化该行为，可在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升临床效力，为医学报告生成提供了新的解码侧思路。

title: Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images
summary: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

AI.tldr: 面向 LoViF 2026 AIGC 图像压缩挑战（0.025 BPP 全局码率预算）的竞赛报告：微调四个速率专用 AEIC 一步扩散编解码器 checkpoint，逐图生成候选并加入编码端 TTO 精化，用 rANS 熵编码后以精确多选背包按真实码流大小择一，解码端附加零比特残差恢复网络；最终得分 31.527739（PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 @ 0.02495 BPP），测试榜第 5、DISTS 第 2。
AI.motivation: AI 生成图像在超低码率下包含渲染文字、合成边缘、重复纹样、类 UI 布局与风格化微纹理，传统失真导向编解码器会直接抹除这些语义关键细节，而无约束生成式解码器又会"幻觉"出与源几何/符号不符的合理细节。因此作者将该任务重新定义为码率—感知的分配问题，而非单纯的失真最小化，目标是在严格全局比特预算下尽可能保留源图语义结构。
AI.method: 1) 基于 AEIC 一步扩散编解码器，微调得到 4 个速率专用 checkpoint；2) 每张图从四者各生成候选，其中一个 latent 经编码端 test-time optimization（TTO）并周期性刷新 entropy conditioning；3) 所有候选以实用 rANS 熵编码，获知真实编码文件大小；4) 以"真实码流大小"为约束，用精确多选背包（multiple-choice knapsack）为每图恰好选择一个比特流；5) 解码端施加固定、零额外比特的残差恢复网络；6) 全部提交码流可由随附解码器独立解码，不使用源图或外部侧信息；报告覆盖 77 次记录实验的消融史及负结果。
AI.result: 挑战赛最终得分 31.527739，在 0.02495 BPP 下取得 PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390；DISTS 位列榜单第二，2026 年 8 月 4 日公布的最终测试阶段榜单排名第 5。负结果指出：该架构下 PSNR 无法与面向率失真的竞品持平。
AI.conclusion: 在极端码率约束下，以"候选生成 + 按真实编码尺寸的精确背包分配 + 零比特后处理"为核心的率—感知分配框架，可在保留 AIGC 图像语义结构（文字、UI 布局、微纹理）方面获得较强的感知指标表现，尤其 DISTS 具竞争力，但纯失真指标 PSNR 存在架构性上限。该工作为后续参赛者提供了完整的管线描述、消融历史与可复用的负结论。

title: A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency
summary: Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers. SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: SURGE：基于3000万帧手术数据训练的手术基础模型，系统评估15个基准上标签效率，发现任务依赖的缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 手术AI中专家标注昂贵稀缺，自监督基础模型虽能用少量数据适应新任务，但标签效率在不同手术任务间如何变化尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建最大手术预训练数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+（3000万+帧），训练手术基础模型SURGE并公开检查点；在5类任务、15个基准上系统评测标签效率，涵盖时序/空间场景理解、器械-解剖交互的细粒度推理及安全关键操作。
AI.result: SURGE在所有基准上超越先前SOTA，在复杂推理任务上甚至超过任务专用模型；揭示任务依赖缩放行为：场景理解任务在极少监督下即饱和，细粒度推理任务则随标注预算显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 标签效率具有任务依赖性，为复杂领域专家标注资源的分配提供了蓝图。

title: SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

AI.tldr: 提出 SynDORBench——首个基于物理成像约束（DORI 像素密度标定）的大型视觉语言模型感知鲁棒性基准，含 54k+ 问答对与可扩展的低可见度标注框架，评测 16 个开源 LVLM、1 个商用基线及 YOLO11x，发现感知失败主要由像素密度与物理成像约束而非模型规模决定。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 评测默认理想视觉输入，忽略了相机距离、光照、视角、像素密度等物理成像条件对语义可恢复性的影响，无法刻画真实部署中的感知可靠性边界。
AI.method: 构建可控合成数据流水线，按物理可解释的像素密度区间系统改变视距、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，生成 54k+ QA 对；提出基于掩码条件统计特征与集成学习的可辨识度标注框架，将人类感知标签传播到低可见度样本；在人类存在分类与动作识别任务上评测 17 个 LVLM 与 YOLO11x。
AI.result: LVLM 感知失败受像素密度和物理成像约束主导，而非模型规模；多个紧凑开源 LVLM 在远距离与低光条件下优于更大的商用基线，并显著超过 YOLO11x 的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SynDORBench 建立了物理落地的多模态评测新范式，支持在真实感知约束下系统分析 LVLM 可靠性并与人类可见度阈值直接对比，但对机器人具体任务（操作、导航、VLA）缺乏直接可操作方法贡献。

title: CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

AI.tldr: CueKFS：免训练的关键帧选择方法，将问题-帧匹配重构为帧与动态生成视觉线索（cues）的比对。从初始显著帧分解问题为线索，各线索并行探测视频定位自身证据，推理VLM智能体式修正线索集并重新探索，最后按存活线索分配预算。在三个基准、27个设置上全部取得SOTA，预算平均提升最高+4.54%，中位仅需2次VLM调用。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中，基于问题条件的关键帧选择比均匀采样更有效。但已有方法存在两类缺陷：(1) 纯相似度排序——当问题组合了任何单帧都不显示的主体或时刻，或需要措辞中未含的隐含信息时，相关帧相似度得分会很低；(2) 将问题分解为子查询的方法——因使用静态初始上下文，分解不准确。
AI.method: 免训练框架 CueKFS：1) 从初始显著帧集合出发，将问题分解为一组视觉线索（cues）；2) 每个线索并发探测视频，导航至自身证据；3) 用推理VLM智能体式地根据证据修正线索集，并据此重新探索视频（agentic cue refinement 驱动主动再探索）；4) 在存活的线索间分配帧预算。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，27个可对比设置全部实现SOTA；相较此前基线，预算平均增益最高达+4.54%；中位数仅需2次VLM调用；消融/行为分析显示智能体式线索精修带来最高92%的相对相似度提升（相对初始上下文）。
AI.conclusion: 动态视觉线索替代静态子查询，使关键帧选择能覆盖多主体/多时刻组合及隐含信息；免训练、低VLM调用开销，在长视频问答的关键帧选择任务上兼具效果与效率。

title: Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation
summary: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示建筑工地自动标注流水线对"低姿态"（跪姿、弯腰）工人的系统性漏检与过滤偏差，指出边界框与姿态线索不足以支撑长尾人体数据治理。
AI.motivation: 建筑机器人需识别跪姿、弯腰等"低姿态"工人以保障安全，但自动标注流水线在训练数据收集中易丢失这类样本；作者希望探究低姿态稀缺究竟是真实分布稀疏，还是流水线质量过滤带来的采集偏差。
AI.method: 采用"人体检测→NLF关节估计→相似姿态聚类"的三段式流水线，并对其质量过滤环节进行诊断：以四种替代姿态线索（边界框形状、身体垂直跨度、与场景垂直方向对齐的姿态分组、图像外观）检验过滤是否对低姿态有偏；另外在受控仿真场景中，用公开建筑数据集微调的人体检测器测试，并在将低姿态者的边界框高度校正为与站立者一致后再评估漏检。
AI.result: 保留样本中低姿态仅约占2%；四种替代线索一致表明低姿态更易被质量过滤拒绝；固定边界框高度后，微调检测器在仿真场景中对低姿态工人的漏检仍更多。
AI.conclusion: 低姿态样本既真实稀缺又难以被流水线捕获；边界框或姿态线索本身带有姿态相关偏差，不能作为长尾人体数据治理的可靠依据，需针对姿态分布设计更好的采集与过滤策略。

title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 提出融合解剖区域、边界框与区域级文本描述的医学报告生成框架，设计空间与事实奖励对推理过程做可验证强化学习，发现联合验证推理步骤与最终输出带来更大提升，并识别多种奖励攻击模式。
AI.motivation: 医学报告生成中幻觉严重，根源在于SFT只优化与参考报告的词汇相似度而非临床正确性；RL在有可验证奖励的数学、代码领域有效，但在开放式医学任务中应用有限，且现有工作只评价最终答案、忽略推理过程，而错误推理会拖累整体表现。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基座，先做医学域监督微调，再通过cold-start SFT引入推理能力，最后用强化学习精调；构造整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述的推理验证框架，并设计空间奖励与事实奖励，使推理同时具备视觉接地性和事实准确性。没有真实机器人实验。
AI.result: RL带来的性能增益超出仅靠SFT所能达到的水平；联合验证推理步骤与最终输出的提升大于单独验证任一项；在RL阶段发现多种奖励攻击（reward hacking）模式；模型的结构化思维链提升了可解释性，便于临床审计。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的推理过程奖励与结构化的思维轨迹能同时改善开放式医学多模态任务的正确性和可审计性，为缺乏可验证答案的领域引入RL提供了可行范式，但未涉及机器人或具身系统验证。

title: PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement
comment: Preprint. 14 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

AI.tldr: PredRA将强配对医学图像翻译中的残差生成过程视为优化问题，以确定性预测为稳定参考，并从中提取可确定成分，同时全局控制随机细化的注入量，从而兼顾保真度与感知质量，并以极少参数与采样步数取得竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中，源图像已蕴含大量可直接预测的成分。纯确定性预测会抹平细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节，却会引入多余甚至有害的变化。因此需要一个既能保留细节、又不引入无益不确定性的方案。
AI.method: 提出PredRA框架：1) 将确定性预测作为稳定参考（reference）；2) 在生成式细化过程中从残差中进一步提取额外确定性成分；3) 将整个基于残差的生成过程建模为优化问题并推导实用解法，在受控细化中恢复有用残差细节，同时保持预测靠近配对目标；4) 机制研究表明有用残差信息遵循结构化模式，但体素级可靠性难估，故改为全局控制残差细化注入到确定性预测中的比例，以抑制不必要不确定性累积。
AI.result: 多个真实世界数据集上验证：受控细化相比完整残差细化提升了与配对目标的保真度，同时保留生成式建模的大部分感知收益。PredRA以1.4–11.9倍更少的总参数量和3.1–26.2倍更少的可训练参数量，达到与显著更大的SOTA模型相当或更优的性能；其32步流采样器相比匹配的1000步DDPM减少31.25倍采样步数。
AI.conclusion: PredRA结合确定性成分提取与受控随机细化，实现了快速、保真且感知质量强的医学图像翻译，说明全局控制残差细化强度可在保真度与感知质量间取得有效平衡，并具备显著的效率优势。

title: Facial classification Using Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出混合量子-经典人脸识别流水线：图像经Gamma校正、对比度增强与PCA后，特征编码进8量子比特变分量子分类器，再用经典图像匹配完成识别；在CelebA+CIFAR-10共5万张图像上优于CPU训练的FaceNet基线，并在GPU与量子硬件及校园考勤部署中验证。
AI.motivation: 混合量子方法在资源受限的人脸生物识别场景中研究不足；作者希望验证在普通CPU硬件上部署量子-经典混合人脸识别的可行性，以提升准确率与训练效率。
AI.method: 预处理采用Gamma校正、对比度增强与PCA降维；将特征编码为8量子比特的变分量子分类器（VQC）；分类后由经典图像匹配模块完成识别。在CPU、GPU与量子硬件上分别评测，并进行实际考勤系统部署测试。
AI.result: 在5万张图像（CelebA人脸2.5万 + CIFAR-10非人脸2.5万）实验中，准确率与训练效率均超过所报告的CPU训练FaceNet基线；CPU推理耗时0.2–0.5秒/人，系统对佩戴眼镜保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在既有CPU硬件上部署混合量子人脸识别方法具有可行性，为量子-经典混合模型在生物特征识别领域的实用化提供了初步证据。

title: CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CaptchaArena：首个大规模细粒度交互式CAPTCHA求解训练数据集（5万题、20类、5种交互模式，含5万条截图-动作轨迹与4.6万条分步推理标注），据此训练9B单策略CaptchaAgent，SFT达70.5 Pass@1，RL提升至71.7。
AI.motivation: 交互式CAPTCHA对computer-use agent仍具挑战，现有数据集在类型覆盖、交互真实性与轨迹监督三方面存在权衡，缺少规模化且执行验证的细粒度监督数据。
AI.method: 构建CaptchaArena：50K题目覆盖20种CAPTCHA类型、5种交互模式，全部解经执行验证；提供50K截图-动作轨迹、46K分步推理标注，以及针对不规则目标的像素级掩码标注。在其上训练单一9B策略CaptchaAgent，先监督微调再用环境验证器直接提供奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: SFT达到70.5 Pass@1，RL进一步提升到71.7，并在两个外部benchmark上有性能改善。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、细粒度的computer-use监督对训练交互式CAPTCHA智能体有价值，数据集与模型已开源。

title: WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.

AI.tldr: WB-WAM 将显式全身动作监督（身体、根节点、灵巧手）引入生成式视频预训练，构建共享物理动作空间，在 1880.2 小时部分标注视频与运动数据上联合学习视频与动作；再经 PICO 中训练与辅助前向运动学监督适配到机器人任务。仿真 HumanoidArena 达 81.9%，真机五任务平均成功率 84.0%，并证明任务对齐中训练可减少真机示范需求。
AI.motivation: 人形全身移动-操作（loco-manipulation）要求身体与手部协调，但现有机器人预训练数据对全身运动覆盖有限，真机示范采集成本高。作者希望以异构人类视频/运动数据补充稀缺的机器人数据，实现数据高效的人形全身预训练与人类运动迁移。
AI.method: 提出 World Action Model（WB-WAM）：构建跨异构来源的共享物理动作空间，统一身体、根节点与灵巧手标注；在 1880.2 小时部分标注视频与运动数据上联合进行视频-动作生成式预训练；通过 PICO 中训练（mid-training）注入任务对齐的人体运动，并以辅助前向运动学监督适配机器人；构建 WB-Datasets，含重定向的自我中心人类示范与机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真 HumanoidArena 全身任务性能 81.9%；真机 5 项任务平均成功率 84.0%；任务对齐 PICO 中训练提升下游性能并降低真机示范需求。
AI.conclusion: 异构全身预训练与人类运动迁移是通向数据高效人形移动-操作的可行路径，显式全身动作监督的生成式世界模型可作为人形全身策略预训练范式。

title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
comment: 28 pages, 17 figures. Project website: this https URL
summary: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLE-Bench，一个面向编码智能体（coding agents）的机器人学习基准，覆盖交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计四类开发流程，将任务指标汇总为 RLE Index 并给出能力画像，附带案例研究。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基准主要评估单一产物（策略或控制器）的性能，无法覆盖编码智能体在真实机器人工程中所需的构建、集成、诊断、改进异构产物以及从多模态反馈中推理的能力，因此需要新的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 RLE-Bench，包含四类代表性机器人开发工作流（交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计）；对智能体提交的产物采用任务特定指标评估，包括智能体达成的成功率、训练出的策略、搭建的执行框架（harness）以及设计的机械结构；将指标聚合为 RLE Index 并输出按工作流划分的能力画像；并开展案例研究分析智能体行为。
AI.result: 报告了跨能力维度的编码智能体对比结果、总体 RLE Index 排名与工作流特定的能力画像，并通过案例研究展示了当前智能体的能力与局限。
AI.conclusion: RLE-Bench 将机器人评测从单一产物性能扩展到端到端工程能力，为编码智能体在机器人领域的系统比较提供基准，并指出机器人任务对智能体训练的机会。

title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
summary: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.

AI.tldr: 提出mmHRI，首个毫米波雷达引导的隐私保护人机交互框架，通过双流雷达表征学习与记忆式状态空间模型估计人体动作与3D姿态，并将估计结果转为文本指令驱动VLA策略，实现视觉遮挡下的闭环物体递送与取回，动作识别准确率85.09%。
AI.motivation: 现有HRI系统多依赖RGB相机持续观测人类以响应手势等非语言指令，在医院病房、餐厅等隐私敏感场景中受限于不可直接拍摄人类。作者希望用毫米波雷达穿透隐私屏障、不产生可识别影像的特性，构建保护隐私的人机交互方案。
AI.method: mmHRI包含两项关键设计：(1) 双流架构，联合学习未滤波的原始雷达张量与雷达点云，分别估计人体动作与3D姿态，以缓解雷达数据稀疏性；(2) 记忆式状态空间模型（MSSM），保留历史雷达特征以抑制姿态/动作的突变，缓解时序不一致。估计出的人体状态被转换为结构化文本机器人指令，用于控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现闭环操作与对人感知的反应。
AI.result: 在隐私保护帘幕遮挡设置下，动作识别准确率达85.09%，优于现有基于雷达的替代方案；机器人实验中在视觉遮挡条件下成功完成递送与取回，并在未见过的受试者、杂乱配置与不同环境中保持稳定任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 毫米波雷达可在无视觉影像的条件下支撑隐私保护的HRI，通过多模态雷达表征学习与文本指令接口对接VLA策略，为隐私敏感环境中的人机协作提供了可行路径。

title: Proprioceptive Force Estimation for Quadruped Locomotion and Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Payload forces must be accommodated during locomotion, while leash forces can specify desired motion. We investigate whether a shared three-dimensional force estimate in newtons, inferred from proprioceptive history under sustained loading, can support both tasks. An estimator and locomotion policy are jointly trained with supervised force and velocity outputs and learned latent context. The estimated force conditions locomotion and additionally generates planar-velocity and yaw-rate commands for leash guidance through an analytical map. In sustained-force simulation sweeps, temporal means of componentwise force root mean square error range from 1.44 to 2.83\,N. Compared with a domain-randomized baseline, the framework reduces velocity-tracking and base-orientation error scores by 21.6\% and 46.5\%, respectively, and increases mean survival from 68.29\% to 94.60\% in separate sustained-force tests. Unitree Go1 experiments demonstrate stationary vertical and horizontal force estimation, locomotion with an 8.5\,kg payload whose weight exceeds the 70\,N training force limit, and leash guidance using the same force-estimation interface.

AI.tldr: 提出共享三维力估计框架：从本体感受历史推断牛顿级受力，同时支撑负载承载与牵引绳引导，并在仿真与Unitree Go1上验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人在运动时需承受负载力，而牵引绳力可用于指定期望运动方向，二者本质都是外部力作用。作者希望用统一的三维力估计（而非分离的传感/建模）来同时服务这两个任务，减少对专用力传感器的依赖。
AI.method: 联合训练一个力估计器与运动策略，采用监督力/速度输出与学习到的隐上下文（latent context）。估计出的力一方面对运动策略进行条件化，另一方面通过解析映射生成平面速度与偏航角速度指令用于牵引绳引导，实现同一接口复用。
