AI.result: 持续受力仿真扫描中，各分量力RMSE的时间均值在1.44–2.83 N之间。与域随机化基线相比，速度跟踪与基座姿态误差评分分别降低21.6%和46.5%，平均存活率从68.29%提升至94.60%。Unitree Go1实验展示了静态竖直与水平力估计、承载8.5 kg（超过70 N训练力上限）负载行走，以及使用同一力估计接口的牵引绳引导。
AI.conclusion: 单一三维力估计接口可在仿真与真实四足平台上同时支持负载承载与牵引绳引导，具备跨任务复用性与一定的力上限外推能力，但实验范围限于四足本体与有限力场景。

title: GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出GAE统一学习框架，实现通用、低延迟的人形机器人全身遥操作，可平滑模仿多样、敏捷、富有表现力的人类行为。
AI.motivation: 人形化身需通过遥操作机器人延伸人类物理存在，要求系统能实现多样动态全身行为并保持响应式人机同步，现有方法难以兼顾通用性与低延迟。
AI.method: 构建异构来源（视频、动画、动捕）大规模人体运动数据集并标准化与增强；采用两阶段训练：特权生成器策略在仿真中跟踪人体运动参考并生成可行人形轨迹，可部署执行器策略在课程域随机化下学习跟踪这些轨迹；引入延迟条件预测机制自适应补偿端到端时延。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1与Westlake O1机器人上的仿真与真实实验表明，GAE使人形机器人能平滑模仿多样、敏捷、富有表现力的人类行为。
AI.conclusion: GAE为人形全身通用低延迟遥操作提供了统一框架，具备较强的通用性与实用价值。

title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 WAM-OPD，将 on-policy 蒸馏引入预训练世界动作模型（WAM），并设计 prefix-weighted trajectory replay（PWTR）用固定轨迹池与路径分数加权的代理重要性权重来避免蒸馏期间的重复环境交互，实现任务适配且不遗忘预训练能力。
AI.motivation: 预训练世界动作模型具备跨任务通用性，但把目标任务性能提升到专家水平且不损害预训练技能仍很困难。OPD 能让特定任务教师知识在"学生自身诱导分布"下迁移，避免直接拟合狭窄的任务数据分布；然而闭环操作中观测历史随策略演化而改变，需反复环境 rollout 维持 on-policy，仿真中代价高昂、真机上往往不可行。
AI.method: WAM-OPD：面向 WAM 的 on-policy 蒸馏框架。PWTR（prefix-weighted trajectory replay）：使用固定轨迹池，主体为初始学生策略 rollout，辅以任务特定教师 rollout 以扩大覆盖；对每条回放轨迹，令当前策略在连续存储的历史前缀条件下生成新的去噪路径，由任务特定教师在这些路径上提供监督；由于历史分布随策略演化发生偏移，用轨迹前缀累计路径分数导出代理重要性权重，对各决策的蒸馏损失重新加权。环境轨迹保持固定，去噪路径随策略刷新，从而无需额外环境交互。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验显示，蒸馏过程中无需额外环境交互即可完成任务适配；两种设定下 WAM-OPD 均提升目标任务性能，同时对未纳入适配的任务保持接近初始水平的表现（缓解灾难性遗忘）。
AI.conclusion: 将 on-policy 蒸馏扩展到世界动作模型，并用固定轨迹池上的前缀加权回放替代重复环境 rollout，可在离线采集数据条件下实现任务适配与预训练技能保留，为 WAM 的低成本专家级微调提供可行路径。

title: UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose. We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出统一动作表示UMR，将操作分解为世界系物体运动(World Flow)与相对本体末端的Ego Trajectory，并以0.5B参数的WEPVLA策略实现，配合数据高效策略DES，实现从人类示范到异构机器人的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有具身操作策略依赖本体特定的动作空间，导致跨本体示范难以规模化利用，并限制向新本体与空间变化的迁移。作者希望构建一个跨本体、易扩展的统一动作表示。
AI.method: UMR将操作分解为两个功能不同但几何关联的分量：本体无关的World Flow（世界系中任务相关物体运动）和Ego Trajectory（相对当前位姿的末端运动），二者通过SE(3)共轭耦合。实例化为WEPVLA：0.5B参数策略，含双流Point Action Adapter与统一Point Action Expert，在统一几何动作空间学习。补充DES数据高效策略：通过阶段感知的点云编辑多样化物体配置，同时保持示范的接触几何。
AI.result: 仿真中LIBERO平均成功率97.5%，10任务RLBench 85.7%。真实实验中，单一策略仅用人类示范（每任务约10分钟，无机器人示范）并经DES增强，零样本迁移到多种部署条件，六个评测设置平均成功率91.7%，对比HumanEgo的60.8%。
AI.conclusion: 统一几何动作表示UMR能有效打通人类示范到异构机器人的零样本迁移，显著降低真实数据需求，验证了跨本体动作空间设计的可行性与数据高效增强的价值。

title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
summary: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $\pi_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: RoboICL 是一个无需机器人专用参数更新、也无需学习 VLA 的上下文机器人控制框架：将"演示上下文"（已有示例）与"交互记忆"（模型自身动作与观测结果）分离，共用 observation–action–receipt–observation 语法，并用采样演示块与有界锚定记忆结合，从而在保持早期 rollout 经验的同时支持即时纠错。在 30 个 RoboDojo 任务上，相对官方零样本 GPT 系列模型各类别提升 20–27 分，Overall 50.64（最强基线 33.68）；真实机器人三任务上从零样本 14.45 提升到单样本 63.33、三样本 78.89。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉-语言模型（如 GPT 系列）在零样本机器人控制上很有前景，擅长开放式、语言或图像条件化的操作，但在高精度与长时程任务上明显偏弱。作者希望在既不进行机器人专用参数微调、也不训练专用 VLA 的前提下缩小这一差距，低成本地把通用模型的上下文学习能力用于机器人控制。
AI.method: 提出 RoboICL 的上下文机器人控制框架。核心设计有两点：（1）将 demonstration context（可用时提供录制示例）与 interaction memory（模型自身动作与观测结果）分离，二者共享统一的 observation–action–receipt–observation 语法表示；（2）为跨任务阶段保留经验，将采样演示块与有界锚定记忆组合——固定锚点保证早期 rollout 交互持续可用于上下文学习，最新交互用于即时纠错。可选地加入 Jev-gated 动作复用以减少模型调用次数。整个方法不更新参数、不训练 VLA。
AI.result: 在 30 个 RoboDojo 任务上（Open 类别零样本、其余类别单样本演示），RoboICL 相对官方零样本 GPT 系列模型在每个类别上提升 20–27 个 progress score 点；在 Memory 与 Open 类别领先排行榜基线，Precision 上与最强基线相当，Long-Horizon 上保持竞争力。30 任务 Overall 50.64，对比最强基线 33.68，相对提升约 50%。在另一组十个任务子集上得分 60.60，与 π0.5 + GPT 系列的混合方法相差 2.00 分以内。真实机器人三个任务上平均 progress 从零样本 14.45 提升至单样本 63.33 与三样本 78.89。两个开发任务上，可选 Jev-gated 动作复用使模型调用减少 33–48%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将演示与交互记忆结构化分离并共享统一的观察–动作–回执–观察语法，RoboICL 证明无需参数更新或专用 VLA，即可用上下文学习显著增强通用视觉-语言模型在高精度、长时程及开放任务上的机器人控制能力，并在仿真基准与真实机器人上一致有效，同时可借助动作复用降低推理成本。

title: SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 3 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Code and benchmark: this https URL
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|\pi|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE：单LLM具身规划器，用零token的符号化前置条件门控（运行时安全监控）加局部后缀编辑修复，配合种子+在线混合记忆；在AI2-THOR 75任务上揭示基准饱和，并以更少LLM调用实现可比恢复能力。
AI.motivation: LLM作为具身家用智能体的认知核心，其输出计划在执行前缺少基于环境接地模型的校验；同时现有任务成功率基准已饱和，无法区分方法优劣，导致安全性与真实能力评估失真。
AI.method: SAGE由两个轻量机制构成：(1) 领域无关的符号门控（约250行Python、零token、O(|π|)复杂度），以带类型的原因阻止违反前置条件的动作，作为执行前verify-before-execute的运行时安全监控；(2) 局部编辑，仅重新生成失败子目标的后缀，保留已完成与未触及的工作；辅以种子+在线混合记忆存储支持冷启动。评估采用无泄漏协议（leave-one-out检索），覆盖5个开源权重模型与75任务AI2-THOR基准，并加入注入式中途失败与多目标组合测试。
AI.result: 标准基准上目标完整性饱和（52%实例被轻易解出），SAGE与强分层基线打平；在更难的、方法无关的多目标组合上，SAGE完整性领先重现（跨四个模型+0.06至+0.23）。注入中途失败时，SAGE以2.4-3.3倍更少的LLM调用达到与整计划重规划相当的恢复可靠性。符号监控在动作执行前阻止不安全动作，对每个被测规划器都提升模拟器报告的步级成功率（最高+0.11），且验证器无法看到该信号（非循环）。门控不调用模型（0.008 ms/plan），在Jetson AGX Orin上可复现同等规划质量。
AI.conclusion: SAGE表明廉价、零token的符号安全门控加局部修复可成为边缘端近乎免费的安全层，并揭示饱和基准掩盖了方法差异；开源基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控测试框架及验证器可移植性研究（ALFWorld自动诱导，留出集0.89）。

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
comment: Accepted by CoRL 2026, also presented at IROS 2026 Human-Robot Dialogue workshop
summary: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯主动学习框架，用LLM初始化并对比生成澄清问题，同时用贝叶斯优化维护用户意图不确定性并选最大信息增益查询，收敛后推断出的STL规范交给形式化规划器生成可验证轨迹。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指令常模糊、不完整或欠指定，机器人需推断并执行真实人类意图；直接依赖LLM驱动多轮对话进行澄清会引入系统性失败，因此需要把澄清建模为对接地任务的主动学习问题。
AI.method: 以 grounded STL 任务规范为假设空间，用LLM初始化候选形式化规范并将有信息量的对比转写为自然语言澄清问题；贝叶斯优化对用户意图做不确定性估计并选信息增益最大的查询；收敛后将推断出的STL规范送入形式化规划器合成可验证的机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个仿真与真实任务域上，方法总体取得更高的任务满足度、所需澄清轮数少于LLM基线，并帮助较小模型缩小与较大推理模型之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的概率化先验与贝叶斯主动学习的严谨不确定性管理结合，可在保证形式化可验证性的前提下提升人机澄清效率与任务成功率。

title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Frontier models can now perform well on individual embodied navigation tasks through multi-round multimodal reasoning with simple tools. Across successive tasks, however, an agent must also rely on an evolving map and earlier search records, both of which may be incomplete or conflict with new observations. We present NavHarness, a training-free embodied harness towards lifelong navigation that makes memory processing part of the navigation loop. During navigation, its multi-round agentic session draws on maps, task records, and house knowledge, checking them against observations and recording corrections to guide its actions. NavHarness preserves this experience across fresh conversations for new tasks or recovery attempts, while outcome verification and run-end summaries support its later reuse. On GOAT-Bench, NavHarness improves s-SR over context-only independent sessions by 18.6 points with Astra and 22.6 with Opus 5. Using SLAM-estimated poses, NavHarness with GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art task success of 83.7 s-SR with 36.9 e-SR on GOAT-Bench and 85.9 s-SR on IR2R-CE. To understand these gains, we examine how experience is carried between sessions and find that structured recovery handovers outperform length-matched summaries. In extended deployments across houses, consolidation improves navigation beyond retaining maps and task records, with case studies showing how agents use earlier experience to interpret new goals, investigate unresolved questions, and resume failed searches. We suggest that progress towards lifelong navigation depends on how successive reasoning sessions build on prior experience, alongside improvements in single-task capability.

AI.tldr: NavHarness：一种免训练的具身导航框架，将记忆处理纳入导航闭环，跨任务保持并复用地图、任务记录与房屋知识，在 GOAT-Bench 上显著提升 s-SR。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型在单任务具身导航上表现良好，但跨连续任务时需依赖不断演化的地图与先前搜索记录，这些记忆往往不完整或与新观测冲突。作者希望解决"终身导航"中跨会话经验累积与复用的问题。
AI.method: 提出 NavHarness——免训练（training-free）具身 harness。其多轮 agentic 会话在导航循环中调用地图、任务记录与房屋知识，与观测进行一致性校验并记录修正以指导动作；跨新任务或恢复尝试时在新对话中保留该经验；通过结果验证与运行结束总结支持后续复用。使用 SLAM 估计位姿。<begin_of_box>NavHarness 是一种免训练的具身导航框架（harness），将记忆处理整合进导航循环。</begin_of_box>
AI.result: GOAT-Bench 上，相对仅上下文独立会话，s-SR 提升 18.6 分（Astra）与 22.6 分（Opus 5）。使用 SLAM 位姿时，GPT-6 Astra 达 83.7 s-SR、36.9 e-SR（SOTA），IR2R-CE 上 85.9 s-SR。经验传递消融显示结构化恢复交接（structured recovery handover）优于等长摘要；跨房屋部署中，经验整合优于仅保留地图与任务记录。
AI.conclusion: 迈向终身导航的进展不仅取决于单任务能力提升，还取决于连续推理会话如何在前序经验上构建与复用。结构化经验交接与跨会话整合是关键设计要素。

title: TLC-DiT: Task-Aligned Local Visual Conditioning for Robust Multitask Robot Manipulation
summary: Language-conditioned robot policies have made clear progress in multitask manipulation, but task-relevant local visual evidence usually stays hidden inside a visual backbone or attention layers. This leaves the policy difficult to inspect and fragile under visual change, two symptoms of a missing explicit, task-aligned local visual channel. We present TLC-DiT, a plug-in extension of the Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps without changing the diffusion objective or the action-generation process. For each camera view, frozen DINOv2 patch features are modulated by the CLIP task embedding through FiLM and refined by a lightweight CoordConv CNN adapter into smooth spatial maps, which are concatenated with the original global image, language, joint-state, and timestep conditions. On LIBERO, TLC-DiT reaches a 93.5% average success rate, compared with 86.5% for Multitask DiT and 79.25% for SmolVLA. On LIBERO-plus, the total success rate improves from 54.07% to 57.24%, with larger gains under camera, background, and sensor-noise changes. In real-world bimanual tasks, TLC-DiT raises Teabag Putting completion from 44% to 89% while maintaining comparable Match Box Opening performance. Feature-map visualizations confirm that the model attends to task-relevant regions across views and perturbations, providing a direct way to inspect the visual evidence.

AI.tldr: TLC-DiT：在 Multitask DiT 策略上插入任务引导的局部视觉特征图通道（DINOv2 patch + CLIP FiLM 调制 + CoordConv CNN 适配），不改变扩散目标与动作生成流程，提升 LIBERO/ LIBERO-plus 与真实双臂操作性能并提供可检视的视觉证据热图。
AI.motivation: 语言条件多任务操作策略虽进步明显，但任务相关的局部视觉证据被隐式编码在视觉 backbone 或注意力层内部，导致策略难以检视、在视觉扰动下脆弱。作者认为根因是缺少显式、任务对齐的局部视觉通道。
AI.method: 以 Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 策略为底座做插件式扩展：每个相机视角使用冻结 DINOv2 的 patch token 特征，经 CLIP 任务嵌入的 FiLM 调制，再由轻量 CoordConv CNN adapter 精炼为平滑空间特征图；该特征图与原全局图像、语言嵌入、关节状态、时间步条件拼接作为扩散策略条件。保持扩散目标函数与动作生成采样过程不变。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 93.5%，高于 Multitask DiT 的 86.5% 与 SmolVLA 的 79.25%；LIBERO-plus 总成功率由 54.07% 提升至 57.24%，在相机、背景、传感器噪声扰动下增益更大；真实双臂任务 Teabag Putting 完成率由 44% 提升到 89%，Match Box Opening 性能持平；特征图可视化显示模型在不同视角与扰动下聚焦任务相关区域。
AI.conclusion: 显式任务引导的局部视觉通道可作为即插即用模块，在不改动扩散策略训练/推理框架的前提下提升多任务操作成功率与视觉鲁棒性，同时让局部视觉证据可被直接检视，为策略可解释性提供途径。

title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
summary: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应隐空间安全滤波器：用世界模型预测与观测推断隐状态之间的偏差，通过自适应保形推断在线构造不确定性集合，并在集合上对学习到的 HJ 安全值函数做悲观最小化，从而在模型准确时保守度最小、模型失配时更谨慎，并给出有限时间覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 隐空间安全滤波通常在世界模型动力学上学习 Hamilton-Jacobi 安全值函数，但世界模型本身有偏、失准或"自信地错误"，值函数会继承这些误差，导致过度自信的安全估计。现有方法依赖集成分歧或值-目标一致性残差等辅助信号进行自适应，但这些信号在世界模型预测偏离观测时仍可能保持很小，无法可靠指示模型失配。
AI.method: 以直接观测到的世界模型误差为校准信号：用 Adaptive Conformal Inference（ACI）在"预测隐状态"与"由观测推断的隐状态"的差异上构造在线不确定性集合；随后在该集合上对所学 HJ 安全值函数取最小值（悲观评估），得到对安全性的保守下界。相比依赖间接残差的方案，该方法直接把模型失配纳入滤波决策，并给出自适应不确定性半径的有限时间覆盖性保证。
AI.result: 在仿真与硬件实验中，相比当前最先进的隐空间安全滤波器，显著降低了失败次数（安全性提升），同时保持了任务完成率（未因过度保守而牺牲性能）。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型误差显式、在线地转化为安全值函数的悲观校准，是提升隐空间安全滤波鲁棒性的有效途径；ACI + 集合内最小化为自适应保守度提供了有理论保证、可实用的实现范式，且兼顾安全性收益与任务完成。

title: Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: this https URL
summary: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出预测语义安全(PSS)框架，用VLM预测物理事件与时间、经保形预测校准得到未来占据区域，再据此修正名义控制输入以保障后备机动可行，MuJoCo中Unitree Go1安全率99.3% vs 基线43.3%。
AI.motivation: 机器人当前几何感知无法反映物理交互引发的未来隐患（如物体坠落、支撑失效、接触传播），仅基于当前障碍几何的安全滤波会失效，需要将视觉物理推理与安全滤波耦合起来。
AI.method: VLM预测物理事件及其时序或直接预测物体位移；显式运动模型将事件假设转成物体轨迹；分裂保形预测在指定物体、观测时刻与未来时刻上联合校准位置误差；几何形状包围盒把位置区域转为预测占据；PSS对给定后备机动评估该占据，导出输入仿射约束，在机器人动力学与输入限幅下最小化修改名义输入并保持后备可行。
AI.result: MuJoCo中Unitree Go1实验涵盖灯具坠落、冲击导致支撑丧失与接触传播三类场景，PSS安全回合率99.3%，仅用当前障碍几何的BCBF基线为43.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM物理事件预测与保形校准、后备可行安全滤波结合，可显著提升动态物理隐患下的安全性；但证据限于仿真，缺少真机验证与开源信息。

title: FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.

title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

AI.tldr: 提出隐式指称落地(IRG)能力概念与RoboIRG-Bench基准(基于RoboMME的40个变体/11任务/4类挑战)，评估多种记忆机制VLA，发现显式指令下表现好的模型在隐式指称下性能显著下降，并在Franka Research 3真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA基准假设任务相关信息在指令中显式给出，但真实人类常以隐式方式指代物体、数量和关系，需机器人从语言与感知上下文中恢复目标，该能力此前缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建RoboIRG-Bench基准，基于RoboMME扩展出11个任务、40个变体，覆盖直接、推理中介、空间、上下文四类指称落地挑战；评测具有不同记忆机制的代表性VLA模型，并在Franka Research 3机械臂上做真机验证。
AI.result: 发现明显的指称鲁棒性差距：显式指令表现良好的模型在需从上下文恢复信息时性能急剧下降；推理中介与空间指称最难；使用外部VLM的模型更鲁棒但仍大量失败，更换更强外部VLM也不能消除差距；真机上差距持续存在，表现为指称错误与下游执行失败。
AI.conclusion: IRG是机器人可靠指令跟随的一个独立且被忽视的能力，亟需能稳健整合语言、感知、推理与动作的VLA模型。

title: Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, plus 25-page online appendix (included). Under review
summary: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文结合面部识别大样本分析与预注册实验，发现女性议员在电视新闻中更常被置入分屏画面，分屏框架会降低其政治胜任力感知，而动态视频与情绪化语言对男女议员的影响不对称。
AI.motivation: 女性在国会中的比例长期低于30%，其在电视新闻中的可见度亦受限。既有研究多关注女性议员是否出现，却很少探讨其以何种视觉方式被呈现，而视觉呈现可能塑造公众对其胜任力与权威性的判断。作者因此希望揭示视觉框架如何影响女性议员的媒介可见度与能力感知。
AI.method: 研究分为两部分。第一，对CNN与福克斯新闻2011至2021年间695,464个图文片段进行面部识别分析，统计女性议员在分屏与单人镜头中的出现比例。第二，开展两项预注册实验，共6,220名被试，分别测试静态画面中的分屏框架效应、动态视频中的分屏与愤怒语言效应，并考察女性观众的外部政治效能感。
AI.result: 面部识别分析显示女性议员在分屏镜头中比例失衡地偏高。静态画面实验表明分屏框架降低女性议员的感知政治胜任力，对男性议员无此影响；动态视频中胜任力惩罚消失，但愤怒语言使女性议员的感知温暖度下降约为男性议员的三倍。提示性证据（p = .057）显示女性观众在观看女性议员单独出镜后报告更高的外部政治效能感。
AI.conclusion: 视觉框架不仅影响女性议员的媒介可见度，也影响公众对其能力的感知。分屏、镜头形式与情绪化语言对男女政治人物产生不对称效果，说明媒介呈现方式是政治性别不平等的重要机制。

title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
summary: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究在固定编码器与预训练数据的前提下，系统对比九种视觉-语言预训练目标（全局/局部对比学习、图文生成及其组合）在五个空间粒度递增的胸片任务上的表现，揭示预训练粒度与任务粒度、目标类型之间的交互决定下游性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种差异对胸片（CXR）解读的影响尚缺乏系统研究。既有工作多混杂编码器、数据与目标变量，难以归因于目标本身。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定编码器与预训练数据，训练九种预训练目标，涵盖全局对比、局部对比、图像描述（captioning）及其两两组合；在五个空间粒度递增的胸片任务上进行评测。
AI.result: （i）极端粒度上预训练粒度与任务粒度对齐：局部目标在异常检测占优，全局目标在分类占优；（ii）局部目标在全局级生成与问答任务上出乎意料地有竞争力；（iii）captioning 与对比学习的优势随粒度层级反转；（iv）组合目标中，captioning+对比监督在分类与分布内生成最强，两个 captioning 目标配对在零样本报告生成上泛化最佳。
AI.conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的预训练目标；目标类型、空间粒度与下游任务的交互共同决定性能，需按任务粒度进行目标选择与组合设计。

title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
summary: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出联邦学习框架用于模拟仪表读数，四阶段流水线（表盘定位、联邦细结构分割、极坐标展开、刻度计数解码），并发布 MeterFL 数据集（1382 张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性构建伪客户端，含 dHash 近重复控制）。
AI.motivation: 模拟仪表广泛部署但环境与表型各异，传统自动抄表需逐场景定制；深度学习需大量标注数据，而现场图像受所有权、治理与隐私限制无法汇聚，且各站点标注稀缺。故需在不共享原始图像的条件下进行多站点协同训练。
AI.method: 联邦学习框架下的四阶段流水线：1）表盘定位；2）细结构（指针/刻度）分割，跨客户端联邦训练；3）极坐标展开；4）刻度计数解码得出读数。同时发布 MeterFL 数据集，用确定性规则依据视觉属性划分伪客户端，并以 dHash 控制分割训练/测试划分间的近重复泄漏。
AI.result: 在 MeterFL 上同时评估分割质量与端到端读数精度；数据集已公开。摘要未给出具体量化提升数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将联邦学习引入视觉模拟仪表读数，规避原始图像共享的隐私与治理约束，并提供面向该设定的系统化评测基准。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.tldr: TriO 是一种多模态无监督世界模型,以相机、LiDAR、RADAR 互为输入与自监督信号,同时预测 4D 占用、障碍分割、光流与 LiDAR,并在 Argoverse 2 与 Spotting the Unexpected 上取得多项 SOTA 及零样本道路障碍分割结果。
AI.motivation: 现有占用预测与开集方法依赖人工标注,且在长尾物体与道路障碍上泛化不足;需要一种无需额外标注、能跨模态自监督并分割任意占用的世界模型。
AI.method: TriO 将相机、LiDAR、RADAR 三种模态统一作为输入与自监督来源(跨模态预测作为监督信号),在多模态框架下联合输出 4D 占用、障碍分割、流与 LiDAR 预测,无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在 4D 占用、流、LiDAR 预测等多项 3D/4D 任务上取得 SOTA,并在多个数据集的零样本道路障碍分割上超越现有开集方法。
AI.conclusion: 多模态自监督世界模型可有效突破开集感知的长尾瓶颈,为自动驾驶场景理解提供可扩展的预训练范式。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: this https URL
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: Depth Any Seen: Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) for visible surface depth sets; improves support recovery, cuts overprediction 88.2%/80.5%, code to be released.
AI.motivation: 单目图像中一条光线常可见多个表面，恢复可见3D结构需同时估计表面存在性与度量深度。现有方法（如depth stacking）在多层可见表面上易产生过预测，且把深度与存在性联合建模的目标函数存在组件-表面分配不明确的问题。
AI.method: 将可见表面建模为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合（multi-Bernoulli depth sets），每个分量输出一个深度或缺失；提出无需辅助损失的精确多伯努利目标ExactMB，通过对完备且互异目标的一对一分配做边缘化来同时学习深度与存在性（presence）；并引入有序分配（ordered assignment）与计数正则化（count-regularized）两种配置，在扩展的真实与合成多层深度基准上评估深度精度、恢复支撑集与过预测。
AI.result: 相比depth stacking，ExactMB在LD-Real上过预测相对减少88.2%，在MD-3K上减少80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，并在LD-Syn上具有可比的条件下度量深度误差；消融显示有序分配相比边缘化提升了深度准确的召回与精确率，而计数正则化配置在较低召回下取得更高的更深秩（deeper-rank）精确率。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了匹配期望计数不足以解决组件-表面分配问题的缺陷，ExactMB通过一对一分配边缘化有效抑制多层可见表面的过预测，是有代码发布的前馈可见层深度估计方法；但真机/部署级证据缺失，属于3D重建核心但偏方法性工作。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScreenHaystack 基准，通过动态移动目标图标测量 GUI grounding 模型的空间一致性，揭示"盲区"现象，并用盲区导向的数据增强缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评测将目标固定在同一位置，无法反映模型对空间位置的鲁棒性；作者怀疑模型存在位置相关的系统性失败区域。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenHaystack 动态基准：在高分辨率 GUI 背景上系统重定位受控目标图标，量化 grounding 一致性；对 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等模型做探测，验证盲区在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上的迁移性；通过受控合成实验证明训练数据空间覆盖不均会导致盲区；提出 blind-zone-oriented augmentation，在盲区补充监督信号，并与原始及随机增强的 Click-100k 微调对比。
AI.result: 主流 GUI grounding 模型普遍存在盲区；Qwen3-VL-8B 在盲区内目标上下降 16.1 个百分点；将目标迁入盲区精度下降、迁出则提升，证明因果性；盲区导向增强在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上优于原始与随机增强微调。
AI.conclusion: GUI grounding 的空间可靠性可由数据空间覆盖偏差解释，针对盲区的定向数据增强是简单有效的改进手段。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: this https URL
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ControlGS 将 XR 显示端后处理与光学链路建模进 3DGS 优化目标，并依据下游处理参数动态生成高斯原语，实现端到端视觉质量优化。
AI.motivation: XR 用户看到的并非渲染引擎的直接输出，图像还要经过后处理管线与显示光学路径，且该下游处理会随相机位姿、显示功耗预算等运行时因素变化。传统 3DGS 或假设该链路保真，或无法适应其变化，导致端到端视觉质量次优。
AI.method: 提出 ControlGS：把渲染输出到人眼之间的完整下游处理纳入优化目标进行端到端建模；在运行时以下游处理参数为条件动态生成高斯原语，使表示随处理链路自适应变化。
AI.result: 在多种神经高斯骨干与数据集上，ControlGS 一致提升后光学 XR 端到端质量，且额外开销极小。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将下游显示与光学链路纳入可微优化、并做参数条件化高斯生成，是提升 XR 高斯渲染体验的有效且轻量的范式。

title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
summary: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场/综述型论文，提出"无状态性瓶颈"概念，将持久化、有证据支撑的文档状态形式化为统一框架，并设计"状态性审计"与纵向基准测试方案，主张 Document AI 下一阶段将由跨文档、跨会话、跨时间的"保留内容"来定义。
AI.motivation: 当前 Document AI（合同字段抽取、表格推理、页面区域答案溯源）被实现为无状态函数：处理次日修订稿时从零开始，不保留 schema、不检测矛盾、不积累经验。作者认为这不是规模失败，而是结构性选择——存储提供持久性、检索提供访问，但两者都不把观察"固化"为可改进未来处理的知识。因此需要把"持久、有证据支撑的文档状态"确立为一个统一的研究框架。
AI.method: 纯概念与度量框架工作，无模型或实验：(1) 将 persistent evidence-grounded document state 形式化，规定把多模态证据转化为持久、可溯源状态的必需操作与不变量（invariants）；(2) 提出"状态性审计（statefulness audit）"，按 8 条状态性判据对 10 个代表性基准编码评估；(3) 推导纵向基准测试框架（longitudinal benchmark harness），定义五项反事实度量：Experience Gain、Cost Efficiency、Memory Harm、Forgetting Fidelity、Coverage Retention，用以刻画持久文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。
AI.result: 审计发现：所考察的十个代表性基准均未测试跨会话的状态演化（cross-session state evolution 空白）；并指出 Document AI 目前缺乏将持久状态与文档原生结构、溯源信息、时间有效性相耦合的机制。论文未给出任何实证数据、系统实现或定量结果。
AI.conclusion: Document AI 缺失的核心能力是把持久状态与文档原生结构、provenance 与 temporal validity 耦合起来的机制。作者主张下一时代的 Document AI 将由系统在文档之间、会话之间与时间维度上保留了什么来定义。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: ReFM将动作重定向重新表述为渐进式精炼过程：先用SO(3)规范化器消除冗余全局朝向变化，再用对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器提供角色不变表征，随后通过学到的流场在语义一致性、物理合理性、时序连贯性与最小修改四项能量引导下逐步精炼目标动作，兼容动作复制与HumanIK等初始化策略。
AI.motivation: 既有重定向方法依赖向复制动作约束来保语义，会把有效关节线索与骨骼比例/体型不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起；且重定向本质欠定，一次性回归唯一配对目标受限，难以兼顾语义保真与目标角色的物理、时序约束，同时缺少高质量配对数据来学习源动作语义。
AI.method: 提出ReFM源网格无关的能量引导模型：1）SO(3)规范化器去除冗余全局朝向变化；2）通过对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器，提供角色不变表征用于优化指导与语义评价；3）以学到的流场对初始化目标动作渐进精炼，能量项包含语义一致性、物理合理性、时序连贯性与最小动作修改；框架兼容直接动作复制与Autodesk HumanIK初始化。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；框架在统一表述下兼容动作复制与HumanIK（工业级全身IK重定向）两类初始化，并利用对比学习编码器支撑语义引导与语义评估，从而避免对配对重定向数据的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 重定向应被建模为受多目标能量约束的渐进精炼问题而非单次配对回归，角色不变的语义表征与源网格无关的设计是兼顾语义保真与目标物理可行性的关键。

title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于2D Gaussian图像表示的隐写方法：将信息嵌入高斯参数（对数各向异性、不透明度、颜色亮度）而非像素，配合密钥选择子集微调嵌入8位消息，正确密钥可零误码恢复，错误密钥BER接近随机猜测，视觉代价仅0.091 dB。
AI.motivation: 2D Gaussian图像表示日益流行，但其参数空间作为信息载体的潜力尚未被探索；传统像素域隐写易受压缩与视觉检测影响，需要一种在高保真重建下仍可可靠隐藏信息的新范式。
AI.method: 先对目标图像拟合2D Gaussian参数，再用密钥选取部分参数进行微调，通过三类参数（log-anisotropy、opacity、color luminance）嵌入8位消息，并比较"密钥随机选择"与"扰动最小选择"两种策略。
AI.result: 3张合成图30次拟合：正确密钥零误码，错误密钥BER 0.543（近随机猜测）；扰动最小选择恢复更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB；在112张256×256自然图像、4096个高斯上正确密钥BER=0.000，错误密钥0.520。九次拟合简化设置中去除颜色亮度（参数类型减少33.3%），正确密钥仍零误码，但错误密钥BER由0.514升至0.571。
AI.conclusion: 高斯参数空间可作为有效隐写载体，在保持高视觉保真度的同时实现近零误码恢复与良好的密钥安全性；减少参数类型会削弱安全裕度，提示嵌入容量与隐蔽性之间存在权衡。

title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalDriveBench，基于 Pearl 因果层级（PCH）评估驾驶 VLA 的因果推理，包含 7,285 条因果 QA 与 1,000 条反事实轨迹，发现最强模型仅 70.6% 准确率，且因果 QA 与轨迹精度统计不相关。
AI.motivation: 驾驶 VLA 模型会输出自然语言推理与预测轨迹，但其推理是否真正反映场景的因果结构从未被系统检验；现有评测无法区分感知显著性与因果相关性。
AI.method: 在 nuScenes 上构建因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体；以 PCH 四层级（关联、干预、反事实、因果发现）生成结构化 VQA，并在高层级提供场景修改下的参考轨迹进行动作级验证；共 7,285 条经核验的因果 QA 与 1,000 条反事实轨迹，评测 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型 QA 准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中 4 个低于随机水平；与共享语言骨干的通用 VLM 相比，驾驶微调的因果 QA 代价为 2–34 个百分点，差异由后训练设计解释；因果 QA 与轨迹精度跨模型统计不相关，反事实提示下轨迹要么过度反应要么坍缩回观测场景基线。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的推理文本和准确的观测场景轨迹都不能作为因果理解的证据，驾驶 VLA 的因果推理能力仍显著不足。

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: PruneForget：将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，用遗忘集指导剪枝，使二者互相受益，同时移除遗忘样本影响并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现实中遗忘请求与延迟/内存预算常同时存在，但已有工作把遗忘与剪枝当作独立问题串行处理，忽略了二者在"删除参数"上的天然一致性。
AI.method: 提出 PruneForget，将遗忘集作为剪枝的引导信号——编码了待遗忘样本信息的参数即为自然剪枝目标，从而在同一框架内联合求解遗忘与剪枝。
AI.result: 在图像分类器与生成模型上，PruneForget 既能移除遗忘样本的影响，又得到更紧凑、推理开销更低的模型，性能与"从头重训再剪枝"的 oracle 差距可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝是自然对齐的，应当联合建模；PruneForget 验证了联合求解的可行性与有效性。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: PQR3D 是一种相机-only 多视角 3D 检测器，通过在参考条件时间窗内进行渐进式查询精化，摆脱流式检测器的持续查询记忆依赖，实现随机帧采样与独立推理，在 nuScenes test 上达到 71.6 NDS / 64.9 mAP。
AI.motivation: 现有流式检测器需维护并跨帧传播查询状态，导致必须进行序列感知训练和按时间顺序推理，灵活性差。作者希望保留时序上下文收益的同时，去除持久查询记忆的约束。
AI.method: 提出 PQR3D，在参考条件时间窗内做渐进式查询精化：将早期时间戳的运动对齐高置信查询逐步传递到目标帧；引入掩码自注意力，规范常规查询、传播查询与去噪查询之间的交互，并将去噪监督与检测查询隔离；设计阶段解耦锚点嵌入，在自注意力前注入位置，之后注入尺寸、朝向与速度，减少时序不一致属性的干扰。骨干为 ViT-L。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes test set 上取得新 SOTA，71.6 NDS 与 64.9 mAP，并开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 通过时间窗内查询传播与阶段解耦嵌入，PQR3D 在无需持续查询记忆和时序推理的前提下超越了流式检测器，验证了窗口式时序建模的有效性。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: OneFixer：面向自动驾驶仿真的单步自回归视频扩散修复器，通过"部署匹配的共享 rollout"（自身一步预测既作因果上下文又接受像素级感知监督）在单一适配阶段联合学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，并用车道几何与动态智能体状态提升几何保真，在 900 帧 rollout 下取得最优 FVD/LPIPS/DISTS 并将闭环碰撞率降低约三分之一。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 在自动驾驶仿真中需要渲染时的视频修复器，但部署要求低延迟下的高画质与时序一致性；单步因果生成尤为困难，因为每个不完美的预测会立即成为后续帧的上下文。现有方法依赖多模块分阶段训练与 rollout 感知正则，单步质量仍不达标，且需双向到因果转换或教师-学生蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出 OneFixer，单任务适配阶段训练的单步自回归视频扩散修复器。核心是部署匹配的共享 rollout：模型自身的一步预测作为 flow matching 的因果上下文，使训练暴露于部署时误差；同一次 rollout 直接接受像素空间感知监督以保留细节。由于为当前帧质量优化的预测正是被重用为未来上下文的预测，保真度与自回归鲁棒性被联合学习，无需双向转因果或蒸馏。此外利用驾驶仿真易得的车道几何与动态智能体状态线索改善几何保真。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 与专有驾驶场景、900 帧 rollout 设置下，OneFixer 在单步生成中取得所有基线中最低的 FVD、LPIPS 和 DISTS，时序一致性匹配或超过多阶段 DMD 流程。在相同骨干与条件设置下，以不到一半的 GPU 小时数达到多阶段 DMD+Self-Forcing 流水线的水平，且在其平台期后继续提升。在带驾驶策略的闭环仿真中，相较原始 3DGS 渲染将碰撞率降低三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 单步自回归视频扩散修复器可在无多阶段训练、无蒸馏的条件下同时获得高保真与时序稳定，且计算成本显著低于多阶段方案，并能通过闭环碰撞率等下游指标验证其对驾驶仿真的实际价值。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出面向无线边缘的联邦3D-GS训练框架：端侧高斯点重要性评估与剪枝的模型轻量化机制 + 无需相机参数的结构一致性恢复机制，实现低时延、高保真的大场景协同训练。
AI.motivation: 大场景3D-GS训练若在无线边缘进行，面临四重瓶颈：边缘设备通信/算力/GPU显存受限；各本地模型结构不一致（高斯点数量与分布不同）导致无法有效聚合；原始视觉内容与相机参数上传存在隐私泄漏风险。现有联邦3D-GS方法未同时解决资源约束与结构异构聚合问题。
AI.method: 1) 端侧模型轻量化：量化评估每个高斯点的重要性，按"重要性-时延比"准则在GPU显存与计算/通信时延约束下自适应确定剪枝数量，平衡渲染质量与训练效率；2) 3D-GS模型恢复机制：在不访问私有相机参数的前提下恢复各本地模型间的结构一致性，使其可被有效聚合为全局模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，相比当前最先进的联邦3D-GS基线，该方法显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量，并降低训练时延。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将联邦学习与3D-GS大场景重建结合，通过重要性驱动的自适应剪枝与免相机参数的结构一致性恢复，在严格资源约束下实现了资源高效、隐私友好的协同训练，为边缘端分布式3D场景重建提供了可行路径。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出双耳视听实例分割新任务BiAVIS，利用双耳音频的耳间差与头相关滤波构建空间先验，配合查询级视听融合解码器，在两个新基准上显著超越单耳AVS方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视听分割（AVS）方法多基于单耳音频设置，仅依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类别中外观相似的多个发声实例，缺乏物理层面的空间线索。
AI.method: 受人类双耳听觉中耳间差与方向相关声学滤波提供空间线索的启发，定义双耳视听实例分割（BiAVIS）任务；基于已有双耳视听数据集人工标注，并新采集真实场景数据集BiAVIS-Bench，建立两个基准；提出BiAVIS模型：先用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频中学习发声实例的空间与语义先验，再以查询级（query-level）视听融合策略将这些先验注入实例分割解码器。
AI.result: 在两个基准上实验，BiAVIS模型优于此前单耳AVS方法，尤其在解决实例级类内歧义方面；在更具挑战性的BiAVIS-Bench上，mAP较最佳单耳基线提升17.22%，FSLA提升7.71%。
AI.conclusion: 双耳空间线索可有效缓解视听实例分割中的类内歧义，BiAVIS任务、基准与模型为后续研究提供了新方向与评测平台。

title: Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA2027)
summary: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出基于B超图像的无接触力传感的接触感知阻抗控制方法，实现探头-组织接触点在线估计并动态更新交互坐标系，提升机器人超声成像安全性。
AI.motivation: 机器人超声成像需要可靠感知探头与组织的接触状态与位置，但仅依赖力传感器存在残余力偏置问题，且无法感知物理接触点位置，影响安全性与成像精度。
AI.method: 以B-mode超声图像为接触反馈：独立于力测量检测声学接触，实现接触条件下的力/力矩零偏消除；接触期间沿曲面探头连续估计有效接触位置，并据此更新阻抗控制器的交互坐标系，对物理接触点进行视觉伺服。
AI.result: 琼脂体模实验中，探头滚转角-15°~15°范围内接触定位RMSE为1.46±0.14 mm；静态滚动时保持与固定坐标系阻抗控制器相当的任务空间跟踪精度，最大压缩交互力由31.56 N降至20.09 N（降低36.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 超声图像可作为直接的接触反馈用于安全、精确的机器人辅助超声成像，为接触感知控制提供了不依赖力测量的替代方案。

title: From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom
summary: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出类型化语义-几何接口：语言只给出实体/关系/阶段，每个关系索引已注册的"任务相关区分+保留自由度"规格，机器人端编译器用共形几何代数接地并构建关系专属任务图与一致微分，再经 RMPflow 组合成连续策略，实现保留自由度的可组合操作控制。
AI.motivation: 自然语言操作指令表达的是定性关系，而连续控制器需要可求值的任务量、微分与完成条件。定性关系天然不指定部分相对位姿，直接展开为完整位姿会引入指令未要求的额外约束（过约束），因此需要明确界定"语言模型"与"编译器"之间的责任划分，既让语言提供语义，又让几何规格保留任务无关的自由度。
AI.method: 1) 设计类型化语义-几何接口：语言指定实体、关系、阶段，每个关系索引一个注册规格，声明其任务相关区分与保留自由度；2) 机器人端编译器接地这些规格，用共形几何代数（CGA）构造关系专属任务图与一致微分；3) 通过 RMPflow 组合各关系策略为可组合连续目标；4) 对比两种接口——纯语义拓扑接口 vs. 附加关系专属几何规格接口，在 60 条指令上评测；5) 在 MuJoCo 中仿真 Franka Emika Panda 做 8 种几何关系、64 次接地评测（任务图零方向保持、扰动响应、解析方向导数对有限差分、Jacobian 秩）与 3 次闭环消融。
AI.result: 接口对比中两种方式均在 41/60 得到正确的共享语义内容，但在各自接口要求下的关键错误分别为 19/60 与 58/60；64 次接地的 8 种关系形式评测中，任务图保持已注册的零方向并对关系相关扰动有响应，解析方向导数与有限差分一致，Jacobian 秩与注册维数匹配；三次闭环消融中固定任一关系保留坐标使终端进度误差中位数增加 20.24–71.00 mm，而保留关系的误差仍在评测界内。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将"关系可见几何"与"保留自由度"一并编译为可组合的连续目标；语义-几何接口的显式责任划分可将定性语言与可微、可组合的控制器对齐，避免过约束，为语言条件下保留任务无关自由度的操作控制提供可行路径。局限在于验证主要为仿真（MuJoCo/Panda），缺少真机部署证据。

title: From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction
summary: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning. By jointly learning across different next-state parameterizations, heterogeneous Human and Robot experience can bypass appearance differences and directly contribute to shared state-transition learning, improving cross-embodiment generalization. Experiments show that CF-WAM improves both training efficiency and final control performance, while translating Human experience effectively into policy gains. CF-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa-GR1 with an average success rate of 82.50%, while reaching 82.65% on LIBERO-Plus and up to 84.00% in real-world evaluations.

AI.tldr: CF-WAM 提出动态下一状态预测框架,将同一未来的视觉、语义、几何与交互投影统一为标准视频形式,联合监督统一的 World-Action Model,从而突破固定表示带来的归纳偏置限制,并实现人类-机器人跨本体状态转移学习。
AI.motivation: 现有 World-Action Model 在训练前就把下一状态固定为 RGB、单一隐特征或预定义目标的静态组合,使动作学习被特定表示的归纳偏置所束缚;同时人类与机器人经验因外观差异难以共享状态转移知识。
AI.method: 对同一动作条件下的未来采样多种投影(视觉、语义、几何、交互),统一标准化为共同视频形式,并在这些投影上联合监督一个统一的 WAM;随训练步数累积不同投影暴露的动作相关约束,迫使模型捕捉支撑多种投影的底层状态转移结构;该动态机制同时提供跨本体的动力学参考系。
AI.result: 训练效率与最终控制性能均提升,人类经验可有效转化为策略增益;RoboCasa-GR1 平均成功率 82.50%,LIBERO-Plus 82.65%,真实世界评估最高 84.00%。
AI.conclusion: 动态、多投影的下一状态参数化可作为统一监督信号,提升 WAM 的表示泛化与跨本体迁移能力,并在仿真与真实任务上取得 SOTA 控制表现。

title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
summary: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at this https URL

AI.tldr: ARS 用通用 VLM 构建"智能体式奖励系统"，通过子智能体提出任务相关事件时间线、主智能体验证修正后逐帧估计进度，无需训练奖励模型，在语义错配基准与真机长程装配策略学习中优于多种奖励基线。
AI.motivation: 进度奖励建模需要区分"有意义的状态变化"与"失败尝试/任务无关动作"，否则会给出虚假进度；同时训练专用奖励模型成本高、泛化差，希望直接利用通用 VLM 的推理能力在零训练条件下完成可靠的进度估计与审计。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Reward System (ARS)：输入离线轨迹与任务指令，采用自适应视觉检查进行事件提议与验证。子智能体先提出任务相关事件时间线，主智能体验证并修订，再估计逐帧进度；可选用终点结果标签与视觉参考辅助判断，并可对外部奖励模型的估计做审计。使用 27B VLM，在受控语义错配基准、仿真与真机下游策略学习中评估。
AI.result: 语义错配基准显示多个奖励基线即使在简单 pick-and-place 场景中也会给错误物体操作分配虚假进度；ARS 更能抑制这类错误，并在仿真策略学习中超过这些基线。进一步在工业洗衣机装配线全尺寸实验室复制品上完成多螺钉紧固的真机长程策略学习，验证可从混合质量离线经验中学习。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理与验证（事件提议—验证—逐帧估值）能显著提升通用 VLM 在机器人奖励建模中的可用性，无需额外奖励模型训练即可支持真机长程任务策略学习。

title: Trajectory-Safe Orienteering for Human-Robot Shared Environments
summary: Orienteering problem (OP) has wide real-world applications and also great potential in human-robot collaboration. However, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously ensure safe and feasible trajectories while achieving high-quality task execution in shared workspaces. To this end, this work studies the OP with time windows and variable profits (OPTWVP). A two-stage DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory (DeCoST) approach is proposed to effectively solve OPTWVP in shared spaces. Meanwhile, the safety-aware time windows of nodes and the discretized workspace are introduced to ensure collision-free trajectories between the end effector and the human. Preliminary results validate the effectiveness of DeCoST in generating collision-free trajectory plans while preserving the quality of orienteering tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCoST两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法，结合服务时间引导轨迹，求解带时间窗与可变收益的定向越野问题（OPTWVP），并引入安全感知时间窗与离散化工作空间以保证人机共享空间内无碰撞轨迹。
AI.motivation: 定向越野问题（OP）在人机协作中潜力大，但现有方法难以在共享工作空间中同时保证轨迹安全可行与任务执行质量，因此需要研究带时间窗和可变收益的OP变体（OPTWVP）并设计兼顾避碰与任务质量的求解框架。
AI.method: 提出DeCoST（两阶段解耦的离散-连续优化 + 服务时间引导轨迹）；引入节点的安全感知时间窗，并对工作空间进行离散化，以在末端执行器与人类之间生成无碰撞轨迹。
AI.result: 初步结果验证DeCoST能生成无碰撞的轨迹规划，同时保持定向越野任务的质量。摘要仅给出初步验证，缺少定量指标与真实机器人实验细节。
AI.conclusion: DeCoST为共享空间中的人机协作定向越野任务提供了安全且高质量的求解思路，但证据仍停留在初步阶段，需进一步定量评估与实机验证。

title: Model-Informed Safe Reinforcement Learning for Bipedal Locomotion via Step-to-Step Prediction
summary: Humanoid robots promise versatile mobility in cluttered, human-centric environments, but real deployment demands principled safety. Classical model-based gait generators yield interpretable motions but often lack the robustness and adaptability of modern reinforcement learning (RL) based approaches. We propose a model-informed reinforcement learning framework anchored to the analytical Angular Momentum Linear Inverted Pendulum (ALIP) template. We provide a step-to-step safety certificate for ALIP stepping via a discrete exponential control barrier function (DECBF) and use it as (i) a training-time shaping signal and (ii) a runtime action filter that minimally adjusts swing-foot placement to satisfy template-level constraints. Full-order safety is evaluated empirically on the Digit humanoid in MuJoCo with a whole-body controller stack. Compared to an unconstrained baseline, our approach reduces safety-violation events in the reported external-disturbance trial, while larger lateral-velocity transients reveal a safety-tracking tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 提出模型信息引导的强化学习框架，以ALIP模板为锚，用离散指数控制屏障函数(DECBF)提供逐步安全证书，作为训练塑形信号与运行时动作滤波器，在MuJoCo Digit人形上减少越界事件。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在杂乱人类环境部署需原则性安全保障；传统模型步态生成可解释但鲁棒性/适应性不足，纯RL又缺少形式化安全保证，故需将解析模板的安全约束嵌入学习框架。
AI.method: 基于Angular Momentum Linear Inverted Pendulum (ALIP)模板，推导离散指数控制屏障函数(DECBF)，构造step-to-step安全证书；将其用作(i)训练期塑形奖励信号，(ii)运行时动作滤波器，对摆动脚落点做最小修正以满足模板级约束；在Digit人形+全身控制器栈的MuJoCo中评估全阶安全性。
AI.result: 在外扰试验中相较无约束基线减少安全越界事件；但较大的横向速度瞬变暴露出安全性与跟踪性能之间的权衡(tradeoff)。
AI.conclusion: 模型信息+RL的安全框架在模板层具备可证明约束、可实机落地性，但全阶安全性仅经验验证，且安全-跟踪折衷表明约束松弛程度需进一步调优与扩展。

title: Robot-Assisted Deployment and Maintenance of Inflatable Modules for Lunar Habitation: A Field Demonstration
comment: Author's version of a manuscript accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026). (c) IEEE
summary: Long-term human habitation and in-situ development on the Moon open a new era of space utilization. In this context, robots are a key technology for facilitating the construction of future human outposts. Toward the deployment and establishment of human habitation modules on the lunar surface, we propose a combined system consisting of inflatable modules and a modular, reconfigurable robotic system. This paper presents a report demonstrating various robot-assisted task executions using real hardware, namely the modular and reconfigurable robot MoonBot and the inflatable module HIDAS, to enhance the reliability of their deployment and maintenance. The demonstrated tasks include robotic inspection during inflation, module position alignment, final safety locking, and three-dimensional mapping for post-deployment maintenance. All demonstrations were conducted either in a laboratory environment or at a lunar analogue test site. Finally, lessons learned are discussed to provide essential insights for this robotic application to future lunar habitation.

AI.tldr: 提出由充气式居住舱与模块化可重构机器人MoonBot组成的月面人类居住支援系统，用真实硬件演示充气监测、模块对位、安全锁定与三维建图任务。
AI.motivation: 月球长期驻留与就地开发需要机器人协助搭建未来人类前哨站。为使充气式居住模块的部署与维护更可靠，作者希望验证机器人与充气模块协同工作的可行性。
AI.method: 构建充气模块HIDAS与模块化、可重构机器人MoonBot的组合系统，在实验室环境或月球模拟试验场用真实硬件演示多类任务：充气过程中的机器人巡检、模块位置对准、最终安全锁定，以及部署后维护所需的三维建图。
AI.result: 所有演示均在实验室或月球模拟场地完成，验证了该机器人在充气模块部署与维护流程中的多任务执行能力，并总结了相应经验教训。
AI.conclusion: 该组合系统展示了机器人辅助月球居住模块部署与维护的可行性，所获经验为未来月球居住场景中的机器人应用提供了参考。

title: MonoEgo: Monocular Metric Egocentric Demonstration Capture with Passive Wrist Constellations and Sparse Workstation Anchors
summary: Image-aligned metric demonstrations often require dedicated tracking hardware and synchronization across devices. We present MonoEgo, a capture system that replaces active wrist instrumentation with offline monocular reconstruction. One 90-FPS global-shutter camera observes calibrated passive wrist constellations, sparse workstation anchors, and the scene on a shared image clock. MonoTag SLAM combines marker corners with ORB geometry and uses visual evidence to reject ambiguous planar-marker poses. Its metric Atlas supports interval scale re-anchoring, verified map merging, and retrospective localization of earlier frames supported by the final map. Camera and wrist-constellation outputs retain validity and map provenance, and unsupported motion is left missing. Experiments show metric tracking beyond continuous anchor visibility, reconnection of supported map components, and recovery of some missing camera poses. Comparisons against a multisensor camera reference and separate stationary-constellation tests characterize trajectory agreement and precision while revealing incomplete coverage and residual geometric uncertainty. The results indicate that passive fixtures and offline reconstruction can reduce capture-side requirements. Dynamic accuracy, deployment, and downstream policy benefits require further study.

AI.tldr: MonoEgo 用一台 90 FPS 全局快门单目相机离线重建手部与场景度量轨迹，以无源腕部标定星座替代主动式腕部追踪硬件，实现超出连续锚点可见范围的度量跟踪与地图组件重连。
AI.motivation: 图像对齐的度量演示（如手-物交互采集）通常依赖专用追踪硬件与多设备时间同步，部署成本高、易失效。作者希望用离线单目重建替代采集端主动仪器，降低采集侧硬件需求。
AI.method: 设计共享图像时钟下的单目采集系统：一台 90 FPS 全局快门相机同时观测标定的无源腕部星座、稀疏工作站锚点与场景。MonoTag SLAM 将标记角点与 ORB 几何融合，利用视觉证据剔除平面标记的歧义位姿；metric Atlas 支持区间尺度重锚定、经验证的地图合并以及对早期帧的追溯式定位。输出保留有效性标记与地图溯源，不支持的运动直接置为缺失，而非强行外推。
AI.result: 实验显示可在连续锚点可见性之外维持度量跟踪，重连被支持的子地图组件，并恢复部分缺失的相机位姿；与多传感器相机参考及独立静止星座测试对比，刻画了轨迹一致性与精度，同时暴露覆盖不完整和残余几何不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 无源标定物配合离线重建可降低采集端硬件要求；但动态精度、实际部署与下游策略收益仍需进一步研究。

title: Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning.
