During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $\pi_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"眼动仪监督的注视提示"(gaze prompting):在VR遥操作中记录人眼注视,将注视点以十字光标形式渲染到机器人头部相机图像上,为VLA微调提供帧级视觉引导;部署时用轻量注视预测器替代眼动仪。基于π₀实现在六个真实双臂操作任务上平均成功率从26.3%提升至56.0%。
AI.motivation: VLA微调将每步图像与动作配对,但语言监督通常只停留在任务级指令,帧间视觉相关性(当前该看哪里)是隐含的、未被显式标注。作者希望以近乎零成本的方式(利用遥操作中本就存在的注视数据)为VLA注入帧级空间注意力监督,从而提升策略的视觉-动作对齐质量,且不改变策略架构、不依赖部署时硬件。
AI.method: 1) 数据采集:在VR遥操作时同步记录眼动仪注视坐标;2) 训练阶段:将注视点渲染为头部相机图像上的十字光标,与任务级语言指令一起输入VLA微调(实例化为π₀);3) 部署阶段:去掉眼动仪,使用一个轻量预测器根据近期图像与指令回归注视位置,生成同类视觉提示;4) 发布GazeMani数据集:1200条带同步注视的遥操作轨迹。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界双臂操作任务上,平均成功率由26.3%提升至56.0%;当用单条策略同时训练全部六个任务时也观察到增益,说明提示在多任务设置下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 帧级注视提示是一种低成本、架构无关的VLA监督信号增强方式:注视来自遥操作数据天然附带的信号,训练时作为像素级提示、部署时由预测器合成,可显著提升真实机器人双臂操作成功率,并伴随公开数据集与代码资源,便于社区复用。

title: Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon, partially observed robotic manipulation: a robot must remember which object was placed in a drawer, whose cup it moved, or how many action cycles have elapsed. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models embed memory directly inside the policy, but benchmarks show no single in-policy mechanism covers all spatio-temporal dimensions, trailing oracle methods by a wide margin. We argue that memory type dictates where memory should reside: short-term perceptual memory (repetition, timing, retracing) belongs inside the policy, while long-term object memory (persistent spatial state, containment, event history) belongs outside as an explicit, readable record. We present Ledger, a harness that realizes this split over a single fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ policy by pairing an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory, the ledger, built from a SAM3 tracker and a VLM captioner of the demonstration and read by an LLM planner that decides at step boundaries. On RoboMME, Ledger reaches the highest four-suite average among the evaluated methods, 64.3% (vs. 45.9% for the strongest prior method under identical evaluation), leading object reference (60.7% vs. 40.3%) and object permanence (86.7% vs. 56.2%) using a single set of weights. Choosing the memory source at runtime, from the instruction and the record, removes the need for a task-level router.

AI.tldr: Ledger 提出将机器人记忆按类型拆分：短期感知记忆留在策略内（帧采样），长期物体记忆外置为可读的 spatio-temporal ledger（SAM3 跟踪 + VLM 描述），由 LLM 规划器在步边界读取，在 RoboMME 上以单一权重取得四套件最高平均 64.3%。
AI.motivation: 长时序部分可观测操作需要记忆（放置了哪个物体、移动了谁的杯子、经过多少动作周期）。现有 VLA 把记忆嵌入策略内部，但基准显示单一 in-policy 机制无法覆盖全部时空维度，且与 oracle 方法差距大。作者主张记忆类型决定记忆位置：短期感知记忆适合策略内，长期物体记忆应外置为显式可读记录。
AI.method: 在单个微调的 π0.5 策略上实现该拆分：策略内为 frame-sampling memory（处理重复、计时、回溯），策略外构建 Ledger（由 SAM3 tracker 与 VLM captioner 从示范中生成时空物体记忆），并交由 LLM planner 在步边界决定读取哪一记忆源。运行时依据指令与记录选择记忆来源，免除任务级 router。
AI.result: RoboMME 上四套件平均 64.3%（最强先前方法在相同评估下为 45.9%）；物体指代 60.7% vs 40.3%，物体恒存性 86.7% vs 56.2%，且仅用单一套权重。
AI.conclusion: 记忆放置应遵循记忆类型：短期感知在策略内、长期物体状态外置为可读账本，可显著超越 in-policy 记忆方案并接近 oracle 表现，同时无需任务级路由。

title: Aerial GRIPPER: A Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and Planner
summary: Accurate capture of non-cooperative targets is critical. In an attempt to tackle this intractable challenge, an aerial gripper system integrated with a Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and PlannER (GRIPPER) framework is proposed. The interaction is formulated as a general-sum pursuit-evasion game under incomplete information. Specifically, underlying cost parameters of the target are inferred online, and the open-loop Nash equilibrium (OLNE) strategy is iteratively refined within a receding-horizon loop. To ensure high-frequency execution, a computationally friendly gradient-based inverse-game solver is developed. Without explicit computation of the Hessian inverse, the optimized solution is updated (> 50 Hz) based on implicit differentiation and fast Hessian-vector products. Meanwhile, an anti-disturbance controller is developed to overcome disturbances of uncertain payload and gripper actuation, enabling precise tracking of the planned trajectory and accurate grasping of the target. Simulations and real-world experiments illustrate the superior computational efficiency and task performance of GRIPPER. The task of capturing and delivering a non-cooperative target is accomplished, highlighting the robustness, adaptability, and real-time performance of the framework in highly adversarial scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出GRIPPER框架，用梯度实时逆博弈预测与规划结合空中抓取系统，实现在线推断非合作目标代价参数并迭代求解开环纳什均衡，>50 Hz执行，完成真实抓取与投送任务。
AI.motivation: 非合作目标的精确捕获极其困难，目标策略未知且对抗性强，需在信息不完全条件下实时预测其行为并规划抓取；同时机载计算受限，需高效求解与抗扰控制。
AI.method: 将交互建模为不完全信息下的一般和追逃博弈；在线推断目标代价参数，在滚动时域内迭代精化开环纳什均衡（OLNE）策略；设计基于梯度的逆博弈求解器，借助隐式微分与快速Hessian-向量乘积避免显式Hessian逆，实现>50 Hz更新；并设计抗扰动控制器应对不确定负载与夹爪驱动扰动，实现轨迹精确跟踪与抓取。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明GRIPPER在计算效率和任务性能上更优，成功完成非合作目标的捕获与投送，体现框架在高对抗场景下的鲁棒性、适应性与实时性。
AI.conclusion: 逆博弈+滚动时域+高效梯度求解的空中抓取框架可行且实时，适用于对抗性非合作目标捕获与投送任务。

title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 WAMachine，通过跨重规划重映射、跨去噪步观测重绑定、跨层残差重缩放来保留并自适应推理状态，加速世界动作模型的闭环推理，取得1.47-3.05×观测到动作延迟加速，同时保留96.69-99.54%成功率。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 联合建模动作与环境动力学以实现前瞻控制，但迭代扩散/流推理带来显著去噪延迟。前一推理状态看似可复用，然而规划上下文、观测与中间表示不断变化会使保留状态迅速失效，因此需要“自适应”而非“原样复用”推理状态。
AI.method: 免训练加速框架 WAMachine，含三个层次状态保留与自适应机制：(1) Trajectory Remapping——在闭环重规划间，将前一重规划的规划状态重映射以初始化下一次重规划，减少冗余轨迹生成；(2) Observation Rebinding——在动作执行期间进行预期性推理，当一致性检查通过时把保留的去噪状态与真实观测重绑定继续推理，降低暴露给控制回路的延迟；(3) Residual Rescaling——在Transformer层间，选择性重缩放保留的层状态，并在探针检查失败时通过中间层全量计算刷新，减少重复Transformer计算。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上对三种代表性 WAM 架构评测：观测到动作延迟加速 1.47-3.05×，每次重规划的 GPU 推理时间加速 2.23-3.27×，同时保留原生 WAM 任务成功率的 96.69-99.54%。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应保留推理状态，可在不重新训练的前提下大幅加速世界动作模型的闭环推理，且任务成功率损失极小，说明扩散/流式 WAM 推理中存在大量可复用计算，关键在于状态一致性校验与重绑定策略。

title: On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at the IROS 2026 workshop: Deformable Objects Manipulation: Research Foundations, Reproducibility and Real-World Challenges
summary: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.

AI.tldr: 基于两个MPM（弹塑性与颗粒材料）系统辨识基准，系统研究可微物理长时程接触丰富仿真中梯度传播的数值可靠性，揭示三类偏差来源并给出可复现性建议。
AI.motivation: 可微物理越来越多用于机器人材料操作（系统辨识、轨迹/技能优化、演示生成、末端执行器设计），这些应用依赖长时程、接触密集的仿真 rollout 反传梯度；然而这些梯度的数值可靠性缺乏受控检验，失败可能被误诊为物理建模问题或优化器问题。
AI.method: 构造两个源自弹塑性与颗粒材料操作的 MPM 系统辨识基准，作为受控实验平台；(1) 对比 GPU 多对一求和在不同线程调度顺序下与确定性参考的长时程梯度差异；(2) 将有限差分得到的“扰动引起的损失变化”与重复运行造成的损失波动进行量级对比；(3) 改变观测与损失函数定义，观察优化行为及独立指标所偏好解的变化。
AI.result: GPU 多对一求和顺序随线程调度变化，会改变长时程梯度并使某一参数梯度相对确定性参考发生符号反转；随着 rollout 变长，重复运行损失波动增长远快于参数扰动引起的损失变化，导致有限差分校验失效；观测与损失定义的变化会改变优化行为，并改变独立度量所偏好的解。
AI.conclusion: 建议在可微仿真用于机器人优化时：(1) 采用可复现的累加方式；(2) 有限差分校验应比较扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行波动，而非仅看绝对梯度；(3) 显式报告目标函数的构造方式。

title: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to ICRA. Website: this http URL
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出HOI-Retarget，一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，将人-物交互（HOI）迁移到人形机器人上，用于大规模运动数据生成。
AI.motivation: 学习自示范（LfD）已使人形机器人获得多样全身技能，但向人-物交互（HOI）扩展受限于缺乏与机器人兼容的交互参考数据。
AI.method: 窗口化轨迹优化，将每个标注接触点作为物体坐标系下的目标，在机器人运动学约束下平衡身体跟踪、足部支撑与平滑性；可跨物体尺寸增广单次示范、吸收单目视频重建的接触、并扩展到多机器人操作同一物体。
AI.result: 方法可将单次示范增广到不同物体尺寸，兼容单目视频重建接触，并支持多机器人协同操作同一物体；公开代码与重定向运动数据集。
AI.conclusion: HOI-Retarget为HOI数据向人形机器人的大规模迁移提供了可行的重定向方案，并释放数据集以推动后续研究。

title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
summary: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出评估框架，将VLA内部表示预测的"准确率"与"目标状态响应性""上下文稳定性"解耦，证明高自然轨迹准确率可能掩盖弱因果响应。
AI.motivation: 仅从VLA模型内部表示中解码物体状态的高准确率，不足以证明预测真正随目标物理状态变化而变化；自然观测中物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡与任务进度共变，模型可能依赖上下文线索而非目标状态本身。
AI.method: 构建物理验证的评估框架：交叉目标坐标与机器人上下文，分离预测准确率、目标状态响应性、上下文稳定性三个指标；对表示、读出层、训练数据进行对比与干预实验，并将响应性与上下文敏感性加入基于初始状态误差和物理变量的失败预测器。
AI.result: 在固定表示-读出对上，高自然轨迹准确率可与弱受控目标状态响应性共存；三属性提供互补诊断信息；将响应性与上下文敏感性加入失败预测器后，在新初始化上的策略失败预测误差相对指定基线下降，同观测受控MAE 亦有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 应把目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性同自然预测准确率并列评估，并考察其与实际策略行为和任务结果的关系。

title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
summary: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统探讨了机器人强化学习奖励整形中零阶与一阶状态项的必需性：理论上与实验上证明策略梯度无需一阶（速度）奖励项即可求解镇定任务，加入该奖励项反而随尺度增大引发严重敏感性，但奖励函数必须在目标相关坐标上满足零阶完备性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人RL奖励设计大量沿用经典最优控制与轨迹优化的启发式原则，未能区分"控制目标内在的奖励项"与"数值正则项"，导致超参数调优脆弱、泛化差。作者希望从原理层面回答"奖励函数究竟必须包含哪些量"这一问题。
AI.method: 以镇定控制（stabilization control）为研究载体，聚焦零阶（构型/位置）与一阶（速度）信息。结合理论分析（在低耗散假设下考察策略梯度可解性与奖励尺度敏感性）与实证实验，对是否加入一阶奖励项、奖励项尺度变化、策略观测中是否保留一阶状态等变量进行对照研究。
AI.result: 理论上与实验上均表明：策略梯度方法在没有一阶奖励项的情况下也能成功完成镇定任务；而随着一阶奖励项尺度增大，会引入严重的敏感性/脆弱性。同时确认奖励函数必须在目标相关坐标上具备零阶完备性，且在其低耗散假设下，策略观测中仍需要包含一阶状态信息。
AI.conclusion: 给出了可操作且有原理依据的机器人RL奖励设计指南：奖励需在目标相关坐标上零阶完备，可将一阶项从奖励中剔除，但应保留在策略观测中，从而减少奖励整形的超参数敏感性。

title: MarsLab: A Martian Rover Simulator for Planetary Rover Autonomous Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 11 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Future Mars missions will require rover autonomy that can operate across unstructured terrain, changing illumination, atmospheric dust, and limited communication. Simulation is a practical way to study these conditions before deployment, but existing Mars-relevant resources differ in scope, including mission-oriented simulators, fixed analog datasets, task-specific environments, and open robotics interfaces. In this context, we present MarsLab, an open-source, ROS2-native Mars rover simulator for autonomy and navigation algorithm development. MarsLab combines HiRISE-derived and procedural terrain with customizable rock, crater, solar-illumination, and atmospheric-dust settings, and runs a Perseverance-class rover model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The runtime publishes RGB, depth, RGB-D point clouds, LiDAR, IMU, wheel odometry, and Ground Truth (GT) pose data through standard ROS2 topics. We demonstrate MarsLab with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) benchmarks across sensing modalities, dust levels, scene geometry, and route length, and with Visual Place Recognition (VPR) benchmarks over repeated Mars Base traversals under illumination and dust changes. The results illustrate how controlled scene variation and shared GT trajectories can be used to compare trajectory-level estimation and image-level place recognition within the same simulator. Our Project Page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: MarsLab：基于ROS2与Isaac Sim的开源火星车仿真器，集成HiRISE与程序化地形、岩石/陨石坑/太阳光照/大气尘埃可配置参数，输出RGB、深度、RGB-D点云、LiDAR、IMU、轮式里程计与真值位姿，并在统一真值轨迹下开展SLAM与VPR基准评测。
AI.motivation: 未来火星任务需要火星车在非结构化地形、光照变化、大气尘埃与通信受限条件下自主运行，而部署前研究依赖仿真。现有火星相关资源（任务型仿真器、固定类比数据集、任务专用环境、通用机器人接口）在覆盖范围上互不衔接，缺乏统一的、同时支持感知模态变化与场景受控变化的地面真值评测平台。
AI.method: 构建开源、ROS2原生的火星车仿真器：地形由HiRISE数据与程序化生成结合，可配置岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照与大气尘埃；在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中运行Perseverance级火星车模型；运行时通过标准ROS2话题发布RGB、深度、RGB-D点云、LiDAR、IMU、轮式里程计与GT位姿。基于该平台设计SLAM基准（跨传感模态、尘埃等级、场景几何、路径长度）与VPR基准（重复穿越Mars Base场景，光照与尘埃变化）。
AI.result: 实验表明，受控场景变化与共享GT轨迹可在同一仿真器内对轨迹级估计（SLAM）与图像级地点识别（VPR）进行可比评测；给出了不同传感模态、尘埃水平、场景几何与路径长度下的SLAM表现，以及光照/尘埃变化下Mars Base重复穿越的VPR表现。
AI.conclusion: MarsLab为火星车自主导航算法（SLAM、VPR等）提供了一个可复现、可配置、开源的仿真基准平台，强调受控变量与统一真值，便于跨模态、跨条件的算法对比，可作为部署前研究与评测的基础设施。

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: KeyRec：无需训练的有界视觉记忆框架，将近期细粒度观测存入视觉缓存、历史证据组织为结构化事件库（新颖性驱动的在线增-并-淘汰），推理时用纯文本路由器在固定预算下自适应分配读取，支持模块化VLM与NEO-ov。
AI.motivation: 长视频与连续流场景下，稠密视觉token随时长线性增长，长上下文推理代价过高；现有免训练token选择方法会丢失连贯事件证据，且难以区分细粒度近期观测与长程历史。
AI.method: 免训练框架KeyRec，构建有界视觉记忆：查询无关写入阶段，近期观测保留在视觉缓存，历史证据按新颖性（相对已存事件）提出候选并在线add-merge-evict维护为事件库；查询到达时，纯文本路由器在固定readout预算下分配近期与事件记忆读取，不重处理历史帧；作用于模型侧视觉嵌入，兼容encoder-projector式VLM与无encoder/projector的NEO-ov。
AI.result: 在4个流式/长视频基准、3个VLM骨干上，仅用10%稠密decoder侧视觉token预算，15个设置中13个取得最佳压缩性能；实时问题上超最强压缩基线2.21–18.37分；6个长视频设置中5个最佳；NEO-ov 2B全部设置最佳。
AI.conclusion: 以有界记忆与固定读取预算替代稠密长上下文，在极低token开销下实现长视频/流式理解的最优压缩性能，且对架构与骨干具有良好通用性。

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出面向高分辨率、高像素多物种植物图像的域内自监督基础模型（MAE + ViT），在 1000 万+多视角图像块上分布式预训练，在密集预测与全局识别任务上验证域内预训练可缩小域间差距。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率植物成像的密集科学分析受限于像素级标注昂贵、图像像素维度大、成像条件变异剧烈；通用基础模型在密集特征表示上存在域间差距，迁移效果受限。
AI.method: 采用 ViT 骨干的掩码自编码器（MAE），在超过 1000 万多视角植物图像块上进行分布式规模化自监督预训练，随后在有限监督、跨视角变化、分辨率退化等真实下游条件下系统评测密集预测与全局特征识别。
AI.result: 域内基础模型取得 Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别比基于大规模自然图像预训练的 MAE 高出 0.0694 和 0.0613；预训练规模增大带来一致的密集特征迁移提升。
AI.conclusion: 扩大域内自监督预训练规模可缩小域间差距，改善高像素科学成像中的可迁移密集表征，为科学影像基础模型提供可扩展范式。

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 病理VLM存在"不看图像也能答对"的证据使用缺陷(数据集污染/先验知识混淆)。作者提出CleanSlide(149K题、9,985张WSI、患者与组织来源隔离、逐题审计)与Pair-DPO(同题同源反事实切片对偏好优化),使图像证据贡献从2.81%提升至15.29%,CPTAC 57.6%、BCNB 59.0%。
AI.motivation: 病理VLM评测惯例以准确率为主,但准确率无法度量模型是否真正使用图像证据,可能混入数据污染与语言先验。作者在淋巴结转移预测的预实验中观察到:输入整张WSI、标注病灶或完全不输入图像时,多数公开病理VLM输出差异极小,说明模型可能主要依赖问题文本与先验而非图像。
AI.method: 1) CleanSlide:基于TCGA构建的VQA基准,含9,985张切片上的149K道经审核多选题,按患者与组织来源做互斥划分,逐题审计选项捷径、题干泄漏、跨划分重复、盲解可答性。2) Pair-DPO:在同一问题、同一来源下构造由两张真实切片组成的反事实切片对,二者具有相反且经核验的findings;通过控制共享混杂因素,抵消问题可归因信号,使偏好来源仅剩图像证据;不引入编辑伪影,也不为侵袭、坏死、分级等弥漫/分级特征使用未核验标签。
AI.result: 在CleanSlide上,图像证据带来的增益为15.29%,而最佳已发表模型仅为2.81%;外部CPTAC与BCNB队列上分别达到57.6%与59.0%准确率,较所有对比模型分别高出9.7%与3.4%。基准与代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 以反事实配对偏好优化替代纯准确率导向,可有效解耦语言先验/污染与图像证据,提升病理VLM对视觉证据的真实依赖度,并具备跨队列泛化能力。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出文生图模型在比喻性提示下会把喻体（vehicle）错误地渲染为可见物体，提出"喻体侵入"（Figurative Vehicle Intrusion）概念，并构建多语言基准 VISTA、诊断性问答指标 V-Score 以及轻量缓解方法 VISTA-Guard。
AI.motivation: T2I 模型能从自然语言生成高质量图像，但在比喻性语言下出现系统性失败：本应仅用于引导本体（tenor）描绘的喻体被直接画成可见对象。作者强调这种错误文本上"有据可依"，却属于视觉角色错配，说明"视觉出现≠忠实"，而现有的基于存在性（presence-oriented）的评测无法捕捉此类错误，因此需要专门的问题定义、基准与指标。
AI.method: 1) 形式化并命名 Figurative Vehicle Intrusion 这一失败模式，区分"文本授权的存在"与"正确的视觉角色"。2) 构建 VISTA 多语言基准，按 Figurative Form（比喻形式）与 Mapping Mechanism（映射机制）两个维度组织比喻性提示。3) 提出 V-Score，一种基于诊断式问答（diagnostic QA）的度量，评估生成图像中角色感知（role-aware）的比喻忠实度。4) 提出轻量缓解方案 VISTA-Guard。
AI.result: 在近期高性能 TTI 模型上的评测显示，喻体侵入现象在不同语言与不同比喻类别中普遍存在，说明该失败并非个别模型或个别语言的偶然现象；VISTA-Guard 作为轻量缓解手段可部分减少喻体侵入。
AI.conclusion: 文本上合理的喻体内容常被赋予错误的视觉角色，存在性导向的评测会漏检此类错误；VISTA 与 V-Score 为角色感知的比喻忠实度提供了系统的评测手段，VISTA-Guard 给出了通往更忠实比喻生成的可行缓解路径，全部资源将公开。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: MOXAI：整合DNA甲基化与CNV的深度多组学框架，用于成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类，并提供基于CAM/Grad-CAM的可解释性归因。
AI.motivation: 现有甲基化分型模型单独处理甲基化与拷贝数数据，未利用二者互补信息；缺乏类内风险评估机制（类似肿瘤分级）；且无可解释方法将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点。
AI.method: 基于TCGA队列，将甲基化芯片的DNA甲基化与CNV数据融合，训练ResNet50、DINOv2、Graph Attention Network（GAT）三种模型，分别用单模态与多模态输入；用CAM与Grad-CAM生成可解释归因，定位关键CpG位点、基因与染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于单用CNV数据；DINOv2泛化最强，独立验证集准确率94.25%（置信度>0.9）；XAI归因结果与已知胶质瘤分子特征一致。
AI.conclusion: 多组学融合+可解释AI可提升胶质瘤分型精度与生物学可解释性，但属医学影像/组学领域应用研究，与方法学核心方向（具身智能、3D重建、世界模型等）无直接关联。

title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

AI.tldr: Devol-ONE：单一自回归 Mixture-of-Transformers 框架，将视觉语言理解、V-JEPA 潜空间世界动力学预测与动作生成统一，动作专家每层受语言语义与预测物理动态共同调制。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅以当前视觉-语言上下文直接映射动作，缺乏对场景在候选动作下如何演化的显式建模；而 WAM 虽预测未来状态，却将预测与策略学习在架构上分离，仅通过预测输出（像素视频或独立训练的潜空间模块）耦合策略，导致语义推理与物理动态未能持续塑造动作生成。
AI.method: 提出 Devol-ONE，基于 Mixture of Transformers 的单体自回归架构：视觉语言流与 V-JEPA 预训练动力学流联合自回归预测，每一层通过注意力访问视觉语言 KV cache，在语言引导下预测未来潜状态；动作专家由语义推理与预测的物理动态逐层持续调制，而非依赖预先计算的固定表征。消融验证动态流预测与逐层统一注意力的作用。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0 及真实 Flexiv 单臂与双臂平台开展大量实验；消融表明动态流预测与逐层统一注意力均有效，验证架构的内聚性。摘要未给出具体定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 统一世界模型预测与动作生成于单自回归框架、并以层间共享注意力让语义与动态持续塑造策略，是提升具身策略可行性与泛化的有效架构方向，且在仿真与真实双臂平台上具备可迁移性。

title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.

AI.tldr: ASK 通过小图像组内的成对判断构造半正定核目标，并在冻结 CLIP 正则下用低秩适配器联合更新视觉与文本编码器，把 VLM 的相似性偏好蒸馏进 CLIP 图像嵌入，推理时无需调用 VLM。
AI.motivation: VLM 能判断视觉相似性，但其判断无法直接作为紧凑图像嵌入用于高效比较；CLIP 嵌入可高效检索，却缺少 VLM 的细粒度相似性偏好。目标是在保留 CLIP 图文能力的前提下，把 VLM 偏好迁移进 CLIP，且不访问教师嵌入、不额外收集人类相似性标注。
AI.method: 提出 ASK：在小组图像内构造半正定目标核，将视觉核匹配与图文分布锚定相结合；用低秩适配器(low-rank adapter)联合更新视觉与文本编码器，同时把预测正则向冻结 CLIP 靠拢。适配后检索仅用 CLIP 图像嵌入与余弦相似性，不调用 VLM。提示(prompt)可控制学生学习的视觉区分维度。
AI.result: 在 5 个图像域、4 个 CLIP 骨干、6 个评审模型上评测教师一致性、检索与识别保持。ViT-B/16 上，未参与适配类别的平均检索 mAP 从 53.8 提升至 75.0（DINOv2 目标 + KL 锚定基线为 71.7）；联合适配编码器的平均零样本准确率从 61.8% 提升至 62.4%（12 个基准 × 5 个适配域平均）。4 个数据集上的人工标注评测支持提示可进行准则特异性的控制。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的成对相似性偏好可通过核匹配与分布锚定的低秩适配有效转移到 CLIP，兼顾检索提升与图文零样本能力保持，并支持提示级可控的相似性准则选择。

title: Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds
summary: Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes. Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需原始点云辅助的盲水印框架，直接在xyz坐标上操作，采用八叉树前馈架构联合学习水印嵌入与提取，支持物体级与场景级点云。
AI.motivation: 点云作为核心几何表示，其所有权认证困难：点集不规则、无序，且常经重采样与几何预处理而被改动。需要一种不依赖颜色、法线、网格连接性或原始点云的盲水印方案。
AI.method: 基于八叉树的前馈架构，联合学习嵌入器与提取器以进行多尺度几何推理；训练时引入随机变换层使解码器暴露于常见几何扰动，并采用渐进式姿态对齐提升对姿态变化的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在物体级与场景级基准上，常见几何处理后仍能可靠恢复水印信息，几何形变失真低；定性比较显示学习到的扰动比手工设计方法在视觉上更不显著、空间结构更弱。
AI.conclusion: 该盲水印框架在验证阶段仅需观测点云即可恢复信息，兼顾物体级与场景级点云，在鲁棒性与低失真之间取得较好平衡，为点云版权保护提供可行路径。

title: Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.

AI.tldr: GSFM：用时空骨骼图注意力耦合的单条件速度场，通过测地线条件流匹配一次性生成整段未来骨骼轨迹，并保持骨长与物理时间偏移。
AI.motivation: 人体运动预测需要多样且与观测片段、骨骼关节结构一致的多未来轨迹；骨骼约束限制单帧姿态，协同运动又依赖空间（相连关节间）与时间（时刻间）交互，现有方法难以同时满足这些约束与交互。
AI.method: 将完整未来骨骼轨迹表示为一个时空骨架图，用单一条件速度场对其整体运输；以空间与时间注意力按骨骼连接关系与物理时间偏移耦合图的演化；骨骼方向以根关节为参考置于单位球面，在切空间上演化以保持输入骨长。训练时在连接"以最后观测姿态为中心采样的随机轨迹"与"真实未来轨迹"的测地路径上做条件流匹配，学习该速度场。
AI.result: 在AMASS上评估预测精度、多样性校准与运动统计指标；消融实验验证空间与时间消息传递各自的贡献；在AMASS上训练的GSFM迁移到Human3.6M骨骼时无需参数更新或重训练即取得有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 把骨骼序列生成建模为单速度场的流匹配并显式嵌入骨骼拓扑与时间偏移，可同时兼顾准确性与多样性；模型对未见骨架结构具有零样本泛化能力，但仅在人体动作捕捉数据上验证，尚未涉及机器人与真实场景。

title: Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network
summary: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.

AI.tldr: 两阶段步态识别框架 TFTR：浅层孪生卷积网络将 GEI 映射到视角特定嵌入空间，再由 12 层 Transformer 编码器重投影并融合多视角，实现跨视角泛化与任意视角数融合。
AI.motivation: 单阶段步态识别存在严重过拟合与刚性视角约束，且先前方法受固定输入视角数限制，难以灵活融合多视角信息。
AI.method: 第一阶段用带 triplet loss 的浅层 Siamese 卷积网络把 Gait Energy Images 编码为 128 维视角特定嵌入；第二阶段将这些逐视角嵌入视作 token，输入 12 层 Transformer 编码器重投影到余弦可分性更好的空间，推理时可灵活融合任意数量视角。
AI.result: 在 OU-MVLP（6000 人）训练，未见过的 CASIA-B 上评估（正常、背包、穿大衣三种条件）：OU-MVLP 单视角 96.91%、三视角 99.49% 准确率；CASIA-B 三视角达到 100% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段"先对齐-再推理"设计可缓解过拟合并突破固定视角输入限制，多视角融合带来显著精度提升，具备较好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.

AI.tldr: RoBoSTAR：文本驱动的机器人手语动作生成框架，采用部件级FSQ＋跨尺度自回归，由粗到细生成可重定向至人形机器人的手势动作。
AI.motivation: 公共沟通中的手语翻译依赖合格口译员，难以规模化，机器人手语可作为补充性无障碍界面；同时传统自回归SLP将动作展平为单一全分辨率token序列，长程与局部依赖被迫以统一时间粒度建模，效率与质量受限。
AI.method: 将运动分解为身体与手部等部件，采用部件级有限标量量化（Finite Scalar Quantization, FSQ）；以next-scale自回归在逐步变细的时间分辨率上生成运动，每一步并行预测同步的身体与手部token；引入自条件化（self-conditioning）与上下文扰动（context corruption）增强跨尺度预测误差鲁棒性；文本为条件，语音通过外部ASR前端可选接入；生成动作随后重定向至实体人形机器人执行。
AI.result: 论文以大量定性与定量评估验证RoBoSTAR的有效性，但摘要未给出具体量化指标、对比基线或真实机器人部署细节。
AI.conclusion: 粗到细、跨尺度自回归＋部件级量化的生成范式为可重定向的机器人手语生成提供了新思路，兼具长程紧凑上下文与细节精修能力，具备无障碍交互与具身执行的应用潜力。

title: FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

AI.tldr: FSS-UBrain：一种区域式单样本（one-shot）脑肿瘤分割框架，用一张带标注的正支撑切片分别条件化 WT/TC/ET 的二分查询分割，并结合硬负/全负查询与空查询正则；在 BraTS 2020/2023/Africa 上取得较高 Dice 与较低 HD95。
AI.motivation: 多模态 MRI 中全肿瘤、肿瘤核心与增强肿瘤的精确勾画受限于标注稀缺、跨队列差异大以及目标极度稀疏；作者希望在不做目标域微调、不更新测试时参数的前提下，用极少标注（单张支撑切片）实现可迁移的区域级分割。
AI.method: 提出 FSS-UBrain：以标注的正支撑切片分别对 WT/TC/ET 进行二分类查询分割；由支撑集导出的前景/背景描述子引导查询特征自适应、瓶颈层交互、解码器侧重构与边界精修。训练采用 episodic 方式，引入硬负查询、全负查询及空查询正则以抑制区域缺失时的虚假前景激活。推理在 2D 支撑–查询切片对上完成，但检查点选择、阈值标定与最终评估在体数据重建后进行。评估设置：BraTS 2020 留出划分，以及 BraTS 2023 与 BraTS-Africa 的目标支撑跨队列协议；作为目标支撑的病例从查询队列中剔除，无目标域微调、无测试时参数更新。
AI.result: BraTS 2020 上体数据 Dice 分别为 WT 89.82%、TC 82.14%、ET 77.42%，对应 HD95 为 11.12、9.01、4.46 mm；在 BraTS 2023 与 BraTS-Africa 上取得对比少样本方法中最高的平均 Dice 与最低的有限配对平均 HD95 点估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持“目标条件化少样本分割”这一思路的有效性，同时指出方法对支撑切片选择敏感、并受队列特异性差异影响；作者将其定位为对 WSSS 方法的推广（摘要中提及相关工作方向），但整体属于医学影像分割范畴。

title: HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection
summary: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 提出 HeroFrame-Bench，用 VLM-as-a-Judge 框架评估电影"英雄帧"选择任务，通过 Reference-anchored Percentile 与 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution 实现可扩展、可扩展的主观美学评估。
AI.motivation: 英雄帧（用于海报、封面、影库条目等宣传物料的首屏剧照）是观众对影片的第一视觉入口，其选择需兼顾内容相关性与美学吸引力。现有 keyframe selection 基准偏重相关性、忽略美学，且标注有限或依赖 VideoQA 使评估与下游模型能力纠缠，因此缺少一个可靠的黄金帧选择评估基准。
AI.method: 构建 HeroFrame-Bench：以多模态元数据构造上下文，供 VLM 裁判打分；提出 Reference-anchored Percentile，将候选帧插入可复用的预排序参考链得到百分位得分；提出 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution，生成影片专属评分细则来条件化裁判并与其排序联合迭代优化；引入可验证信号（尤以 Inverted Rubric Attack 为主）筛选鲁棒细则。
AI.result: 基准覆盖 204 部影片、2,031 条参考链、1,970 条学习到的细则；构建标注界面做人类对齐研究，VLM 与人一致率由 77.56% 提升至 83.78%；多种方法评测显示英雄帧选择仍是难题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为主观、美学相关的帧选择任务提供了可扩展、可扩展且与人类判断更对齐的评估方案，表明英雄帧选择尚未被现有方法解决。

title: One Perception, All Maneuvers: Directional Traffic Signal Understanding for Maneuver-Level Signal Intent Prediction
summary: Traffic lights are a key regulatory signal for autonomous driving at urban intersections, yet existing traffic signal perception is still predominantly formulated as instance-level detection or color recognition. Such formulations identify where traffic lights are and what colors they display, but leave a critical semantic gap before downstream planning: which ego maneuver is controlled by each visible signal and what dynamic permission the signal expresses for that maneuver. In this paper, we formulate Directional Traffic Signal Understanding, a decision-oriented task that predicts structured signal states for straight, left-turn, right-turn, and U-turn maneuvers from a front-view image. Each state contains the associated signal color and signal-implied passability. Based on OpenLane-V2, we provide a direction-level benchmark with maneuver-level supervision and metrics for color recognition, passability, full-frame consistency, and safety-critical errors. A direction-aware baseline combines global context, localized traffic-light evidence, and maneuver-specific representations. Experiments show that direction-level modeling improves passability prediction over image-level classifiers and detection-oriented pipelines, particularly at complex multi-signal intersections. The resulting representation provides a direct and interpretable traffic-signal interface for downstream planning together with topology, route, and surrounding-agent information.

AI.tldr: 将交通信号感知从实例级检测/颜色识别重构为面向决策的"方向级交通信号理解"任务：从前视图图像预测直行、左转、右转、掉头四个机动各自对应的信号颜色与通行许可，并基于OpenLane-V2构建带机动级监督的基准与方向感知基线。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号感知多被建模为实例级检测或颜色识别，只能回答"信号在哪里、是什么颜色"，与下游规划之间存在语义鸿沟：无法说明每个可见信号究竟控制哪一个自车机动、以及该信号对该机动表达的动态通行许可。因此需要一个面向决策、直接对接规划接口的结构化信号表征。
AI.method: 提出Directional Traffic Signal Understanding任务，从前视图像为直行/左转/右转/掉头四类机动分别预测结构化信号状态（信号颜色 + 信号隐含的可通行性）。基于OpenLane-V2构建方向级基准，提供机动级监督以及颜色识别、可通行性、全帧一致性、安全关键错误等指标。基线方法融合全局上下文、局部交通灯证据与机动特定表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，方向级建模在可通行性预测上优于图像级分类器与面向检测的流水线，在复杂的多信号交叉口场景中尤为明显。所得表征可与拓扑、路线及周围智能体信息一起，为下游规划提供直接且可解释的交通信号接口。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把交通信号理解从感知层面推进到决策层面，建立了方向级任务定义、基准与基线，为端到端/模块化自动驾驶规划提供了更贴近决策的信号接口；但验证限于基准数据集，尚缺闭环规划或实车部署证据。

title: FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution
summary: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.

AI.tldr: FoundDSR 提出一个可泛化的深度重建基础模型：用 RGB 引导的 2D 高斯泼溅建模深度表征，并通过异构联邦学习实现大规模异构数据的稳定训练，在零样本评测中超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 深度重建模型在分布外场景泛化性差；同时大规模异构 RGB-D 数据存在分布差异，集中式训练易不稳定并对主导数据源产生偏置。
AI.method: (1) 引导式 2D 高斯泼溅：以高分辨率 RGB 作为提示优化高斯参数，使每个高斯基元沿高频结构方向各向异性形变，得到高斯上采样表征；(2) 深度重建分支将表征映射到高分辨率深度；(3) 异构联邦学习：每个数据源作为独立客户端本地优化，再全局聚合，提升可扩展性与稳定性。
AI.result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度及含噪条件的广泛零样本评测中，FoundDSR 一致优于现有 SOTA，表现出对未知场景的强鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将高斯泼溅表征与联邦式异构训练结合，是提升深度重建基础模型泛化性与可扩展性的可行路径。

title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进视角在线策略蒸馏（PVD）：通过引入保持宽高比的填充裁剪作为中间视角，将学生的视角分布从裁剪图逐步过渡到完整图像，并用区域优势加权重分配 token 级监督，在感知、视觉数学与通用多模态问答基准上平均准确率达 77.51%，较无奖励蒸馏基线提升 2.01 分。
AI.motivation: 区域到全局蒸馏利用裁剪条件指导提升全图理解，但难点在于如何把教师基于裁剪图的优势有效迁移到学生的全图推理阶段。直接使用裁剪视角训练与部署时的全图输入存在分布不匹配，需要在训练过程中平滑地弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 一是渐进视角策略：引入宽高比保持的填充裁剪作为中间视角，其保留区域内容同时与全图的视觉 token 网格对齐；各阶段视角混合中全图概率递增，实现从裁剪到全图的分布迁移。二是轻量级区域优势加权：利用裁剪条件教师-学生对数概率差，在采样输入上对 token 级监督重新分配权重，差距小时温和重加权，差距大时强化高差距 token。三是用 Jensen-Shannon 度量分解解释该调度，显示其由匹配输入模仿向部署目标转变。
AI.result: 在涵盖感知、视觉数学和通用多模态问答的多项基准上，PVD-full 三个随机种子平均准确率为 77.51%，比无奖励蒸馏基线高 2.01 分，比奖励匹配变体高 1.00 分；在无奖励设定下，PVD-distill 仍提升 1.16 分。
AI.conclusion: PVD 通过渐进视角与区域优势加权，有效将裁剪条件教师的局部优势迁移至学生全图推理，缓解了训练-部署视角分布不匹配，并在多类多模态基准上取得一致增益，为区域-全局蒸馏提供了可行的求解思路。

title: SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.

AI.tldr: 针对Flow-GRPO在空间与时间维度上使用统一标量优势的缺陷，提出面向DiT的梯度引导空间信用分配框架：将转移级对数似然重写为token级形式，用奖励梯度构建连续空间信用图，并以MAD离群鲁棒归一化+温度缩放抑制梯度噪声；GenEval上达到SOTA对齐质量。
AI.motivation: Flow-GRPO等无critic的RL对齐方法将统一标量优势施加于所有去噪时间步与空间潜变量维度，忽略了生成图像的空间结构，导致策略更新次优（空间信用分配不合理、边界敏感分割启发式引入伪影）。
AI.method: 1) 将Flow-GRPO中转移级对数似然重构为与DiT patch架构原生对齐的token级表示，构造空间细粒度的重要性采样比；2) 用奖励梯度导出的连续空间信用图替代刚性、边界敏感的分割启发式来分配局部信用；3) 采用基于中位数绝对偏差(MAD)的离群鲁棒归一化并结合温度缩放，抑制梯度噪声、突出与prompt功能对齐的区域。
AI.result: 在GenEval上取得SOTA对齐质量，收敛速度与DiffusionNFT等顶级方法相当，并显著优于基于Flow-GRPO的方法。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、连续的空间信用分配可有效提升DiT基于RL偏好对齐的效率与质量，为扩散/流模型的空间感知策略优化提供通用思路。

title: SOR-Nav: Search or Relocate? Context-Gated Exploration and Cross-Region Relocation for Object Navigation
summary: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to find an object in an unseen environment under partial observability and a limited motion budget. Existing methods primarily optimize where the robot should go next by ranking candidate destinations. In contrast to these methods, we present SOR-Nav, a hierarchical navigation system that explicitly arbitrates between continuing to explore the current context and abandoning it for a more promising reachable region. First, an autonomous semantic exploration system is built that accumulates persistent 3D object clusters and organizes reachable frontiers into a cluster decision graph to provide an efficient search abstraction. Then, SOR-Nav uses a context-gated LLM-driven object-search supervisor to evaluate the suitability of the current search context and decide whether to continue exploration or perform cross-region relocation to another reachable frontier cluster. Across the complete, unfiltered validation sets of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and MP3D, SOR-Nav achieves the strongest reported Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) on all three benchmarks. On MP3D in particular, it more than doubles the previous best SPL from 18.1\% to 38.5\% while increasing SR from 50.7\% to 61.8\%. Nested HM3D-v2 ablations validate the proposed decision structure, while a continuous three-target physical deployment demonstrates persistent ObjectNav operation in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: SOR-Nav：分层ObjectNav系统，用语义探索累积3D物体簇并构建可到达前沿决策图，再用上下文门控的LLM监督器裁决"继续当前区域探索"还是"跨区域重定位"；在HM3D-v1/v2与MP3D上取得最优SR/SPL，MP3D SPL由18.1%提升至38.5%，SR由50.7%提升至61.8%，并完成三目标真机部署。
AI.motivation: 现有ObjectNav方法主要在候选目标点之间排序"下一步去哪"，缺少对"是否放弃当前搜索上下文、转向更有希望的可达区域"这一粗粒度决策的显式建模，导致在部分可观测与有限步数预算下探索效率低、易在低收益区域耗尽预算。
AI.method: 1）自主语义探索模块：累积持久化的3D物体簇，将可到达前沿组织为簇决策图，形成高效搜索抽象；2）SOR-Nav采用上下文门控的LLM驱动物体搜索监督器，评估当前搜索上下文的适宜性，输出继续探索或执行跨区域重定位到另一可达前沿簇；3）分层结构将图级区域选择与局部导航解耦。评估：HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2、MP3D完整未筛选验证集，嵌套消融验证决策结构，真机三目标连续部署。
AI.result: 在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2、MP3D三个基准的全部未筛选验证集上同时取得报告中最高的SR与SPL。MP3D上SPL由此前最佳18.1%提升至38.5%（翻倍以上），SR由50.7%提升至61.8%。嵌套HM3D-v2消融验证了所提决策结构的有效性；三目标真机连续部署表明系统可在真实场景中持续运行ObjectNav。
AI.conclusion: 显式的"继续 vs 重定位"区域级仲裁是提升ObjectNav探索效率的关键，优于纯候选点排序范式；LLM作为上下文适宜性监督器与语义簇图抽象结合，可在保持分层简洁性的同时显著提升SR/SPL，并具备真机持续部署可行性。

title: ExcavaTwin: Training-Free Geometry-Guided Semantic Elevation Mapping for Autonomous Excavation
summary: Autonomous excavation requires a spatial representation that jointly captures terrain geometry and task-relevant semantics. Existing excavation mapping is largely elevation-centric, while generic semantic models remain unstable in unstructured outdoor scenes. We present ExcavaTwin, a pure-vision geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework without excavation-specific training. Given multi-view RGB images, the framework: 1) reconstructs scene geometry and semantic observations using frozen vision models; 2) derives terrain and non-terrain geometric support; 3) performs geometry-constrained multi-view semantic fusion to suppress implausible predictions and recover incomplete observations; and 4) projects the fused state into a task-oriented semantic elevation map. Experiments on public datasets and real excavation scenes demonstrate reliable geometric and semantic perception. In real excavation, the system achieved an average update interval of approximately 1.4 s and a mean elevation error of 12.74cm in dynamically modified regions. Larger errors mainly occur during rapid terrain changes and transient visual disturbances caused by machine motion.

AI.tldr: ExcavaTwin：纯视觉、几何引导的语义高程建图框架，无需挖掘专用训练，用冻结视觉模型完成几何与语义观测，经几何约束多视图语义融合后投影为面向任务的语义高程图，在公开数据集和真实挖掘场景验证。
AI.motivation: 自主挖掘需要同时表达地形几何与任务相关语义的空间表示，但现有挖掘建图以高程为中心、缺乏语义，而通用语义模型在非结构化室外场景中不稳定，因此需要一种无需领域训练、几何引导的语义高程建图方法。
AI.method: 四步流水线：1）用冻结视觉模型从多视图 RGB 重建场景几何并获取语义观测；2）推导地形与非地形的几何支撑；3）进行几何约束的多视图语义融合，抑制不合理预测并补全缺失观测；4）将融合状态投影为任务导向的语义高程图。全程不进行挖掘特定训练。
AI.result: 公开数据集与真实挖掘场景实验显示几何与语义感知可靠；真实挖掘中平均更新间隔约 1.4 s，动态变化区域平均高程误差 12.74 cm；较大误差主要出现在地形快速变化和机器运动引起的瞬态视觉扰动时。
AI.conclusion: 几何引导的多视图语义融合可在零领域训练下支撑挖掘场景的语义高程建图，具备近实时更新与厘米级高程精度，但动态变化与视觉扰动仍是主要误差来源。

title: DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
summary: Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support. The resulting references are tracked by an anatomy-aware Transformer policy that represents anatomical regions as structured tokens and uses directed masked attention to model their dependencies, with object information selectively conditioning the upper-body pathway for dexterous interaction. The policy jointly outputs body and dexterous-hand actions and is trained directly with reinforcement learning, without pretrained tracking policies, teacher-student distillation, or subsequent residual refinement. DexWeave improves retargeting fidelity and interaction consistency while achieving higher manipulation performance and faster policy convergence than MLP baselines. We further deploy the learned policies on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with Inspire dexterous hands, demonstrating dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation in the real world. See our project page ( this https URL ) for videos.

AI.tldr: DexWeave：将交互一致的运动重定向（两阶段：专用求解器初始化 + 上肢交互链耦合精修、保留下肢支撑）与解剖感知的Transformer全身策略结合，把解剖区域表示为结构化token并用有向掩码注意力建模依赖，物体信息选择性地条件化上肢通路；策略直接RL训练，无需预训练跟踪策略、师生蒸馏或残差精修，联合输出身体与灵巧手动作，并在Unitree G1 + Inspire灵巧手上完成真实世界全身移动操作。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示学习人形灵巧移动操作时，难点不仅是迁移人体运动，还要迁移演示行为背后协调的"交互结构"。具身差异会破坏身体运动、腕部位置、手指关节与物体交互之间的耦合；而运动学上精确的参考在机器人动力学下仍可能难以实现。因此需要同时解决交互一致的重定向与解剖结构的全身策略学习。
AI.method: 1）两阶段重定向：先用专用求解器分别初始化身体与手部运动，再在上肢交互链上做耦合精修，同时保留下肢支撑，从而在具身差异下维持物体交互一致性。2）解剖感知Transformer策略：将解剖区域表示为结构化token，用有向掩码注意力建模区域间依赖关系，物体信息选择性条件化上肢通路。3）策略联合输出身体与灵巧手动作，直接用强化学习训练，不使用预训练跟踪策略、教师-学生蒸馏或后续残差精修。
AI.result: 相比MLP基线，DexWeave提升了重定向保真度与交互一致性，获得更高的操作性能与更快的策略收敛速度；并在配备Inspire灵巧手的实体Unitree G1人形机器人上部署所学策略，展示了真实世界中的灵巧全身移动操作（项目页含视频）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明：将"交互一致的运动重定向"与"解剖结构化的全身策略学习"统一起来，可有效缓解具身差异带来的耦合破坏，并在不依赖蒸馏/残差精修等复杂训练管线的前提下，实现真实人形机器人上的灵巧全身移动操作。

title: Action Sequence Transfer via LLMs for Heterogeneous Environments
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: We present an action sequence transfer system that adaptively transfers user action sequences across different target spaces. Given an input action sequence from a source space and scene graph representations of both the source and target environments, our system predicts a corresponding action sequence in the target space by adapting to the spatial and object constraints of the new environment. To achieve this, we leverage multi-level representations of user activity to generalize actions at varying levels of abstraction. To demonstrate our system, we collect a new scene graph-based dataset derived from the Ego4D GoalStep dataset for evaluation. Results indicate that our system can generate valid action sequences even between spaces with drastically different object configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出动作序列迁移系统，将源空间用户动作序列适配迁移到目标空间，基于源/目标场景图预测目标动作序列，并构建Ego4D GoalStep衍生的场景图数据集验证。
AI.motivation: 用户活动数据稀缺，且不同环境中物体配置与空间约束差异大，直接复用源空间的动作序列往往不可行；需要一种能跨空间泛化动作知识的方法，减少新环境中重新采集与标注的代价。
AI.method: 输入源空间动作序列与源、目标两个环境的场景图表示；利用多层级用户活动表示（不同抽象粒度的动作/物体/空间关系），在目标空间的空间与物体约束下推断对应动作序列，实现跨空间的动作抽象与泛化。
AI.result: 在基于Ego4D GoalStep构建的新场景图数据集上评估，系统在物体配置差异显著的空间之间也能生成有效的动作序列。
AI.conclusion: 场景图条件化的多层级动作表示可有效支撑跨空间动作序列迁移，为跨环境用户活动泛化提供可行路径；但缺少真实机器人执行与部署验证，属相邻工作。

title: Simulation for Planetary Robotic Perception and Autonomy: A Concise Survey of Recent Capabilities and Gaps
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Planetary robotics is an important enabler of scientific exploration in environments where direct human-in-the-loop operation is costly, hazardous, or infeasible. However, developing and validating planetary robotic systems remains difficult because representative field testing is expensive, limited, and often unrepeatable under mission-relevant conditions. In this setting, simulation serves as a central tool for perception and autonomy research, synthetic data generation, system integration, and pre-deployment evaluation. Despite its importance, the literature on planetary robotics simulation remains dispersed across different simulation engines, implementations, and application settings. This paper surveys simulation works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy across four practical axes: Openness and Availability, Scenario and Platform Coverage, Sensor and Perception Support, and Environmental and Operational Realism. The surveyed simulation works report visual or physical fidelity and support perception-oriented workflows. They also indicate uneven public availability, rover-centered coverage, partial support for specialized sensing modalities, and uneven reporting of operational constraints such as onboard computation, energy, and communication restrictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一篇行星机器人仿真工作的综述，围绕开放性、场景平台覆盖、传感器感知支持、环境操作真实感四个维度梳理现有仿真引擎与实现，指出公开可得性不均、以巡视器为中心、专用传感支持不足、操作约束报告不全等问题。
AI.motivation: 行星机器人科学探索中人机在环操作代价高、危险或不可行，野外验证昂贵且不可重复，仿真因此成为感知与自主性研究、合成数据生成、系统集成与部署前评估的核心工具；但相关文献分散于不同引擎、实现与应用场景，缺乏系统性梳理。
AI.method: 综述方法：以四个实践性维度组织行星机器人感知与自主性仿真工作——Openness and Availability、Scenario and Platform Coverage、Sensor and Perception Support、Environmental and Operational Realism；对已调研的仿真工作进行归类与比较分析。
AI.result: 被调研的仿真工作报告了视觉或物理保真度并支持面向感知的工作流；同时显示公开可用性不均衡、覆盖以巡视器为中心、对专用传感模态支持不完整，以及对机载计算、能量、通信限制等运行约束的报告不一致。
AI.conclusion: 行星机器人仿真文献分散且成熟度不均，未来需提升仿真器的公开可用性、平台与场景多样性、专用传感支持，并标准化运行约束（计算、能量、通信）的建模与报告，以支撑更可靠的任务前评估。

title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.

AI.tldr: CoHuB 是一个面向多仿人协作的仿真基准，在自视角视觉观测下提供 10 个任务（8 个双仿人、2 个三仿人），并配有多操作员 VR 遥操作采集的同步演示数据。实验表明现有视觉运动策略在多体协同感知与控制上存在显著困难，为多仿人协作策略研究提供基础平台。
AI.motivation: 人类环境中的许多物理任务（如协助伙伴、协同操控物体）需要协作，但现有人形机器人基准主要聚焦单仿人技能，且缺乏在自视角（egocentric）视觉观测下的多仿人协作评测。因此需要一个能覆盖多样协作模式、并提供高质量多体同步演示的仿真基准，以支撑多仿人协作策略的研发与评估。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准 CoHuB：设计 10 个协作任务（8 个双仿人任务、2 个三仿人任务），覆盖多种协作模式；采用多操作员 VR 遥操作流水线，每位操作员从对应仿人的自视角控制一个仿人，从而采集多个仿人之间的同步演示数据；并在该基准上评测代表性视觉运动（visuomotor）策略。
AI.result: 实验显示，代表性视觉运动策略在不同形式的协同感知与控制上均面临显著挑战，说明多仿人协作在自视角观测条件下远未解决。基准同时提供了任务集合与同步演示数据，可作为后续方法比较的统一评测平台。
AI.conclusion: CoHuB 通过多仿人协作任务、自视角观测设定与多操作员同步演示，填补了现有人形机器人基准在协作评测上的空白，为多仿人协作策略的发展与评估提供了基础。当前策略表现不佳，表明该方向仍存在较大研究空间。

title: AGRO-SUVIDE: Agentic Robotics for Surgical Viscoelastic Debridement
summary: Augmented dexterity has the potential to reduce the fatigue experienced by surgeons during repetitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we propose the first AGentic RObotics framework for SUrgical VIscoelastic DEbridement (AGRO-SUVIDE), the repeated removal of small fragments attached to a viscoelastic substrate. Leveraging the self-improving and coding capability of agents, AGRO-SUVIDE adopts a modular framework. Specifically, the demonstration analysis module automatically identifies recurring skills from a single expert demonstration, using both visual and kinematic information. The construction module then builds each skill, either as a procedural model-based skill the agent codes against a scaffolded library or as a model-free policy-based skill. At runtime, the monitoring module composes the skills into a loop-style graph sized to the number of fragments it observes, then verifies pre- and post-conditions of each skill to decide whether to advance or retry. We evaluate AGRO-SUVIDE through 340 physical trials on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). AGRO-SUVIDE achieves an average single-fragment removal success rate of 85%, completing consecutive three-fragment removal at 60% and at 95% with one human intervention. It further generalizes to unseen five-fragment scenarios with an average success rate of 80% for single-fragment removal. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向外科黏弹性清创（AGRO-SUVIDE）的代理式机器人框架，通过演示分析、技能构建与运行时监控三大模块，将单次专家演示自动拆解为可复用技能并在 dVRK 上验证。
AI.motivation: 外科重复性操作（如清除黏附在黏弹性基底上的小碎片）易导致术者疲劳，需要通过增强灵巧性来减轻负担；而现有方法难以从单次演示中自动提取可复用技能并在多变碎片数量场景下稳定执行。
AI.method: 采用模块化 agent 框架：演示分析模块基于视觉与运动学信息从单次专家演示中自动识别循环出现的技能；构建模块将每个技能实现为基于程序模型的技能（agent 针对脚手架式库编写代码）或无模型策略技能；运行时监控模块将技能组合成与观测碎片数量匹配的环形图，并校验各技能的前置/后置条件以决定推进或重试。
AI.result: 在 da Vinci Research Kit（dVRK）上完成 340 次物理试验：单碎片清除平均成功率 85%，连续三碎片清除成功率 60%，在 1 次人工干预下达到 95%；并泛化到未见过的五碎片场景，单碎片清除平均成功率 80%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了 agent 自改进与代码生成能力在手术机器人长程重复操作中的可行性，模块化技能图配合前后置条件校验可提升鲁棒性并支持开放数量的碎片场景。

title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
summary: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose *Action Upcycling*, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2--1.7$\times$ with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Action Upcycling 算法，通过复用被丢弃的动作并依据动作速度平滑度动态延长执行时域，在不访问模型内部、不额外采样的前提下减少 VLA/WAM 类分块策略的调用次数。
AI.motivation: 分块策略每次只执行前缀、丢弃其余动作，执行时域长度在反应性与效率间存在权衡：短时域反应快但需频繁调用策略。现有测试时自适应时域方法或需读取模型内部信号（依赖架构）、或需额外采样（增加成本），缺乏通用且零开销的方案。
AI.method: 免训练算法：复用本会被丢弃的动作，不访问模型内部、不额外采样。核心洞察是被丢弃的动作与重规划版本在动作速度保持平滑时高度接近，因此将执行时域延长至速度开始波动的时刻为止。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务上，跨多个 VLA 及一个 WAM，策略调用次数减少 1.2–1.7 倍且成功率无损失；开销可忽略，且与少步采样、流式动作解码等加速方法正交。
AI.conclusion: Action Upcycling 为分块策略提供了一种通用、零成本的加速轴，适用于任意 chunked policy，与其他加速手段互补，开辟了策略加速的新维度。

title: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.

AI.tldr: RoboFL 提出面向联邦 world-action 学习的 MoSAIC 框架：将各客户端本地训练的 LoRA 适配器直接作为服务器端 MoE 的专家分支，通过服务器路由器学习 token 分配并联合优化路由与专家参数，并用 FARD 对齐三条路径的路由、用 PCEA 将完整专家更新压缩为紧凑全局适配器。在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 和真实 Franka 机械臂上优于集中式 PEFT 基线，通信量最多降低 86.81%。
AI.motivation: VLA 与世界-动作模型受限于物理交互数据稀缺、机构间数据孤岛和任务异构，集中训练难以获取多方数据；自然方案是联邦 PEFT，避免交换全模型更新。但朴素聚合会纠缠不兼容的适配器更新，而将 MoE 路由引入联邦聚合又可能稀释专家专精并使专家选择不稳定。
AI.method: MoSAIC（Mixture of Slotted Adapters）把本地 LoRA 适配器作为服务器 MoE 的专家分支（先验初始化，"slotted"），服务器端路由器学习 token 级分配并联合精修路由与专家参数；Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation（FARD）在模型三条路径间对齐路由；Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation（PCEA）将完整专家更新转化为紧凑全局适配器以个性化再分发。通信上只传适配器/紧凑全局适配器而非全模型。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 及真实 Franka 机械臂上验证。Franka 机械臂上比集中式 PEFT 的 InternVLA-A1 高 12.23%；相比基于 MoE 的联邦 VLA 基线，每轮客户端通信量最多降低 86.81%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化专家组装（将联邦 PEFT 适配器作为 MoE 先验专家并配合路由蒸馏与共识聚合）是联邦 VLA/world-action 学习的有效路径，同时兼顾隐私友好的低通信开销与真实机器人性能。

title: NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory
summary: Recent zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) methods increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over visual observations, navigation instructions, and candidate actions. Although effective, repeatedly invoking autoregressive multimodal reasoning at every navigation step introduces substantial inference latency, limiting the responsiveness of embodied agents. We propose NavJev, an efficient VLN framework that reformulates online navigation from repeated multimodal generation into compact visual compression followed by lightweight typed action selection. Specifically, Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) integrates waypoint geometry, BLIP captions, and RAM semantic tags into compact representations of candidate actions, while Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) filters shared semantics and maintains discriminative action-specific evidence across navigation steps. Based on these representations, Jev directly performs structured probabilistic decisions over the available action set. Experiments on R2R-CE show that NavJev achieves 27.0% SR and 22.4% SPL with only 0.65 s per navigation step, while substantially reducing inference latency and cost compared with MLLM-based VLN methods. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: NavJev将零样本VLN的在线导航从逐步多模态自回归生成重构为视觉压缩+轻量类型化动作选择,在R2R-CE上以每步0.65秒达到27.0% SR与22.4% SPL,显著降低推理延迟与成本。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本VLN方法依赖多模态大模型在每一步进行自回归多模态推理,虽有效但推理延迟高,限制了具身智能体的响应能力。因此需要一种高效的在线导航框架。
AI.method: 提出NavJev框架:1) 动作中心视觉压缩(ACVC),将路径点几何、BLIP字幕与RAM语义标签整合为候选动作的紧凑表示;2) 判别式动作语义记忆(DASM),过滤共享语义并跨导航步维护判别性动作专有证据;3) 基于上述表示,Jev直接对可用动作集执行结构化概率决策。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE上达到27.0% SR和22.4% SPL,每步仅0.65秒,相比基于MLLM的VLN方法大幅降低推理延迟与成本。
AI.conclusion: NavJev通过将重复的多模态生成替换为紧凑视觉压缩加轻量类型化动作选择,在保持零样本VLN性能的同时实现了高效低延迟的在线导航。

title: Graph-Based Simultaneous Path and Foothold Planning for Multi-Limbed Intra-Vehicular Robots in Space Stations
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Robot-aided operations in space stations are essential for reducing the workload of astronauts and improving the efficiency of on-orbit activities. Multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots (MLIVRs) equipped with grappling end-effectors have emerged as a promising solution, as they can securely grasp pre-existing interfaces, such as handrails and seat tracks, thereby enabling stable locomotion and forceful manipulation in microgravity environments. Since graspable locations on these interfaces are spatially limited and discretely distributed, motion planning for MLIVRs must be addressed jointly with foothold planning. This paper presents a simultaneous path and foothold planning framework based on graph theory for MLIVRs. The proposed method efficiently searches for feasible stance sequences for a multi-limbed robot while satisfying manipulability constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through simulations in a 3D model of the International Space Station (ISS) cabin, demonstrating its capability to generate feasible and efficient locomotion plans in realistic intra-vehicular environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于图论的多肢舱内机器人（MLIVR）同时路径与落脚点规划框架，在ISS舱室3D模型中通过仿真验证了可生成可行且高效的运动规划方案。
AI.motivation: 空间站内机器人作业对减轻航天员负担、提升在轨活动效率至关重要；配备抓取末端执行器的MLIVR可抓握扶手、座椅轨道等既有接口，实现微重力下的稳定移动与施力操作。但这类接口上可抓握位置在空间上有限且离散，因此运动规划必须与落脚点（抓握点）规划联合求解，这是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出基于图论的同时路径与落脚点规划框架：将机器人运动与可用抓握点建模为图结构，在图搜索中高效寻找满足可操作度（manipulability）约束的可行支撑序列（stance sequence），实现 locomotion 与 foothold 的联合优化。
AI.result: 在国际空间站舱室的3D模型中进行仿真验证，结果表明该框架能在真实舱内环境中生成可行且高效的移动规划，验证了同时路径—落脚点规划的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为微重力舱内多肢机器人提供了一种可扩展的图搜索式联合规划方法，为后续在真实硬件上的部署奠定了基础；当前证据限于仿真，缺乏实机验证。

title: Learning to Act under Visual Interruptions with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but they are typically developed and evaluated with all camera streams available throughout task execution. When a camera stops delivering frames during task execution, the policy must continue acting without access to subsequent observations from the missing view. Despite its practical importance, how such interruptions affect closed-loop manipulation remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this problem, we introduce MAIL-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates visual interruptions with VLA models. By interrupting different cameras at multiple stages of each policy's successful reference trajectory, MAIL-Bench measures how well policies retain their capabilities when visual inputs become unavailable. Building on this benchmark, we propose MINT, which first trains VLA policies to remain functional under missing visual inputs. At inference time, MINT selectively supplements missing observations using optical-flow extrapolation or an action-conditioned world model, and withdraws predicted views when they become unreliable. Experiments on $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 MAIL-Bench 基准评估 VLA 模型在相机中断下的闭环操作能力，并提出 MINT 方法提升相机失效时的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型训练与评测均假设任务全程相机可用，实际部署中相机中途失效时策略必须无后续观测继续动作，该问题影响显著但研究不足。
AI.method: MAIL-Bench 通过在成功参考轨迹的多个阶段中断不同相机来评测策略保留能力；MINT 先训练策略在缺失视觉输入下保持功能，推理时用光流外推或动作条件世界模型选择性补齐缺失观测，并在预测不可靠时撤销。
AI.result: 在 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 上 MINT 显著提升相机丢失下的任务成功率，并在 AgiBot G2 真机上完成部署验证。
AI.conclusion: 相机中断是 VLA 闭环操作中不可忽视的鲁棒性问题，结合基准与预测性观测补齐可有效缓解。
