title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出可拒绝且标定的决策头RCDH，替换冻结VLA输出接口即可在遮挡下实现风险感知弃权，而无需重训练。
AI.motivation: VLA策略被训练为必须输出动作轨迹，无法表达"我不知道"或"不应行动"。在机器人采摘中，遮挡导致单帧决策本质上存在歧义：相同像素可能对应可切茎或无茎，迫使VLA高置信度犯错并造成不可逆后果。作者认为失败模式由输出接口而非骨干规模决定。
AI.method: RCDH是一种类型化、可拒绝、可标定的输出接口，可附加到冻结VLA骨干上，无需重训练或新特征。包含：(i)带显式拒绝与有序条件分解的决策schema；(ii)面向风险感知弃权的标定流程。在可控叶片遮挡的采摘平台上，对比生成式、枚举式、标定式与可拒绝式四类接口，并检验拒绝空间排序的重要性。
AI.result: 仅替换输出头即可在遮挡下恢复分布外可用性，同时保持分布内性能；拒绝空间的有序性对效果有影响。
AI.conclusion: 在不确定性下可靠操作所缺失的是拒绝的权利，而非更大的模型；输出接口设计是VLA可靠性的关键杠杆。

title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
comment: The last two authors contributed equally as co-advisors. Website and code: this https URL
summary: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: this https URL

AI.tldr: EMPIRIC 提出一种"残差世界模型"智能体：以物理引擎为基底，用可学习的程序代码补全缺失机制（如胶水固化、水加热、风），并通过贝叶斯推断从带噪观测中估计参数与隐藏状态，从而支持预测、主动实验与假设修正。
AI.motivation: 物理引擎能提供运动与接触的先验知识，但会遗漏整类机制（黏合、加热、风等），导致对陌生物体行为的预测失败。智能体不必从头学习动力学，而应在引擎基础上补齐缺失机制，从而实现可解释、可迁移的建模与规划。
AI.method: 学习"残差世界模型"：在物理引擎之上扩展程序代码，可引入新的力、约束与隐藏状态；采用贝叶斯推断从噪声观测中估计程序参数与隐状态；模型支持动作结果预测、信息量最大的实验选择，以及在预测失败时进行假设修正（程序增删/修定）。
AI.result: 在五个仿真域中，EMPIRIC 学到可解释、可复用的模型，并且比三种基线在更少的环境交互下解决更多任务；在真实机器人上学习风力与多米诺骨牌质量，完成了一项操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 将物理引擎与可学习的程序化残差机制结合，是构建可解释、样本高效且能自我修正的世界模型的有效途径，具备从仿真迁移到真实机器人任务的能力。

title: QuadHand: A Compact Quadrotor Aerial Manipulator with MRC-SDF-Based Whole-Body Motion Planning
summary: Uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs) integrate robotic arms with aerial platforms for three-dimensional physical interaction. However, enlarging the workspace increases arm-induced disturbances, while existing geometric representations face a trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency in close-proximity interaction. This paper presents QuadHand, a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm, gripper, and battery-assisted passive CoG compensation module to reduce dominant arm-induced disturbances. We further propose MRC-SDF, a Multi-articulated Robot-Centric Signed Distance Field that preserves fine geometric detail with tractable computation, and a spatiotemporal whole-body trajectory optimization framework that jointly optimizes the quadrotor and manipulator for safe and executable trajectory generation. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate safe and executable aerial manipulation in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂QuadHand（3-DoF臂+夹爪+电池辅助被动重心补偿模块），并给出MRC-SDF多关节机器人中心符号距离场与时空全身轨迹优化框架，实现复杂环境下的安全可执行空中操作。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂（UAM）将机械臂与飞行平台结合以实现三维物理交互，但扩大工作空间会加剧臂致扰动；现有几何表征在近距离交互中难以兼顾几何保真度与计算效率。
AI.method: 硬件上设计紧凑四旋翼平台QuadHand，配3-DoF机械臂、夹爪及电池辅助被动重心补偿模块以抑制主导的臂致扰动；几何表征上提出MRC-SDF（多关节机器人中心符号距离场），在可接受计算量下保留细粒度几何细节；并构建时空全身轨迹优化框架，联合优化四旋翼与机械臂生成安全且可执行的轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验均表明，该系统能够在复杂环境中完成安全且可执行的空中操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 被动重心补偿硬件设计与MRC-SDF几何表征、全身轨迹优化的结合，可有效缓解臂致扰动并支撑近距离复杂环境下的空中操作。

title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
summary: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at this https URL

AI.tldr: ReCAT：语言条件策略＋结构化循环记忆（Mamba-2 层＋一层因果注意力），流匹配 Transformer 解码器逐块分别对当前/历史表征做交叉注意力；LIBERO 95.3%、RMBench 62.4%，真实机器人记忆任务显著优于短历史基线。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖型操作（空间回忆、事件计数、时间间隔估计）要求策略利用当前传感器已不可获取的信息，而主流短历史/无记忆 VLA 难以胜任。
AI.method: 指令条件编码器提取当前观测特征；循环记忆用 Mamba-2 层加一层因果注意力整合观测流；流匹配 Transformer 解码器每个 block 通过独立交叉注意力分别读取当前与历史表征。作者还对比了不同记忆更新规则（加性更新 vs delta-rule 更新）。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 95.3%，RMBench 62.4%，九个任务中六个最佳或并列最佳；三个真实机器人任务（空间回忆、事件计数、时间间隔）最佳变体平均 66.7%，最强短历史基线仅 8.3%。消融显示观测编码器与逐块记忆条件化均为性能必需；加性更新在计数与计时上最好，delta-rule 更新在空间回忆上最好。
AI.conclusion: 结构化循环记忆是记忆依赖型机器人操作的有效且必要的设计；记忆更新规则需按任务类型选择，而非统一沿用高效序列建模的惯例。

title: OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI
summary: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMASC开源流程，用物理模拟从CT生成配对干净/金属伪影的Cartesian与radial k-space数据，配合MA-VarNet重建网络与强化学习主动采样策略，实现轨迹无关的金属伪影感知MRI采样与重建。
AI.motivation: 金属植入物会污染整个k-space的MRI测量，但现有加速MRI方法假设数据干净，多数金属伪影减少方法假设全采样；且缺乏同一解剖结构的配对k-space与图像公开数据集，也缺少同时处理伪影感知采样与跨轨迹重建的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 基于物理的数据生成模块，将公开CT体数据转换为Cartesian与radial两种格式的配对干净与金属污染MRI数据；2) MA-VarNet：带逐级DC Rectifier的展开式重建网络，修正数据一致性步骤从污染测量中重新引入的伪影；3) 强化学习智能体主动选择k-space读出，并通过解耦的三阶段流程与重建网络共同训练；4) 框架除数据一致性算子外与轨迹无关，无需改变架构即可支持两种采集轨迹。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、4倍与8倍加速下，两种轨迹上均一致优于传统与学习基线。
AI.conclusion: OpenMASC提供了从数据生成到部署的完整开源流程，首次将伪影感知主动采样与伪影鲁棒重建联合求解，并验证了跨轨迹的通用性。

title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2027 CREATE Workshop. 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Project page: [ this https URL ]( this https URL )
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 EyeVQA，一个整合 21 个眼科数据集的统一视觉问答基准（2 万条 QA，六类疾病、七种题型），用于系统评测眼科 VLM 的识别、跨图推理与空间定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有眼科数据集多面向单一疾病或特定任务，无法系统评估 VLM 是否已从疾病识别迈向比较推理与细粒度空间定位；眼科影像方向的 VLM 能力亦缺乏充分刻画。
AI.method: 从 21 个公开眼科数据集构建 2 万条 QA 对，覆盖六个疾病组与七种题型（单选、多选、可变选择、判断、排序、点定位、边界框）；金标答案由源数据诊断、严重度分级、临床发现、分割掩码、检测框和解剖标志确定性导出，避免模型生成标注；44.5% 问题需跨多图推理。在统一零样本协议下评测 14 个通用、科学与医学专用 VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型总体得分仅 62.8，空间定位与跨任务泛化存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: EyeVQA 可诊断当前 VLM 在眼科视觉理解上的不足，为发展更可靠、具备空间定位能力的眼科多模态模型提供基准。

title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
comment: Code is at this https URL
summary: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出 LT-OPD 的在线自蒸馏训练框架，用全 token 教师模型监督极端压缩视觉 token 的 MLLM，并配合 token 预算课程，在 5% 视觉 token 保留率下将平均性能从 68.6% 提升到 82.3%。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 缩减可加速多模态大模型，但在极低 token 预算下性能急剧下降。已有工作多依赖 token 选择或基于训练适配，尚未回答"严重压缩的模型应如何从自身生成所诱导的状态中学习"这一问题。
AI.method: 提出 LT-OPD（on-policy self-distillation）框架：学生模型仅用少量视觉 token 自行 rollout 回答，冻结的同源全 token 模型在这些学生生成轨迹上提供分布级监督；同时引入 budget-level 课程，训练中逐步降低 token 预算以稳定视觉证据稀缺时的 on-policy 学习。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个基准上，5% 视觉 token 保留率下平均保留性能从 68.6% 提升至 82.3%，优于同预算的无训练、训练式与强化学习基线；增益可迁移到 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B、LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B；KV-cache 使用降低 85.2%，prefill FLOPs 降低 85.4%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: on-policy 自蒸馏能够显著恢复极端视觉 token 缩减所损失的能力，是一种有效且可迁移的 MLLM 加速训练范式。

title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
summary: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出StegGNN：首个基于图神经网络（GNN）的自动编码器式、cover-agnostic图像隐写框架，将图像建模为图结构以突破CNN网格刚性与感受野限制；在标准基准上与CNN方法表现相当。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习图像隐写主要基于CNN（逆神经网络、自编码器、GAN），把图像视为规则网格，受限于感受野尺寸与空间局部性偏置；而GNN（如ViG）在多个视觉任务中展现更强表示适应性，因此作者希望将GNN引入隐写领域，探索非网格化表示。
AI.method: 提出StegGNN：基于GNN的自编码器框架，cover-agnostic（与载体无关）；将封面图像转换为图结构（节点为图像块/像素特征，边表示相似性或空间邻接），利用GNN在图上的消息传递进行秘密信息嵌入与提取，替代传统CNN编解码器。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上进行视觉质量与不可感知性（如PSNR/SSIM等隐写指标）的广泛实验，结果显示该GNN方法性能与现有CNN基准方法相当（comparable），未报告超越性优势。
AI.conclusion: GNN可作为隐写嵌入的一种有前景的替代表示，为基于深度学习的隐写开辟了GNN架构的进一步探索方向；但当前仅为初步验证，性能尚未超过CNN基线，距实际应用仍有差距。

title: An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses
summary: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 FiST（Flow-in-Stage Transformer）与"先蒸馏后精炼"框架，在潜空间实现少步生成器：先用教师模仿建立强初始化，再以对抗+辅助分类目标对完整潜变量 rollout 做端到端精炼，ImageNet 256×256 三类条件生成 FID 1.11、2 阶段 FID 1.15。
AI.motivation: 少步生成器的迭代过程本质是跨步联合优化：中间预测会影响后续计算并决定最终输出分布。从预训练扩散/流匹配模型蒸馏得到的少步生成器使这种端到端优化在算力上变得可行，但单纯教师模仿（回归）难以直接对齐真实数据分布。
AI.method: 两阶段"蒸馏-精炼"：(1) 蒸馏阶段用教师强制回归，对教师轨迹上选定状态做监督，为少步潜空间 rollout 建立强初始化；(2) 精炼阶段改用对抗损失与辅助分类目标监督最终潜输出，在真实数据上端到端优化。架构 FiST 用共享 Transformer 在少数几个 stage 中组合潜状态转移，并可选跨 stage 隐状态通信。判别器作用于冻结的 REPA 预训练 SiT 骨干从干净真实/生成潜变量中提取的语义特征。全部训练在潜空间进行，不进行图像解码；精炼时模型消费自身中间预测，终点梯度穿过每个生成 stage。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成：3 stage 达到 FID 1.11（IS 282），2 stage 达到 FID 1.15（IS 280）。证明无需显式最小化 Fréchet 距离，仅靠学习到的分布级监督也能获得有竞争力的少步生成质量。消融实验刻画了蒸馏方式、预训练 checkpoint 选择、精炼监督形式以及跨 stage 隐状态通信对生成质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 少步生成可通过"教师蒸馏初始化 + 潜空间端到端对抗精炼"在无解码、无 FID 显式优化下取得竞争性结果；共享 Transformer 的分 stage 组合与跨 stage 通信是有效的架构设计。

title: RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion
comment: Accepted in ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Visual Arts
summary: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

AI.tldr: RefCompose 提出像素空间组合式条件框架，用固定分辨率参考画布将条件尺寸与参考数量解耦，通过双流 LoRA 分离布局与外观，实现高参考数量下的多主体一致生成。
AI.motivation: 现有图像/影视合成工具在引入多个参考（人物、场景、道具等）时，per-reference tokenization 使内存随参考数 N 线性增长，难以扩展；同时生成结果常偏离给定参考，细粒度主体身份被破坏。作者希望同时解决"可扩展性"和"参考保真度"两个矛盾。
AI.method: 核心是像素空间的组合式条件设计：1）单一固定分辨率参考画布（reference canvas），使条件尺寸与参考数量无关，从而内存恒定；2）将 where（位置/布局）与 what（外观）解耦；3）布局在推理时由冻结的扩散 transformer 诱导，并用 Grounding DINO 提取，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型；4）双流 LoRA 适配器分别注入布局派生的深度图与编码后的画布，把几何脚手架与局部外观解耦到不同低秩流。
AI.result: 在 Dense Layout 协议上，RefCompose 在颜色、纹理、形状、空间准确性以及身份/内容保持方面一致优于基于布局的方法和当前最先进的多参考基线，且在高参考数量下依然占优，推理内存保持恒定。
AI.conclusion: RefCompose 以恒定内存实现高参考数量的多主体组合生成，为生产级电影化多主体构图提供了实用基础模块。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

AI.tldr: Endo-TSR 在可形变高斯泼溅基础上引入有界傅里叶颜色残差、共享时频的独立平移残差与 Matérn 谱先验，并用多尺度拉普拉斯监督，提升内窥镜动态场景重建的渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需同时建模组织运动、时序外观变化并恢复精细表面细节。可形变高斯模型虽提供显式轨迹，但其固定颜色系数缺少针对光度变化的时序表示，导致外观变化与细节恢复不足。
AI.method: 在可形变高斯泼溅框架上增加：1）有界傅里叶颜色残差，捕捉局部外观变化；2）与颜色共享时频、独立的平移残差；3）用 Matérn 谱先验正则化运动修正；4）联合图像拟合时以多尺度拉普拉斯监督引导组织细节恢复。
AI.result: 在 EndoNeRF 与 StereoMIS 数据集上取得 SOTA 渲染质量，所有评测序列均获得最高 PSNR。消融表明时序外观带来的 PSNR 增益最大，外观与细节监督在高斯数量固定时可共同提升渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式时序外观表征与谱先验正则化能有效弥补可形变高斯固定颜色的缺陷，与多尺度细节监督协同提升内窥镜动态重建质量，但方法面向特定医疗场景、缺乏泛化性与实时性证据。

title: Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

AI.tldr: DELL 提出块级局部稠密监督方案，用可学习空间局部头替代 BPTT 全局梯度，在全脉冲 U 形网络上做事件相机光流回归与语义分割，光流训练显存降 39.6% 且精度反超端到端。
AI.motivation: 事件相机低延迟异步感知适合资源受限机器人，SNN 天然处理事件流，但 BPTT 训练深度 SNN 内存开销大、难以在神经形态硬件上实现。已有局部学习（如 DECOLLE）主要面向分类，用固定随机局部读出，不适配稠密回归任务，稠密事件视觉缺乏高效局部学习方法。
AI.method: DELL（Dense Event-driven Local Learning）：块级（block-wise）局部学习框架，将全局梯度传播替换为局部稠密监督。每个块使用可学习、具空间结构的局部头，在各自合适分辨率上监督，同时保持块内时间动态。整体为全脉冲 U 形网络，在光流回归与语义分割两类稠密任务上验证。
AI.result: DSEC 光流：相比端到端 BPTT，峰值训练内存降低 39.6%，精度反而提升，官方测试榜 EPE 1.670 px（同骨干端到端 1.941 px）。块间梯度截断更像正则化而非约束。基线 DECOLLE 因固定随机局部读出不适配稠密回归，EPE 高 3.9 倍；可学习局部头弥补损失并在全部光流指标上超越端到端。分割任务上弥补大部分差距，但仍落后端到端数 mIoU。模型 2.3M 参数（比最强 SNN 基线少 24 倍），在 DSEC 上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DELL 将局部学习从分类拓展到稠密事件视觉预测，在显存显著降低的同时达到甚至超越端到端精度，为资源受限机器人上的 SNN 训练提供了实用路径；但分割稠密任务仍有差距，神经形态硬件实测与真实机器人部署尚未验证。

title: RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架RefAdapt，按块自适应控制DiT条件生成中参考流的联合注意力计算，实现在少步设置下最高3.54倍加速且视觉质量相当。
AI.motivation: DiT已成为高质量生成建模的标准骨干，但条件生成任务中双向联合注意力反复处理大规模参考流，部署代价过高。现有优化依赖粗粒度静态复用，忽略了参考与目标表示在生成轨迹上的差异化动态。
AI.method: 观察到两个现象：参考表示沿生成轨迹演化缓慢（reference drift），且目标对参考分配的注意力质量较小。RefAdapt免训练地结合相邻target-Q变化量与已观测的target-to-reference注意力质量，在block粒度上自适应控制参考计算量。
AI.result: 在超少步设置下，4步MiniMax H3上加速最高2.097倍，8步Qwen Image Edit上最高3.54倍，视觉质量保持可比。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用参考漂移与目标对参考暴露度两个动态信号，可在不训练的前提下显著降低条件DiT推理成本，为生成模型部署优化提供即插即用方案。

title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
summary: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

AI.tldr: CityToolVQA 通过将城市低空视觉问答中的定量任务外置到一个视觉-几何工具链（目标接地、分割、深度反投影、空间计算），零样本挂载于多种 VLM，并训练 8B 模型适配工具条件输入，在 Open3D-VQA-v2 上达到 67.6% 总体准确率。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖 RGB 的视觉语言模型在定量空间任务（度量距离、物体尺寸）上表现薄弱，而城市低空场景恰恰需要精确的三维几何量估计。
AI.method: 将七类任务分为定性组（VLM 直接回答）与定量组（外部工具链处理）；工具链包含目标接地、分割、深度反投影与空间计算，可零样本挂载于不同 VLM；主链检测失效时触发 Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) 兜底；并用 CityToolVQA-SFT 让 8B 主干适配工具条件输入。
AI.result: 在 73,324 题的 Open3D-VQA-v2 测试集上，CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) 总体准确率 67.6%；将工具链挂载到十个开源 VLM 上，定量任务准确率提升 12.7–36.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 把显式三维几何计算外置，可有效弥补纯 RGB VLM 在度量距离与物体尺寸估计上的不足，工具链具备即插即用的通用性。

title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at this https URL
summary: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出CHASE（凸包自适应平移归一化），通过将世界坐标原点自适应移至骨架凸包内来消除实体偏置，改善骨架动作与交互识别。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架动作/交互识别多采用晚期融合，隐含假设各实体独立同分布以训练权重共享的实体编码器；而世界坐标系原点初始配置带来实体偏置，违反该假设，导致骨干优化次优与识别错误。
AI.method: 设计即插即用的参数化网络，对输入骨架施加自适应平移，约束重定位后的世界原点落在骨架凸包内以限制搜索空间、避免不收敛；引入基于成对分布距离的辅助损失引导优化；提出子实体策略统一单实体与多实体情形；兼容骨骼、速度等骨架内模态。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上验证，可与多种骨干网络无缝集成并显著提升其性能，覆盖多种骨架动作与交互识别任务。
AI.conclusion: CHASE作为归一化方法有效降低实体偏置，使后续分类器在多样设置下取得更优识别性能，具备良好兼容性与即插即用特性。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

AI.tldr: QuacamFM: 用四元数约束的流匹配框架估计多视角相机位姿，全程保持单位四元数表示，并用球面线性插值设计最优传输路径。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下的相机位姿估计几何约束不足、存在内在歧义。近期工作用扩散模型生成多个位姿假设以刻画不确定性，但多数方法用单位四元数表示旋转却在生成过程中当作无约束4D向量处理，忽略了单位范数约束，导致轨迹不光滑、次优。
AI.method: 提出 QuacamFM，一个四元数约束的流匹配（flow matching）框架，在整条流轨迹上保持单位四元数表示；通过光滑的球面线性插值（slerp）构建四元数流的最优传输路径。
AI.result: 在 CO3Dv2 上，相机位姿精度优于基于扩散的方法和经典 SfM 方法；四元数约束形式优于将标准流匹配直接用于4D四元数向量的朴素做法；在跨数据集和 in-the-wild 样例上泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 在流匹配生成过程中显式维持单位四元数流形约束可提升稀疏视角相机位姿估计的精度与泛化性。

title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
summary: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

AI.tldr: WorldScope 通过"可能世界语义+证据约束"研究部分观测下的世界建模，给出 1.2M 问答对数据集、4,800 组反事实世界监督，并提出 WorldFlow（跨视角实体证据+支撑面覆盖构成图像子集证据格），在 5,000 题测试集达 64.34% 精确准确率，较纯 QA 基线提升 24.88 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 部分观测下，被遮挡物体与不可见区域会留下多种与视觉证据兼容的完整世界状态；多视角可排除部分可能世界、强化结论。作者希望把这一"可能世界推断"过程形式化，并用可训练的表征与数据来支撑"观察如何约束可能世界"的推理，而非仅做单视角问答。
AI.method: 1) 数据：WorldScope-1.2M，含 120 万英问答对，覆盖 8 类世界属性、10 种任务接口、3 种观测协议；答案区分已确认事实、有界范围与未决可能。另有 4,800 组"认证反世界组"（相同基础观测、不同隐藏物体配置与答案），作为歧义物理见证与仅训练用的世界兼容性/视角排除标签。2) 模型：WorldFlow 将跨视角实体证据与支撑面覆盖组合为"图像子集证据格"（evidence lattice），用反世界兼容性与转移目标训练子集表征，再以共享答案生成器输出最强受支持结论。3) 评测：WorldScope-Bench 在视角被选择、组合、移除或重排序时评估断言判断与依赖证据的结论，测试集 5,000 题，另有 3,000 题结构不相交场景。
AI.result: 5,000 题测试集上精确准确率 64.34%，比同一骨干仅用 QA 训练提升 24.88 个百分点；在 3,000 题结构不相交场景上仍保持 50.43% 准确率。同时提供歧义度量与视角诱导排除的训练信号，形成可用基准。
AI.conclusion: 论文把遮挡与不可见区域下的世界建模统一到可能世界语义框架下，用证据格表征捕捉"新观测如何约束可能世界"，并证明反世界监督在多视角证据推理中带来显著增益与一定结构泛化能力。

title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
summary: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

AI.tldr: 提出首个AI生成医学教学演示的评测基准REMEDY，覆盖4类场景12项任务、900个首帧、4500段生成视频，用临床清单+视频/运动质量指标评估4个维度；结果显示视觉逼真不等于临床动作正确，最强模型严格临床成功率仅28.25%。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型进步使其有望作为世界模型基础，用于生成医学教学演示，但该场景同时要求视觉质量与精确操作步骤，现有生成器能否满足尚无度量手段。
AI.method: 构建REMEDY基准：采集真实演示视频的900个首帧，覆盖手术室、影像、门诊与床旁、复苏四类场景共12项任务；由5个当代开源视频生成模型生成4500段视频；结合任务专属临床检查表与视频质量、运动质量指标，从临床动作遵循、临床画像、视频质量、运动质量四个维度评测。
AI.result: 真实感与时间一致性无法保证临床动作正确；即使最先进的MiniMax-H3严格临床成功率也仅28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍是难点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为医疗教育世界模型的开发建立了评测基础和路线图，指出现有生成模型在程序化正确性上存在根本短板，需在动作级可控性上进一步突破。

title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE基准（5,869组三元组）系统评测运动-语言模型评测器对时间顺序、镜像反射与动作身份的结构 grounding 能力，发现普遍存在结构性 grounding 薄弱与镜像敏感性缺失，并证明结构性硬负样本可有效改善对比学习表现。
AI.motivation: 运动-语言模型通常由运动-语言评测器打分，但这些评测器是否真正理解语言结构（时间顺序、镜像、动作身份）尚不清楚；现有评测协议无法暴露这些缺陷。
AI.method: 构建STRIDE诊断基准，包含5,869个三元组（运动、原始描述、扰动描述），覆盖长短文本描述；通过似然平衡caption对以抑制纯文本偏置，并在不相关运动下估计评测器的caption偏好，以此衡量匹配运动带来的判别增益；进一步分析标准检索与分布度量对结构破坏的响应，并提出结构性硬负样本的对比学习干预。
AI.result: 被审计的评测器结构性grounding普遍较弱、镜像敏感性严重不足；纯文本先验即可在现有数据集的朴素扰动测试上取得通过，常见检索与分布指标对镜像造成的结构破坏几乎无响应；简单的对比学习修改即可在时间顺序与镜像反射任务上显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前运动-语言评测器的结构理解能力被高估，标准评测协议存在盲区；引入结构性硬负样本是改善结构grounding的有效且自然的干预方向。

title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
summary: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督框架，利用大而清晰文本的检测结果作为监督，通过视频时序回溯生成伪标签，训练专注于远距离退化文本的早期检测学生模型，并构建多语言户外数据集SceneText50。
AI.motivation: 远距离场景文本往往尺寸小、模糊，常被现有检测器漏检。人工标注这类退化文本成本高，而清晰大文本的成熟检测能力尚未被用于自动监督早期/远距文本检测。
AI.method: 以现有文本spotting模型在高置信、清晰大文本上的输出为监督信号；沿视频序列时序回溯，将后帧的高置信检测映射到前帧，自动合成退化/小尺寸文本的伪标签；据此训练专注早期检测的学生模型，无需人工标注。为保证伪标签质量，设计专用场景文本跟踪器以在复杂视频中保持文本ID一致。另构建多语言户外数据集SceneText50用于训练与评测。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在多种场景和语言下显著提升早期（远距）文本检测的准确率与鲁棒性。代码与数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将成熟清晰文本检测能力通过时序回溯自监督迁移到退化文本检测，是无需标注即可提升远距场景文本检测的有效路径，配合专用跟踪器与SceneText50数据集可支撑训练与评测。

title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

AI.tldr: 该论文从"线性测量"角度解释JEPA对mask几何的敏感性：被隐藏区域内的紧支撑小波原子落入测量零空间，导致低层先验可恢复的目标形成捷径；只有mask留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容才能消除捷径，并用151次预训练实验验证。
AI.motivation: JEPA类联合嵌入预测架构对输入mask方式异常敏感（块状mask有效、散点mask无效），但既有解释几乎全是经验性的，缺乏对"为什么mask几何决定表征质量"的测量层面理论刻画。作者希望给出一个可度量、可预测的解释框架。
AI.method: 将mask建模为线性测量：在紧支撑小波基下，支撑完全落在隐藏区域内的原子落在测量零空间，数据中不留痕迹。JEPA损失只要求编码上下文足以预测目标，因此能被低层先验（如滑动平均目标编码器）自洽恢复的目标会形成捷径。作者提出用"mask留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容量"作为预训练前的评分指标，并在151次预训练运行中检验其独特预测。
AI.result: ImageNet-100上，strip mask与block mask面积和连通性相同却可恢复，线性top-1为40.3%，接近随机mask的40.8%，远低于block的64.3%；同一几何家族内，不可恢复内容最少的位置比最多的低6.5个点（5组种子对）；像素目标跨度7点而潜变量目标跨度25点；冻结目标编码器后随机与block mask差距从19点缩至1.5点，说明几何通过编码器自生成目标起作用。UCF101上mask比例决定"内容"还是"可达性"约束主导；V-JEPA自有mask上，batch完整拼接仅从35.1%微增至36.0%，而让块内100个目标token可见提升到48.7%，隐藏块外100个上下文token则无益（33.7%）。
AI.conclusion: mask几何的作用机制在于不可恢复的粗尺度内容，且这种作用通过目标编码器自生成的目标传递；该测量视角能定量预测mask设计效果，对自监督表征学习（尤其视频JEPA）的mask策略设计具有指导意义。

title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
summary: We propose NUDGE (Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry), a training-free obstacle-avoidance procedure that can be incorporated in any robot policy based on diffusion or flow matching, including diffusion policies and vision-language-action models. Our work injects gradients from a signed distance field, a function returning each point's distance to the nearest obstacle, into the policy at inference time to steer it away from obstacles. It supports any common action parameterization, from absolute or relative joint poses to end-effector poses, through a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder. Experiments show that NUDGE preserves the policy's task distribution and runs reactively in real time.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练避障方法 NUDGE，将符号距离场梯度注入扩散/流匹配策略的推理过程，配合可微关节轨迹解码器，支持多种动作参数化，实时避开障碍且保持任务分布。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略与 VLA 模型生成动作时往往缺乏显式几何约束，阻碍其在含障碍真实环境中部署；重训练代价高，需一种通用、即插即用的推理时避障手段。
AI.method: 在推理阶段对策略采样过程注入符号距离场（SDF）梯度：以 SDF 计算轨迹点到最近障碍的距离，通过可微关节轨迹解码器将任意动作参数化（绝对/相对关节位姿、末端位姿）映射到几何空间，从而引导去噪/流匹配更新远离障碍，无需再训练。
AI.result: 实验显示 NUDGE 能保持原策略任务分布，并以反应式方式实时运行；摘要未给出量化指标、具体任务或真机结果。
AI.conclusion: NUDGE 提供了一种通用的推理时几何引导避障方案，可无缝接入扩散策略与 VLA，但缺乏定量与真机验证，需进一步评估其安全性与任务成功率权衡。

title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $\pi_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Grafting：一个轻量、通用的空间模块，将冻结的三维重建特征绑定到机器人相对度量几何，生成"度量锚定空间 token"并通过交叉注意力注入流匹配动作专家，无需改动宿主感知通路。单一架构零改造适配 2 个 VLA 与 2 个 WAM、4 个仿真基准与 3 类真机平台，在 RoboTwin 2.0 与 BEHAVIOR-1K 双机械臂任务上普遍超越已有 3D 条件策略。
AI.motivation: 预训练操作策略（VLA/WAM）把交互相关的度量几何隐式地留在模型内部；虽然空间重建模型能可靠提供几何，但其特征描述的是局部形状，未说明该几何相对机器人的位置关系。如何把这些重建特征最佳地送入预训练策略，仍是未解问题。
AI.method: Spatial Grafting 保持宿主重建编码器与感知通路冻结，将冻结重建特征与机器人相对度量几何绑定，构造度量锚定的空间 token；通过 cross-attention 注入 flow-matching 动作专家，不修改感知主干，从而保留预训练收益。采用统一架构，无需针对不同宿主做重设计。
AI.result: 评测覆盖 2 个 VLA、2 个 WAM、4 个仿真基准（短时程操作、视觉鲁棒性、杂乱场景、长时程移动操作）及 3 个真机平台（单臂/双臂）。RoboTwin 2.0 上所有宿主均提升；grafted π0.5 在干净与随机场景分别 +11.3%/15.6%，达 94.0%/92.4%，超过最强公开 3D 条件策略 WAM4D（93.8%/89.9%）。长时程下优势扩大：BEHAVIOR-1K 六个任务中五个超过 2025 挑战赛冠军，最多领先 0.47 Q-score，并平均超过 map-conditioned 空间策略。
AI.conclusion: 将机器人相对度量几何显式嫁接进预训练策略是可行且高效的方向：一个轻量、宿主无关的接口即可跨 VLA/WAM、跨仿真与真机、跨短/长时程任务带来稳定提升，且任务时程越长增益越明显。

title: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
summary: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.

AI.tldr: 提出Boundary Feature Repair (BFR)冻结宿主适配框架，在相机-LiDAR检测器的模态接口处学习任务监督的残差修正，无需重训练检测器即可提升多模态3D检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 相机-LiDAR检测器即使两传感器同时存在、已同步与标定，仍会持续消费不可靠特征（如受腐蚀退化）。现有方案多依赖干净参考、腐蚀元数据、时序历史或在线更新，难以在部署后低成本修复；因此需要一种在不改动已部署检测器的前提下，针对"模态接口"进行定向修复的适配方法。
AI.method: 冻结宿主适配：仅训练修复模块，编码器、融合消费者、路由器、检测头及宿主归一化统计量全部固定。BFR-C在每个被融合读取的相机特征层级上学习任务监督残差修正；BFR-L将宿主条件化的LiDAR候选对齐到选定边界，并相对冻结锚点路由site-wise创新；二者联合训练构成BFR-CL。每个通道尺度零初始化，使各变体在优化前是精确的检测器级恒等映射。
AI.result: 在完整20种腐蚀、5个严重度的KITTI-C网格上，BFR-C将MVX-Net的RCE从14.07降至11.92，Focals Conv-F从14.29降至11.00。Focals Conv-F上，BFR-L将AP_cor从73.65提升至74.48，BFR-CL达77.01 AP_cor、10.46 RCE、86.02干净AP。nuScenes-R上，BFR-CL将MoME基线mAP鲁棒性比从80.1提升至81.4。
AI.conclusion: 边界修复是一种针对"腐蚀但存在"传感场景的定向改造方案，可在不重训练已部署检测器的情况下提升鲁棒性，且推理时无需干净参考、腐蚀元数据、时序历史或在线更新。

title: GuardPIBT: Counterfactually Gated Neural Guidance for Ultra-Large-Scale 3D Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: Large-scale 3D multi-agent path finding becomes increasingly difficult under dense traffic. Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) scales well, but its one-step goal-directed ordering may become insufficient under dense interactions and large-scale congestion. We present GuardPIBT, which augments rather than replaces the PIBT executor: neural predictions only propose residual reorderings of PIBT's native candidates, while final actions remain determined by PIBT. First, local graph attention models nearby interactions, while global source--goal transport features provide population-level coordination context for candidate reordering. Second, a counterfactual group gate filters reorderings whose closed-loop effects may degrade coordination. Third, for ultra-large populations, population-adaptive grouping preserves decision granularity, asynchronous cached inference amortizes neural computation, and selective repair resolves long-tail agents. PIBT retains validity checking, priority inheritance, and backtracking throughout. Experiments with up to 100,000 agents demonstrate reliable completion across 2D and 3D environments, including all three 100,000-agent warehouse runs with zero audited graph violations. The project website is available at {\color{magenta}\texttt{ this https URL }}.

AI.tldr: GuardPIBT 在 PIBT 执行器之上加入神经残差重排序，实现十万级智能体的大规模 3D 多智能体路径规划，并保证零图冲突。
AI.motivation: PIBT 在大规模稠密交通下扩展性好，但其一步式目标导向的候选排序在密集交互和大范围拥塞下不足；本文希望在不放弃 PIBT 正确性保证的前提下提升其协调质量。
AI.method: 采用"增强而非替换"思路：神经预测只对 PIBT 原生候选提出残差重排序，最终动作仍由 PIBT 决定。包括局部图注意力建模近邻交互，全局起点-终点运输特征提供群体级协调上下文；反事实分组门控过滤可能导致闭环协调退化的重排序；超大规模下使用群体自适应分组、异步缓存推理与选择性修复处理长尾智能体；PIBT 全程保留有效性检查、优先级继承与回溯。
AI.result: 在最多 100,000 个智能体的实验中，2D 与 3D 环境均可靠完成，包括全部三次 100,000 智能体仓库运行且零审计的图冲突。
AI.conclusion: 将学习型重排序作为 PIBT 的保守增强，可在大规模稠密场景中提升协调而不牺牲完备性与安全保证。

title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project website: this https URL
summary: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: DexAgent：以智能体式 Human2Sim2Robot 框架，从单段自我中心人类视频+任务提示生成物理可行的机器人轨迹与数据，用于策略训练。
AI.motivation: 现有 Human2Sim2Robot 流程依赖预定义步骤，难以适应多样物体属性与交互，尤其是铰接与可变形物体；需一种能按任务/物体属性自适应的自动化管线。
AI.method: 四阶段：人类视频语义理解、基于属性的仿真重建、机器人轨迹优化、机器人数据生成。每阶段从工具库选择或新开发技能，并由属性特定 verifier 校验物理有效性与任务要求，反馈迭代修正以阻断误差传播；末阶段在仿真中扰动物体与机器人状态生成多样轨迹，并对渲染观测重纹理化以助 sim-to-real；新技能与 verifier 回存工具库实现自演化。
AI.result: 在 11 个真实世界任务上，使用 DexAgent 生成数据训练的策略成功率比竞争基线高 3.5 倍；随处理人类视频增多，工具库积累可复用能力使处理时间下降。
AI.conclusion: 验证引导的自适应智能体式人类视频到机器人数据管线可覆盖多样物体与长程任务，并具备自演化与效率递增特性，是低成本扩展灵巧操作演示数据的可行范式。

title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
summary: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.

AI.tldr: P2P-T 提出一种数据高效、以物体为中心的工具操作框架：先用人类视频预训练物体中心世界模型提取稳定位姿先验，再将其注入高效的位姿感知低层策略，从而在无需人-机对齐数据的条件下实现复杂真实工具操作，性能较此前 SOTA 提升 73%。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人数据稀缺是扩展机器人操作的主要瓶颈。现有借助人类视频演示的方法计算开销大，且仍依赖配对的人-机数据做域对齐；当前 SOTA 虽擅长长时程任务，却难以完成工具操作所需的精细精确控制。作者希望绕过人-机对齐数据，直接从人类演示中学习工具使用。
AI.method: 两阶段、以物体为中心的框架：(1) 预训练物体中心世界模型以提取稳定的位姿先验；(2) 将这些先验集成到高效、位姿感知的低层策略中。配套使用由现代基础模型驱动的自动化数据处理流水线，完全规避人-机对齐数据需求，显著降低训练开销，每任务仅需极少微调。
AI.result: 在真实世界复杂工具操作任务上，执行性能较此前 SOTA 提升 73%，这些任务对标准大规模预训练模型而言仍难以完成；且显著降低了整体训练开销与对配对数据的依赖。
AI.conclusion: P2P-T 通过物体中心世界模型 + 位姿感知策略 + 自动化数据流水线，证明无需人-机对齐数据也能实现精细工具操作，为数据高效的真实机器人操作提供了可行路径。

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出残差感知共形动作滤波（RACF），利用固定名义预测器的残差分位数校准安全操作裕度，在无需重训练的情况下实现自适应ACC约束满足，兼顾安全性与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 冻结的ACC策略在部署动态偏离训练条件时会违反安全约束；现有CBF-QP类基线要么保守（计算开销大、投影频繁），要么安全率不足，需要在无需重训练的前提下实现可靠约束满足。
AI.method: 对固定名义预测器的残差进行共形校准，将残差分位数转换为操作裕度；用该裕度进行有限模型动作投影，并由已完成transition在线更新裕度与候选选择，全程不更新策略参数。理论上刻画单步残差覆盖与约束满足之间的联系条件。
AI.result: 2400个控制器-试验单元注册对比中，Adaptive RACF 达到94.3%回合安全率，较名义CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点，投影频率由8.11%降至6.63%；受控实验分离出残差裕度注入带来的4.54点增益。匹配硬件评估中，相对Robust CBF-QP平均摊销 rollout 时间减少21.2%，安全回合161/180 vs 170/180。
AI.conclusion: 残差感知共形滤波可在不重训练策略的条件下提升部署安全性并降低计算开销，但安全性与计算效率之间存在可量化的折衷，且其覆盖保证依赖于所刻画的条件。

title: Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation
summary: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality. This enables the downstream QA value of candidate memories to be measured and optimized without accessing the internal mechanisms of the black-box captioning, retrieval, and reasoning pipeline. Building on this metric, we develop a memory-centric (MemCen) framework that jointly selects UAVs and allocates transmit power to maximize memory quality under communication constraints. In the noise-limited regime, we derive a QoM-aware capped water-filling law that explicitly connects task utility with physical-layer power allocation. We further develop penalty successive optimization (PSO) and learning to memorize (L2M) solvers. MemCen achieves QA accuracies of 92.4% and 84.0% in CARLA Town04 and Town05 under static and dynamic communication conditions, respectively. In real-world experiments, MemCen achieves 88.5% QA accuracy on the panoramic multi-agent system (PMAS) benchmark. Finally, UAV-to-robot-dog demonstrations further validate the practical utility of the acquired memories for environmental understanding and navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出生成对抗考试（GAE）为UAV分布式记忆定义可量化的“记忆质量”指标，并据此构建以记忆为中心（MemCen）的UAV选择与功率分配联合优化框架，含QoM感知截断注水律、PSO与L2M求解器，在CARLA与真实PMAS基准上取得高QA精度。
AI.motivation: 长时程低空问答（LAQA）中，地面服务器需聚合多UAV记忆来回答观测问题。传统资源分配以感知、通信、控制或计算指标为准则，无法显式刻画“记忆对下游问答任务的价值”，因此需要一个与任务效用直接挂钩的记忆价值度量，以指导UAV选择与功率分配。
AI.method: 提出生成对抗考试（GAE）：利用前向仿真评估记忆检索，并用考试分数量化记忆质量，从而在无需访问黑盒描述生成、检索与推理内部机制的情况下度量候选记忆的下游QA价值。基于该指标构建MemCen框架，在通信约束下联合选择UAV并分配发射功率以最大化记忆质量；在噪声受限区推导QoM感知的截断注水（capped water-filling）功率分配律，显式连接任务效用与物理层功率分配，并给出罚函数逐次优化（PSO）与Learning-to-Memorize（L2M）两类求解器。
AI.result: MemCen在CARLA Town04/Town05静、动态通信条件下分别达到92.4%与84.0%的QA精度；真实世界PMAS全景多智能体基准上达到88.5% QA精度；UAV到机器狗的演示进一步验证所获记忆在环境理解与导航中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 将“记忆价值”显式引入通信-任务联合优化可有效提升低空问答性能，所推导的QoM感知截断注水律揭示了任务效用与功率分配之间的解析关系，MemCen在仿真与真实系统中均具可行性与泛化性，为UAV协作记忆系统提供了可度量的优化范式。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models map observations and instructions directly to robot actions. This directness ties a policy to training: minor layout or viewpoint changes cause failure, and instructions generalize poorly. The root cause lies in representation: task requirements, conditions, progress, and failure recovery are implicitly encoded in action sequences, making them difficult to inspect or revise. Digital coding agents offer a precedent: LLMs call tools, verify results, and revise from feedback as executable code. The same working pattern of explicit state, manageable execution, and revisable procedures underlies generalization and long-horizon execution in the physical world, letting physical experience return as reusable programs, memory, or evidence. We propose Physical Coding, representing task state and execution as code. Code as World records objects, relations, constraints, and progress; Code as Policy organizes planning, verification, recovery, and execution. We build HexaAnything, which calls perception, planning, and control tools, including VLA/WAM policies, and makes in-the-loop decisions from external feedback. Verified traces become data and memory, enabling evolution from tools and Harness to model weights, architectures, and ultimately hardware and task design. On RoboCasa365, HexaAnything improves Composite-Unseen and overall success over XR-1 VLA, and its Harness-trained HexaModel beats the base on every split, indicating code traces internalize physical execution. On PhyBench and a dual-arm AgileX robot, the agent autonomously completes physics experiments and most tabletop tasks, often faster than published results. We observe data, model, and tool self-evolution; future work targets weight internalization, autonomous redesign of architectures, languages, representations, and tasks, and deployment in manufacturing and science.

AI.tldr: 提出 Physical Coding 范式：用代码显式表示任务状态与执行过程（Code as World 记录物体/关系/约束/进度，Code as Policy 组织规划、验证、恢复与执行），构建调用感知、规划、控制工具（含 VLA/WAM 策略）的智能体 HexaAnything，并将验证过的执行轨迹转化为数据、记忆与模型，实现工具—模型—硬件—任务的自演化。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 与世界动作模型将观测和指令直接映射为动作，策略与训练分布强绑定：布局或视角轻微变化即失败，指令泛化差。根因在于表征——任务需求、条件、进度与失败恢复被隐式编码在动作序列中，难以检视与修改，从而阻碍泛化与长时程执行。
AI.method: 以数字编码智能体为参照，提出 Physical Coding：把任务状态与执行表示为可执行代码，分两层——Code as World 维护物体、关系、约束与进度等显式世界状态；Code as Policy 组织规划、验证、失败恢复与执行。实现为智能体系统 HexaAnything，通过调用感知、规划、控制工具（包括 VLA/WAM 策略）并在外部反馈下做闭环决策，将验证过的轨迹沉淀为数据与记忆。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa365 上，HexaAnything 的 Composite-Unseen 与总体成功率超过 XR-1 VLA；由 Harness 训练得到的 HexaModel 在所有划分上均优于基座。在 PhyBench 与 AgileX 双臂机器人上，智能体自主完成物理实验与多数桌面任务，速度常优于已发表结果。观察到数据、模型与工具三类自演化现象。
AI.conclusion: 代码轨迹能够内化物理执行经验，显式表征是物理世界泛化与长时程执行的有效路径；未来工作指向权重内化，以及架构、语言、表征与任务的自主重设计，并落地制造与科学场景。

title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures. Project Page: this https URL
summary: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出可修订时序规划(RTP)，将预测的视觉未来作为持续动作条件，并用学习到的"修订桥"在执行反馈后恢复中间生成状态并适配后续生成，配合时间感知历史与自适应策略在新噪声下选择保留、桥接修订或重新规划，在RoboMME/RMBench达到48.6%/84.8%的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型用预测视觉未来条件化机器人动作，但执行反馈可能使预测的部分内容失效，而其中任务结构信息仍有价值；因此需要一个能在反馈后局部修订而非全盘重规划的机制。
AI.method: RTP把视觉未来保持为持久动作条件并在反馈后修订；核心是学习到的修订桥：恢复视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态，并让后续生成适配当前观测；视觉与动作监督将该修订与后续控制连接；时间感知历史提供观测证据，自适应策略依据新噪声在保留、桥接修订、全新重规划三种模式间选择，再解码下一动作。
AI.result: 在RoboMME和RMBench上任务平均成功率分别为48.6%与84.8%；配对比较支持学习式延续的有效性，估计的检查点来源效应与动作前缀效应为正但精度较低。
AI.conclusion: 结果将反馈驱动的视觉规划修订与闭环任务性能联系起来，表明对视觉未来的局部可修订性优于整段重规划/不可修订方案。

title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.

AI.tldr: Uni-VLaT 在预训练 VLA 策略中引入全身分布式触觉通路，其潜在状态除驱动动作生成外，还预测未来触觉、本体与视觉表征，形成"触觉锚定"的多模态上下文，在五类真实机器人任务上取得 75% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在 loco-manipulation 中如何响应常由物理接触决定，但纯视觉与本体感受难以刻画物理交互，尤其当接触区域被遮挡时；预定义部位的稀疏力/力矩测量又丢失空间分辨的接触模式。因此需要把全身分布式触觉信息整合进 VLA 策略以支持富接触控制。
AI.method: 提出 Uni-VLaT：在 VLA 架构中增加独立触觉通路，其隐状态不仅用于动作生成，还被训练去预测未来的触觉、本体感受与视觉表征；该预测目标构造触觉锚定的多模态上下文。评测覆盖 5 个真实机器人任务（触觉触发行走、持续物理交互、人机接触、loco-manipulation），并在两个预训练 VLA 骨干上对比无触觉基线、无可预测监督的触觉基线，并做消融。
AI.result: 平均成功率 75%，比无触觉输入基线高 43 个点，比有触觉输入但无可预测监督的基线高 7 个点。在两个预训练 VLA 骨干上，Table Sweeping 均提升 30 个点，Back-Tap Walking 提升 85–90 个点。消融显示情境化触觉预测与绝对未来目标对性能关键。
AI.conclusion: 预测式触觉学习为把预训练 VLA 策略扩展到全身物理交互提供了有效路径。

title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.

AI.tldr: 提出CATok因果动作分词器，将分词重构为因果结构化生成过程，通过条件退火流匹配提取token，并用MMDiT解码器重建连续动作块，实现纯自回归VLA的高效token化。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归VLA模型的动作分词器把分词当作压缩问题，产生的表征与自回归主干语义错位，导致离散token空间与生成式建模目标不匹配，且高层推理与低层执行难以清晰分离。
AI.method: CATok将分词定义为因果结构化生成过程：引入条件退火机制，逐步退火流匹配过程以提取动作token，每个token以所有前序token为条件并编码特定噪声水平下的残差重建信号，形成由粗到细的因果token空间；再用基于MMDiT的token条件流匹配解码器，从离散token重建连续动作块，以离散瓶颈实现知识隔离。
AI.result: 在三个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上，CATok在重建保真度-压缩权衡与推理效率上持续超越现有分词方法，同时提升VLA任务成功率与训练效率。
AI.conclusion: CATok为纯自回归VLA系统建立了高性能、可扩展的基础，验证了因果结构化生成式动作分词的有效性。

title: CoBrush: A Hierarchical Planning Framework for Human-Robot Co-Painting
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Embodied co-painting requires a robot to repeatedly update a shared physical canvas while human intent evolves over interaction. Existing reference-driven painters or reactive assistants are typically optimized for single-shot rendering or sketch completion, limiting their ability to sustain coherent multi-round collaboration or to construct complex, content-rich scenes over time. We present CoBrush, a hierarchical framework that formulates multi-round co-painting as a coordinated semantic, spatial, and execution process. By separating high-level intent inference from spatial grounding and stroke-level control, the system supports progressive scene development on real acrylic canvases. We evaluate the framework through real human-robot painting sessions, stress tests, and user studies. Compared to single-turn baselines, our approach achieves stronger semantic alignment, more stable spatial progression, and higher perceived plausibility of robot actions. These results demonstrate that structured multi-stage reasoning improves the coherence and robustness of interactive painting and supports the progressive development of content-rich physical artworks.

AI.tldr: CoBrush：将多轮人机共同绘画建模为语义—空间—执行的分层框架，可在真实丙烯画布上持续协作，语义对齐与空间推进稳定性优于单轮基线。
AI.motivation: 现有参考驱动绘画机器人或反应式助手多面向单次渲染或草图补全，难以在人类意图随交互演化时维持连贯的多轮协作，也无法逐步构建内容丰富的复杂场景。
AI.method: 提出分层框架 CoBrush，把多轮共画分解为高层意图推断、空间落地与笔画级控制三个协调阶段，解耦高层语义推理与低层执行，从而支持真实丙烯画布上的渐进式场景生成。
AI.result: 通过真实人机绘画会话、压力测试与用户研究评估：相较单轮基线，语义对齐更强、空间推进更稳定、机器人动作的感知合理性更高。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多阶段推理能提升交互绘画的连贯性与鲁棒性，支持内容丰富的实体艺术作品的渐进式创作；但缺少量化指标、开源代码与跨任务泛化证据。

title: Robot Tool Design from Scratch via Behavior-Aware Hierarchical Optimization
summary: The ability to design a tool for a task marks a level of intelligence beyond merely understanding, selecting, or using one. Existing methods for robotic tool design typically optimize a tool's continuous shape and action within a structure that is prescribed or generated beforehand, so the structure itself stays outside the physical optimization loop. We study task-driven tool design from scratch, where tool structure, shape, and action are all derived from the desired physical outcome. Here we show that the three elements can be designed jointly by HOT, a hierarchical optimization whose upper level searches over discrete tool structures with BASS, while lower-level physical optimization evaluates their task behavior and returns milestone progress as behavioral evidence for the search, ultimately providing jointly optimized shape and action. On four tool-use tasks with distinct physical functions, HOT discovers functional structures after evaluating only a small fraction of search spaces containing up to 56 million structures, and the subsequent refinement of their geometry lowers the task loss on all tasks while preserving success, through deformations that are functionally interpretable. Once 3D printed, the tools accomplish all tasks on a real robot with the actions found in simulation. Designing tools from required physical effects, rather than a catalog of known tools, is a step toward the open-ended tool making seen in humans and animals.

AI.tldr: HOT：双层分层优化实现任务驱动的工具结构-形状-动作联合设计，上层用BASS搜索离散结构、下层物理优化评估行为并以里程碑进展作为证据。在4个任务上仅评估极小比例（最多5600万结构）搜索空间即发现功能结构，几何细化降低损失并保持成功，3D打印后在真机上以仿真动作完成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人工具设计方法多在预先给定或事先生成的结构下优化连续形状与动作，结构本身处于物理优化循环之外，无法从零开始由任务物理效果反推工具。作者希望实现结构、形状、动作三要素共同由期望物理结果导出的开放式工具制造。
AI.method: HOT分层优化框架：上层在离散工具结构空间上以BASS进行搜索（评估预算受限），下层执行物理优化以评估该结构在任务中的行为，并将“里程碑进展”作为行为证据回传给上层搜索，最终输出联合优化的形状与动作；随后对其几何进行细化，产生功能可解释的形变。
AI.result: 在4个具有不同物理功能的工具使用任务上，HOT仅评估高达5600万结构搜索空间中的一小部分即发现功能结构；几何细化在全部任务上降低任务损失且保持成功率，形变具有功能可解释性；3D打印工具在真实机器人上以仿真得到的动作完成全部任务。
AI.conclusion: 由所需物理效果而非已知工具库来设计工具，是走向人类与动物那种开放式造工具能力的一步；结果表明结构、形状与动作可在同一物理优化循环中联合搜索，并具备sim-to-real可行性。

title: ForVis: An In-Field Dataset and Benchmark for VIO Using Under-Canopy UAV Flights in Forests
summary: Visual-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for UAVs remains difficult to evaluate in real forest environments, where motion, illumination changes, repetitive vegetation, and vibration can all affect estimation. We present ForVis, an in-field dataset and benchmark for evaluating VI-SLAM during UAV flight in forest environments. The dataset contains twelve flights across open meadow, above-canopy, and under-canopy conditions in each environment. In total, it provides 563.8s of flight over 1096.8m of trajectory, recorded simultaneously with an Intel RealSense D435i and an OAK-D Pro Wide together with inertial and flight-controller data. We benchmark seven open-source VI-SLAM systems over 504 runs. The results show that sensor choice has a larger effect on trajectory error than the spread between algorithms: all seven methods achieve lower median error on the OAK-D Pro than on the D435i. ForVis is intended to support evaluation of speed, accuracy and robustness for VI-SLAM in challenging forest flight.

AI.tldr: ForVis：面向森林环境中无人机VI-SLAM评估的实飞数据集与基准，含12次飞行、563.8s/1096.8m轨迹，同步采集RealSense D435i与OAK-D Pro Wide及IMU/飞控数据，评测7套开源VI-SLAM共504次运行，发现传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法差异。
AI.motivation: 真实森林环境中的无人机VI-SLAM缺乏可复现的评估手段，运动、光照变化、重复植被纹理与振动都会影响估计精度，而现有数据集与基准难以覆盖开敞草地、冠层上方与冠层下方等典型飞行条件。
AI.method: 构建实飞数据集ForVis：在每类环境中各采集开敞草地、冠层上方、冠层下方三类飞行，共12次；使用Intel RealSense D435i与OAK-D Pro Wide双相机同步记录，并采集惯性测量与飞控数据，累计飞行563.8s、轨迹1096.8m；在此基础上对7个开源VI-SLAM系统开展504次基准运行，比较速度、精度与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法之间的差异：7种方法在OAK-D Pro上的中位误差均低于D435i；基准覆盖多环境、多状态下的精度、速度与鲁棒性对比。
AI.conclusion: ForVis为挑战性森林飞行场景下的VI-SLAM评估提供了实飞数据与标准化基准，表明相机硬件选型是影响估计误差的关键因素，可用于支撑后续方法在速度、精度与鲁棒性方面的对比研究。

title: Terrain-Aware Autonomous Planetary Exploration for Exteroceptive-Proprioceptive Mapping with Quadruped Scouts
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Autonomous planetary exploration requires robots to navigate unknown, uneven terrain while assessing risk, traversability, and energetic cost. Quadruped scouts are well suited for this task because they can traverse irregular surfaces and gather mobility-relevant information during locomotion. This paper presents a terrain-aware exploration framework that combines exteroceptive and proprioceptive mapping for a quadruped robot in lunar-like environments. An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps, estimates geometric traversability, and derives navigation costs for autonomous planning. In parallel, proprioceptive measurements provide interaction-aware terrain cues that complement geometry-based assessment. Local maps are incrementally registered into a global multi-layer representation, which is used by an exploration module to select targets in unexplored regions of interest. The targets are reached by an autonomous navigation system that guides collision-aware motion using the available map and cost layers. Simulation results on NVIDIA Isaac Sim show autonomous exploration, map expansion, and spatial association between terrain geometry and robot-terrain interaction. Subsequent navigation using this information exhibits lower average Cost of Transport (CoT) than initial exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向类月球环境的四足机器人地形感知自主探索框架：融合RGB-D外部感知与本体的地形建图，构建多层全局表示，驱动兴趣目标选择与避障导航。
AI.motivation: 行星自主探索要求机器人穿越未知崎岖地形并评估风险、可通行性与能耗。四足机器人适合该任务，但需要同时利用几何观测与足-地交互信息来弥补纯几何建图的不足。现有工作往往只依赖外部感知或仅做局部建图，缺少将本体交互线索与全局多层地图结合的自主探索框架。
AI.method: 在机载RGB-D相机上构建以机器人为中心的高程图，估计几何可通行性并推导导航代价；并行利用本体测量（关节/足端接触等）生成交互感知的地形线索，补充几何评估。局部地图增量配准为全局多层表示（几何层+交互层+代价层），探索模块据此在未探索兴趣区域选择目标点，由自主导航系统结合地图与代价层进行碰撞感知运动规划。
