AI.result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim上的仿真实验显示：实现了自主探索与地图扩展；地形几何与机器人-地形交互之间呈现空间关联；利用该信息进行后续导航时，平均运输代价（Cost of Transport, CoT）低于初始探索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 本体感知与外部感知结合的多层建图可提升四足机器人在类月球非结构化地形上的探索与能效导航，为该方向提供了可行框架与仿真验证。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
comment: Please visit our project page this https URL
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: GeoCR 是一个统一的多传感器去云通用模型，通过冻结的 RGB 自编码器主干加轻量输入/输出 stem 与共享流变换器，在 10 个数据集上联合预训练，支持单/多时相、全波段/RGB、可选 SAR 引导，无需逐数据集微调即可推理或 LoRA 适配。
AI.motivation: 现有去云方法高度专用化：绑定单一数据集、传感器、波段与输入配置（如仅 RGB 或多光谱、是否多时相、是否有 SAR），导致跨传感器、跨光谱、跨观测设置的复用性差，每种配置都需重新训练专用模型，缺乏可复用的通用去云先验。
AI.method: 以预训练的 RGB 自编码器为骨干并冻结其编码器与解码器主干，仅扩展紧凑的输入/输出 stem 以适配不同光谱与传感域；共享潜空间接口使单一流变换器（flow transformer）在分别以多云观测流和可选 SAR token 为条件下，联合建模干净 RGB 与非 RGB 潜变量。在 10 个数据集训练划分（883,331 张无云目标影像）上联合预训练，学习跨异构配置的共享去云先验；同一检查点支持直接推理与 LoRA 低秩适配。
AI.result: 在贡献数据集的测试划分上，于全波段与仅 RGB 两类设置下与通用图像复原及去云方法对比：GeoCR 在全波段 SEN12MS-CR、Sen2_MTC_New 以及仅 RGB 的 CUHK-CR2 上取得最优 FID 与 DISTS，超越已有模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式解耦"共享生成先验 + 轻量域适配 stem"的通用生成式去云模型可在异质传感器、光谱与观测配置间复用同一预训练权重，无需逐数据集微调即可达到领先性能，验证了可复用生成模型在多种遥感去云设置下的有效性。

title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对手写数学表达式识别(HMER)中的域差异问题，通过碎片化与笔画宽度分析刻画训练图(数字/二值化)与相机拍摄图之间的差距，并提出面向MFH-CoMER的作者自适应微调流程，在自建5个作者专属子集上验证：数字手写识别率提升、CER下降，物理手写结果较为混合，5个子集中4个有改善，2个子集统计显著。
AI.motivation: 现有HMER最优系统不针对特定书写者风格自适应；同时训练图像(数字或完美二值化)与推理时相机实拍图像之间存在域差异，而该问题在此任务上关注极少。作者因此希望刻画该域差异并探索书写者自适应的可行性。
AI.method: 1) 通过图像碎片化(fragmentation)和笔画宽度(stroke-width)分析量化数字/二值化图像与相机实拍图像之间的域差异；2) 在MFH-CoMER上引入作者自适应微调(writer-adaptive fine-tuning)流程；3) 构建含两位作者、5个书写类别子集的样本数据集；4) 在有限数据下采用McNemar检验与置换检验进行评估。
AI.result: 数字手写场景下表达式识别率上升、CER下降；物理手写场景结果较为混合，模型在基模型本身已能较好处理的字迹文章上表现吃力；整体上5个子集中4个自适应模型有改善；统计检验显示2个作者专属子集具有一致性的提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果指向书写者自适应(writer adaptation)在HMER任务上的潜在可行性，为后续个性化手写数学识别提供了初步证据与流程范式。

title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
summary: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

AI.tldr: UnStep 提出一种免训练推理加速方案,通过减少 DiT 步数与注意力 KV 缓存时间窗,并配合重噪化精修、截断 SVD 及运行时优化,使少步因果视频扩散模型在单卡 H100 上达到 50 FPS、GB200 上 77 FPS 且无质量损失。
AI.motivation: 少步因果视频扩散学生模型虽比双向多步教师快,但仍达不到实时生成要求。作者希望在不重新训练的前提下进一步压缩推理计算,弥补减步与注意力窗口裁剪带来的质量退化。
AI.method: 免训练推理封装:(1) 用比蒸馏时更少的 DiT 步数运行,并限制注意力 KV 缓存保留的时间窗口;(2) 对生成的潜帧重新加噪至近干净水平,复用已有 clean-cache 通路进行精修;(3) 对 DiT 注意力的 value/output 投影做截断 SVD;(4) 运行时栈优化,包括更高效的注意力调用与 KV 索引、融合 Triton RoPE(缓存系数)、VAE 解码的内存布局/精度/卷积核优化。
AI.result: 在不重新训练的情况下显著快于现有方法,单张 H100 达到 50 FPS,单张 GB200 达到 77 FPS,且无明显质量损失,创下因果视频扩散吞吐新水平。
AI.conclusion: 少步因果视频扩散模型可通过免训练的推理期机制与运行时栈协同优化,突破实时生成瓶颈,为流式视频生成提供高吞吐方案。

title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
summary: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

AI.tldr: 提出SetOPD开放提示检测框架，用Base+Residual框级提示保留视觉模态，并在候选状态级进行文本-视觉仲裁（PQA），提升少样本异构示例下的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有开放提示检测器对视觉模态利用不足：多示例被压缩为单一类级嵌入（视觉提示文本化，容量受限），且跨模态交互发生在检测状态形成之前（提示或表征空间）。
AI.method: 从集合视角重构：共享提示条件下的初始化分别驱动文本与视觉解码路径；提出BR框级提示——每个框示例在完整场景上下文中读取，将支持证据分解为Base锚点与学习的Residual校正，提示容量与示例数无关；提出Paired-Query Arbitration（PQA）——两路reader共享query初始化使候选按索引配对，学习门控在配对内仲裁，再由置换等变模块对融合集合推理。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集、指标或定量结果，仅声明现有设计次优并主张所提方法在候选状态级协作上更优。
AI.conclusion: 将文本-视觉协作从表征级融合转为候选集合建模问题，可能成为开放提示检测的新范式。

title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
summary: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

AI.tldr: 提出 DepthBench 受控基准，固定模型规模与预训练配方，系统调整宽深比，在 10 类架构上研究"计算深度"，发现残差连接设计（HC、Full AttnRes）决定深度能否作为有效扩展轴，而 Pre-LN 及其归一化/缩放变体在深层窄型下收益甚微甚至退化。
AI.motivation: 深层 Transformer 的深层贡献会随深度增大而衰减。近期通过归一化（LayerNorm Scaling）或残差连接（mHC、AttnRes）改进信息流的方法声称能提升深度利用，但尚不清楚它们是否真将"架构深度"转化为"有效计算深度"，以及增益是来自跨层信息获取改善还是未被控制的混淆因素。
AI.method: 构建 DepthBench 受控基准：在保持模型总规模和预训练配方不变的前提下，系统改变宽深比（d_model/n_layer），从浅宽到深窄；覆盖 10 类代表性架构（Pre-LN、多种归一化/缩放变体、HC、Full AttnRes 等），并进行受控的逐层分析以定位增益来源。
AI.result: 增加深度容量带来的收益强烈依赖架构：标准 Pre-LN 及多数归一化/缩放变体在深窄形态下收益很小甚至性能下降；HC 与 Full AttnRes 在极端深窄形态下仍持续改进。收益不仅体现在预训练损失，也转化为下游领域性能与有效计算的提升，逐层分析显示与额外层被更有效利用相关。
AI.conclusion: 残差连接设计是决定深度能否作为有意义扩展轴的关键因素，它使额外的架构深度能够转化为有效计算；不同架构实现计算深度的机制存在差异。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RIPE-MambaSpike 通过用固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥替换分辨率相关的投影层，将脉冲-Mamba 混合模型参数从 36.25M 压缩到 0.870M（43 倍输入面积范围内参数恒定），并在 CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200 上取得帕累托最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有事件视觉的脉冲-Mamba 混合模型精度虽高但参数量达数千万。作者指出，参数开销主要来自脉冲前端与状态空间骨干之间的连接方式（单分辨率相关投影层占 36.25M 中的 33.55M），而非混合架构本身，因此存在大幅压缩空间。
AI.method: 提出 RIPE-MambaSpike：用固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥替代分辨率相关投影；配合重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制，以及动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，在紧凑设计下保持精度。部署参数 0.870M，在 43 倍输入面积范围内于固定时间步与宽度下保持恒定。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200 上达到帕累托最优；在 200 类的 DailyDVS-200 上，8.04M 配置取得 45.7% top-1 准确率，为该基准上已报道的最佳脉冲结果，且参数量比稠密 ANN 少 3.0–15.1 倍。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的事件视觉识别并不要求参数随分辨率增长；通过改进前端-骨干连接即可显著降低参数量，为参数高效的事件视觉模型提供了可行路径。

title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

AI.tldr: FlashForward 通过直接复用每个去噪阶段已计算的在途 KV 缓存替代额外的缓存刷新前向传播，并用稀疏干净锚点潜变量补偿噪声历史，实现多 GPU 阶段并行，将少步自回归视频扩散的生成速度提升 1.16–2.92 倍并保持长时视频质量稳定。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散需要逐块生成长视频，为记忆已生成块，以往方法需通过额外的"仅更新缓存"前向传播重建干净或低噪声的 KV 缓存，计算开销大；而每次去噪前向本身就已计算当前块的在途 KV，这部分计算被浪费。
AI.method: 提出 FlashForward：(1) 直接复用当前块去噪阶段产生的阶段特定 KV 缓存，省去缓存更新专用的额外前向；(2) 当前块完成一个去噪阶段后，其阶段缓存即可供下一块使用，从而可将每个去噪阶段分配到不同 GPU，使不同时间块在不同阶段上并发执行；(3) 针对阶段匹配历史含噪导致的外观与运动漂移，在对应区域生成前产生稀疏的辅助干净锚点潜变量，形成双边条件：稀疏干净锚点 KV 提供粗粒度长程结构引导，稠密阶段匹配历史保留细粒度近期演化。
AI.result: 在最多 4 块 GPU 上，对 20 秒以上、16 FPS 的视频，FlashForward 在 1.3B 与 14B 骨干、480p 与 720p 下比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69 倍、比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92 倍。VBench 上 1.3B/480p 模型得分更高，且在 20s、35s、65s 长时长下保持稳定，兼顾高质量、时序一致性与更快的生成速度。
AI.conclusion: 复用去噪过程中的在途 KV 缓存可消除冗余的缓存更新计算，使阶段级流水线并行成为可能；辅以稀疏干净锚点的双边条件，可在显著加速的同时抑制噪声历史带来的漂移，验证了长时视频生成中"速度—质量"可同时优化的路径。

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
summary: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: TRACE：以分离但耦合的连续隐变量框架联合建模身体、物体与手部运动流，解码后施加几何损失约束接触，支持单流补全，冻结流特征亦可用于HOI理解。
AI.motivation: 文本条件HOI生成要求身体运动、物体轨迹与旋转、手部关节三者协调，但它们在尺度与动力学上差异大：共享表示会抹平各流结构，独立生成又无法相互响应；仅靠隐空间监督也不能在解码后直接约束接触。
AI.method: TRACE将身体、物体、手部编码为独立隐变量，在完整当前交互状态下预测各流速度，实现"状态分离、更新耦合"；在解码后的运动上施加几何损失，随时间约束接触与物体相对运动；同一模型可仅凭另两流补全缺失流；冻结的流特征作为语言模型输入用于HOI理解。
AI.result: 在InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE上，联合补全训练提升生成效果，冻结流特征优于原始运动编码的理解表现；在InterAct上取得对比方法中最高的接触精确率、召回率与F1。
AI.conclusion: 分离隐状态+耦合更新+解码几何约束的组合，可同时服务于HOI生成、流补全与理解，验证了接触显式约束的必要性。

title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出动态分析潜在表示的DCE-MRI乳腺分类框架，抑制背景摄取、补偿形变错位、跨期相选取时序特征，并以病灶分割预训练增强微调；ODELIA留一中心验证与AMBL队列上AUROC提升约8点，获MICCAI ODELIA 2025挑战赛第一。
AI.motivation: DCE-MRI可提供高分辨解剖细节与丰富时间对比信息，但4D高维输入、病灶小、跨中心采集协议异构，导致健康/良性/恶性自动分类鲁棒性差。作者希望框架能动态适应协议特异性特征，从而提升跨中心泛化。
AI.method: 1) 空间层面降低混杂背景摄取并补偿软组织形变导致的错位；2) 在潜空间中利用各期相间关系选择最具信息量的时序特征，以增强对协议时序差异的鲁棒性；3) 通过大规模有监督病灶分割预训练获得任务判别性特征，再进行下游微调。评估采用leave-one-center-out协议，在ODELIA与AMBL队列上验证。
AI.result: 在ODELIA留一中心验证和held-out AMBL队列上显著优于微调的放射学基础模型与既有方法：相比最强基线，平均AUROC提升近8个百分点，平衡准确率提升4个百分点；并在MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025中获得第一名。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，针对协议差异进行潜空间动态适应、跨期相时序特征选择与分割预训练，可有效提升乳腺DCE-MRI跨中心分类鲁棒性与准确性，具备临床多中心部署潜力。

title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
summary: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease this http URL address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出CFCH双分支粗-细协同层次学习框架，显式建模解剖区域与疾病语义的层次依赖，并构建AS-9K前节图像数据集（8975图/12类），在眼科前节疾病分类上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 裂隙灯图像因成像条件多变、且眼病存在"解剖区域—疾病"的内在层次结构，现有方法多将其简化为扁平多分类，忽略了结构依赖关系。
AI.method: CFCH：双分支层次学习框架，粗粒度分支建模解剖区域（角膜、结膜、晶状体等），细粒度分支建模疾病语义；引入语义注意力一致性与跨粒度注意力一致性约束，实现跨粒度协同的特征对齐与互补学习；同时构建AS-9K数据集。
AI.result: 在两个前节数据集上优于现有SOTA方法；定性可视化显示激活区域更聚焦、更贴合病灶。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模解剖—疾病层次结构与跨粒度一致性约束，可有效提升前节疾病分类性能，并提供大规模公开数据集。

title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
summary: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

AI.tldr: 在完整COCO-Val 5000张图像上重新评估LAOD式零训练LLM+开放词汇检测器流程，发现CAAP与SNAP的差距主要源于标注体系闭集限制与新词指代不同物体，而非真正的定位失败。
AI.motivation: LAOD等零训练LLM+OVOD流程分别报告类无关定位精度（CAAP）与语义命名精度（SNAP），二者持续背离但无人解释原因，且原工作仅在小子集上评测，结论可靠性存疑。
AI.method: 在完整COCO-Val 5000张图像（27,273个检测）上重做评测；分析物体视觉复杂度、词汇新颖性与定位精度的关系；区分真同义词、语义无关噪声标签与指向不同物体的新词；核查表面定位失败子集中是否为COCO非穷尽80类未标注的真实物体；通过替换检测器骨干（YOLO-World vs Grounding DINO）与LLM（Gemma-3 vs Qwen2.5-VL）验证效应泛化性。
AI.result: 物体视觉复杂度并非驱动因素，小目标与遮挡目标定位反而更好；词汇新颖性是关键：LLM措辞超出检测器原生类别集时定位精度从80.9%降至31.6%；该下降几乎全部来自新词实际指代与COCO标注不同物体的情况（真同义词仍达89.3%，语义无关噪声标签仅12.0%）；进一步失败子集中78-88%实为模型正确找到COCO未标注的真实物体，而非幻觉；替换骨干或LLM后效应及幅度基本保持。
AI.conclusion: CAAP-SNAP差距的大部分可归因于闭集标注体系的局限，而非真实的grounding失败，这是该流程家族的普遍属性；对幻觉检测、失败模式分析与开放世界grounded多模态系统的评测设计具有重要影响。

title: OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents
summary: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniSmartHome 多模态智能家居基准，将语音请求与视觉和空间音频上下文配对，评测 16 个 Omni-LLM，并提供 PROME 程序性记忆智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居基准仅用纯语言表达用户请求，忽略真实场景中用户常借助指向物体或指代所见所闻的多模态线索，导致请求在语言层面欠定，与现实交互脱节。
AI.method: 构建 OmniSmartHome 基准，含 1,360 个合成与 272 个真实世界 episode，每个语音请求配备视觉与空间音频上下文；评测 16 个全模态大模型；提出 PROME（多模态证据收集的程序性记忆）智能体基线，配备专用音视频感知工具与用于编排工具使用的程序性记忆。
AI.result: 当仅凭语音足以传达意图时，模型表现强劲；但需要跨多模态上下文线索推理以消解欠定请求时，性能显著下降。PROME 在六种 Omni-LLM 上普遍提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 多模态上下文对真实智能家居请求理解至关重要，当前 Omni-LLM 在该能力上仍存明显短板；程序性记忆与专用感知工具编排是一种有效的智能体增强方向。

title: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form. We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on those same messages improves it by 2.31. Delivery is the larger term on all three MemLens backbones and grows with backbone strength; retrieval grows too, without closing the gap. We propose DeliverMem, an instantiation of delivery as three decisions: keep the original modality, give each item a readable identity, and state when it was seen, with a retrieval-side adapter for the one property delivery cannot supply. Each is measured against a delivery-matched control that alters only its own variable. DeliverMem leads the strongest published memory agent on MemLens at all four context lengths, and beats DMV-Bench's own strongest method at every setting on both backbones. On MemLens it does this on a tenth to a seventieth of the input. Each decision helps only where the question lacks what it supplies, and is null elsewhere. A single fixed configuration nonetheless leads both benchmarks, without training any component or modifying the stored records. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"delivery"（记忆投递）这一多模态智能体记忆流程中被忽视的阶段，并通过受控分解证明其贡献大于检索优化，进而提出 DeliverMem 框架在 MemLens 与 DMV-Bench 上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体记忆研究集中于"写什么、如何更新、如何检索"，而从检索结果到模型回答之间的"投递"阶段未被隔离评估，作者认为该阶段存在最大的剩余提升空间。
AI.method: 在 MemLens 上进行受控分解：固定检索证据集，仅改变投递形式（如投递原始像素 vs 隐去）；提出 DeliverMem，将投递形式化为三个决策——保留原始模态、为每条记忆赋予可读身份、标注其被看到的时间，另加一个检索侧适配器处理投递无法提供的属性；每个决策均设有只改变自身变量的投递匹配对照。
AI.result: 在 8B 骨干上投递原始像素比隐去像素提升 13.87 点，而完美检索仅提升 2.31 点；投递项在 MemLens 三个骨干上均为更大项且随骨干增强而增大。DeliverMem 在 MemLens 四个上下文长度上均领先最强已发表记忆智能体，并在 DMV-Bench 两个骨干的所有设置下超越其最强方法，输入量仅为基线的 1/10 至 1/70。各决策仅在问题缺少其提供的信息时有效，否则无效。
AI.conclusion: 投递是多模态记忆中被低估且收益更大的瓶颈；单一固定配置、无需训练组件、不修改存储记录即可同时领先两个基准，说明记忆投递设计具有即插即用的通用价值。

title: SPACE: Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction for Streaming Video Memory
summary: Fixed-capacity streaming video memory requires repeated eviction decisions whose effects accumulate over time. Yet existing policies are evaluated primarily in terms of retained information or downstream accuracy, leaving how repeated updates alter the futures supported by memory largely unexamined. We define a memory's predictive state as the future representations supported by its retained history and formulate eviction as counterfactual control over transitions in this space. We introduce SPACE (Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction), which uses a frozen multi-horizon JEPA to predict the future representations induced by alternative eviction actions. Counterfactual utility identifies future-useful alternatives, while slow predictive-basin geometry determines when to correct avoidable drift and when to adapt to sustained predictive change, without online parameter updates. We further introduce MABS-Bench, which evaluates future-task sufficiency, within-regime predictive stability, transition responsiveness, and perturbation recovery under matched causal streams and memory budgets. Across multiple video datasets, SPACE yields consistent improvements in dataset-native task performance while reducing predictive-state drift.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPACE：用冻结的多时域 JEPA 预测不同驱逐动作导致的未来表征，把流式视频记忆的驱逐视为对预测状态轨迹的反事实控制，并给出 MABS-Bench 评测协议。
AI.motivation: 定容量流式视频记忆需要反复做驱逐决策且效应累积，但现有策略只用保留信息量或下游精度评估，未考察反复更新如何改变记忆所能支撑的未来表征（预测状态）。
AI.method: 将记忆的预测状态定义为所保留历史支撑的未来表征集合，把驱逐形式化为该空间转移的反事实控制。SPACE 借助冻结的多时域 JEPA 预测备选驱逐动作所诱导的未来表征；以反事实效用识别对未来有用的替代方案，用慢速预测吸引盆几何判定何时纠正可避免漂移、何时适应持续预测变化，全程不做在线参数更新。
AI.result: 在多个视频数据集上，SPACE 在数据集原生任务性能上取得一致提升，同时降低预测状态漂移。
AI.conclusion: 以预测状态与反事实控制视角重构流式视频记忆驱逐，可在无在线更新条件下兼顾任务性能与预测稳定性；MABS-Bench 为未来任务充分性、regime 内稳定性、转移响应性与扰动恢复提供匹配因果流与记忆预算下的评测。

title: GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking
comment: 9 pages of main text plus appendices. Code: this https URL
summary: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90° random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-level translation from 1% to 5% metric anchors, four degrees of freedom per group and frame. On dynamic query points of eight trackers, including D4RT, 4RC and SM4RT, our correction lowers endpoint error by 15.1% to 62.6% over the uncorrected predictions, while spending the same anchors on gradient fine-tuning improves the same models by only -1.1% to 15.2%. Code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出GAUGE，一个免训练、模型无关的事后校正模块，识别前馈3D点轨迹预测中的"组级视角不一致"（每组沿视线方向的径向自由度），用1%-5%度量锚点估计每帧径向尺度与组级平移，在八种跟踪器上将端点误差降低15.1%-62.6%。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型从单目视频直接回归稠密3D点轨迹，但全局对齐后的残差仍然很大且缺乏结构性解释；作者发现误差沿视线方向集中，且各运动组所需的尺度校正不同，而位移方向本身足够可靠，可用于分组。这提示残差中含有一类2D观测无法约束的径向自由度。
AI.method: 对残差做结构性分析：在动态查询点上测量跨模型/数据集的误差分布，证明其集中于视线方向、方向中位夹角远低于90°随机基线。据此定义"组级视角不一致"，并设计GAUGE：基于方向一致性与空间连通性恢复运动组，再用1%-5%度量锚点估计每组每帧的径向尺度与组级平移，共4个自由度。模块免训练、模型无关、事后接入。
AI.result: 在八个跟踪器（含D4RT、4RC、SM4RT）的动态查询点上，端点误差相比未校正预测下降15.1%-62.6%；相同锚点预算用于梯度微调时，同一批模型仅改善-1.1%至15.2%。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 前馈单目3D轨迹预测的残余误差具有明确结构：每个运动组存在2D观测不可约束的径向自由度，可分解为组级尺度/平移并借少量度量锚点高效校正，显著优于同等监督下的微调。

title: Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration
summary: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.

AI.tldr: 提出 LevyMatch，用 Lévy 过程（布朗参考桥 + Gamma 随机时钟）驱动软匹配矩阵的迭代精化，并提出前置 Gamma 策略在不增加网络评估的情况下提升非刚性点云匹配精度。
AI.motivation: 低重叠或非刚性形变下的点云对应关系难以可靠建立；迭代精化虽能修正不确定匹配，但每次网络评估代价高，限制了更新次数，因此在有限评估预算下需要更高效的更新机制。
AI.method: 将匹配矩阵的精化建模为 Lévy 驱动的随机过程：每步由网络结合当前匹配状态与几何信息预测目标匹配矩阵，用布朗参考桥给出朝目标的显式更新公式，用 Gamma 随机时钟设定每步的时间增量；更新后的匹配反哺下一步的几何反馈。进一步提出固定的前置 Gamma 策略，把更大的期望时钟时间分配给早期更新，且通过重排同一组采样增量即可实现，无需重训练或额外网络评估。
AI.result: 在 4DMatch 与 4DLoMatch 上，非刚性特征匹配召回率（NFMR）与内点率（IR）均优于对比方法；前置策略在 4DMatch 取得 93.09% NFMR 与 92.11% IR，在 4DLoMatch 取得 82.79% NFMR 与 79.07% IR。
AI.conclusion: 以随机跳变驱动的匹配精化在受限网络评估次数下能有效提升非刚性/低重叠点云匹配质量，且更新时序的分配（前置 Gamma 时钟）本身即构成一种零额外成本的有效增益。

title: Inspection-SPARS: Task-Oriented Sparse Roadmaps for Inspection Planning
summary: Inspection planning seeks a minimum-length collision-free robot tour that observes a given set of points of interest (POIs). Sampling-based methods reduce this continuous problem to a graph inspection planning (GIP) problem over a discrete roadmap, which is then solved using combinatorial solvers. Dense roadmaps capture diverse inspection viewpoints and motion shortcuts, and thus admit higher-quality solutions, but they induce large combinatorial search spaces on which state-of-the-art GIP solvers struggle to find good solutions within practical time budgets. Roadmap sparsification---restructuring a dense roadmap into a compact representation that preserves connectivity and path lengths---can alleviate this burden. However, existing sparsification approaches are either agnostic to the underlying inspection task, or strive to ensure coverage of the POIs without accounting for the quality of the resulting inspection plan. We present Inspection-SPARS, which is, to our knowledge, the first inspection-roadmap sparsifier with POI coverage and path-quality guarantees relative to the dense roadmap. To this end, we generalize the SPARS framework, a popular task-agnostic sparsifier, from purely geometric criteria to task-oriented ones, introducing an inspection-aware vertex admission mechanism that treats POI coverage as a first-class sparsification criterion alongside connectivity and path quality. Experiments in realistic 3D environments show that Inspection-SPARS reduces vertex and edge counts by 4-8x while preserving coverage, allowing the GIP solver to compute tours up to 25% shorter than with the dense roadmap or state-of-the-art inspection roadmap. More broadly, Inspection-SPARS shows that sparsification can be made task-aware without sacrificing guarantees on solution quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Inspection-SPARS，首个具备 POI 覆盖与路径质量保证的任务感知路图稀疏化方法，将 SPARS 从纯几何准则推广到巡检任务准则，在保持覆盖率的同时将顶点/边减少 4-8 倍，使图巡检规划求解器得到最多短 25% 的巡检路径。
AI.motivation: 巡检规划需在连续空间中求解最短无碰撞巡检路径，采样法将其化简为离散路图上的图巡检规划（GIP）问题。稠密路图可提供更多巡检视点与运动捷径、解质量更高，但组合搜索空间过大，现有 GIP 求解器难以在实用时间内求得优解。已有稀疏化方法要么与巡检任务无关，要么仅保证 POI 覆盖而不考虑最终巡检计划的质量。
AI.method: 将经典任务无关稀疏化框架 SPARS 从纯几何判据推广为任务导向判据，提出巡检感知的顶点准入机制：把 POI 覆盖与连通性、路径质量并列为一级稀疏化准则，从而在保证相对稠密路图的 POI 覆盖与路径质量的前提下重构紧凑路图。
AI.result: 在真实感 3D 环境实验中，Inspection-SPARS 将顶点与边数减少 4-8 倍且保持覆盖，使 GIP 求解器算出的巡检路径比基于稠密路图或当前最优巡检路图的解短最多 25%。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏化可以在提供解质量保证的前提下被做成任务感知的，为采样式巡检规划中“路图密度—求解效率—解质量”的权衡提供了有理论保证的解决方案。

title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our this http URL VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 EdgeVLN：量化 StreamVLN 骨干+轻量因果 Transformer LATTE 停止验证头，配合端侧 VLN 驱动实现流式上下文重建与记忆 token 剪枝；在 Jetson Orin NX 上 IQ4 NL 精度使 1839 条 R2R VLN-CE 验证可见集 SR 达 58.02%，显存 11.35 GB，较 BF16 存储流式方案快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍。
AI.motivation: VLN 模型性能强但依赖高算力平台，难以部署于内存与功耗受限的机器人边缘设备。仅做压缩无法回答模型是否同时满足边缘平台的内存、时延、能耗预算并保持导航行为，缺少运行时感知的端侧部署方案与量化-停止决策的联合评估。
AI.method: 1) 在预训练 StreamVLN 骨干上系统刻画 8-bit 至 2-bit 权重量化及多种推理运行时，寻找可行工作点；2) 提出 LATTE（Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor），轻量因果 Transformer 复用骨干隐状态预测 Stop Action 验证器排序，无需额外视觉编码器或第二次骨干前向，利用量化释放的预算；3) 自研 VLN 驱动，实现流式上下文重建与机载内存 token 剪枝；4) 在 BF16 与 IQ4 NL 上比较 6 种骨干精度与 7 种候选停止头。
AI.result: 在全部 1,839 条 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen 回合上评估：部署的 4-bit 模型上 LATTE 取得最高 SR 58.02%，超过 BF16 基线，每步仅增加 0.013 s 时延。4-bit 各格式 SR 近乎相同，但单步能耗随执行路径相差 36.8 倍。仅 IQ4 NL 配自研驱动可满足板卡约束，常驻内存 11.35 GB，比存储流式 BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍。INT2 性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 运行时选择、内存 token 剪枝与量化是高效的边缘 VLN 部署不可或缺的三要素；细粒度量化（4-bit）配合轻量因果停止头可在不牺牲导航成功率的前提下显著降低时延与能耗。

title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
summary: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

AI.tldr: F4R：把真实世界的失败案例自动重建为以物体为中心的交互式桌面仿真环境，通过"失败条件化"的仿真-真实协同训练与定向强化学习闭环迭代提升策略，无需额外采集真实纠错示范。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型受限于专家示范覆盖不足以及对物理交互理解薄弱；常见做法是采集新失败场景的真实示范，但成本高、效率低、有安全风险且难以规模化。作者希望把"失败"本身转化为策略改进的信号，构建真实-仿真-真实的闭环。
AI.method: 提出Failure for Rising (F4R) 闭环框架：(1) 用智能体从rollout中自动识别并诊断失败；(2) 将每个失败重建为以物体为中心的交互式桌面环境，保留任务相关的空间与物理条件；(3) 进行失败条件化的sim-real协同训练，随后在重建环境中做定向强化学习；(4) 改进策略重新部署，新出现的失败持续回流进入下一轮重建与学习循环。
AI.result: 在四个真实操作任务上，F4R达到93.75%分布内成功率和90.0%分布外(OOD)成功率；在与预算匹配的Targeted BC基线对比下，OOD条件下高出18.75个百分点，且未采集任何额外的真实纠错示范。
AI.conclusion: 失败驱动的real-to-sim-to-real闭环可在不增加真实数据采集成本的前提下显著提升VLA策略的分布外泛化能力，为数据高效的具身策略改进提供了可行范式。

title: CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism
summary: Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.

AI.tldr: 提出 CollisionSplatting，一种直接作用于 3DGS 场景的 GPU 加速、概率启发式距离度量，可与图像条件奖励函数结合，实现几何-视觉联合规划，并集成到 MPPI 与 RRT 中。
AI.motivation: 几何规划器依赖抽象场景表示、丢弃视觉丰富度；学习式视觉模型缺乏几何可解释性与计算效率。需要一种能在丰富感知与实时运动规划之间架桥的表征。
AI.method: 在标准 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景上定义概率式距离度量（可调保守度），直接用于碰撞分类；将其与学习到的图像条件奖励函数统一，形成碰撞感知代价 + 图像空间目标的联合规划；集成进 GPU 加速的 MPPI 与 RRT 规划器。
AI.result: 碰撞分类性能与代表性基线持平或更优，同时碰撞检测吞吐显著提升、VRAM 占用明显降低；在真实世界视觉引导导航与操作任务中验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 3DGS 可作为丰富感知与实时运动规划之间的实用桥梁，实现几何与视觉信息的联合规划。

title: Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)
summary: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes \textit{deformations} to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: this https URL

AI.tldr: D4orm：基于扩散去噪采样的多机器人轨迹规划框架，衍化出解耦、滚动时域与分布式三类规划器，在仿真与真实机器人上验证
AI.motivation: 多机器人轨迹规划具有非凸、多模态、高维特性，传统数值优化计算困难；需借助GPU并行采样实现高效、通用的可行轨迹生成
AI.method: 以D4orm（动力学感知的扩散-去噪框架）为基元，通过对候选控制轨迹的"形变"迭代去噪优化，生成满足动力学约束且无冲突的轨迹；并构建三种架构：解耦规划器（提升可扩展性）、带反馈控制的在线滚动时域规划器、面向资源受限场景的分布式规划器
AI.result: 在2D/3D环境的差速与全向机器人上，比MPPI等采样优化方法及学习式扩散模型方法更快、更可靠地获得高质量解；实现十架真实四旋翼障碍环境零样本部署、100个仿真机器人大规模去冲突、六台地面机器人全机载分布式"终身"运行
AI.conclusion: 扩散去噪可作为多机器人协调的可扩展且可靠的规划框架，且能自然扩展到解耦、在线与分布式多种运行需求

title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
summary: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: MM-ABC 是一个面向移动操作（mobile manipulation）的机器人基础模型，围绕"看（Seeing）、协调（Coordinating）、想象（Imagining）臂-基协作"三大能力构建：用稀疏多层级 VLM 特征做空间感知，用仅训练期的未来分支（world imagination + 几何意图）作为额外监督，并用 MM-APT 通过 masked joint attention 与 clean-action x-prediction 协调机械臂与底盘两条异构动作流。模型在 5000+ 小时、40 万+ episode、12 数据集、17 种本体上预训练，在 EBench(44.71%)、RoboCasa365(61.2%)、LIBERO(99.1%)、LIBERO-Plus(82.8%) 及五项真实任务（均值 83%）上验证，消融表明 clean-action 预测、未来监督与多层级条件化均有显著贡献。
AI.motivation: 移动操作把"可达空间"本身变成可控量，从而带来两个核心难题：(1) 连续自运动（ego-motion）下的空间接地感知；(2) 机械臂与底盘异构动作的协同控制。现有方法或用显式 3D 表征/预测式世界模型增强几何，或把移动与操作解耦为独立动作流。作者认为仅有解耦不够，还需要能支持跨流高效协作的表征。
AI.method: 提出 MM-ABC 基础模型，包含三部分：1) 空间感知采用稀疏多层级 VLM 特征；2) 仅训练期未来分支，以世界想象（world imagination）与几何意图作为额外监督，增强感知与操作意图预测；3) MM-APT 模块，通过 masked joint attention 与 clean-action x-prediction 协调相互分离的操作流与移动流。预训练数据为 5000+ 小时异构机器人数据（40 万+ episode、12 数据集、17 本体）。消融以替换 clean-action 预测为 velocity 预测、移除未来监督或多层级条件化来检验各组件的必要性。
AI.result: 消融显示：将 clean-action 预测替换为 velocity 预测使 RoboCasa365 composite-seen 成功率从 32.8% 降至 29.2%；移除未来监督或多层级条件化导致更大跌幅。实验覆盖 EBench、RoboCasa365、ManiSkill-HAB、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 与真实移动操作：EBench 44.71%、RoboCasa365 61.2%、LIBERO 99.1%、LIBERO-Plus 82.8%（未做扰动训练）、五项真实任务平均成功率 83%。
AI.conclusion: 面向移动操作的基础模型应在解耦异构动作流的同时，显式提供支持跨流协作的表征；仅训练期的世界想象/几何意图监督与 clean-action x-prediction 对提升整体学习信号与成功率关键。方法在仿真基准与真实机器人任务上均取得较强表现，但真实世界任务数量与跨本体泛化验证仍较有限。

title: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning
summary: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.

AI.tldr: 提出 APPL 框架，将策略的“结构先验”（如抓取仅依赖夹爪相对物体位姿）同时用作训练约束与语言化接口，从而在少样本示范下同时提升技能泛化与组合泛化。
AI.motivation: 少样本示范学习要求同时具备组合泛化（重组技能解新任务）与技能泛化（策略适应新情境），二者相互依赖，但组合层只能通过技能名称/指令/符号算子等描述调用技能，丢失了决定策略适用范围的内部结构信息，导致接口信息不匹配。
AI.method: 将策略的结构先验（声明行为依赖哪些因素）内建于训练中以塑造其泛化空间，并以语言形式显式暴露给组合层。实例化为 APPL：构造智能体把完整示范分割为可复用技能，为每个技能提出多个结构先验并各训练与验证一个策略；运行时智能体依据先验接口选择合适策略并组合以达成新任务目标。
AI.result: 在 MetaWorld 与长时程 ManiSkill 任务上，APPL 提升了分布外技能泛化并实现未见过的新技能组合；消融接口信息后性能显著下降，表明结构先验接口是关键贡献。
AI.conclusion: 训练阶段的结构假设可作为技能学习与技能组合之间的桥梁，为少样本示范下的双重泛化提供统一机制。

title: LQR-ArUco Fusion: Robust Hierarchical Control for Navigation and Asymmetric Manipulation in Two-Wheeled Robots
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Navigation and Systems (CINS), Dubai, UAE
summary: We propose a hierarchical control framework to address severe dynamic instabilities and navigational drift that arise when a two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP) robot attempts asymmetric object manipulation. While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded on uneven terrain. To solve these coupled problems, our architecture divides the workload. An offboard vision system tracks overhead ArUco markers to provide high-latency global waypoint navigation, bypassing odometry drift. Simultaneously, a low-latency onboard control loop rejects active physical disturbances using inertial and encoder data. In our physical experiments, this dual-loop approach enabled the custom-built robot to navigate accurately, reject transient impacts from speed bumps, adapt to a dynamic seesaw ramp, and carry a payload securely without falling over its narrow wheelbase.

AI.tldr: 提出分层控制框架，用离板视觉定位 + 在板低延迟反馈控制解决两轮倒立摆机器人单侧抓取时的动态失稳与导航漂移。
AI.motivation: 两轮倒立摆机器人机动性强，但持续平衡调整使里程计严重不可靠；侧挂机械臂举升负载产生不可驱动的横向滚转力矩，在非平整地形上进一步恶化，导致严重动态失稳与导航漂移。
AI.method: 分层双环架构：离板视觉系统通过俯视 ArUco 标记提供高延迟全局航点导航，绕开里程计漂移；同时在板低延迟控制环利用惯性测量与编码器数据主动抑制物理扰动。任务在慢速全局规划与快速局部姿态稳定之间解耦。
AI.result: 自建机器人物理实验中实现精确导航，能抑制减速带瞬态冲击、适应动态跷跷板坡道，并在窄轮距上安全携带负载而不倾倒。
AI.conclusion: 分层解耦（离板高延迟定位 + 在板低延迟扰动抑制）是应对单侧载荷�instance操纵与不平地形下两轮倒立摆稳定性的有效方案，具备真实机器人验证。

title: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.

AI.tldr: Holo-M 是首个面向人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 的离散 VLA 模型，通过将动作 token 扩展到语言模型词表，并设计四部位统一动作分词器与分组离散扩散解码，在 SIMPLE 基准上取得最优成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身动作空间（腿、躯干、臂、手）维度高且异构，现有离散动作 token 的 VLA 方法主要针对机械臂操作，未解决人形场景下的分词、训练与实时推理难题；同时使用独立连续动作专家的方案存在知识隔离问题。
AI.method: 将人形动作空间分解为末端执行器、身体、手、运动学四个部位专属分词器构成统一动作分词器，支持跨形态与跨数据源（人形遥操作、自我中心人类视频、仿真）训练；把动作 token 加入语言模型词表以避免知识隔离；推理时对各部位动作 token 采用分组离散扩散解码替代自回归，以满足实时控制。
AI.result: 在 SIMPLE 人形 loco-manipulation 基准上进行了大量实验，Holo-M 在通用型（generalist）与专用型（specialist）评测中均取得最高成功率，且显著领先第二名。代码与模型权重将开源。
AI.conclusion: 离散动作 token 与语言模型词表扩展的结合可有效支撑高维异构的人形全身动作建模，分组离散扩散解码兼顾了跨形态数据训练与实时控制需求。

title: RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation
summary: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and analytic residual Jacobians, then assembles feasible configurations through rank-checked continuation and correction. A tangent lift maps independent velocities to full robot and task motion, while paired actuator-port maps preserve virtual work. A constraint-curvature correction extends the reduction to accelerations and projected rigid-body dynamics, including floating-base and support modes. Cycle-local evaluation, generated Jacobians, and dependency-aware reuse enable localized updates when closure inputs change. We evaluate physical loops and task-induced constraints on a Komatsu excavator, Unitree Go2, Franka Panda, Kangaroo, and a six-UPS Stewart platform. High-precision constrained-dynamics and independent Pinocchio checks confirm mechanical consistency; MuJoCo and Isaac Sim/PhysX executions demonstrate task performance and model reuse under native contact. For Kangaroo, compilation reduces residual-and-Jacobian evaluation time by 96.7% and closed-loop rollout wall time by 66.8%, with dynamics and control held fixed.

AI.tldr: RoboCompiler 是一个图原生的机械接口编译框架，将规范机构图（刚体、关节、坐标系、惯量、执行器端口）编译为统一的配置/运动/力/动力学接口，通过闭环路径与解析残差雅可比、秩检验延拓校正、切空间提升、执行器端口对偶映射和约束曲率修正，保证闭环与驱动一致性；在挖掘机、Go2、Panda、Kangaroo 和六-UPS Stewart 平台上验证，Kangaroo 上残差与雅可比求值时间降 96.7%、闭环 rollout 墙钟时间降 66.8%。
AI.motivation: 含运动学闭环、耦合执行器和接触变化的机器人需要一致的配置、运动、力与动力学模型，但控制与仿真通常各自重建这些接口，导致闭环一致性（closure）与驱动一致性（actuation consistency）难以维持。
AI.method: 以规范机构图为输入，编译出共享机械接口：由刚体/关节/坐标系/惯量/执行器端口构建闭环路径与解析残差雅可比，用秩检验的延拓与校正组装可行构型；用切空间提升把独立速度映射到全机器人与任务运动，成对执行器端口映射保持虚功；用约束曲率修正把约简扩展到加速度与投影刚体动力学，支持浮基与支撑模式；通过环路局部求值、生成式雅可比与依赖感知复用来实现闭环输入变化时的局部更新。
AI.result: 在 Komatsu 挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo 与六-UPS Stewart 平台上评估物理闭环与任务诱导约束；高精度约束动力学与独立 Pinocchio 校验确认机械一致性；MuJoCo 与 Isaac Sim/PhysX 执行展示原生接触下的任务性能与模型复用。Kangaroo 上编译使残差与雅可比求值时间降低 96.7%，闭环 rollout 墙钟时间降低 66.8%，且动力学与控制保持不变。
AI.conclusion: RoboCompiler 用共享的图原生编译接口统一闭环机器人的配置、运动、力与动力学表示，获得的生成式解析雅可比与局部更新在保持机械一致性的同时显著加速计算，具备跨平台复用潜力。

title: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
summary: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations, in which whole-body motion remains continuous and coupled throughout the human-to-robot transfer process. To enable scalable collection of whole-body human manipulation demonstrations, we develop a tracker-free capture system using only a consumer VR headset and a head-mounted stereo camera, without external cameras or motion trackers. We then perform three explicit alignment stages---embodiment, action-semantic, and temporal---to map captured motion into the robot action space, preserving fine-grained whole-body motion and allowing human and robot demonstrations to be jointly learned by standard VLA policies. Real-world experiments with different VLA backbones show that human demonstrations consistently improve policy learning across training paradigms, raising average success from 29% to 56% on GR00T N1.7 and from 32% to 57% on pi0.5, while matching robot-only training with half the robot demonstrations. Ablations confirm that each alignment stage is necessary. These results highlight the potential of human demonstrations for scalable whole-body mobile manipulation with preserved fine-grained motion structure.

AI.tldr: DexRoam 提出一套从人类示范学习移动双臂灵巧操作的系统，用消费级 VR 头显+头戴立体相机实现无追踪器全身动作捕捉，并通过本体、动作语义、时间三个对齐阶段把人体运动映射到机器人动作空间，使 VLA 策略能联合学习人机数据，真实世界中成功率显著提升且仅需一半机器人示范。
AI.motivation: 移动双臂灵巧操作需在单条轨迹中持续协调运动、全身姿态与手指级灵巧性，导致机器人示范数据严重不足。人类自我中心示范是可扩展的替代方案，但先前方法通过简化人体运动来降低迁移难度，恰好丢弃了此类任务所依赖的细粒度耦合结构。
AI.method: 1) 无追踪器捕捉系统：仅用消费级 VR 头显与头戴立体相机，无需外部相机或动捕设备，实现可扩展的全身人类操作示范采集；2) 三阶段显式对齐：本体对齐（embodiment）、动作语义对齐、时间对齐，将捕捉运动映射到机器人动作空间；3) 保留细粒度全身运动结构，使人类与机器人示范可被标准 VLA 策略联合训练。
AI.result: 真实世界实验中，使用不同 VLA 骨干网络，人类示范在多种训练范式下均稳定提升策略学习：GR00T N1.7 平均成功率由 29% 提升至 56%，pi0.5 由 32% 提升至 57%；同时以一半的机器人示范量达到纯机器人训练的水平。消融实验确认三个对齐阶段均为必要。
AI.conclusion: 人类示范在保持细粒度运动结构的前提下，可用于可扩展的全身移动操作学习，为人机数据联合训练 VLA 提供了可行路径。

title: DraftAttention2: Fast Video Diffusion with Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention
summary: Video generation has broad applications in content creation and entertainment. Diffusion transformers have advanced the quality of generated videos, but attention over spatiotemporal tokens becomes increasingly expensive as video resolution and duration increase. We present DraftAttention2, a training-free framework that uses the low-resolution draft attention map to jointly select attention blocks and assign their numerical precision. Specifically, spatial 2D average- and max-pooled queries and keys capture complementary regional statistics to estimate block importance, and a shared ranking assigns higher precision to important blocks, lower precision to less important retained blocks, and skips the rest under configurable budgets. Our analysis separates sparsification error from attention-weighted quantization error, establishing when recovering skipped interactions with low-bit computation tightens the output-error bound. This analysis motivates retaining more interactions at low precision while reserving higher precision for blocks with larger attention mass. To translate these fine-grained assignments into practical speedups, we further develop fused operand preparation and a single attention kernel with precision-specific phases, sharing data movement, softmax statistics, and output accumulation across precisions. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a superior quality-efficiency trade-off over existing efficient video generation methods. Notably, its advantage is particularly pronounced for few-step video diffusion, where jointly combining sparsity with 4- and 8-bit mixed-precision computation substantially improves generation quality while retaining significant acceleration. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 DraftAttention2，用低分辨率 draft attention map 联合决定注意力块的稀疏选择与数值精度分配，并配以融合算子与单一混合精度注意力 kernel，在视频扩散生成上取得更优的质量-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer提升视频生成质量，但时空token上的注意力随分辨率与时长增长而开销剧增；现有加速方法（稀疏化或量化）通常独立设计，未同时利用两者。
AI.method: 用空间2D平均池化与最大池化的query/key捕获互补区域统计以估计块重要性，共享排序在可配置预算下把重要块分配高精度、次要保留块分配低精度、其余直接跳过；将稀疏化误差与注意力加权量化误差分离分析，给出用低比特计算恢复被跳过交互可收紧输出误差界的条件；实现融合的算子准备与单一注意力kernel，按精度分阶段共享数据搬运、softmax统计与输出累加。
AI.result: 在视频生成任务上相比现有高效视频生成方法取得更优的质量-效率权衡；优势在少步视频扩散上尤为明显，稀疏与4/8比特混合精度结合显著提升生成质量同时保持明显加速。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 低分辨率draft attention可作为统一信号同时驱动稀疏化与混合精度分配，理论误差界分析支持“多保留低精度交互、对高注意力质量块用高精度”的策略，配合融合kernel可落地实际加速。

title: InterTab: Interleaved Visual-Structure Alignment for Multi-Modal Table Reasoning
summary: Table images preserve structural information that are often lost in text serialization, and reasoning over them requires locating relevant rows, columns, and cells step by step. Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode the whole image once before reasoning, so they cannot pick up row-, column-, and cell-level evidence as the question unfolds. Encoder-side table structure and generic interleaved visual chain-of-thought still do not bind each reasoning step to that structure. We propose \textbf{InterTab}, an \textbf{Inter}leaved structure-aware framework for CoT reasoning over \textbf{Tab}le images, interleaves chain-of-thought with tool calls that crop structure-aligned table regions. First, we build InterTab-22K, includes reasoning trajectories in which each step is tied to both a structural location and a bounding box. InterTab is trained in two stages: supervised structure-aware alignment (SSA) on InterTab-22K teaches the model to interleave reasoning with structure-aligned crops, and active localization optimization (ALO) further optimizes answer correctness, localization IoU, and output format, while penalizing missing or excessive tool calls. Experiments on nine table benchmarks show that InterTab improves the average accuracy of its backbone from 68.28% to 73.17% and achieves the best average performance among all compared methods. Code and data will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 InterTab 框架，将思维链推理与结构对齐的表格图像裁剪工具调用交错进行，并构建 InterTab-22K 数据与两阶段训练（SSA+ALO），在九个表格基准上把骨干平均准确率从 68.28% 提升到 73.17%。
AI.motivation: 表格图像保留结构信息，但现有多模态大模型在推理前一次性编码整张图，无法在推理过程中逐步定位行、列、单元格级证据；编码器侧结构建模与通用交错视觉思维链均未能将每一步推理绑定到表格结构。
AI.method: 构建 InterTab-22K，其中每条推理轨迹的每一步都绑定结构位置与边界框；采用两阶段训练：监督式结构感知对齐（SSA）教会模型交错进行推理与结构对齐裁剪，再用主动定位优化（ALO）联合优化答案正确性、定位 IoU 与输出格式，并对缺失或冗余工具调用施加惩罚。
AI.result: 在九个表格基准上，骨干模型平均准确率由 68.28% 提升至 73.17%，在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能。代码与数据将开源。
AI.conclusion: 将工具调用（结构对齐裁剪）交错嵌入思维链，可有效把每一步推理绑定到表格结构，显著提升表格图像推理精度，为文档/表格图像的多模态推理提供可复用的数据与训练范式。

title: RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving
summary: 4D radar provides geometric and motion cues that complement visual semantics, but integrating it into vision-language-action (VLA) models requires both radar--language alignment for semantic reasoning and explicit use of radar measurements for trajectory refinement and selection. To support these capabilities, we construct Cap4DR with 86,016 radar-image-text samples for alignment pretraining and OmniHD-QA with 520,161 question-answer pairs for instruction tuning across scene description, key-object reasoning, occupancy understanding, and trajectory planning. Building on these datasets, we propose RCVLA, a radar-camera VLA framework consisting of a radar-grounded semantic reasoning stage (RCVLA-Sem) and a trajectory arbitration stage (RCVLA-Phys). RCVLA-Sem performs gated bidirectional interaction between camera and radar tokens for driving question answering and reference trajectory generation, while auxiliary heads provide object and occupancy queries. RCVLA-Phys refines reference-guided trajectory candidates through truncated diffusion conditioned on these queries and cluster-level radar measurements, then calibrates candidate scores using radar-derived time-to-collision risk. On OmniHD-QA, RCVLA-Sem improves CIDEr by 9.92 points and reduces key-object velocity error by $21.9\%$ relative to OmniDrive. RCVLA-Phys further reduces average L2 error from $0.348$ to $0.259\,\mathrm{m}$ and average open-loop collision rate from $0.576\%$ to $0.175\%$ relative to RCVLA-Sem. Ablation studies further show that language-aligned radar tokens improve semantic reasoning, while cluster-level radar measurements and risk calibration improve trajectory arbitration. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 构建Cap4DR（86,016雷达-图像-文本对齐样本）与OmniHD-QA（520,161问答对）数据集，提出RCVLA雷达-相机VLA框架：RCVLA-Sem做雷达-视觉门控双向交互生成参考轨迹，RCVLA-Phys用截断扩散+雷达TTC风险校准精修并仲裁轨迹。
AI.motivation: 4D雷达提供几何与运动线索，可补充视觉语义，但要融入VLA模型需同时解决雷达-语言对齐（语义推理）与显式利用雷达测量（轨迹精修与选择）两个问题，现有工作缺乏相应数据与统一框架。
AI.method: 构建两个数据集：Cap4DR（86,016雷达-图像-文本样本，对齐预训练）、OmniHD-QA（520,161 QA对，覆盖场景描述、关键物体推理、占据理解、轨迹规划）。RCVLA含两阶段：RCVLA-Sem在相机与雷达token间做门控双向交互，输出驾驶问答与参考轨迹，并用辅助头做物体与占据查询；RCVLA-Phys以这些查询与簇级雷达测量为条件，通过截断扩散精修候选轨迹，并用雷达推导的TTC风险校准候选分数。
AI.result: 在OmniHD-QA上，RCVLA-Sem较OmniDrive CIDEr提升9.92，关键物体速度误差降低21.9%；RCVLA-Phys将平均L2误差由0.348 m降至0.259 m，平均开环碰撞率由0.576%降至0.175%。消融显示语言对齐雷达token改善语义推理，簇级雷达测量与风险校准改善轨迹仲裁。
AI.conclusion: 雷达-语言对齐与显式雷达几何测量在VLA中互补，二者结合可同时提升语义问答与轨迹安全性；数据与框架为后续雷达-视觉-动作研究提供基础，代码将开源。

title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现多模态大模型存在"符号视觉鸿沟"：将图像替换为caption/代码等符号视图后，性能反而提升10.2%–23.6%，据此提出MM-OPD多模态在线自蒸馏框架，将符号视图的条件行为迁移到图像条件策略，改善视觉证据选择。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型隐含假设"感知到推理无缝衔接"，但作者观察到反直觉现象：固定模型、问题与解码方式，用符号视图（caption/code）替代原始图像后性能显著提升。这说明感知与推理之间的"证据选择"环节存在瓶颈，而非感知或推理能力本身不足。符号视图能引导注意力聚焦正确证据且易于大规模获取，可免费充当证据选择的监督信号。
AI.method: 先定义并量化"符号视觉鸿沟"：在固定模型、问题与解码条件下对比图像输入与符号视图（caption/code）输入的性能差异，并通过注意力分析发现符号视图模型对正确证据的注意力显著更高。据此提出MM-OPD——多模态在线策略自蒸馏框架，实现符号到视觉的纠偏：以残差式token级目标，将符号条件行为中的指导迁移到图像条件策略，引导模型关注正确的视觉证据，无需人工标注证据。
AI.result: 符号视图替代图像在多种模型规模和数据集上带来10.2%–23.6%的性能提升；注意力分析显示符号视图输入模型对正确证据的注意力远高于图像输入模型。MM-OPD在多个基准和模型规模上提升了广泛的多模态能力，包括视觉感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理和通用VQA。
AI.conclusion: 感知与推理之间存在被忽视的"证据选择"瓶颈；符号视图可作为免标注监督信号，通过MM-OPD的符号到视觉在线自蒸馏加以利用，从而在无需额外标注的情况下全面提升多模态能力。该工作属于通用多模态MLLM方法，未涉及机器人、具身导航或3D重建等具身核心域。

title: DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution
summary: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.

AI.tldr: 提出DPAMixerSR，一个退化模式感知的稀疏计算超分辨率框架，通过感知退化排序模块将图像分为重退化与轻退化区域并分别路由到自适应稀疏处理与轻量卷积分支。
AI.motivation: 现有内容自适应超分辨率方案主要关注纹理复杂度，忽略模糊核、噪声模式等内在退化因素，导致计算分配与重建性能次优。
AI.method: 设计轻量级感知退化排序（PDR）模块对图像块进行退化程度分级，重退化块送入自适应稀疏处理（ASP）分支执行结构对齐的多尺度稀疏传播与双向细化，轻退化块送入轻量卷积分支；通过退化驱动路由与结构对齐稀疏处理耦合，形成自调节框架动态平衡效率与保真度。
AI.result: 在多种超分辨率任务上取得更优的结构恢复与感知保真度，同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 退化感知的稀疏计算路由为资源高效超分辨率提供了一种新颖且可扩展的框架。

title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
summary: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.

AI.tldr: ProDyGS：在单目静态相机视频下，用单目深度生成多视角代理监督，实现动态3D高斯泼溅新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 动态场景新视角合成通常依赖多视角相机阵列或显著相机运动提供几何约束；本文针对完全无多视角监督的单目静态相机视频这一困难设定。
AI.method: 用单目深度基础模型估计时间一致深度图，通过深度引导的代理图像合成生成合成多视角监督；据此构建3D高斯表示，从任意视角渲染代理图像；再用变形网络对规范高斯做时序形变，学习动态。
AI.result: 在DyNeRF数据集上达到SOTA，且仅需单目深度估计作为外部监督，优于依赖场景流等更强先验的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过深度引导的代理监督弥补多视角缺失，是单目静态相机动态新视角合成的有效途径。

title: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 提出"区域-局部copula证据融合"方法：保留超像素级区域决策结构，同时引入空间变化的局部依赖异常（独立拟合的局部copula模型刻画未变化跨图像关系的偏离），经参考排序与上尾门控变换后与连续区域置信度融合，并推导区域相关的局部判决阈值。在Lake与UK数据集上取得kappa 0.78136/0.90817，改善混合区域与边界判决。
AI.motivation: 超像素copula模型为异质遥感变化检测提供稳定的区域级证据，但每个区域单一标签限制了混合超像素内部的定位能力，需要在保留区域决策结构的同时增强区域内部的空间分辨能力。
AI.method: 区域-局部copula证据融合：独立拟合局部模型以刻画偏离未变化跨图像关系的依赖异常；通过参考排序与上尾门控将异常变换后与连续区域置信度融合；推导区域相关的局部判决阈值，并给出门控等价于无门控融合重参数化的条件；辅以四折回顾式空间验证（10个训练子集）与固定/无门控配置对比。
AI.result: Lake与UK上整图优化配置kappa分别为0.78136与0.90817，混合区域与边界判决改善；四折空间验证中无门控参考融合平均kappa提升0.00693（Lake）与0.01793（UK）；固定门控在UK增益较大（0.03353），在Lake仅0.00041。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"区域-局部依赖交互"的有效性，表明局部信息与区域证据互补；但校准与门控的收益具有场景依赖性，需按场景调节。

title: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 REALIS，一个包含 143 万张真实与合成图像、覆盖 42 个现代文生图模型的数据集，并配套 REALIS-Expert 压力测试子集与 35 种图像变换的鲁棒性评测协议，用于在更贴近真实使用的条件下评测 AI 生成图像检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测基准中，真实与合成样本常在内容、质量或生成伪影上存在系统性差异，使检测器依赖数据集特定的捷径线索，从而在陌生生成器或经过后处理的图像上失效；且已有数据集难以在多样化视觉内容上联合评测这些挑战。
AI.method: 构建 REALIS 数据集：由 42 个现代文生图模型生成，共 143 万张真实与合成图像；采用由真实图像派生的提示词、质量过滤与分层采样，以减少类别特定捷径同时保持内容多样性；提出 REALIS-Expert 压力测试子集，使真实与合成样本在语义与视觉特征上紧密匹配；并提出覆盖 35 种变换、五个严重程度的鲁棒性协议，用于分析图像处理下的检测器行为。基于该数据集对预训练检测器、微调模型和零样本视觉语言模型在生成器与后处理偏移下进行评测。
AI.result: 在最难的经过处理的评测划分上，最佳预训练传统检测器仅达到 0.550 ROC-AUC，而最佳经 REALIS 训练的检测器达到 0.752，显示现有检测器在生成器与后处理偏移下可靠性显著不足。
AI.conclusion: REALIS 提供了一个统一框架，用于在更贴近真实使用的条件下度量并改进 AI 图像检测器的可靠性；同时揭示当前检测器受数据集捷径与后处理影响严重，需针对生成器偏移与图像变换进行专门训练。
