title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度引导解耦适配框架G2DA，利用梯度特性将多任务Geo-VLM任务分为视觉/语言两组，构建模态特定课程并双向复演，在24个基准-模型组合上一致超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间视觉语言模型（Geo-VLM）普遍采用统一的多任务适配范式，未考虑不同任务间异构的优化特性。作者通过实证观察发现任务间存在视觉-语言梯度差异、分支内梯度关系及任务干扰等问题，阻碍了有效的多任务优化。
AI.method: G2DA首先通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦将任务划分为视觉中心与语言中心两组；随后基于任务梯度相似度构建模态特定的课程学习顺序，并采用双向复演（bidirectional rehearsal）缓解顺序优化带来的近因效应。在InternVL3、Qwen3.5-VL、GeoChat、GeoLLaVA等模型上，于三个Geo-VLM基准评测。
AI.result: 在全部24个基准-模型组合上一致优于代表性基线，相较最强竞争者，在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite与VRS-Bench-VQA上分别提升3.08、4.30和2.81个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了梯度引导的任务组织方式对Geo-VLM适配的有效性，表明显式建模异构优化特性可显著提升多任务遥感视觉语言模型的性能。

title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
summary: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 AnesTRACE 麻醉术中多模态决策评测套件，含 Bench（感知/单点/多步决策）与 Eval（专家标准+时间一致性），30+ 模型上细粒度视觉接地与干预选择仍困难，且高质量决策伴随 74.3s P95 延迟。
AI.motivation: 术中麻醉需要系统解读动态演变的多模态证据、及时给出管理建议并随病人状态变化修正决策，但现有基准仅孤立评测感知或单点推理，缺乏对纵向、时序一致决策能力的评估手段。
AI.method: 基于公开围术期数据集并由麻醉医师标注构建 AnesTRACE-Bench，覆盖术中感知、单点麻醉决策、多步麻醉决策三类任务；AnesTRACE-Eval 通过麻醉医师定义的四项标准（临床正确性、证据接地、任务完整性、安全性）及多步决策的时间一致性评估开放式回答，领域专用评估器经专家审核判断上的监督微调与偏好对齐训练。
AI.result: 评测 30 余个模型：领先模型 TEE 视觉接地仅 32.2 mIoU，多步管理仍保留 17.5% 的重度/危急安全错误率；评估器与麻醉医师的对齐程度在两阶段训练中均提升；最佳决策质量伴随 74.3 秒的 P95 延迟。
AI.conclusion: 聚合性能指标本身不足以证明安全、及时的纵向决策能力，需同时考察接地精度、安全性错误率与时序一致性/延迟；代码已开源。

title: LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

AI.tldr: LoCoVSR：基于像素空间扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习的视频超分框架，用局部滑动窗口+共享噪声轨迹实现长视频并行推理。
AI.motivation: 视频超分是病态逆问题，现有扩散类方法依赖显式光流估计，或在潜空间处理导致信息损失，且递归式处理存在误差累积与长度限制。
AI.method: 采用像素空间去噪扩散概率模型，将扩散后验采样（DPS）与时空上下文学习结合，以移动平均形式工作：用相邻LR帧的局部窗口恢复中心帧，所有帧共享同一条噪声轨迹；避免光流估计与潜空间压缩。
AI.result: 在VFHQ人脸数据集上训练，实现高保真、时序一致的放大效果，并在与近期扩散类VSR方法比较中取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: LoCoVSR以简洁有效的像素空间扩散方案替代光流/潜空间路线，支持无长度限制的长视频并行推理并抑制误差累积，但验证仅限人脸域。

title: From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Haoru Wang and Qianfan Shen contributed equally
summary: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的流匹配框架，用单一干净目标预测器同时实现前馈重建（单步端点）与条件生成（多步流），并在新视角合成与3D几何任务上实例化为JiT-LVSM与JUSt3R。
AI.motivation: 重建与生成长期分属两个范式，失效模式互补：前馈重建把歧义平均成模糊，条件生成则编造合理但场景不一致的细节。受Atlas等空间世界模型启发，作者希望找到统一二者的简洁表述。
AI.method: 基于流的统一公式：共享的干净目标预测器在单步端点做直接重建，通过多步流展开条件生成。用受控玩具实验揭示机制（单步收敛到条件均值，偏好一致性；多步下细节保真度随上下文丰富度提升）。在3D外观与几何任务上实例化：JiT-LVSM用于新视角合成，JUSt3R用于几何预测。
AI.result: JiT-LVSM在新视角合成上提升感知与分布质量；JUSt3R保持有竞争力的单步几何预测，并具备多步推理能力，减少veil与flying-pixel伪影，在更大测试时算力下产生更干净的表面结构。
AI.conclusion: 重建与生成可以共享同一公式与同一骨干，其行为由去噪配置（步数）决定，统一出人意料地简单。

title: OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector. For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.

AI.tldr: OmniMoE-VL 提出一种稀疏 VLM 架构，用"视觉深度路由投影器"让投影器按问题动态选择稀疏的中间视觉层深度，并将该全局偏好同时用于局部 patch 融合和向语言模型的动态视觉注入，在八个图像基准上以 28B 总参/9B 激活参数取得平均 85.9 分。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏 MoE 视觉语言模型只在语言侧扩展计算，视觉信息必须经过固定的跨模态接口后才被路由，无法针对具体问题决定"应暴露哪些中间视觉表示给语言侧计算"，缺乏问题依赖的视觉访问机制。
AI.method: 提出 OmniMoE-VL：耦合视觉深度路由投影器。对每个图像-提示对，投影器选择一组稀疏的中间视觉深度，得到的全局偏好被复用，同时驱动局部 patch 融合与动态视觉注入；保留原生视觉 token 序列，并与视觉/语言栈中的 token 级专家路由互补。通过匹配的路由与组件控制、同图路由分析、路由干预进行验证。
AI.result: 在八个图像基准上平均 85.9 分，总参数 28B、激活参数 9B。控制实验显示路由式视觉接口贡献了主要的架构增益；匹配控制、同图路由分析与路由干预进一步支持耦合和问题条件化视觉访问的价值。
AI.conclusion: 问题条件化、耦合的视觉深度路由是稀疏 VLM 的有效架构增益来源，可与 token 级 MoE 路由互补，但论文仅覆盖图像基准，未涉及视频、3D、具身或物理交互任务。

title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.

AI.tldr: 提出CT-OPD方法：用已完成答案的教师响应结合学生当前轨迹的未解掩码，重构部分状态进行token级蒸馏，提升扩散视觉语言模型的多模态理解与推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型逐帧解掩码生成答案，其生成轨迹反映了模型自身的"揭示决策"，但轨迹中的临时可见token可能与目标响应冲突；基于结果的强化学习只能提供响应级反馈，当采样奖励打平时对比信号丢失。因此希望把连贯的token级监督与模型自身的揭示决策对齐。
AI.method: CT-OPD：将完成的教师响应按学生词表重新分词，并在学生反向过程的各个阶段提取未解位置的掩码；对每个掩码，丢弃临时rollout值，从教师端点重建部分状态，使监督位置沿用当前轨迹、可见上下文与目标保持同一响应的一致性；用学生原生类别损失训练，并随模型演化刷新轨迹。
AI.result: 在稠密与稀疏扩散架构上，CT-OPD一致提升多模态理解与推理能力，九基准平均最高提升9.80分；在统一理解-生成架构上同时改善视觉理解与图像生成，说明原理可跨架构、跨模态迁移。消融实验将增益归因于一致性重建与当前模型轨迹掩码。
AI.conclusion: CT-OPD通过将连贯的token级监督与模型自身的揭示决策对齐，为扩散视觉语言模型的后训练提供了有效且可迁移的方案，但论文未涉及机器人与具身应用验证。

title: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds
summary: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出统一点云压缩框架：隐式几何场表示 + 层级频域压缩 + 条件高频预测网络，在八百万点复杂边界点云上实现更高压缩比且重建质量相当。
AI.motivation: 大规模复杂几何点云的显式表示带来极高的计算与内存开销，需要压缩的隐式表示以降低存储与传输成本，同时尽量避免细节丢失。
AI.method: 将无序点云映射到其物理包围盒内的隐式场；构建平滑傅里叶金字塔，用紧凑低频分量捕捉全局几何，编码跨尺度高频残差以保留细节所需空间信息；用分层3D神经网络恢复压缩中丢失的高频信息；最后经等值面提取把重建隐式场转回点云。
AI.result: 在超过八百万点的复杂边界点云实验中，压缩比优于现有点云压缩方法，重建质量与之相当。
AI.conclusion: 频域分层+隐式场+高频预测的组合是高效点云压缩的可行路线，但验证局限于单一大规模场景，泛化性与实时性未充分展示。

title: Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 该工作揭示隐式生成模型中潜空间几何的强各向异性及低秩结构特性，提出 Latent Structure Flow（LSF），在冻结编解码器的前提下仅改动生成器，将潜状态分解为低秩"结构"与正交"残差"并分别用全局上下文与局部方式建模，在跨模态合成与肿瘤修补任务上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: 潜式生成模型虽通过压缩空间使 3D 医学图像合成变得可行，但其基于 ℓ2 目标的"平坦欧氏空间"假设并不准确：潜空间几何具有强各向异性，等幅度误差可导致截然不同的解码失真。作者进一步发现这种各向异性有明确特征——敏感变化集中在低秩子空间。动机即在于利用这一非对称性，显式建模潜空间结构以提升合成质量。
AI.method: 提出 Latent Structure Flow（LSF）。在每个 block 中将潜状态分解为 structure（低秩主导成分，编码长程、空间协调的全局变化，抗局部噪声）与正交 residual（局部、图像特异变化）。LSF 用全局上下文建模结构变化，局部预测残差变化，同时为输入结构保留直接通路（direct path）。LSF 仅修改生成器，冻结的 codec 与逐点训练目标保持不变，无额外训练目标改动。
AI.result: 在跨模态合成（cross-modality synthesis）与肿瘤修补（tumor inpainting）两类任务上，LSF 在全局指标与肿瘤特异性指标上均优于所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模潜空间结构（结构/残差分解 + 全局—局部不对称处理）对 3D 医学图像合成有实质收益；该思路具有通用性，因仅改动生成器而不触动 codec 与训练目标，易迁移到其他潜式生成框架。

title: Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PRE-ACT将事故预测从二分类重构为连续风险曲线建模，通过时序排序约束与"距事故距离"感知，在MM-AU子集与Nexar上取得显著提升，并引入Separation Score评估风险曲线全局行为。
AI.motivation: 现有事故预测方法多建模为二分类，只回答"是否会发生事故"，忽略"何时发生"，导致风险估计缺乏时间演化语义，并易在正常驾驶中产生过早误报。作者希望将事故风险建模为随事故临近而持续上升的连续信号。
AI.method: 提出PRE-ACT框架，将风险表示为随时间连续演化的信号：显式施加时间排序约束（越接近事故风险应越高）与距离事故awareness（distance-to-accident），逐步抬升风险并抑制过早告警；同时提出Separation Score，用于在局部时间窗之外评估预测风险曲线的全局分离行为。
AI.result: 在MM-AU子集与Nexar数据集上取得显著提升；Separation Score提供了对风险曲线全局行为的新评估维度；代码与可视化已开源。
AI.conclusion: 事故预测的连续风险建模与显式时序/距离约束能同时改善预警及时性与误报抑制，风险曲线分离度可作为超越局部窗口的评估指标。

title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.

AI.tldr: 提出 USAI-Quant——首个基于遥感影像定量评估视觉语言模型（VLM）对建筑环境指标推理能力的基准，覆盖美国335个最大城市，并揭示当前先进模型在数值推理任务上系统性不足。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在城市与空间 AI 中多依赖定性 VQA，缺乏对建筑环境指标定量推理能力的系统评估，导致模型真实推理水平不明。
AI.method: 从335个美国最大城市的高分辨率遥感影像出发，与定量建筑环境指标对齐构建 USAI-Quant；对通用 VLM 与遥感 VLM 在数十个指标、三个复杂度层级上以 VQA 形式评测，并进行模型、问题类型与地理位置的深入分析。
AI.result: 当前最先进模型在数值推理任务上一致表现不佳；性能随模型、问题类型与地理位置存在明显变异，暴露任务特定挑战。
AI.conclusion: USAI-Quant 填补了遥感影像定量推理评测的空白，表明 VLM 在建筑环境定量理解上仍有显著差距，为后续方法改进提供基准与方向。

title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
summary: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.

AI.tldr: 提出EGGroW，利用GenusSink与随机特征实现高效测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离计算，并应用于3D姿态估计与部分3D模板检测。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离可跨不同度量空间比较概率分布，在图匹配、3D目标检测等任务中潜力大，但其计算涉及稠密空间内距离矩阵，时间复杂度为三次方，难以规模化。现有加速方法多针对欧氏空间（如可扩展核方法），缺乏面向流形测地距离或图上最短路径距离（离散变体）的通用高效方案。
AI.method: 提出EGGroW（Efficient Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein）算法族：基于近期提出的GenusSink方法与随机特征理论，结合熵正则化的Sinkhorn式迭代，高效计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离。下游应用方面，将部分3D模板恢复建模为分阶段问题：先进行容量约束的场景选择，再进行半松弛的模板可见性与对应关系恢复。
AI.result: 在3D姿态估计与3D模板检测任务上，EGGroW在标准欧氏方法失效的情形下仍能给出准确解，且计算开销小，与理论分析预测一致。
AI.conclusion: EGGroW为一般测地距离（流形/图）上的Gromov-Wasserstein计算提供了可扩展的熵正则化高效算法，扩展了GW类方法在大规模几何与匹配问题中的实用性。

title: VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: this https URL
summary: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出VCRE-Fib视图条件区域证据框架，用于血吸虫病肝纤维化超声细粒度分级，联合输出纤维化评分、采集视图与候选异常区域图，在大规模多中心队列上降低了复合分级风险。
AI.motivation: 血吸虫病相关肝纤维化的准确分级对疾病管理与长期随访至关重要。超声无创但局部回声模式与解剖结构复杂，现有深度学习仅预测评分，难以在保留空间信息的同时融入采集视图与区域线索。
AI.method: VCRE-Fib在空间池化前构建视图条件的局部评分证据，用弱定位引导其聚合，再与全局预测结合；仅用图像推理即可同时输出纤维化评分、采集视图和候选异常区域图。在35个中心、6373名患者、108709张超声图像的重整队列上开发评估。
AI.result: 在4个中心、240名患者、4107张图像的患者不相交测试集上，相比同一数据划分下训练评估的SFibAI，复合分级风险相对降低7.115%；图像级平均绝对误差从0.391降至0.378，患者最大、患者中位数与中心均衡风险也更低；完整模型优于分别去除视图条件或弱定位的变体。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在超声分级中融入解剖上下文与区域证据，并在给出严重度估计的同时提供可供检查的空间预测。

title: Beyond Temporal Smoothing: Spatial Energy Budgets Stabilize One-Step Diffusion Editing
summary: One-step text-guided diffusion editing is efficient but prone to spatially misallocated updates that distort the edited object and alter the background. Existing methods often improve stability by averaging the editing field across timesteps. We instead identify spatial energy misallocation as a distinct and measurable failure mode: across two independent noise draws, the residual field is essentially unrepeatable, making the background field unreliable for direct transport, while its total energy still sets a usable magnitude for the draw at hand. BudEdit turns that magnitude into an explicit budget and reallocates it to edit-relevant regions selected jointly by residual energy and cross-attention, controlling where editing energy is spent rather than averaging over timesteps. The resulting training-free, inversion-free editor spends the budget on transport and reuses it to scale a correction in a lower-noise gated refinement. The budgeted injection field matches its prescribed budget exactly and vanishes on the identified background support, by construction. On PIE-Bench with SD-Turbo, BudEdit outperforms ChordEdit under each method's reported default settings on all 11 evaluated metrics, including a $2.1$\,dB gain in background PSNR, $31$\% lower DINO, and $36$\% lower LPIPS, while improving all five editing-quality metrics and reporting the lowest runtime in the comparison.

AI.tldr: BudEdit 将一步文本引导扩散编辑中的空间能量错配视为独立失败模式，通过显式能量预算与区域重分配实现免训练、免反演的稳定编辑。
AI.motivation: 一步扩散编辑高效但易出现空间错配更新，扭曲编辑对象并改变背景；已有方法多依赖跨时间步平均编辑场来提升稳定性，未针对错配根源建模。
AI.method: 识别"空间能量错配"失败模式：两次独立噪声采样下残差场几乎不可重复，背景场不可靠，但其总能量仍可给出当前采样可用的幅度。BudEdit 将该幅度转为显式预算，依据残差能量与交叉注意力联合筛选编辑相关区域并重分配能量；预算内的注入场严格匹配给定预算并在背景支撑上构造性消失；免训练免反演，预算同时用于低噪声门控精修中的校正缩放。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 与 SD-Turbo 上，按各方法默认设置，BudEdit 在全部 11 项指标上优于 ChordEdit，背景 PSNR 提升 2.1 dB，DINO 降低 31%，LPIPS 降低 36%，五项编辑质量指标全面提升，且对比中运行时间最低。
AI.conclusion: 以能量预算与区域重分配替代跨时间步平均，为一步扩散编辑提供了可控、可解释且高效的稳定化范式。

title: SynCo: Learning Cross-Modal Synergy by Contrasting Interaction Residuals
summary: Multimodal contrastive learning is a dominant paradigm for learning transferable representations from unlabeled data, but standard objectives primarily capture information that is redundant between modalities. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) shows that task-relevant information in multimodal data decomposes into three components: redundancy shared between modalities, uniqueness specific to each modality, and synergy available only from their joint observation. Recent frameworks extend contrastive learning to capture all three components, yet synergy remains undertrained in practice. We propose SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning), a method that directly addresses synergy undertraining through dedicated supervision on an interaction residual. SynCo fits a linear projector to predict the fused representation from independently computed unimodal features, and the resulting interaction residual, which removes the linearly unimodal-predictable component, receives dedicated contrastive supervision at negligible computational cost. On the controlled Trifeature benchmark, SynCo achieves state-of-the-art synergy capture with a $+5.98\%$ gain over the baseline, and on real-world benchmarks from MultiBench, DARai, and MM-IMDb, SynCo consistently outperforms or matches prior methods across diverse modality combinations and task types. The method operates as a plug-in to existing contrastive multimodal frameworks without modifying the underlying fusion architecture and can further improve synergy capture when combined with other methods.

AI.tldr: SynCo 通过对"交互残差"进行专门的对比监督，解决多模态对比学习中协同信息（synergy）训练不足的问题，作为即插即用模块在 Trifeature、MultiBench、DARai、MM-IMDb 上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 标准多模态对比目标主要捕获模态间的冗余信息。根据部分信息分解（PID），任务相关信息包含冗余、独特性与协同三部分，而现有框架虽声称覆盖三者，协同成分在实际训练中仍严重欠拟合。
AI.method: SynCo 先用线性投影器从各自独立计算的单模态特征预测融合表示，得到的"交互残差"剔除了可由单模态线性预测的成分，随后对该残差施加专门的对比监督；计算开销可忽略，不改动底层融合结构，可作为插件接入现有对比式多模态框架。
AI.result: 在受控的 Trifeature 基准上协同捕获达 SOTA，较基线提升 +5.98%；在 MultiBench、DARai、MM-IMDb 等真实基准上，跨多种模态组合与任务类型一致优于或持平既有方法，并能与其他方法叠加进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差式显式监督补足协同训练信号，是一种低代价、通用、可组合的多模态表示学习改进方案，适用于广泛模态组合与下游任务。

title: PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PolyTopoBench——一个面向遥感图像矢量多边形生成的统一评测框架，重点评估含孔洞与多环的复杂多边形，并对 11 种代表性方法在两类遥感数据集上进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 矢量多边形生成（将遥感等视觉输入转为矢量几何）对自动驾驶、矢量地图构建等应用有重要价值。早期"栅格掩膜+后处理"流程无法端到端优化，易漏检小目标、产生不准确顶点；近期直接生成矢量的方法多局限于简单外轮廓，难以表示含孔洞的复杂多边形或保持其拓扑结构。作者希望明确现有方法在复杂多边形上的能力边界。
AI.method: 构建统一评测框架 PolyTopoBench，同时评测外环与内环；覆盖建筑、道路、植被、无植被区域两类遥感图像数据集；对 11 种代表性方法（基于分割的多边形化流水线、视觉基础模型基线、专用矢量生成器）进行系统性基准测试。
AI.result: 实验表明现有方法通常能较好恢复简单外边界，但在含孔洞或多环多边形上性能显著退化，说明复杂多边形生成仍是未解决的难题。
AI.conclusion: 复杂多边形生成是开放挑战，需推动拓扑感知的基准与方法设计；代码与数据已公开。

title: Is H&E Image-to-Spatial Transcriptomics Simpler Than It Looks?
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H&E histology offers a scalable route toward spatial molecular profiling. Recent work has pursued increasingly sophisticated architectures to capture spatial context and richer expression structure. At the same time, simple estimators have shown strong performance in several studies, but what they already solve and where additional complexity is needed remain unclear. We study this behavior through the structure of prediction error under the mean-squared error (MSE) objective. Differences in average expression across genes can account for a substantial part of aggregate prediction performance, while a key unresolved error lies in recovering variation within each slide. Decomposing MSE into slide-level and within-slide components, we find that the within-slide component has lower residual-normalized parameter sensitivity in controlled neural experiments. This motivates Component-Guided Loss (CGL), which increases supervision of the within-slide component. CGL-Linear is a closed-form affine instantiation that achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across HEST-1k cohorts and gene-panel sizes. The same within-slide supervision improves existing neural models. These results suggest that substantial gains can come from aligning the training objective with prediction-error structure rather than increasing model complexity.

AI.tldr: 该工作从MSE误差结构出发，将空间基因表达预测误差分解为滑片级与滑片内分量，发现滑片内分量在归一化参数敏感度上更低，据此提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL）及闭式仿射实现CGL-Linear，在HEST-1k上取得SOTA并同样提升现有神经模型。
AI.motivation: 从常规H&E组织学图像预测空间基因表达是实现可扩展空间分子图谱的重要途径。已有工作不断加码模型架构复杂度以捕获空间上下文与表达结构，但简单估计器同样表现强劲，说明"简单方法已解决什么、何时需要额外复杂度"尚不清晰，需要从预测误差结构这一角度加以厘清。
AI.method: 在MSE目标下分析预测误差结构：将总体MSE分解为滑片级（基因间平均表达差异）与滑片内（同一滑片内空间变异）两个分量。在受控神经网络实验中计算两个分量的残差归一化参数敏感度，发现滑片内分量敏感度更低，即其监督信号不足。据此提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL），加强对滑片内分量的监督；并给出闭式仿射实例CGL-Linear，可直接求解。
AI.result: CGL-Linear在HEST-1k各队列及不同基因面板规模上达到整体SOTA；同一滑片内监督策略亦能改进已有神经模型，说明该类模型同样存在滑片内分量欠优化的现象。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升的关键在于使训练目标与预测误差结构对齐，而非一味提升模型复杂度；滑片内表达变异的恢复是当前主要未解误差来源。

title: SV2V-RSim: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Self-Selective V2V Cooperative Perception with Near-Realistic Data
summary: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) cooperative perception enhances autonomous driving by enabling vehicles to share information beyond their direct line of sight. However, existing V2V datasets are limited by a small number of participating agents, static collaborator selection strategies, and a significant domain gap between simulated and real-world environments. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SV2V-RSim, a large-scale, multi-modal, near-realistic simulation dataset engineered to elevate agent diversity and realism. Additionally, we present the Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) module, which optimizes collaborator selection to balance perception performance against communication bandwidth constraints. Our dataset is generated using the Unreal Engine 5-based simulator that integrates high-fidelity 3D assets, diverse environments, and intricate traffic scenarios. All vehicles within a specified range of the ego vehicle are equipped with sensor suites, enabling dynamic and adaptive collaborator selection. SV2V-RSim encompasses four maps, four weather conditions, six time periods from sunrise to night, 203K LiDAR frames, 402K RGB frames, and 788K annotated 3D bounding boxes across 17 object classes, supporting a range of cooperative perception tasks such as 3D object detection, segmentation, and depth estimation. Benchmarking on recent cooperative perception algorithms demonstrates that SVA achieves a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off, while sim-to-real experiments and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment validate the dataset's high realism and practical effectiveness. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出SV2V-RSim大规模多模态近真实V2V协同感知仿真数据集（UE5，4地图/4天气/6时段，203K LiDAR帧、788K 3D框）及自适应选择协作车辆模块SVA，在性能-带宽权衡上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有V2V数据集受限于参与智能体数量少、协作者选择策略静态、仿真与真实域差距大，难以支撑动态自适应协作感知研究与带宽约束下的权衡分析。
AI.method: 基于Unreal Engine 5构建高保真仿真：集成高质量3D资产、多环境与复杂交通场景；主车范围内所有车辆均配备传感器套件，支持动态协作者选择；提出Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA)模块，在感知性能与通信带宽间优化协作者选择；提供多模态标注支持检测、分割、深度任务。
AI.result: SVA在近期协同感知算法基准上取得更优的性能-带宽折衷；sim-to-real实验与无参考图像质量评价（NR-IQA）验证了数据集的高真实感与实用有效性。
AI.conclusion: SV2V-RSim通过提升智能体多样性与真实感，配合自适应协作者选择模块，为协同感知研究提供了可扩展的仿真平台与带宽感知的基线方案，数据集与代码将公开。

title: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
summary: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations. LLMs appear less susceptible to this failure, likely because they perform semantic visual comparison of morphology and tissue architecture rather than relying on shortcut features tied to acquisition context. Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage. Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MOSAIC基准，通过相对相似性框架评测17个模型在6个数据集上的跨机构组织学相似性判断，发现病理基础模型存在跨域失败模式，而通用多模态LLM表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型虽在数百万组织切片上训练，但跨切片或跨机构比较时无法保持组织相似性，且标准域内评测无法发现这种临床危险的失败模式，因此需要建立跨机构、跨队列的评估框架并寻找替代方案。
AI.method: 提出相对相似性框架并发布MOSAIC（Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts）基准；在6个数据集上评测17个模型，比较病理编码器与通用多模态LLM的跨域组织学相似性判断行为，并分析训练数据规模扩展的影响。
AI.result: 通用多模态LLM在跨域组织学相似性判断上持续优于专用病理基础模型；病理编码器常将同机构不同疾病的切片排得比同疾病不同机构的切片更相似；扩大训练数据不能解决病理编码器的问题。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了当前病理基础模型的根本性鲁棒性差距，问题源于学习目标而非数据覆盖；多模态LLM可作为跨机构检索、数据集协调和多站点质量控制的可行替代方案。

title: Improving Video Sparse Attention with Fine-grained Router and Sparse Rebasing
summary: We present VSA2, a frontier trainable sparse attention for video DiTs. VSA2 includes a variety of new architectural features and training procedures that we apply across all stages of the DiT development cycle, including pretraining, RL, and inference, to produce a DiT with comparable or better quality than a full attention counterpart. Architecturally, VSA2 introduces a fine-grained router that improves the precision of identifying critical tokens and supports dynamic computation by allowing each query to attend to a variable number of key-value pairs. In training, we identify a Hard-to-Easy Curriculum, where models trained under high sparsity and later evaluated with lower sparsity during inference not only generalize effectively, but also outperform models trained with full attention in motion quality. VSA2 is also flexible: it can replace full attention during the middle of progressive low-to-high resolution pretraining, rebasing early-stage full-attention checkpoints. Experiments show that VSA2 reduces attention computation by half over VSA with lower loss. On 720p videos, it accelerates attention by 8.9x and end-to-end generation by 4.62x compared to the FlashAttention-3 baseline, while achieving comparable or better video quality.

AI.tldr: VSA2 是一种面向视频 DiT 的可训练稀疏注意力机制，通过细粒度路由、动态 KV 数量与"难到易课程"训练策略，在 720p 视频上实现相对 FlashAttention-3 约 8.9 倍注意力加速、4.62 倍端到端加速，同时保持或超越全注意力画质。
AI.motivation: 视频 DiT 的全注意力计算代价随序列长度平方增长，成为高分辨率、长时长视频生成的主要瓶颈。已有稀疏注意力（如 VSA）在精度与可训练性上仍有不足，需要在保持甚至提升生成质量的前提下大幅降低注意力与端到端开销。
AI.method: 提出 VSA2：1）架构上引入细粒度路由器，提高关键 token 识别精度，并支持动态计算——每个 query 可关注可变数量的 key-value 对；2）训练上发现"难到易课程"（Hard-to-Easy Curriculum），即高稀疏度训练、低稀疏度推理，不仅泛化良好，运动质量还优于全注意力训练；3）具备灵活性，可在低到高分辨率渐进预训练中途替换全注意力，并对早期全注意力 checkpoint 进行 rebasing；训练流程覆盖预训练、RL 与推理。
AI.result: 相比 VSA，注意力计算减半且损失更低；在 720p 视频上相对 FlashAttention-3 基线，注意力加速 8.9x，端到端生成加速 4.62x，同时视频质量相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: VSA2 为视频 DiT 提供了一种可训练、可插拔的稀疏注意力方案，兼顾效率与生成质量，并可无缝嵌入现有预训练流程。

title: Rethinking the Fully Hyperbolic Vision Transformer in Polar Coordinates
summary: Hyperbolic space can embed intrinsic hierarchies in data with low distortion due to the exponential growth of volume with distance from the origin. However, current Lorentz transformer blocks are formulated in ambient coordinates, where numerical errors increase at large radii due to instability in the Lorentzian inner product, leading many models to limit the radius to avoid this issue. This prevents us from utilizing the regions of hyperbolic space that motivate the geometry. To address this, we revisit the components of the transformer block in polar coordinates, where hyperbolic operations such as distance calculation and attention centroids can be computed without the numerical cancellation in their ambient-coordinate formulations. Specifically, we propose a polar fully connected layer that separately maps an embedding's direction and radius, allowing the radius of a feature to be learned rather than determined by the norm of a linear map. We additionally introduce horospherical shifts as relative positional encodings whose query-key distances grow logarithmically with the token gap. Finally, we reformulate the residual connection as average radius Lorentz boosts. Combining these components, we develop a fully hyperbolic transformer that substantially improves performance over Euclidean and hyperbolic baselines on standard vision tasks. We further evaluate our model on ImageNet and demonstrate its ability to generalize to other datasets using pre-trained weights, similar to Euclidean counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出极坐标下的全双曲Transformer：将FC层、注意力质心、距离计算、相对位置编码与残差连接全部改写为极坐标/洛伦兹Boost形式，避免大半径数值不稳定，从而可真正利用双曲空间远端区域。
AI.motivation: 双曲空间因体积随半径指数增长而适合嵌入层次结构，但现有Lorentz Transformer在环境坐标（ambient coordinates）中表述，洛伦兹内积在大半径处数值误差急剧增大，导致模型被迫限制半径，无法使用真正体现双曲几何优势的远端区域。
AI.method: 在极坐标下重新审视Transformer各组件：(1) 极坐标全连接层，分别映射嵌入的方向与半径，使半径可学习而非由线性映射范数决定；(2) 以horospherical shift作为相对位置编码，使query-key距离随token间隔对数增长；(3) 将残差连接重构为平均半径的Lorentz boost。由此组装出完全双曲的Transformer。
AI.result: 在标准视觉任务上显著优于欧氏与双曲基线；在ImageNet上验证，并可像欧氏对应模型一样用预训练权重迁移到其他数据集。
AI.conclusion: 极坐标表述消除了环境坐标中的数值抵消问题，使双曲Transformer可在大半径区域稳定训练与推理，验证了全双曲架构在视觉任务上的可行性与迁移能力，为几何深度学习提供了可扩展的数值稳定方案。

title: Synthetic Thermal Image Generation for Real-Time Animal Detection Under Low-Visibility Conditions
comment: Accepted at The IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS), 2026
summary: Wildlife-vehicle collisions remain a significant road safety concern, particularly during nighttime and low-visibility conditions when RGB-based perception systems are often unreliable. Thermal imaging offers a promising alternative for detecting animals under poor illumination. However, the limited availability of annotated infrared animal datasets restricts the development of robust deep learning-based detection models. This paper investigates synthetic thermal image generation as a scalable approach for real-time animal detection under low-visibility conditions. A subset of 514 annotated visible-spectrum animal images from the NTLNP dataset is translated into synthetic thermal representations using CycleGAN-Turbo, while a limited real thermal dataset of 60 images is expanded through thermal-focused augmentation. Multiple object detection architectures, including YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and RT-DETR, are trained independently on synthetic and real thermal datasets and evaluated using precision, recall, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, model size, and inference latency. Experimental results show that synthetic thermal images provide competitive detection performance, with RT-DETR achieving the highest synthetic-data mAP@0.5 of 0.9613. Models trained on augmented real thermal data achieve the strongest overall performance, with YOLOv10s obtaining 0.9879 mAP@0.5 and 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95. Computational analysis further indicates that lightweight YOLO variants provide favorable inference latency, supporting their potential for real-time deployment. These findings demonstrate that synthetic thermal imagery can reduce dependence on scarce infrared datasets and support the development of efficient animal detection systems for future vehicle-mounted wildlife collision mitigation applications.

AI.tldr: 用CycleGAN-Turbo把可见光动物图像转为合成热成像，结合增强的真实热数据训练YOLOv8/9/10与RT-DETR做低能见度下动物检测，结论是合成热数据可替代稀缺红外数据集。
AI.motivation: 夜间与低能见度条件下RGB感知不可靠，热成像虽适合探测动物，但标注红外动物数据稀缺，限制了深度学习检测模型的训练与泛化。
AI.method: 取NTLNP数据集中514张已标注可见光动物图像，用CycleGAN-Turbo做可见光-热成像风格翻译生成合成热图；对60张真实热图做热成像导向的数据增强。分别在合成集与真实集上独立训练YOLOv8、YOLOv9、YOLOv10、RT-DETR，用precision、recall、mAP@0.5、mAP@0.5:0.95、模型大小和推理延迟评估。
AI.result: 合成热数据训练的RT-DETR取得最高合成mAP@0.5=0.9613；增强真实热数据训练的YOLOv10s最优，mAP@0.5=0.9879、mAP@0.5:0.95=0.9571；轻量YOLO变体推理延迟较低，利于实时部署。
AI.conclusion: 合成热成像可缓解红外数据集稀缺问题，支撑高效动物检测系统，面向车载野生动物碰撞减缓应用。

title: DynamicDx: Evaluating Evidence Acquisition in Video-Based Diagnosis
comment: 49 pages. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Diagnosing a patient from video requires more than recognizing the sign: a vision-language model must turn what it sees into hypotheses, questions and tests. DynamicDx evaluates each step in 71 neurological consultations across 11 sign categories, linking authentic patient videos to confirmed diagnoses and fixed charts built from the same case reports, so that every model queries the same evidence. Across five such models, video improves accuracy by 9.9-22.5 percentage points over blind input, but neither recognition alone nor temporal order explains the gain: the cause is usually missing from the model's video-only differential diagnosis even when the sign is recognized, and shuffling the frames produces no reliable accuracy loss. Instead, a trajectory replay traces most of the gain to the investigation results the video prompts. Evidence acquisition is the bottleneck: supplying the decisive investigations raises accuracy to 73.2-93.0%. Two interventions act on it. A post-trained 4B video describer improves sign descriptions, especially from a short, densely sampled segment, and source-clean literature retrieval expands initial hypotheses; both bring the tests a model orders closer to those the treating clinicians documented and, through them, raise accuracy. For video-based diagnosis, seeing better helps when it leads to asking better.

AI.tldr: DynamicDx是一个基于71例神经科会诊真实视频的视觉-语言诊断评估基准，将"看懂体征"与"主动追问检查"分解为可测步骤，发现视频增益主要来自检查结果获取而非体征识别。
AI.motivation: 现有视频医学诊断评测只考核最终诊断准确性，无法区分"识别体征"与"提出假设、提问、下检查"等中间步骤的贡献，作者希望定位视频输入带来增益的真实来源。
AI.method: 构建DynamicDx：71例神经科会诊视频、11类体征，配同一病例报告生成的固定病历，保证各模型查询同一证据；评测五个视觉-语言模型的盲测、纯视频、帧打乱、轨迹回放等条件；并测试两种干预——后训练4B视频描述器（短时密集采样片段）与source-clean文献检索。
AI.result: 视频较盲测提升9.9–22.5个百分点；体征识别本身与帧时序均不能解释增益（帧打乱无稳定下降），增益主要来自视频触发的检查结果；直接提供决定性检查可将准确率提至73.2–93.0%；视频描述器与文献检索使模型所下检查更接近临床医生实际记录并提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视频诊断的瓶颈在于证据获取：体征识别若无检查追问，对鉴别诊断贡献有限；提升视频描述质量与初始假设质量才能让模型"问得更好"，从而实现更准诊断。

title: Distributed Hydrological Modeling in the Feature Space
summary: Accurate forecasting of river discharge and floods is very challenging. River dynamics are affected by storage, meteorological forcing, and flow propagation at different spatial and temporal scales. Forecasting thus requires a framework that considers the upstream-to-downstream flow through river networks across grid cells and catchments. This modeling is known in hydrology as distributed modeling and routing. Existing deep learning approaches either ignore this topology, operate on lumped catchments, or route predicted physical quantities through a separate graph or physical routing model. We instead introduce feature-space routing: a topology-aware state-space operator embedded directly in the forecasting dynamics. At every forecast step, the operator gathers latent states from upstream grid cells and causally updates the downstream state according to the known river network. This preserves the physical connectivity of the river system while allowing the propagated state itself to be learned end-to-end and allows the model to predict river discharge considering both local dynamics and neighboring upstream contributions. To address uncertainty and provide probabilistic forecasts, we minimize the fair continuous ranked probability score (fCRPS) as a training objective. Our experiments on the European Flood Awareness System (EFAS) and observational data for river discharge forecasting demonstrate that encoding the physical structure of river networks explicitly in the feature space substantially improves the forecasting skill, particularly in an ungauged setting. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on both reanalysis and observational data and is able to forecast maps of river discharge at 1 arcminute and 6-hourly resolution up to 10 days lead time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"特征空间路由"（feature-space routing），将河流网络拓扑作为状态空间算子直接嵌入深度学习的预报动力学中，在每个预报步从上游网格单元汇聚隐状态并因果更新下游状态，并以fCRPS为训练目标实现概率预报。
AI.motivation: 河流径流与洪水预报受蓄水、气象强迫和不同时空尺度上的流量传播影响，需要跨网格单元与流域的上游—下游连通建模（分布式建模与汇流）。现有深度学习方法要么忽略这种拓扑结构，要么在集总式流域上操作，要么需将预测的物理量经单独的图模型或物理汇流模型进行路由，割裂了学习与物理连通性。
AI.method: 提出特征空间路由：一种拓扑感知的状态空间算子，直接嵌入预报动力学。每个预报步中，算子从上游网格单元采集潜状态，并依据已知河网对下游状态进行因果更新，从而在学习端到端传播状态的同时保持河流系统的物理连通性，兼顾本地动态与上游邻域贡献。训练目标采用公平连续排序概率评分（fCRPS）以处理不确定性并给出概率预报。
AI.result: 在EFAS再分析数据与观测径流数据上的实验表明，将河网物理结构显式编码进特征空间可显著提升预报技巧，在无测站（ungauged）设定下尤为明显，达到当前最优水平，可输出1弧分、6小时分辨率、最长10天预见期的径流预报图。
AI.conclusion: 将河网拓扑作为可微状态空间算子嵌入预报模型，是一种兼顾物理连通性与端到端学习的有效径流预报范式，在再分析与观测数据上均取得领先性能，并对无测站泛化尤为有利。

title: ReVision3D: Attribution-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement for 3D Medical Perception
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising path for overcoming the limited visual capability of current medical imaging agents. Yet applying RSI to volumetric imaging remains difficult: failures can arise from acquisition, perception, training recipe, or downstream inference, while self-generated feedback and logged trajectories provide little guidance on which component should change. We introduce ReVision3D, an RSI system that leverages 3D volumes with spatially grounded annotations to determine where visual evidence is lost and recursively improve the corresponding visual capability. A frozen language-model designer proposes revisions to acquisition, perception, training, or inference, while the verifier and system-level objective remain fixed. Our key insight is that an annotated volume forms an exact replay world for view rendering and spatial verification: unvisited views can be rendered on demand, and localized predictions can be checked directly against reference masks. This grounded feedback directs targeted revision, while only changes that improve beyond measured seed noise are retained. Each accepted change triggers renewed attribution, allowing the dominant bottleneck to shift across rounds. On abdominal CT, attribution identifies perception as the dominant remaining limitation. Revising that level enables ReVision3D to achieve 79% liver recall and 83% kidney recall at under 0.4 false positives per patient, outperforming the evaluated frozen multimodal foundation models, with the largest gains on small lesions.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReVision3D，一个将递归自我改进（RSI）用于三维医学影像的智能体系统：以带空间标注的 3D 体数据作为"可精确回放的世界"，通过冻结的语言模型设计者对采集、感知、训练、推理四个环节提出修改，并用可渲染视图与参考掩膜进行空间验证，仅保留超过种子噪声的改进。在腹部 CT 上归因指出"感知"是主要瓶颈，改进后达到 79% 肝脏召回与 83% 肾脏召回（每患者 <0.4 假阳性），优于所评估的冻结多模态基础模型，小病灶增益最大。
AI.motivation: 当前医学影像智能体的视觉能力有限，递归自我改进（RSI）是潜在突破路径，但在体数据上难以落地：失败可能来自采集、感知、训练配方或下游推理，而自生成反馈与日志轨迹无法指示应改动哪个组件。作者希望建立一个有"接地"（grounded）信号来定位瓶颈并定向修正的 RSI 框架。
AI.method: ReVision3D：使用带空间接地标注的 3D 体数据。冻结的语言模型设计者提出对采集 / 感知 / 训练 / 推理某一层级的修改；验证器与系统级目标保持固定。核心思路是把带标注体数据当作"精确回放世界"：未访问视角可按需渲染，局部预测可直接与参考掩膜比对，从而将视觉证据丢失归因到具体组件。只保留改进幅度超过实测种子噪声的修改；每次接受的改动触发重新归因，使主导瓶颈可跨轮次转移。
AI.result: 在腹部 CT 上，归因将感知识别为剩余的主导瓶颈；修订该层级后，ReVision3D 达到 79% 肝脏召回、83% 肾脏召回，且每患者假阳性低于 0.4，优于所评估的冻结多模态基础模型，并在小病灶上取得最大增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，以可回放、可空间验证的标注体数据作为接地反馈，可将 RSI 的修改归因到具体组件并实现定向、可持续的自我改进；归因驱动的层级切换是有效机制。但其评估限于医学影像领域与单一任务/模态，未提供代码或跨域泛化证据，对物理 AI / VLA / 世界模型等核心方向属于领域专用应用而非通用方法贡献。

title: Oracle Gaps in Reliability Coverage: Sampling Noise or Policy Specialization?
summary: Policies trained from the same base model can appear to solve different problems. An oracle that chooses the best policy for each problem may therefore appear much stronger than any single policy. Selecting the largest estimated success rate also selects favorable sampling errors. We study this effect through reliability coverage, the fraction of problems whose success probability reaches a chosen threshold. Our first test redistributes stored correctness outcomes across policies within each problem. A second also preserves each policy's total successes, accounting for overall quality differences under a specified statistical model. For five training seeds of a seven-billion-parameter vision-language model, redistribution reproduces 0.096 of an estimated 0.113 oracle gap at threshold 0.10. Neither test finds significant evidence at this threshold. Small advantages remain unresolved. Mixtures, routers, voting, and weight averaging show no detectable improvement over their corresponding single-policy baselines. Training policies on different datasets shows little detectable specialization under light post-training, and no router gain. A stronger recipe does create it, both tests detect it, and a router gain appears only at the high thresholds where the specialists separate. In a control with predictable specialization, a router recovers about half the oracle gap. Coverage bounds explain why even a genuine oracle advantage need not yield a deployment gain. The tests assess apparent specialization from stored responses before investment in routing. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可靠性覆盖率"(reliability coverage)度量与两种统计检验，检验从同一基座模型训练出的多个策略所表现出的"专精化"是否只是采样噪声；对70亿参数VLM的5个训练种子，重分配可解释0.10阈值下0.113 oracle差距中的0.096，未发现显著专精证据。
AI.motivation: 用同一基座模型训练的不同策略在不同问题上表现各异，用oracle为每个问题挑选最佳策略会显得远强于任一单策略；但"选最大估计成功率"同时也会选中有利的采样误差，因此需要区分真实的专精化与纯粹的统计假象，以判断是否值得投入训练路由/集成。
AI.method: 定义reliability coverage：成功率超过给定阈值的问题占比。测试一：在每个问题内部跨策略重分配已存储的正确性结果，打散策略—问题的对应关系。测试二：在指定统计模型下进一步保持每个策略的总成功数，以控制策略整体质量差异。在70亿参数视觉语言模型的5个训练种子上比较重分配结果与oracle差距；并检验混合、路由、投票、权重平均，以及不同数据集训练与更强训练配方下的表现，最后用coverage bound解释oracle优势为何不一定转化为部署收益。
AI.result: 阈值0.10时，重分配可复现估计oracle差距0.113中的0.096，两种检验在该阈值下均无显著证据，仅存未解析的小优势。混合、路由、投票和权重平均相对对应单策略基线无可检测提升。不同数据集训练在轻量后训练下几乎无可检测专精，也无路由增益；更强的训练配方确实产生专精，两种检验均可检出，路由增益只在专家分化的高阈值处出现。在专精可预测的对照设置中，路由器约恢复一半oracle差距。
AI.conclusion: 表面上的策略专精化大多可由采样误差解释，统计检验可在投入路由训练之前、仅凭存储的响应评估其真实性；即使存在真实oracle优势，coverage bound也说明它未必带来部署收益。小优势是否真实仍未定论，需要更强训练配方或高阈值场景才能显现。

title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
summary: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 AliasForge，利用定点重采样下采样中的"零化整数扰动"构造可证明的信息丢失样本：隐藏标签翻转扰动后，经接口后的张量逐比特一致，导致任何视觉语言验证器/路由器的配对平衡准确率恒为 1/2，并用格判据在 20 个配置中判定 17 个可构造、3 个不可构造。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言验证器与路由器需要区分"可通过更多推理修复的错误"与"视觉证据根本没传到语言模型导致的错误"，但由于标注者看的是全分辨率图像、模型收到的是预处理后的张量，这一区分缺乏真值。作者希望构造一种可证明的"接口信息缺失"情形，作为该区分的上界/判据基准。
AI.method: 核心是定点重采样（fixed-point resampling）：令预处理前的缩放成为精确的整数线性映射，可将非零整数扰动映射为零。在该零空间（null vector）中隐藏翻转标签的扰动，生成两张图像——步骤正确性标签相反、但经过缩放后的接口状态逐比特相同。作者证明了任何定点下采样器都存在此类零向量，并在常见比例下给出最小零向量规模界（界超过 255 时排除 8-bit 表示）。进一步给出一个格（lattice）判据，仅从缩放配置即可给出可实现碰撞并证明其在指定构造族内是否不存在。此外用这些对筛选只做接口侧再注意/再推理的路由器。
AI.result: 格判据解析了全部 20 个被筛查配置：17 个可构造、3 个不可构造。在三种架构上构造了认证对（certified pairs），并认证了另外四种处理器；18 个计分对上决策 logit 差为零，18 个对照全部非零。这些对还能筛掉浪费算力的"再注意/再推理"路由器。自然数据上逐项路由存在余量，但所有被测的仅接口路由器都没有优于直接停止；作者给出"纤维上界（fiber ceiling）"来界定接口可恢复的余量上限。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为"视觉信息未到达语言模型"这一失败模式提供了可证明、可构造、可认证的基准与判据，说明仅靠接口无法恢复被下采样零化掉的视觉证据；对验证器/路由器的能力评估具有方法论价值，但属于评估基准类工具，而非直接推动 VLA/世界模型/三维重建性能的方法。

title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出 MalariaCascade 两级推理系统：轻量 MobileNetV2 哨兵在低成本下做置信分类，将不确定样本升级给仅在干净标准化图像上推理的 EfficientNet-B3 专家，通过结构隔离而非学习式鲁棒性，在手机传感器噪声下维持疟疾诊断召回率。
AI.motivation: 自动疟疾薄血涂片诊断可减轻资源匮乏实验室负担，但仅在干净实验室图像上追求高精度的模型，一旦遇到廉价手机摄像头的传感器噪声就严重失效。作者希望在低算力、低成本前提下保证临床安全约束（召回率下限），并避免依赖学习式噪声鲁棒性。
AI.method: 两阶段级联推理：轻量 MobileNetV2 哨兵（2,225,153 参数）低算力下输出高置信分类，不确定样本升级至 EfficientNet-B3 专家（10,697,769 参数）；专家只接收干净、标准化图像，与输入帧的损坏程度无关，靠结构隔离保证鲁棒性。哨兵以安全分数目标训练，在优化精度前对 Recall(Parasitised)>=0.95 与 Recall(Uninfected)>=0.40 设硬性下限，使检查点按构造满足临床安全约束。
AI.result: 在 NIH Malaria Cell Images（27,558 细胞）上，干净测试集 Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570、Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955。最严重高斯传感器噪声下，级联 Recall(Parasitised) 仅降 2.4 pp（0.9570→0.9329），而单模型基线崩塌 63.0 pp（0.9584→0.3281）。McNemar 检验显著（chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085）。消融显示：将干净图像路由至专家，在噪声下带来 16.8 pp 的 Recall(Parasitised) 优势。
AI.conclusion: 结构隔离专家阶段（而非学习式鲁棒性）是维持噪声下性能的关键机制；带安全下限的哨兵目标可按构造满足临床安全约束；该级联在低成本手机成像条件下显著优于单模型基线。

title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at this https URL
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: RDIM 用残差扩散隐式模型显式建模 HQ/LQ 图像残差，对齐真实退化过程，配合非马尔可夫隐式反演采样器实现单步/少步高质量图像复原，并用可控方差机制平衡保真与多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在逆问题中常用纯高斯噪声初始化，与真实退化不匹配；扩散桥约束端点且反演链长、易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽可一步映射，但缺乏显式方差建模，在严重退化下性能下降。因此需要一个能对齐退化过程、支持少步采样且可控随机性的框架。
AI.method: 提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM）：显式建模高质量与低质量图像之间的残差，使前向过程与真实退化对齐；推导非马尔可夫隐式反演采样器，可跳过中间时间步；引入可控方差机制在确定性与随机采样间插值；并支持按需使用感知损失。
AI.result: 在去噪与超分辨率基准上，RDIM 在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 上一致优于包括桥模型与一致性模型在内的当前最优方法，同时减少幻觉，且仅需少量采样步（常为一步）。
AI.conclusion: RDIM 将残差建模、少步隐式采样与可控方差统一，为广泛的图像复原任务提供了高效且高质量的解决方案，兼具保真度与多样性。

title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
summary: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

AI.tldr: NutriVision 是一个端到端营养估计框架，用 DepthAnything-V3 生成深度、CLIP 编码食材文本，通过食材条件化的频域融合、掩码预测头与模态内语义建模，从单张 RGB 图加可选食材表预测热量、质量、脂肪、碳水与蛋白质，在 Nutrition5k 上平均 PMAE 13.60%。
AI.motivation: 现有营养估计方法分为两条割裂路线：依赖标定 RGB-D 采集的视觉模型，以及使用文本线索但多模态融合有限的食材感知方法；本文希望仅凭单张 RGB 图与可选食材描述即可获得准确营养估计，摆脱专用深度传感硬件。
AI.method: NutriVision 用 DepthAnything-V3 从 RGB 图合成深度模态，用 CLIP 编码食材描述，并集成三个机制：食材条件化的频域对齐融合模块（IC-FAFM）以文本引导重加权并对齐 RGB-深度频域分量；食材感知掩码预测头（IA-MPH）的门控与通道掩码以食物身份为条件；以及模态专属的内部语义建模（ISM）块。
AI.result: 在 Nutrition5k 上平均 PMAE 为 13.60±0.10%，比作者自己的 IGSMNet 实现高 0.89 个百分点，比 OmniFood8k 高 2.90 个百分点（均 p<0.001）；模块级消融显示食材感知预测头是主要架构贡献者，使平均 PMAE 改善 1.50±0.17 个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 食材条件化预测与频域感知的 RGB-深度融合对单图营养估计带来可量化收益，提供了一条无需专用深度传感硬件的营养评估实用路径。

title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
summary: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

AI.tldr: 将深度可分离卷积的不对称参数增长特性(立方核项仅出现在depthwise阶段)用于3D U-Net,构建仅536,990参数(比同构密集3D U-Net少24倍)的肝脏/肿瘤分割网络,并在MSD Task03 LiTS上取得超过既往报道的肝脏Dice与更优的肿瘤Dice,同时表明固定位移可替代大部分可学习空间滤波但不可全部替换。
AI.motivation: 3D密集卷积在体数据医学分割上性能最强,但参数量随卷积核立方化而剧增(2D→3D增长约200%),在医学影像的小数据场景下极易过拟合且部署代价高。作者希望利用depthwise separable卷积从2D到3D仅增长约5%的不对称性,在保持性能的前提下大幅压缩参数。
AI.method: 基于depthwise separable factorization构建3D U-Net(536,990参数,约为同构密集3D U-Net的1/24)。在MSD Task03 Liver(源自LiTS)全部131例公开体数据上做五折交叉验证、逐例评估;与低分辨率配置和2D配置对比;在共同留出划分下与密集3D U-Net同条件训练做配对比较;并进一步在LiTS与2D内窥镜基准上用固定位移替换可学习空间滤波器,考察空间容量位置与总量的影响。
AI.result: 肿瘤Dice 0.577(95% CI [0.518, 0.633]),肝脏Dice 0.947(95% CI [0.941, 0.952]),肝脏Dice超越既往报道;肿瘤Dice比既往低分辨率配置(0.4701)高0.107、超过其2D配置(0.5394),而参数量仅约1/24、面内分辨率约一半。同条件下相比密集3D U-Net,肝脏+0.031 Dice(配对 p=0.006),肿瘤+0.041(95% CI [+0.005, +0.081],配对 p=0.056)。固定位移可替换大部分可学习空间滤波器(精度无损),但全部替换会明显变差。
AI.conclusion: depthwise separable分解使3D U-Net在小数据医学影像场景下兼具参数高效与精度优势,并表现出正则化效果;空间容量的"放置位置"比其"总量"更关键。该结论属医学/领域CV范畴,对通用AI方法学有一定启示但非核心方向。

title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
summary: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 SemReward-VL：用冻结语言模型对 VLM 生成的发育行为描述从结果一致性、条目相关性、弃答与清晰度四方面打语义奖励，并用 GRPO 更新 LoRA，从而从临床结果标签反推行为描述，在 13379 段视频、41 个条目上提升整体准确率与高召回条目数。
AI.motivation: 发育筛查视频包含儿童具体行为表现，但临床记录通常只保存结论性结果（如通过/未通过），缺乏对"发生了什么"的描述。作者希望让模型直接从稀疏的结果标签中学会生成条目特定的行为描述，填补行为描述与临床结论之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建 SemReward-VL：由视觉语言模型生成行为描述，冻结的语言模型充当评分器，从四个维度给出语义奖励——与临床结果的一致性、与筛查条目的相关性、对无关视频-条目对的弃答（abstention）、描述清晰度。使用 GRPO（组相对策略优化）以该语义奖励更新 LoRA 适配器。
AI.result: 在覆盖 41 个条目、13379 段视频的数据上，方法提升了整体准确率，并增加了召回率高于 0.5 的条目数量。仍存在错误，集中于时间方向、持续时长以及随年龄变化的特定行为解释。
AI.conclusion: 以结果标签为监督、用冻结语言模型构造语义奖励并结合 GRPO 微调 LoRA，可有效提升条目级行为描述的生成质量；但时间性与年龄相关语义仍是后续改进方向。

title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
summary: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

AI.tldr: dKFD：在固定帧预算下，用"阶段结构化"的差异化选择器（事件前/事件/事件后划分预算）替代全局Top-K竞争，在DoTA异常识别上K=12时Frame AUC提升+30.97，并保持识别与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视频理解需在固定帧预算下挑少量视觉证据。主流稀疏选择器采用全局Top-K竞争，但对时间局部化事件，证据常分布于事件前上下文、事件本体与事件后果三段，全局竞争会让各帧过度相互压制，导致事件证据不稳定（即便整体识别与定位分数尚可），因此需要一种符合事件时间结构的预算分配归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出dKFD——阶段结构化可微选择器：先对全序列做时间编码，再在事件前、事件、事件后三个阶段之间预留（划分）证据容量，并施加阶段监督，使预算分配与事件相位对齐；在DoTA视频异常识别与VRU-Accident上做匹配预算、多种子评测，并与Global Top-K对照，附加机制消融与下游VLM诊断。
AI.result: K=12时Global Top-K识别与时序定位有竞争力但选择器-事件对齐差（Frame AUC 51.5±10.8）；dKFD在同预算多种子下Frame AUC提升+30.97（p<0.01），识别小幅但显著提升，定位性能相当。消融：去掉阶段监督后即使保留阶段划分预算，Frame AUC降至41.1±12.0，说明监督是承重项。VRU-Accident上跨VLM家族一致优于可学习Global Top-K；密集描述任务中均匀采样仍具竞争力（边界条件）。
AI.conclusion: 阶段结构化预算分配是一种可控的、面向事件中心的固定预算稀疏证据选择方法，而非通用视频摘要策略；其收益主要来自阶段监督与相位对齐的归纳偏置。

title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
summary: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP），支持类别名、同义词与意图句式查询，输出查询特定掩膜与成对时序语义图；在SECOND上优于RCDNet，并在WHU-CDC上验证跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统变化检测（CD）只输出二值变化区域，语义变化检测（SCD）使用固定类别体系，均难以满足用户特定需求。现有类别提示的指代变化检测（RCD）仅用查询类别指定变化"目标"，只返回二值掩膜，无法回答"什么变成了什么"，也缺乏显式源-目标推理与成对语义图。
AI.method: 提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP）：1）将自然语言请求解析为意图与语义槽位，支持类别名、同义词及承载意图的句子；2）构建双向视觉证据（变化前后两个方向的证据组合）；3）用查询条件化解码器预测两个时相的语义状态，输出查询特定掩膜与成对时序语义图。
AI.result: 在SECOND数据集上，QSCP在同义词查询、句子查询和转移（transition）查询上均优于RCDNet，并在端到端语义预测上超过所评测的语义基线；WHU-CDC实验在无目标域训练条件下评估了跨数据集迁移与等价表达间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: QSCP将RCD从"目标类别定位"扩展为"源-目标转移推理+成对语义制图"，统一支持多种查询形式，具备跨数据集泛化潜力；代码已开源。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段高效VLN方案：先训练带显式可学习查询瓶颈的高性能教师模型（Navigable Query Generator + Instruction-Query Aligner），再将查询瓶颈作为蒸馏接口，用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏出紧凑学生模型，参数量减少93.65%且性能接近教师。
AI.motivation: 大规模VLN模型精度高但参数量与算力开销大，难以部署，需在保持导航性能的前提下大幅压缩模型规模。
AI.method: 第一阶段：教师模型引入少量可学习查询槽，经Navigable Query Generator从全景观测中抽取全局与局部"可导航充分证据"，再由Instruction-Query Aligner逐步将证据token与指令对齐以预测策略。第二阶段：以该显式查询瓶颈为蒸馏接口，用导航感知的token自适应目标迁移教师的全局/局部可导航查询（where to attend），微调阶段再匹配动作分布（what to do），训练紧凑学生模型。
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准上，学生模型导航性能几乎与教师持平，参数量相比教师减少93.65%。
AI.conclusion: 显式查询瓶颈可作为有效且可压缩的蒸馏接口，实现VLN的高效部署，在几乎不损失精度的同时大幅降低参数规模。

title: Octree-based Video Representation
summary: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

AI.tldr: OctVideo 用八叉树对视频时空体做自适应划分，叶子存局部 RGB 与时空梯度并配轻量学习残差，用 Conv1D VAE 将序列化单元映射为规则潜网格并解码时选择性细化。K400 上达 36.12 dB PSNR，38.2M 参数、189.4 GFLOPs/clip，零样本泛化到 DAVIS 2016，编解码最快、FLOPs 最低。
AI.motivation: 视频模型普遍采用均匀网格表示，但视觉复杂度在空间与时间上差异巨大，均匀采样在平滑区域浪费算力、在细节区域又可能不足。作者希望利用视频信号固有冗余，用稀疏自适应结构替代均匀网格以提升表示与计算效率。
AI.method: 1) 用八叉树递归将视频时空体划分为 8 个子体，平滑区域保持粗粒度、细节区域细分；2) 每个叶节点存储局部 RGB 值和时空梯度，并附加轻量学习残差；3) 重建阶段用 Conv1D VAE 把序列化叶单元映射到规则潜变量网格，解码时选择性细化细节。
AI.result: 在 Kinetics-400 上以 38.2M 参数、189.4 GFLOPs/clip 达到 36.12 dB PSNR；零样本泛化到高分辨率 DAVIS 2016，重建质量与最优对比模型相当；在两个数据集上相比受评模型 FLOPs 最低、编码解码最快；从零训练时以少量输入 token 取得有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用视频信号已有冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo 为视频提供了一种高效的自适应表示，兼顾重建质量、计算效率与视频理解能力。

title: Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models
summary: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"朝向落地（orientation grounding）"任务：给定语言或框查询，预测物体的6D朝向与轴向对称性，支持单/多视图场景；构建ReferOri数据集（331K多视图+387K单视图查询），并提出OG-VLM模型（结构化框/朝向输出、符号与对称token、几何感知辅助损失）。
AI.motivation: 现有空间视觉语言模型的指代落地工作只关注"物体在哪里"，但许多3D任务还需要知道物体"如何朝向"；现有3D VLM虽可预测有向框，但框的姿态无法显式表达以物体为中心的朝向及对称性带来的歧义。
AI.method: 构建ReferOri数据集，通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证获得33.1万多视图、38.7万单视图朝向落地查询；提出OG-VLM，将3D VLM适配为结构化框/朝向输出，引入符号与对称token及几何感知辅助损失。
AI.result: 在单视图与多视图基准上，OG-VLM显著优于具备朝向感知能力的VLM基线，并在场景级指代基准上超越物体级朝向基础模型；下游结果表明其有助于与朝向相关的空间推理。
AI.conclusion: 显式朝向落地是超越定位的一项独立且可学习的能力，对朝向相关空间推理有实际收益。

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
