Experiments across diverse concepts and multiple erasure methods demonstrate consistent concept reactivation across both architectures, highlighting the cross-architecture applicability of CSR and the persistent recoverability of apparently erased concepts. For strict nudity, CSR reaches average ASRs of 50.47\% on FLUX and 40.29\% on Stable Diffusion, consistently ranking first across all evaluated safety settings.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的概念分数重学习(CSR)框架，在噪声预测U-Net与流匹配Transformer两类范式上实现被擦除概念的参数级重新激活。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除的鲁棒性评估多依赖针对特定架构定制的重学习攻击，无法跨生成范式比较，且通常需要目标概念图像数据集。
AI.method: CSR在模型原生预测空间内优化概念导向目标，无需外部目标概念图像数据，同一目标同时适用于Stable Diffusion(U-Net)与FLUX(Transformer)。
AI.result: 在多种概念与多种擦除方法上均观察到跨架构一致的概念再激活；严格裸露概念下ASR平均达FLUX 50.47%、SD 40.29%，在所有评估安全设置中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 被擦除概念具有持续可恢复性，CSR揭示了现有概念擦除方法的跨架构脆弱性，说明擦除鲁棒性评估需统一基准。

title: A Visual Classification Dataset and Model Evaluation for Historical Manuscript Illustrations
summary: Historical manuscript illustrations preserve rich visual evidence of past cultures. They depict people, animals, plants, diagrams, music notations, and decorative forms. Although large digitization projects have made many manuscripts available online, the material itself remains difficult to explore at scale. Extraction systems can find illustrations on manuscript pages, but without meaningful categories, large collections remain hard to search and explore. We address this gap by introducing a manually labeled dataset of 15,000 illustrations from manuscripts dating back hundreds of years across 22 categories, and evaluating modern vision models for image classification on this task. The problem is challenging due to stylistic diversity, degradation, and semantic ambiguity, with many images that fit more than one category. We compare fine-tuned CNN and Transformer-based classifiers, zero-shot CLIP, embedding-based classifiers, and direct vision-language models. Results show that fine-tuned image classifiers perform best overall, with ConvNeXt reaching 88.9% accuracy and 81.3% macro-F1. Using CLIP embeddings with XGBoost provides a strong alternative. In contrast, zero-shot CLIP and direct vision-language classification perform substantially worse, highlighting the limits of general-purpose models in this domain. Beyond overall performance, the analysis reveals which categories are visually separable and where errors reflect genuine semantic overlap, suggesting that some limitations arise from the taxonomy itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了包含22类、15000幅历史手稿插图的人工标注数据集，系统性评测了微调CNN/Transformer、零样本CLIP、嵌入分类器及视觉语言模型，发现微调图像分类器（ConvNeXt达88.9%准确率、81.3% macro-F1）最优，CLIP嵌入+XGBoost为强替代方案，零样本与直接VLM分类明显较差。
AI.motivation: 大规模手稿数字化使图像可在线获取，但缺乏有意义的类别标注，导致海量藏品难以按类检索与探索；已有插图抽取系统只能定位图像，无法赋予语义类别，因此需要带类别标注的数据集并检验现代视觉模型在该细粒度、风格多样的历史图像分类任务上的能力边界。
AI.method: 人工标注来自数百年历史手稿的15000幅插图，划分22个类别；对比微调CNN与Transformer分类器、零样本CLIP、基于CLIP嵌入的传统分类器（XGBoost）以及直接调用视觉语言模型进行分类，并以准确率与macro-F1评估；进一步分析各类别的视觉可分性及错误是否源于语义重叠。
AI.result: 微调图像分类器整体最佳，ConvNeXt取得88.9%准确率与81.3% macro-F1；CLIP嵌入结合XGBoost为较强的替代方案；零样本CLIP与直接视觉语言模型分类显著更差。分析揭示了哪些类别视觉上可分离，以及错误在多大程度上反映真实的语义重叠，部分局限源自分类体系本身。
AI.conclusion: 在历史手稿插图分类这一风格多样、退化严重且语义模糊的领域，针对性微调的视觉分类器显著优于通用零样本与视觉语言模型，说明通用模型的领域迁移能力有限；分类错误部分由标注体系的内在语义重叠造成，提示未来需改进分类法与表示学习。

title: Native Association: Confidence-Aware Human Perception in the Wild with a Foundation VLM
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Human-Centered Multimodal Intelligence in the Wild (HCMIW). 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Extracting who is where, on which team, wearing which number from a broadcast frame is typically done by stitching a detector, an OCR engine, and classifiers together -- and the stitching step swaps identities under occlusion. We make association native instead: a 0.77B vision-language model (Florence-2) is fine-tuned to emit all per-person attributes as one grammar-constrained sequence, with each attribute generated inside its owner's block. Output is therefore schema-valid on every frame by construction, and no post-hoc binding step exists to attach a correctly read number to the wrong player: residual misassociation is pure perception error, $\approx4\times$ rarer than zero-shot-prompted frontier APIs' (0.057 vs. 0.21-0.24). On a frozen multi-sport test set, this single pass reaches 0.95 detection F1 (APIs: 0.65-0.75). A single extra forward pass yields a per-field confidence that supports a reject option (jersey precision $0.71\rightarrow0.96$ at half coverage) and routes a training-free zoom-and-re-read for small players. Surprisingly, once the grammar is learned, further parameter-efficient tuning yields no measurable gain under the adaptation configurations we test; the identical recipe on WIDER-Attribute reaches 93.1 mAP given-box, yields the first detection-coupled end-to-end results under its standard test protocol (84.5 mAP), and reproduces the same tuning result. In this regime, the gains live in the structure, not in added weights.

AI.tldr: 用单个 0.77B 视觉语言模型（Florence-2）微调，将"谁在场、属于哪队、穿几号"等多人属性一次性生成为受语法约束的序列，使身份-属性关联内生于生成过程，从而消除传统检测+OCR+分类器拼接时的错绑问题。
AI.motivation: 传统体育转播帧解析依赖检测器、OCR 引擎与分类器的后处理拼接，遮挡下拼接步骤会交换身份，导致号码被正确地读出却挂到错误球员身上。作者希望把关联变成模型的原生能力，而非事后绑定。
AI.method: 微调 0.77B 的 Florence-2 视觉语言模型，让每个球员的属性在其所属块内按语法约束序列生成，输出在构造上即满足 schema；另加一次前向得到逐字段置信度，支持拒识选项（可做训练无关的缩放重读以处理小目标球员）。
AI.result: 残差错绑率 0.057，约为零样本前沿 API（0.21–0.24）的 1/4；冻结多体育测试集上单次推理检测 F1 0.95（API 0.65–0.75）；拒识使球衣号精度 0.71→0.96（覆盖一半）。WIDER-Attribute 上达 93.1 mAP（given-box），并在其标准协议下给出首个检测耦合的端到端结果（84.5 mAP）。
AI.conclusion: 一旦语法结构被学会，继续做参数高效微调在测试的适配配置下没有可测增益；增益来自结构本身而非新增权重，同一配方可迁移到其他属性识别任务。

title: SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera
summary: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.

AI.tldr: SphMind：无需训练、即插即用的MLLM全向空间推理框架，通过球谐空间图（SHSG）与推理时几何锚定（IGG）将语义感知与几何推理解耦，在多项基准上显著提升方向推理与旋转不变性。
AI.motivation: 360度全景相机赋予具身智能体全局宽视场感知，使多模态大模型（MLLM）具备全向空间推理能力成为可能。但现有MLLM多基于传统2D透视图像训练，难以应对球面几何带来的严重畸变与环绕不连续性，且在不重训练的前提下泛化到非欧几里得3D空间十分困难。
AI.method: 提出SphMind训练免费、即插即用框架，将语义感知与几何推理解耦：不在MLLM内部学习球面几何，而是外部处理几何。核心包含球谐空间图（SHSG），通过球面上的等变变换建模空间关系；以及推理时几何锚定（IGG），一种模型无关的闭环优化过程，在推理阶段将MLLM表征与球面几何约束对齐。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，SphMind在MP3D与Stanford2D-3D的方向推理平均提升超21.4%；在真实世界ODI-Bench上比提示工程基线高8.7%；在全景旋转下旋转不变性提升5.9%，且无需额外训练或数据集特定调参。野外评估显示其可解决基线视觉语言模型无法正确回答的方向推理问题。
AI.conclusion: SphMind证明可通过外部几何约束与推理时优化，使现成MLLM无需重训练即获得全向/球面空间推理能力，为具身智能体的全景空间理解提供了通用、可插拔的方案。

title: Printability-Constrained Adversarial Decals for Near-Nadir Aerial Perception: Measured Ink Gamuts, Nested Realism Constraints, and a Physical-World Bound
summary: Adversarial patches for aerial perception are typically evaluated as digital composites, with printing left as an implementation detail. This study imposes three physical constraints during optimization rather than after it: the color range a particular printer can reproduce, the size of the flat panel a vehicle offers, and the loss of fine detail incurred when the patch is imaged from altitude. The principal comparison isolates the ink set. Two patches share all seventeen recorded optimization settings and differ only in the colors available to them. One is constrained to a uniform color cube; the other to a gamut measured by printing and scanning a 216-patch chart. Each was optimized at three seeds and evaluated against thirteen victim conditions, with every rate reported against a size-matched optimized control. The effect of the measured gamut is victim-dependent rather than uniform. Net attack success rises on three of six closed-set segmentation victims, and for these the seed ranges of the two ink sets are disjoint: $+0.120$ on DeepLabv3-R101 and $+0.041$ on SegFormer-B0. The color-cube patch is consistently stronger on the open-vocabulary segmenter and on two of four detectors, though no detector exceeds a net of $+0.026$ under either ink set. The natural explanation is that a printable palette is simply less chromatic and lower in frequency than a digital one. Eleven further patches test this account and it does not hold. Once cardinality is matched, a palette as chromatic as the cube attacks equally well. Cardinality itself shows no trend from three inks to thirty-two. Palettes matched on cardinality, lightness and chroma, and differing only in hue placement, span $0.035$ to $0.136$. A physical evaluation with printed decals did not detect transfer; it bounds the transferred rate at $0.133$, which does not exclude the simulated value of $0.121$.

AI.tldr: 在对抗贴片优化中直接嵌入打印机色域、面板尺寸和航拍细节损失三项物理约束，通过"仅更换墨水集合"的对照实验发现：实测色域带来的攻击收益依受害者模型而异（DeepLabv3-R101 +0.120），而"可打印调色板色度低、频率低"的常见解释被后续11组贴片实验证伪，真正起作用的是基数匹配与色相排布，物理打印贴片未检出迁移但上界0.133 不排除仿真值0.121。
AI.motivation: 空中感知的对抗贴片多以数字合成方式评估，打印仅被视为实现细节，导致数字域结论与真实物理部署之间存在鸿沟。作者希望把打印机的可复现色域、车辆可承载平板尺寸、以及从高空成像时的细节丢失这三项物理约束前置到优化过程中，从而回答一个具体问题：墨水的可打印色域本身是否决定了对抗贴片的攻击效果。
AI.method: 在优化阶段而非事后引入三项物理约束（打印机色域、平板尺寸、航拍细节损失）。核心对照严格隔离墨水集合：两块贴片共享全部十七项优化设置，唯一差异是可用颜色——一块限制在均匀色立方，另一块限制在通过打印并扫描216色卡实测得到的色域。每种墨水在3个随机种子下优化，对13种受害者条件评估，所有攻击率均以尺寸匹配的优化控制为基线报告。进一步用11块附加贴片检验"可打印调色板色度更低、频率更低"的解释，控制基数、明度、色度、色相排布等变量，并开展打印贴花的物理评估估计迁移率上界。
AI.result: 实测色域的影响依受害者而异而非一致提升：在六个闭集分割受害者中有三个净攻击成功率上升，且这些情况下两种墨水的种子区间互不重叠，DeepLabv3-R101 上 +0.120、SegFormer-B0 上 +0.041。色立方贴片在开放词表分割器和四个检测器中的两个上稳定更强，不过任一墨水集合下检测器净收益均不超过 +0.026。对"色度/频率更低"这一自然解释的11块贴片测试不支持该说法：基数匹配后，与色立方同样高色度的调色板攻击效果相当；基数从3种墨到32种墨无单调趋势；在基数、明度和色度上匹配、仅色相位置不同的调色板跨度达0.035至0.136。物理打印贴花评估未检出迁移，将迁移率上界界定为0.133，尚不能排除仿真的0.121。
AI.conclusion: 对抗贴片的物理可实现性不能简化为"数字色域更丰富所以更强"；实测色域带来的收益是受害者依赖的，且在基数、明度、色度受控后，色相排布才是主要变量。物理打印实验中未观察到迁移，但置信上界与仿真值重叠，说明结论仍受样本量限制，需更大规模物理评估方可定论。

title: SceneScaffold: Active Scene-State Construction for Unified 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Recent 3D large multimodal models (3D-LMMs) rely on a visual bottleneck to compress complex 3D scene evidence into a limited number of visual tokens compatible with large language models (LLMs). Current visual bottlenecks, however, often passively compress heterogeneous 3D evidence into a homogeneous object-centric token sequence, leaving the spatial organization of the scene under-represented. This under-representation forces the LLM to recover spatial relations from a flattened token sequence, leading to unstable reasoning in relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous scenes. To address this issue, we propose SceneScaffold, an active scene-state construction framework for unified 3D scene understanding. SceneScaffold reformulates the visual bottleneck from a passive feature compressor into an active scene organizer, constructing a role-aware spatial scaffold before language reasoning. Specifically, SceneScaffold organizes superpoint-level visual evidence into scene-state components with distinct structural roles: entity states preserve core object semantics, scene-frame states maintain spatial references via boundary and region anchors, relation states encode object-environment interaction cues, and a global summary provides compact context. Through this role-aware construction, SceneScaffold provides the LLM with a spatially organized scene representation before language reasoning. Experiments on unified 3D scene understanding tasks, including 3D visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning, demonstrate the effectiveness of SceneScaffold, while diagnostic results further show its applicability to relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous cases. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SceneScaffold 将 3D-LMM 的视觉瓶颈从被动压缩器改造为主动场景组织器，通过角色感知的空间脚手架（实体/场景框架/关系/全局摘要四类状态）为 LLM 提供结构化 3D 场景表示，提升统一 3D 场景理解任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D-LMM 的视觉瓶颈被动地将异构 3D 证据压缩为同质的目标中心 token 序列，场景空间组织信息严重缺失，迫使 LLM 从扁平 token 中恢复空间关系，在关系密集与空间歧义场景中推理不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 SceneScaffold 主动场景状态构建框架：将超点级视觉证据组织为具有不同结构角色的场景状态组件——实体状态保留核心目标语义，场景框架状态通过边界与区域锚点维持空间参照，关系状态编码目标-环境交互线索，全局摘要提供紧凑上下文；在语言推理前构造角色感知的空间脚手架。
AI.result: 在 3D 视觉定位、3D 问答、密集描述等统一 3D 场景理解任务上验证了有效性；诊断实验进一步表明其在关系密集与空间歧义案例中具有适用性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉瓶颈重新定义为主动场景组织器、以角色感知结构强化空间组织，是提升 3D-LMM 空间推理稳定性的有效方向。

title: Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical MIL for Weakly-Supervised Thoracic Disease Detection in Chest X-rays
summary: Weakly-supervised thoracic disease detection in chest X-rays (CXR) is challenging due to subtle appearances and complex anatomical overlap, motivating anatomy-aware modeling for improved localization. However, prior anatomy-aware methods typically rely on coarse region proxies or static spatial priors, which may restrict dynamic instance discovery and limit precise localization of small abnormalities. We propose Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning (ASH-MIL), a framework that introduces parallel anatomy-structured observation branches (cardiac, pulmonary, and agnostic) combined with hierarchical MIL aggregation. Anatomical priors are injected as soft spatial biases into decoder cross-attention, enabling anatomically grounded evidence maps without disease bounding-box supervision. Instance localization is derived directly from MIL-weighted cross-attention maps without bounding box supervision. Experiments on CXR8 and cross-domain MIMIC-CXR held-out sets demonstrate consistent improvements over prior weakly-supervised and anatomy-aware approaches, particularly under stricter localization criteria. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ASH-MIL：将解剖结构先验以软空间偏置注入解码器交叉注意力，结合分层MIL聚合，在无框监督下实现胸部X光多病种检测与病灶定位。
AI.motivation: CXR弱监督胸病检测存在病灶外观细微、解剖结构重叠等难点，需要解剖感知建模提升定位。但现有解剖感知方法多依赖粗区域代理或静态空间先验，限制了动态实例发现，尤其对小结节病灶定位精度不足。
AI.method: 提出解剖结构化分层多示例学习（ASH-MIL）：并行设置心脏、肺、非特定（agnostic）三类解剖结构观察分支，结合分层MIL聚合；把解剖先验作为软空间偏置注入解码器交叉注意力，从而在无检测框监督下生成解剖锚定的证据图；实例定位直接由MIL加权的交叉注意力图导出。
AI.result: 在CXR8与跨域MIMIC-CXR留出集上，相比已有弱监督与解剖感知方法取得一致提升，在更严格的定位评价指标下增益更明显，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 用软空间偏置替代硬区域先验、以分层MIL组织多解剖分支，是在无框监督下兼顾分类与精细定位的有效途径，且具备跨域泛化表现。

title: In-Token Learning for High-Fidelity Image Restoration via Diffusion Transformers
comment: Technical report, 25 pages, 12 figures. Preserves the earlier broader study underlying Fill2SR (ECCV 2026), including automatic colorization; Fill2SR subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction
summary: We present In-Token Learning, an image restoration framework that adapts a pretrained diffusion transformer using conditional rectified flow matching. Clean targets paired with degraded inputs supervise transport from Gaussian noise to restored images. Spatially aligned degraded-image tokens are fused with evolving latent tokens along the channel dimension, preserving the image-token count at a given resolution. Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) combines frozen degraded-image embeddings with a fixed task prompt through the native conditioning pathway, without a trainable ControlNet-style branch or image captioning. We evaluate super-resolution and denoising on DIV2K, LSDIR, FFHQ, RealLQ250, and RealPhoto60, and automatic colorization on DIV2K and LSDIR. The tasks use separately trained checkpoints under the same framework. Results show competitive fidelity and perceptual quality under the evaluated protocols, with weaker generalization on RealLQ250. We report full-image QHD ($2560{\times}1440$) inference and a tiled $12$K restoration demonstration of Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Attention cost still increases with resolution. This technical report preserves the early broader study underlying Fill2SR, which subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction.

AI.tldr: 提出 In-Token Learning 图像复原框架：用条件整流流匹配微调预训练扩散 Transformer，将退化图像 token 沿通道维与潜变量融合，并以 Direct Low-Quality Guidance 替代可训练 ControlNet 分支，实现超分、去噪与上色。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练扩散模型的图像复原多依赖 ControlNet 式可训练旁支或图像描述生成，参数量与流程复杂；作者希望在保持 token 数量不随分辨率变化的前提下，复用冻结的退化图像嵌入，简化条件注入路径并支持高分辨率推理。
AI.method: 条件整流流匹配（conditional rectified flow matching）：干净目标与退化输入配对，监督从高斯噪声到复原图像的传输。空间对齐的退化图像 token 与演化中的潜变量 token 沿通道维融合，不增加给定分辨率下的 token 数。Direct Low-Quality Guidance（DLG）通过原生条件通路将冻结的退化图像嵌入与固定任务提示结合，无需可训练 ControlNet 分支或图像描述。各任务（超分、去噪、上色）在相同框架下分别训练检查点。
AI.result: 在 DIV2K、LSDIR、FFHQ、RealLQ250、RealPhoto60 上评估超分与去噪，在 DIV2K、LSDIR 上评估自动上色，保真度与感知质量在评测协议下具竞争力，但 RealLQ250 上泛化较弱。实现整图 QHD（2560×1440）推理，并给出《清明上河图》12K 分块复原演示；注意力开销仍随分辨率增长。
AI.conclusion: 该技术报告保留 Fill2SR 早期更广泛研究的基础，后者随后发展为真实世界超分方向；框架在统一条件下可覆盖多复原任务并有高分辨率推理能力，但跨域泛化与高分辨率效率仍是瓶颈。

title: PGL-3D: Towards Progressive Geometric Learning for 3D Visual Query Localization
comment: Code and models will be released
summary: 3D Visual Query Localization (3DVQL) retrieves the latest contiguous occurrence of a queried object in an RGB--point-cloud sequence and predicts a 9-DoF cuboid for every response frame. The query is captured independently of the search sequence, so its annotated pose may differ from how the object appears in the search frames. The benchmark baseline predicts cuboids after feature modeling, leaving their geometry unused for subsequent feature refinement. We investigate whether complete intermediate cuboids can improve query and proposal representations before final decoding. We introduce Progressive Geometric Learning for 3DVQL (PGL-3D), a predict--select--refine--re-predict framework that uses intermediate cuboids to guide the aggregation of search evidence and update query and proposal representations. A shared head first predicts a complete cuboid for every proposal. Query--Tube--Memory (QTM) then selects reference observations by combining proposal association, cuboid quality, frame response, and target absence, since association confidence alone establishes neither target presence nor geometric accuracy. The center, size, and orientation of each selected cuboid define soft pooling weights over query-conditioned proposal features. The pooled memory updates the query and proposal representations, and the head re-predicts from the updated features. A training-only objective, ST-D9O, supervises cuboid geometry at every stage by adding boundary, signed-distance, and soft-overlap terms to parameter regression. PGL-3D achieves a mean stAP of $0.270 \pm 0.004$ on 3DVQL, compared with $0.044$ reported for LaF. Ablations support the benefits of geometry-guided feature updates, while stage-wise analyses show improved cuboid accuracy. Replacing the geometry objective in our PROT3D reproduction with ST-D9O improves mAO on GSOT3D from $21.63\%$ to $25.78\%$. Our code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PGL-3D，一种用于 3D 视觉查询定位（3DVQL）的"预测—选择—精修—重预测"框架，利用中间 3D 长方体（cuboid）几何信息反向引导 query 与 proposal 特征聚合，并配合 ST-D9O 几何监督目标，将 3DVQL 平均 stAP 从基线 LaF 的 0.044 提升至 0.270。
AI.motivation: 3DVQL 任务要求在被查询物体独立采集（其标注位姿与检索序列中呈现方式不一致）的设定下，在 RGB-点云序列中检索最近一次连续出现并逐帧预测 9-DoF 长方体。现有基线仅在特征建模后才预测长方体，中间几何结果未被用于后续特征精修，浪费了可用的几何先验，导致定位与位姿精度受限。
AI.method: 提出 PGL-3D 预测—选择—精修—重预测框架：共享头先为每个 proposal 预测完整长方体；Query–Tube–Memory（QTM）结合 proposal 关联度、长方体质量、帧响应与目标缺失来选取参考观测（因仅靠关联置信度无法判定目标存在性与几何准确性）；被选长方体的中心、尺寸、朝向定义对 query 条件化 proposal 特征的软池化权重，池化所得 memory 更新 query 与 proposal 表示，再由头重预测。训练期引入 ST-D9O 目标，在各阶段以边界、有符号距离与软重叠项联合参数回归监督长方体几何。
AI.result: 在 3DVQL 上达到平均 stAP 0.270±0.004，而 LaF 报告仅 0.044；消融实验支持几何引导特征更新的收益，分阶段分析显示长方体精度提升；将 PROT3D 复现中的几何目标替换为 ST-D9O 后，在 GSOT3D 上 mAO 由 21.63% 提升至 25.78%。代码与模型将开源。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用中间长方体几何来引导 3D 查询定位的特征表示是有效的，几何感知的特征精修与分阶段几何监督（ST-D9O）可显著提升 3DVQL 的定位与位姿精度，并具备向相关 3D 定位基准（GSOT3D）迁移的泛化性。

title: ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: ForeFly提出双时域潜在世界动作模型，为无人机视觉语言导航同时预测近端与航线关键远端未来，并用以非对称指导动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有航空视觉语言导航（AVLN）方法多为反应式或仅做单时域预测，忽略了不同时间尺度上互补的未来线索，导致长轨迹复杂3D环境中的指令跟随不够可靠。
AI.method: 提出ForeFly双时域潜在世界动作模型：分别预测近端未来以保证局部连续性、预测自适应航线关键未来以提供长程引导；用近期与航线关键视觉记忆初始化各时域的前瞻查询，形成历史感知上下文；并引入Foresight-Guided Action Refinement（FGAR），非对称地利用近端前瞻增强局部动作、利用航线关键前瞻做特征级校正与航线级引导。
AI.result: 在TravelUAV与UAV-ON基准上，ForeFly在seen与unseen设置下均持续优于强基线，验证了双时域前瞻与FGAR学习的有效性，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 双时域前瞻建模与FGAR动作细化可有效提升无人机视觉语言导航的长程指令跟随性能，为世界模型驱动的具身导航提供可行范式。

title: Fill2SR: Repurposing Inpainting Diffusion Transformers for Real-World Super-Resolution
comment: ECCV 2026. 26 pages, 12 figures, including an 8-page appendix with additional visual results
summary: Recent real-world image super-resolution (SR) methods often adapt text-to-image (T2I) backbones with ControlNet-style branches or spatial conditioning tokens, which increases memory and computes with resolution and often constrains training to a fixed scale. We propose Fill2SR, which repurposes a masked-inpainting Diffusion Transformer for SR without extra spatial branches. Our Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) writes the low-quality (LQ) observation into the native masked-image slot under a full-image mask, turning inpainting into a reverse-degradation conditional rectified flow trained with LoRA-only tuning. We further introduce RCDT, an offline pipeline that distills degradation descriptors from unpaired real images and transfers them onto clean targets using frozen open-source models. Fill2SR supports mixed-resolution training up to QHD and yields stable performance across $512/1024/2048$ outputs. On synthetic benchmarks, our base model with IIEA achieves the best LPIPS on DIV2K and LSDIR; adding RCDT trades a small LPIPS drop for consistently stronger no-reference quality on RealLQ250 and RealPhoto60. Fill2SR remains memory-predictable, running $1536^2$ inference on a single 32GB GPU and extending to multi-megapixel outputs via tiled restoration.

AI.tldr: Fill2SR将掩码修复DiT改造为超分模型：用Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter把低质图像写入原生mask槽位，在LoRA微调下把修复任务转化为反向退化的条件整流流，配合RCDT离线退化描述符蒸馏，实现混合分辨率训练与单卡QHD推理。
AI.motivation: 现有真实场景超分方法多依赖ControlNet式分支或空间条件token改造T2I骨干，导致显存与计算随分辨率增长，且训练被固定在单一尺度，难以扩展到高分辨率与混合分辨率场景。
AI.method: 复用掩码修复型Diffusion Transformer，无需额外空间分支。IIEA将LQ观测写入全图掩码下的原生masked-image槽位，把修复任务重构为反向退化条件整流流，仅用LoRA微调；RCDT为离线流水线，利用冻结开源模型从无配对真实图像中蒸馏退化描述符并迁移到干净目标上，从而免配对数据训练。支持最高QHD的混合分辨率训练。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，配IIEA的基础模型在DIV2K、LSDIR取得最优LPIPS；加入RCDT后LPIPS略降，但在RealLQ250与RealPhoto60上无参考质量稳定提升。显存可预测，单张32GB GPU可完成1536²推理，并通过分块修复扩展到多百万像素输出。
AI.conclusion: 该方法说明掩码修复接口可作为超分的通用条件通道，避免额外空间分支，兼顾混合分辨率训练、显存可控与高分辨率可扩展性；退化描述符蒸馏在无配对真实数据上以少量感知指标代价换取更好的真实感质量。

title: IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Content (AIGC) necessitates robust and interpretable detection mechanisms. However, existing detectors are predominantly confined to single modalities and provide binary outputs without reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) present a promising solution, their development is constrained by the scarcity of multimodal reasoning data and the reasoning-detection optimization dilemma, where explicit reasoning supervision can compromise detection accuracy. To this end, we introduce IVT-Set, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 152K diverse image, video, and text samples equipped with multi-granularity Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Based on it, we propose IVT-Guard, a pioneering framework for unified and interpretable AIGC detection across image, video, and text modalities. Furthermore, to overcome the aforementioned optimization dilemma, we design a novel three-stage training paradigm: Artifact-Aware Pre-training, Artifact-to-Evidence Supervised Fine-Tuning via artifact-aware injection, and Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IVT-Guard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-dataset settings while delivering faithful reasoning. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 IVT-Set 数据集与 IVT-Guard 框架，统一实现图像、视频、文本多模态 AIGC 检测与可解释推理，并通过三阶段训练缓解推理-检测优化冲突，取得 SOTA 检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 AIGC 检测器多局限于单一模态，且仅输出二元判别而无推理依据；MLLM 虽具潜力，但受限于多模态推理数据稀缺，以及"显式推理监督会削弱检测精度"的推理-检测优化困境。
AI.method: 构建 IVT-Set（超 152K 图像/视频/文本样本，含多粒度 CoT 推理轨迹）；提出 IVT-Guard 统一可解释检测框架；设计三阶段训练范式：伪影感知预训练（Artifact-Aware Pre-training）、基于伪影感知注入的伪影到证据监督微调（Artifact-to-Evidence SFT）、证据-判决一致性 GRPO。
AI.result: 在域内、域外及跨数据集设置下均达到 SOTA 检测性能，同时输出忠实的推理过程。代码与数据将开源。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态 AIGC 检测与可解释推理可通过多粒度 CoT 数据与分阶段对齐训练协同实现，三阶段范式有效缓解推理与检测间的优化冲突。

title: LoopLUT: 3D Lookup Tables with Progressive Region Refinement for Real-Time 4K Image Enhancement
summary: Color enhancement of 4K images must meet a quality target under a tight compute budget. Three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) dominate real-time enhancement because they decide at low resolution and apply a per-pixel lookup at full resolution. A single global LUT, however, is spatially invariant, so an underexposed shadow and a well-exposed region that share a pixel value receive identical corrections. Spatially heterogeneous demands cannot be expressed by such a mapping. We propose LoopLUT, a region-cascaded 3D LUT with progressive refinement. A global LUT performs the overall correction, followed by K-1 loop iterations. In each iteration a gating head predicts at low resolution the region that still needs correction, then builds a residual LUT from the color statistics of that region alone. The cascaded gates form a partition of unity, so the output is a per-pixel convex combination of the K lookup results. Fusion is therefore performed by the gates themselves, with no separate fusion module and no interpolation error accumulating across rounds. The decision stage runs at a fixed 256x256 resolution, independent of output resolution, so a 4K image costs only K pure lookups. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks show that LoopLUT improves PSNR by up to 2.81 dB over the strongest prior method, while keeping real-time throughput at 4K. The same decomposition also generalizes well to underwater enhancement datasets.

AI.tldr: LoopLUT 提出区域级联 3D LUT 结构，用全局 LUT 加 K-1 次残差迭代，通过低分辨率门控头定位待校正区域并生成残差 LUT，实现 4K 实时高质量色彩增强。
AI.motivation: 单一全局 3D LUT 是空间不变的，对相同像素值的欠曝阴影区和正常曝光区施加相同校正，无法表达空间异质性需求；同时 4K 增强需在严格算力预算下达到质量目标。因此需要一种既保持逐像素查表的高效性、又能实现区域自适应校正的方法。
AI.method: 提出 LoopLUT：全局 LUT 先做整体校正，随后进行 K-1 轮循环迭代。每轮由门控头在低分辨率预测仍需校正的区域，并基于该区域的颜色统计构建残差 LUT。级联门控构成单位分解（partition of unity），输出为 K 个查表结果的逐像素凸组合，融合由门控自身完成，无需额外融合模块，也不会跨轮累积插值误差。决策阶段固定在 256x256 分辨率，与输出分辨率无关，4K 图像仅需 K 次纯查表。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，LoopLUT 相比最强前置方法 PSNR 最高提升 2.81 dB，同时在 4K 下保持实时吞吐；该分解方式也能良好泛化到水下增强数据集。
AI.conclusion: 区域级联加渐进细化的 3D LUT 在保持实时性的同时显著提升色彩增强质量，且具有跨域泛化能力。

title: ViCoR: Reliable Molecular Structure Extraction via Spatially Aligned Verification and Executable Revision
summary: Reliable optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) is essential for building high-quality chemical data from scientific literature, yet even small recognition errors can propagate into chemical databases and downstream models. In practice, recognized structures often require manual inspection and correction before use, making large-scale data curation costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study Selective Structure Recognition (SSR), a post-recognition setting that automatically produces reliable structured outputs while rejecting unresolved cases. Selection-only approaches can improve reliability by rejection, but cannot create additional correct outputs beyond those produced by the base recognizer. We propose ViCoR, a repair-before-rejection framework for iterative VerIfiCatiOn and Revision. Its key idea is to make observation-prediction correspondence explicit: coordinate-preserving rendering establishes spatial correspondence between the source image and predicted structure, while index anchoring maps localized visual discrepancies to executable graph edits without full-structure regeneration. A shared VLM is progressively trained from verification to revision. On two real-world OCSR benchmarks, ViCoR improves overall accuracy from 73.53\% to 88.26\% and from 61.83\% to 84.32\%, while achieving over 97\% accepted accuracy at 85--89\% coverage. The resulting molecular data further improve reaction-extraction F1 by 15.5 points and literature-sourced reaction prediction accuracy by 7.7 and 5.8 points, demonstrating the value of automated reliability control for scientific data curation and downstream chemical learning.

AI.tldr: ViCoR: 先修复后拒绝的迭代验证-修订框架用于选择性光学化学结构识别，显著提升准确率并改善下游化学任务。
AI.motivation: OCSR 识别错误会污染化学数据库并影响下游模型，实际中需人工校验修正，大规模数据治理成本高。已有的"仅选择"策略虽可通过拒绝提升可靠性，但无法产生新的正确输出，因此需要能在拒绝前先修复错误的框架。
AI.method: 提出 Selective Structure Recognition (SSR) 任务设定，并给出 ViCoR 框架：显式建立观测-预测对应关系——用保坐标渲染在源图像与预测结构间建立空间对齐，用索引锚定把局部视觉差异映射为可执行的图编辑（局部修改而非整图重生成）；共享同一 VLM 从验证任务渐进训练到修订任务，形成迭代验证-修订循环。
AI.result: 在两个真实 OCSR 基准上整体准确率从 73.53%→88.26%、61.83%→84.32%；在 85–89% 覆盖率下接受样本准确率超过 97%。所得分子数据使反应抽取 F1 提升 15.5 点，文献来源反应预测准确率提升 7.7 与 5.8 点。
AI.conclusion: "先修复后拒绝"的自动化可靠性控制对科学数据治理和下游化学学习具有实际价值，验证了局部图编辑相对整体重生成的优越性。

title: Anguinus Sculpturae: Compositional Synthesis of Peak-Enhancement Breast DCE-MRI Scans
comment: Accepted as an oral at the MAMA-SYNTH 2026 challenge / Deep-BreAth 2026 Workshop, MICCAI 2026. 12 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
summary: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is rich in anatomical and perfusion information, but its reliance on gadolinium-based contrast agents raises safety concerns and adds cost. Virtual contrast enhancement, synthesizing post-contrast from pre-contrast images, is a promising alternative. We address the MAMA-SYNTH challenge task of predicting peak-enhancement breast MRI. Rather than adopting the full machinery of diffusion or flow matching, we observe that under a rectified, straight-line path the generative process collapses to a single difference prediction: the synthetic peak image is the pre-contrast image plus a predicted enhancement map, recovered in one forward pass. Around this we build Anguinus Sculpturae, a compositional pipeline in which nnU-Net segmentations of lesion, foreground and breast region guide two generators - one optimized for global fidelity, one for lesion structure through an asymmetric Tversky term routed via a frozen segmenter - composited region-wise with Gaussian-weighted blending. On the held-out Duke subset of MAMA-MIA our model achieves the best FRD and Dice among all evaluated variants, showing that single-step difference prediction with segmentation guidance suffices to recover both global fidelity and lesion structure. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该工作针对MAMA-SYNTH挑战赛，提出用单步差值预测替代扩散/流匹配全流程，用预对比图像加预测增强图直接合成峰值增强乳腺MRI，并以nnU-Net分割引导双生成器合成，在Duke子集上取得最佳FRD与Dice。
AI.motivation: 乳腺DCE-MRI依赖钆对比剂，存在安全性顾虑与额外成本。虚拟增强（由预对比图合成对比后图像）是有前景的替代方案，但现有扩散或流匹配方法流程复杂、推理开销大。
AI.method: 观察到在整流直线路径下生成过程可退化为单次差值预测：合成峰值图像=预对比图像+预测增强图，一次前向即可恢复。据此构建Anguinus Sculpturae组合式流程：用nnU-Net分割病灶、前景和乳腺区域；两个生成器分别优化全局保真度与病灶结构（通过冻结分割器传递的非对称Tversky损失）；再以高斯加权进行区域级融合。
AI.result: 在MAMA-MIA的留出Duke子集上，模型在所有评估变体中取得最佳FRD和Dice，表明单步差值预测配合分割引导即可同时恢复全局保真度和病灶结构。
AI.conclusion: 单步差值预测加分割引导在虚拟对比增强任务中足够有效，为免对比剂乳腺MRI筛查提供了一种更简洁、推理高效的技术路线。

title: SpatialSpeak: QA-Native Reconstruction with Local and Global Context for Spatial Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can benefit from geometric priors for multi-view spatial reasoning, yet answer-only training does not directly supervise the intermediate geometric estimates and their use in deriving quantitative spatial answers. We hypothesize that spatial chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision becomes more effective when the VLM first jointly learns complementary local geometry and global scene context through multi-view reconstruction. We introduce SpatialSpeak, a two-stage framework that connects QA-native reconstruction pretraining with spatial CoT learning. In Stage I, QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining (QA-RP) combines marked-point 3D queries for fine-grained local geometry with object-center queries for global scene context across views. Both tasks are formulated as text-based question answering, allowing geometric estimation and subsequent reasoning to share the same autoregressive output interface. In Stage II, spatial CoT with Visual Compensation (CoT-VC) trains the model to express question-relevant geometric estimates and use them to derive answers, with reliability assessment and visual compensation supporting answer refinement when needed. On ReVSI, QA-RP increases the gain from CoT-VC from 2.6 to 6.9 points, and ablations show that both local and global reconstruction supervision are beneficial. SpatialSpeak achieves state-of-the-art results on ReVSI, VSI-Bench, and SPAR-Bench, with a ReVSI score of 62.8 that exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 8.7 points.

AI.tldr: SpatialSpeak提出两阶段框架，先以QA形式的问答式重建预训练（QA-RP）联合学习标记点局部几何与物体中心全局场景上下文，再用带视觉补偿的空间思维链（CoT-VC）监督几何估计与答案推导，在ReVSI、VSI-Bench、SPAR-Bench上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型做多视角空间推理时，仅用答案监督（answer-only）无法直接监督中间几何估计及其在推导定量空间答案中的作用，因此需要显式引导模型先获得互补的局部几何与全局场景上下文，再学习空间思维链。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。Stage I：QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining（QA-RP），将标记点3D查询（细粒度局部几何）与物体中心查询（跨视角全局场景上下文）统一建模为文本问答，使几何估计与后续推理共享同一自回归输出接口。Stage II：空间思维链+视觉补偿（CoT-VC），训练模型输出与问题相关的几何估计并据此推导答案，配合可靠性评估与视觉补偿进行答案精化。
AI.result: 在ReVSI上，QA-RP将CoT-VC带来的增益从2.6分提升到6.9分；消融显示局部与全局重建监督均有收益。在ReVSI、VSI-Bench、SPAR-Bench上取得SOTA，ReVSI得分62.8，超过最强对比基线8.7分。
AI.conclusion: 将多视角重建预训练与空间思维链监督以统一问答接口衔接，可显著增强VLM的定量空间推理能力，局部几何与全局上下文监督互补，且框架在多个空间推理基准上一致领先。

title: StoryEngine: A State-Grounded Agentic Framework for Video Storytelling
summary: Despite recent progress in agentic multi-shot video generation, producing coherent and consistent long-form stories remains challenging. Existing agentic pipelines typically rely on textual shot plans or previously generated pixels, yet lack an explicit mechanism for propagating the consequences of story events and maintaining the video world state across shots. As a result, missing visual details may be reconstructed inaccurately, while visual drift may propagate across subsequent shots, undermining both narrative coherence and visual consistency. To address these challenges, we propose StoryEngine, a state-grounded agentic framework for video storytelling. StoryEngine establishes a separation between authoritative semantic plans and unreliable visual observations. Specifically, StoryEngine maintains a structured representation of entity placement and story-relevant states, and propagates event-induced changes to define the intended start and end states of each shot. To visually realize these states, StoryEngine constructs canonical references for recurring entities and environments, and compiles state and visual constraints into executable render plans. Meanwhile, to realize these states correctly, a bounded evaluation-guided repair loop further corrects local state inconsistencies. Together, these mechanisms preserve causal story progression and prevent local visual errors from propagating across shots. To comprehensively evaluate long-form storytelling, we construct a benchmark across diverse scenarios and visual styles, with metrics assessing storytelling quality, narrative coherence, and visual consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that StoryEngine consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation dimensions, validating its effectiveness for coherent and consistent video storytelling.

AI.tldr: 提出 StoryEngine——一种以状态为依据的智能体式长视频叙事框架，通过显式维护实体与故事状态表示、传播事件引发的状态变化并编译渲染计划，配合有界评估-修复循环，实现跨镜头叙事连贯与视觉一致。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic 多镜头视频生成依赖文本分镜或已生成像素，缺少显式机制传播故事事件的后果、维持跨镜头的视频世界状态，导致视觉细节重建失真、视觉漂移在后续镜头中累积，损害叙事连贯性与视觉一致性。
AI.method: 1) 将权威语义规划与不可靠视觉观测分离；2) 维护结构化的实体放置与故事相关状态表示，并传播事件引发的状态变化，定义每个镜头的预期起止状态；3) 为反复出现的实体与环境构建规范参考（canonical references）；4) 将状态与视觉约束编译为可执行的渲染计划；5) 引入有界评估引导的修复循环，修正局部状态不一致。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖多种场景与视觉风格的长视频叙事基准，指标涵盖叙事质量、叙事连贯性与视觉一致性；实验显示 StoryEngine 在所有评测维度上一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 以显式状态为基础、结合规范参考与评估引导修复的智能体框架，可有效抑制局部视觉误差跨镜头传播并保持因果故事推进，为连贯一致的长视频叙事生成提供了可行范式。

title: Learning Multimodal Embeddings with Evidence-Aligned Readout
summary: Multimodal large language models can expose task-relevant evidence through generation, but producing useful evidence does not by itself determine how it enters a retrieval embedding. We study whether the semantic organization of that evidence can also specify where representations are read. To address this question, we introduce EviAlign, which couples Semantic Evidence Generation with Boundary Readout in a shared multimodal large language model. It organizes evidence into five semantic units, reads the contextualized state at each unit boundary, and aggregates these states into a single normalized embedding. Generation and contrastive retrieval objectives jointly train this shared structure. With the same trailing readout, semantic evidence and free-form CoT yield nearly identical retrieval performance, suggesting that evidence organization alone does not explain the full gain. A controlled $2\times3$ study compares consistent and permuted evidence organization across three readout strategies, using training targets with matched evidence spans. With five readout states and the same mean pooling, the advantage of consistent semantic organization grows from 0.65 points at length-based training positions to 2.39 at evidence boundaries, yielding a 1.74-point co-design interaction. Across 12 MMEB retrieval tasks, EviAlign achieves 76.9 average Recall@1 with 500K training pairs while retaining single-vector indexing and scoring.

AI.tldr: EviAlign 将多模态大模型生成的语义证据组织为五个语义单元，在单元边界读取隐状态并池化为检索嵌入；实验表明收益主要来自"语义组织×边界读出"的协同设计（1.74 点交互效应），在 12 个 MMEB 检索任务上达 76.9 平均 Recall@1。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型可通过生成暴露任务相关证据，但"生成有用证据"本身并不等于该证据会以同样方式进入检索嵌入。作者想区分：检索收益究竟来自证据内容本身，还是来自证据的语义结构对表征读取位置的指定作用。
AI.method: 提出 EviAlign，将语义证据生成与边界读出耦合于同一 MLLM：把证据组织为 5 个语义单元，在每个单元边界读取上下文隐状态，归一化聚合为单向量嵌入；生成目标与对比检索目标联合训练该共享结构。设计受控 2×3 实验，对比一致 vs 置换的证据组织 × 三种读出策略，且训练目标证据跨度匹配；另做了尾部读出下"语义证据 vs 自由形式 CoT"的对照。
AI.result: 同尾读出下语义证据与自由 CoT 检索性能几乎一致，说明证据组织本身不足以解释全部增益。2×3 实验：5 个读出状态、同一均值池化时，一致语义组织的优势从按长度训练位置的 0.65 点增至证据边界的 2.39 点，协同交互效应 1.74 点。12 个 MMEB 检索任务平均 Recall@1 为 76.9，仅用 500K 训练对，并保持单向量索引与打分。
AI.conclusion: 检索性能增益主要来自"语义证据组织"与"边界读出"的协同设计，而非证据文本内容本身；该解耦式分析为多模态检索嵌入的结构-读出对齐提供了可验证的设计原则，且保持单向量检索的高效性。

title: When Noise Meets Long-Tail: Feature-Threshold Dual Calibration for Robust Pseudo-Labeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track. Code: this https URL
summary: Pseudo-labeling has become a cornerstone of learning from unlabeled data in semantic segmentation. Yet its effectiveness drops sharply in real-world scenarios where strong imaging noise and long-tailed class distributions occur together. We trace this failure to a vicious cycle of pseudo-label degradation. Imaging noise entangles foreground and background features, lowering prediction confidence across all classes, while long-tailed distributions leave tail classes with far fewer training samples and inherently lower confidence. Under fixed high-threshold filtering, these tail-class predictions are systematically filtered out, so they receive no supervision from unlabeled data and thus features keep degrading in subsequent iterations. Critically, noise and long-tail are not independent obstacles but mutually amplifying ones, and addressing either alone is insufficient. To break this cycle, we propose FTC-Seg, a Feature-Threshold dual-Calibration framework built on a standard teacher-student framework. At the feature level, Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) uses a set of learnable orthogonal prototypes to residually purify pixel-wise features, widening the margin between weak foreground targets and noisy backgrounds. At the threshold level, Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) dynamically adjusts class-specific thresholds based on learning difficulty and prediction-distribution bias, rescuing low-confidence pseudo-labels of tail classes from systematic exclusion. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks spanning three distinct noise modalities show that FTC-Seg achieves strong performance against state-of-the-art methods, with particularly substantial gains on tail classes. Our results establish that jointly calibrating features and thresholds is essential for robust pseudo-labeling under compounded noise and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: FTC-Seg：通过特征级正交原型重建与阈值级自适应校准，打破噪声+长尾共同导致的伪标签退化循环，提升半监督语义分割尾部类性能。
AI.motivation: 半监督语义分割依赖伪标签，但在强成像噪声与长尾类分布同时出现的真实场景下显著失效。作者将失败归因于伪标签退化的恶性循环：噪声纠缠前景/背景特征，普遍降低预测置信度；长尾使尾类样本少、置信度天然偏低；固定高阈值过滤会系统性剔除尾类伪标签，使其得不到无监督监督，特征继续退化。噪声与长尾相互放大，单独处理任一因素不足。
AI.method: 基于标准 teacher-student 框架提出 FTC-Seg，包含两个层面的校准：(1) 特征层：Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR)，用一组可学习的正交原型对逐像素特征做残差净化，扩大弱前景目标与噪声背景之间的间隔；(2) 阈值层：Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC)，根据学习难度和预测分布偏置动态调整类特定阈值，挽救被系统性排除的尾类低置信伪标签。
AI.result: 在覆盖三种噪声模态的四个公开基准上，FTC-Seg 相比当前最优方法取得更强性能，在尾类上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 联合校准特征与阈值是在噪声与类别不平衡叠加条件下实现鲁棒伪标签的关键。

title: MAD-Guard: Controlled Study of Autoregressive Generation versus Direct Decision Interfaces for Closed Multimodal Forensic Tasks
summary: When should multimodal foundation models generate tokens, and when should they directly output a decision? We present MAD-Guard, a controlled study of output-decision interfaces for closed multimodal forensic tasks. Once a multimodal representation is computed, is autoregressive generation necessary for closed forensic decisions with high input complexity but low output entropy? Under a matched Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, 2,400 FakeClue training samples, and LoRA budget ($r=16, \alpha=32$) on Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, we evaluate a progression of decision interfaces (AR-SFT [generate] $\to$ Logit Slice $\to$ Binary Direct Head $\to$ +choice $\to$ +act $\to$ CLM-Head) and decompose latency into backbone representation (53.12 ms), 151,643-way vocabulary projection (+85.04 ms $\to$ 138.16 ms), and decoding (+248.26 ms $\to$ 386.42 ms). Under 1-to-1 binary supervision ($\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}$), a Binary Direct Head cuts latency by $2.60\times$-$7.27\times$ (53.12 ms) and lowers calibration error by $1.88\times$ (ECE = 0.0450 vs. 0.0845), with a -1.80% accuracy trade-off (93.10% vs. 94.90%; 0.9795 vs. 0.9871 ROC-AUC) from forfeiting token priors. Gains above AR-SFT arise either from multi-task attribution and uncertainty gating (+choice+act: 96.44% accuracy, 0.9940 ROC-AUC, 0.0187 ECE at 53.71 ms) or from a disaggregated contrastive head (CLM-Head: 96.55% binary and 96.44% multi-task accuracy, 0.0166 ECE, 98.79% 7-class attribution at 54.42 ms) retaining semantic priors without token decoding. Across 5,000 out-of-sample images from five benchmarks, our framework excels on synthetic, camouflage, and document forgeries (96.44% GenImage, 97.73% Chameleon, 91.84% Doc) while showing a clear boundary on compressed face manipulation (FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913).

AI.tldr: 该文提出 MAD-Guard，在 Qwen3-VL-8B 与 LoRA 设置下系统比较六种输出决策接口（AR-SFT、Logit Slice、Binary Direct Head、+choice、+act、CLM-Head），将延迟分解为主干表征、15 万词表投影与解码三部分，证明闭集多模态取证任务可绕过自回归解码，以二值直连头实现 2.6–7.3× 加速与更优校准。
AI.motivation: 质疑"多模态基础模型必须逐 token 生成"的默认范式：对输入复杂但输出熵极低的闭集取证判定，自回归解码是否必要？作者希望通过受控对照实验厘清生成式与判别式决策接口在延迟、校准与精度上的取舍，为高效取证模型设计提供依据。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B 为统一主干，LoRA（r=16, α=32），2,400 条 FakeClue 训练样本，昇腾 910C NPU 上评测决策接口演进序列：AR-SFT（生成式）→ Logit Slice → Binary Direct Head（BCE 一至一监督）→ +choice → +act → CLM-Head（解耦对比头）。同时将延迟拆解为主干表征（53.12 ms）、151,643 路词表投影（+85.04 ms）与解码（+248.26 ms），并进行多任务归因、不确定性门控与 7 类来源归因分析。
AI.result: Binary Direct Head 将延迟降低 2.60–7.27×（53.12 ms），校准误差降低 1.88×（ECE 0.0450 vs 0.0845），精度代价仅 −1.80%（93.10% vs 94.90%，ROC-AUC 0.9795 vs 0.9871）；+choice+act 达 96.44% 精度、0.9940 ROC-AUC、0.0187 ECE、53.71 ms；CLM-Head 达 96.55% 二值与 96.44% 多任务精度、0.0166 ECE、98.79% 七类归因、54.42 ms。5,000 张跨五个基准的样本上，合成/伪装/文档伪造表现优异（GenImage 96.44%、Chameleon 97.73%、Doc 91.84%），而压缩人脸篡改（FF++ ROC-AUC=0.5913）存在明显边界。
AI.conclusion: 对高输入复杂度、低输出熵的闭集多模态判定，自回归生成并非必要；用轻量直连决策头或解耦对比头可在保持语义先验的同时大幅削减词表投影与解码开销，并改善概率校准。该接口设计在合成、伪装与文档伪造上泛化良好，但在压缩人脸篡改上受限于压缩域分布偏移。

title: Resource-Aware Parameter-Efficient Model Adaptation for Onboard High-Dimensional Data
summary: Onboard satellite models often require frequent updates, but the weights adapted to earlier data distributions can quickly become outdated. However, updating large-scale model parameters in orbit presents significant challenges due to the limited uplink bandwidth of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, particularly for hyperspectral satellite imagery, where high-dimensional spectral-spatial inputs lead to increased model size and update costs. Existing full fine-tuning methods are thus expensive to retrain and difficult to deploy under strict communication constraints. To address this challenge, we propose NE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for bandwidth-constrained onboard hyperspectral model updates. NE-LoRA combines a primary low-rank branch with a nonlinear auxiliary branch to capture both global update trends and complex spectral-spatial variations. Additionally, we introduce a differentiated training strategy for multi-matrix adapters, motivated by the asymmetric initialization and gradient dynamics of different adapter matrices. Experiments on four hyperspectral datasets and three representative backbone models demonstrate that NE-LoRA consistently outperforms LoRA-based baselines and remains competitive with, and in several cases superior to, full fine-tuning. Across the evaluated settings, NE-LoRA updates only a small fraction of the total parameters on average while preserving low deployment overhead, offering a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off for onboard hyperspectral adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出NE-LoRA，一种面向带宽受限星载高光谱模型更新的参数高效适配框架，用主低秩分支+非线性辅助分支捕捉全局更新趋势与复杂光谱-空间变化，并以差异化训练策略适配多矩阵adapter；四个数据集、三个骨干上超越LoRA类基线，多数情况可比或优于全量微调，且平均仅更新极小比例参数。
AI.motivation: 星载模型需频繁更新以适应新数据分布，但LEO卫星上行带宽受限；高光谱影像输入维度高、模型大、更新开销大，全量微调重训昂贵且难以在严格通信约束下部署，故需参数高效、低上传开销的在轨适配方案。
AI.method: NE-LoRA：参数高效适配框架。结构上由主低秩分支（捕捉全局更新趋势）与非线性辅助分支（建模复杂光谱-空间变化）组成；针对多矩阵adapter因初始化不对称与梯度动态差异引入差异化训练策略，降低更新参数量与上传开销。
AI.result: 在4个高光谱数据集与3个代表性骨干模型上，NE-LoRA持续优于基于LoRA的基线，并与全量微调相当、在若干设置下更优；平均仅更新总参数的很小一部分，同时保持低部署开销，在精度-通信权衡上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: NE-LoRA为带宽受限的在轨高光谱模型更新提供了实用的参数高效适配方案，验证了低秩+非线性分支结合与差异化训练策略的有效性，通信-精度权衡具有部署价值。

title: Seeing and Solving Are Not Enough for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) answer visual questions by combining visual information extraction with downstream problem solving. We investigate a fundamental question: Does an incorrect answer necessarily reflect a failure in visual extraction or problem solving? A model may succeed at both abilities when tested separately yet still fail on the original multimodal question, a distinction that overall answer accuracy cannot reveal. To study this, we perform a question-level empirical analysis across multiple VLMs and visual domains. We define an exactly scorable task state (i.e., the visual information sufficient to solve a question) and use it to test whether the same model can extract the required state, solve the question from the ground-truth state, and answer the original multimodal question. We find that composition failures, where extraction and solving both succeed but direct answering fails, account for 17.7% to 75.6% of direct-answering errors across multiple VLMs and datasets. To address this failure mode, we introduce a simple yet effective method, termed State Realization Tuning (SRT). SRT fine-tunes LoRA adapters attached to the language-model layers while keeping the pretrained VLM weights frozen. It trains the model to output the ground-truth task state before the final answer in a single autoregressive response. SRT improves over standard supervised fine-tuning by 1.7 to 14.1 percentage points and repairs 92.5% to 98.1% of diagnosed composition failures. A single LoRA adapter trained with SRT also improves performance across substantially different task-state structures. Our work shows that having both visual extraction and problem-solving capabilities does not guarantee correct multimodal answering. Requiring the model to first output the visual information needed to solve the question can help bridge this gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示VLM存在"组合失败"：视觉抽取与问题求解各自成功，但直接回答多模态问题仍出错，占直接回答错误的17.7%–75.6%；提出State Realization Tuning (SRT)，通过LoRA微调让模型先输出任务状态再输出答案，显著缓解该失败模式。
AI.motivation: 总体答案准确率无法区分失败来源：错误答案可能源于视觉信息抽取失败，也可能源于下游求解失败，还可能是两者各自成功却无法在端到端多模态回答中组合起来。作者希望用问题级经验分析厘清这一区别。
AI.method: 定义"精确可评分的任务状态"（足以解题的视觉信息），对同一模型分别测试三件事：能否抽取所需状态、能否从真实状态解题、能否直接回答原多模态问题；据此诊断"组合失败"。方法上提出SRT：冻结预训练VLM权重，仅在语言模型层挂载并微调LoRA适配器，训练模型在单次自回归响应中先输出真实任务状态、再输出最终答案。
AI.result: 组合失败占直接回答错误的17.7%–75.6%（跨多个VLM与数据集）；SRT相比标准SFT提升1.7–14.1个百分点，修复92.5%–98.1%已诊断的组合失败；单一SRT LoRA适配器可跨显著不同的任务状态结构带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 同时具备视觉抽取与问题求解能力并不能保证正确的多模态回答；要求模型先显式输出解题所需的视觉信息，可有效弥合这一"能力—表现"鸿沟。

title: Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
summary: Pretrained biomedical vision-language models achieve strong zero-shot performance in biomedical image classification. However, downstream biomedical classification often depends on subtle visual differences between classes that may not be fully captured by pretrained representations. Few-shot adaptation addresses this mismatch by optimizing a task-specific predictor on a small labeled support set. Because the selected examples capture only part of the visual variation within the target classes, the adapted predictions can depend strongly on their composition. We propose Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA), which retains the frozen prompt prediction as a support-invariant semantic anchor and incorporates a visual prediction learned from the support set through an anchor-relative residual. The residual step is computed in a closed form from frozen support embeddings using anchor discrepancy and support agreement. Support-set dependence also limits evaluation: comparisons are fair within a shared draw but remain conditional on its composition. To obtain more reliable comparisons, we introduce a repeated-support protocol that separates support-selection variation from optimization randomness and reports both average and worst-20% performance. PARA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot classification and base-to-novel generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA)：将冻结的提示预测作为支持集不变的语义锚点，用闭式求解的锚点相对残差融合支持集视觉预测，并引入重复支持评估协议。
AI.motivation: 预训练生物医学视觉-语言模型零样本能力虽强，但下游分类往往依赖细微类间视觉差异，预训练表征难以充分捕捉；少样本适配虽可缓解该错配，但支持集只覆盖类内部分视觉变化，导致预测高度依赖支持集构成，评估也受此影响而不稳定。
AI.method: 保留冻结提示预测作为支持集不变的语义锚点，在其基础上引入由支持集学习得到的视觉预测，构成锚点相对残差；残差步由冻结支持嵌入以闭式解计算，依据锚点分歧度与支持一致性进行加权。同时提出重复支持协议，将支持集选择方差与优化随机性分离，报告平均性能与最差20%性能。
AI.result: 在少样本分类与 base-to-novel 泛化两个设定上均取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并在重复支持协议下给出更可靠的比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 以支持集不变的提示锚点约束少样本适配，可降低对支持集构成的敏感性并提升泛化；重复支持评估协议为少样本比较提供了更可靠的度量方式。

title: Revisiting Diffusion Fine-Tuning for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Diffusion-based unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) improves cross-domain transfer by generating target-specific synthetic data for downstream adaptation. Existing methods are largely designed for single-target adaptation: when a model trained on one labeled source domain must be adapted to multiple unlabeled target domains, they typically require separate diffusion fine-tuning for each source--target pair, causing training, storage, and deployment costs to grow with the number of targets. In this paper, we study multi-target data generation for diffusion-based UDA, where a single source-guided diffusion fine-tuning process is reused to generate target-specific synthetic data for multiple target domains. We propose MUSE (Multi-target UDA-oriented Synthesis with Efficient diffusion fine-tuning), a decoupled adaptation framework that separates source-supervised semantic adaptation from target-specific style adaptation. MUSE uses a shared semantic branch updated by labeled source data and target-private style branches specialized to individual target domains, enabling target-specific generation while avoiding repeated source-guided fine-tuning for each target. Experiments on standard UDA benchmarks show that MUSE achieves a stronger accuracy--efficiency trade-off than repeated per-target diffusion adaptation, reducing diffusion fine-tuning cost while improving average target-domain accuracy. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出MUSE解耦式UDA框架，用共享语义分支+目标私有风格分支实现单次源域扩散微调即可为多目标域生成合成数据，减少重复微调开销并提升平均精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的无监督域适应（UDA）多为单目标设定：源域到多个无标签目标域适应时，需为每对源-目标单独微调扩散模型，训练、存储与部署成本随目标数量线性增长。作者希望用一次源引导扩散微调复用生成多目标风格数据。
AI.method: MUSE将源监督的语义适应与目标专属的风格适应解耦：共享语义分支由有标签源数据更新，保证类别语义；多个目标私有的风格分支分别特化到各目标域，用于控制生成样本风格。由此实现目标专属生成而无需对每个目标重复源引导微调。
AI.result: 在标准UDA基准上，MUSE相比逐目标重复扩散适应取得了更好的精度-效率权衡：降低扩散微调成本的同时提升了目标域平均精度。
AI.conclusion: 单一源引导扩散微调+多目标风格分支可有效支撑多目标UDA数据生成，为多目标域适应提供更经济的方案，项目页面已公开。

title: GeoShrink: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Two Lines of Code
summary: Diffusion transformers incur substantial inference cost through repeated model evaluations along a sampling trajectory. We introduce GeoShrink, a training-free acceleration method that retains the original solver grid while evaluating the model only at a prescribed set of anchors. At skipped stages, GeoShrink predicts the solver-facing output by adding a geometrically retained fraction of the latest observed innovation to the most recent exact output. We derive this rule from chordal tangent transport and round-trip line projection, and establish a geometric anchor-spacing principle that minimizes the largest adjacent gap expansion under fixed coverage and first span. The analysis characterizes the geometric closure and propagation of prediction errors without assuming access to future model outputs. Experiments cover image, video, motion, and audio generation, together with adapted 3D backends. At approximately $5\times$ acceleration, GeoShrink improves FLUX PSNR by 3.10 dB over the strongest listed baseline. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a reported $4.99\times$ speedup and improves ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR by 5.44 dB over the strongest listed fidelity baseline. Comparisons at fixed evaluation budgets further show substantial gains on motion, audio, music, and 3D generation.

AI.tldr: GeoShrink：免训练扩散Transformer推理加速方法，保留原求解器网格，仅在预设锚点处评估模型，跳过阶段用几何规则预测输出，约5倍加速下显著提升生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer沿采样轨迹反复评估模型，推理成本高昂；需要在不重训练的前提下减少模型评估次数，同时尽量维持生成质量。
AI.method: 提出GeoShrink，免训练加速：保留原始solver网格，仅在指定锚点集合评估模型；在跳过的阶段，将最近观测到的新息（innovation）的几何保留比例加到最近一次精确输出上，从而预测solver-facing输出。该规则由弦切线传输（chordal tangent transport）与往返线段投影推导，并给出几何锚点间距原则，在固定覆盖率与首跨度下最小化最大相邻间隙扩张。分析刻画了预测误差的几何闭包与传播，且不假设可获取未来模型输出。
AI.result: 覆盖图像、视频、运动、音频生成及适配的3D后端。约5倍加速下，FLUX的PSNR较最强的列出基线提升3.10 dB；HunyuanVideo报告4.99倍加速，ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR较最强保真度基线提升5.44 dB；在固定评估预算下，运动、音频、音乐与3D生成也有显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 几何锚点式跳步评估可在免训练条件下有效加速扩散Transformer采样，并在多模态生成任务上兼顾速度与保真度。

title: Constrained Edit Fields for Training-Free Flow Editing
summary: Text-guided image editing aims to perform a desired edit while preserving source content unrelated to it. Pretrained rectified-flow models enable training-free editing of real images through modifications to their sampling trajectories. However, responses at locations unrelated to the desired edit can still accumulate along the editing trajectory and become visible in the final result. To overcome this, we propose Constrained Edit Fields (CEF), which assigns each spatial location a continuous edit responsibility that quantifies its relevance to the desired edit. CEF estimates edit responsibility directly from the source image when the relevant content is present. For edits whose target content is absent from the source, CEF first generates an unconstrained proposal to reveal its realized spatial support and then estimates responsibility from that proposal. At each editing step, CEF decomposes the base edit field into prompt-induced and trajectory-induced components, enabling edit responsibility to preserve instruction-relevant updates while suppressing unintended trajectory-induced changes. Evaluated on all 700 PIE-Bench examples, CEF achieves state-of-the-art Structure Distance, background LPIPS, and background MSE with both Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and FLUX, while retaining competitive instruction alignment. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, it reduces these metrics over the previous best results by 10.2%, 21.2%, and 48.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 Constrained Edit Fields (CEF)，从源图（或未约束提议）估计每个空间位置与编辑指令的相关度，并分解基础编辑场为提示诱导与轨迹诱导两部分，从而在保持指令对齐的同时抑制无关区域的轨迹漂移，在 PIE-Bench 全部 700 例上取得最优结构保持与背景一致性指标。
AI.motivation: 基于预训练 rectified-flow 的免训练文本引导图像编辑，虽然通过修改采样轨迹实现真实图像编辑，但沿轨迹累积的响应会出现在与编辑无关的位置，导致背景/结构被意外改变；需要一个显式的"编辑责任"机制来区分哪些更新应保留、哪些应抑制。
AI.method: CEF 为每个空间位置分配连续的编辑责任值以量化其与目标编辑的相关性；当源图中存在相关内容时直接由源图估计责任，当目标内容缺失时先生成无约束提议以揭示其实际空间支持再估计责任；在每步编辑中将基础编辑场分解为 prompt-induced 与 trajectory-induced 分量，据此保留指令相关更新并压制轨迹诱导变化。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 全部 700 个样例上评估，配合 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 与 FLUX 均在 Structure Distance、背景 LPIPS 和背景 MSE 上达到 SOTA，且指令对齐保持竞争力；在 SD 3.5 Medium 上相较此前最优分别降低 10.2%、21.2% 和 48.0%。
AI.conclusion: CEF 通过空间编辑责任分配与编辑场分解，有效解决了免训练 flow-based 图像编辑中无关区域漂移累积的问题，是一种即插即用的编辑器无关方法，可推广到不同 rectified-flow 骨干。

title: ENet-GP: Unified Document Image Restoration
summary: Reliable document digitization in uncontrolled capture settings is challenging because real images exhibit multiple interacting degradations rather than a single isolated distortion. Documents thus captured are affected simultaneously by geometric distortions, like page warping, as well as photometric degradations such as non-uniform illumination, and blurring. However, most existing approaches address these factors independently and are evaluated on benchmarks containing only one distortion type, limiting their real-world applicability. We introduce GutenDoc, a large-scale dataset of high-resolution dense-text documents with physically grounded compound degradations. Using physics-based rendering, our dataset jointly models geometric warping and diverse photometric effects, enabling systematic evaluation under realistic capture conditions. We further propose a unified restoration framework that jointly corrects geometric and photometric distortions within a single-network and single-training setup, without the need for degradation-specific retraining or sequential inference passes. Extensive experiments show that our method remains competitive on established single-distortion benchmarks while substantially improving robustness under compound degradations, providing a practical solution for real-world document digitization.

AI.tldr: 提出 GutenDoc 数据集（基于物理渲染的复合退化稠密文本文档图像）与单网络统一修复框架，同时校正几何形变与光度退化，在单退化基准上保持竞争力并在复合退化下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 真实拍摄的文档图像常同时存在几何形变（页面弯曲）与光度退化（非均匀光照、模糊）等多种交织失真，而现有方法多单独处理某一类失真，且评测基准仅含单一退化类型，导致实际场景适用性受限。
AI.method: 构建 GutenDoc 大规模高分辨率稠密文本数据集，采用基于物理的渲染联合建模几何弯曲与多种光度效应；提出统一修复框架，在单一网络、单次训练设置下联合校正几何与光度失真，无需按退化类型重训或串行多次推理。
AI.result: 在既有单退化基准上保持有竞争力的性能，同时在复合退化条件下鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为真实场景文档数字化提供了可用的数据集与统一修复方案，表明联合建模复合退化比分别处理更具实用价值。

title: M3-Score: Fidelity, Memorization and Coverage as Separate Axes for Evaluating Generative Radiology Image Models
summary: Quantitative evaluation of generative models for radiology remains challenging. Clinically relevant structures are often small and infrequent, feature spaces learned from natural images may represent them poorly, and a single summary score cannot distinguish limited fidelity from limited diversity. This study proposes the Medical Multi-axis Maximum Mean Discrepancy score (M3-Score), an evaluation framework based on RadioDINO-s16, a frozen vision transformer pretrained on radiology images. M3-Score reports three complementary axes computed at pre-specified encoder depths: \emph{fidelity}, measured by an unbiased multi-bandwidth radial basis function (RBF) MMD$^2$ at the final block; \emph{memorization}, measured by nearest-neighbor distances at 75\% depth; and \emph{coverage}, defined as the fraction of real images with a generated neighbor within their $k$-nearest-neighbor radius at 33\% depth. Reference sets are sampled across subjects to limit the influence of correlated slices. On BraTS brain MRI, the fidelity axis ordered five comparison sets of increasing severity (Spearman $\rho = 1.00$), and a subject-disjoint real set yielded $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0$ (permutation $p = 1$). An unconditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model achieved $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0.073$ (95\% confidence interval $[0.071, 0.080]$) but covered only 38\% of the real distribution. Under progressive mode dropping, $k$-NN manifold recall increased at all twelve encoder blocks, whereas the proposed coverage estimator decreased monotonically ($\rho = -1.00$). RadioDINO-s16 features separated real brain MRI from generated samples with a ROC-AUC of 0.819, compared with 0.555 for InceptionV3 and 0.582 for CLIP. Across a twentyfold range of sample sizes, the mean M3 value varied by a factor of 1.05, compared with 2.52 for the Fréchet Inception Distance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于冻结放射学ViT（RadioDINO-s16）的多轴MMD评估框架M3-Score，在多个encoder深度分别量化生成医学图像的保真度、记忆性与覆盖度，并在BraTS上验证其敏感性、稳健性与优于FID/InceptionV3/CLIP的判别力。
AI.motivation: 医学（尤其放射）生成模型缺乏可靠量化评估：关键解剖结构小且稀疏，自然图像预训练特征对其表征不足，单一汇总分数（如FID）无法区分保真度不足与多样性不足，且对样本量敏感。
AI.method: 以放射学预训练的冻结ViT（RadioDINO-s16）为特征骨干，在预设的三个encoder深度计算互补指标：最终block用无偏多带宽RBF核的MMD²测保真度；75%深度用最近邻距离测记忆化；33%深度用"真实图像中能在其k-NN半径内找到生成近邻的比例"定义覆盖度。参考集按受试者采样以削弱相关切片影响。
AI.result: BraTS脑MRI上，保真度轴对五组递增严重度比较集排序完美（Spearman ρ=1.00）；受试者互斥真实集MMD²=0（置换检验p=1）；无条件DDPM达MMD²=0.073（95%CI [0.071,0.080]）但仅覆盖38%真实分布。渐进模式丢弃下，k-NN流形召回在全部12个block上升，而覆盖度估计单调下降（ρ=-1.00）。RadioDINO-s16特征区分真实与生成样本ROC-AUC 0.819，优于InceptionV3（0.555）与CLIP（0.582）；在20倍样本量范围内M3均值变化仅1.05倍，而FID为2.52倍。
AI.conclusion: M3-Score以冻结放射学特征的多深度多轴分解，同时提供可分离的保真度、记忆性与覆盖度度量，在敏感性与样本量稳健性上优于传统FID类指标。

title: Eyes on the Road: A Naturalistic Comparison of MTW Rider Gaze in Urban Indian Traffic
summary: Motorized two-wheelers (MTW) dominate Indian roads but remain underrepresented in driver behavior research. This study presents the first large-scale analysis of MTW driver gaze behavior in naturalistic, heterogeneous urban traffic, using the \textit{myEye2Wheeler} dataset. A semantic segmentation pipeline (YOLOv11 + SAM2) was used to extract object-level gaze metrics under two attention modes: direct gaze (foveal overlap) and central vision (parafoveal monitoring). Results reveal a functional division: central vision supports broad monitoring, while direct gaze enables brief, selective sampling. Novice riders exhibit road-anchored scanning, returning to the road between object fixations, while experienced riders form longer chains of attention across multiple objects. The findings suggest that experience primarily refines temporal rhythm rather than altering allocation strategy and reduces object-class effects in gaze patterns. These findings offer new insight into MTW attention structures and inform future work on behavior modeling and safety systems.

AI.tldr: 基于 myEye2Wheeler 数据集，首次大规模分析自然驾驶中摩托车骑手眼动行为，用 YOLOv11+SAM2 分割提取注视指标，发现中央视觉负责广域监控、直接注视用于选择性采样，且经验主要改变注意的时间节奏。
AI.motivation: 摩托车在印度道路中占比极高，但在驾驶行为研究中长期被忽视，缺乏自然、异质交通场景下的大规模注视行为数据与分析，而理解骑手注意力结构对行为建模与安全系统设计具有价值。
AI.method: 使用 myEye2Wheeler 自然驾驶数据集；构建语义分割流水线（YOLOv11 + SAM2）进行目标级分割，并在此基础上定义两种注意力模式——直接注视（中央凹重叠）与中央视觉（旁中央凹监控），提取目标级注视指标并对比新手与资深骑手。
AI.result: 发现功能性分工：中央视觉支持广域监控，直接注视实现短暂且选择性的采样；新手呈"道路锚定"扫描，在目标注视间回到道路，而资深骑手形成跨多个目标的更长注意链；经验主要优化注意的时间节奏而非改变资源分配策略，并减弱了目标类别对注视模式的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了对摩托车骑手注意力结构的新认识，可为后续骑手行为建模与安全系统设计提供依据。

title: Augmenting Visual Anomaly Detection with Automated Interpretability
summary: Visual anomaly detectors identify deviations from known-normal data, but their anomaly signals may mix evidence of actual anomalies with benign visual variation. We investigate whether automated interpretability can augment visual anomaly detectors by identifying and intervening on different components of this signal. We decompose PatchCore nearest-normal residuals into sparse features using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), and provide high-activation and contrastive non-active examples to a Multimodal LLM, which describes each feature and labels it as anomaly, distractor, or uncertain. These labels guide interventions in the SAE hidden representation, where distractor features are suppressed and anomaly features amplified. The edited representation is then used to reconstruct patch embeddings, which are rescored with PatchCore. Across 40 categories from four benchmarks, applying both interventions jointly improves macro-average image-level AUROC from 0.8724 to 0.8857 on source data and from 0.8066 to 0.8210 under synthetic corruptions. On three additional RobustAD categories with real acquisition shifts, the same interventions improve AUROC from 0.8745 to 0.9056 on source data and from 0.6069 to 0.6599 under real acquisition shifts. Finally, individual feature interventions across all 43 categories show that the MLLM labels are aligned in aggregate with how features differently affect normal and anomalous images.

AI.tldr: 利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解 PatchCore 的最近邻残差，再用多模态大模型自动标注特征为异常/干扰/不确定，并在 SAE 隐空间中对干扰特征抑制、对异常特征放大后重打分，从而提升异常检测在跨数据集与真实采集漂移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视觉异常检测器的异常信号中混杂了真实异常证据与良性视觉变化（干扰因素），导致误报与域漂移下性能下降。作者希望验证自动化可解释性（MLLM 解释 + SAE 可分解表示）能否用于解耦并干预这些信号成分，从而增强检测器。
AI.method: 1) 将 PatchCore 的最近邻残差用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解为稀疏特征；2) 为每个特征提供高激活样本与对比性非激活样本，交由多模态大模型描述并标注为 anomaly / distractor / uncertain；3) 用这些标签在 SAE 隐表示上进行干预：抑制 distractor 特征、放大 anomaly 特征；4) 用编辑后的表示重建 patch embedding，再由 PatchCore 重新打分。
AI.result: 在四个基准的 40 个类别上，联合施加两种干预使宏平均图像级 AUROC 从 0.8724 提升至 0.8857（源数据），合成损坏下从 0.8066 提升至 0.8210；在三个含真实采集漂移的 RobustAD 类别上，源数据 AUROC 由 0.8745 升至 0.9056，真实采集漂移下由 0.6069 升至 0.6599。全部 43 个类别的单特征干预实验表明，MLLM 标签在整体上与特征对正常/异常图像的不同影响方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 自动化可解释性（SAE + MLLM 标注）可作为视觉异常检测器的增益模块，通过隐空间特征级干预有效解耦异常证据与良性干扰，并在合成与真实域漂移下均带来一致的 AUROC 提升，验证了 MLLM 语义标签与特征功能行为的整体对齐性。

title: One Attack to Fool Them All: Highly Transferable Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Frontier MLLMs
summary: Adversarial attacks have long posed a fundamental threat to machine learning systems. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rapidly evolve and become widely deployed, assessing their vulnerability to such attacks is essential for their safe use. In this work, we investigate whether a single adversarial image can consistently mislead diverse frontier MLLMs in black-box settings. We propose O-Attack, a highly transferable black-box attack framework. This framework builds on our insight that surrogate models contain a broad, high-level, cross-modally aligned semantic space. This space extends beyond final-layer outputs and provides multiple semantically consistent representations that remain underexploited by existing attacks. Within this space, O-Attack anchors aligned representations, progressively broadens semantic conditions, and optimizes perturbations through semantic consensus to promote consistent target alignment. By fully exploiting this space with the same surrogate models as M-Attack, O-Attack raises attack success rates on GPT-5.4 (29.1% to 77.2%), Claude-4.6 (42.8% to 81.6%), and Gemini-3.1 (38.2% to 80.9%). Extensive experiments across 24 MLLMs show that O-Attack outperforms six state-of-the-art methods in black-box transferability, with consistent effectiveness across prompts and improved efficiency and imperceptibility. This work exposes the practical safety risks posed by black-box adversarial attacks against frontier MLLMs, underscoring the need for more rigorous robustness evaluation and more effective defenses.

AI.tldr: 提出 O-Attack 黑盒可迁移对抗攻击框架，利用替代模型跨模态对齐的高层语义空间，通过语义共识优化单张对抗图像，显著提升对前沿多模态大模型的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）快速演进并广泛部署，其对抗鲁棒性评估对安全使用至关重要；现有黑盒攻击对前沿 MLLM 的迁移性不足，需探究单张对抗图像能否稳定误导多种前沿模型。
AI.method: O-Attack 基于"替代模型存在广泛、高层、跨模态对齐的语义空间"这一观察，该空间超越最终层输出、包含多种语义一致的中间表征。方法在该空间内锚定对齐表征，逐步扩展语义条件，并通过语义共识优化扰动，以促成一致的目标对齐；与 M-Attack 使用相同替代模型。
AI.result: 在 GPT-5.4（29.1%→77.2%）、Claude-4.6（42.8%→81.6%）、Gemini-3.1（38.2%→80.9%）上大幅提升攻击成功率；在 24 个 MLLM 上黑盒迁移性优于 6 种 SOTA 方法，跨提示一致有效，效率与不可感知性提升。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了黑盒对抗攻击对前沿 MLLM 的实际安全风险，强调需要更严格的鲁棒性评估与更有效的防御。

title: CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Diffusion models are now widely used in Bayesian inverse problems in imaging as priors, where latent diffusion models are often used for larger scale problems to keep the computational complexity and model-size manageable. Unfortunately, the auto-encoder based compression results in loss of spatial detail. In addition, the optimization is converted to a non-linear problem. In this paper, we introduce a posterior sampling algorithm customized for the pyramidal/cascaded architecture, which relies on a coarse to fine hierarchical strategy to generate images in the pixel domain. We present CLIMB-Flow which alternates between three steps: an end-point estimation from the current coarse and noisy image, data-consistent update of the clean image, and re-noising it back to the level the network expects. Together these steps sample the posterior at that scale using an approximate Gibbs sampling from two conditional distributions. Experiments on ImageNet, CelebA, AFHQ and fastMRI span inpainting, deblurring, super-resolution and accelerated MRI, with PSNR gains of 1.37-7.66 dB over the strongest competing method on CelebA and pixel-domain reconstruction up to 512x512.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLIMB-Flow，一种面向金字塔/级联扩散先验的像素域后验采样算法，通过端点评 估、数据一致性更新与再加噪三步的近似 Gibbs 采样实现粗到细的贝叶斯逆问题求解，在 CelebA 上较最强基线 PSNR 提升 1.37–7.66 dB。
AI.motivation: 潜空间扩散模型虽能控制计算复杂度与模型规模，但自编码器压缩会丢失空间细节，且优化被转化为非线性问题，导致成像逆问题重建质量受限。
AI.method: 针对金字塔/级联架构定制后验采样：在像素域按粗到细层次生成，交替执行三个步骤——(1) 从当前粗糙含噪图像估计端点，(2) 对干净图像做数据一致性更新，(3) 再噪化回网络期望的噪声水平；三步合起来构成对两个条件分布的近似 Gibbs 采样，从而在该尺度上采样后验。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet、CelebA、AFHQ、fastMRI 上验证，覆盖图像修补、去模糊、超分辨率与加速 MRI；CelebA 上较最强竞争方法 PSNR 提升 1.37–7.66 dB，并支持最高 512×512 的像素域重建。
AI.conclusion: 将后验采样直接放到像素域并结合级联架构的层次化策略，可规避潜空间压缩的信息损失，在多种成像逆任务上取得显著一致的增益。

title: ReDrive: Shaping Representations with World Modeling for End-to-End Driving
summary: Driving policies require capabilities of scene understanding and future evolution prediction. To achieve this goal, current end-to-end models typically construct complex perception-planning pipelines or introduce world models that explicitly predict future states, resulting in a complex system architecture. Inspired by the transferability of general-purpose visual representations, we argue that combining sufficiently strong visual representations with representation world modeling can support effective planning without relying on complex inference-time auxiliary modules. Based on this insight, we present ReDrive, an end-to-end driving framework that strengthens planning-oriented visual features via future representation prediction. To achieve this, ReDrive adopts a three-stage training pipeline consisting of driving video pretraining, joint world-modeling and planning training, and planner adaptation. This yields a strong planning-oriented representation and a high-performance planner, while requiring neither auxiliary perception modules nor future prediction at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate strong performance, achieving 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. These results show that shaping representations with world modeling is sufficient to enable high-performance end-to-end planning while retaining a simple encoder-planner inference pipeline.

AI.tldr: ReDrive 提出一种端到端驾驶框架，通过"未来表征预测"塑造面向规划的视觉表征，无需推理期辅助感知模块或未来状态预测即可实现高性能规划。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型为获得场景理解与未来演化预测能力，往往需构建复杂感知-规划流水线或引入显式预测未来状态的世界模型，导致系统架构臃肿、推理成本高。作者认为，若视觉表征本身足够强，结合表征空间的世界建模即可支撑有效规划，从而摆脱推理期的辅助模块。
AI.method: ReDrive 采用三阶段训练流水线：(1) 驾驶视频预训练；(2) 世界建模与规划联合训练，以未来表征预测作为辅助目标强化面向规划的视觉特征；(3) 规划器适配。推理阶段仅保留简单的编码器-规划器结构，不依赖辅助感知模块，也不做显式未来预测。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 基准上取得 91.0 PDMS（v1）与 90.8 EPDMS（v2），表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 以世界建模塑造表征足以支撑高性能端到端规划，同时保持简洁的编码器-规划器推理流水线，验证了"强视觉表征 + 表征世界模型"路线的有效性。

title: Program-Verified Self-Evolution for Vision-Language Models
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models train on questions they generate from unlabeled images. Since these questions have no gold answers, prior methods label them by majority vote over sampled answers or by a model judge. In a human evaluation, we find that 24\% of majority-vote labels and 18\% of model-judge labels produced during self-evolution are wrong. To address this problem, we present Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models (VQS), which changes how the model judges answers. Instead of voting on an answer, the model parses each image into a structured record, such as a scene graph, a chart table, or a diagram graph. Fixed programs then write a question from the record and compute its answer. The model still acts as a visual checker, but it only confirms the individual facts the program reads, one short claim at a time. These claim-level checks select the parser's training targets, so the parser also improves without labels. Human raters find 94\% of VQS answers correct, against 76\% for majority voting. Across ten benchmarks, VQS improves Qwen3-VL by up to 3.18 points at the 2B, 4B, and 8B scales and outperforms the strongest self-evolving baseline at each. Gains keep growing over three training rounds, reaching 3.84 points at 2B. Code is released at this https URL

AI.tldr: VQS改变自进化VLM的答案判定方式：模型将图像解析为结构化记录（场景图/图表/示意图图），由固定程序据此生成问题并计算答案，模型仅对程序读取的单个事实做短声明级校验，用这些校验信号无标注地优化解析器。人工评估显示94%答案正确（多数投票为76%），在10个基准上Qwen3-VL各规模提升最高3.18点，三轮训练后2B提升3.84点。
AI.motivation: 自进化VLM用未标注图像自生成问题训练，但这些问题没有金标准答案，先前做法靠采样答案多数投票或模型裁判打标签，人工评估发现多数投票标签24%、模型裁判标签18%是错的，噪声伪标签限制了自进化效果。
AI.method: 提出VQS（Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models）：1）模型将图像解析成结构化记录（场景图、图表表格、示意图图）；2）固定程序从记录中写出问题并计算答案，答案由程序确定而非投票；3）模型退化为视觉校验器，对程序读取的每个事实逐条做短声明级确认；4）这些声明级校验结果作为解析器的训练目标，使解析器在无标注条件下持续改进。
AI.result: 人工评分中VQS答案94%正确，多数投票仅76%；在十个基准上相较Qwen3-VL在2B/4B/8B规模提升最高3.18点，且在每一规模均优于最强的自进化基线；三轮训练收益持续累积，2B规模达3.84点。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将自进化中的“答案判定”从不可靠的投票/裁判改为可验证的程序化生成与声明级事实校验，能显著降低伪标签噪声并带来跨规模、跨基准的稳定增益，为无标注自进化VLM提供了一条可验证的数据构建路径。

title: Residual-Stream Burden Shapes Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers
summary: In diffusion-based generation, a neural network can be trained to predict the clean data, the noise, or the velocity from a noisy input. These prediction targets are interconvertible and describe the same generative process, yet plain Diffusion Transformers operating on large pixel patches succeed with clean prediction and fail with noise or velocity prediction. We argue that this asymmetry arises because noisy targets require the residual stream to preserve noise-dependent input variation through depth for the final readout, forcing subsequent layers to compute on noisy representations. A spectrally concentrated clean target imposes a lighter demand, leaving greater freedom to organize hidden representations for subsequent computation. We call this preservation requirement *residual-stream burden* and show how it shapes representation learning in Diffusion Transformers. Controlled experiments indicate that the exploitable structure is spectral concentration in patch space and that the bandwidth of the persistent residual state is a key resource for noisy prediction. We further show that this account is consistent with recent decoupled pixel-space architectures, whose diverse designs all reduce the residual-stream burden on the main pathway. To examine this understanding from a complementary direction, we expand and reorganize the residual-stream bandwidth directly, introducing Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) that reach FID 1.71 on ImageNet $256^2$. Together, these results identify residual-stream burden as a mechanism through which prediction targets and architecture jointly shape representation learning in Diffusion Transformers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"残差流负担"概念，解释扩散Transformer中为何预测干净数据可行而预测噪声/速度失败，并据此设计SiHC达到ImageNet 256² FID 1.71。
AI.motivation: 扩散生成中预测目标（干净数据、噪声、速度）理论上可互换，但实践上Diffusion Transformer仅在使用干净数据预测时成功，噪声/速度预测则失败，这一不对称性缺乏机理解释。
AI.method: 提出"残差流负担"假说：噪声目标要求残差流在深层保留噪声相关的输入变化直到最终读出，迫使后续层在噪声表示上计算；干净目标因频谱集中而负担更轻。通过受控实验验证可被利用的结构为patch空间中的频谱集中，残差状态带宽是关键资源；并反向扩展残差流带宽，提出空间索引超连接（SiHC）。
AI.result: 受控实验证实频谱集中与残差状态带宽是噪声预测的关键因素；SiHC在ImageNet 256²上达到FID 1.71；该解释与近期解耦像素空间架构（均降低主通路残差流负担）一致。
AI.conclusion: 残差流负担是预测目标与架构共同塑造扩散Transformer表示学习的机制，为架构设计提供了可操作的指导。

title: Preserving DEG Rankings for Gene Discovery in Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histology images could scale spatial transcriptomics (ST) to image-only cohorts, but conventional histology-based ST prediction is trained and evaluated mainly by per-gene spatial-profile reconstruction. This objective is misaligned with a key downstream use of ST: differentially expressed gene (DEG) discovery, where genes are ranked for a biological or morphology-defined contrast by evidence of between-group expression differences. We formulate image-based differential expression ranking (IDER), which asks whether predicted expression profiles preserve the contrast-specific ranked gene list obtained from measured profiles. IDER compares gene rankings induced by differential-expression statistics, rather than raw expression magnitudes or per-gene spatial correlations. We further introduce a differentiable IDER objective that aligns these statistics across genes and can be trained with morphology-derived proxy contrasts without predefined biological group labels. Experiments on public ST datasets show improved DEG-ranking agreement and pathway-enrichment overlap over conventional reconstruction objectives, including morphology-derived and pathologist-annotated tissue-region evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于图像预测的差异表达基因排序任务（IDER）及可微训练目标，使组织学图像预测的表达谱更贴合下游DEG发现需求。
