AI.motivation: 常规基于组织学图像的ST预测以逐基因空间谱重建为训练与评价目标，与ST的核心下游用途——差异表达基因（DEG）发现——不一致，评价指标与真实应用错位。
AI.method: 形式化IDER任务：检验预测表达谱是否保留由测量谱得到的对比特异性基因排序；比较由差异表达统计量导出的基因排序而非原始表达量或逐基因空间相关性；提出可微IDER目标，跨基因对齐统计量，并可用形态学导出的代理对比（无需预设生物学分组标签）进行训练。
AI.result: 在公开ST数据集上，相比传统重建目标，DEG排序一致性提升，通路富集重叠度提升，涵盖形态学导出与病理学家标注的组织区域评测。
AI.conclusion: 面向下游任务的评估与训练目标能更有效提升图像预测ST的差异表达发现能力，为无标签场景下的代理对比训练提供可行路径。

title: Video, Ergo Genero: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
summary: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

AI.tldr: ViGeo 将视觉类比（in-context learning）从图像域扩展到视频域，通过时空画布补全（spatiotemporal canvas completion）统一多种视频任务，无需微调即可泛化到未见过的视频操作与零样本模态（如事件相机），并发现并缓解了"任务内化"这一提示格式与任务身份耦合的捷径问题。
AI.motivation: 1) 视频模型适配新任务通常需要专门的数据整理与微调，成本高；2) 视觉类比提供了免训练的任务指定方式，但此前局限于图像域；3) 作者希望验证类比方法能否统一多样化的视频任务并泛化到分布外场景。
AI.method: 提出 ViGeo 框架，以时空画布补全的形式将视觉 in-context learning 扩展到视频域：给定上下文中的演示视频与查询，模型在时空画布上完成补全以指定并执行任务。评估采用多样化任务分类体系，并严格划分训练/测试集。此外，作者分析了"任务内化"现象——当查询格式与某个预训练任务相关联时会覆盖演示内容，并尝试用少量任务无关数据移除该捷径。
AI.result: ViGeo 能够泛化到未见过的视频操作任务以及零样本模态（如事件相机）；识别出任务内化捷径，并证明该捷径可通过少量任务无关数据予以消除。
AI.conclusion: 类比式方法有潜力统一多种视频任务并实现分布外泛化，但提示格式与任务身份之间的相关性会导致捷径，需要解耦二者，这为免训练视频任务指定提供了新方向与警示。

title: Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) are traditionally treated as disjoint problems: the former adapts models to domain shift assuming all test classes are known, while the latter discovers novel categories assuming labeled training data for known classes. However, real-world deployment rarely fits either setting. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD), a unified and more realistic scenario where a vision-language model must adapt to distribution shifts, classify known categories using only textual supervision, and discover novel categories, all during test time and without access to labeled data. To address this challenging scenario, we propose PACT (Prototype Assignment for Category discovery at Test time), a fully unsupervised framework that casts known-class recognition and novel-class discovery via prototype assignment. PACT first re-aligns shifted visual features with the text-derived class representations of the VLM using confident zero-shot predictions. Known and novel categories are then both represented by prototypes in the visual embedding space, estimated from the unlabeled test stream, and each test image is assigned to the category whose prototype is most similar to its visual feature. Extensive experiments across corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that PACT outperforms adapted state-of-the-art TTA and GCD methods, effectively bridging the gap between adaptation and discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD) 新设定，并给出全无监督框架 PACT，通过原型分配在测试时同时完成域适应、已知类识别与新类发现。
AI.motivation: 测试时适应（TTA）假定所有测试类已知，广义类别发现（GCD）假定有已知类的标注训练数据，二者割裂；真实部署中视觉语言模型往往既无标注又需同时应对分布偏移、已知类识别与新类发现，因此需要一个更现实的统一场景。
AI.method: PACT 首先利用高置信度零样本预测，将偏移后的视觉特征与 VLM 由文本导出的类别表征重新对齐；随后在视觉嵌入空间中用从无标注测试流估计的原型同时表示已知类与新类，每个测试图像按视觉特征相似度分配到最相近的原型所属类别。整个过程完全无监督、在测试时在线进行。
AI.result: 在多种损坏（corruption）与域偏移（domain-shift）基准上，PACT 优于经过适配的最先进 TTA 与 GCD 方法，在适应与发现之间取得桥梁效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一了 TTA 与 GCD 的问题设定，表明基于原型分配的无监督测试时框架可同时实现偏移适应、已知类文本监督识别与新类发现，为开放世界部署提供了可行路径。

title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
summary: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.

AI.tldr: SAGA：基于分层稀疏4D锚点的动态3DGS体视频编解码器，通过锚点间插值与正交性记忆槽实现紧凑表示与熵上下文建模，在Neu3D和MPEG MIV上相对GIFStream分别达到80.39%与83.94%的PSNR BD-rate降低。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式视频通信需要照片级真实、渲染高效且紧凑的动态场景表示。动态3DGS因密集基元与时空冗余难以压缩；现有基于锚点的方案依赖单一规范模板的形变、且每个基元仅孤立地条件化于其关联锚点，难以处理非局部运动与去遮挡，并低估了锚点间相关性（在运动/纹理密集区域尤甚）。
AI.method: 提出SAGA：用分层组织的稀疏4D锚点表示动态3D场景；基于坐标的INR解码器由锚点间插值生成细锚点与高斯基元，实现跨时空结构的紧凑参数共享；针对非结构化锚点的长程依赖，引入固定尺寸记忆槽与正交性驱动的更新机制，实现精确的熵上下文建模。
AI.result: 在Neu3D与MPEG MIV数据集上相对GIFStream取得强率失真性能，PSNR BD-rate分别降低80.39%与83.94%。
AI.conclusion: SAGA表明分层稀疏4D锚点+锚点间插值+记忆槽熵建模可有效缓解动态3DGS的时空冗余与非局部动力学建模难题，为紧凑动态场景编解码提供可行路径。

title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture
summary: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文对7个公开杂草检测数据集进行了多数据集基准评测，重点评估YOLO26（n/s/m）的域内精度、复杂度、时延、FPS与模型大小，并考察统一单类设置下的跨域泛化与多源联合训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有杂草检测的深度学习研究多依赖单数据集评测，难以判断模型在不同作物、杂草种类、田间条件、采集设备与标注协议下的鲁棒性，作者希望提供跨农业域的标准化基准并检验新模型YOLO26的实际适用性。
AI.method: 在7个公开杂草检测数据集上评测YOLO26的nano/small/medium三种规模，比较检测精度、模型复杂度、推理时延、FPS和模型大小；除域内评测外，构建统一单类杂草设置评估跨域泛化，并用全部数据集训练子集合并进行多源联合训练。
AI.result: YOLO26域内表现强，YOLO26m平均精度最高，YOLO26s在精度-效率权衡上最佳；但跨域性能显著下降，YOLO26s平均域内mAP50:95从0.603降至离域0.148；多源联合训练在部分数据集上带来提升，但未能完全消除域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 面向真实精准农业的鲁棒杂草检测，数据集多样性、域相似性与目标域自适应至关重要；YOLO26可作为高效域内检测器，但跨域部署仍需针对性适配。

title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
summary: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^\omega_\beta$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $\Delta$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^\omega_\beta$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: UnfoldCRF 将掩码精修建模为像素标签与潜在区域变量上的条件随机场推理，用可校正一元项、学习到的局部成对交互和图像条件区域一致性（含可退出的一致性的空状态）构成单一能量，并展开阻尼平均场更新。在与同输入、同参数量、同阶段数、同监督的循环黑箱精修器对比中，COD10K 上提升 1.0 Fωβ、四项 COD 指标全升、变差图像比例由 11.7% 降至 8.5%；跨五数据集 train-once 协议下 2.6M 参数变体平均 ΔIoU +4.2（对照 +2.0），冻结 DINOv2 变体以约 1/7 参数匹配最强基础模型精修器；未见掩码生成器上 +2.0 Fωβ（对照 +0.6）；消融显示成对消息主要修复边界，区域消息主要修复非边界误差。
AI.motivation: 学习式掩码精修器常提升分割精度，但难以区分增益来自显式结构还是额外容量，也不清楚在掩码生成器或其误差分布变化时是否稳健。作者试图在严格匹配参数预算、阶段数与监督的条件下，隔离"结构"本身的贡献。
AI.method: 将精修视为像素标签与潜在区域变量上的 CRF 推理：能量函数包含校正后的一元项、学习到的局部成对交互、图像条件的潜在区域一致性项，并设空状态使标签一致性弱的区域退出一致性项；推理通过在单一能量上展开阻尼平均场更新实现（展开式优化）。对照为读取相同输入、参数预算/阶段数/监督均匹配的循环黑箱精修器。
AI.result: COD10K：较最强匹配对照高 1.0 Fωβ，四项 COD 指标全部提升，变差图像比例 11.7%→8.5%。五数据集 train-once：2.6M 参数变体平均 ΔIoU +4.2，对照 +2.0。基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的变体以约 1/7 常驻参数匹配最强基础模型精修器并优于自身对照。未见掩码生成器：+2.0 Fωβ，对照 +0.6。消融：成对消息主要修正边界，区域消息主要修正非边界误差。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 显式 CRF 结构在参数匹配下带来可归因于结构而非容量的稳定增益，并在掩码源/误差分布变化下保持优势；不同消息通道功能可分离解释，方法可迁移到跨数据集与基础模型特征场景。

title: MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.

AI.tldr: MetaSampling：免训练、即插即用的长视频问答帧采样策略，可叠加在现有帧选择器上，动态缩减送入MLLM的帧数，在36组配置中全部降帧（均值8.9%），25组精度反升。
AI.motivation: 现有帧选择方法虽优于top-k嵌入检索和均匀采样，但普遍在固定全局采样预算下运行，未根据问题-视频难度自适应调整帧数，造成冗余计算或信息不足。
AI.method: 提出MetaSampling：一种无需训练、即插即用的采样策略，置于已有帧选择器之上，依据查询/上下文动态确定帧数预算，从而在保持或提升答案精度的同时减少送入MLLM的帧数量。
AI.result: 在36组“帧选择器—MLLM主干—VQA基准”配对配置上评估：全部36组帧数下降，25组精度提升，平均减帧8.9%，整体精度略有提高。
AI.conclusion: 固定预算并非最优，动态帧数调节可在通用框架下同时提升长视频问答效率与精度，且无需训练、可广泛兼容现有选择器。

title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling. Integrating these, LQN i) adapts and improves zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 by 9.8% Top-1 on OOD ImageNet, ii) outperforms the previous best GS-Bias on fine-grained classification by 3.9% Top-1, iii) achieves faster convergence than TPS for CLIP ResNet-50 (47 mins vs 55 mins), iv) generalizes adaptation to VLMs like SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, and CoCa, and lightweight students like MLP, ResNet, VGG, and v) extends to panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: LQN 用一次前向传播的中间层空间 token 蒸馏加坐标采样自监督，让冻结的 VLM 在测试时高效自适应，无需多次增强前向。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 的 Test-Time Training 依赖多增强视图，每个视图都要完整前向（甚至反向），计算开销大；作者观察到单次前向的中间层输出信息量已远超全部增强后的最终嵌入。
AI.method: 提出 Layer Query Network：一个小型 student 模型在冻结的 teacher VLM 单次前向中完成自适应。包含 (1) Position-Aware Distillation，通过查询中间 token 的空间坐标来模仿 teacher 中间层空间 token；(2) Location Consistency Regularization，用 O(1) 坐标采样替代 O(H×W) 图像增强实现自监督。
AI.result: 零样本 CLIP ViT-B/16 在 OOD ImageNet 上 Top-1 提升 9.8%；细粒度分类超过此前最优 GS-Bias 3.9% Top-1；CLIP ResNet-50 收敛快于 TPS（47 vs 55 分钟）；可泛化到 SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa 等 VLM 和 MLP、ResNet、VGG 等轻量 student，并扩展到全景/实例/语义分割。
AI.conclusion: 用中间层信号和坐标级自监督即可实现低成本、单次前向的 VLM 测试时自适应，效率与精度均优于现有 TTT 方法，且具备跨模型与跨任务泛化性。

title: Re:Cognize -- Open-Set Comic Character Re-Identification
summary: A manga reader meets a character on one page and knows them on sight a hundred pages later, without ever being handed a cast list. Re-identifying comic characters demands the same, open-set and sequential: pages arrive as a stream in reading order, new faces appear before anyone names them, and the cast is assembled as the story is read. $\textbf{Re:Cognize}$ evaluates recognition as the story is read, not against a cast handed over in advance: four protocols on one query stream, from closed-set retrieval to a cast the model must build and grow itself. The surprise is where models fail. Recognising is close to solved: one reference image per character already ranks as well as a gallery built in advance. Knowing what to believe is not: a model that adds its own matches makes its cast worse, while the same growth with correct labels would gain over twenty points of top-1 accuracy. The bottleneck is acceptance, not vision, and one comparison decides it: an addition pays exactly when it is right more often than the cast already was on the queries it takes over. The comparison has nothing to fit, and measured on half of a new corpus it calls the other half correctly. $\textbf{ReCast}$ puts it to work with nothing fitted on data: a cast sheet of one running average per character, grown only where the page itself vouches for a crop. It recovers a third to two thirds of what perfect labels would, depending on whether the cast starts from random examples or from first appearances. Re:Cognize measures whether a model can read along; ReCast is a cast that does. Our claims are on identity maintenance, recognising characters already met; the emergence of new ones is measured as a diagnostic under a fixed reference rule, and we propose no method for it.

AI.tldr: 提出 Re:Cognize 评测基准与 ReCast 无训练方法，将漫画角色识别形式化为按阅读顺序到达的开放集、序贯身份维持问题；发现瓶颈在"是否接受新匹配"的决策而非视觉识别本身。
AI.motivation: 现有漫画/图像角色识别通常假设预先给定完整角色库的闭集设定，与真实阅读过程不符：页面按阅读顺序流式到达，新角色在未被命名前先出现，角色表需随阅读逐步构建。作者希望考察模型能否在开放集、序贯条件下自行维护并扩展角色身份。
AI.method: 1) Re:Cognize：在同一查询流上设计四种协议，从闭集检索到模型自建并自行增长角色表；2) 关键分析：单张参考图即可达到预建库相当的水平，但模型自行加入匹配会降低角色表质量，而同样增长若标签正确可提升 20+ top-1；3) 提出接受准则——当某次新增在其接管的查询上"正确频率高于原角色表"时才获益，该比较无需拟合，在半个新语料上测得可正确判定另一半；4) ReCast：每个角色一个运行平均模板的角色表，仅在页面自身为裁剪提供证据处生长，无任何数据拟合。
AI.result: 识别环节接近已解决：单参考图检索与预建库相当。自行增长匹配反而损害角色表，而正确标签下的同样增长可带来超过 20 个百分点的 top-1 提升。所提接受比较无需拟合参数，在新语料的一半上标定即可正确判定另一半。ReCast 在无拟合条件下，恢复完美标签收益的三分之一至三分之二（取决于角色表从随机样例还是首次出场初始化）。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张聚焦于身份维持（识别已见过的角色）；新角色涌现仅作为固定参考规则下的诊断指标测量，作者明确不提出相应方法。核心结论是接受决策而非视觉表征才是此类序贯开放集识别的瓶颈。

title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding
summary: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.

AI.tldr: 提出无位姿、单目、单卡GPU预算下的度量(绝对尺度)3D点跟踪方法:冻结光流+M单目度量深度前端,仅用Mamba-3状态空间模型在DINOv3外观特征条件下学习残差深度,实现帧数无关的常数内存,在TAPVid-3D minival取得mean AJ 0.256的最优度量精度。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的绝对尺度(米制)3D点跟踪是4D重建、机器人导航与自动驾驶的基础,因为这些任务的决策单位是米而非像素。现有最强3D跟踪器多基于Transformer,其KV缓存随帧数线性增长,难以在单张商用GPU、无位姿、单目条件下部署,因此需要在绝对度量精度与算力预算之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 核心观察:一旦点的2D图像轨迹确定,决定其度量精度的量就是沿像素射线的深度。因此不端到端学习跟踪,而是组合两个冻结前端——用于2D对应的稠密光流与用于第三维的单目度量深度网络——只学习它们无法提供的残差:该深度由紧凑状态空间模型Mamba-3在DINOv3外观特征条件下进行细化。选择SSM而非Transformer的关键在于固定大小的循环状态使显存开销不随帧数增长,而注意力机制需要线性增长的KV缓存。
AI.result: 在TAPVid-3D minival基准上,最佳配置在相同评估条件下取得最高的绝对度量精度(mean metric Average Jaccard为0.256),超过强前馈跟踪器;配套分析使用各竞争方法自身的评估器复现,解释了为何若干已发表跟踪器在该预算下损失大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过"冻结前端+仅学习深度残差"的组合式设计与Mamba状态空间建模,可在单张消费级GPU、无位姿、单体素的约束下实现绝对米制精度的3D点跟踪,为度量级4D重建与具身导航提供了可行的算力友好范式;同时揭示了现有Transformer类跟踪器在固定预算下的精度退化问题。

title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有无训练视觉token剪枝的性能下降并非仅因信息不可逆丢失，而存在"表征-利用差距"：剪枝后的视觉表征仍可被采样利用，只是模型使用不可靠。作者提出SCOPD（稀疏上下文同策略自蒸馏）及SCOPD+（视觉敏感位置选择性蒸馏），在10%视觉token保留率下将性能保持率从86.37%提升至92.43%。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLM将图像/视频作为长视觉token序列处理，推理成本高。无训练token剪枝可降本，但激进压缩会显著掉点，常规解释是任务相关视觉信息不可逆丢失。作者认为该解释不完整，真实瓶颈在于视觉证据虽可被访问却未被可靠利用。
AI.method: 1）用固定上下文的Pass@K分析揭示"表征-利用差距"：同一剪枝表征重复采样可恢复贪心解码漏掉的样本。2）提出SCOPD：学生模型从剪枝视觉token生成推理轨迹，特权全上下文教师在同一同策略前缀上监督，无需真值答案、不改结构、不增推理开销。3）提出SCOPD+：用小幅视觉预算干预定位视觉敏感响应位置并选择性蒸馏。
AI.result: 10%视觉token保留下，Vanilla模型在13个基准上保留未剪枝性能的86.37%，SCOPD提升至90.49%，SCOPD+进一步提升至92.43%。结论在不同token预算、基准和剪枝算子下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理不仅取决于剪枝后保留哪些视觉信息，还取决于模型能否可靠地学会使用这些信息；将剪枝问题从"信息保留"重构为"表征-利用差距"可带来显著性能增益。

authors: Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
summary: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (\rho=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.

AI.tldr: 构建建筑跨表征多模态识别基准 ARCH-B（354题、11类原型、3.9M图像语料），评测25个多模态模型与5830份人类回答，模型准确率10.45%–83.90%，人类基线35.35%，人机难度仅弱相关（ρ=0.33）。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型对视觉环境的解释能力不断增强，但其在同一建筑跨照片、平面图、立面、剖面与渲染图等不同表征间进行身份识别与表征迁移的能力尚缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 基于3.9M建筑图文语料构建与建筑实体绑定的数据池，采用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导的难度筛选与人工校验，形成354道四选一题、覆盖11种跨表征原型；评测25个多模态模型并采集非专家人类基线响应。
AI.result: 模型准确率区间10.45%–83.90%，人类基线35.35%；模型在混合表征离群检测与照片匹配上相对较好，在平面图—照片对应上较弱；人机跨原型难度弱相关（Spearman ρ=0.33）；留出评测表明筛选出的难度可泛化至策展模型之外。
AI.conclusion: ARCH-B 提供了面向建筑媒介跨表征视觉对应与表征迁移的诊断性评测，揭示了当前多模态模型在跨媒介识别上的系统性短板。

title: SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models can produce high-quality posterior samples for inverse problems, but typically require tens to thousands of network evaluations per draw. MeanFlow enables one-step generation, yet applying it to inverse problems leaves no intermediate steps at which to enforce measurement consistency. We introduce SNaP, a one-step MeanFlow posterior sampler for linear inverse problems with Gaussian noise. Its central innovation is a measurement-adapted source: a Gaussian distribution whose mean and anisotropic covariance are determined by the measurement operator, observation, and noise level. The source anchors well-measured directions while preserving variation where the measurements are weak or uninformative. We show that the exact conditional flow transports this source to the true posterior. Across natural-image restoration and multi-coil MRI, SNaP produces diverse, high-quality samples with one network evaluation per draw, 30 to 2250 $\times$ faster than iterative samplers.

AI.tldr: 提出SNaP：面向线性高斯逆问题的一步MeanFlow后验采样器，通过"测量自适应源分布"（均值与各向异性协方差由测量算子、观测和噪声水平决定）实现单次网络评估生成多样高质后验样本，证明条件流精确传输该源至真实后验，在自然图像复原与多线圈MRI上比迭代采样快30–2250倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型虽能产生高质量逆问题后验样本，但每次采样需数十到数千次网络评估，计算昂贵；MeanFlow虽支持一步生成，但其轨迹无中间步骤，难以在采样过程中施加测量一致性约束。因此需要一种无需迭代即可保持数据一致性的单步后验采样方法。
AI.method: SNaP为线性高斯噪声逆问题的一步MeanFlow后验采样器。核心是对源分布进行测量自适应设计：用测量算子、观测值与噪声水平确定高斯源的均值与各向异性协方差——在测量充分的方向上"锚定"先验信息，在测量薄弱或无信息的方向上保留变化自由度。作者从理论上证明，精确的条件流（conditional flow）可将该自适应源传输至真实后验分布，从而保证采样的正确性，同时保持单次前向评估的采样效率。
AI.result: 在自然图像复原任务与多线圈MRI重建上，SNaP每次抽样仅需一次网络评估即可生成多样且高质量的后验样本，相较迭代采样器加速30至2250倍，同时保持样本质量与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过测量自适应源分布设计，SNaP将MeanFlow的一步生成能力成功拓展到贝叶斯逆问题后验采样，在无需中间步骤施加一致性约束的前提下兼顾了测量一致性与采样效率。该思路对快速、不确定性感知的图像复原与医学成像重建具有实用价值。

title: WhiteCon: Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation Regression Through Whitening Transform and Dual Consistency
summary: Domain adaptation is crucial for addressing distributional shifts that degrade model performance across domains. While most existing research has centered on classification, semi-supervised domain adaptation regression (SSDAR) for continuous-output tasks remains largely unexplored, particularly in practical scenarios with limited labeled target data. To address this gap, we propose semi-supervised domain adaptation regression through whitening transform and dual consistency (WhiteCon), which combines domain-specific whitening transform (DWT) and dual consistency regularization to enhance training stability and domain adaptation. DWT reduces the variance of the model parameters by transforming the feature covariance matrix into an identity matrix, thus stabilizing training under ordinary least squares assumptions. In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 WhiteCon，用域特定白化变换（DWT）与对偶一致性正则化解决半监督域适应回归（SSDAR）问题，在多个基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 域适应研究多集中于分类任务，半监督域适应回归（SSDAR）在连续输出任务上探索不足，尤其目标域标注数据稀缺时性能下降明显。
AI.method: WhiteCon 包含两部分：1) 域特定白化变换（DWT），将特征协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵，降低模型参数方差，在普通最小二乘假设下稳定训练；2) 对偶一致性正则化，其中方差一致性正则化对齐弱增强、强增强及 mixup 增强特征的方差，提升对增强扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集的 SSDAR 设定下，WhiteCon 相比现有方法达到 SOTA，有效缓解回归任务中的域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 白化变换与一致性正则化结合可有效提升半监督域适应回归的稳定性与跨域泛化，代码已开源。

title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
summary: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态动物重识别数据集 MetaWild（20890 张图、6 物种，含环境元数据）与轻量 Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA)，可将元数据注入现有 VLM-based ReID 方法，实验证明引入元数据后性能稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 Animal ReID 数据集仅依赖视觉信息，忽略了生态学中与动物行为、身份高度相关的环境元数据（温度、昼夜节律等）；同时现有 VLM 资源未充分利用文本/元数据的推理潜力。
AI.method: 构建 MetaWild 数据集：从相机陷阱叠加文本与场景上下文中提取环境元数据，与图像配对。提出 Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA)，一个轻量适配模块，可插入已有 VLM-based ReID 流程，使模型同时利用元数据与视觉特征进行重识别。
AI.result: 在 MetaWild 上，基线 ReID 模型 + MFA 相比仅用视觉信息在多种设置下性能一致提升，验证元数据对重识别的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 元数据（环境上下文）是 Animal ReID 中被忽视的有效信号，MFA 提供即插即用方案；MetaWild 为该方向提供多模态基准资源。

title: The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation
summary: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization. In particular, SpecMatch outperforms conventional feature matching in 40 of 42 teacher--student and training-setting combinations, while consistently improving over the original student model in all settings. We further demonstrate that the proposed objective generalizes beyond vision, improving downstream performance across six protein understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现传统的基于L2距离的特征匹配蒸馏目标偏向重建教师表征中的主导演方向，而欠优化低方差但含任务信息的谱方向，提出谱平衡特征匹配SpecMatch，自适应强调欠优化的谱方向，实现简单、开销极小，在图像识别与蛋白质理解任务上广泛验证。
AI.motivation: 大视觉基础模型迁移性强，但部署成本高。无标注的特征匹配知识蒸馏是常用压缩手段，然而作者指出传统L2特征匹配目标存在谱偏差：过度优化教师表征中能量占优的主方向，忽略方差小却含任务相关信息的低能量方向，从而限制了学生模型的下游迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出SpecMatch（谱平衡特征匹配），一种简单的特征匹配目标函数，在保留主导演方向相对重要性的同时，自适应地加大对欠优化谱方向的强调权重。方法实现简便，几乎不增加计算开销，可直接替换常规L2特征匹配损失。
AI.result: 在图像识别任务的广泛实验显示，SpecMatch在图像分类、异常检测、医学图像分析和领域泛化等多样下游任务中持续提升适应性能。在42种教师—学生与训练设置组合中有40种优于常规特征匹配，且在所有设置下均优于原始学生模型；此外该目标可推广到视觉之外，在六个蛋白质理解任务上提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 特征匹配蒸馏的性能瓶颈部分源于L2目标的谱偏差，通过谱平衡重加权可显著提升蒸馏学生模型的下游迁移能力；该方法通用性强，可跨图像识别与蛋白质理解等非视觉领域。

title: SpatialSkill: Self-Evolving Skills for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning requires a model to align different viewpoints into a coherent spatial representation, yet this ability remains challenging for vision-language models despite being natural to humans. Existing methods typically improve spatial reasoning by updating model weights, which keeps the acquired knowledge implicit and tied to a specific backbone. We propose \textit{SpatialSkill}, a weight-update-free framework that enables a frozen vision-language model to accumulate explicit natural-language reasoning skills from offline trajectories. Unlike symbolic tasks, perceptual skills cannot be reliably verified simply by executing them: a plausible spatial rule may lack visual support or require transformations that the frozen model cannot perform. SpatialSkill therefore admits candidate skills only after visual-grounding and executability checks, constrains manual evolution to prevent harmful regressions, and routes skills by spatial-reasoning category to reduce negative transfer. On CityCube, across four frozen executors, SpatialSkill yields consistent gains, and a 9B executor equipped with SpatialSkill surpasses the strongest closed-source reference in our evaluation. The skills are stored in a versioned natural-language manual, making the reasoning strategies explicit and auditable without modifying model parameters. Code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialSkill——一种无需更新权重的框架，让冻结的视觉语言模型从离线轨迹中积累显式的自然语言空间推理技能；技能经视觉接地与可执行性校验、受约束的人工演化并按推理类别路由，在 CityCube 上跨四个冻结执行器取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 跨视角空间推理（将不同视点对齐为连贯空间表征）对人类自然、对 VLM 仍困难。现有方法多通过更新模型权重提升空间推理，导致知识隐式化且绑定于特定骨干网络，难以迁移、审计和复用。
AI.method: 1) 冻结 VLM，不修改参数；2) 从离线轨迹中提炼候选自然语言技能，并通过视觉接地检查（是否有视觉证据支撑）与可执行性检查（冻结模型能否执行所需变换）才予以接纳；3) 对人工演化施加约束，防止有害回退；4) 按空间推理类别路由技能，抑制负迁移；5) 技能以版本化自然语言手册存储。
AI.result: 在 CityCube 上，跨四个不同冻结执行器均取得一致的性能提升；配备 SpatialSkill 的 9B 执行器超过评测中最强的闭源参考模型。
AI.conclusion: 空间推理技能可以以显式、可审计的自然语言形式跨骨干累积，无需权重更新即可获得稳定收益，为空间推理能力提供了一种可插拔、可迁移的替代范式。

title: PrefLUT: Reusable and Refinable Personalized Color Editing from Pairwise Preferences
summary: Photographic color editing is inherently personal: the same image can appear too warm, too muted, or already satisfactory to different users. Most lookup table (LUT) and reference-guided methods target a specified appearance rather than model persistent preferences from repeated user choices. To address this gap, we introduce PrefLUT, a reusable and refinable user-preference modeling framework for deployable 3D LUTs, encoding ordered preferred/non-preferred image pairs into a lightweight Reusable User Profile that is reused across queries and refined using additional user preference pairs, without per-user optimization. A Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor combines this profile with each image to predict a LUT latent vector and edit strength. An Identity-Residual LUT Decoder and Edit-Strength Controller then produce an exportable 3D LUT. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate effective personalized editing and general-purpose enhancement. Each quantized profile requires only 260 bytes, and editing takes 1.365 ms/image on an RTX 5090 GPU. We also introduce the Preference-Conditioning Verification Protocol (PCVP), an evaluation protocol to verify whether personalized image edits depend on user preferences and the query image through controlled changes to user profiles, preference orders, pair correspondences, and query images.

AI.tldr: PrefLUT：将用户偏好的图像对编码为可复用、可细化的"用户画像"，结合查询图像预测3D LUT隐向量与编辑强度，导出可部署的3D LUT，实现个性化照片调色。
AI.motivation: 摄影调色高度个人化，同一图像在不同用户看来可能偏暖、偏淡或已满意；现有LUT与参考图引导方法只能针对指定外观，无法从用户反复选择中建模其持久偏好。
AI.method: 构建PrefLUT框架：将有序的偏好/非偏好图像对编码为轻量级"可复用用户画像"（跨查询复用、可由新增偏好对细化，无需逐用户优化）；查询条件化LUT预测器结合画像与图像预测LUT隐向量及编辑强度；身份-残差LUT解码器与编辑强度控制器输出可导出3D LUT；并提出偏好条件化验证协议PCVP，通过受控改变用户画像、偏好顺序、图像对对应关系与查询图像来检验个性化编辑是否真正依赖偏好与查询图像。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上实现有效的个性化编辑与通用增强；量化后每个用户画像仅260字节，RTX 5090上编辑耗时1.365 ms/图。
AI.conclusion: PrefLUT以极小存储与低延迟实现了可复用、可细化的用户偏好建模，并将偏好条件化验证作为个性化编辑的评估协议，为可部署个性化调色提供方案。

title: Analytical and Convolutional Neural Network-Based Motion-Vector Propagation for Efficient Video Object Detection
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Continuous video analytics requires accurate localization at low latency within embedded power budgets. This paper presents a hardware-software design methodology that reuses codec motion vectors (MVs) between detector invocations. Two alternative models support translation and scale changes: analytical motion-vector propagation (Analytical-MV) and learned propagation using a convolutional neural network (CNN) (CNN-MV). The learned model uses convolutional operations and independent object updates suited to parallel execution on an edge graphics processing unit (GPU). Analytical-MV combines a harmonic-mean precision-recall score (F1) of 0.909 with a mean end-to-end latency of 9.03 ms and an energy consumption of 0.177 J per frame, yielding the lowest latency and energy among the evaluated configurations. Relative to detection on every frame, it reduces mean latency by 25.9% and energy per frame by 36.4%. CNN-MV offers a different trade-off: its fastest configuration raises recall from 0.871 for Analytical-MV to 0.890 and lowers mean power from 19.64 to 17.32 W, while achieving a latency of 18.42 ms and an energy consumption of 0.319 J per frame. It is therefore useful when recall or operating power is more important than minimum latency and energy. Execution on a deep learning accelerator (DLA) further reduces time-averaged GPU utilization relative to GPU execution. Host-processing optimization substantially improves both latency and energy, demonstrating the value of jointly designing temporal models and their execution pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出复用编解码器运动矢量的硬件-软件协同设计方法，用于低延迟、低功耗的连续视频目标检测定位于嵌入式平台。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式功耗预算下连续视频分析难以同时满足高精度、低延迟与低能耗，逐帧检测代价过高，需要利用帧间冗余减少检测调用次数。
AI.method: 提出两种检测器调用间的传播模型：解析式运动矢量传播（Analytical-MV）与基于CNN的学习式传播（CNN-MV）；CNN-MV采用卷积操作与独立目标更新，适配边缘GPU并行执行，并进一步在DLA上执行以降低时均GPU占用，同时进行主机侧处理优化。
AI.result: Analytical-MV达到F1=0.909、平均端到端延迟9.03 ms、每帧能耗0.177 J，较逐帧检测降低平均延迟25.9%、每帧能耗36.4%；CNN-MV最快配置将召回率由0.871提升至0.890，平均功耗由19.64 W降至17.32 W，但延迟为18.42 ms、每帧能耗0.319 J。DLA执行进一步降低GPU时均利用率。
AI.conclusion: 复用编解码器运动矢量并在模型与执行流水线间联合设计，可在边缘功耗预算内显著改善连续视频分析的延迟与能效，并在精度-功耗间提供可调权衡。

title: Beyond Geometry: Benchmarking and Consistency Reasoning for 3D Logical Anomaly Detection
summary: Existing 3D industrial anomaly detection mainly targets local geometric deviations. In contrast, many industrial anomalies violate object-level design or assembly rules, which we define as 3D logical anomalies. To address these challenges, we introduce the Industrial Logical Anomaly Detection Dataset (ILGAD), the first scalable benchmark dedicated to logical anomalies in industrial point clouds. ILGAD contains 2,774 samples from 15 categories with point-level annotations and covers existence, specification, pose, and assembly-state errors. To detect such 3D logical anomalies, we propose a consistency reasoning framework that assesses whether local geometry, structure coverage, and spatial relations conform to the normal design. The framework detects geometric changes, unsupported expected structures, and abnormal local arrangements. Experiments on ILGAD, Anomaly-ShapeNet, and IEC3D demonstrate superior object-level detection and point-level localization, showing that the framework effectively detects logical anomalies and generalizes to conventional geometric defects.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向工业点云“3D逻辑异常”的可扩展基准ILGAD（15类、2774样本、点级标注），并给出基于一致性推理的检测框架，验证对象级检测与点级定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D工业异常检测主要针对局部几何偏差，而许多工业异常违反的是对象级设计或装配规则（如缺失、规格、姿态、装配状态错误），这类“3D逻辑异常”缺乏适配的数据与检测方法。
AI.method: 构建ILGAD数据集，覆盖存在性、规格、姿态、装配状态四类逻辑错误；提出一致性推理框架，通过检测几何变化、识别应有结构缺失、评估空间关系与结构覆盖是否符合正常设计来判定异常。
AI.result: 在ILGAD、Anomaly-ShapeNet、IEC3D上取得更优的对象级检测与点级定位表现，并能泛化至常规几何缺陷检测。
AI.conclusion: 将3D逻辑异常从局部几何偏差中区分出来，数据集与一致性推理框架可同时处理逻辑异常与传统几何缺陷，为工业点云异常检测提供新范式。

title: CAST: Reconstruction-Coupled Acceleration of Interactive World Models
summary: Interactive world models must respond quickly to controls while preserving scene consistency. Existing acceleration methods can miss heterogeneous control responses and spatial transport when recovering skipped features. We observe that interaction-induced feature changes correlate with approximation error, while low-frequency interpolation errors are phase-sensitive and show more predictable phase progression. These findings motivate CAST, a reconstruction-coupled inference framework. CAST selects anchors by interaction sensitivity and cross-layer coverage, reconstructs skipped residuals with frequency- and confidence-aware Phase-Aware Reconstruction (PAR), and coordinates historical KV routing according to downstream reconstruction responsibility. On Matrix-Game 3.0 and HY-World 1.5, CAST achieves 2.15x and 3.48x speedups, respectively, while maintaining visual quality close to Native (Figure 1). It also attains the highest VBench scores among compared methods and leads non-native baselines on seven and six of thirteen WorldMark dimensions, demonstrating a balance of generation speed, visual quality, and interactive responsiveness under real-time control. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出CAST推理加速框架，通过交互敏感锚点选择、相位感知残差重建(PAR)与历史KV路由协调，实现交互式世界模型在保持画面一致性的前提下最高3.48倍加速。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需在实时控制下快速响应并保持场景一致性，但现有加速方法在恢复被跳过的特征时，忽略了异构的控制响应差异与空间传输特性。
AI.method: 观察到交互引起的特征变化与近似误差相关、低频插值误差对相位敏感且相位演进更可预测；据此设计CAST：按交互敏感度与跨层覆盖度选择锚点，用频率与置信度感知的相位感知重建(PAR)恢复跳过的残差，并按下游重建责任协调历史KV路由。
AI.result: 在Matrix-Game 3.0与HY-World 1.5上分别取得2.15x与3.48x加速，视觉质量接近Native；对比方法中VBench得分最高，WorldMark十三个维度中分别领先非原生基线七项和六项。
AI.conclusion: CAST在生成速度、视觉质量与实时控制下的交互响应性之间取得平衡，为交互式世界模型的高效推理提供可复用的耦合式重建框架，代码已开源。

title: Geometric Encoding for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are far more reliable at recognizing what appears in a video than at reasoning about its spatial and temporal properties, such as metric distances, object dimensions, and consistent object identities across frames. We present Geometric Code, a perception-to-geometry pipeline that computes explicit spatial structure from video and supplies it to VLMs as context to augment reasoning. A perception layer segments and classifies objects and recovers depth, camera pose, and intrinsics from monocular RGB video. A deterministic geometric engine then back-projects, merges, and cleans these outputs into a spatial code, including per-object positions, dimensions, counts, inter-object distances, appearance order, and room geometry. The code is serialized into VLMs' prompts, either alongside the video or replacing it entirely. Specifically, there is no component trained or fine-tuned in our approach. On VSI-Bench, augmenting 2B and 4B open models with the spatial code improves average accuracy by +4.1 points over the frames-only baseline, with the largest gains on numeric estimation tasks such as absolute distance (+24.1 points). The results suggest that explicitly computed geometry, delivered through the language channel, recovers spatial competence that small VLMs cannot extract from pixels alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 Geometric Code 感知-几何流水线：从单目 RGB 视频用现成模型恢复深度、相机位姿与物体分割，再经确定性几何引擎反投影、融合、清理，生成含物体位置/尺寸/数量/间距/出现顺序/房间几何的空间代码，序列化进 VLM 提示（可替代视频），无任何训练或微调。在 VSI-Bench 上使 2B/4B 模型平均提升 +4.1 分，绝对距离任务提升 +24.1 分。
AI.motivation: VLM 擅长识别视频中"有什么"，但在度量距离、物体尺寸、跨帧一致身份等空间与时间属性推理上明显不足。作者希望在不训练模型的前提下，把显式几何结构通过语言通道注入 VLM，弥补小模型无法从像素中提取空间信息的能力缺口。
AI.method: 三段式无训练流水线：1）感知层用现成模型分割分类物体，并从单目 RGB 视频恢复深度、相机位姿与内参；2）确定性几何引擎对输出做反投影、跨帧融合与清理；3）生成空间代码，包含逐物体位置、尺寸、数量、物体间距离、出现顺序及房间整体几何；将代码序列化写入 VLM 提示，可与视频并用或完全替代视频输入。
AI.result: 在 VSI-Bench 上，将空间代码作为上下文增强 2B 与 4B 开源模型，平均准确率较仅用帧的基线提升 +4.1 分；数值估计类任务增益最大，绝对距离估计提升 +24.1 分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，显式计算并被语言化的几何结构能够恢复小型 VLM 无法仅从像素中提取的空间能力；该范式说明在视频空间推理中，"计算几何 + 语言通道注入"是训练-free 的有效补充路径。

title: Functional Hand Type Prior for 3D Hand Pose Estimation and Action Recognition from Egocentric View Monocular Videos
summary: Current methods for egocentric view action recognition often face challenges in perceiving dynamic hand movements relying solely on geometrical or physical information. In this work, we effectively address this problem by gaining insights into the correlation between functional hand configurations and objects, which improves the detailed interpretation of real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce a practical taxonomy of hand types based on the functioning perspective and utilize it for per-frame hand type labeling on existing datasets. We also propose a novel hand action recognition framework considering semantic details of the hand type as prior. This approach boosts the network's understanding of the continuous hand interaction throughout the action sequence. Our whole pipeline consists of three main modules: (1) Feature Extraction, (2) Egocentric Knowledge Module, which estimates 3D hand pose, object category, and hand type leveraging short-term cues, and (2) Egocentric Action Module, which aggregates per-frame knowledge, including text embeddings of hand type, over a longer time. In our extensive experiments with large-scale benchmarks, FPHA and H2O, our model outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superior performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种以"手部功能类型"语义先验为核心的第一人称视角手部动作识别框架，通过构建手型分类体系并逐帧标注，结合3D手姿、物体类别与手型估计，提升对连续手-物交互的建模能力，在FPHA与H2O基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视角动作识别中，仅依赖几何或物理信息难以准确刻画动态手部运动。作者希望引入"手部功能构型与物体之间的关联"这一语义线索，从而更细致地解释真实场景中的手-物交互。
AI.method: 流程含三个模块：(1) 特征提取；(2) Egocentric Knowledge Module，利用短时线索估计3D手姿、物体类别与手部类型；(3) Egocentric Action Module，在更长时间跨度上聚合逐帧知识，包含手型的文本嵌入。同时提出基于功能视角的手型分类体系，并对现有数据集进行逐帧手型标注，将手型语义作为先验注入网络。
AI.result: 在FPHA和H2O两个大规模基准上，模型性能优于当前最先进方法，验证了手型语义先验对连续手部交互理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将功能性手型语义作为先验引入第一人称动作识别可显著增强对连续手-物交互的理解，该思路在多个大规模基准上得到验证。

title: Natural Image Autoencoder-Based fMRI Representations for Trait and State Prediction
summary: Foundation models pre-trained on large-scale fMRI datasets have shown strong downstream performance, but at substantial data and computation cost. To investigate how much fMRI-specific pre-training is actually needed for such performance, we introduce FReD, which derives fMRI representations from a frozen Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) pre-trained exclusively on natural images and pairs them with a task specific readout. For trait prediction, FReD summarizes frame-wise representations by their temporal mean and log-standard deviation and applies linear probing, with late fusion across two normalization schemes. For state prediction, it represents each frame as a single token and models temporal dependencies with a shallow Transformer. Across four resting-state datasets spanning six trait-prediction targets, linear probes on frozen DCAE features generally outperform those on fMRI foundation model representations and remain competitive with fully fine-tuned fMRI foundation models. On three task-fMRI state-prediction tasks, a temporal readout on DCAE features performs comparably to the strongest foundation models evaluated. A Gaussian injection analysis further shows that localized signal changes are recovered more accurately from the frozen DCAE features than from the evaluated foundation-model representations. Together, these results show that strong performance on current fMRI benchmarks is possible without fMRI-specific representation pre-training, making frozen natural-image features as a useful baseline for assessing its added value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FReD，直接复用冻结的、仅在自然图像上预训练的DCAE特征来做fMRI表征，配合任务特定读出层，在四个静息态数据集六个特质预测目标上线性探测结果普遍优于fMRI基础模型表征，并在三个任务态状态预测上与最强fMRI基础模型相当。
AI.motivation: fMRI基础模型依赖大规模fMRI数据预训练，数据与算力成本高昂。作者希望探究：获得强下游性能究竟需要多少fMRI专属预训练，是否存在无需fMRI预训练即可达到同等性能的替代方案。
AI.method: FReD从冻结的DCAE（仅自然图像预训练）中提取fMRI表征，并接任务特定读出层。特质预测：对逐帧表征取时间均值与对数标准差，线性探测，并在两种归一化方案上做late fusion。状态预测：每帧表示为单token，用浅层Transformer建模时间依赖。另用高斯注入分析检验局部信号变化恢复能力。
AI.result: 在四个静息态数据集、六个特质预测目标上，冻结DCAE特征的线性探测普遍优于fMRI基础模型表征，且与全量微调的fMRI基础模型相当。三个任务态fMRI状态预测任务上，DCAE特征的时间读出层与最强基础模型表现相当。高斯注入分析显示DCAE特征对局部信号变化的恢复比所评估的基础模型表征更准确。
AI.conclusion: 当前fMRI基准上的强性能并非必须依赖fMRI专属表征预训练，冻结自然图像特征可作为评估fMRI预训练增量价值的有效基线。

title: AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: AGILE-GS 将"寻找信息"与"选择相机"解耦：在 SE(3) 上用黎曼梯度上升优化一个虚拟锚点位姿标记最大不确定性区域，再用贪心岭杠杆筛选出一个不冗余的候选短列表，从而把 NBV 选择从全池渲染/求 Fisher 信息降到极少量视图，延迟降低 1—2 个数量级。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 辐射场重建依赖数百个视角，且视角摆放位置与数量同等重要。现有 NBV 方法通常对候选池中每个候选都打分并取最优，计算代价高、延迟大。作者认为"搜索信息"与"挑选相机"本质上是两个可分离的子问题，耦合在一起导致冗余计算。
AI.method: (1) 在 SE(3) 流形上以期望信息增益为目标，用黎曼梯度上升优化一个虚拟锚点位姿；该锚点无需可达、也不在候选池内，仅指示模型最不确定的观测几何。(2) 以锚点的观测几何为参照对候选打分。(3) 通过贪心岭杠杆（ridge-leverage）步骤把候选池蒸馏为小型、非冗余的短列表，该过程无需渲染任何候选。AGILE-GS 直接取短列表首个视角作为下一个视角（不为任何候选计算 Fisher 信息）；AGILE-GS+ 仅对短列表内的少量视角计算 Fisher 信息增益并择优。
AI.result: 在标准基准以及闭环具身采集任务上，AGILE-GS 与 AGILE-GS+ 均达到或超过现有基线，同时将视角选择延迟降低 1—2 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将 NBV 中的信息搜索与相机选择解耦、并用锚点几何 + 无渲染的杠杆筛选构建短列表，是一种通用且高效的加速范式；在不牺牲重建/采集质量的前提下大幅压缩 NBV 的决策开销，适用于离线基准与闭环具身主动感知。

title: Enhanced Video Text Editing with Trajectory-Aligned Glyph Rendering
summary: Video text editing aims to replace or add text in a video while keeping the rest of the video unchanged, which requires the edited text to be correct in every frame and to move coherently with the scene. Despite the remarkable progress of video diffusion models, they struggle to reproduce exact stroke structures and often produce garbled or wrong characters, especially for characters with complex strokes. To address this, we propose a trajectory-aligned glyph rendering reference that provides explicit per-frame glyph guidance following the position and perspective of the text, and a depth-normalized recognizer feature supervision that supervises the generated text on multi-depth features of a frozen text recognizer with per-depth normalized errors, targeting stroke errors overlooked by the diffusion loss. We further build VTEdit, a benchmark of 288 real-scene clips with 440 annotated text trajectories covering text replacement and text addition, which will be publicly released to facilitate future research. Experiments on VTEdit show that our method outperforms image text editing methods, video editing methods, and commercial models in text accuracy and background preservation, achieving a sentence accuracy of 0.9408, and receives the highest preference in a user study.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹对齐字形渲染参考与深度归一化识别器特征监督，实现视频文字编辑中逐帧字形正确与运动连贯，并构建VTEdit基准（288个真实场景片段、440条文字轨迹）。
AI.motivation: 视频文字编辑要求逐帧文字正确且随场景透视连贯运动，但现有视频扩散模型难以复现精确笔画结构，复杂笔画字符常出现乱码或错字。
AI.method: 两点核心设计：(1) 轨迹对齐的字形渲染参考（trajectory-aligned glyph rendering reference），按文字位置与透视提供显式的逐帧字形引导；(2) 深度归一化识别器特征监督（depth-normalized recognizer feature supervision），用冻结文字识别器的多层特征、按深度归一化误差进行监督，以弥补扩散损失忽略的笔画错误。
AI.result: 在VTEdit上，方法在文字准确率与背景保持上优于图像文字编辑方法、视频编辑方法及商用模型，句级准确率达0.9408，用户研究偏好最高。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式字形轨迹引导与识别器特征监督，可有效缓解视频扩散模型的文字生成错误；VTEdit基准将公开以促进后续研究。

title: CRF Loss is How Networks Should Learn Boundaries in Weakly Supervised Segmentation
summary: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) learns pixel-level predictions from image-level tags. Recent work focuses on improving coarse CAMs extracted from large vision-language models (commonly CLIP), but does little to improve their accuracy along segment boundaries. That job is instead delegated to a post-processing method like DenseCRF. However, because DenseCRF relies on low-level colour cues, it can flip correct labels to incorrect ones when neighbouring pixels share similar colours. SAM has recently been adopted as a natural alternative, yet it simply takes on DenseCRF's role as an intermediate "refinement" step that outputs one-hot pseudo-labels in prior work. By discarding the valuable uncertainty in CAMs, these one-hot pseudo-labels turn borderline errors into confidently wrong targets. Our key insight is that CAMs should supervise training alongside SAM boundaries, each through its own loss, rather than being fused together into a single hard target. Inspired by CRF potentials, we propose a framework that disentangles soft pseudo-labels as unary supervision and binary edge maps as pairwise supervision. We realize our framework in a single-stage model, DS-CRF, using CAMs from this http URL and boundaries from SAM. DS-CRF sets a new state-of-the-art of 56.5% mIoU on MS COCO.

AI.tldr: 提出单阶段框架 DS-CRF，将 CAM 作为一元监督（软伪标签）、SAM 边界作为二元成对监督，二者通过各自损失解耦，而非融合为硬标签，在 MS COCO 上达到 56.5% mIoU 的 WSSS 新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 WSSS 聚焦于改进 CLIP/CAM 的粗粒度质量，边界精度依赖后处理（如 DenseCRF）；DenseCRF 依赖低层颜色线索，颜色相近时会翻转正确标签；SAM 虽被引入，但仅充当 DenseCRF 式的"精炼"步骤，输出 one-hot 伪标签，丢弃了 CAM 中的不确定性，使边缘错误变成自信的错误目标。
AI.method: 受 CRF 势函数启发，将监督拆解为两部分：CAM 提供的软伪标签作为一元（unary）监督，SAM 提供的二值边缘图作为成对（pairwise）监督，分别使用独立损失；在单阶段模型 DS-CRF 中实现，CAM 来自 CLIP，边界来自 SAM。
AI.result: 在 MS COCO 上取得 56.5% mIoU，刷新弱监督语义分割的 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将 CAM 与 SAM 边界解耦为软标签与边缘两种监督信号、并各自设计损失，优于将二者硬融合为单一目标的做法，为 WSSS 提供了新的监督设计范式。

title: MotionSpaceFlow: Representation-Aware Flow Matching in Direct Motion Space
summary: Recent advances in diffusion and flow models have substantially improved text-driven human motion generation. Yet most methods generate in low-dimensional, temporally downsampled latent spaces learned primarily for reconstruction, a bottleneck that can limit generation quality and preclude direct manipulation of individual frames and joints. We introduce MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow), a representation-aware flow-matching framework that predicts clean motion directly in continuous motion space without a learned encoder or decoder. To account for the anisotropic structure of direct motion representations, we propose representation-aware noise scaling and show how the initial Gaussian source scale governs the covariance of intermediate probability-path marginals. We further introduce a Representation-Aware Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (RA-MMDiT), which jointly updates token-level language and full-resolution motion features through joint attention while adapting temporal information flow to the motion representation: causal attention for incremental features defined by frame-to-frame changes, and bidirectional attention for global features such as absolute joint coordinates. Across different datasets and motion representations, MSFlow achieves state-of-the-art text-to-motion performance. Its global representation variant additionally enables zero-shot, inference-time control over any joint or frame through projection sampling without control-conditioned training, delivering leading motion quality with exact constraint satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow)，一种表示感知的 flow-matching 框架，直接在连续运动空间预测干净运动，无需学习式编码器/解码器，并支持零样本推理时关节/帧级控制。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动人体运动生成方法多在低维、时间降采样的隐空间（主要为重建而学）中生成，形成瓶颈，既限制生成质量，也无法直接操纵单帧与单关节。
AI.method: 1) 直接在连续运动表示空间中做 flow matching，去除编解码器；2) 针对直接运动表示的各向异性，提出表示感知的噪声缩放，分析初始高斯源尺度如何决定概率路径中间边缘分布的协方差；3) 提出 Representation-Aware Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (RA-MMDiT)，通过联合注意力同时更新 token 级语言特征与全分辨率运动特征，并按表示类型适配时间信息流：帧间增量特征用因果注意力，绝对关节坐标等全局特征用双向注意力。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与运动表示上取得 SOTA 的 text-to-motion 性能；其全局表示变体在无控制条件训练的情况下，通过投影采样实现零样本、推理时对任意关节或帧的控制，运动质量领先且约束精确满足。
AI.conclusion: 直接在连续运动空间建模可突破隐空间瓶颈，表示感知的噪声缩放与注意力设计是关键；该框架兼具 SOTA 生成质量与免训练的灵活控制能力。

title: ConvCue: Complementary Visual Inductive Biases for Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance across a broad range of multimodal tasks, yet still struggle with visual questions that require fine-grained discrimination and spatial understanding. These limitations motivate investigating whether supplementary visual representations can improve existing VLMs without replacing their native visual encoders. Pretrained convolutional networks offer a candidate feature source, motivated by their local connectivity and spatial weight sharing. We introduce CONVCUE, which augments the native visual representations of a pretrained VLM with final-stage features from a parallel, frozen pretrained CNN. A learnable adapter maps convolutional features to the native visual feature dimension, while gated cross-attention allows the original visual tokens to retrieve information from the CNN features. The enhanced tokens are passed through the original visual-to-language projector, and the model is adapted through a two-stage training procedure. We evaluate CONVCUE on Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B across 13 multimodal benchmarks covering visual question answering, document and chart understanding, and multimodal reasoning. CONVCUE improves average benchmark performance over both the original models and matched two-stage fine-tuning controls on all three backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it improves over the original model on all 13 benchmarks and raises the average score from 75.00 to 78.82 relative to the matched fine-tuning control. These results show that pretrained convolutional representations, when integrated through learned adaptation and fusion, can improve the visual understanding of existing VLMs without replacing their original visual encoders.

AI.tldr: CONVCUE 在不替换 VLM 原生视觉编码器的前提下，将冻结的预训练 CNN 末阶段特征经适配器映射后，通过门控交叉注意力注入原生视觉 token，经两阶段训练提升细粒度判别与空间理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现代 VLM 在细粒度判别和空间理解类视觉问题上仍存在明显短板。作者认为预训练卷积网络的局部连接性和空间权重共享可提供互补的局部空间特征，因此探索在保留原生视觉编码器的前提下引入补充视觉表征来增强现有 VLM。
AI.method: 方法为 CONVCUE：并行的冻结预训练 CNN 提供末阶段特征，可学习适配器将其映射至原生视觉特征维度，门控交叉注意力让原始视觉 token 从 CNN 特征中检索信息；增强后的 token 送入原视觉-语言投影器，采用两阶段训练完成适配。在 Qwen3-VL-2B/4B 与 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 三个骨干、13 个多模态基准（VQA、文档与图表理解、多模态推理）上评测。
AI.result: 在三个骨干上，CONVCUE 的平均基准性能均优于原始模型和匹配的两阶段微调对照。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上于全部 13 个基准均有提升，平均分相对匹配微调对照从 75.00 提升至 78.82。
AI.conclusion: 预训练卷积表征若通过学习式适配与门控融合进行集成，可在不替换原视觉编码器的情况下提升现有 VLM 的视觉理解能力。该工作属通用多模态感知增强，未涉及机器人实机验证或具身操作证据。

title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Latent world models offer a promising way to improve Vision-Language-Action policies by capturing the consequences of actions. However, models trained primarily on expert demonstrations have limited exposure to failure outcomes and may struggle to distinguish visually similar successful and failed interactions. We propose \textbf{WorldGuide}, a framework that learns these distinctions in latent space and uses them to guide policy training. WorldGuide combines predictive pretraining on successful and failed trajectories with contrastive learning on matched success--failure pairs. The learned predictor then provides a differentiable reward to guide joint optimization of the policy and visual encoder. The predictor is discarded after training, so deployment requires no additional world-model inference. Extensive experiments show that WorldGuide substantially improves VLA reliability and achieves state of the art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv, reaching \textbf{96.8\%} and \textbf{72.0\%}, respectively. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: WorldGuide 通过在潜空间中对比成功/失败轨迹的预测模型提供可微奖励，引导 VLA 策略与视觉编码器联合优化，训练后丢弃预测器，在 LIBERO 100 和 SimplerEnv 上达到 96.8% 与 72.0%。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略主要依赖专家演示训练，对失败结果暴露不足，难以区分视觉上高度相似的成功与失败交互；需要一种能显式建模动作后果并区分成败的机制来提升策略可靠性。
AI.method: 先用成功与失败轨迹做预测式预训练，再对匹配的成功—失败对做对比学习，使潜空间中的预测器能区分二者；学到的预测器在训练阶段提供可微奖励，用于策略与视觉编码器的联合优化；训练完成后丢弃预测器，部署时不引入额外世界模型推理开销。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 100 上达到 96.8%，在 SimplerEnv 上达到 72.0%，均取得当时最优性能，并显著提升 VLA 的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将成功/失败判别嵌入潜空间世界模型，并以其作为可微奖励引导 VLA 训练，是一种不增加部署成本且有效的可靠性提升方案；但评测仍以仿真基准为主，缺乏真实机器人验证，代码仅承诺开源。

title: WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation
comment: Project page: this https URL . Code repository: this https URL (implementation coming soon)
summary: Despite rapid progress, world models still lack explicit, persistent structural memory, making it difficult to preserve consistent world structure during continual scene expansion and cross-view revisits. To address this limitation, we present WorldWeave, a world generation framework that decouples world-state maintenance from visual rendering. Specifically, WorldWeave combines continual elevation-map generation with agent-guided scene organization and stitching to build an expandable explicit 3D world that incrementally extends structural memory while preserving existing structure. First, its terrain module uses diffusion-based image outpainting to generate continuous metric elevation maps under neighborhood conditioning and boundary constraints. Next, an agent integrates user intent, terrain evidence, and cross-region connectivity constraints to construct scenes through hierarchical semantic planning, deterministic geometry compilation, and local revision. Finally, during visual generation, planned camera trajectories query world geometry through a read-only interface, producing depth sequences that guide video synthesis without writing the generated results back into the world state. As a result, structural memory remains independent of short-window video generation, enabling continual expansion without predefined map boundaries and providing a consistent geometric basis for observations across trajectories and repeated visits.

AI.tldr: WorldWeave 将世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦，用扩散外绘持续生成高程图、由智能体做语义规划与几何编译，构建可扩展的显式 3D 世界，使结构记忆独立于短视频生成窗口。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型缺少显式、持久的结构性记忆，在持续扩展场景和跨视角回访时难以保持世界结构一致。作者希望让结构记忆不再受限于短视频生成窗口，从而支持无预设边界的世界扩展与跨轨迹一致观测。
AI.method: WorldWeave 将世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦。地形模块用基于扩散的图像外绘，在邻域条件与边界约束下生成连续度量高程图；智能体结合用户意图、地形证据与跨区域连通性约束，通过分层语义规划、确定性几何编译和局部修正构建场景；视觉生成阶段由规划相机轨迹通过只读接口查询世界几何，生成深度序列引导视频合成，且不回写世界状态。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅声明：结构记忆独立于短视频生成，可在无预设地图边界下持续扩展，并为跨轨迹及重复访问的观测提供一致的几何基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出以显式 3D 世界状态为持久记忆、以只读几何查询驱动渲染的世界生成范式，为持续场景扩展与跨视角一致性提供了可行框架，但尚缺真实数据上的量化验证与开源证据。

title: Uncovering Ordinal-Matching Bias in Audio-Visual LLMs
summary: This work aims to improve how audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) associate speech with the correct visible speaker in multi-speaker scenes. We find that current AVLLMs frequently fail at this task, and analyze the nature of these failures. To this end, we construct a synthetic diagnostic dataset in which multiple visible speakers each utter a single word. Analysis on this corpus reveals a consistent error pattern across three recent open-source AVLLMs: models attribute utterances by simply matching the order of spoken sentences with the left-to-right, top-to-bottom arrangement of visible faces, rather than relying on audio-visual cues such as lip synchronization. We term this behavior \emph{ordinal-matching bias}. We further show that this bias can be substantially mitigated through a simple remedy, Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning (OD-FT), in which models are fine-tuned on synthetic videos where spatial positions of speakers and speaking order are independently randomized. Despite using only 400 synthetic training videos, OD-FT not only suppresses ordinal-matching bias but also improves audio-visual understanding on real-world videos, yielding average gains of 8.27\% for Qwen2.5-Omni and 2.57\% for video-SALMONN2+ across three audio-visual benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现当前音视频大语言模型（AVLLM）在多说话人场景中依靠"序数匹配偏差"（将语音顺序与画面中人脸的从左到右、从上到下的排列顺序对应）来分配说话人，而非依赖唇同步等音视频线索；提出序数解耦微调（OD-FT），仅用400个合成视频即可缓解该偏差，并在三个音视频基准上提升真实视频理解能力。
AI.motivation: AVLLM在多说话人场景中需将语音正确关联到可见说话人，但现有模型在此任务上频繁失败。作者希望揭示其失败机理，并找到低成本的有效改进方案。
AI.method: 构建合成诊断数据集（多个可见说话人各说一个单词），用于定位错误模式；在三个开源AVLLM上验证一致偏差；提出OD-FT微调方法，在说话人空间位置与说话顺序被独立随机化的合成视频上微调模型，打断序数与空间的耦合。
AI.result: 三个近期开源AVLLM均表现出一致的序数匹配偏差；OD-FT在仅使用400个合成训练视频的条件下显著抑制该偏差，并提升真实视频上的音视频理解，Qwen2.5-Omni平均提升8.27%、video-SALMONN2+平均提升2.57%（三个音视频基准）。
AI.conclusion: 模型可能依赖序数匹配等浅层捷径而非真正的音视频对应关系；通过针对性数据解耦设计的轻量微调即可同时消除偏差并在真实场景获得泛化收益。

title: ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry
summary: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at this https URL .

AI.tldr: REGDIFF：面向体素化超材料几何生成的生成框架，结合隐空间正则化（RAS机制）与引导扩散（SRR引导），以缓解"合理性-新颖性"权衡，并提出体素基准与评估模块。
AI.motivation: 体素表示可统一表达桁架、壳、多孔等多类超材料几何，但基于体素的生成存在"合理性-新颖性"矛盾：贴近已知几何可保持几何规律性，偏离则利于新颖性却易产生退化几何。需在二者之间取得平衡。
AI.method: REGDIFF将体素表示与隐空间正则化及引导扩散耦合：(1) repel-and-sink (RAS) 机制，平滑合理几何的隐分布；(2) short-range repulsion (SRR) 引导，抑制生成过度接近已知样本，同时保持几何合理性。此外构建覆盖桁架与壳型超材料的体素基准，并配套几何合理性、新颖性、多样性的评估模块。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上平均超越体素生成基线：几何合理性+8.9%、新颖性+46.4%、多样性+128.6%。
AI.conclusion: REGDIFF是面向下游评估的强几何候选生成器，代码已开源。

title: Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle
summary: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇综述，主张可信媒体不应依赖单一真实性标记，而应整合"从媒体中恢复的取证证据"与"生产时记录、随资产传播的溯源证据"，并讨论这些证据在常规处理或刻意篡改后是否仍然有效。
AI.motivation: 生成式系统使逼真媒体可被无痕生成与修改，外观不再能说明场景是被拍摄、合成还是被篡改，传统的"以貌取真"信任机制失效，需要重新界定真实性证据的作用条件。
AI.method: 综述性整合：将媒体取证（被动从媒体中恢复证据）与内容溯源/生产记录（主动记录并随资产流通保存）两类路径统一到一个框架中，并以"证据是否契合待答问题、能否抵达判断者、是否允许被更好信息修正"为判据评估其效力。
AI.result: 论证不存在普适的真实性标记；不同证据类型只能回答特定问题，且在常规处理或蓄意操纵后其有效性会衰减或失效。
AI.conclusion: 可信媒体应以问题适配、可传递、可纠错的证据生态来维持媒体历史的可理解性，而非追求单一真实性标准。

title: SegBanana: Steering Unified Multimodal Models into Medical Segmenters
summary: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in practical deployment, as models often struggle to generalize beyond the distributions covered by their training data and high-quality pixel-level annotations are typically unavailable for adaptation. Inspired by the cross-task transferability of large language models, we investigate whether unified multimodal models (UMMs) can transfer their pretrained visual understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities to medical image segmentation without task-specific post-training. By recasting segmentation as structured visual generation, we find that frontier UMMs (e.g., Nano Banana) already exhibit basic segmentation capabilities across diverse clinical scenarios, but still struggle with challenging tasks requiring specialized anatomical or domain-specific knowledge. We further show that these limitations can be effectively mitigated by incorporating visual anatomical knowledge from in-context exemplars, expanding candidate solutions through repeated sampling, and refining suboptimal predictions via targeted this http URL by these observations, we propose SegBanana, to our knowledge, the first agentic visual generation framework for training-free medical image segmentation. SegBanana builds on a frozen UMM as the core generative model, augmented with Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval and Comparative Quality Critique to unlock its potential segmentation capability. A State-Aware Multimodal Controller maintains structured state and iteratively orchestrates these tools, repeatedly refining intermediate predictions toward higher-quality masks. Across eight medical segmentation datasets, SegBanana achieves an average mDice of 77.45%, outperforming representative generalist (SAM3 and SegGPT) and medical-specific (BiomedParse and MedSAM3) baselines by at least 14.93 points, while remaining robust to out-of-domain visual supports.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练智能体式视觉生成框架 SegBanana，以冻结的统一多模态模型为核心，通过解剖知识检索与比较式质量评判迭代精化掩码，在八个医学分割数据集上平均 mDice 达 77.45%，显著超越通用与医学专用基线。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割在实际部署中面临两大瓶颈：模型难以泛化到训练分布之外，且目标域缺乏高质量像素级标注用于适配。受大语言模型跨任务迁移能力启发，作者探索统一多模态模型（UMM）能否在不做任务特定后训练的情况下，将其预训练的视觉理解、推理与生成能力迁移到医学分割任务。
AI.method: 将分割重构为结构化视觉生成任务；观察到前沿 UMM（如 Nano Banana）已具备基础分割能力，但在需专门解剖或领域知识的困难任务上失效。据此提出 SegBanana：以冻结 UMM 为核心生成模型，引入 Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval（解剖感知知识检索）与 Comparative Quality Critique（比较式质量评判）两个工具，并由 State-Aware Multimodal Controller 维护结构化状态、迭代编排工具调用，通过上下文示例注入解剖知识、重复采样扩展候选解、对次优预测做定向精化，逐步提升掩码质量。
AI.result: 在八个医学分割数据集上平均 mDice 达 77.45%，较代表性通用基线（SAM3、SegGPT）与医学专用基线（BiomedParse、MedSAM3）至少高出 14.93 个点，同时对域外视觉支持（out-of-domain visual supports）保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型的预训练视觉能力可经智能体式编排直接迁移至医学分割，无需任务特定训练；解剖知识检索、重复采样与质量评判是解锁该能力的关键。SegBanana 是首个面向免训练医学图像分割的智能体式视觉生成框架。

title: DecFlowEdit: Self-Localized Flow-based Image Editing via Guidance Decoupling
summary: Flow-based image editing (FlowEdit) enables inversion-free semantic changes through the difference between source and target velocities. In this paper, we observe that FlowEdit's default classifier-free guidance (CFG) configuration, with asymmetric source and target scales, causes substantial background leakage. Matching these guidance scales, for example by removing CFG, improves edit-relevant localization but severely degrades editability. To get the best of both worlds, we propose DecFlowEdit, which decouples the optimal guidance scales for localization and for editing in flow-based generative models. In particular, DecFlowEdit first extracts an edit-relevant prior by temporally aggregating velocity differences evaluated without CFG, and then uses this prior to reweight the original updates under default CFG. Our method remains training-free and inversion-free, requiring neither external spatial masks nor attention manipulation. Experiments on PIE-Bench across FLUX, SD3, and SD3.5 show that DecFlowEdit improves background preservation, reducing structure distance by approximately 61 to 73 percent and background LPIPS by 68 to 80 percent relative to FlowEdit at comparable editing fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 DecFlowEdit：解耦 FlowEdit 中定位与编辑的最优引导尺度，通过时间聚合无 CFG 的“速度差先验”再对默认 CFG 更新重加权，实现免训练、免反演、无需外部掩码与注意力操纵的图像编辑，显著改善背景保持。
AI.motivation: FlowEdit 采用源/目标不对称尺度的默认 CFG 配置会导致严重背景泄漏；而令两尺度一致（如去掉 CFG）虽改善编辑相关定位却严重损失可编辑性。作者希望在保持可编辑性的同时获得良好定位与背景保持。
AI.method: DecFlowEdit 在基于流的生成模型中解耦“定位”与“编辑”的最优引导尺度：先用无 CFG 条件下评估的速度差做时间聚合，提取编辑相关先验；再用该先验对默认 CFG 下的原始更新进行重加权。方法保持免训练、免反演，无需外部空间掩码或注意力操纵。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 上，跨 FLUX、SD3、SD3.5 实验表明：在编辑保真度相当的情况下，相比 FlowEdit，结构距离降低约 61%–73%，背景 LPIPS 降低 68%–80%，背景保持明显改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦引导尺度并利用无 CFG 速度差先验重加权，可在不牺牲可编辑性的前提下大幅提升背景保持，为流模型图像编辑提供一种无需训练与反演的通用改进方案。

title: Scaling Versatile 3D Assets Editing with a Million-Scale Dataset
summary: Although recent 3D generative models produce increasingly realistic assets, controllable 3D asset editing remains challenging. Existing methods are limited by scarce training data, insufficient source-aware modeling, and a lack of practical evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we present Alchemy3D, a unified framework for training and evaluating versatile 3D asset editors that covers data construction, model architecture, and benchmark evaluation. Specifically, we curate Alchemy3D-1M, a large-scale 3D editing dataset containing 1.25M assets and 1.38M editing pairs across seven editing types. On this data, we train a family of generative flow models for general-purpose 3D asset editing. The model family supports image- and text-conditioned editing, few-step inference, and transfer to multi-view 3D part segmentation. We further introduce GEdit3D-Bench, a large-scale, open-world benchmark with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, our method outperforms prior methods on most metrics of editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual quality.

AI.tldr: Alchemy3D：统一3D资产编辑框架，含1.25M资产/1.38M编辑对数据集Alchemy3D-1M、生成流模型族（图/文条件编辑、少步推理、可迁移至多视图部件分割）及GEdit3D-Bench基准，在编辑保真、源保留与视觉质量多数指标上超越前作。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型虽产出日益逼真资产，但可控3D资产编辑仍受限于训练数据稀缺、源感知建模不足、缺少实用评估协议。
AI.method: 构建Alchemy3D-1M大规模3D编辑数据集（125万资产、138万编辑对、7类编辑）；在此数据上训练生成流（generative flow）模型族，支持图像/文本条件编辑与少步推理，并迁移至多视图3D部件分割；提出GEdit3D-Bench开放世界基准与多维评估协议。
AI.result: 在既有及新增基准上，方法在编辑保真度、源保留、视觉质量的大多数指标上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 统一的数据—模型—评测框架可有效推进通用3D资产编辑，数据集与基准有望成为该方向的基础设施。

title: See, Measure, and Reason: Learning Visually Grounded Reasoning in Pathology
summary: Pathological assessment relies on recognizing fine-grained visual details in histological images. Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support pathology interpretation, yet their ability to perceive these details remains inadequate. This weakness leads to inaccurate cellular observations that can persist even when final answers are correct. In this paper, we propose ASPECT to improve visually grounded reasoning through explicit supervision of cellular appearance and abundance. ASPECT trains intermediate visual tokens through pathology feature reconstruction, cell feature alignment, and count supervision. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.

AI.tldr: ASPECT通过显式监督细胞外观与数量，分三阶段微调并配合强化学习，提升病理视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，并发布PathoVernier基准评估中间测量。
AI.motivation: 病理判读依赖组织学图像的细粒度视觉细节，而现有视觉语言模型对这些细节的感知不足，导致细胞观测不准确；即使最终答案正确，错误仍可能隐藏在中间测量中。作者希望改进视觉 grounding 的推理可靠性。
AI.method: 提出ASPECT：对中间视觉token施加病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐与计数监督三类显式监督；采用三阶段有监督微调（感知、生成视觉token、推理），随后用强化学习同时奖励答案正确性与与报告测量的一致性。并构建PathoVernier基准，含5个病理数据集的759道专家审核题、覆盖4类细胞组成任务，同时评估最终答案与中间测量。
AI.result: 在PathoVernier上，ASPECT较最强基线Gemini-3.1-Pro相对准确率提升约19.2%，较其Qwen3-VL-8B骨干提升99.3%；RAWR（正确回答内计数错误指标）分别降低28.1%与42.7%。在三个外部病理基准的分类与问答任务上也优于骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式监督细胞外观与数量、并让奖励与测量一致性对齐，可显著增强病理VLM的细粒度视觉 grounded 推理；同时表明仅看答案准确率会掩盖中间观测错误，需引入中间测量评估。

title: Dexterous Tactile World Model
summary: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.

AI.tldr: DTWM将预训练视频扩散Transformer与手套触觉信号结合，通过零初始化残差注入每只手对应视频token位置，构建以自我为中心的视频世界模型，显著降低手部运动低估与感知误差。
AI.motivation: 操作过程中决定走向的事件（如接触的建立与释放）在视觉上难以观察，却更易通过触觉感知；现有视频世界模型缺乏触觉模态，导致手部动态预测偏差较大。
AI.method: 基于预训练视频扩散Transformer，将每只手套的触觉信号以零初始化残差方式注入对应手部位置的视频token；使用因果掩码防止预测帧访问未来信息；通过与视觉单模态模型在架构、参数量、训练上对齐进行对照，并做消融（二值接触状态替换、幅值与空间位置）比较。
AI.result: 相比视觉单模态模型，手部运动低估从23%降至9%，手部区域感知误差降低7.4%（每种模型3次训练）；随预测时域增加收益增大，后段chunk改进约为首段的4.1倍；优于同设定下其他视触觉世界模型；即使推理时无触觉输入，训练中使用触觉仍带来提升；力的大小与空间位置均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 触觉为视频世界模型提供了视觉难以获取的接触事件监督，力信号的时间进程可指示交互是持续还是变化，触觉条件化能有效提升长时域未来帧预测。

title: Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings
