To this end, we introduce a physics-guided spectral distillation (PSD) method, which reduces model capacity for real-time applications while maintaining the high performance of underwater image enhancement models. To decompose the outputs of teacher and student models, PSD adopts a multilevel Haar discrete wavelet transform. It transfers low-frequency color and illumination information as well as high-frequency structural details through band-specific objectives. Moreover, the distillation process of PSD is degradation-aware. We estimate degradation-aware weights through a physical head and combine them with ground-truth-guided reliability masks to selectively retain valuable teacher guidance. Experiments on the UIEB, LSUI, and EUVP datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Furthermore, we demonstrate the benefits of enhanced images for downstream perception tasks, including object detection. Deployment on a self-developed ROV further demonstrates its practical applicability in real-world underwater scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导光谱蒸馏(PSD)方法,通过多级Haar小波分解与退化感知加权蒸馏,在保持水下图像增强性能的同时压缩模型以支持实时部署,并在ROV上验证实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有水下图像增强研究主要关注增强质量与视觉保真度,很少考虑资源受限水下机器人所需的实时部署能力,亟需在压缩模型容量的同时保持高性能。
AI.method: PSD采用多级Haar离散小波变换分解教师与学生模型的输出,通过频带特定目标迁移低频颜色/光照信息与高频结构细节;蒸馏过程为退化感知,利用物理头估计退化感知权重,并与真值引导的可靠性掩码结合,选择性保留有价值的教师指导。
AI.result: 在UIEB、LSUI与EUVP数据集上验证了有效性;展示了增强图像对下游感知任务(如目标检测)的收益;在自研ROV上的部署进一步证明真实水下场景中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的小波域光谱蒸馏可有效实现水下图像增强模型的实时化,兼顾增强质量与部署可行性,并有益于下游感知任务。

title: ControlTrace: Recovering Control Fields for Hidden-Content Recognition
summary: Spatially conditioned diffusion models can embed words and contours in natural-looking images, but vision-language models (VLMs) may fail to recognize the hidden content. Transformation-based recovery depends on parameter and view selection. To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition, we construct FreqBlind, a 6,000-image benchmark spanning contours, real words and non-words across three conditioning strengths. The evaluated transformation-based methods show limited recognition of contour patterns and weakly conditioned hidden content. To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace to recover the grayscale control field used during generation. An 8.4M-parameter U-Net predicts this field from the carrier image, and a VLM then identifies its content. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, ControlTrace achieves 60.2% open-ended contour recognition accuracy across the three conditioning strengths, exceeding the best of the three evaluated prior methods by 26.9 percentage points. On an A100 GPU, the complete pipeline adds only 7.4 ms (5.3%) to direct VLM inference. Recovered fields have lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformation views. Across four evaluated VLMs, ControlTrace retains its overall contour recognition advantage. Recognition remains stable under the tested JPEG compression, Gaussian noise and downsampling. These results support control-field recovery for hidden-content recognition in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 该文构建FreqBlind基准并提出ControlTrace，用8.4M参数U-Net从载体图像恢复生成时的灰度控制场，再交由VLM识别隐藏内容，轮廓识别达60.2%，较最佳基线提升26.9个百分点，仅增加5.3%推理开销。
AI.motivation: 空间条件扩散模型可将文字与轮廓嵌入自然图像，但VLM往往无法识别这些隐藏内容；基于变换（旋转、缩放等）的恢复方法依赖参数与视角选择，效果有限，因此需要一个系统性基准与更可靠的恢复途径。
AI.method: 构建FreqBlind基准（6,000张图像，覆盖轮廓、真实词与非词，三种条件强度）；提出ControlTrace：用8.4M参数U-Net从载体图像预测生成时使用的灰度控制场，再由VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct）识别其中内容；与三种基于变换的既有方法对比，并在四种VLM、JPEG压缩、高斯噪声与下采样条件下测试稳健性。
AI.result: ControlTrace在三种条件强度下平均开放轮廓识别准确率60.2%，超最佳基线26.9个百分点；A100上整条流程仅增加7.4 ms（5.3%）；恢复场的像素误差更低、结构相似度更高；四种VLM上均保持优势，且在测试的JPEG、噪声、下采样下识别稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在评测设定下，直接恢复控制场比变换视图更有利于隐藏内容识别，ControlTrace以极小开销取得稳定的轮廓识别增益，支持"控制场恢复"这一技术路线。

title: From Perception to Integration: Revisiting the Internal Dynamics of Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer simple visual questions, but often struggle when one question requires several visual judgments. We study this gap with controlled tasks for feature binding, numerosity, spatial relations, and amodal completion, together with a Composite task that combines them. Matched counterfactual image pairs isolate changes in the visual evidence needed to answer. Across four models, direct answers, hidden-state readouts, and state interventions show that the individual judgments can be made without explicit reasoning and that intervening on the corresponding states can affect the answer. During reasoning, the Composite answer becomes decodable from hidden states and usable from shortened traces, often before the model stops on its own. We train a small detector to predict this readiness and stop reasoning at that point. On MMStar and RealWorldQA, this reduces mean reasoning tokens by 79.1% and 74.5%, while average accuracy rises by 3.13 and 3.30 percentage points, respectively. These findings connect the internal development of answer readiness to a practical rule for allocating reasoning computation.

AI.tldr: 该研究用受控任务（特征绑定、数量、空间关系、非模态补全及组合任务）与匹配的反事实图像对，证明VLM的多项视觉判断可无需显式推理完成，并通过检测隐状态中的"答案就绪"信号提前终止推理，在MMStar/RealWorldQA上减少约75-79%推理token且准确率提升约3点。
AI.motivation: VLM能回答简单视觉问题，但在需要多项视觉判断的复合问题上表现较差；作者希望厘清这一差距的来源——是视觉判断本身不能被隐式完成，还是推理计算分配不当，并据此找到更高效的推理终止规则。
AI.method: 设计特征绑定、数量、空间关系、非模态补全四类受控任务及组合任务，配以匹配的反事实图像对以隔离所需视觉证据的变化。对四个模型进行直接回答、隐状态读出与状态干预实验；训练一个小型探测器预测推理过程中答案何时可从隐状态解码，并据此提前停止推理。
AI.result: 单项判断可无需显式推理完成，干预对应隐状态可影响答案；组合任务答案在推理早期即可从隐状态解码，并可从截断的推理轨迹中获得。在MMStar与RealWorldQA上，提前停止使平均推理token减少79.1%与74.5%，平均准确率分别提升3.13与3.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 答案就绪性在模型内部会逐步形成，可将此内部信号转化为分配推理计算量的实用规则：在答案已就绪时停止推理，从而同时提升效率与准确率。

title: ESTHER: Egocentric Stereo Hand Estimation and Reconstruction in the Wild
summary: Human dexterity is guided by two eyes watching two hands: binocular vision supplies the metric 3D structure that fine-grained manipulation consumes. Egocentric stereo is therefore the natural perceptual interface for robots, AR, and VR-yet metric 3D hand reconstruction from this very signal still has neither an end-to-end model nor an in-the-wild benchmark. We propose ESTHER, a model whose stereo geometry, temporal reasoning, and output representation are designed for wearable egocentric stereo. It is trained on pseudo-labels from a calibrated labeling pipeline and in turn assembles our benchmark ESTHER3D, an egocentric stereo hand dataset pairing a large in-the-wild training set of model-generated labels with a motion capture test set of true metric ground truth. Experiments show state-of-the-art accu?racy, superior external generalization, and robustness to the missing views, dropped frames, and lighting and motion blur extremes of real egocentric capture that break existing meth?ods. This robustness runs deeper than graceful degradation: stereo guidance teaches the model to bind apparent hand scale to metric depth, so it not only adapts to different stereo rigs and modalities with minimal fine-tuning, but more strikingly preserves true metric scale even after collapsing to a single monocular view.

AI.tldr: 提出 ESTHER：面向头戴自中心双目（egocentric stereo）的端到端度量 3D 手部重建模型，涵盖双目几何、时序推理与输出表示设计，并基于标定式伪标签流程训练，产出配套基准 ESTHER3D。
AI.motivation: 人类手部灵巧操作依赖双目视觉提供的度量 3D 结构，自中心双目因而是机器人、AR/VR 的天然感知接口；但基于该信号的度量 3D 手重建既缺乏端到端模型，也缺乏真实场景（in-the-wild）基准。现有方法在真实自中心采集的缺视角、丢帧、光照与运动模糊极端条件下易失效。
AI.method: ESTHER 针对可穿戴自中心双目联合设计三部分：双目几何建模、时序推理模块、以及适配双目度量输出的手部表示。训练使用经标定的标注流水线生成的伪标签；再以该模型产出大规模真实场景训练标签，与动捕获得的真值度量测试集配对，构成 ESTHER3D 基准。
AI.result: 实验显示 SOTA 精度、更强的外部泛化能力，以及在真实自中心采集的缺视角、丢帧、光照与运动模糊极端条件下优于现有方法的鲁棒性；仅需极少微调即可适配不同双目装置与模态；尤为突出的是，即使退化为单目视图仍能保持真实度量尺度。
AI.conclusion: 双目几何引导使模型将表观手部尺度与度量深度绑定，从而获得超越“优雅降级”的鲁棒性与尺度泛化；ESTHER 与 ESTHER3D 为可穿戴自中心双目度量手重建提供了模型与基准。

title: Generative Residual Factorization
summary: Under a shared-factor model, the conditional law of the next image patch factors into a posterior over the shared scene factor and a residual kernel given that factor. A sufficient statistic of the past replaces the raw past in the posterior and does not replace the kernel. The conditional entropy splits into residual entropy, which no observation of the factor can remove, and a posterior term, which a better representation of the past can remove. Next-embedding prediction is a directional likelihood on a shallow map, so the fiber of that map is unidentified and a constant embedding remains a minimizer. The same split is an equality in a scalar Gaussian model, evaluated in closed form.

AI.tldr: 本文在共享因子模型下将下一图像块的条件分布分解为共享场景因子的后验与给定该因子的残差核，并证明条件熵可拆为不可消除的残差熵与可通过更好表示消除的后验项；指出 next-embedding 预测是浅层映射上的方向似然，其纤维不可辨识，常数嵌入仍是最优解，并在标量高斯模型中给出闭式等式。
AI.motivation: 自监督预测式表示学习（如 next-embedding prediction）在实践中有效，但缺乏理论刻画：不清楚哪些预测不确定性来自场景本身、哪些来自过去表示的不足，因此无法判断改进表示能消除哪部分熵。作者希望为"预测下一观测"这一范式给出可分解的信息论解释，并揭示其可辨识性缺陷。
AI.method: 在共享因子（shared-factor）模型假设下分析：将下一图像块的条件律分解为共享场景因子的后验与给定因子后的残差核；用过去的充分统计量替换后验中的原始过去，但残差核保持不变，由此得到条件熵的加性分解。进一步将 next-embedding 预测视为定义在浅层映射上的方向似然，从映射纤维的角度分析其不可辨识性。最后在标量高斯模型中对同一分解给出闭式等式验证。
AI.result: 条件熵被严格拆分为两部分：残差熵（观测到共享因子也无法消除，属于数据内在随机性）与后验项（更好的过去表示可以消除）；充分统计量只作用于后验项而不影响残差核。同时证明浅层映射的纤维不可辨识，常数嵌入仍是目标函数的极小值点，说明该目标本身不足以阻止表征坍塌。标量高斯情形下分解以闭式等式成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为下一嵌入/下一块预测提供了信息论分解视角，区分了不可约的残差不确定性与可约的表示不足，并从映射纤维角度解释了常数嵌入最优的可辨识性问题。贡献上更偏理论与分析，未提供机器人或三维重建等任务上的实证验证，对具体系统的直接指导有限。

title: WM-VLM: Probing Internal World Models for Interleaved Visual-Textual Reasoning
summary: Humans often solve spatial problems by mentally simulating visual transformations. In contrast, conventional vision-language models (VLMs) reason primarily through language. We investigate whether VLMs can solve spatial problems by reasoning with both text and generated visual states. To this end, we introduce WM-VLM, which equips a pretrained VLM with a lightweight world model branch for generating intermediate visual states. Our two-stage training first teaches the model to generate the next visual state and then to use that state for reasoning. We programmatically construct spatial reasoning tasks with verifiable intermediate visual states. These tasks allow us to evaluate how well the model generates visual states and how much it relies on them to answer the question. On 2D and 3D mental rotation tasks, WM-VLM consistently outperforms the supervised fine-tuned backbone, with gains of up to 39.25 percentage points. Ablations suggest that these gains depend on the generated visual states, as removing or corrupting them sharply reduces performance. Together, these results suggest that internal world models offer a promising path toward VLMs that reason in both language and visual space.

AI.tldr: 提出 WM-VLM，用两阶段训练为预训练 VLM 加装轻量世界模型分支，先生成下一视觉状态再据此推理，在 2D/3D 心理旋转任务上较 SFT 基线最高提升 39.25 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 人类常通过心理模拟视觉变换解决空间问题，而现有视觉语言模型主要依赖语言推理，缺乏在视觉空间中显式推演状态的能力。作者希望探索 VLM 能否同时用文本与生成的视觉状态进行空间推理。
AI.method: 为预训练 VLM 附加一个轻量世界模型分支以生成中间视觉状态；采用两阶段训练，先学会预测下一视觉状态，再学会利用该状态作答；同时用程序化方式构造带可验证中间视觉状态的空间推理任务，用于评估状态生成质量及其对答案的贡献。
AI.result: 在 2D 与 3D 心理旋转任务上，WM-VLM 稳定优于监督微调主干，最高提升 39.25 个百分点；消融表明增益依赖生成的视觉状态，移除或破坏这些状态会显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 内部世界模型为 VLM 在语言与视觉空间中双重推理提供了有前景的路径，但当前验证限于程序化构造的旋转任务。

title: Multi-Scale Semantic Mapping in Urban Environments via Observation Calibration and Policy Dependence Regularization
summary: Semantic mapping is fundamental to embodied navigation, yet existing methods are developed for indoor environments, where objects exhibit relatively limited scale variation and are observed from a restricted range of viewpoints. Urban environments pose substantially greater challenges: agents must map objects ranging from pedestrians to buildings while navigating large spaces with highly diverse viewing distances. These conditions introduce two key difficulties that existing datasets and methods fail to cover. First, object scale and observation distance can be severely mismatched. For example, small objects may be viewed from far away, whereas large objects may be observed at extremely close range, resulting in unreliable observation likelihoods. Second, objects with substantially different sizes and geometries require distinct mapping behaviors, which are difficult to capture with a single shared value estimator. To investigate these challenges, we introduce a large-scale urban semantic mapping dataset featuring realistic city layouts, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level annotations spanning multiple object scales. We then propose a category-aware likelihood calibration policy that identifies and alleviates unreliable observations according to object category and viewing distance. Because the calibration and motion policies are optimized toward the same mapping objective, they may learn redundant shortcuts and become excessively coupled. We therefore introduce a mutual-information (MI) regularizer that penalizes their estimated representation dependence and encourages complementary behaviors. To better model heterogeneous mapping strategies across object scales, we further employ category-wise value estimators. We formulate their joint optimization as a Pareto optimization problem to mitigate conflicting gradients across categories.

AI.tldr: 本文面向城市具身导航的语义建图，提出大规模城市语义建图数据集，并设计类别感知的似然校准策略、互信息正则化与按类价值估计器，通过Pareto优化缓解类别间梯度冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有语义建图方法主要面向室内场景，物体尺度变化有限、视角范围受限。城市场景中物体尺度差异极大（行人到建筑）、观测距离分布广泛，导致两个问题：(1) 物体尺度与观测距离严重失配，观测似然不可靠；(2) 不同尺度与几何形态的物体需要不同的建图行为，单一共享价值估计器难以刻画。
AI.method: (1) 构建大规模城市语义建图数据集，具备真实城市布局、高保真渲染与跨多物体尺度的实例级标注；(2) 提出类别感知的似然校准策略，按物体类别与观测距离识别并缓解不可靠观测；(3) 由于校准策略与运动策略共享同一建图目标易产生冗余捷径与过度耦合，引入互信息正则项惩罚二者表示的依赖、鼓励互补行为；(4) 采用类别级价值估计器建模异构建图策略；(5) 将联合优化建模为Pareto优化问题，缓解类别间梯度冲突。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅报告了所提数据集及方法框架：类别感知似然校准、互信息正则化、类别级价值估计器与Pareto联合优化，用于应对城市大尺度场景下的观测失配与异构建图问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将语义建图从室内推向大规模城市环境，强调尺度—距离失配与异构建图策略两大挑战，并以数据、校准策略、表示解耦正则和Pareto多目标优化构成完整方案，为城市具身导航建图提供新基准与方法思路。

title: Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression
summary: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 TALF：把属性变换显式作用于学习到的空间表征，使其与变换域编码目标对齐，并证明所得特征恰为光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项（Taylor 余项有界）；集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，在系数域做显式系数预测与条件残差熵建模，统一率失真优化，保留量化步长控制。三个基准数据集、多种变换基上率失真性能优于传统与学习基线。
AI.motivation: 基于变换的点云属性压缩框架中，引入学习式空间上下文需要把空间表征映射到变换域，而这种已知的基变换通常被留给网络隐式学习，效率与可解释性受限。
AI.method: 将属性变换直接施加于学习到的空间表征，显式对齐编码目标（TALF）；理论上分析该特征等价于光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项且 Taylor 余项有界；将其嵌入变换域编解码器，进行显式系数预测、条件残差熵建模，统一系数域率失真目标，并保留显式量化步长控制。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集和多种变换基上的大量实验表明，TALF 相比传统方法和其他学习式基线均取得率失真性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式对齐变换与学习特征是一种有效且有理论支撑的设计，可提升点云属性压缩的率失真性能。

title: ORAV: Benchmarking Audio-Video Generation from Multimodal Contexts
summary: Audio-video generation using heterogeneous multimodal references has emerged as a new challenge, requiring both compositional control over generation and grounded understanding of multimodal context. In this paper, we introduce ORAV Bench for Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation, comprising 380 task instances with 2-10 references, 9 semantic roles, and 30 role compositions. Instructions specify the relationships among references; the media supply the identities, dynamics, and audio characteristics to be realized. To evaluate these open-ended outputs, we develop a reference-aware pairwise protocol that prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares the intended contribution of each reference, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders. On held-out instances, it achieves 86.08% effective agreement with human judgments. Across 5 frontier systems, overall rankings conceal distinct strengths across reference compositions. A recurring failure is to reproduce unintended source content in place of the requested result, despite closely resembling a reference. Reproducible pointwise diagnostics of quality, reference affinity, and speech reveal distinct dimensions of model behavior. ORAV thus offers a benchmark for tracking progress toward controllable, compositional, and reference-faithful audio-video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ORAV Bench：面向多模态参考的音频-视频生成基准，含 380 个任务、2–10 个参考、9 类语义角色与 30 种角色组合，并给出参考感知的成对评测协议（与人判断一致率 86.08%）。
AI.motivation: 带异构多模态参考的音频-视频生成是新出现的挑战：既要对生成过程做组合式控制（角色/身份/动态/音频特征的分工），又要真正理解多模态上下文中的指代关系。现有评测缺少能同时考察"组合控制"与"参考忠实性"的基准与协议，特别是无法定位"哪条参考应贡献什么"。
AI.method: 构建 ORAV 基准：380 个任务实例，每个含 2–10 条参考、覆盖 9 种语义角色与 30 种角色组合；指令显式指定参考间关系，媒体则提供身份、动态与音频特征。评测采用参考感知的成对（pairwise）协议：先准备视觉与听觉证据，逐条比较各参考的预期贡献，再在两种呈现顺序下核验整体结论，从而缓解位置偏置。另提供可复现的逐点（pointwise）诊断指标，分别刻画质量、参考亲和度与语音表现。
AI.result: 在留出实例上，该成对协议与人类判断达到 86.08% 的有效一致率。在 5 个前沿系统上，整体排名掩盖了不同参考组合下各自的优势与弱点；一个反复出现的失败模式是把未预期的源内容复现出来，替代了所要求的生成结果，尽管其与某条参考高度相似。逐点诊断显示质量、参考亲和度、语音是彼此独立的模型行为维度。
AI.conclusion: ORAV 为"可控、可组合、参考忠实"的音频-视频生成提供了可追踪进展的评测基准，强调评测需按参考角色分解，而非仅给单一总分。

title: EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.

AI.tldr: EviSplat 提出一种开放词汇 3D 场景理解方法，基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 保留每个观测（视图）的独立特征作为证据，在文本查询到来时按查询相关性聚合，避免预查询融合导致的信息丢失。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 方法（多基于 3DGS）在查询未知前就把多视图观测（如掩码裁剪）压缩为语言特征或紧凑物体描述子。但同一物体在不同视角的观测信息量不等，有的包含与特定查询相关的线索，有的则片面甚至误导。预查询压缩会抑制后续查询所依赖的线索。作者希望把多视图证据保留到查询时刻再按需聚合。
AI.method: 1) 将单视图观测特征保留在类别无关的 3D 实例内，实例可以是物体、物体部件或背景区域；2) 为每个 Gaussian 学习一个分布，描述其所支持的视觉外观；3) 给定文本查询时，先用与该实例最相关的观测对实例打分；4) 再结合实例级相关性与局部支持证据计算每个 Gaussian 的分数，并用该 Gaussian 被观测的频率与无歧义程度加权。由此，不同查询可从同一份保留证据中调用不同视觉线索。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和评测协议上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，验证了将多视图证据保留至查询时刻并按查询聚合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 把多视图观测证据延迟到查询时刻再聚合，优于预查询特征压缩；该方法为开放词汇 3D 场景理解提供了有效的证据保留与查询条件化聚合范式。局限与开源情况摘要未提。

title: When Text Matters: Design Principles for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Model
summary: Visual token pruning has been widely studied as a practical approach to reducing the computational cost of large vision-language models. However, it struggles to preserve essential visual information, which can lead to substantial performance degradation. In particular, image-based token selection can overlook task-relevant details, while text-guided token selection may fail to capture the text--visual relationships needed for complex reasoning. We find that applying textual guidance too early can limit its ability to identify answer-relevant visual regions, whereas text-to-visual attention becomes more informative at intermediate decoder depths. This finding motivates our training-free method, which separates early vision-guided pruning from deferred text-guided reselection. We first prune visual tokens using vision-encoder attention, retain additional candidates until the decoder midpoint, and then use text-to-visual attention to determine the final visual-token set. Across eight benchmarks and three models, our method outperforms the best-performing baselines by an average of 11.10 and 16.84 percentage points in performance recovery at 80% and 90% pruning, respectively, with comparable or lower LLM-prefill latency than most baselines. The source code is publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的视觉token剪枝方法：早期用视觉编码器注意力剪枝，在解码器中间层之前保留候选token，随后用文本到视觉注意力进行重选，在80%/90%剪枝率下平均性能恢复分别超越最优基线11.10和16.84个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型计算开销大，视觉token剪枝是常用手段，但现有方法难以保留关键视觉信息：基于图像的token选择会忽略任务相关细节，文本引导的选择又难以捕捉复杂推理所需的文本—视觉关系。作者发现文本引导过早介入会限制其识别答案相关视觉区域的能力，而文本到视觉注意力在解码器中层才更具信息量。
AI.method: 免训练方法，将早期视觉引导剪枝与延迟的文本引导重选分离：先用视觉编码器注意力剪枝视觉token，并在解码器中点之前保留额外候选token，再用文本到视觉注意力确定最终视觉token集合。基于该现象（文本引导时机）设计两阶段流程，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在8个基准和3个模型上，80%与90%剪枝率下性能恢复分别平均超越最优基线11.10和16.84个百分点，LLM-prefill延迟与多数基线相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导的时机是视觉token剪枝的关键因素，中期解码器深度的文本到视觉注意力更可靠；分离式两阶段剪枝在保持高效率的同时显著提升性能恢复，方法免训练且代码开源。

title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出SWiM框架，通过"工作记忆蒸馏"让MLLM在推理分割中获得自生成记忆的引导增益，推理时可无需记忆即受益。
AI.motivation: MLLM生成的推理轨迹与定位提议可作为工作记忆，重新访问同一图像与查询时能提升推理分割。作者希望把这种"重访增益"蒸馏进主干模型，使其无论推理时是否有记忆都能受益。
AI.method: 以分割质量筛选rollout构建工作记忆；用记忆条件模型作教师，在学生对自身轨迹上提供token级分布监督，而学生仅见原始图像与查询；联合优化on-policy自蒸馏与基于结果（分割质量）的强化学习。
AI.result: 在多个推理分割基准上达到state-of-the-art，验证工作记忆蒸馏的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 自生成工作记忆可作为有效上下文；通过蒸馏可将其收益内化到模型参数中，兼顾有/无记忆的推理场景。

title: P4Q: Co-designing Token Pruning and Quantization for Vision-Language Model Acceleration
summary: Vision language models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal applications, yet their substantial computational and memory costs hinder efficient deployment. Visual token pruning and post-training quantization reduce inference overhead along two complementary dimensions, namely sequence length and numerical precision. Existing workflows typically optimize these techniques independently or apply them sequentially. Their distinct optimization objectives leave critical interactions unaddressed and constrain the achievable compression performance. We revisit these designs and present P4Q, a practical co-design framework that jointly optimizes visual token pruning and low-bit quantization for efficient VLM inference. First, P4Q introduces a quantization-aware visual token selection strategy before the LLM. It applies fake quantization to copies of the features produced by the projector and selects visual tokens using statistics computed from these fake-quantized features, thereby conditioning the selector's feature-based decisions on simulated low-bit perturbations. Second, P4Q introduces a pruning-aware quantization calibration strategy. It uses the same selection strategy as pruning to calibrate the quantized model on the retained-token distribution, thereby aligning the calibration process with the pruned execution path used during deployment. By coupling these two components, P4Q achieves substantial inference speedups while maintaining comparable task performance, resulting in a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off than independently optimized pipelines. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT, P4Q achieves an average end-to-end inference speedup of 2.8x across eight distinct test sets, while retaining higher accuracy than prior compression and quantization methods.

AI.tldr: P4Q 提出视觉 token 剪枝与低比特量化的协同设计框架：在 LLM 前用伪量化特征统计量做 token 选择（量化感知选择），并用同一选择策略在保留 token 分布上做校准（剪枝感知校准），在 LLaVA-NeXT 上实现约 2.8x 端到端加速且精度优于单独优化方案。
AI.motivation: VLM 推理的算力与显存开销大，视觉 token 剪枝（缩短序列）与训练后量化（降低数值精度）是两个互补的压缩维度，但现有流程多独立或串行使用，二者优化目标不同、交互作用未被建模，压缩率受限。
AI.method: P4Q 包含两个耦合组件：(1) 量化感知视觉 token 选择：在 LLM 之前对 projector 输出的特征副本施加 fake quantization，用伪量化特征的统计量作为选择依据，使选择器的决策条件化于模拟低比特扰动；(2) 剪枝感知量化校准：采用与剪枝相同的选择策略，在保留 token 分布上校准量化模型，使校准路径与部署时的剪枝执行路径对齐。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-NeXT 上，跨 8 个测试集平均端到端推理加速 2.8x，同时精度高于既有压缩与量化方法，效率—精度权衡优于独立优化的流水线。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉 token 剪枝与低比特量化从独立/串行优化转为联合协同设计，可缓解二者目标冲突并释放更高压缩比，是 VLM 高效部署的实用方案。

title: SPOC-Net: Single-Primitive Online Composition Network for GNSS Jamming Set Recognition
summary: Reliable positioning, navigation, and timing support intelligent transportation, autonomous systems, and space-air-ground integrated networks. However, global navigation satellite system (GNSS) jamming recognizers that treat each mixture as a separate class are difficult to extend to new combinations. Therefore, this paper proposes SPOC-Net, which decomposes the recognition problem into identifying a set of basic jamming components. Multi-resolution time-frequency features and learned component queries provide evidence for each component type. A high-resolution branch estimates the number of active types, and a structured decoder combines this estimate with component evidence to select a valid set. For training, measured single-component records are the only physical samples used in gradient optimization. Their associated clean in-phase and quadrature (IQ) sequences are combined on demand during training to produce labeled mixtures with different relative powers and jamming-to-noise ratios. Separate measured mixtures from ten training-listed compositions support model selection and decoder calibration; six other compositions are reserved for final testing. Evaluation on 14,220 independently generated, conductively combined, and recorded radio frequency mixtures yields 80.69% exact-set accuracy and a 92.84% micro-averaged F1 score. On combinations excluded from model development, SPOC-Net achieves 80.89% exact-set accuracy, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 18.77 percentage points under the reported protocols.

AI.tldr: SPOC-Net将GNSS干扰识别重构为"基础干扰分量集合辨识"问题，仅用实测单分量IQ样本按需合成混合信号训练，在14,220条独立录制混合物上取得80.69%整集准确率与92.84%微平均F1，未见组合上超最强基线18.77个百分点。
AI.motivation: GNSS干扰识别对智能交通、自主系统与空天地一体化网络至关重要，但现有识别器把每种混合样式当作独立类别，类别扩展性差，无法泛化到训练中未出现的新干扰组合。因此需要一种可组合、可扩展的识别框架。
AI.method: 提出SPOC-Net，将识别分解为对一组基础干扰分量的辨识：利用多分辨率时频特征与可学习分量查询为每类分量提供证据；高分辨率分支估计活跃干扰类型数；结构化解码器结合数量估计与分量证据以选择有效集合。训练时仅使用实测单分量记录的干净IQ序列，按需组合生成不同相对功率与干噪比的标注混合样本；另用10种训练清单内组合的独立实测混合物做模型选择与解码器校准，其余6种组合作最终测试。
AI.result: 在14,220条独立生成、传导合成并录制的射频混合物上，整集准确率80.69%，微平均F1为92.84%；在未参与模型开发的组合上整集准确率80.89%，按所报协议超出最强对比方法18.77个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以分量分解代替混合类别分类的策略，使模型能泛化到训练中未出现的干扰组合，验证了按需合成训练数据与结构化解码的有效性，可用于可扩展的GNSS干扰识别与PNT保障。

title: SubRot: Signed Gradient Subspace Calibration for VLM Rotation Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but preserving multimodal capabilities at low bit widths remains challenging. Existing methods rely on modality- or token-level gradient statistics, which are susceptible to cross-sample variations in visual-to-textual token ratios and the positions of visual information, limiting statistical stability. Moreover, overly coarse aggregation through absolute values and averaging discards gradient signs and channel-wise differences, limiting the separation of modality-specific sensitivities. In contrast, the channel space provides a shared coordinate system across samples, making it a more natural basis for capturing stable task-sensitive structures. We therefore propose SubRot, a signed gradient subspace calibration method for VLM rotation quantization. Through eigendecomposition of the empirical Fisher matrix of activation gradients, SubRot identifies a sensitive channel subspace with three properties: cross-sample stability, clear sensitivity separation, and consistent signed effects on the autoregressive loss along certain directions. Guided by a local Taylor expansion, SubRot combines signed first-order guidance along sign-stable directions with second-order constraints along the remaining sensitive directions, while retaining MSE for overall reconstruction quality. This objective steers quantization errors toward loss-decreasing directions while controlling their magnitude. Experiments on five VLMs across five benchmarks show consistent average-score improvements over FlatQuant under W4A6 and W4A4, reaching 1.4 percentage points on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. Under W4A4, average accuracy degradation from FP16 remains within 1.4 percentage points across all evaluated models, while LLaVA-v1.5-13B exceeds its FP16 average score by 0.4 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出SubRot，一种针对视觉语言模型（VLM）旋转量化的有符号梯度子空间校准方法，通过激活梯度经验Fisher矩阵的特征分解定位跨样本稳定的敏感通道子空间，并结合一阶符号引导与二阶约束改进量化误差方向。
AI.motivation: 低比特训练后量化（PTQ）是降低VLM部署成本的关键，但现有方法依赖模态级或token级梯度统计，易受视觉-文本token比例及视觉信息位置跨样本变化的影响，统计不稳定；且绝对值+平均的粗糙聚合丢弃了梯度符号与通道差异，难以区分模态特异性敏感度。通道空间跨样本共享坐标系，更适合捕捉稳定的任务敏感结构。
AI.method: 对激活梯度的经验Fisher矩阵做特征分解，识别同时具备跨样本稳定性、敏感度清晰分离、对自回归损失存在符号一致的敏感通道子空间；基于局部泰勒展开构造目标：在符号稳定方向施加一阶有符号引导，在其余敏感方向施加二阶约束，并保留MSE以保证整体重建质量，从而将量化误差导向损失下降方向并控制其幅度。
AI.result: 在5个VLM、5个基准上，W4A6与W4A4设置下平均分一致优于FlatQuant，LLaVA-NeXT-7B上提升达1.4个百分点；W4A4下所有评测模型相对FP16的平均精度退化不超过1.4个百分点，LLaVA-v1.5-13B甚至高出FP16平均分0.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SubRot表明通道级有符号梯度子空间是VLM旋转量化中更稳定的敏感度刻画基础，可在极低比特下有效保持多模态能力。

title: ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation
summary: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ECHO 是一种腕部单目事件相机驱动的潜在世界-动作模型，通过记忆（hindsight）与预见（outlook）模块为策略提供时空上下文，在极端曝光下显著优于 RGB 与 RGB+事件基线。
AI.motivation: RGB 操作策略在极端曝光下观测退化；事件相机虽具高动态范围，但其观测强烈依赖相机布置：固定相机丢失静态场景，腕部相机运动使已访问区域离开视场，存在时空局限。
AI.method: ECHO（Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook）为腕部事件增强的潜在世界-动作模型。用预训练事件编码器解释帧间视觉特征变化；hindsight 模块以过去事件流保存夹爪轨迹作为可寻址的离视场上下文；outlook 模块引入可学习事件预见查询，监督其预测未来动作对应的事件窗口。
AI.result: 腕部单目 RLBench 任务上，正常光照下较 RGB 与 RGB+事件基线分别提升 20.6 与 12.0 个百分点，严重曝光下降时提升 14.6 与 11.3 个百分点，并超过使用第三人称相机的 RGB 参考；真实世界腕部事件相机实验在正常与极暗光照下均优于 RGB-only 与 RGB+事件基线。
AI.conclusion: 以事件流构建时空上下文的世界-动作建模可有效缓解曝光退化与腕部视角局限，仿真与真机均验证其有效性。

title: LVMT: Video Mask Transformer for Long-term Video Segmentation
summary: Existing online video segmentation methods struggle to track objects in long, complex videos with long-term occlusions. We hypothesize that this limitation is caused by (i) the inability of their temporal propagation mechanism to adaptively select the object information that is propagated across time, and (ii) their inability to be trained on long videos due to memory requirements and vanishing gradients. To address the first limitation, we propose to use a lightweight GRU-based temporal propagation module that can learn to select which information it keeps in memory and propagates across time. Second, to allow training on long videos, we introduce Truncated Query Propagation (TQP), a training strategy in which the model processes a video in chunks of frames, where information about tracked objects is propagated between chunks but backpropagation is only conducted in individual chunks, enabling longer temporal supervision without out-of-memory issues, inference overhead, or vanishing gradients. The resulting model is called the Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT). Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that LVMT sets a new state of the art across a range of video segmentation tasks, while retaining the speed of the highly efficient model it is based on, making it 10X faster than the prior state of the art. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 LVMT 视频分割模型，用轻量 GRU 时序传播模块实现自适应记忆选择，并用截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略支持长视频训练，在六个基准上刷新 SOTA 且比前 SOTA 快 10 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有在线视频分割方法在长时间遮挡的复杂长视频中难以持续跟踪目标，作者认为原因有二：(i) 时序传播机制无法自适应地选择要跨时间传播的目标信息；(ii) 因显存限制与梯度消失，模型无法在长视频上训练。
AI.method: 1) 引入轻量 GRU 时序传播模块，学习在记忆中保留并跨时间传播哪些信息，实现自适应选择；2) 提出截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略：模型分块处理帧序列，目标信息在块间传播但反向传播仅在单块内进行，从而在无显存溢出、无推理开销、无梯度消失的前提下获得更长的时序监督；整体模型称为 Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT)。
AI.result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明，LVMT 在多种视频分割任务上均达到新的 SOTA，同时保持其基础高效模型的速度，比此前 SOTA 快 10 倍。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时序记忆传播结合分块截断训练可有效解决长视频、长时遮挡下的视频分割难题，兼顾精度与效率。该方法属通用视频分割领域，与物理 AI/机器人具身导航等核心方向关联有限，主要作为通用 CV/视频理解的相邻参考。

title: Role-Guided MOE for Encoder-Level Pathology Representation Learning in WSI Classification
summary: Whole slide image classification is a fundamental task in computational pathology, where patch representation quality directly affects downstream aggregation and slide-level discriminability. Pathology foundation models are widely adopted as frozen feature extractors for WSI classification; however, their fixed encoders may produce representations insufficiently adapted to target-specific tissue patterns and discriminative cues. Fine-tuning can improve target adaptation, but introduces a trade-off between pathology-specific representation capacity and adaptation efficiency, particularly in data-scarce settings. To address this, we propose a pathology role-guided mixture-of-experts feed-forward network (MoE-FFN) framework for efficient encoder-level representation learning. We design a two-stage training paradigm to establish and adapt pathology-aware expert specialization. In source-domain expert initialization, pathology-specific priors are distilled from a frozen Virchow2 teacher into a lightweight DINOv2-small student, while role prototypes serve as weak pathological anchors to encourage distinct expert functions. MoE-FFN blocks are introduced into selected high-level transformer layers to provide transformation diversity for heterogeneous pathological patterns. In target-domain adaptation, the initialized experts are refined through asymmetric prototype-guided optimization, enhancing task-relevant positive evidence and separating confusable hard negatives. The resulting encoder extracts offline patch representations that can be directly integrated with standard MIL aggregators. Experiments on the public BRACS dataset and a private PAROTID WSI dataset across five representative backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出病理角色引导的MoE-FFN框架，通过在选定高层Transformer层插入专家模块，并用两阶段（源域专家初始化+目标域原型引导适配）训练，实现高效的编码器级表征学习，可输出离线patch特征直接对接标准MIL聚合器，在BRACS和私有PAROTID数据集上稳定超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型多被冻结用作WSI分类的特征提取器，但其固定编码器难以适配目标特异的组织模式和判别线索；微调虽能提升适配性，却在数据稀缺场景下存在病理表征能力与适配效率之间的权衡。
AI.method: 设计病理角色引导的MoE-FFN框架：两阶段训练，源域阶段将冻结Virchow2教师的病理先验蒸馏到轻量DINOv2-small学生，并以角色原型作为弱病理锚点促进专家功能分化；在选定的高层Transformer层引入MoE-FFN块提供变换多样性；目标域阶段通过非对称原型引导优化精炼专家，强化任务相关正证据并分离易混淆难负样本。
AI.result: 在公开BRACS数据集与私有PAROTID WSI数据集上，跨五种代表性骨干网络均较最强基线取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以低参数量实现编码器级病理表征适配，产出可直接与标准MIL聚合器结合的离线patch表征，为数据稀缺条件下的WSI分类提供了高效的专家化表征学习方案。

title: FILIGREE3D: Scaling Sparse Latent Flow Matching for Ultra-High-Resolution Image-to-3D Generation
summary: Scaling image-to-3D generation to ultra-high resolutions requires controlling rapidly growing computational costs without sacrificing fine geometric detail. We present \textbf{Filigree3D}, a sparse latent flow-matching framework that generates 3D geometry from a single image at voxel resolutions up to $2048^3$, with straightforward extensibility to $4096^3$. To make training tractable, we introduce Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling, which combines spatial bounding with alternating local-global attention to constrain token growth while preserving both fine-scale details and long-range structural context. To enhance detail reconstruction, we curate training samples based on their high-resolution geometric gains and inject multi-scale image features into a sparse 3D DiT, effectively coupling structural semantics with fine-grained visual cues. Furthermore, a visibility-aware voxel regularization strategy improves robustness against sparse perturbations and facilitates the completion of unobserved geometry. Under our default configuration, Filigree3D maintains peak GPU memory consumption within practical limits for contemporary hardware, enabling the generation of highly intricate 3D geometry in approximately one minute. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields substantial improvements in overall geometric fidelity and fine-detail preservation compared to existing baselines, validating practical, detail-preserving 3D generation at unprecedented resolutions.

AI.tldr: Filigree3D 提出稀疏隐空间流匹配框架，从单图生成最高 2048³（可扩展至 4096³）体素分辨率的 3D 几何，通过结构化稀疏缩放、高分辨率增益样本筛选与多尺度图像特征注入，在约一分钟内完成高细节生成且显存可控。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率 image-to-3D 生成的算力随分辨率急剧增长，现有方法难以在保持精细几何细节的同时控制计算与显存开销。
AI.method: 稀疏隐空间流匹配（sparse latent flow-matching）；Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling，结合空间包围与交替 local-global 注意力约束 token 增长；依据高分辨率几何增益筛选训练样本；将多尺度图像特征注入稀疏 3D DiT；可见性感知体素正则化提升对稀疏扰动的鲁棒性并补全未观测几何。
AI.result: 默认配置下峰值 GPU 显存保持在当代硬件实用范围内，约一分钟生成高复杂度 3D 几何；实验显示整体几何保真度与细节保持显著优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在 2048³/4096³ 等空前分辨率下实用、保细节的 3D 生成可行性。

title: ReSight-SMC: Two-Stage Power Sampling via Island SMC with Visual Scouts
summary: Power sampling has emerged as a training-free approach to LLM reasoning, eliciting capabilities comparable to reinforcement learning by sharpening the model distribution over complete responses. Despite this success, power sampling remains underexplored in large vision-language models (LVLMs). We transfer Power-SMC to LVLM decoding by defining a sequence-power target conditioned on both the image and the prompt. This direct transfer provides a strong training-free baseline, but leaves two aspects of finite-particle multimodal inference unaddressed. At the particle level, global resampling can collapse genealogies, while particle-based power sampling does not diversify trajectories through distinct visual cues in multimodal decoding, limiting exploration under a finite particle budget. At the answer level, sequence-level sharpening makes distinct reasoning trajectories compete even when they support the same answer. We introduce ReSight-SMC, a verifier-free two-stage power sampler for LVLM inference. Its first stage uses ancestry-isolated SMC islands to preserve independent trajectory families and routes a bounded set of prefix-conditioned visual scouts to prefix-relevant image regions while discouraging redundant overlap. Each scout temporarily increases attention to the image tokens and emphasizes its routed region. Exact importance correction preserves the base LVLM sequence-power target. The second stage aggregates terminal importance mass by canonical answer, powers the answer marginal, and samples an answer together with a supporting trajectory. Across four LVLM backbones and five benchmarks, ReSight-SMC achieves stronger aggregate performance than Power-SMC over both the reasoning and perception benchmark groups. Without post-training, it remains competitive in aggregate with backbone-matched models trained using reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReSight-SMC，一种无需验证器的两阶段 power sampler，将 Power-SMC 迁移到 LVLM 推理并解决粒子坍塌与答案级竞争问题。
AI.motivation: Power sampling 在纯文本 LLM 推理中已被证明可逼近 RL 效果，但在大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中尚未充分探索。直接迁移存在两个未解决问题：粒子层面的全局重采样会破坏轨迹谱系，且基于粒子的采样未利用多模态中不同视觉线索来多样化轨迹；答案层面，序列级锐化会让支持同一答案的不同推理轨迹相互竞争。
AI.method: ReSight-SMC 采用两阶段无验证器 power sampler。第一阶段使用祖先隔离的 SMC 岛屿以保持独立轨迹族，并将有限数量的前缀条件视觉侦察粒子路由至与当前前缀相关的图像区域，同时抑制冗余重叠；每个侦察粒子临时提升对图像 token 的注意力并强化其路由区域，配合精确重要性校正以保持基础 LVLM 的 sequence-power 目标不变。第二阶段按规范答案聚合终止重要性质量，对答案边缘分布做幂次锐化，并采样一个答案及其支撑轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个 LVLM 骨干与五个基准上，ReSight-SMC 在推理与感知两组基准上的聚合性能均优于 Power-SMC；在无后训练条件下，其聚合表现与使用强化学习训练的同等骨干模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ReSight-SMC 表明，针对多模态推理的粒子级谱系隔离与视觉引导路由，以及答案级边际聚合，是提升 LVLM 免训练推理的有效手段，可在不进行 RL 后训练的情况下达到可比性能。

title: TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation
summary: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.

AI.tldr: TaoTex：基于扩散的原生3D材质生成模型，通过数据构建代理、多级特征融合与潜空间到像素空间的损失转换，提升单/多视图下的纹理细节恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型能生成准确几何，但纹理重建细节不足；公开数据集缺乏高频纹理3D资产，扩散模型的VAE重建误差也限制了像素级细节还原。
AI.method: 1) 构建数据构建代理生成高频纹理3D资产以弥补数据缺口；2) 设计多级特征融合(MLFF)模块自适应整合条件输入的局部与全局特征；3) 采用潜空间到像素空间的损失转换缓解VAE重建误差；4) 引入可学习视角嵌入将模型扩展至多视图输入。
AI.result: 在单视图与多视图设置下，纹理细节保持能力显著优于现有方法，对文字、图案等高频细节恢复效果提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 数据、特征融合与损失设计的针对性改进可有效提升原生3D材质生成的纹理保真度，并具备多视图一致重建能力。

title: Resolution as a First-Class Decision: Task-Conditioned Routing for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: The inference efficiency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is severely constrained by massive visual token sequences induced by high-resolution inputs, with computational cost scaling quadratically. Existing approaches primarily focus on downstream token compression, while overlooking a fundamental upstream inefficiency: input resolution is treated as a static, task-agnostic hyperparameter. We propose Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR), which formulates visual compression as a task-conditioned decision and employs a lightweight cross-modal router that conditions backbone visual representations on textual semantics via feature-wise modulation and cross-attention to predict the minimal sufficient compression level per query. To support this, we curate a dataset of 500k samples across 12 task categories, labeled via a teacher-oracle pipeline to approximate Pareto-optimal compression scales. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures show that TCRR achieves a superior efficiency frontier, specifically reducing visual FLOPs by 40.9% and latency by 53.7% on Qwen3-VL-8B while preserving competitive performance. Further analysis of scaling behavior confirms that dynamically routing visual compression enables optimal resource allocation without modifying the MLLM backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出任务条件化分辨率路由（TCRR），用轻量跨模态路由器按查询预测最小充分压缩级别，替代静态输入分辨率，降低 MLLM 视觉 token 开销。
AI.motivation: MLLM 推理效率受高分辨率输入带来的海量视觉 token 制约，计算量随 token 数二次增长；现有方法集中在下游 token 压缩，忽略了上游输入分辨率被视为静态、任务无关超参数这一根本低效。
AI.method: 将视觉压缩建模为任务条件化决策：轻量跨模态路由器通过特征级调制与交叉注意力，使骨干视觉表示受文本语义条件化，为每个查询预测最小充分的压缩级别；并构建 500k 样本、覆盖 12 类任务的数据集，经 teacher-oracle 流程标注以近似帕累托最优压缩尺度。
AI.result: 在多种架构上取得更优效率前沿，Qwen3-VL-8B 上视觉 FLOPs 降低 40.9%、延迟降低 53.7%，同时保持有竞争力的性能；缩放行为分析确认动态路由压缩可在不修改 MLLM 骨干的前提下实现资源最优分配。
AI.conclusion: 上游任务条件化视觉压缩路由是提升 MLLM 推理效率的有效且即插即用方向，无需改动骨干即可动态分配计算资源。

title: Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models
summary: Long visual token sequences often account for a substantial fraction of the computational overhead in multimodal large language models~(MLLMs). Existing approaches reduce this cost by pruning redundant visual tokens, but permanently discard visual evidence that may become useful in subsequent layers. We instead ask whether all visual tokens can be preserved while reducing the cost of repeatedly evolving the representations through the Transformer. To answer this question, we perform low-rank interventions on visual-to-text information flow. We find that, after visual-to-text attention is blocked, restoring only a few directions recovers most of the lost accuracy, suggesting the relevant visual influence is concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. We further observe strong predictability in layer-specific visual states: lightweight MLPs approximate them with high cosine similarity and low reconstruction error. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\delta$-Vision, which replaces repeated Transformer evolution of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that construct layer-wise visual memories while preserving all visual tokens for text retrieval. Across image and video benchmarks, $\delta$-Vision achieves higher accuracy than visual token pruning baselines at comparable or lower computation, while delivering competitive inference efficiency without discarding visual tokens.

AI.tldr: δ-Vision 通过低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆，替代视觉 token 在 Transformer 中的重复演化，在保留全部视觉 token 的前提下降低 MLLM 推理开销。
AI.motivation: MLLM 中长视觉 token 序列带来显著计算负担；现有剪枝方法永久丢弃可能在后层有用的视觉证据，作者质疑是否必须剪枝，转而探索在保留全部视觉 token 的同时降低其表示重复演化的成本。
AI.method: 对视觉到文本信息流做低秩干预：阻塞视觉-文本注意力后仅恢复少数方向即可找回大部分精度，说明有效视觉影响集中于低维子空间；同时发现逐层视觉状态可被轻量 MLP 高余弦相似度、低重构误差地预测。据此提出 δ-Vision，用轻量低秩适配器构造 layer-wise 视觉记忆，取代视觉 token 的重复 Transformer 演化，同时保留全部 token 供文本检索。
AI.result: 在图像与视频基准上，δ-Vision 在相当或更低的计算量下精度高于视觉 token 剪枝基线，且不丢弃视觉 token 即可获得有竞争力的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息流存在低维可预测结构，据此可用低秩适配替代逐层演化，实现"全保留 + 低开销"的 MLLM 视觉计算范式。

title: SPIDER: Multi-Layer Semantic Token Pruning and Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose \textbf{SPIDER}, a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer \underline{\textbf{S}}emantic visual token \underline{\textbf{P}}run\underline{\textbf{I}}ng with an a\underline{\textbf{D}}aptive sub-lay\underline{\textbf{ER}} skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by $79\%$ while maintaining 96$\%$ of the baseline performance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的SPIDER框架，通过多层语义视觉token剪枝与自适应子层跳过，同时消除多模态大模型的数据冗余与计算冗余，在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上减少79% FLOPs仍保持96%性能。
AI.motivation: MLLM推理效率受数据冗余与计算冗余双重制约；现有工作多聚焦视觉编码器输出的token剪枝或LLM解码器的块级重要性计算，忽视了层间表示漂移与层内分布差异。作者认为视觉编码器的中间层token应参与剪枝，因为语义焦点随层数变化，中间层包含更细粒度的物体中心信息。
AI.method: 免训练框架SPIDER：(1) 多层语义视觉token剪枝——利用视觉编码器中间层表示进行视觉token选择；(2) 自适应子层跳过机制——基于Attention与FFN在不同解码器层中贡献差异化的发现，跳过冗余子层。
AI.result: 在多种MLLM架构与压缩比下保持一致强性能；LLaVA-NeXT-7B上FLOPs降低79%，保留基线96%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的层间/层内冗余分析可同时缓解数据与计算两重冗余，免训练即插即用，具备跨架构可迁移性。

title: One Sensor, Whole Body - 3D Body Pose from a Single Consumer Earbud IMU
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 6th International Workshop on Human-centric Multimedia Analysis (HUMA '26), ACM Multimedia 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Code: this https URL
summary: Consumer earbuds already stream inertial motion data from the head, one of the most widely worn sensor locations on the body. We ask how much of the 3D body pose a single such head IMU can recover, and whether adding more consumer sensors actually helps. We build a multimodal capture pipeline that records four-view RGB-D video together with an AirPods head IMU and two Striv insole IMUs, synchronize the streams post-hoc, and generate pseudo-ground-truth with SAM 3D Body, yielding a 35-take single-subject benchmark spanning gait, turning, vertical, everyday, and clinically inspired motions. Adapting two recurrent model families (IMUPoser and MobilePoser), we show that one head IMU recovers lower-body pose at 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE and per-foot ground contact at 0.809 macro-F1, and that a causal variant retains most of this accuracy at streaming latency. In paired per-take significance tests across both families, adding the consumer foot IMUs never significantly improves pose and significantly degrades it in two of four model-split combinations; a mounting-bias probe and feet-only ablation identify insole orientation quality, not foot placement, as the mechanism. Extending the output to a 20-joint full-body skeleton maps the boundary: gross distal-arm motion is partially recoverable from the head alone, proximal upper-body pose is not, and staged fine-tuning recovers the leg accuracy that naive joint training sacrifices to multi-task dilution. For learned pose from consumer wearables, sensor reliability, not sensor count, is the binding constraint here. For the devices tested, the earbud is its sweet spot. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文构建多模态采集管线（四视角RGB-D + AirPods头戴IMU + 两枚鞋垫IMU），同步后用SAM 3D Body生成伪真值，形成35段单被试基准，验证单个头戴IMU能恢复79.0 mm刚性MPJPE的下肢姿态与0.809 macro-F1的足部接地，而增加足底IMU并不稳定增益甚至有害，主因是鞋垫朝向可靠性而非足部位置。
AI.motivation: 消费级耳机已在头部提供惯性运动数据，头戴是人体最普遍佩戴的传感位置之一。作者想探究：单个头戴IMU究竟能恢复多少三维全身姿态，以及增加更多消费级传感器是否真的有用，从而厘清消费级可穿戴姿态估计中"传感器可靠性"与"传感器数量"的约束优先级。
AI.method: 搭建多模态采集管线：四视角RGB-D视频 + AirPods头部IMU + 两枚Striv鞋垫IMU，事后时间同步，用SAM 3D Body生成伪真值，构建覆盖步态、转身、垂直、日常与临床启发动作的35段单被试基准；适配两族循环模型（IMUPoser、MobilePoser）；设计因果变体以评估流式延迟下的精度；开展配对逐段显著性检验、安装偏差探针与"仅足部"消融；并将输出扩展到20关节全身骨架，采用分阶段微调缓解多任务稀释。
AI.result: 单个头戴IMU即可恢复下肢姿态（刚性MPJPE 79.0 mm）与逐足接地（macro-F1 0.809），因果变体在流式延迟下保留大部分精度；在两族模型的配对逐段检验中，加入足底IMU在四组模型-划分组合中的两组显著降低精度，从未显著改善姿态；机制归因于鞋垫朝向质量而非足部位置；扩展到20关节全身时，远端手臂粗运动部分可恢复，近端上身姿态不可恢复，分阶段微调可找回朴素联合训练因多任务稀释而损失的腿部精度。
AI.conclusion: 对消费级可穿戴设备的学习式姿态估计而言，约束瓶颈是传感器可靠性而非传感器数量；在所测设备中，耳机头戴IMU处于"最佳甜点"位置。该工作同时给出可复现的多模态采集/评估流程与代码。

title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{ this https URL }}}

AI.tldr: 论文发现隐式世界动作模型（Latent WAM）虽在分布内任务上与显式WAM持平，但丧失了WAM原有的泛化优势；该差距几乎全部源自首个去噪步，即"准备未来"而非"生成未来"才是关键。据此提出Simple-WAM：用单次前向传播处理全噪声视频token，并调整训练噪声调度以匹配推理行为，在仿真与真实任务上兼顾显式WAM的泛化性与隐式WAM的效率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）在训练时联合预测未来与动作，但视频去噪计算开销大，推理时是否仍需生成未来存在争议：显式WAM逐动作块去噪出清晰帧，隐式WAM则完全丢弃未来以加速。作者质疑隐式WAM是否真能保留WAM最初的泛化收益，并希望找到既高效又保持泛化的折中方案。
AI.method: 在三轴（环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化）上做受控对比，固定骨干、训练数据与预算，隔离"动作专家是否依赖未来表征"这一变量；进一步做逐步去噪分析，定位差距来源。提出Simple-WAM：将未来建模简化为对全噪声视频token的单次前向传播，并为此适配训练期噪声调度。
AI.result: 受控实验显示隐式WAM在三个泛化轴上一致退化，且差距几乎全部来自第一个去噪步；Simple-WAM在仿真与真实世界任务上泛化性能优于显式WAM，效率与隐式WAM相当。
AI.conclusion: 未来表征的价值在于"准备未来"而非"生成未来"，因此推理阶段无需完整去噪即可保留泛化收益；Simple-WAM以极简的单步前向设计实现了泛化与效率的兼得。

title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves {\pi}0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ActionUNet：在预训练VLA的动作特征空间中插入轻量时序U-Net融合多尺度结构先验，并用带二阶平滑约束的条件SIREN连续解码器消除抖动，实现低成本微调，提升操作成功率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型将多模态语义映射到物理动作时，粗粒度语义难以与细粒度时序执行对齐，导致在杂乱环境中泛化与鲁棒性不足。多尺度时序建模虽可桥接该尺度鸿沟，却会破坏微观时序连续性、引发机械抖动。
AI.method: 提出ActionUNet多尺度高效微调框架：在时序对齐的动作特征空间内构建轻量级时序U-Net，融合层级结构先验以弥合语义—执行尺度差；针对多尺度建模造成的时序不连续，采用条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器，并施加显式二阶平滑约束，保证时间连续性、抑制高频抖动。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus基准及真实世界困难评测上，π0.5成功率分别绝对提升9.8%、6.1%、11.4%；并可泛化到回归式OpenVLA-OFT骨干，验证其有效性与高效性。
AI.conclusion: 将多尺度结构先验与连续动作解码结合，可在极低计算成本下增强预训练VLA的时序执行质量，减少机械执行失败，同时保持基础模型的泛化与操作鲁棒性，是一种通用、高效的微调策略。

title: Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.

AI.tldr: 本文定义"压缩特异性失败"(CSF)这一配对失败归因概念，并提出 CIRA——一种仅需视觉编码器白盒权限的压缩诱导风险攻击，在12个数据集-压缩器组合上平均 CSFR 达20.35%，同时全 token 攻击成功率仅6.92%。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 压缩可降低 LVLM 推理成本，但聚合鲁棒性指标无法区分某次对抗失败是压缩诱发还是原模型固有。作者希望对压缩风险做因果、可归因的刻画。
AI.method: 提出压缩特异性失败(CSF)定义：全 token 推理正确、压缩后失败的对抗样本，将其建模为配对失败归因问题。受反事实诊断（保留集分配因果性、恢复与表征漂移负相关）启发，提出 CIRA：在视觉编码器白盒下优化图像扰动，通过编码器侧目标操纵候选压缩预算下的 token 优先级，同时保留被位移的证据；不需要下游问题、标签、语言模型、部署压缩器或确切压缩预算。
AI.result: 在12个数据集-压缩器设置、4种预算下，CIRA 平均 CSFR 20.35%，全 token ASR 仅6.92%，在其他 LVLM 家族上表现类似。跨视角选择-稳定化防御可显著抑制 CIRA，但自适应 CIRA 能部分恢复其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 压缩特异性失败在受限访问条件下依然存在，支持用全 token 与压缩推理的双轨配对评估来将风险归因于视觉 token 压缩。

title: Verifying the Linear Representation Hypothesis: How Interpretable Are Vision SAEs?
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables, preprint under review
summary: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文将NLP中的Autointerpretability Score (AIS)适配到视觉稀疏自编码器(SAE)可解释性评估，通过用户研究验证，发现现有SAE可解释性指标之间以及与AIS之间均不相关，表明无单一无参考指标足以验证视觉SAE的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 视觉SAE被广泛假设可将多义特征分解为单义概念，但现有评估多用稀疏性或字典一致性等代理指标，隐含假设这些指标反映人类感知对齐。作者质疑这种假设，认为SAE可解释性度量比代理指标所暗示的更难，且缺乏可验证的、锚定真值的评估方式。
AI.method: 将原本在NLP中与人类判断对齐的Autointerpretability Score (AIS)适配到视觉任务；通过专门用户研究验证该适配；在视觉SAE上同时使用标准指标（稀疏性、字典一致性等）与适配后的AIS评估概念质量，并进行相关性分析。
AI.result: 实验发现已有的SAE可解释性指标彼此之间不相关，且与AIS也不相关；即无论是否基于线性表示假设(LRH)，没有任何单一无参考指标足以验证视觉SAE的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这些发现支持近期关于解释方法应更具可验证性、锚定真值(ground-truth-anchored)的设计与评估的呼吁，提示SAE可解释性评估需引入外部真值或人类判断锚定。

title: Detection of Adversarial Attacks on Super-Resolvers Using Spectral Features
comment: To be published in the 2026 Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers
summary: The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models. In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights. More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks. We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios. Our proposed detector out-performs the comparison detectors in most of these scenarios and indicates that high-frequency features are most informative for detecting AdvSR attacks across SR architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于径向平均功率谱密度（RAPSD）特征与 XGBoost 分类器的检测方法，用于识别嵌入超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击（AdvSR），并在多训练场景与跨架构场景下优于幅度谱和相位谱检测器。
AI.motivation: 超分辨率等图像预处理模型被集成到关键成像流水线中，其模型权重层面的对抗植入成为未被充分探索的攻击面；为保障流水线可信性，需要能检测预处理模型内部的对抗行为。
AI.method: 提取模型权重的径向平均功率谱密度作为判别特征，训练 XGBoost 检测器；与基于傅里叶幅度谱和相位谱的检测器在多种训练设置与跨架构场景下进行对比评估。
AI.result: 所提检测器在多数场景下优于对比方法，并表明高频特征对跨 SR 架构检测 AdvSR 攻击最具信息量。
AI.conclusion: 谱域特征（尤其是高频成分）可有效实现超分辨率模型权重级对抗攻击的检测，为下游任务流水线的可信性提供了一种轻量检测手段。

title: Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them
summary: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.

AI.tldr: Proxy2World 提出一种仅用普通位姿 RGBD 视频训练的可控世界模型，通过跨模态流匹配联合学习深度条件 RGB 生成与联合 RGBD 生成，实现代理-相机混合去噪，并发布 ProxyBench 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 轻量场景代理（如粗糙几何或布局）便于创作者控制场景结构与运动，同时保留外观、光照和特效的想象空间；但"合适的代理"定义不唯一，导致成对的代理-视频数据难以大规模自动构建。因此作者希望在不依赖人工制作代理-视频配对数据的条件下，仅从普通 posed RGBD 视频中习得"遵循代理结构"与"生成逼真细节"这两种互补能力。
AI.method: 提出 Proxy2World：一个可控世界模型。核心是跨模态流匹配框架，联合训练两个任务——深度条件 RGB 生成、以及 RGB 与深度联合生成。推理时利用两个任务的互补性进行代理-相机混合去噪（proxy-camera hybrid denoising），在服从代理结构的同时生成自然、细节丰富的视觉效果。同时构建 ProxyBench 基准，覆盖多样场景、相机轨迹与主体运动。
AI.result: 在 ProxyBench 上，Proxy2World 在结构遵循度与视觉质量之间取得了比相机控制方法与几何条件方法更好的平衡；该结论由定量指标、VLM 评估、人工评估以及多种定性结果共同支持。
AI.conclusion: 无需成对代理-视频数据，仅用 posed RGBD 视频即可训练出兼具结构可控性与视觉保真度的世界模型，为创作者提供灵活的场景代理控制接口，并提供相应评测基准。

title: Mixed-Prior Decision Risk for Open-Set Recognition
summary: In open-set recognition (OSR), a probe must either be identified as one of the known gallery classes or rejected as unknown, so three error types coexist: false acceptance, false rejection, and misidentification. An uncertainty score for selective recognition should rank probes by the risk of the decision the system has made. Bayesian gallery-aware models such as Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) summarize the posterior over known and unknown classes by Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence components and map them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator. We show that the KL summary is not generally monotone in decision risk: linear fusion of the KL components tuned on validation data yields negative filtering quality on several benchmarks. We propose MPRisk, a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that keeps the same Bayesian posterior but directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision: false-acceptance, misidentification, and false-rejection risks, plus a non-specificity penalty for rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component. Four nonnegative weights tuned on a validation set suffice for ranking; no nonlinear supervised model is required. Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, MPRisk achieves the best or tied-best Prediction Rejection Ratio at every operating point on the image and audio benchmarks and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks (up to $+0.19$ PRR) at comparable or lower runtime.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MPRisk，一种混合先验后验决策风险评分，用于开集识别中的选择性识别，直接对错误事件打分，避免了 KL 分量非单调问题。
AI.motivation: 开集识别中同时存在误接受、误拒识与误识别三类错误，不确定性分数应对系统所做出的决策风险进行排序。现有贝叶斯方法（如 HolUE）用 KL 散度分量线性融合并配监督非线性校准器，但其 KL 摘要对决策风险并非单调，线性融合在多个基准上出现负的过滤质量。
AI.method: MPRisk 保留相同的贝叶斯后验，但直接对所选决策对应的错误事件评分：误接受风险、误识别风险、误拒识风险，并加入针对拒识的非特异性惩罚项；将未知身份建模为连续分量以实现该评分。仅需在验证集上调节四个非负权重即可排序，无需非线性监督模型。
AI.result: 在九个图像、音频与文本基准上，MPRisk 在图像和音频基准的每个操作点、以及大多数文本操作点上取得最佳或并列最佳的预测拒识率（PRR）；在五个基准上经 bootstrap 确认优于 HolUE，提升最高达 +0.19 PRR，且运行时间相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 以决策风险为中心、直接对错误事件建模的评分方式，比 KL 分量线性融合更可靠地实现选择性开集识别，且以简单可解释的权重调节取代监督非线性校准器。

title: LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.

AI.tldr: LEGAU 提出统一框架，联合预测 NOCS 对应、物体位姿尺寸与类别级规范语义高斯场，将高斯场作为类别条件结构先验参与多模态特征融合，为局部位姿推理提供全局引导，在单模型多类别设置下 SOPE 提升最高 22%。
AI.motivation: 单帧 RGB-D 的类别级 6D 位姿估计本质欠约束：局部可见几何需与规范物体结构协同解释才能确定稳定位姿。现有方法多将重建作为游离的辅助任务，缺乏显式的类别级结构先验来约束位姿推理。
AI.method: 以类别文本嵌入为条件，用基于 Transformer 的融合模块整合 RGB-D 的视觉、几何与类别级线索，统一解码 NOCS 地图、位姿尺寸以及基于高斯的规范语义高斯场表示；高斯场不孤立重建，而是作为类别条件结构先验参与多模态特征融合并指导局部位姿推理，形成位姿-形状耦合表述。
AI.result: 在合成与真实世界基准上，该单模型多类别框架表现强劲，SOPE 最高提升 22%，并向真实数据具备有竞争力的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 在统一表示中联合学习规范对应、物体形状与位姿对齐，可显著受益于类别级结构先验对欠约束位姿问题的正则化，为类别级 6D 位姿估计提供了新的耦合范式。

title: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models
summary: Video world models must preserve the visual state of the world over time, but existing evaluation protocols often rely on generated histories, video reference, or selected revisit viewpoints that can confound the assessment of a model's true memory capability. To address this, we introduce OPIS, an input-grounded benchmark that strictly anchors the assessment to a fixed set of object instances from the initial observation for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models. The OPIS dataset comprises 500 cases across real-world, embodied-robotic, and game-world domains, providing dense object-level annotations for 12,672 rigid, articulated, and deformable instances. Our object-centric evaluator combines association and explicit visibility reasoning to hierarchically measure Object (O) Presence (P), Identity (I), and Structure (S), utilizing static or dynamic evaluation tracks based on object kinematics. Across eight image-to-video or camera-conditioned world models, our proposed OPIS scores range from 48.65 to 56.01. As the reference inventory grows from less than 20 to more than 40 objects, the Presence, Identity, and Structure scores show an overall decline, with the average Identity score falling from 40.22 to 23.11. The results demonstrate that preserving the particular object instances in the input is considerably harder than generating plausible visual elements.

AI.tldr: 提出 OPIS，一个以初始观测中的固定物体实例为锚点的输入接地基准，用于评估视频世界模型的多物体记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型记忆评估依赖生成历史、视频参考或选取的回访视角，这些设定会混淆模型真实记忆能力的度量。作者希望以严格锚定初始观测中物体实例的方式，隔离并度量"保真记忆"而非"生成合理画面"。
AI.method: OPIS 数据集涵盖真实世界、具身机器人、游戏世界三类域共 500 个案例，为 12,672 个刚性、铰接、可变形实例提供密集物体级标注；评估器结合数据关联与显式可见性推理，分层度量 Object Presence、Identity、Structure，并按物体运动学区分静态/动态评估轨道。
AI.result: 在八个图像到视频或相机条件世界模型上，OPIS 得分区间为 48.65–56.01；当参考物体清单从不足 20 增至 40 以上时，Presence、Identity、Structure 整体下降，平均 Identity 分从 40.22 降至 23.11。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明保持输入中特定物体实例的视觉状态显著难于生成视觉上合理的元素，OPIS 可作为以输入为锚的记忆评测协议。

title: Towards Generalizable 3D Anomaly Detection via Relational Inconsistency Modeling
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: 3D anomaly detection (3DAD) aims to identify defective regions in point cloud data, serving as a critical component in industrial inspection systems. Existing methods are normality-centered -- learning the distribution of normal samples and treating deviations as anomalies -- without explicitly modeling what constitutes a defect. This leads to ambiguous decision boundaries with increased false positives and negatives, particularly in unified and cross-domain settings where diverse normal distributions further blur the boundaries. We propose a relational inconsistency modeling framework that characterizes defects as violations of geometric consistency among neighboring structures. Our approach learns category-agnostic defect cues through pseudo-anomalies designed as controlled relational violations, instantiated by two key modules: Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) for encoding geometric relationships among local regions, and Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) for identifying regions that are relationally incompatible within their structural peer group. Extensive experiments on Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD demonstrate consistent improvements over prior state-of-the-art methods in both in-domain and cross-domain settings, validating the effectiveness of learning an explicit, relation-based defect criterion for 3D anomaly detection. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出"关系不一致性建模"框架做3D异常检测，用伪异常学习类别无关的缺陷判据，含Edge-aware Graph Refinement与Cluster-Deviation Modeling两模块，在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD上域内与跨域均超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3DAD方法以"正常性"为中心，只学正常样本分布、把偏差视作异常，不显式建模"缺陷"本身，导致决策边界模糊、误检漏检多；在统一设定与跨域设定下，正常分布更分散，边界问题进一步恶化。
AI.method: 将缺陷定义为相邻结构间几何一致性的破坏，通过受控的"关系违背"构造伪异常来学习类别无关的缺陷线索；具体实例化为两个模块：Edge-aware Graph Refinement（EGR）编码局部区域间的几何关系；Cluster-Deviation Modeling（CDM）识别在同结构同类组中关系不兼容的区域。
AI.result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet与Real3D-AD两个基准上，域内与跨域设定均取得相对现有SOTA的一致提升，验证了显式关系式缺陷判据的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 从"正常性建模"转向"缺陷关系建模"是3D异常检测的有效路径，伪异常+关系不一致性可缓解边界模糊问题并提升跨域泛化；未来可扩展到更复杂结构与多模态工业检测场景。

title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving rely heavily on successful expert demonstrations, leaving model-specific failures underexploited. Learning from these failures is hindered by unreliable diagnoses, poorly matched correction targets, and coarse rewards. We propose RefineDrive, a failure-guided post-training framework that learns from self-generated failures through targeted supervision and safety-aware reinforcement learning. Reliable Diagnosis derives structured, verifiable feedback on collisions and drivable-area violations directly from simulator states. Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval searches a clustered human trajectory bank for nearby corrections that satisfy hard-safety constraints in the current scene, prioritizing preservation of the failed prediction's motion pattern. Conditioned on the driving context and failed trajectory, Correction SFT learns to generate the diagnosis followed by the retrieved correction as a training-only auxiliary task. We then apply GRPO with a Safety-Layered Reward that strictly prioritizes hard-safe trajectories, retains continuous safety feedback for both unsafe and hard-safe trajectories, and rewards driving progress only after hard safety is satisfied. At inference, the policy directly predicts trajectories from the driving context without an explicit diagnosis or repair stage. On NAVSIM v1, RefineDrive improves the 4B base SFT policy from 87.7 to 91.7 PDMS. Using the same checkpoint without additional training, RefineDrive achieves 89.4 EPDMS on the original NAVTEST scenes evaluated with NAVSIM v2 extended metrics. Controlled ablations support the benefits of structured diagnosis supervision, retrieved corrections, and safety-layered optimization for direct planning.

AI.tldr: RefineDrive：从自生成失败中学习，用可靠诊断+最小修正目标检索+GRPO安全分层奖励做后训练，NAVSIM v1上PDMS 87.7→91.7，v2上EPDMS 89.4，推理时无需诊断/修复阶段。
AI.motivation: VLA自动驾驶模型高度依赖成功专家演示，模型自身的失败样本未被充分利用；而从失败中学习受限于诊断不可靠、修正目标不匹配、奖励过于粗糙三个瓶颈。
AI.method: （1）Reliable Diagnosis：从仿真器状态直接导出碰撞与可行驶区域违规的结构化可验证反馈；（2）Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval：在聚类的人类轨迹库中检索满足当前场景硬安全约束、且尽量保留失败预测运动模式的就近修正；（3）Correction SFT：以驾驶上下文与失败轨迹为条件，将"诊断+检索修正"作为仅训练用辅助任务学习；（4）GRPO + Safety-Layered Reward：硬安全优先级最高，对不安全与硬安全轨迹均保留连续安全反馈，仅在满足硬安全后才奖励行驶进展。推理时策略直接从上下文预测轨迹，无显式诊断/修复阶段。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1上4B base SFT策略PDMS由87.7提升至91.7；同一checkpoint不再额外训练，在NAVTEST原始场景用NAVSIM v2扩展指标取得89.4 EPDMS。消融实验验证结构化诊断监督、检索式修正与安全分层优化的收益。
AI.conclusion: 失效驱动的后训练框架可有效利用自生成失败，结构化诊断+检索式最小修正+安全分层RL三者协同提升直接规划性能，且不增加推理开销。

title: Advancing Video-Text Pretraining with Multi-View Captions
summary: Video-text pretraining has achieved remarkable progress through the scaling of models and datasets, yet the quality of language supervision remains underexplored. Existing web-scale datasets often provide only a single sparse caption per video that fails to capture rich spatiotemporal semantics, while directly using captioning models can generate noisy descriptions. We propose a large-scale multimodal large language model-based supervision generation framework that improves supervision diversity, fidelity, and semantic coverage. Starting from 10 million videos, our approach generates multi-view captions (MVC) through complementary summary and detailed captions, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive caption generation. To effectively exploit supervision at different granularities, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views. We pretrain video-text models using the resulting supervision corpus and evaluate them across standard, fine-grained and detailed text-to-video retrieval benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance while using smaller pretraining corpora than existing methods, demonstrating the importance of rich and complementary textual supervision for video-text pretraining. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出基于MLLM的多视角字幕(MVC)监督生成框架，为1000万视频生成摘要+细节互补字幕并经推理式精炼，配合粒度感知文本表示（摘要/细节双CLS token）预训练视频-文本模型，在更小语料下提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Web级视频-文本数据多为单一稀疏字幕，无法覆盖丰富时空语义；直接用captioning模型又引入噪声。语言监督质量这一维度被scaling掩盖，尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 以MLLM为核心构建监督生成流水线，从1000万视频出发生成多视角字幕：互补的摘要型与细节型字幕、基于推理的精炼、语义正样本字幕生成；2) 设计粒度感知文本表示，为摘要视图与细节视图设置独立CLS token，使不同粒度监督可被分别利用；3) 用该监督语料预训练视频-文本模型。
AI.result: 在标准、细粒度与细节文本到视频检索基准上，零样本与微调性能均持续提升，且所用预训练语料规模小于既有方法，说明丰富互补的文本监督可替代部分数据规模收益。
AI.conclusion: 文本监督的多样性与语义覆盖度是视频-文本预训练中被低估的关键因素；MLLM生成的多视角、多粒度字幕配合粒度感知表示，可在更小数据下取得更优检索表现。

title: DF-CBM: Region-Aware Concept Bottleneck Models for Deepfake Detection
