summary: Deepfake detection methods have become increasingly effective yet most provide limited insight into the evidence behind their predictions. However, in forensic settings users also need to know which manipulation cues support the decision and where they appear. Existing explainability methods only partially address this need since localization-based approaches lack semantic descriptions while language-based explanation methods are only weakly grounded in visual evidence. In this work, we propose DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM builds a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from textual artifact annotations and links each concept to plausible facial and boundary regions. It then predicts these concepts from visual features using a concept-specific masked attention mechanism guided by parsed facial masks and the final real/fake decision is made from the predicted concept bottleneck. Our experiments show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Finally, qualitative results and intervention analyses demonstrate that DF-CBM provides spatially grounded concept evidence and enables counterfactual explanations of how individual manipulation concepts influence the final prediction. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出DF-CBM区域感知概念瓶颈模型，用文本伪影标注构建可解释概念词表并绑定人脸/边界区域，通过概念特定掩码注意力预测概念并据概念瓶颈做真假判别，兼顾可解释性与检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测虽准确率提升，但预测证据不足；定位类方法缺乏语义描述，语言类解释与视觉证据对齐弱，法证场景需要"何处、何种操纵线索"的联合证据。
AI.method: 从文本伪影标注抽取紧凑的操纵相关概念词表；将每个概念关联到合理的人脸与边界区域；用解析的人脸掩码引导的概念特定掩码注意力，从视觉特征预测概念；最终真伪决策由概念瓶颈层给出。支持反事实干预分析。
AI.result: 概念预测与深伪分类优于概念类基线，与SOTA黑盒检测器性能相当；定性结果与干预分析表明模型可给出空间落地的概念证据，并支持反事实解释概念对最终预测的影响。
AI.conclusion: 概念瓶颈+区域监督为深度伪造检测提供了可解释且空间有据的解释范式，在保持竞争性检测性能的同时实现概念级反事实解释，代码开源。

title: Style-Driven Data Synthesis and Degradation-Aware Enhancement for Ultrasound Image Restoration
summary: Low-cost handheld ultrasound devices can be widely deployed compared to professional hospital ultrasound machines. However, their images suffer from compound degradation that can mislead clinical judgment. Motivated by this observation, mapping handheld low-quality (LQ) to hospital high-quality (HQ) images has been considered a valuable research question. Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ-HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ-HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ-to-LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ-to-HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix. Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架解决手持低质量超声到高质量超声的映射：先用非对齐真实LQ-HQ对训练循环一致的风格迁移模型生成像素对齐LQ数据，再用双退化引导LoRA微调增强模型。
AI.motivation: 低成本手持超声设备可广泛部署，但图像存在复合退化，易误导临床判断，因此LQ到HQ映射有价值；然而传统方法要求像素对齐的LQ-HQ配对，实际不同时间扫描的图像从不像素对齐，该要求不切实际。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段在非对齐真实LQ-HQ对上训练循环一致（cycle-consistent）风格迁移模型，学习HQ到LQ的映射，从而将真实HQ图像转为像素对齐的LQ图像以构造数据集。第二阶段在生成的对齐对上，基于PiSA-SR框架并插入退化条件校正矩阵，采用双退化引导（DDG）LoRA方法微调LQ到HQ模型。
AI.result: 在USenhance2023数据集上，FID指标较最强基线提升16.7%，其他指标显示增强输出与真实HQ分布良好对齐。源码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过风格迁移生成对齐配对结合退化引导LoRA微调，可在无需像素对齐真实配对的前提下有效提升手持超声图像质量，验证了该两阶段方案在医学超声增强任务中的有效性。

title: VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction
summary: Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored. We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame. PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking. We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation. We further construct PCVE-RigidBench, a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出"物理反事实视频编辑"（PCVE）任务：给定源视频、物理编辑及其执行帧，生成体现场景物理后果（后续运动与交互变化）的反事实视频。提出免训练pipeline VideoPhysEdit与合成基准PCVE-RigidBench，并提出Physical Edit Score指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法主要处理视觉后果（阴影、遮挡等），忽视编辑的物理后果（后续运动与交互的改变）。PCVE需要理解场景物理并推断物理干预引发的下游运动，但缺乏配对的事实/反事实数据与专用评测指标。
AI.method: VideoPhysEdit为免训练即插即用pipeline，面向刚体场景。核心是显式的物理推理：通过新颖的物理场景重建方法，恢复出在仿真下能复现观测运动与交互的场景；随后将物理编辑作为干预施加于该重建场景，用仿真产生的反事实轨迹引导视频生成。同时构建PCVE-RigidBench合成基准（含配对源/反事实视频与物理真值），并提出Physical Edit Score。
AI.result: 物理编辑准确率显著优于开源方法与商业模型，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度；Physical Edit Score为0.376，是所有对比方法中唯一正值。真实视频定性对比显示方法可迁移至真实场景，且比对比方法更好地刻画编辑引发的下游运动与交互。
AI.conclusion: PCVE作为新任务被形式化，VideoPhysEdit以"重建-仿真干预-轨迹引导生成"的免训练范式验证了显式物理推理对物理合理视频编辑的有效性；基准与指标为该方向提供了评测基础，但方法目前限于刚体场景。

title: Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut
comment: Preprint, under review. 9 pages main text, 27 pages total; 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable. To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench, a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video. Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics. Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests. A task is resolved when the output passes every test. The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief's explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors. We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments. Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft. We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Timeline-Bench：56 个真实视频剪辑任务的智能体基准，最佳 agent 仅解决 26.8%，多数失败源于无法"感知工艺"的质量测试。
AI.motivation: AI agent 正承担长时程专业工作，但现有评测很少要求交付一件完成的创意成品；缺乏对"原材料→成品"端到端创作能力的度量，因此需要面向视频剪辑这一高难度创作交付物的基准。
AI.method: 构建 Timeline-Bench：56 个真实视频剪辑任务（对话选段、访谈故事化、产品广告剪辑等），每任务含简报、素材、容器与测试集；任务需通过全部测试才算解决。测试覆盖交付格式、内容与简报显式要求，并含一个基于 43 名剪辑师 2,582 次盲评校准的质量测试。评测 16 个"前沿模型 + 编码 agent 框架（Codex/Claude Code/OpenCode 等）"组合。
AI.result: 最佳组合 GPT-6 Astra + Codex + 人工编辑指导仅解决 15/56（26.8%），平均仅 14.0%；人类剪辑师在 83.5% 的判断中更偏好参考版本。771 次未解决运行中有 562 次仅质量测试失败；agent 通过静帧与转写理解素材、只检查渲染缺陷而非剪辑工艺。
AI.conclusion: 长时程创作型交付仍是前沿 agent 的能力短板，失败集中在"审美/叙事工艺"而非格式或程序性检查；需发展能感知时序、叙事与剪辑质量的方法，并公开任务、验证器与逐次运行结果以推动该方向。

title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
summary: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assume that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G$^3$-LoRA (Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.

AI.tldr: 提出 G³-LoRA：通过探测类别级梯度、去除共享全局更新方向、按残差梯度兼容性聚类，训练分组的 LoRA 专家并合并+策略蒸馏为单一适配器，用于文本到视频后训练中的异构奖励加权数据组织。
AI.motivation: 奖励加权数据后训练通常假设所有数据类别产生兼容的更新，但当面类别对应不同技能、领域或评测维度时该假设不成立。作者在 VBench2.0 维度定义数据桶、多模态奖励管线赋权的文本到视频后训练场景下研究此问题。
AI.method: 把奖励加权 flow matching 视作速度场回归，指出不兼容奖励维度在重叠噪声潜空间区域偏好不同去噪方向，导致共享 LoRA 训练"平均化"能力。G³-LoRA 流程：探测奖励加权样本的类别级梯度→移除共享全局更新方向→按残差梯度兼容性聚类类别→训练组专属 LoRA 专家→通过权重合并并配合 on-policy 蒸馏整合为单一适配器。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers 上，合并后的分组适配器在匹配的 VBench2.0 评测上优于基座、联合奖励加权 LoRA 基线，以及随机/语义/原始梯度划分的同管线对照；独立评测者结果一致。在 CogVideoX-2B 上分组避免了联合训练的负迁移。增益不均匀：合压缩了最大专家增益，蒸馏挽回部分损失，camera motion 与若干局部质量维度仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 梯度兼容性可作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的实用诊断工具。局限在于增益不均衡，运动类与局部质量维度未充分解决，且仅在两个视频模型上验证。

title: CarveMix-RC: Addressing Rare-Class Imbalance Through Lesion-Aware Synthetic Augmentation for Brain Metastasis Segmentation
summary: Accurate segmentation of post-treatment brain metastases is essential for treatment planning, longitudinal disease monitoring, and quantitative assessment of therapeutic response. The BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 challenge introduces a clinically relevant segmentation problem involving four anatomically distinct tumor subregions: non-enhancing tumor core (NETC), surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity (SNFH), enhancing tumor (ET), and the resection cavity (RC). Among these, RC segmentation is particularly challenging because of its low prevalence, heterogeneous postoperative appearance, and lesion-wise evaluation protocol, leading conventional segmentation networks to prioritize dominant tumor classes during optimization. The proposed nnU-Net-based framework explicitly addresses RC segmentation through four complementary components: (i) RC-weighted Dice and Cross-Entropy optimization to alleviate class imbalance, (ii) anatomically consistent cavity augmentation to increase the diversity of postoperative cavity appearances, (iii) a residual encoder architecture for enhanced multi-scale feature learning, and (iv) lesion-aware morphological post-processing to suppress false-positive cavity predictions while preserving anatomically plausible structures. The framework is evaluated on the BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 online validation benchmark. Among the evaluated configurations, the ensemble model (Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix) achieves the best performance, with lesion-wise Dice scores of 0.732, 0.752, 0.708, and 0.575 and corresponding NSD scores of 0.794, 0.798, 0.727, and 0.474 for ET, TC, WT, and RC, respectively. These experimental results show that integrating RC-aware optimization, anatomically consistent augmentation, and lesion-aware post-processing provides an effective strategy for improving rare resection cavity segmentation in post-treatment brain metastases.

AI.tldr: 提出基于nnU-Net的框架，通过RC加权损失、解剖一致的腔洞增强、残差编码器与病灶级形态学后处理，改善脑转移治疗后切除腔（RC）分割，验证集RC病灶级Dice 0.575。
AI.motivation: 治疗后脑转移瘤分割对治疗规划与疗效评估至关重要，但切除腔（RC）因样本稀少、术后形态异质且采用病灶级评估协议，常规分割网络在优化中会偏向主导肿瘤类别，导致RC分割性能不佳。
AI.method: 基于nnU-Net的四项改进：(i) RC加权的Dice与交叉熵损失缓解类别不平衡；(ii) 解剖一致的腔洞增强提升术后腔洞外观多样性；(iii) 残差编码器架构增强多尺度特征学习；(iv) 病灶感知的形态学后处理抑制假阳性腔洞预测并保留解剖合理结构；并采用集成模型（Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix）。
AI.result: 在BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1在线验证基准上，集成模型最优：ET、TC、WT、RC的病灶级Dice分别为0.732、0.752、0.708、0.575；对应NSD为0.794、0.798、0.727、0.474。
AI.conclusion: 融合RC感知优化、解剖一致增强与病灶级后处理，是提升治疗后脑转移稀有切除腔分割的有效策略。

title: From UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-T: Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2027)
summary: Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands. We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of 0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024^2 analysis (21.8x speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 将UNI2-h病理基础模型通过输出级知识蒸馏压缩为ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型（34.7M参数，教师1/20），在PanNuke达0.519 mPQ（教师98.8%），MoNuSeg零样本0.668 bPQ，推理634.3 img/s、1024²仅0.045s（21.8x加速）。
AI.motivation: 数字病理细胞核实例分割的高精度依赖大型ViT编码器，推理速度难以满足实时临床需求，需要轻量高效方案。
AI.method: 输出级知识蒸馏：将病理基础模型UNI2-h蒸馏到ConvNeXt-Tiny学生网络（Ours-T，34.7M参数）；并检验多尺度门控卷积（MALA）在ViT编码器下的效果。
AI.result: PanNuke mPQ 0.519（教师98.8%）；MoNuSeg零样本bPQ 0.668；634.3 img/s，1024²全分辨率0.045s，21.8倍加速；MALA在ViT编码器下无增益，输出级蒸馏即可完成高效知识迁移。
AI.conclusion: 轻量学生模型可在基本保持病理基础模型精度的同时实现实时级推理；输出级蒸馏足以支撑高效知识迁移，复杂模块未必必要。

title: Generative AI-Based Data Augmentation for Oral Lesion Classification: The PhotoMOCI Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets. To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology. Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers. Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs). Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance. Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively. Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.

AI.tldr: 提出PhotoMOCI口腔癌影像数据集，系统评测GAN/扩散模型等生成式数据增强策略，并提出SIF合成图像过滤机制，通过代理分类器与真实性检测器筛选高价值合成样本，在两个数据集与ResNet50/ViT上均优于传统增强。
AI.motivation: 口腔癌早期筛查依赖摄影成像，但高质量标注数据稀缺，限制了深度学习分类器的性能；同时生成式数据增强直接使用时常导致下游性能下降，缺乏有效的合成样本筛选手段。
AI.method: 构建并开源PhotoMOCI多任务口腔癌影像数据集；对传统增强与生成式增强（GAN、扩散模型）进行基准对比；提出合成图像过滤器（SIF），基于合成代理分类器（保证类别代表性）与合成图像检测器（保证真实性）双辅助模型对生成样本打分筛选，仅保留高效用样本参与训练。
AI.result: 在PhotoMOCI上，SIF筛选设置相对传统增强使ResNet50与ViT精度分别提升+1.73%与+2.35%；在KOCD上分别提升+2.38%与+2.08%，所有评测数据集与分类器组合均取得一致的精度增益。
AI.conclusion: 直接使用生成式数据增强可能造成性能下降，而结合合成数据真实性与其类别判别特征代表性的SIF机制，可有效过滤干扰分类器训练的合成样本，是一种简单且有效的增强方案。

title: Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling框架，在推理时将隐状态优化按令牌角色解耦：视觉反馈路由至图像敏感token，推理反馈路由至高熵token，其余token用锚点正则约束，在多模态基准上超越CoT与输出空间TTS基线。
AI.motivation: 现有隐空间测试时缩放（latent test-time scaling）对所有可编辑隐token施加单一标量奖励，忽视了多模态大模型中不同生成token的角色差异——部分token对视觉证据敏感，部分对应不确定的推理决策，全局更新会导致优化信号错配。
AI.method: 从初始生成轨迹出发，优化一段短隐状态前缀；将感知侧视觉反馈路由到图像敏感token，将推理反馈路由到高熵（不确定）token，形成角色感知的令牌解耦更新；未被任一通路选中的token由锚点正则项约束以保持稳定；无需重训练，纯推理时框架。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B上，跨感知与推理基准，宏观准确率较CoT分别提升+2.57与+1.51，并在相同解码候选预算下优于强输出空间TTS基线。
AI.conclusion: 令牌角色感知的隐空间细化是一种有效且通用的推理时增强手段，解耦感知与推理反馈可提升多模态推理性能；代码已开源，但评测限于多模态推理基准，未涉及具身或机器人任务验证。

title: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). Code: this https URL
summary: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. Experiments show that Braco forms the favorable empirical accuracy-efficiency frontier under $23\times$--$64\times$ compression and remains competitive at $144\times$, reaching 95.2% accuracy while reducing prefill FLOPs by 84.2%--86.7% relative to the uncompressed upper bound. Against prior methods, Braco matches or improves accuracy while achieving up to approximately 36% end-to-end speedup and using $16.6\times$/$78.8\times$ lower compressor latency/FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 该论文从"token参数化"视角重新审视视觉token压缩，将之分解为基础变换与结构化截断、坐标组织两个环节，提出可压缩性与可学习性两个耦合目标，并据此设计四步轻量编码器Braco，在23×–64×压缩比下形成更优的精度-效率前沿。
AI.motivation: 视觉token压缩能提升VLM效率，但在极端压缩预算下，token剪枝会破坏视觉grounding，而可学习重采样器又会增加参数量、注意力开销与训练复杂度。作者希望在不引入重型模块的前提下，解决极端压缩时的精度与效率矛盾。
AI.method: 从token参数化视角将压缩拆为两部分：(i) 基础变换与结构化截断（保留子空间/可压缩性），(ii) 坐标组织（优化与跨模态对齐）。据此形式化"可压缩性"与"可学习性"为统一泛函目标，并设计Braco四步编码器：变换基截断、输入无关的基坐标嵌入、依赖预算的正交重参数化、以及来自轻量池化的可学习空间残差token。
AI.result: 在23×–64×压缩下Braco处于较优的精度-效率前沿，144×压缩下仍具竞争力，达到95.2%准确率，同时相对未压缩上界将prefill FLOPs降低84.2%–86.7%。相较既有方法，精度持平或更优，端到端加速最高约36%，压缩器延迟/FLOPs分别低约16.6×/78.8×。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离基础变换与坐标组织并显式建模可压缩性与可学习性，可在极端压缩预算下兼顾视觉grounding与效率，为VLM视觉token压缩提供了无需重型重采样器的轻量范式。

title: DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for modern industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD). However, existing autoregressive SVG generation models are predominantly tailored for artistic creation and struggle to maintain the rigorous geometric fidelity and cross-view spatial alignment required for engineering drawings. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{DrawingsDreamer}, a unified Large Language Model (LLM)-driven framework for multi-view vector-based engineering drawings generation. By formulating the generation of multi-view engineering drawings purely as a sequence modeling task, we eliminate the need of raster image encoders. We propose a Streamlined Representation utilizing hierarchical postfix tokenization, which guides the model to establish local geometric coordinates before assigning semantic boundaries. Optimized via a progressive task-aware curriculum schedule, \textbf{DrawingsDreamer} effectively transitions from localized structural repair to macroscopic generation in a unified model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model achieves strong performance in both geometric fidelity and syntactic accuracy across diverse conditional and unconditional generation tasks.

AI.tldr: DrawingsDreamer：用 LLM 将多视角工程制图 SVG 生成统一建模为序列任务，采用层级后缀分词与渐进式课程学习，实现局部结构修复到宏观生成。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归 SVG 生成模型主要面向艺术创作，难以满足工业 CAD 工程图纸所需的严格几何保真度与跨视角空间对齐要求。
AI.method: 提出统一的 LLM 驱动框架，将多视角矢量工程图生成纯粹形式化为序列建模，去除栅格图像编码器；设计层级后缀分词（hierarchical postfix tokenization）的简洁表示，先建立局部几何坐标再分配语义边界；并以渐进式任务感知课程调度优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该统一模型在多种条件与无条件生成任务上，几何保真度与语法准确率均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为工程制图的矢量生成提供了新的统一范式，但摘要未给出具体量化指标、数据集规模与开源信息，实际工业可用性仍需进一步验证。

title: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
summary: When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AnswerMap：一种无需训练、任务无关、黑盒的视觉解释方法，通过对图像行/列条带进行 yes/no 相关性提问并取外积得到查询条件空间图，并用多种读出方式实现定位、幻觉检测与答案修正。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 可解释性工具依赖文本理由（模态不匹配）或内部读出（出现时机过早、需白盒访问，且难以反映最终输出）。需要一种能够反映最终输出、无需白盒访问、且能原生支持连续输出的视觉理由。
AI.method: 将图像切成 K 个行条带与 K 个列条带，分别与查询组合为 yes/no 相关问题输入冻结模型，取行、列 "yes" 后验概率的外积得到查询条件空间图 AnswerMap；在其上定义固定读出 R（如期望、最大值、top-mass 区域）以获得连续输出（如位置）。全程无需训练、任务无关、黑盒。
AI.result: 在 4 个模型、3 种查询分布上用两项测试验证：(a) 与模型自身生成点的 AUC 为 0.85（attention 为 0.38）；(b) 删除地图区域使 53% 正确回答翻转（attention 为 19%）。三种读出分别实现：最大值标记幻觉对象、期望在模型自身指向失败时正确、top-mass 区域回送裁剪修复约半数错误答案。
AI.conclusion: AnswerMap 提供了 VLM 可解释性的新视角，并通过其读出为视觉任务提供了超越文本 token 的新型输出接口。

title: Evaluating Hierarchy-Aware Deep Learning for the Recognition of Tironian Notes
comment: Accepted at the 2026 ICDAR Workshop on Computational Paleography (IWCP). 25 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory. Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers. Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce. However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs. This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition. We use the Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes. We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, Shifted Window Transformer (Swin), and Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers with Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network (HD-CNN)-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering. The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain. The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation. On Vergilius Turonensis, HD-CNN achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43%, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09%. Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究提洛尼亚符号（Tironian notes）的自动识别，比较平铺分类器（ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT）与层级式HD-CNN及层级路由模型，发现层级结构在无域适应条件下更优，而平铺模型在少样本适应后表现最好。
AI.motivation: 提洛尼亚符号作为最早的拉丁速记系统，符号数量庞大且视觉上高度相似，人工释读耗时，含此类符号的手稿对研究者几乎不可及。自动识别面临细粒度笔画与结构差异的挑战，且真实标注数据稀缺；此外标准平铺分类器未显式利用符号间视觉与结构关系，因此作者希望验证符号间层级结构关系能否辅助识别。
AI.method: 基于Martin Hellmann的Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum（SNT）数据集，该数据集提供理想化字形与层级组织。作者将平铺分类器（ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT）与HD-CNN式粗到细模型以及基于视觉类别清洗和相似度重聚类的层级感知路由模型进行对比；在手写样本与Vergilius Turonensis手稿域样本上评估，并分别测试是否使用有限的少样本域适应。
AI.result: 在Vergilius Turonensis上，HD-CNN取得最佳非适应Top-1为45.43%；平铺分类在少样本适应后取得最佳Top-1为82.09%。平铺与层级模型的相对性能取决于是否进行域适应。
AI.conclusion: 层级结构能够支持提洛尼亚符号识别，尤其在无域适应条件下；但域适应会显著改变平铺与层级模型的相对优势。

title: Domain-adaptive Zero-Shot Image Enhancement via Locality-Constrained Diffusion Guidance
comment: Accepted manuscript. The final version is published in Computers & Graphics
summary: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have shown remarkable performance in unconditional image generation. In order to generate images with desired semantics, recent works have restricted the solution space by using guidance constraints in the diffusion sampling process. However, for image enhancement across different domains, these methods struggle to balance two main requirements: looking realistic in the target domain (photorealistic images) and preserving relevant features of the source domain, e.g., low-quality renderings or art paintings. Here, small local changes can alter the fidelity of the image completely, while large changes in other regions might be insignificant. We introduce LocDiff, a locality-constrained guidance method for image enhancement, which serves as a zero-shot extension to pre-trained diffusion models, ensuring the preservation of critical features during domain adaptation. In this way, we retain important local features, while allowing less critical regions to remain unconstrained and not interfere with the guidance process for relevant regions. We evaluate our method on two different domain-shift tasks: For art-to-photo translation, we apply the method in a fully zero-shot setting, preserving facial identity from paintings while generating photorealistic details. For enhancing low-quality fetal ultrasound renderings, we demonstrate zero-shot inference with auxiliary prior alignment. Here, the objective is to artificially add high-resolution characteristics and produce photorealistic ultrasound renderings, a target domain for which no ground truth distribution exists. Our experimental results demonstrate that LocDiff achieves favorable realism-faithfulness trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art methods, enabling controllable cross-domain enhancement.

AI.tldr: LocDiff：面向图像增强的局部性约束引导方法，作为预训练扩散模型零样本扩展，在域迁移中保留源域关键局部特征并提升目标域真实感，在画作→照片与低质胎儿超声渲染两任务上取得更优真实感-忠实度权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型引导采样通过全局约束压缩解空间以生成语义目标图像，但跨域图像增强需同时满足两难点：目标域照片级真实感与源域关键特征保留。且不同区域敏感度差异大——局部小改动可能彻底破坏保真度，而其他区域大幅改变却无关紧要，全局约束无法区分。
AI.method: 提出LocDiff，基于局部性约束的引导方法，作为预训练扩散模型的零样本扩展。在扩散采样中引入空间局部性约束，仅对关键区域施加引导以保留重要局部特征，非关键区域不加约束，避免其干扰相关区域的引导过程，从而在域适应中兼顾特征保留与真实感。
AI.result: 在两个域偏移任务上评估：画作→照片翻译（完全零样本，在生成照片级细节的同时保留画作人脸身份）；低质胎儿超声渲染增强（零样本推理+辅助先验对齐，注入高分辨率特征并生成照片级超声渲染，该目标域无真值分布）。实验表明相较SOTA取得更优真实感-忠实度权衡，实现可控跨域增强。
AI.conclusion: LocDiff通过局部性约束引导实现零样本跨域图像增强，在无真值分布的目标域上仍可工作，提供了更好的真实感与忠实度平衡，支持可控的跨域增强。

title: Scaffold Then Internalize: Representation Injection for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer's hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders. In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder's space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce \textit{REPresentation Injection} (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over $43.5\times$. Code will be available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出REPI训练框架，将预训练视觉编码器表示注入扩散Transformer参与去噪，采用"脚手架到内化"策略，训练速度提升超43.5倍。
AI.motivation: REPA等表示对齐方法仅将扩散模型的隐状态投影到编码器空间做对齐监督，编码器表示是被动目标而非参与生成的组件；作者希望反向探索，让编码器表示主动注入扩散Transformer并参与去噪过程。
AI.method: REPI（REPresentation Injection）：基于scaffold-to-internalization（脚手架到内化）策略——投影后的编码器表示先作为临时脚手架辅助训练，随后被扩散Transformer逐步内化。与REPA方向互补，可联合使用。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络上REPI均优于REPA；与REPA组合后增益超过单独使用任一方法。仅160K训练步的REPI+REPA即达到原版SiT训练7M步的效果，加速超过43.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 表示注入是比表示对齐更主动、有效的扩散Transformer训练加速方向，且与现有对齐方法互补，具备良好的通用性和实用价值。

title: Beyond Saying Less: Fine-Grained Alignment for Informative and Faithful Vision-Language Models
summary: Object hallucination remains a major challenge for large vision-language models. While off-policy preference optimization proves to be an effective solution, on-policy reinforcement learning provides a more promising direction as it directly targets a model's current failure modes. However, we find that without fine-grained reward formulation and allocation, on-policy optimization often falls into an easy shortcut: reducing hallucinations merely by saying less---making fewer valid claims. To comprehensively resolve this, we propose a fine-grained alignment framework that couples dense reward signals at the data level with precise credit assignment at the algorithmic level. Specifically, we first construct the Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) dataset to address sparse annotations that prevent valid object claims from being verified and rewarded. DOPA exhaustively annotates the deterministic presence and absence of every concept across an expanded vocabulary, significantly increasing the density of reliable reward signals during on-policy rollouts. Second, we propose Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO) to prevent response-level shared advantages from allowing local hallucinations to compromise all other valid outputs within the same response. By assigning credit to each subsentence independently based on its object claims, SCAPO can precisely reinforce faithful generations and penalize hallucinations. Furthermore, we leverage the resulting faithful image descriptions as auxiliary context to transfer generative gains to discriminative tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces highly informative, faithful descriptions in generative tasks while yielding clear performance gains on discriminative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出细粒度对齐框架（DOPA 数据集 + SCAPO 子句级信用分配），解决在线策略 RL 中"少说少错"的幻觉捷径问题。
AI.motivation: LVLM 物体幻觉严重。off-policy 偏好优化有效，但 on-policy RL 更能针对当前失败模式。然而缺乏细粒度奖励构造与分配时，在线优化会走捷径：通过减少有效陈述（说得更少）来降低幻觉率，而非真正提升忠实度。根源在于两点：稀疏标注导致有效物体陈述无法被验证与奖励；响应级共享优势使局部幻觉连累整条回复的其他正确输出。
AI.method: 1) 构建 DOPA（Dense Object Presence and Absence）数据集，在扩展词表上穷举标注每个概念的确定性存在与缺失，提升在线 rollout 中可靠奖励信号密度。2) 提出 SCAPO（Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization），按子句的物体陈述独立分配信用，精确强化忠实生成、惩罚幻觉，避免响应级共享优势。3) 将生成的忠实图像描述作为辅助上下文，把生成增益迁移到判别任务。
AI.result: 生成任务上产出信息量大且忠实的描述，同时在判别式评测上取得明确性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 密集奖励信号（数据层）与精确信用分配（算法层）耦合的细粒度对齐框架，可有效抑制 on-policy 优化中的"少说少错"捷径，兼顾生成忠实度与判别性能。

title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
comment: 11 pages for the main paper, 20 pages for the supplementary
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment. While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigate sparse rewards using hindsight information, their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step, defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget. However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments. To bridge this gap, we present Pivot-Aware Internalized Visual On-Policy Training (PIVOT), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives. At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped. Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (+8% over SFT+GRPO baseline and +5% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B (+12% over SFT+GRPO baseline).

AI.tldr: PIVOT 将"关键步骤定位 + 状态回滚"从环境物理回滚内化为 token 级参数更新，用 Analyzer-Teacher-Student 三角色统一 GRPO 与 OPD，在多轮 VLM 智能体任务上显著超越 SFT+GRPO 与前 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多轮 VLM agent 的 RLVR（GRPO）存在两大痛点：全失败组内奖励方差为零导致零梯度"沉默"，以及仅 episode 级粗粒度信用分配。On-Policy Distillation / Self-Distillation 借 hindsight 信息缓解稀疏奖励，但其有效机制未被解释清楚；作者需要先弄清收益来源，再设计不依赖环境回滚的可行训练方案。
AI.method: 1) 在五个多轮 VLM agent 基准上做受控反事实回滚探针，定位收益来源为"pivot step（无剩余步预算下首个不可恢复动作）处的物理状态回滚"；2) 提出 PIVOT：单个架构内含三个功能角色——failure Analyzer 基于视觉轨迹拼贴图与动作日志非侵入地定位 pivot 并诊断失败模式；detached Teacher 在该特权诊断上下文中对失败 token 重打分；Student 优化联合 GRPO + 置信度门控的 OPD 目标；3) 测试时剥离 Teacher 与 Analyzer，无需环境回滚与额外技能提示。
AI.result: 在覆盖认知网格谜题、3D 具身控制与导航、生成式推理的五类多轮 VLM agent 任务上，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 达到 0.90 总体准确率（较 SFT+GRPO 基线 +8%，较此前 SOTA +5%），并扩展到 Qwen3-VL-2B 的 0.92（较 SFT+GRPO 基线 +12%）。
AI.conclusion: OPSD/OPD 的多轮 agent 收益主要来自 pivot 步的状态回滚而非更细的监督信号本身；PIVOT 证明该收益可被内化为 token 级参数更新，在去除环境回滚与测试期技能提示后仍取得一致增益，为多轮 VLM agent 训练提供了免回滚、免特权推理的实用范式。

title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
summary: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RoGSW4RLD，一个前馈框架，将同步多相机机器人 rollout 提升为统一、可按时间查询的度量 4D 高斯场，用于把世界模型生成的视频未来转化为跨视角一致的 4D 度量表示。
AI.motivation: 现有 action-conditioned 视频世界模型虽能预测机器人交互，但输出仅为多相机视频集合，而非跨视角与时间可查询的共享度量场景；直接逐相机 4D 重建再合并无法保证跨视角一致性，尤其对移动机载相机与固定外部视角的融合问题尤为严重。
AI.method: 两阶段前馈架构：Stage 1 通过融合跨视角证据与机器人特定关节几何及运动学，联合构建度量 4D 场；Stage 2 在严格保持初始时间位移的前提下细化场的几何与外观。不学习独立的几何转移模型，而是直接重建现有世界模型生成的视觉未来。
AI.result: 在 256 个 held-out DROID episodes 上，相比逐相机重建加标定合并：新视角 PSNR 提升 2.15 dB，深度 AbsRel 降低 47%，机器人位移误差降低 61%；增益可扩展到 action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts。
AI.conclusion: 预测的视频未来可成功转化为一致、空间可查询的 4D 度量表示，为世界模型输出提供统一时空查询能力。

title: Generative Uncertainty as a Self-supervised Signal for Semantic Similarity Learning
summary: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.

AI.tldr: 利用T2V扩散模型的生成不确定性，以纯生成数据自监督学习掩码，筛选出预训练视频表征中的稳定语义特征子空间，用于视频语义相似度评估。
AI.motivation: 视频语义相似度的定义与标注受复杂时空结构影响，成本高且困难；而T2V扩散模型对熟悉概念输出一致、对专有概念输出方差大，这一现象可作为无需人工标注的相似度学习信号。
AI.method: 基于VideoMAE、V-JEPA等预训练视频表征，用纯生成数据学习一个嵌入掩码：保留在通用概念多次生成中稳定一致的特征维度，抑制与生成噪声/不确定性相关的维度，从而得到语义特征子空间。
AI.result: 在三个下游任务（含OOD检测、视频检索等）上，所学特征子空间一致优于原始预训练特征与基线特征选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 生成不确定性可作为具身无关的自监督信号，用于从现成视频表征中提取语义相似度子空间，避免昂贵的人工标注。

title: Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: Ego-Forge：免caption、免几何偏置的exo-to-egocentric视频生成框架，通过Dynamic Captioning从模型隐状态导出条件token，替代外部文本条件与几何引导注意力。
AI.motivation: 外中心到自中心视频生成需在大视角变化下迁移外观与语义，并幻觉出exo相机未见内容。现有方法或需额外输入（真值初始ego帧、多同步exo视角），或限于特定类别；EgoX虽实现跨活动、in-the-wild泛化，但推理时需人工提供不存在ego视角的caption，且引入计算昂贵的几何引导注意力偏置，会传播重建误差并压制文本与视觉上下文。
AI.method: 提出Ego-Forge，免caption、免几何偏置框架。核心为Dynamic Captioning：直接从模型隐状态推导条件token，并使其适配扩散时间步与网络深度，取代外部文本条件；训练规模扩大一个数量级并使用全部可用exocentric视角，从而隐式学习跨视角对应，去除几何引导注意力，仅保留轻量深度先验。
AI.result: 在Ego-Exo4D上达到SOTA，端到端运行更快，推理时无需外部标注，并泛化到in-the-wild场景，包括过度依赖几何会阻碍外观推断的情形。模型与源码将公开。
AI.conclusion: Ego-Forge以隐式跨视角对应学习替代显式几何偏置与人工文本条件，简化推理依赖并提升泛化与效率，为exo-to-ego视频生成提供免标注、可泛化的新范式。

title: Rethinking Visual Token Compression for Video Large Language Models: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by long videos. Recent video token compression methods increasingly introduce sophisticated strategies for token selection, pruning, and merging. This raises a fundamental question: how much of compression performance can be obtained by simply preserving the structure encoded in the visual representations? We investigate this question with SimpleCluster, a simple and training-free baseline that performs position-aware cross-frame clustering in the visual feature space and represents each cluster using the mean of its original visual features. Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的视频Token压缩基线SimpleCluster，通过位置感知的跨帧聚类与簇均值表示，在1%极致压缩率下仍保持稳健性能，并揭示全局特征覆盖度是性能关键。
AI.motivation: Video LLM推理效率受长视频产生的大量视觉Token制约；现有压缩方法（选择、剪枝、合并）策略日益复杂，作者追问一个基本问题：仅靠保留视觉表征中已编码的结构，能获得多少压缩收益？
AI.method: SimpleCluster：无需训练，在视觉特征空间进行位置感知的跨帧聚类，每个簇用其原始视觉特征的均值表示，从而在极大压缩率下保留原始特征分布。
AI.result: 在4个视频理解基准、3个代表性Video LLM上，跨广泛Token保留率取得与近期压缩方法相当或更优的性能，在1%等极低保留率下尤为稳健；分析表明更强的下游性能与更好的原始视觉特征分布保持（尤其全局覆盖度）一致相关。
AI.conclusion: 在高度受限的Token预算下，特征空间保持（而非复杂选择策略）是视频Token压缩的重要设计考量；简单聚类基线可作为强有力参照。

title: Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI
summary: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度体数据降维（MVR）方法，将3D脑部sMRI的D层切片压缩为M<<D个2D分量，再用冻结的2D基础模型编码并线性探测。
AI.motivation: 2D预训练基础模型比专用3D预训练更易获取，但2D编码器与3D体数据之间存在维度不匹配；现有方法先逐切片独立编码再融合特征，计算成本高且未充分利用层间信息。
AI.method: MVR采用"先降维后编码"策略：对每个解剖视图，将D层切片压缩为M个互补2D分量。其中包括一个基于原始穿层强度的无中心PCA基分量，以及由多尺度空间描述子构建的残差细节分量。降维由训练集体数据估计，无需诊断标签或梯度优化，且之后固定不变。各分量由共享的冻结2D基础模型独立编码，拼接后用于线性探测。
AI.result: 在冻结编码器设置下，MVR在ADNI、OASIS和ABIDE数据集上相对所评估的2D-to-3D适配方法及简单输入降维基线取得较强整体性能，并从ADNI到AIBL具有良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: MVR以无标签、无梯度的固定降维方式有效桥接2D基础模型与3D体数据，为脑结构MRI提供高效且可泛化的迁移方案。

title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
summary: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出BiMoGen，一个基于掩码离散扩散的统一框架，同时处理文本到动作生成与动作到文本描述，并用两阶段训练与生成感知自校正缓解误差累积。
AI.motivation: 文本-动作生成与动作-文本描述共享同一跨模态对应关系，但现有统一方法多依赖自回归建模，固定生成顺序难以适配语言与动作的双向依赖，早期预测错误会被固化为上下文，损害时序连贯性与跨模态一致性。掩码离散扩散通过迭代双向预测提供天然解法，但其自身存在训练用干净真值上下文、推理用自生成含噪上下文的不一致问题。
AI.method: 1) 统一掩码离散扩散框架BiMoGen，以迭代双向预测建模动作-文本序列；2) 解耦单模态/跨模态训练：先掩码预训练在配对序列上建立跨模态对应，再监督微调专化双向生成；3) 生成感知自校正：训练时暴露模型自身预测，采样早期进行校正轮次以修正过早确定的不可靠token。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D与KIT-ML上，两项任务均取得有竞争力的性能，验证了两阶段训练与自校正设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双向掩码离散扩散可替代自回归成为统一的动作-文本建模范式，配合解耦训练与自校正可提升跨模态一致性与生成质量，但实验仅在标准动作数据集上验证，缺少与具身/机器人系统的结合。

title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 将多光谱卫星图像光谱超分辨率建模为算子学习问题，提出深度算子网络SSRON，学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射，并具备零样本预测未见波段的能力。
AI.motivation: 高时空分辨率的高光谱卫星影像获取成本高，而光谱超分辨率可低成本实现该目标；该任务本身不适定，适合深度学习方法。作者希望借助算子学习范式，学习连续光谱函数映射，突破离散波段预测的局限。
AI.method: 将光谱超分辨率重新定义为算子学习问题，提出SSRON——一种深度算子网络（Deep Operator Network），学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射；训练目标为将类Sentinel-2A多光谱影像超分辨为EMIT高光谱影像。
AI.result: 相比基线模型，SSRON在所有指标上取得更优性能；展现了零样本光谱超分辨率能力，可预测训练中未见的波段；连续输出形式使其有望在比原生传感器更细的波长间隔上估计光谱。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明SSRON的有效性，并确立算子学习作为光谱超分辨率的一个有前景的方向。

title: When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting
comment: 28 pages, 7 figures. Project Page: this https URL
summary: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: StaMina：通过状态条件更新的持续视频计数框架，配多源数据管线与分层训练目标。
AI.motivation: 持续视频计数需区分"新观测"与"新对象/已完成事件"，现有方法难以在时序上显式维护计数状态并处理事件终止。
AI.method: 提出 StaMina：以计数状态为条件做状态更新；递归视觉上下文支持识别；可微递归在计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移；可见性与关联目标训练物体分支；构建 39.8K 空间查询与事件标注的多源管线形成计数轨迹。
AI.result: 在 SVCBench 上评测：前缀回放 (Full) 与持续流式 (Stream) 下，4B/8B 模型分别达 41.9/36.4 与 44.9/38.2 GPA；8B 较 Counting-SFT 在同查询上提升 10.9/3.2 点；匹配图对比分离相位条件与轨迹监督的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 状态维护式递归建模结合轨迹级监督可有效提升视频持续计数的适应性与在线决策能力，但属视频理解范畴，与具身/3D 核心方向关联有限。

title: Automated Species Identification in Camera Trap Images for Wildlife Conservation
comment: 52 pages. this http URL . thesis, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Brac University, June 2025
summary: Wildlife conservation involves protecting, preserving, and managing wildlife species and their habitats. With today's rapid pace of human development, climate change, and other unsustainable practices, the need for wildlife conservation has heightened. Despite significant progress in species identification using deep-learning models, significant challenges still remain in effectively detecting small animals in low-contrast trap images due to limited feature extraction capabilities. This thesis presents a novel end-to-end framework integrating a self-attention mechanism to address these limitations. The proposed architecture involves a Swin-BiFPN backbone integrated in a Faster RCNN detection network, coupled with a visual semantic extraction module driven by the LLaVA v1.5 (13B) multimodal large language model. The detection framework, capable of extracting crucial features in challenging trap images, demonstrates consistently high results and robust generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the visual semantic extraction module provides zero-shot detection capability, as well as providing valuable insights and emergent cues of the animal's behavior, further supporting the conservation effort. The MLLM evaluation was conducted using both traditional NLP metrics (precision, recall, F1, and SBERT similarity) and subjective scoring by LLM-based judges (GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0), across five MLLMs, demonstrating the model's strong performance in visual description generation. The proposed framework improves detection accuracy across low-contrast trap images and small animals while also demonstrating zero-shot detection capability leveraging the MLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端野生动物检测与语义理解框架：以Swin-BiFPN为骨干的Faster R-CNN结合自注意力机制提升低对比度红外相机图像中小型动物的检测，并接入LLaVA v1.5(13B)多模态大模型实现零样本检测与动物行为语义描述。
AI.motivation: 低对比度红外陷阱图像中的小型动物因特征提取能力不足而检测困难，现有深度学习物种识别模型在此类场景下仍有显著局限；同时野生动物保护还需要行为层面的语义理解，而不仅是物种定位。
AI.method: 在Faster R-CNN检测网络中集成Swin-BiFPN骨干与自注意力机制构成端到端检测框架；另设视觉语义提取模块，由LLaVA v1.5(13B)多模态大模型驱动，输出视觉描述与行为线索；MLLM评估采用传统NLP指标（precision、recall、F1、SBERT相似度）与基于LLM的评委主观打分（GPT-4.1、GROK 3.0），比较五个MLLM。
AI.result: 检测框架在低对比度陷阱图像与小型动物上取得稳定提升并表现良好泛化能力；视觉语义模块实现零样本检测，并提供行为洞察与涌现线索；五个多模态模型对比显示所提模型在视觉描述生成上表现较强。
AI.conclusion: 该框架同时改善了低对比度、小目标场景的检测精度，并借助多模态大模型获得零样本检测与语义理解能力，从而更好地服务于野生动物保护。

title: DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
comment: Accepted to IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON BIOMETRICS, BEHAVIOR, AND IDENTITY SCIENCE
summary: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol.

AI.tldr: DiMoP: 基于掩码与扩散驱动的骨架动作表示学习,通过帧级伪分类实现对关节运动分布的可控加噪/去噪建模,在 NTU RGB+D 60/120 与 PKUMMD 上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架动作识别方法侧重强运动(大幅度动作),对微弱与中等幅度运动的建模不足,且通常采用确定性坐标回归,难以刻画关节运动的完整分布,导致表示对运动强度的覆盖不均衡。
AI.method: 提出 DiMoP:对掩码关节施加渐进噪声进行扩散,并以可见关节为条件去噪,从而学习关节运动的生成式分布而非回归确定性坐标;同时设计伪帧分类器,利用序列一致、时序连贯的伪标签在无人工标注下引入判别能力,实现生成与判别运动建模的统一。
AI.result: 在 NTU RGB+D 60/120 和 PKUMMD 上均取得 SOTA;在 NTU RGB+D 120 的 cross-subject 协议下相较已有工作提升 1.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过掩码扩散生成建模与伪帧判别的结合,DiMoP 实现了对弱、中、强动态的均衡学习,为基于骨架的运动表示提供了一种生成-判别统一的原理性机制。

title: From internal representations to model improvement through prediction errors
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary Information is provided as an ancillary file
summary: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model's own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model's internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model's current state to guide which images are labeled next.

AI.tldr: 该方法将目标检测器自身的内部特征与预测误差及其预期性能影响关联起来，在无候选图像标签的情况下选择标注图像并重训练，在16种条件中15种改进了误差识别，并在多个设置下优于仅基于特征稀有度的选择。
AI.motivation: 在有限标注预算下，选哪些图像标注决定模型提升幅度。现有数据选择方法依赖独立训练模型的特征或视觉语言模型生成的场景描述，这些信号无法直接反映被改进模型自身的变化；而目标模型的内部特征会随重训练改变，是选择下一批训练数据的自然线索，但仅靠特征稀有度无法揭示对性能真正重要的错误。
AI.method: 将目标模型的内部特征与其预测误差及误差对性能的预期影响建立联系，在不使用候选图像标签的前提下进行图像选择、标注与重训练；对比特征稀有度选择及另外几种方法，在目标检测任务上于两个数据集、两对随机种子下评估，考察连续多轮标注与不同重训练时长的影响。
AI.result: 在16种条件中的15种，加入内部特征改进了预测误差识别；多轮标注平均性能上，方法在全部四个评估设置中优于仅基于特征稀有度的选择，并在六种方法中排名前二；在固定其他条件时，重训练后性能仍高于稀有度选择，尽管后者收集到更多错误；重训练时间更长时，该方法在六种方法中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将模型的内部特征与其错误及其性能影响关联，可能有助于挑选能提升性能的训练图像，使模型当前状态能够引导下一步标注哪些图像。该思路为主动数据选择提供了利用目标模型自身信号的途径，但证据限于目标检测任务，尚需在更广泛任务与模型上验证其泛化性。

title: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
summary: Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss--compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around $10^{22}$ FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated. Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.

AI.tldr: 系统比较了无视觉编码器与有编码器的 MLLM 缩放定律，发现无编码器架构在约 10^22 FLOPs 处可追上后者，且语言模型会通过视觉专属适配接管视觉处理。
AI.motivation: 现代 MLLM 大多依赖预训练视觉编码器提供视觉先验，而无编码器 MLLM 直接从原始像素学习视觉表示，架构更简洁统一，但其缩放行为尚未被系统刻画。作者希望填补这一空白，判断视觉先验的优势是否随规模增长而衰减。
AI.method: 在统一的多模态与文本目标下，对无编码器与有编码器 MLLM 进行对照缩放实验，拟合损失—计算量前沿（loss-compute frontier）与计算最优分配，并分析无编码器模型内部表征的演化（视觉 token 的双向交互、视觉处理所在层位置、专家路由集中度）。
AI.result: (1) 去掉视觉编码器使多模态目标的算力最优分配向更大模型偏移，文本目标几乎不变；(2) 两架构在文本目标上损失—计算前沿几乎重合，多模态目标上出现分叉：无编码器模型小规模时落后，但预测在约 10^22 FLOPs 处追平；(3) 无编码器时语言模型通过视觉专属适配接管视觉功能——视觉 token 双向交互随算力增长愈发有益，视觉处理前移至更早层，视觉 token 的专家路由更集中。
AI.conclusion: 预训练编码器所提供的视觉先验优势随规模增大而减弱，无编码器架构是多模态预训练的一个有前景方向。

title: W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change
summary: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement. Overall, change across a video can supervise a visual encoder whose representations remain useful at either image or video granularity. Code is available at~\href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: W2Rep 提出掩码特征预测框架，用独立编码的源图像参与预测，条件化于可见视频上下文、查询位置与有符号时间间隔，使视频中的变化信号反过来监督单帧图像编码器。
AI.motivation: 图像自监督只学静态空间结构，视频方法多在多帧联合表示中隐式学时序关系。作者希望验证：观看场景变化能否提升单张图像的特征质量，同时不牺牲视频表示能力。
AI.method: 掩码特征预测框架：源图像独立编码，目标位置特征由以可见视频上下文、查询位置和有符号时间间隔为条件的预测器给出；图像路径被迫学跨时间通用特征，视频路径须补全源图像缺失的证据，从而形成互补的跨帧监督目标。
AI.result: 在多模型规模与下游任务上，冻结与微调识别均优于对比协议基线；联合视频编码相较逐帧聚合进一步增益。控制实验表明增益依赖直接更新源图像特征，以及同时使用视频上下文与时间位移。
AI.conclusion: 视频中的变化可作为一种监督信号，训练出在图像与视频两种粒度上都有效的视觉编码器。

title: Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace
comment: Accepted at 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label efficient. Across datasets, encoder alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace predicts CER within every method. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines; full fine-tuning achieves the lowest mean CER and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results show that the value of pixel reconstruction depends on where discriminative signal lies in the input.

AI.tldr: 在六种语言、六个手写文本识别基准上，作者比较了像素重建（MIM）、JEPA 与对比学习三类自监督目标。作者提出判别信号在像素空间中的分布（集中于高方差方向）决定自监督目标的可迁移性，实验证实像素重建类方法在冻结探针与全量标签微调下均取得最低 CER，且更省标签，编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐度可预测 CER。
AI.motivation: 自然图像分类中对比学习方法通常优于像素重建方法，但在手写文本识别（HTR）自监督预训练中结论相反。作者认为该差异源于判别信号在像素空间中的分布位置不同：HTR 的判别信号集中于高方差方向、在低方差方向基本缺失，因此能够保留高方差像素内容的目标函数应具有最好的迁移性。这一假设为自监督目标的选择提供了可预测的判据。
AI.method: 在匹配编码器、数据与评估协议的前提下，比较三类共六种自监督方法：像素层面的掩码图像建模（pixel-grounded MIM）、JEPA 类方法与对比学习方法。评估覆盖五种语言的六个手写识别基准，包含全标签微调、冻结探针（frozen probe）、标签效率分析，以及度量编码器表示与高方差像素子空间的对齐程度。另以预训练 LLM 作为解码器，测试冻结像素重建编码器的表现。
AI.result: 在全量标签下，像素重建类自监督在每个基准和两种冻结探针上均取得最低 CER；其表示显式暴露逐位置字符信息，而其他方法族只能通过读出层恢复该信息；也是唯一能从真实手写数据预训练中获益的方法族。其表示还具有更好的标签效率。跨数据集来看，编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐度在每种方法内均可预测 CER。搭配预训练 LLM 解码器时，冻结的像素重建编码器可与全量微调的监督基线竞争；全量微调取得最低平均 CER，并在每个基准上位列第一或第二。
AI.conclusion: 像素重建在 HTR 自监督预训练中的优势并非普遍规律，而是取决于判别信号在输入像素空间中的位置；保留高方差像素内容的目标函数迁移性最好。该结论为自监督目标的设计与选择提供了以信号分布为依据的原则。

title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection
summary: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.

AI.tldr: AHMAD 用共享编解码器加轻量任务投影器统一五类视觉任务，COCO 全景 PQ 53.1、语义 mIoU 66.5，并用知识蒸馏把关键点检测压缩为单次前向。
AI.motivation: 通用多任务视觉模型需在单一框架内统一密集与稀疏预测任务，但不同任务的输出结构差异大，难以兼容。
AI.method: 提出 AHMAD 框架：共享编码器-解码器 + 若干轻量任务专属投影器，统一语义分割、实例分割、深度估计、关键点检测与目标检测五类任务；并针对自顶向下关键点检测的多轮前向开销，引入基于知识蒸馏的方法实现单次前向推理。
AI.result: 在 COCO-val 全景分割达 PQ 53.1、语义分割 mIoU 66.5，均为 SOTA；关键点检测效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: AHMAD 提供了一个轻量而有效的通用多任务视觉学习框架，在五类视觉任务上表现强劲。

title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出直接从参考视频学习 rollout 分布的少步自回归视频生成框架，用冻结自监督视频表征空间中的 MMD 目标替代 DMD，省去双向扩散教师与在线 fake-score 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成依赖 DMD，需要双向扩散教师和在线 fake-score 模型，训练开销大、占用显存高，且难以扩展到大规模模型；同时蒸馏范式受限于特定目标扩散教师，无法从参考视频中获取新风格、语义与空间先验。
AI.method: 在冻结的自监督视频表征空间中最小化 MMD，直接匹配参考视频的 rollout 分布；引入混合 Nyström–Monte Carlo 估计器平衡近似偏差与采样方差；配合内存高效的 replay 与梯度子采样使目标可实用化。架构与初始化沿用 Self-Forcing。
AI.result: 1.3B 模型将 VBench Total 从 83.80 提升至 84.64，保持 17 FPS；去除辅助 score 模型后可在八张 H200 上完成 14B 后训练；除蒸馏外还能从参考视频中获得新视觉风格、语义概念与空间先验，且无需目标专用扩散教师。
AI.conclusion: 分布匹配可脱离扩散教师与 score 模型，直接以参考视频为监督信号，兼顾生成质量、推理速度与可扩展性，并支持风格与概念层面的持续学习。

title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sprout，一种"边推理边建记忆"的 agentic 长视频理解框架：以低帧率逐段观看视频并在可回答当前问题时停止，将每段存为时间树粗节点，再以高帧率回访关键区间细化节点；文本化后丢弃对应视频输入、保留视频工具可回访性，记忆与问答记录跨问题持久化，实现在线动态记忆。三个模型多基准上准确率持平或更优，且无预构建阶段、单问题上下文开销更低。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解采用"先建记忆再推理"的两阶段流水线，记忆离线为整段视频一次性构建、推理时视为静态资源。这在实际中两端皆昂贵：问题少时，为整段视频建记忆的成本远超回答所需；问题多时，记忆从不更新，回答过程中获得的信息无法传给下一个问题。核心矛盾在于记忆构建与推理被解耦，与实际"一视频多问题、逐步深入"的消费方式不匹配。
AI.method: Sprout 将记忆构建与推理耦合为单一 agent 过程。维护一棵时间树（temporal tree）：agent 先以低帧率逐段浏览视频，当判定当前问题已可回答即停止；每看完一段，将该段记录为树的一个粗粒度节点；随后对关键时间区间以更高帧率回访，用恢复出的细节细化（sprout）相应节点。当某段被转写为文本后，其原始视频输入从上下文历史中移除，仅通过 video tools 保持原视频可达。记忆树与历史问答记录跨问题持久保存，使记忆为在线、动态的：从第一个问题起被构建，并随后续每个问题持续更新。文中还发现用文本记忆替代累积的视频输入可显著降低上下文占用而保持准确率，部分设置下略有提升。
AI.result: 在三个模型、多个长视频理解基准上，Sprout 相对代表性离线记忆方法取得相当或更优的准确率；且无需前期构建阶段，每问题的上下文成本更低。用文本化记忆替换累积视频输入显著降低上下文占用，准确率维持不降，某些设置下还略有改善。
AI.conclusion: 长视频记忆不必是离线一次性构建的静态资源，而可与问题驱动的推理过程共同生长。Sprout 以"低帧率扫描—停止—高帧率回访细化"的在线时间树机制，把记忆从被动资源变为随问答演化的动态结构，在降低成本的同时保持甚至提升精度，为多问题长视频理解提供了更经济的范式。

title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
summary: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.

AI.tldr: 提出 SolveEpIT 基准与 SolveEdiT-PLAN 两阶段视觉规划器，用"原子过渡契约"在无参考输出的条件下评估目标驱动的图像场景变换完成度与意外改动。
AI.motivation: 现实问题（摆放物体、修复布局、规划路线）本质是视觉的，需同时具备场景理解、目标差异推断与不破坏无关内容的执行能力；现有基准只评测感知、生成或显式指定的变换，目标驱动的视觉问题求解仍缺乏评测手段。
AI.method: 构建包含 2,728 个样例的 SolveEpIT 基准：给定图像与目标，模型需从请求、场景或视觉化规则中推断有效变换并执行。用原子过渡契约（atomic transition contracts）定义必须满足条件与受保护条件，从而以 SolveScore 度量完成度与意外改动，摆脱对单一参考输出的依赖。另提出 SolveEdiT-PLAN 两阶段规划器，先生成过渡实例再交给冻结的编辑器生成图像。
AI.result: 最强评测模型仅取得 57.0% SolveScore；SolveEdiT-PLAN 在匹配的单次生成评测下，跨三个生成器平均提升 9.1 分，GPT-Image-2 上从 57.0% 升至 71.6%，且未修改编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 目标驱动的视觉问题求解是当前模型的明显短板，显式的两阶段规划（先实例化过渡、后生成）可在不训练/不改动生成器的情况下显著增益，为该方向提供了基准与可迁移的方法范式。

title: ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA, a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: ReVA：面向遥感无人机视频问答的多模态大模型时空推理基准，含2438段视频、58万帧、2.2万问答对与11类任务。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感多模态推理基准存在模板化问题生成导致问题重复、以及使用静态图像而无法刻画无人机视频固有时序性的两大缺陷，遥感视频推理的系统性评估基本空白。
AI.method: 构建ReVA数据集：覆盖全球18个城市、2438段无人机视频（580K帧）、11项挑战性QA任务、22K高质量问答对；提出半自动标注流水线，结合文本LLM与MLLM生成问答并辅以人工校验；在ReVA上评测23个闭源与开源Video LLM。
AI.result: 评测揭示当前Video LLM在遥感视频的时空理解、场景中心理解与推理能力上存在根本性局限。
AI.conclusion: ReVA作为关键基准，推动遥感视频理解与面向真实部署的时序推理能力研究，代码与数据集已公开。

title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image.
